data.title: QA Engineer - Automation and Cloud
data.description:
About The Role

We are looking for a smart, analytical and technically strong QA Engineer who is passionate about product quality and enjoys solving complex technical problems. 

The ideal candidate should have strong hands-on experience in both manual and automation testing, along with good programming fundamentals and a solid understanding of APIs, backend systems, databases and cloud environments. 

We are not looking for someone who simply executes predefined test cases or raises defects. We want an engineer who thinks critically, understands how applications work internally, investigates issues independently and takes complete ownership of product quality. 

The individual will be responsible for owning the quality of assigned features/modules end-to-end, from understanding requirements and designing test scenarios to automation, debugging, defect investigation and release validation. 

Key Responsibilities

- Manual Testing & Quality Assurance
 - Analyse business requirements, functional specifications and acceptance criteria to develop comprehensive test scenarios. 
 - Design and execute functional, integration, regression, exploratory and end-to-end test cases. 
 - Identify edge cases, negative scenarios and potential failure points that may not be explicitly covered in requirements. 
 - Independently own testing activities for assigned features/modules. 
 - Validate complex business workflows, application behaviour and data integrity. 
 - Identify, reproduce, document and investigate defects with clear technical details. 
 - Collaborate with developers and product managers to ensure issues are understood and resolved. 
 - Participate in release validation and provide quality sign-off for assigned modules. 
 - Automation Testing
 - Develop and maintain automated test scripts using suitable automation technologies. 
 - Build reusable automation components, utilities and test scripts. 
 - Perform UI automation as well as API automation. 
 - Demonstrate good programming fundamentals, including OOP concepts, functions, data structures, exception handling and scripting. 
 - Maintain automation suites and troubleshoot flaky or inconsistent test cases. 
 - Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines. 
 - Identify opportunities to improve automation coverage, reliability and execution efficiency. 

Preferred technologies: Playwright, Cypress, Selenium, Pytest, JavaScript/TypeScript, Python or Java. 

Candidates with strong automation fundamentals in one technology should be comfortable transitioning to another. 

- API & Backend Testing
 - Perform comprehensive API testing, including positive, negative, integration and edge-case scenarios. 
 - Validate request/response payloads, headers, authentication, status codes and business logic. 
 - Understand REST APIs, JSON, HTTP/HTTPS and basic authentication mechanisms. 
 - Investigate issues across frontend, backend and service integration layers. 
 - Understand backend execution flows and dependencies between services. 
 - Read and interpret application code to identify potential root causes of defects. 
 - Database & Data Validation
 - Write SQL queries involving joins, subqueries, aggregations and other data-validation operations. 
 - Validate data consistency and integrity across application layers. 
 - Investigate database-level issues and discrepancies. 
 - Possess a good understanding of relational databases and basic NoSQL concepts. 
 - Independently validate backend data against expected business outcomes. 
 - Cloud & Infrastructure Understanding
 - Possess a good understanding of cloud computing fundamentals, preferably AWS and/or Azure. 
 - Understand how applications are deployed and operate in cloud environments. 
 - Analyse application logs, cloud logs and monitoring information to investigate issues. 
 - Understand environment configurations, environment variables, service dependencies and application connectivity. 
 - Possess basic networking knowledge, including DNS, ports, HTTP/HTTPS, timeouts and connectivity. 
 - Have working knowledge of Linux commands and command-line troubleshooting. 
 - Understand Docker fundamentals and container-based application deployment. 
 - Have basic familiarity with Kubernetes concepts. 

The ability to independently investigate application and environment-related failures using logs, configurations and other diagnostic information will be a significant advantage. 

- CI/CD & Engineering Collaboration
 - Understand Git, version control and basic branching workflows. 
 - Understand CI/CD pipelines and investigate automation or pipeline failures. 
 - Collaborate closely with developers, product managers and DevOps teams. 
 - Independently investigate technical issues before escalating them. 
 - Communicate defects, investigation findings and root-cause observations clearly. 
 - Production & Performance Testing Exposure
 - Participate in investigating production issues by analysing logs and helping identify potential causes. 
 - Understand the importance of application stability, reliability and performance. 
 - Exposure to performance testing tools such as JMeter or k6 will be an advantage. 
 - Basic understanding of security testing, authentication, authorization and role-based access control is desirable. 

Mandatory Skills & Qualifications

- 2-4 years of hands-on experience in software quality assurance. 
 - Strong fundamentals in manual testing and test case design. 
 - Practical experience in automation testing. 
 - Good programming fundamentals and scripting capabilities in at least one programming language. 
 - Experience with UI and API testing. 
 - Strong understanding of REST APIs, JSON and HTTP protocols. 
 - Good SQL proficiency and understanding of relational and NoSQL databases. 
 - Ability to analyse application logs and troubleshoot issues. 
 - Good understanding of backend systems and application architecture. 
 - Working knowledge of cloud environments, preferably AWS or Azure. 
 - Familiarity with Linux, Git, networking and CI/CD fundamentals. 
 - Ability to read application code and independently identify or narrow down potential root causes. 
 - Strong analytical, logical reasoning and problem-solving abilities. 

Good to Have

- Hands-on exposure to both AWS and Azure. 
 - Experience with Playwright or Cypress. 
 - Exposure to microservices-based architectures. 
 - Docker and Kubernetes troubleshooting experience. 
 - Experience with performance testing tools such as JMeter or k6. 
 - Familiarity with monitoring and observability tools. 
 - Exposure to production issue investigation. 
 - Experience improving existing automation frameworks. 

What We Are Looking For

- Someone who is naturally curious, analytical and inquisitive. 
 - Someone who thinks beyond predefined test cases and proactively identifies potential problems. 
 - A debugging-first mindset rather than a ticket-closing mindset. 
 - Strong ownership and accountability for assigned features/modules. 
 - Someone who can investigate problems independently instead of relying on developers for every technical clarification. 
 - An individual who is comfortable reading code, understanding application behaviour and working with backend systems. 
 - Someone who can quickly learn unfamiliar technologies and tools. 
 - A proactive team player with clear communication and collaboration skills. 

About Company

Hi there! We are Auriga IT. We power businesses across the globe through digital experiences, data and insights. From the apps we design to the platforms we engineer, we're driven by an ambition to create world-class digital solutions and make an impact. Our team has been part of building the solutions for the likes of Zomato, Yes Bank, Tata Motors, Amazon, Snapdeal, Ola, Practo, Vodafone, Meesho, Volkswagen, Droom and many more. 

We are a group of people who just could not leave our college-life behind and the inception of Auriga was solely based on a desire to keep working together with friends and enjoying the extended college life. Who Has not dreamt of Working with Friends for a Lifetime. 

Come Join In!

data.title: Assistant Manager/Manager Airside Controls & Automation
data.description:
Role: Assistant Manager/Manager -Airside Controls

Location: Gurgaon, India

Full/ Part-time: Full time

Build a career with confidence

Carrier Global Corporation, global leader in intelligent climate and energy solutions is committed to creating solutions that matter for people and our planet for generations to come. From the beginning, we've led in inventing new technologies and entirely new industries. Today, we continue to lead because we have a world-class, diverse workforce that puts the customer at the center of everything we do. 

About The Role

This role involves in designing and developing electrical and control systems for AHU units. 

Job Responsibilities

- Design and develop electrical and control systems for Air Handling Units (AHUs) in accordance with project specifications, customer requirements, applicable codes, and engineering standards. 
 - Develop and design electrical control panels, including MCC/control panels, starter panels, VFD/VSD panels, DOL and star-delta starter systems, control transformers, power supplies, protection, switching, and control devices. 
 - Select, specify, and appropriately size electrical and control components, including motors, VFDs, contactors, overload relays, MCBs, MCCBs, fuses, relays, sensors, actuators, terminal blocks, and associated accessories. 
 - Prepare and review electrical schematics, control circuit diagrams, wiring diagrams, single-line diagrams (SLDs), panel layouts, and interconnection drawings. 
 - Develop AHU control philosophy and control logic for supply, return, and exhaust fans; fresh-air and return-air dampers; heating and cooling systems; chilled-water valves; electric heaters; humidifiers; filtration systems; and associated monitoring and protection functions. 
 - Develop, configure, program, and troubleshoot microprocessor-based controllers for HVAC and industrial automation applications. 
 - Configure, program, and troubleshoot temperature, pressure, humidity, airflow, and other process control systems used in HVAC applications. 
 - Select, configure, integrate, and troubleshoot field instrumentation and devices, including temperature, humidity, pressure, differential-pressure, airflow sensors, actuators, valves, and controllers. 
 - Develop and configure HMI/SCADA systems for equipment monitoring, control, alarm management, data visualization, and system diagnostics. 
 - Design and implement communication and interface requirements between AHU electrical/control systems and Building Management Systems (BMS) and other HVAC automation platforms. 
 - Perform system integration, functional testing, validation, troubleshooting, and commissioning of electrical and automation systems. 
 - Diagnose, debug, and optimize existing electrical, control, and automation systems to improve system performance, reliability, and operational efficiency. 
 - Prepare electrical control panel designs using AutoCAD, EPLAN, or equivalent electrical engineering design tools, with preference for hands-on experience in panel design documentation. 
 - Perform electrical engineering calculations, including connected load, operating load, cable sizing, protective device selection, breaker ratings, short-circuit ratings, control transformer sizing, and panel ratings. 
 - Ensure all electrical and automation designs comply with applicable IEC, IS, NFPA, NEC, and other relevant international/local standards, as well as customer and project-specific requirements. 
 - Review and interpret AHU mechanical drawings, equipment layouts, and technical specifications to ensure effective coordination and integration of electrical, mechanical, and control systems. 
 - Prepare and maintain Bills of Materials (BOMs), cable schedules, I/O lists, equipment/component specifications, terminal schedules, technical datasheets, and other engineering documentation. 
 - Review customer specifications, tender requirements, approved drawings, and technical submittals, and incorporate relevant requirements and engineering changes into the design. 
 - Coordinate closely with Mechanical Engineering, Controls/Automation, Production, Procurement, Quality, Project Management, and Service teams to ensure timely and successful project execution. 
 - Provide technical support to the manufacturing and assembly teams during control panel fabrication, panel wiring, component installation, AHU assembly, and inspection activities. 
 - Provide technical support to the Service and Commissioning teams during site installation, testing, commissioning, troubleshooting, and customer handover. 
 - Conduct design verification, functional testing, electrical testing, and system validation to ensure compliance with design requirements and expected equipment performance. 
 - Investigate electrical, instrumentation, control, and automation-related issues, perform root-cause analysis, and implement effective corrective and preventive actions. 
 - Maintain and control engineering drawings, software programs, technical documentation, revisions, and as-built records for current and future projects. 
 - Support the development and implementation of engineering standards, design guidelines, standard control philosophies, and reusable design solutions for AHU applications. 
 - Identify opportunities for cost optimization, component standardization, design simplification, and product improvement without compromising safety, quality, reliability, or performance. 
 - Support continuous improvement initiatives related to AHU electrical systems, automation architecture, control logic, panel design, manufacturing processes, and field performance. 

Education Preferred

Bachelors degree in Electrical Engineering / Electronics & Electrical engineering, having 7-11 years of work experience in Airside products

Experience Preferred

Design & development experience required as below: 

Ø Essential Competencies/ Primary Skill Set

- Electrical System & Control Panel Design: Strong knowledge and hands-on experience in designing electrical systems, control panels, starter panels, MCC panels, and associated control and protection circuits. 
 - AHU/HVAC Electrical & Automation Systems: Sound understanding of electrical, controls, and automation systems used in Air Handling Units (AHUs) and HVAC applications. 
 - Motor Control & Protection: Proficiency in motor starting, control, protection, interlocking, and selection of appropriate protective devices for HVAC and industrial applications. 
 - VFD/VSD Applications: Practical knowledge of Variable Frequency Drives/Variable Speed Drives, including selection, configuration, parameterization, integration, and troubleshooting. 
 - Microprocessor/PLC/DDC-Based Controllers: Knowledge and experience in configuring, programming, integrating, and troubleshooting microprocessor-based, PLC, and DDC controllers used in HVAC and industrial automation applications. 
 - HVAC Instrumentation & Field Devices: Good understanding of HVAC sensors, transmitters, actuators, control valves, dampers, and other field devices, including their selection, installation, configuration, and troubleshooting. 
 - HMI/SCADA Systems: Experience in configuring and troubleshooting HMI/SCADA systems for equipment monitoring, process visualization, alarm management, data acquisition, and operational control. 
 - BMS Integration & Communication Protocols: Understanding of BMS integration and industrial communication protocols for seamless communication between AHUs, controllers, field devices, and building automation systems. 
 - Electrical Load & Cable Sizing: Competence in electrical load calculations, cable sizing, voltage-drop calculations, protective device selection, short-circuit ratings, and control panel sizing. 
 - Electrical Schematics & Panel Documentation: Ability to develop and interpret electrical schematics, single-line diagrams, control circuit diagrams, wiring diagrams, panel layouts, terminal schedules, and interconnection drawings. 
 - AutoCAD/EPLAN: Proficiency in using AutoCAD, EPLAN, or equivalent electrical design software for developing and maintaining electrical drawings and control panel documentation. 
 - System Integration, Testing & Commissioning: Ability to integrate electrical, controls, instrumentation, and automation systems and conduct functional testing, validation, troubleshooting, and commissioning activities. 
 - Electrical & Automation Troubleshooting: Strong troubleshooting skills with the ability to diagnose electrical, instrumentation, control, communication, and automation-related issues and implement effective corrective actions. 
 - Electrical & HVAC Standards: Good working knowledge of relevant electrical and HVAC standards, including IEC, IS, NFPA, NEC, and applicable customer/project-specific standards and requirements. 
 - Ability to interpret customer specifications and deliver technically sound, compliant engineering solutions
 - Ability to drive cross-functional collaboration (Mechanical, Electrical, Controls, Manufacturing, Sourcing) for project execution
 - Good communication skills to manage customer interactions, technical clarifications, and submittal approvals

Ø Desirable Competencies/ Secondary Skill Set

- Experience in handling customer-facing engineering discussions and approvals during project execution
 - Strong analytical thinking, problem-solving mindset, and ability to work in a fast-paced ETO/project environment
 - Ability to adapt quickly to an existing, complex environment. 
 - Analytical thinking, Problem solving, adaptability and strong communication skills. 
 - Self-starter who can work on his/her own initiative, balance demand load & prioritize

Benefits

We are committed to offering competitive benefits programs for all of our employees, and enhancing our programs when necessary. 

- Make yourself a priority with flexible schedules, parental leave
 - Drive forward your career through professional development opportunities
 - Achieve your personal goals with our Employee Assistance Programme

Our commitment to you

Our greatest assets are the expertise, creativity and passion of our employees. We strive to provide a great place to work that attracts, develops and retains the best talent, promotes employee engagement, fosters teamwork and ultimately drives innovation for the benefit of our customers. We strive to create an environment where you feel that you belong, with diversity and inclusion as the engine to growth and innovation. We develop and deploy best-in-class programs and practices, providing enriching career opportunities, listening to employee feedback and always challenging ourselves to do better. This is The Carrier Way. 

Join us and make a difference. 

Apply Now!

Carrier is An Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability or veteran status, age or any other federally protected class.

data.title: Power Platform & Copilot Studio Engineer
data.description:
About The Opportunity

Netrix Global is looking for a client-facing Power Platform / Copilot Studio Engineer to deliver business applications, workflow automation, and conversational agent experiences across the Microsoft ecosystem. 

This role will design and build solutions using Copilot Studio, Power Apps, Power Automate, Dataverse, SharePoint, and enterprise APIs. The engineer will work with business and technical stakeholders to translate processes into maintainable low-code solutions while clearly explaining platform limitations, governance requirements, and custom-code boundaries. 

The ideal candidate combines hands-on delivery expertise with strong process analysis, workshop facilitation, and solution ownership skills. Success means reducing manual effort through governed, reusable, and supportable solutions. 

How You Will Make An Impact

- Lead client discovery sessions to analyze business processes, clarify requirements, and identify the appropriate low-code or agent solution approach. 
 - Build Copilot Studio agents, Power Apps, and Power Automate workflows integrated with Dataverse, SharePoint, and external systems. 
 - Design and implement REST API integrations, custom connectors, Power Fx logic, and authentication patterns. 
 - Package and deploy solutions across environments using appropriate ALM, security, and governance practices. 
 - Configure Dataverse security, Power Platform environment controls, and agent authentication in coordination with client administrators. 
 - Create reusable components, connectors, documentation, support runbooks, and handoff materials. 
 - Troubleshoot cross-platform issues involving data, identity, connectors, Microsoft Teams, and Microsoft 365 services. 
 - Facilitate demonstrations, end-user training, governance coaching, and pre-sales or proof-of-concept (POC) sessions. 
 - Collaborate with AI, Microsoft 365 (M365), Full-Stack, and DevOps engineers when requirements extend beyond low-code capabilities. 

What You Will Bring To The Table

We are looking for a professional who combines technical ownership with strong client partnership. Success requires curiosity, accountability, practical judgment and the ability to move work forward while keeping stakeholders informed. 

- Communicates effectively with clients and internal stakeholders through discovery discussions, delivery updates, risk management and handoffs. 
 - Takes ownership of assigned responsibilities, drives tasks to completion and proactively escalates risks with supporting evidence. 
 - Solves unfamiliar problems through documentation, experimentation and collaboration rather than relying on step-by-step direction. 
 - Adapts to changing technologies, priorities and responsibilities while maintaining quality and security standards. 
 - Strengthens the engineering culture through peer reviews, knowledge sharing and professional client interactions. 

Qualifications

- 3-5 years of relevant professional experience. 
 - Hands-on experience with Copilot Studio, Power Apps, Power Automate, Dataverse, connectors, and SharePoint integration. 
 - Experience with REST APIs/custom connectors, Power Fx, solutions, environment deployment, and Power Platform security. 
 - Working knowledge of Entra ID fundamentals and authentication concepts. 
 - Strong business process analysis, requirements gathering, documentation, and stakeholder communication skills. 
 - Ability to explain low-code trade-offs and support client-facing discovery, estimation, and delivery. 
 - Power Platform ALM, deployment pipelines, or Azure DevOps. 
 - Microsoft Graph, Adaptive Cards, Teams integration, Azure Functions, Logic Apps, and AI Builder. 
 - Dataverse security and agent authentication. 
 - Exposure to PCF Controls, TypeScript/JavaScript, Power BI, Azure OpenAI, RAG fundamentals, Fabric, or Dynamics 365. 
 - Maintainable and governed low-code solutions. 
 - Reduced manual effort and faster process execution. 
 - Reusable connectors, components, and deployment patterns. 
 - Supportable Copilot Studio experiences with clear ownership and documentation. 

Work Schedule: This is a client-facing role. The successful candidate will be expected to participate in client meetings, discovery sessions, demonstrations, delivery reviews, and issue-resolution discussions during the assigned shift. 

Standard Shift: 1: 00 PM to 10: 00 PM India Standard Time (IST), equivalent to 2: 30 AM to 11: 30 AM Eastern Standard Time (EST). During U. S. daylight saving time, the equivalent schedule is 3: 30 AM to 12: 30 PM Eastern Daylight Time (EDT). 

About Us

At Netrix Global, our values are the philosophies and principles that we live by. They support our vision, help us achieve our goals, and commit us to a common purpose. 

We Own Outcomes, Win Together, Make An Impact, Enjoy The Journey, and Respect All!

Netrix Global is a mission-driven organization with the goal of providing the people, processes, and technology needed to run and scale modern, data-driven businesses that are always on and always secure. Our breadth of capabilities allows us to provide holistic offerings that solve even today's most complex business challenges, delivering to you an integrated, optimized, and future-proof solution. 

We work with clients of all sizes and specialize in solutions for healthcare, manufacturing, government, education, financial services, and legal industries. Netrix is consistently ranked in the CRN VAR500, detailing the country's top system integrators. 

At Netrix, we're driven to solve business problems with innovative technology solutions. We focus on end-users and are committed to client satisfaction. 

What You Can Expect From Us

We offer a competitive compensation package, comprehensive group benefits to meet the needs of you and your family, flexibility, and time off when you need it, and a casual work environment. The role can be remote/home office, with some travel required. 

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or veteran status. As part of this commitment, we will ensure that persons with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodations. If you need reasonable accommodations, please let us know by contacting NetrixHR@Netrixglobal.

data.title: Quality Assurance Lead
data.description:
Acuity Analytics (the trading name of Acuity Knowledge Partners) is a global, tech-first organization helping financial institutions and corporates make better decisions through research, data, analytics and AI-enabled solutions. We combine deep financial services expertise with strong engineering, digital and AI capabilities to solve complex, real-world problems. 

With a team of 7, 200+ analysts, data specialists and technologists across 28 locations, we work with more than 800 organizations worldwide to drive efficiency, unlock insight and deliver measurable impact. Our success is built on the strength of our people-by investing in talent, encouraging collaboration and creating room to grow, we enable our teams to do their best work for clients. 

Job purpose: 

Looking for a Test Lead / Data QA Engineer to drive and oversee data validation, manual testing, and regression testing activities across capital markets data pipelines spanning both legacy and modern platforms. The role is responsible for ensuring data accuracy, completeness, consistency, integrity, and adherence to business rules through source-to-target validation, schema verification, data reconciliation, lineage analysis, and automation-led regression testing. 

The successful candidate will lead test delivery, manage and coordinate offshore QA resources, and engage closely with business and technology stakeholders to maintain high-quality data across post-trade and enterprise data ecosystems. Key responsibilities include building reusable Python- and SQL-based validation frameworks, supporting batch and cloud-based execution models, identifying data anomalies, validating end-to-end data flows, and embedding robust data quality controls throughout the development lifecycle. 

The ideal candidate combines strong data QA and testing expertise, hands-on automation skills, capital markets domain knowledge, and a proactive ownership mindset to ensure data quality, consistency, and reliability across environments. 

Key competencies

- 8-12 years of hands-on experience in Data QA, Data Engineering QA, or Python-based automation roles and proven experience leading QA teams, test planning, estimation, execution, defect management, and end-to-end test delivery across complex data programs. 
 - Strong stakeholder management skills with the ability to communicate test status, risks, quality metrics, and release readiness to business and technology leadership. 
 - Experience establishing test strategies, governance frameworks, quality standards, resource planning, and mentoring distributed QA teams. 
 - Demonstrated ability to drive cross-functional collaboration, manage competing priorities, mitigate delivery risks, and ensure successful project outcomes in Agile environments. 
 - Strong Python skills for data validation, automation framework development, regression testing, and pipeline verification. 
 - Working knowledge of PySpark for validating large-scale data pipelines and distributed datasets. 
 - Solid SQL skills for source-to-target validation, reconciliation, complex queries, stored procedures, schema checks, and defect analysis. 
 - Experience in data QA, ETL/ELT testing, data pipeline testing, and regression testing across legacy and modern platforms. 
 - Proven experience building automation-first regression frameworks, reusable validation scripts, test cases, and data verification utilities. 
 - Strong understanding of data quality dimensions including accuracy, completeness, consistency, timeliness, uniqueness, referential integrity, and business-rule conformance. 
 - Experience validating metadata, schema structures, data types, constraints, lineage, transformation logic, and downstream outputs. 
 - Exposure to CI/CD tools such as Azure DevOps, Jenkins, or GitLab, with the ability to integrate automated tests and quality gates into deployment pipelines. 
 - Familiarity with batch orchestration tools such as AutoSys, Control-M, or Airflow. 
 - Good analytical skills to understand post-trade, financial, market data, or reference data and translate them into repeatable validation scenarios. 
 - Experience with JIRA, XRay, agile delivery practices, defect management, and QA process governance. 
 - Proficiency in leveraging AI-assisted tools such as Claude or GitHub Copilot to accelerate test case generation, SQL development, data validation, defect analysis, documentation, and test data creation. 
 - Strong communication, problem-solving, attention to detail, and cross-functional collaboration skills. Domain Experience (Must Have)

- Strong experience in Fixed Income Capital Markets domain
 - Good understanding of Fixed Income products, reference data, pricing, securities, positions, settlements, and trade lifecycle concepts
 - Experience working with market data, reference data, and regulatory reporting-related data sets

Nice to Have

- Exposure to Azure, AWS, ADF, containers, Kubernetes, or cloud-based data platforms. 
 - Experience with relational and NoSQL databases such as SQL Server, MongoDB, Cassandra, DynamoDB, or similar platforms. 
 - Exposure to Hadoop, Spark, Databricks, cloud data lakes, and Big Data validation. 
 - Experience validating batch, streaming, real-time, and Kafka-based ingestion pipelines. 
 - Capital markets domain exposure, especially post-trade, market data, reference data, trade data, or ION/blotter platform integrations. 
 - Exposure to DevSecOps, infrastructure as code, and code quality tools such as Terraform, Bicep, Sonar, Mend, or ZAP.

data.title: Director of Software
data.description:
We're Hiring | Director of Software
Company: BonV Aero | Location: Bhubaneswar | Employment Type: Full-Time

BonV Aero is looking for an experienced and technically accomplished Director of Software to lead our software development function, build a high-performing engineering team, and drive the development of scalable, advanced technology solutions. 

The ideal candidate will bring strong technical leadership, team-building capabilities, and expertise in areas such as Computer Vision, Guidance, Navigation & Control (GNC), and SWARM technology.

- Build and lead a competent software engineering team comprising senior and junior technical professionals. 
 - Hire and onboard 4 key technical members (2 Senior and 2 Junior). 
 - Develop domain expertise across Computer Vision, Guidance, Navigation & Controls, and SWARM technology. 
 - Ensure team stability, productivity, and timely delivery of technical milestones. 2. Technology Development & Delivery

- Lead the development of scalable SWARM technology solutions integrating hardware and software. 
 - Drive the development and integration of open-source SWARM technology stacks. 
 - Oversee the development of heterogeneous UAV SWARM systems. 
 - Lead the development of advanced air-to-ground and air-to-air targeting capabilities for VTOL platforms. 
 - Ensure solutions meet agreed technical and customer requirements and are successfully demonstrated to end users. 3. Strategic Contribution & Business Outcomes

- Drive timely execution of agreed technical milestones. 
 - Ensure developed solutions are reusable and scalable across multiple platforms. 
 - Drive innovation and intellectual property creation, with a target of at least 5 IPs within the department. 
 - Collaborate with business teams to convert pilots, trials, and demonstrations into business opportunities. 
 - Contribute towards overall business and revenue objectives. 

Key Performance Expectations
 - Successful hiring and onboarding of the core technical team within 3 months. 
 - Achievement of agreed technical development milestones within 12 months. 
 - Successful customer demonstrations and fulfilment of key customer requirements. 
 - Creation of a minimum of 5 intellectual properties. 
 - Effective team performance, stability, and contribution to business outcomes. 

Ideal Candidate Profile
 - Strong experience in software engineering leadership and managing technical teams. 
 - Years of experience 10 years - 15 years
 - Demonstrated expertise in relevant areas such as Computer Vision, GNC, UAV systems, and SWARM technology.

data.title: Design Quality Manager (QARA)
data.description:
Overview

Dozee Health AI is a pioneer in Contactless Remote Patient Monitoring (RPM), proven to drive transformation at scale. Headquartered in Bengaluru, India, Dozee has emerged as a leader in this category. We are seeking talented individuals to help us in this very exciting journey. Candidates will be working with top healthcare providers in the country and leverage RPM's innovation to tackle healthcare's biggest challenges - from resource constraints to quality outcomes, to new care models. 

Role Overview

As our Design Quality Manager, you will be part of Dozee's QARA - Quality Assurance & Regulatory Affairs team, leading Design Controls, Product Risk Management and Design Transfer activities in partnership with Product, Engineering and Manufacturing, and building and leading our Design Quality team. It is a high-ownership role for someone who brings structure, quality and pace to everything they deliver, and who wants to help improve patient care through connected health. 

- Champion design quality for Dozee's software and hardware medical devices across the product lifecycle, from user needs through design transfer and design changes. 
 - Lead design control and product risk management activities with Product, Engineering, Data Science and Manufacturing, in line with US FDA requirements (21 CFR 820 / ISO 13485) and applicable international standards. 
 - Build and develop the Design Quality team, embedded with the Bengaluru design team. 
 - Partner with Regulatory on the regulatory impact of design changes and on submission readiness. 

Responsibilities

- Drive the redesign of Dozee's design control and software lifecycle processes, and oversee their consistent use in line with 21 CFR 820 / ISO 13485, IEC 62304 and ISO 14971. 
 - Lead design quality activities across the product lifecycle, including design inputs, outputs, reviews, verification, validation, and design changes. 
 - Drive Design History File (DHF) development, maintenance, and remediation, ensuring documentation supports FDA submissions, including 510(k). 
 - Facilitate product risk management with the cross-functional team so risks are identified, assessed, controlled, and monitored throughout the product lifecycle including input from complaints and post-market data. . 
 - Partner with Engineering, Data Science and Product teams on software lifecycle quality, cybersecurity (FD&C Act Section 524B)and usability (IEC 62366). . 
 - Oversee design transfer to contract manufacturers, ensuring product specifications, processes, and quality requirements are effectively transferred and verified. 
 - Lead design quality reviews, audits, CAPAs, and remediation initiatives, ensuring timely resolution of quality gaps. 
 - Collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders to build a strong design quality culture and ensure regulatory readiness. 

Requirements

- 8-15 years of experience in Design Quality, Quality Assurance, or Medical Device Quality, preferably with at least 7 years of US medical device product experience. 
 - Strong experience with FDA design control requirements and medical device quality systems (21 CFR 820 / ISO 13485). . 
 - Hands-on experience with IEC 62304 software lifecycle and ISO 14971 risk management. 
 - Experience leading design control remediation or building and maintaining Design History Files (DHF) supporting 510(k) submissions. 
 - Experience managing design transfer activities with contract manufacturers. 
 - Exposure to cybersecurity design requirements for connected medical devices, including FDA requirements under FD&C Act Section 524B. 
 - Proven track building, leading, and developing a design quality team. 
 - Familiarity with the software as a medical device (SaMD) or AI/algorithm-based devices is a plus. 

Skills That Set You Up To Win

- Strong understanding of US FDA regulations, medical device quality systems, and design assurance requirements. 
 - Ability to translate regulatory requirements into practical design and engineering processes. 
 - Strong risk management, problem-solving, and quality remediation capabilities. 
 - Ability to influence and collaborate with senior leadership, Product, Engineering, Regulatory, and Manufacturing teams. 
 - Strong documentation and audit readiness skills, including supporting FDA inspections and notified body audits. . 
 - High ownership, attention to detail, and ability to drive quality standards in a fast-paced product development environment. 

Vision & Mission

Save Million lives with Health AI

Dozee is India's leading AI-Powered contactless Remote Patient Monitoring (RPM) and Early Warning System (EWS). A solution that continuously monitors patients and provides early warnings of clinical deterioration, enabling timely interventions and enhancing patient safety in hospitals, nursing facilities and patient homes. A "Made in India for the World" solution, Dozee has pioneered the world's first non-contact blood pressure monitoring system. Trusted by leading healthcare providers in India, the USA, and Africa, Dozee is transforming patient safety and care by enhancing outcomes and reducing costs. 

Dozee is adopted by 300+ hospitals and monitors 16000+ beds across 4 countries . Dozee has monitored over 1 Mn Patients, Delivered 35000+ Life Saving Alerts and Saved 10 Mn+ Nursing Hours. 

Videos

From AI Beds to Remote ICUs, Startups are plugging India's health Gaps

A tertiary care hospital study published in JMIR , validated Dozee's Early Warning System (EWS), showing it identified 97% of deteriorating patients, provided alerts ~19 hours in advance , and generated 5x fewer alerts, reducing alarm fatigue and improving patient outcomes. 

A study at King George Medical University, Lucknow, and published in Frontiers in Medical Technology demonstrated that Dozee's automation can potentially save 2. 5 hours of nursing time per shift , improving workflow efficiency and allowing more focus on patient care.

Research by Sattva , an independent consulting firm, demonstrates Dozee's substantial impact: for every 100 Dozee-connected beds, it can save approximately 144 lives , reduce nurses' time for vital checks by 80% , and decrease ICU average length of stay by 1. 3 days.

Role Overview

Lead the deployment, integration, and day-to-day operation of autonomous mobile robots (AMRs/AGVs), industrial robots, and cobots. This role bridges robotics software, industrial automation, networking, and operations to ensure safe, reliable, and scalable fleet performance. 

Key Responsibilities

- Manage multi-vendor AMR/AGV fleets, including task allocation, traffic management, charging, monitoring, and performance optimization. 
 - Implement and support VDA5050 communication and Open-RMF for multi-fleet interoperability and task orchestration. 
 - Develop and maintain ROS/ROS 2 applications, fleet adapters, and robot integrations. 
 - Design and troubleshoot communication systems using DDS, MQTT, Zenoh, and related middleware. 
 - Build and integrate REST, gRPC, and WebSocket APIs with WMS, MES, ERP, and dashboard platforms. 
 - Configure industrial networks, including Ethernet, Wi-Fi, VLANs, QoS, and robot connectivity infrastructure. 
 - Integrate robots/cobots with material flow and production systems. 
 - Develop peripheral-level PLC logic for I/O, interlocks, conveyors, docking stations, doors, and safety interfaces. 
 - Track fleet KPIs, perform root-cause analysis, and drive operational improvements. 
 - Support commissioning, validation, site acceptance testing, documentation, and operator training. 

Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Robotics, Mechatronics, Computer Science, Electrical/Electronics Engineering, or related field. 
 - 4+ years of experience in robotics fleet management, industrial automation, or autonomous systems. 
 - Hands-on experience with VDA5050, Open-RMF, ROS/ROS 2, MQTT/DDS, and API integration. 
 - Strong understanding of industrial networking (TCP/IP, VLANs, Wi-Fi, industrial Ethernet). 
 - Experience integrating KUKA and/or Mitsubishi robots and working with PLCs (Siemens, Beckhoff, Mitsubishi, or equivalent). 
 - Proficiency with Linux, Docker, Git, and production troubleshooting. 

Preferred Skills

- PROFINET, EtherCAT, EtherNet/IP, Modbus TCP. 
 - KUKA KRL or Mitsubishi MELFA programming. 
 - Knowledge of ISO 3691-4, ISO 10218, and collaborative robot safety standards.

What You'll Bring

- Strong systems-thinking across robotics, software, networking, and automation. 
 - Excellent troubleshooting and field-debugging capabilities.

data.title: Network Test Engineer
data.description:
Senior Test Analyst

APAC AWS Migration - Data Centre Exit (AU and NZ)

Location: Bangalore

About the Role

As Senior Test Analyst you will be a hands-on tester first and a leader second. You will design and run validation for the migration waves and Phase 2 workstreams yourself, and you will also be trusted to lead the testing effort for a project or workstream when needed: setting priorities, directing the offshore Tester/PIV team, and giving the program and our customers a clear, honest view of readiness at each go/no-go gate. You will be equally comfortable in a customer validation session and in a defect triage call. 

What You'll Do

Hands-on analysis and execution

- Analyse requirements and migration designs, and turn them into test scenarios, cases and acceptance criteria for each wave and workstream. 
 - Execute pre- and post-migration validation and regression testing, first in CST and then through production dry runs and cut-overs. 
 - Validate application behavior, integrations and performance after cut-over, including hypercare monitoring before the next wave proceeds. 
 - Test Phase 2 changes: network connectivity and latency over the new VPN and MPLS links, HSM operations after migration (key mapping, PIN translation, DUKPT and other cryptographic functions), and data integrity through the Oracle to Aurora PostgreSQL migration. 
 - Verify that rollback procedures work as designed, so the on-prem fallback can be trusted. 
 - Build and maintain test automation and reusable regression packs where they speed up repeated waves. 
 - Raise, triage and track defects through to closure, working with engineering and platform teams. Test planning and documentation

- Contribute to the test strategy and test plans, and own them for your workstream, including test summary reports per wave. 
 - Prepare go/no-go evidence packs for each cut-over. 
 - Provide estimates for effort, duration, tooling and environment needs (CST, AU2, AU1, NZ), covering both customer and Verifone dependencies. 
 - Manage the review and acceptance of test artifacts by the customer and project teams. Project leadership

- Lead the testing for a project or workstream end to end when required, including planning, progress tracking, risk management and reporting to the QA Manager and Program Manager. 
 - Direct the offshore Tester/PIV team by assigning tasks, setting priorities and reviewing their work, so that non-prod testing and prod dry runs can run in parallel. 
 - Coach and mentor less experienced testers, and share lessons learned after each wave so they feed into the next. 
 - Act as the QA contact for customer QA teams, including Phase 2 joint validation, and represent Verifone in customer sessions. 
 - Escalate risks and blockers early. What You'll Need to Be Successful

- At least 5 years' experience delivering strong QA outcomes through a mix of test automation and manual testing. 
 - Experience testing infrastructure, platform or cloud migrations (for example data centre to cloud, or lift-and-shift), including cut-over validation, regression and rollback testing. 
 - Proven ability to lead testing on a project or workstream, or to guide other testers, without needing a formal management title. 
 - Understanding of, and experience with, software systems in the payments industry, such as payment gateways, terminal management and transaction processing. 
 - Working knowledge of AWS and of network and security concepts (VPN, MPLS, firewalls, load balancers), enough to design meaningful test coverage and challenge assumptions. 
 - Solid experience in API testing and in validating integrations between systems. 
 - Thorough knowledge of QA lifecycle processes, including test data management, test planning, defect triage, management and reporting, and tools and techniques that automate the test and defect lifecycle. 
 - Strong background in Agile delivery and its tooling, with the ability to champion quality principles such as peer reviews, continuous integration, and test automation. 
 - Working knowledge of Atlassian tools, particularly Jira and Confluence (essential). 
 - Experience working with or directing offshore resources. 
 - Strong verbal and written communication skills, with customer-facing experience. 
 - Ability to work independently in a dynamic, fast-moving environment with competing priorities. Highly Preferred

- Experience testing HSM or cryptographic payment functions (for example PayShield, nShield, DUKPT, PIN translation, key ceremonies). 
 - Experience validating database migrations, such as Oracle to PostgreSQL. 
 - Experience in terminal payment testing, including EMV and card scheme certification. 
 - AWS certification, or experience working alongside AWS ProServe or similar partner teams. What Success Looks Like

- Every wave goes through CST, dry run and cut-over with clear, evidence-based go/no-go decisions. 
 - Few or no customer-impacting defects escape to production, and regressions are caught before cut-over. 
 - Phase 2 customer validation completes on schedule with the customer's sign-off. 
 - The workstreams you lead are planned, tracked and reported clearly, with test artifacts accepted without repeated rework. 
 - Less experienced testers on the team grow in confidence and capability.

data.title: Senior QA Engineer
data.description:
About Altura

Altura is an AI technology partner for companies that want technology to work inside their operation, not alongside it. We start by understanding the business. Before proposing anything, we map how the company actually runs: its processes, its systems, its data, and where the operational load sits. The goal is to find where technology has real leverage, and where it doesn't. We build the roadmap. Opportunities are prioritized by return, effort and dependencies, each one with defined scope, estimated investment, and the indicator it is meant to move. The company ends up knowing what to do first, what it costs, and how success will be measured. We implement. Custom software when existing tools don't cover what the operation needs. Automations that connect systems and remove manual work. AI agents that analyze information, decide and execute tasks within a process. And the infrastructure that makes all of it run reliably. We are not tied to a predefined solution - we choose the technology each business priority calls for. We stay after go-live. Solutions reach production and keep being improved. As the operation evolves, we identify what comes next. One team, from strategy through implementation and beyond. That is the whole point: technology projects usually break at the handoff, so we don't hand off. 

Responsibilities

We need a senior QA engineer for our system with 5+ years of experience who will be able to do: 

- Unit Testing
 - Validate individual functions and calculations. 
 - Test business logic and validation rules. 
 - Test edge cases, null values, and invalid inputs. 
 - Verify error handling and expected outputs. 

- Integration Testing
 - Test frontend and backend integration. 
 - Verify API and database interactions. 
 - Test third-party integrations. 
 - Validate data consistency and error handling between services. 

- Functional Testing
 - Test all features against acceptance criteria. 
 - Verify forms, validations, and user actions. 
 - Test authentication and user permissions. 
 - Verify successful and unsuccessful workflows. 

- End-to-End (E2E) Testing
 - Test all critical user workflows. 
 - Verify data flows correctly across the application. 
 - Test successful and failed transactions. 
 - Confirm expected results and notifications. 

- Regression Testing
 - Retest existing features after code changes. 
 - Run regression tests after bug fixes. 
 - Verify critical workflows after updates. 
 - Document any newly introduced defects. 

- Security Testing
 - Test authentication and authorization. 
 - Verify role-based access and permissions. 
 - Test input validation and common vulnerabilities. 
 - Verify sensitive data protection and secure API access. 
 - Check session management and access restrictions. 

- Performance Testing
 - Measure page load times and API response times. 
 - Perform load testing with expected user traffic. 
 - Test application behavior under peak loads. 
 - Identify bottlenecks and resource usage. 
 - Verify recovery after performance failures. 

- Usability and Accessibility Testing
 - Review navigation and user experience. 
 - Verify responsive layouts and readable content. 
 - Test keyboard navigation and screen-reader support. 
 - Check accessibility against agreed WCAG criteria. 
 - Validate error messages and user feedback. 

- Compatibility Testing
 - Test supported browsers and browser versions. 
 - Test desktop, tablet, and mobile devices. 
 - Verify supported operating systems. 
 - Check responsive layouts and screen resolutions. 

- User Acceptance Testing (UAT)
 - Validate features against business requirements. 
 - Execute agreed user acceptance scenarios. 
 - Document client feedback and requested corrections. 
 - Retest resolved acceptance issues. 
 - Obtain formal client approval. 

Requirements

- 5+ years of experience in QA engineering (required)
 - Comprehensive expertise across Unit, Integration, Functional, E2E, Regression, Security, Performance, Usability, Compatibility, and UAT testing (required)
 - Strong analytical and problem-solving skills (typically expected)
 - Experience working in agile environments and cross-functional teams (typically expected)

Benefits

- Competitive compensation package (to be discussed during the hiring process)
 - Remote work flexibility (to be discussed during the hiring process)
 - Opportunities for professional growth and continuous learning (to be discussed during the hiring process)

data.description:
Career Area

Engineering

Job Description

Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc. 

When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do - but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here - we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it. 

Role Summary

Caterpillar is seeking an Engineering Team Leader to help build the data foundation for its connected products. 

Caterpillar equipment generates large volumes of operational, engineering, diagnostic, and telematics data. Turning that data into trusted, understandable, reusable information requires more than collecting it. Data must have consistent definitions, appropriate context, clear ownership, measurable quality, discoverability, and controls governing how it is created and used. 

The Engineering Team Leader - Data Governance will provide technical and project leadership for initiatives that improve the quality, governance, metadata, standardization, and usability of connected-product data. 

This role will work across engineering, connectivity, digital products, data platforms, analytics, and AI teams to make Caterpillar data easier for both people and intelligent systems to discover, understand, and use appropriately. 

What You Will Do

Data Governance Leadership

- Lead initiatives that establish consistent definitions, ownership, standards, and governance for connected-product data. 
 - Define and improve processes for data quality, metadata, lineage, stewardship, retention, and lifecycle management. 
 - Help establish authoritative definitions and common data models across engineering and digital systems. 
 - Define measurable data-quality expectations and drive resolution of systemic data-quality issues. 
 - Ensure business and engineering context is captured alongside technical data definitions. 

Connected Equipment Data

- Work with teams responsible for telematics, equipment configuration, asset characterization, and other sources of connected-product data. 
 - Improve consistency between data generated by machines and the information consumed by engineering, analytics, condition monitoring, digital products, and AI. 
 - Coordinate improvements to data configuration, validation, and deployment processes. 
 - Identify opportunities to automate manual data-governance and data-quality activities. 

Data Products and Discoverability

- Help transform important datasets into clearly defined, reusable data products with known ownership, quality expectations, documentation, and interfaces. 
 - Improve metadata and cataloging so users can determine what information exists, what it means, where it originated, and how it should be used. 
 - Partner with enterprise data-platform and governance teams to connect engineering data with Caterpillar-wide data standards and tooling. 
 - Help establish data structures and governance practices that support analytics, machine learning, Generative AI, and agentic AI applications. 

Project and Technical Leadership

- Lead complex cross-functional data initiatives from problem definition through implementation and adoption. 
 - Develop project scope, priorities, roadmaps, milestones, and success measures. 
 - Coordinate engineers, data specialists, architects, product teams, and business stakeholders across multiple organizations. 
 - Identify dependencies, technical risks, and organizational barriers and drive them to resolution. 
 - Communicate project status, technical decisions, and recommendations to stakeholders and leadership. 
 - Mentor team members and strengthen data-governance and data-engineering capabilities across the organization. 

What You Have

Required

- Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Data Science, Information Systems, or another related technical discipline. 
 - Ability to communicate technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. 
 - Demonstrated ability to influence across organizational boundaries. 
 - Experience with data governance, metadata management, master/reference data, data catalogs, or data product management. 
 - Experience with telematics, IoT, connected products, industrial data, or engineering data. 
 - Experience with enterprise data catalogs such as Alation or comparable metadata/catalog platforms. 
 - Experience with data pipelines, APIs, SQL, Python, cloud data platforms, or modern data engineering. 
 - Experience with AI/ML data requirements and governance of data used by Generative AI and agentic systems. 
 - Experience working with globally distributed engineering and data teams. 

Why This Role Matters

AI and analytics are only as reliable as the data and context available to them. 

This role will help create the standards, metadata, quality controls, and reusable data structures that allow Caterpillar's connected-product data to become a dependable foundation for engineering, digital products, analytics, and AI. 

Location - Chennai

Relocation - Domestic

5 days work from office

November 12, 2026 - November 25, 2026

Caterpillar is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Qualified applicants of any age are encouraged to apply

data.title: AI DevOps Engineer – Platform & Infrastructure
data.description:
Hiring for PULS Group - via Flexiple, the recruiting partner on this role. 

About the Company

PULS is a German manufacturer of industrial DIN-rail power supplies, used by automation OEMs worldwide. Headquartered in Munich with about 1, 700 people globally, PULS is building an India-based IT and AI team that works directly with its Munich Software Development department. The team is relaunching the global PULS website as an AI-ready platform for 21 country sites in 7 languages and runs a growing portfolio of in-house AI solutions on Azure. 

About the Role

You will own the cloud infrastructure, CI/CD and operations behind the new global PULS website and the company's AI and agent infrastructure. The goal is a reproducible, highly available and secure Azure platform for 21 country sites, with committed uptime targets, defined RPO/RTO and restores that are actually tested. You will work closely with the Cybersecurity Engineer, the web developers and the AI team, GDPR-compliant with EU data residency. Coding agents such as Claude Code and Codex are part of the everyday toolkit, including for infrastructure code. 

What you'll do

- Build Azure infrastructure as code (Bicep for Azure-native workloads, Terraform where multi-cloud is needed), container setups on Azure Container Apps or AKS, and dev/stage/prod environments with preview deployments
 - Design high availability with replication and failover, committed uptime targets and defined RPO/RTO with regularly tested restores
 - Run load balancing, CDN (Azure Front Door) and caching for 21 country sites, including the China setup
 - Build CI/CD on GitHub Actions or Azure DevOps with OIDC instead of stored secrets, rollback, and automated quality gates: tests, SAST/DAST, IaC scans (Checkov, Defender for Cloud) and Core Web Vitals checks
 - Set up logging, metrics, alerting and dashboards (Azure Monitor, Application Insights or OpenTelemetry), including integration sync status and cloud cost control
 - Harden and patch, manage secrets in Azure Key Vault, run WAF/DDoS protection and backups, and operate managed PostgreSQL/MySQL with replication and safe migrations
 - Run Claude Code and Codex headless in pipelines with sandboxes and permissions, and deploy MCP servers and the runtime for AI search and the chatbot with the AI team

What you bring

- 4-6+ years in DevOps, SRE or platform engineering on production, customer-facing systems
 - Hands-on Azure: Container Apps or AKS, Azure Monitor, Key Vault and Entra ID
 - Infrastructure as code with Bicep or Terraform that you wrote and maintained across environments
 - CI/CD on GitHub Actions or Azure DevOps with security scanning and automated quality gates
 - Has operated PostgreSQL, MySQL or similar in production: backups, replication and performance tuning
 - Has designed monitoring and alerting and handled real incidents in live operations
 - Works AI-natively: uses Claude Code or Codex daily. Expect live pairing with a coding agent in the interview
 - English at C1 level and comfort working with colleagues in Munich and 21 markets

Nice to have

- Kubernetes depth, global CDN strategies and China deployments
 - Operating LLM/RAG workloads (Azure OpenAI, Microsoft Foundry)
 - FinOps and cloud cost control; WAF/DDoS and hardening in production

data.title: Engineering Manager II
data.description:
What You Will Do

Lead the Air Handling Unit (AHU) engineering function for the India region, owning both product development and manufacturing engineering. Build and manage a team of design, product development and manufacturing engineers to deliver competitive, India-specific AHU platforms from concept, design, prototyping and testing through to production release and ramp-up. Translate the needs of the Indian market, including tropical climate conditions, high latent loads, indoor air quality and energy-efficiency requirements, into reliable, cost-optimized and manufacturable products. Partner with manufacturing, quality, supply chain, sales and marketing to ensure product feasibility, on-time launches and alignment with business goals. Drive manufacturing excellence on the shop floor through robust processes, lean practices and continuous cost and quality improvement. Ensure compliance with relevant codes, standards and safety regulations, mentor engineering talent, and support customer-facing teams with technical expertise and engineered-to-order solutions. 

How You Will Do It

- Lead and manage a multi-disciplinary team of design, product development and factory engineers for AHU products, including modular, double-skin, ceiling-suspended, fresh-air/heat-recovery and hygienic/clean-room AHUs. 
 - Drive end-to-end new product development for India-specific AHU platforms, from voice of customer and concept through design, prototyping, validation, certification and production release, using a stage-gate approach. 
 - Oversee AHU design covering casing and panel construction, thermal-break profiles, coils, fan and motor selection (including EC/plug fans), filtration, heat recovery devices, dampers and acoustic treatment. 
 - Lead manufacturing engineering hands-on: process design, plant and line balancing and capacity planning for AHU production. 
 - Own new product introduction (NPI) into the factory, including pilot builds, first-article inspection, process qualification and smooth ramp-up to volume production. 
 - Drive DFM/DFA, value analysis/value engineering (VA/VE), localization and cost-reduction programs in partnership with procurement and the Indian supply base. 
 - Establish and maintain engineering and manufacturing documentation, including 3D models, drawings, BOMs, routings, work instructions, PFMEA and control plans, with accurate data in PLM/ERP systems. 
 - Improve productivity, quality and yield on the shop floor using Lean, 5S, Kaizen, SMED and Six Sigma tools, and reduce cost of poor quality. 
 - Plan and oversee product testing and validation, including casing leakage, deflection, thermal bridging, airflow, thermal and acoustic performance. 
 - Ensure product compliance with relevant standards such as EN 1886, EN 13053, AHRI 430/1350, Eurovent, ASHRAE/ISHRAE guidelines, ECBC, BIS and applicable safety regulations. 
 - Support sales, application and customer teams with technical expertise, product selection and customized or engineered-to-order solutions. 
 - Collaborate with global engineering centers to adapt global AHU platforms for India and to leverage India manufacturing for export markets. 
 - Mentor and develop engineers, and foster a safety-first culture of continuous improvement and cross-functional collaboration. 

Required

What we look for

- Bachelor's degree (BE/B. Tech) in Mechanical Engineering. 
 - 10+ years of experience in HVAC, with strong hands-on AHU product development experience for the India market, including at least 3 years in a leadership or managerial role. 
 - Proven hands-on experience managing manufacturing engineering in an AHU or HVAC equipment manufacturing environment, including process development, tooling, layout and NPI. 
 - Strong knowledge of psychrometrics, thermodynamics, heat transfer, fluid mechanics and fan/airflow fundamentals. 
 - Sound understanding of AHU manufacturing processes such as sheet-metal fabrication, panel foaming (PU/PIR), coil manufacturing and final assembly. 
 - Proficiency in CAD and PLM/ERP tools (e. g. , Creo, SolidWorks, AutoCAD, Windchill, SAP). 
 - Experience with product development processes, DFMEA, PFMEA, DVP&R, APQP and stage-gate methodologies. 
 - Familiarity with Indian and global AHU standards and certifications (EN 1886, EN 13053, AHRI, Eurovent, ECBC, BIS). 
 - Excellent communication, project management and team leadership skills. 

Preferred

- Master's degree in Mechanical Engineering or an MBA. 
 - Experience with hygienic, clean-room, pharma, healthcare or data center AHU applications. 
 - Lean Six Sigma Green Belt or Black Belt certification. 
 - Exposure to CFD/FEA tools and AHU selection software. 
 - Prior experience working with global teams and suppliers.

Job Description

Honeywell is looking for a Senior Full Stack Developer to help build and evolve enterprise-scale platform services supporting Honeywell Forge and the Cognition platform. 

This role is suited for a strong hands-on software engineer with 5+ years of experience developing modern applications, APIs, backend services, and distributed systems. The engineer will contribute across user experiences, APIs, microservices, data and messaging infrastructure and containerized deployments. 

You will work closely with technical leads, architects, SRE, cybersecurity, QA, product, and other engineering teams to translate product and architecture requirements into secure, scalable, maintainable, and production-ready software. The ideal candidate is comfortable owning features and services from design and implementation through automated testing, deployment, integration, troubleshooting, and production readiness. 

Responsibilities

Key Responsibilities

Full-Stack & Platform Engineering

- Design and develop containerized microservices and distributed platform components. 
 - Implement well-defined service interfaces, APIs, contracts, and reusable abstractions. 
 - Develop event-driven services using RabbitMQ or similar messaging technologies and asynchronous processing patterns. 
 - Build services interacting with relational databases, time-series data stores, caching technologies, and file/object storage. 
 - Implement reliable service-to-service communication, error handling, retry, and integration patterns. 
 - Troubleshoot issues across distributed services and their dependencies. 
 - Develop software that can support deployment across Azure, GCP, Alibaba Cloud, and Cognition environments. 
 - Contribute to a common platform codebase while maintaining appropriate separation between common functionality and provider-specific implementations. 
 - Apply abstraction and adapter patterns where needed to minimize unnecessary cloud-provider dependencies. 
 - Develop software capable of operating in Cognition edge/appliance environments, including deployments with limited or restricted connectivity. 
 - Build platform components with appropriate consideration for CPU, memory, storage, and network utilization. 
 - Develop and support services deployed in Kubernetes-based environments. 
 - Contribute to installation, configuration, upgrade, and lifecycle-management capabilities for platform services. 
 - Follow engineering and security requirements associated with regulated, restricted-connectivity, or air-gapped deployments. 

Engineering & Collaboration Expectations

- Take ownership of assigned features, services, and technical problems with limited supervision. 
 - Translate technical designs and requirements into high-quality working software. 
 - Participate constructively in architecture and design discussions. 
 - Provide thoughtful code reviews and help maintain engineering standards. 
 - Collaborate effectively with technical leads, architects, Product Owners, SRE, cybersecurity, QA, and application teams. 
 - Identify technical risks, dependencies, maintainability concerns, and integration issues early. 
 - Diagnose technical issues spanning applications, services, messaging, databases, Kubernetes, and infrastructure. 
 - Contribute to technical investigations and proof-of-concepts for new technologies or platform capabilities. 

Qualifications

Core Technical Qualifications

The ideal candidate should have solid hands-on experience with most of the following: 

- Modern full-stack application development
 - Web application architecture and modern frontend engineering
 - RESTful APIs and backend service development
 - . NET and C# development
 - Microservices and distributed-system concepts
 - Event-driven architecture and asynchronous processing
 - RabbitMQ or comparable enterprise messaging technology
 - SQL and relational databases, particularly PostgreSQL or comparable platforms

 - Data-processing and persistence concepts
 - Authentication, authorization, and secure API design
 - Automated unit, API, component, and integration testing
 - Observability, structured logging, and production troubleshooting
 - Git-based development, branching, pull-request, and release workflows

Strong hands-on experience with . NET/C# is particularly relevant to the existing platform-services landscape. 

Experience Profile

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical discipline, or equivalent practical experience. 
 - 5+ years of professional software-development experience, with substantial hands-on development responsibility. 
 - Strong experience building production-quality backend, full-stack, or platform software. 
 - Experience developing services using microservice, API-driven, and distributed-system architectures. 
 - Practical experience with containerized applications, automated testing, and CI/CD. 
 - Ability to independently design and deliver moderately complex software components and features. 
 - Experience troubleshooting applications and distributed services in development, integration, or production environments. 

Preferred / Differentiating Experience

Experience in one or more of the following areas would be valuable: 

- Industrial IoT or connected-device platforms
 - Edge computing or appliance-based software

data.description:
About Albertsons

As a leading food and drug retailer in the United States, Albertsons Companies, Inc. (ACI) operates over 2, 200 stores across 34 states and the District of Columbia. About Tech Hub In India

Albertsons Companies India (ACI India) is part of Albertsons Companies Inc. global workforce. As Albertsons' first significant strategic investment in India, it serves as a collaborative hub, supporting Albertsons in driving innovation and efficiency across Technology, Digital, and other key business functions. The employees at the India GCC will play a pivotal role in enhancing the company's digital transformation, customer engagement, and operational excellence. 

We are excited to announce an opening for Sr. Manager, AIDLC at ACI. Please find below the details of the role and its responsibilities. 

Roles & Responsibilities

- Own the AIDLC (AI-driven development lifecycle) workstream end to end: roadmap, delivery and outcomes. You report to the AI First head. 
 - Lead a pod of engineers who build agents across the software development lifecycle: requirements and design, code review before merge, security-finding remediation, test generation, release and path to production, and SRE and incident support. 
 - Stay hands-on for roughly a quarter of your time. Write code, build prototypes and review agent pull requests, so you judge agent designs and eval results first hand. 
 - Build the organization: define roles and levels, hire and onboard engineers, coach them, and set engineering standards for AI-authored and AI-assisted code. 
 - Set the technical direction for agent architecture: orchestration, tool and function calling, MCP servers (including code knowledge graphs exposed over MCP), memory and state management, context engineering and RAG over engineering knowledge. 
 - Make evals a release gate. Every agent, prompt and model change passes golden datasets, LLM-as-judge scoring calibrated against human review, and regression suites before it ships. Require tracing and observability for agents in production. 
 - Define outcome metrics and measure them against the pre-agent baseline: delivery speed and cost, defects, security findings, cycle time and change failure rate. Report outcomes, not login counts or seat usage. 
 - Drive adoption and change management: run pilots with engineering teams, collect feedback, change how teams work, and retire agents that do not earn their place. 
 - Set governance and guardrails for agents that touch source control, CI/CD and cloud: least-privilege tool access, prompt-injection defence, human approval points, and an action trail that can be reviewed and reversed. 
 - Govern multi-agent systems: trust boundaries between agents, rules for delegation, an audit trail across agent handoffs, and the points where a human must approve. 
 - Govern token and compute cost: budgets, model routing, cost per successful outcome, and usage reporting to leadership. 
 - Run vendor and build-vs-buy evaluations for agent platforms, models and tooling, including multi-model support, with clear criteria. 
 - Use agentic coding tools every day (e. g. Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Cursor) and set norms for how the pod and its partner teams use them. 
 - Partner with Security, Cloud, Data, Product, Enterprise Architecture and the AI governance group so agents fit existing toolchains and meet security, legal, risk and compliance standards. 
 - Run agents in production: reliability targets, observability, incident response and a named owner for every agent. 

Experience Required

- AI experience is a MUST. You have personally built and deployed an LLM agent or agentic workflow used by real users in the last 2 years, with evals and tracing in place. Describe it in your application or link a repo or demo. 
 - 12-15 years of software engineering experience, including 4+ years leading engineering teams: hiring, performance management and delivery accountability. 
 - Hands-on programming in Python, Java or TypeScript, used to build agents and the services around them. The agents work on Java/Spring and React/Angular codebases. 
 - Working depth in agent orchestration, tool/function calling, MCP, memory and state management, context engineering and RAG. You can review a multi-agent design and say where it will fail. Frameworks are examples only (e. g. LangGraph, LangChain/LangSmith, Claude Agent SDK, OpenAI Agents SDK, Google ADK). 
 - Experience running evals in practice: golden datasets, LLM-as-judge, regression testing, and using the results to block or approve a release. 
 - Experience with tracing and observability for LLM applications, and with guardrails, prompt-injection defence and human-in-the-loop design. 
 - Everyday use of agentic coding tools (e. g. Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Cursor) in your own work, not only as a sponsor of them. 
 - Experience owning an adoption program with measured outcomes (cycle time, change failure rate, defects, cost) rather than usage counts. 
 - Experience managing LLM cost: token budgets, model selection and routing, and scaling agent workloads. 
 - Experience evaluating vendors and making build-vs-buy decisions for AI platforms. 
 - Cloud experience on Azure and/or Google Cloud Platform. 
 - Strong communication with senior leadership, engineering teams and risk partners. 
 - A plus: agent-to-agent (A2A) protocol, code knowledge graphs or GraphRAG, building internal developer platforms. 

Competencies

- Compassionate and kind, showing courtesy, dignity, and respect. They show sincere interest and empathy for all others. 
 - Foster innovation through creativity to get to a workable solution. Use analytical thinking through issues using logic and reason
 - Show integrity in what is done and how it is done - without sacrificing personal/business ethics. 
 - Embrace an inclusion-focused mindset, seeking input from others on their work and encouraging the open expression of diverse ideas and opinions
 - Team-oriented, positively contributing to team morale and willing to help. 
 - Learning-Focused, finding ways to improve in their field and use positive constructive feedback to grow personally and professionally
 - Think strategically and proactively anticipate future problems, needs or changes in the work
 - Delighting our customers and maintaining customer relationships are top priority and they work to always deliver solutions through this lens
 - Ability to learn newer technologies, methodologies, and solutions in the cloud technology space. 
 - Ability to collaborate across organizational boundaries, build relationships, and achieve broader organizational goals. 

Skills Required

- Agentic AI and Multi-Agent Systems: design review and governance
 - Agent Evals, Tracing and Observability
