data.title: Data Quality and Test Automation Engineer
data.description:
ELLKAY started out providing connectivity solutions to laboratories and within a few years, grew to also provide data management solutions to ambulatory organizations. ELLKAY is now a trusted data management partner in five healthcare segments. ELLKAY's solutions continue to serve laboratories and ambulatory practices and have expanded to empower hospitals and health systems, healthcare IT vendors, ambulatory practices, health plans, and other healthcare organizations with cutting-edge technologies and solutions that drive their growth and interoperability strategies. 

Today, ELLKAY remains true to our core values, building strong partner relationships and offering unparalleled service and support while providing innovative, scalable solutions to the challenges our customers face in today's data-rich world. 

ELLKAY's experience, customer-focused approach, and reputation for innovation, speed, and accuracy differentiate ELLKAY as a premier partner for your interoperability needs and data management strategy. 

Job Description

Develop, execute, and maintain automated tests for healthcare data pipelines, integrations, transformations, and reporting outputs. Use SQL and Python to validate data mappings, reconcile source and target records, and identify missing, duplicate, inconsistent, or incorrectly transformed data. Work within established frameworks to provide dependable validation evidence and timely feedback on data quality. 

Reporting and collaboration

Report to the Senior Manager QE Technology and Innovation and receive technical guidance from the Senior Data Quality Engineer and Principal Quality Architect. Collaborate with Data Engineering, product QEs, analysts, and the Healthcare SME to validate assigned data flows against documented business rules. 

Key Responsibilities

Review data requirements, source-to-target mappings, business rules, and acceptance criteria to identify test scenarios and expected results. 

Develop and maintain SQL- and Python-based automated checks using approved data-testing frameworks and reusable utilities. 

Validate data completeness, accuracy, consistency, timeliness, uniqueness, and referential integrity across assigned datasets. 

Reconcile source and target records, counts, totals, and key attributes across ingestion, transformation, and reporting layers. 

Test batch and incremental loads, schema changes, error handling, retries, and recovery scenarios under senior technical guidance. 

Prepare approved synthetic or masked datasets and follow access, privacy, and sensitive healthcare data-handling procedures. 

Execute data regression tests within CI/CD pipelines, analyze failures, and maintain clear validation results and test evidence. 

Document reproducible data defects, collaborate with Data Engineers on investigation, and verify fixes and affected downstream outputs. 

Use approved AI tools to assist with SQL, Python, test scenarios, and failure analysis while validating generated outputs and protecting sensitive data. 

Maintain existing data-quality checks and alerts, contribute to code reviews, and add regression coverage for assigned production data issues. 

Page

Experience And Qualifications

3+ years in software testing, quality engineering, or data validation, including 2+ years of hands-on ETL/ELT or database testing and SQL-based validation. Experience may overlap. 

Required Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, information systems, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. 

3+ years of relevant testing or data-validation experience, including 2+ years validating data pipelines, transformations, or databases. 

Hands-on SQL skills, including joins, aggregations, subqueries, and reconciliation queries across related datasets. 

Working Python skills for automated data checks, test execution, result comparison, and debugging. 

Understanding of ETL/ELT, relational data models, source-to-target mappings, data-quality dimensions, and batch or incremental processing. 

Experience using Git, defect-tracking tools, and automated testing practices; familiarity with CI/CD workflows. 

Ability to explain data discrepancies, produce reproducible evidence, collaborate with engineers, and handle confidential information responsibly. 

Preferred Qualifications

Healthcare data experience involving clinical, laboratory, patient, provider, claims, eligibility, or other relevant workflows. 

Exposure to a cloud data platform such as Databricks, Snowflake, Azure, AWS, or GCP and frameworks such as pytest, dbt tests, or Great Expectations. 

Familiarity with API or file-based integrations, HL7/FHIR where relevant, and approved AI coding or testing assistants. 

Success measures

Reliable automated coverage of assigned critical data rules and reconciliation controls, with timely completion of planned validation work. 

Clear, reproducible evidence for data defects and dependable verification of fixes and regression outcomes. 

Reduced manual reconciliation effort and growing independence in SQL, Python, data testing, and failure investigation. 

Working expectations

Collaborate with India engineering teams and U. S. stakeholders with agreed working-hour overlap. Follow shared testing standards and approved data-access policies, and support release validation and production data investigations under senior guidance. 

Additional Information

At ELLKAY, we are committed to operating as a hybrid workplace, offering employees flexibility in how they structure their time between in-office and remote work. We recognize the significance of fostering connections, collaboration, and creativity within our office culture and its positive impact on our business. Our philosophy of operating as a hybrid workplace underscores our dedication to enabling employees to tailor work-life balance to their individual preferences. For those who do not live within 40 miles of one of our offices, we are open to considering remote work for candidates whose skills and experience strongly align with the role. While we prioritize a hybrid work environment for most roles, we understand the importance of flexibility and are open to remote work for specific positions and specialized skill sets. 

For more information on our company, visit www. ELLKAY. com. 

ELLKAY LLC is a Smoke-Free Workplace. 

ELLKAY, LLC provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.

data.title: Senior QA Engineer | Onsite
data.description:
About Pristine Data AI

Pristine Data AI is an AI-native, agentic go-to-market platform. We replace the fragmented sales stack (data, enrichment, sequencing, calls, research, reporting) with one full-funnel platform. Revenue teams use it to find prospects with natural language search, enrich records from multiple data sources, personalize outreach with real context, and act on live buying signals. 

The role

We're hiring a Senior QA Engineer to own the quality of our product, full-time and onsite in our Chennai office. The job goes beyond confirming that a feature works. You'll need to know whether it does what our customers need, so we want someone who learns who our buyers and users are, what they're trying to get done, and what success looks like for them. That understanding is what makes UAT smooth instead of a scramble at the end. 

What you'll do

- Design and run test plans and test cases for web and AI-driven features, covering positive, negative, edge and regression scenarios
 - Do manual and exploratory testing across the platform, find defects, trace root causes and see them through to closure
 - Turn business goals and customer success criteria into acceptance criteria before development starts, not after
 - Work closely with engineering, product and data teams to resolve issues and raise risks early
 - Review product requirements and push back when something is unclear or untestable
 - Take part in release planning and help define quality standards, QA processes and documentation
 - Use AI tools thoughtfully to move faster: generating test cases, building test data, analyzing logs and speeding up regression coverageHow we think about AI

We're AI-native from the ground up, and we expect our team to work that way too. We want people who use AI to do better work faster, and who also know where it falls short and when to check its output. If you've built AI into your QA workflow, tell us how. 

What we're looking for

- Strong grounding in QA and software testing, including setting up and maintaining QA processes
 - Hands-on manual testing experience with web applications, ideally data-driven or AI-based products
 - Experience with functional, regression, integration and system testing
 - Comfort with Jira or similar tools, test management tools and version control
 - Real curiosity about the business: who buys, who uses the product and what a good outcome looks like for them
 - Clear communication: precise bug reports, good questions and concerns raised early
 - Critical thinking and systematic problem-solving
 - Comfort with agile, fast-moving teams and shifting priorities
 - Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a related field, or equivalent practical experienceNice to have

- Experience with test automation tools or frameworks
 - Prior senior or lead QA experience
 - Experience testing LLM-powered or agentic features, where outputs aren't deterministic
 - Exposure to B2B SaaS, sales tech or GTM toolsHow we work

We value ownership, integrity and respect. We give direct feedback and expect it back, and we share what we know with each other. 

Location: Onsite, Chennai, India. This role is not remote or hybrid.

data.description:
Job Description

As a Sr Director here at Honeywell, you will lead and manage a large team to drive strategic initiatives and operational excellence within Honeywell Connected Industrials. You will play a pivotal role in shaping the direction of our industrial software solutions and ensuring the delivery of impactful outcomes for our customers. 

You will report directly to the Chief Technology & Software Portfolio Leader, PA, with metrics reporting to VP Engineering, HTCS-PA & IA R&D. This position is based in Bangalore, India, and follows an on-site work schedule. 

In this role, you will impact the growth and success of Honeywell Connected Industrials by managing a team of approximately 450 employees, driving innovation, operational efficiency, and customer satisfaction in the industrial software domain. 

Responsibilities

Technology and Business leadership

- Leader for all the technology teams that align to the HCI in HTCS and accountable for deliverables on Global programs/HGR and India programs. 
 - Drive the execution of product development and ensure on time delivery, cost and quality specs. 
 - Work with Offering, Marketing, Commercial teams to develop a robust program/project/product pipeline and roadmap. Work closely with India & Middle East business team to drive products and solution for regional business growth 
 - Work with offering teams to do competitor benchmarking to determine baseline of competitor product features and areas of differentiation/advantage. 
 - Leading continuous improvement efforts through the institutionalization of Agile and other practices like Honeywell Operating System (HOS), Z21 (Zero to 1st revenue) and driving process maturity (ex: CMMi Level 5). 
 - Continuously challenge status quo to adopt Gen AI and similar technologies into delivery, deriving productivity and modernization of technology offerings - also driving AI in Products which will deliver incremental growth and revenue. 

Strategy & Innovation

- Support and develop strategic priorities (STRAP) for HTCS/HCI (Honeywell connected Industrial) in alignment with global teams. Plan and execute Annual Operating Plan (AOP) aligned with business goals. 
 - Responsible for formulating strategies for growth, innovation, execution & talent 
 - Establishing benchmarks on cycle time performance & demonstrating year on year improvements in productivity through reuse, automation, simulation, modelling, etc. 
 - Influence Product roadmaps for the global and regional markets. Work closely with regional, India and global product marketing leaders for idea conceptualization and innovation to drive regional market growth. 
 - Participating in the organization building practices such as framing of organizational policies, Organization design, strategic priorities and future directions of the organization. 

Talent Management and Development

- Drive Honeywell & Honeywell Technology Solutions Values & Behaviors and culture across the team. 
 - Responsible for Honeywell Performance Development (HPD), Global Compensation Planning (GCP), Management Resource Reviews (MRR), Technical Resource Reviews (TRR) and rewards and recognition for the HTCS/HCI 
 - Mentor / coach / guide experienced leaders reporting into this role. 
 - Driving effective people practices through effective hiring strategy, rewarding, motivating & retention strategy and talent differentiation for high performance. 
 - Responsible for developing people and competencies that are required for future growth with specific emphasis on building top talent for key leadership positions and tracking succession depth for all key positions. 
 - A good people leader, quick to identify people problems, fosters teamwork and ensures transparency and fairness in all actions, also a demanding leader who makes people better through challenges and by holding people accountable to unfaltering performance 
 - Displays courage and confidence without arrogance, positive even in tough situations, initiates change and challenges the status quo. 
 - Good communicator of vision, ideas and work requirement. Should have demonstrated transformational results (Innovation, Productivity, Technology) through cross collaboration

Qualifications

YOU MUST HAVE

- Extensive experience managing large teams and driving operational excellence in industrial or technology sectors. 
 - Strong leadership skills with the ability to influence and drive change across multiple levels of the organization. 
 - Deep knowledge of industrial software, digital transformation, and autonomous operations. 
 - Proven track record in strategic planning, resource management, and delivering business results. 

WE VALUE

- Bachelor's degree in Engineering or related field (Master's degree preferred) 
 - Strong leadership and team management abilities 
 - Ability to drive innovation and foster a culture of continuous improvement 
 - Experience with engineering best practices and quality standards 
 - Knowledge of industry trends and advancements in the relevant engineering discipline 
 - Strong commitment to safety, quality, and compliance

About Honeywell Technologies

Honeywell Technologies is a global, pure-play automation company with a legacy of innovating to help solve the world's most mission-critical challenges, enhancing the quality of life for people and communities around the world. We serve the building, industrial, and process sectors with a broad portfolio of services, solutions, and products, underpinned by our Honeywell Technologies Accelerator operating system and Honeywell Technologies Forge intelligence layer. By combining the deep domain expertise of our more than 50, 000 employees with decades of data from our global installed base, we are uniquely positioned to lead the industrial sector's transition from automation to autonomy. Learn more

THE BUSINESS UNIT

To unlock the next level of value, businesses are ramping up efforts to profitably improve safety, sustainability, and productivity with intelligent autonomous operations. This is a journey of increasing digital maturity fueled by improved intelligence with AI-embedded operations. To reach this goal, industrial companies need industrial-grade software that enables the delivery of domain-specific outcomes. Honeywell Connected Industrials (HCI) offers industrial operations products that drive outcomes for asset reliability, safety, competency, and productivity, end-to-end process optimization, OT cybersecurity, sustainability, and operational excellence. Honeywell Connected Industrials provides enterprise and site-specific solutions designed to improve performance, reach sustainability goals, and craft a rock-solid security network.

Job Description

The Core Engineering

Responsibilities

The Core Engineering builds and operates the platforms, applications, data solutions, models, and analytics that power critical processes for The Core divisions of the firm (e. g. , Risk, responsible for the risk profile of firm activities; Controllers, responsible for the financial control and reporting obligations; Compliance, responsible for the firm's compliance, regulatory, and reputational risks; Corporate Treasury, responsible for the firm's liquidity, funding, balance sheet, etc. ; and Human Capital Management, responsible for attracting, developing, and managing a global workforce). A centralized engineering structure in support of The Core enables a common platform model and operating framework that promotes consistent governance and scalable solutions, leveraging cloud, AI, and machine learning for innovation and efficiency. The Core Engineering's 2, 000+ engineers and strats deliver engineering, data, analytics, and quantitative capabilities within six business units: 

- Metrics & Analytics Platforms: responsible for the measurement and management of the firm's risk, capital, and liquidity for The Core functions 
 - The Core Strats: responsible for the development and implementation of models and other quantitative methodologies, including the accuracy and attribution of modeled metrics 
 - Financials & Reporting: responsible for facilitating the production of the firm's financials and a wide range of reporting functions 
 - Non-Financial Risk & Controls: responsible for non-financial risk and control processes 
 - Enterprise Platforms: responsible for platforms and applications that support critical operational processes across The Core such as payments, people processes, and procurement 
 - Shared Services: responsible for driving the adoption of consistent engineering strategy, including data platforms, cloud, and AI enablement, as well as the management of technology risk

What We Look For

This VP Software Engineer role is for a professional who is passionate about bringing business impact through digital transformation and deployment of scalable and reliable software solutions. 

The Core divisions have a large footprint of software applications to ensure the firm complies with the controls set forth in its policies and risk appetite, meet its regulatory obligations, and to protect the firm's reputation. To meet the demand of the business, drive by the size and complexity of the entire firm, the candidate will have the mandate to continuously increase the level of automation and to modernize and consolidate our software stacks. In addition, data is at the center of what we do. The successful candidate will have demonstrated experiences in and a passion for solving critical problems related to data quality, warehousing, and analytics. 

How You Will Fulfill Your Potential (responsibilities)

- Work in a dynamic, fast-paced environment that provides exposure to all areas of Finance 
 - Build strong relationships with business partners 
 - Understand business needs, facilitating and developing process workflow, data requirements, and specifications required to support implementation 
 - Develop technical specifications, high level/detailed design, testing strategies, and implementation plans from business requirements 
 - Define and govern scalable, secure, and cost-optimized architecture 
 - Leverage AI tools, i. e Devin, Claude etc to improve development efficiency and innovation 
 - Ensure strong cloud governance including security, compliance, and cost control 
 - Manage end-to-end systems development cycle from requirements analysis, coding, testing, UAT and maintenance 
 - Exploring new and emerging technologies as needed by the project. 
 - Drive program execution, manage risks, dependencies, and stakeholder expectations 
 - Collaborate with business leaders to align technology with strategic goals

Skills And Relevant Experience

- Bachelor's degree in computer science or related technical discipline 
 - 10+ years of relevant experience in software development, including a clear understanding of data structures, algorithms, software design, core programming concepts and experiences with continuous delivery and deployment, preferably 2+ years of experience with AWS services. 
 - Deep understanding of cloud architecture, distributed systems, and system design 
 - Strong problem solver, organized and able to work in a fast-paced environment with delivery focus as part of a global team 
 - Exposure to AI/ML tools and modern engineering practices preferred 
 - Excellent communicator who is comfortable engaging stakeholders, both verbally and written 
 - Preferably experienced in managing small to mid-size teams 
 - Strong programming experience in at least one compiled language (e. g. Java, C++, python) 
 - Full Stack experience with industry standard frameworks and tools (e. g. React, SpringBoot, DropWizard, Maven, Web/RESTful service development)

ADVANCE YOUR CAREER. ADVANCE THE WORLD. 

At AMD, we believe technology has the power to solve the world's most important challenges. From advancing healthcare and scientific discovery to powering AI and the technologies people rely on every day, innovation at AMD is shaping the future. 

Whether you're designing next-gen processors, enabling AI breakthroughs, or bringing leading edge products to market, every role at AMD contributes to something bigger - technology that moves the world forward. Join us and, together, we'll advance your career. 

MTS SILICON DESIGN ENGINEER

The Role

We are seeking a seasoned SoC Micro architect with expertise or significant interest in System Architecture. You have had significant success driving architecture, product roadmaps and product requirements. You are meticulous about Power, Performance and Area while driving schedule and managing cost. This role will stretch you as you lead micro architecture teams in new directions, network with our world-class, patent-holding think-tank, and negotiate amongst design teams, marketing, and business unit executives. 

The Person

You have excellent communication and presentation skills, demonstrated through technical publications, presentations, trainings, executive briefings, etc. You are highly adept at collaboration among top-thinkers and engineers alike, ready to mentor and guide, and help to elevate the knowledge and skills of the team around you. 

Key Responsibilities

- Define micro-architecture requirements, drive technical specifications for SoC and IP blocks to meet those requirements, and provide technical direction to execution teams
 - Comprehend the SOC as a complete system which includes HW (Silicon), FW, BIOS & SW and ensure that FW, BIOS & SW are aligned to enable all features, optimizing for performance and power 
 - Work cross functionally with IP/Domain architects to identify and assess complex technical issues/risks and develop architectural solutions to achieve product requirements 
 - Knowledge sharing and other contributions to Platform & System Architecture 
 - Responsible for micro architecture analysis and technical solutions 
 - Work closely with Design teams for Area and Floorplan refinement, Verification Test plan reviews, Timing targets, Emulation plans, Pre-Si bug resolution and Performance/Power Verification sign offs 
 - Support Post-Si teams for Product Performance, Power and functional issues debug/resolution

Preferred Experience

- Outstanding foundation in Systems & SoC architecture, with expertise in one or more of the following: PCIE, DDR, CPU , Memory sub-system, Fabrics, CPU coherency, I/O subsystems, Clocks, Resets
 - Experience analyzing CPU or System-level Micro-Architectural features to identify performance bottlenecks within different workloads 
 - Demonstrated expertise in power management microarchitecture, low power design and power optimization, along with power impact at architecture, logic design, and circuit levels 
 - Excellent communication, management, and presentation skills. 
 - Adept at collaboration among top-thinkers and senior architects with strong interpersonal skills to work across teams in different geographies

Academic Credentials

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in related discipline preferred with 10+Yrs of exp

data.description:
About Us

At ANZ, we're shaping a world where people and communities thrive, driven by a common goal: to improve the financial wellbeing and sustainability of our millions of customers. 

About The Role

As a Team Leader - Institutional Lending Operations, you will play a critical leadership role within the Institutional Lending Operations function, supporting the delivery of high-quality operational services across the US Institutional, Corporate, Commercial and Private Banking portfolios. 

The role is accountable for leading a team responsible for the execution of lending operations activities, while ensuring exceptional customer outcomes, operational excellence, risk management, and regulatory compliance. You will work closely with regional stakeholders, senior leaders, and partner functions to drive strategic initiatives, improve operational efficiency, manage change, and strengthen the control environment. 

As a people leader, you will be responsible for developing a high-performing team culture, fostering employee engagement, building future leadership capability, and driving continuous improvement across processes and service delivery. 

Banking is changing and we're changing with it, giving our people great opportunities to try new things, learn and grow. Whatever your role at ANZ, you'll be building your future, while helping to build ours. 

Role Location: Bengaluru

Role Type: Permanent, Fulltime

What will your day look like?

As a Team Leader, you will lead a high-performing team responsible for delivering operational excellence, exceptional customer outcomes, and sustainable business performance. You will drive a culture of accountability, continuous improvement, risk awareness, and collaboration while ensuring operational activities are executed efficiently, effectively, and in line with organisational policies, regulatory requirements, and customer expectations. 

- Lead the day-to-day operational delivery of the team, ensuring service commitments, performance standards, quality outcomes, and business objectives are consistently achieved. 
 - Foster a customer-centric culture by driving high-quality service delivery, resolving complex issues, and promoting positive customer and stakeholder outcomes. 
 - Build and maintain effective relationships with internal and external stakeholders, partnering across functions to deliver business priorities and achieve shared objectives. 
 - Drive team performance through effective workforce planning, resource management, productivity oversight, and performance monitoring to optimise operational outcomes. 
 - Identify, recommend, and implement continuous improvement initiatives that enhance efficiency, strengthen controls, reduce complexity, and improve the overall customer experience. 
 - Lead, coach, and develop team members by providing clear direction, performance feedback, mentoring, and growth opportunities to build a highly engaged and capable workforce. 
 - Create an inclusive, collaborative, and high-performance culture that promotes accountability, innovation, wellbeing, and continuous learning. 
 - Ensure operational activities are conducted in accordance with regulatory obligations, risk frameworks, governance requirements, and internal policies and procedures. 
 - Proactively identify, manage, and escalate risks, control weaknesses, issues, and incidents while supporting audit, compliance, and remediation activities to maintain a strong control environment. 
 - Lead and support strategic, transformational, and change initiatives, ensuring successful implementation, effective stakeholder engagement, and sustainable business outcomes. 

What will you bring?

To grow and be successful in this role, you will ideally bring the following: 

- Extensive experience in Institutional / Commercial Lending Operations with strong knowledge of syndicated lending, bilateral lending, loan servicing, documentation, and credit administration processes. 
 - Advanced knowledge of Loan IQ and Global Lending Platforms (GLP), including expertise in facility setup, maintenance, loan servicing, and interpretation of lending documentation such as Letters of Offer, Limit Approval Advice Letters, One-Way Amendments, Two-Way Amendments, and facility documentation. 
 - Proven people leadership experience (minimum 3-4 years) managing large operational teams, driving performance, employee engagement, capability development, and succession planning. 
 - Exceptional stakeholder management and influencing skills, with a track record of managing senior business partners and challenging conversations. 
 - Experience managing audits, accreditation reviews, Key Control Testing (KCT), periodic procedure reviews, BAU controls, SOW reviews, and regulatory compliance activities. 
 - Strong understanding of operational risk management frameworks and experience implementing preventive and detective controls. 
 - Proven ability to balance strategic priorities while maintaining operational excellence in a fast-paced and dynamic environment. 
 - Strong analytical thinking, problem-solving, and decision-making skills with the ability to make sound judgments in complex and time-sensitive situations. 

You're not expected to have 100% of these skills. At ANZ a growth mindset is at the heart of our culture, so if you have most of these things in your toolbox, we'd love to hear from you. 

So why join us?

ANZ is a place where big things happen as we work together to provide banking and financial services across more than 30 markets. With more than 7, 500 people, our Bengaluru team is the bank's largest technology, data and operations centre outside Australia. In operation for over 33 years, the centre is critical in delivering the bank's strategy and making an impact for our millions of customers around the world. Our Bengaluru team not only drives the transformation initiatives of the bank, it also drives a culture that makes ANZ a great place to be. We're proud that people feel they can be themselves at ANZ and 90 percent of our people feel they belong. 

We know our people need different things to be great in their role, so we offer a range of flexible working options, including hybrid work (where the role allows it). Our people also enjoy a range of benefits including access to health and wellbeing services. 

We want to continue building a diverse workplace and welcome applications from everyone. Please talk to us about any adjustments you may require to our recruitment process or the role itself. If you are a candidate with a disability or access requirements, let us know how we can provide you with additional support. 

To find out more about working at ANZ visit https: //www. anz. com/careers/. You can apply for this role by visiting ANZ Careers and searching for reference number 127190.

data.title: Senior / Lead Embedded Software Engineer - Zephyr RTOS
data.description:
About GlobalFoundries

GlobalFoundries is a leading full-service semiconductor foundry providing a unique combination of design, development, and fabrication services to some of the world's most inspired technology companies. With a global manufacturing footprint spanning three continents, GlobalFoundries makes possible the technologies and systems that transform industries and give customers the power to shape their markets. For more information, visit www. gf. com

Join the RISC-V Revolution!

We are looking for a senior hands-on engineer to lead Zephyr RTOS architecture and platform enablement for MIPS RISC-V based MCU and embedded compute products. This role combines deep low-level development with technical ownership, upstream engagement, mentoring, and cross-functional delivery. 

Key Responsibilities

- Own the Zephyr enablement architecture and technical roadmap across MIPS RISC-V processors, SoCs, FPGA platforms, and virtual development platforms. 
 - Lead porting and platform bring-up covering boot flow, exception and interrupt handling, timers, SMP where applicable, memory architecture, devicetree, Kconfig, and build integration. 
 - Define scalable BSP, SoC, board, and driver architecture aligned with Zephyr conventions and upstream-quality expectations. 
 - Design and review device drivers, middleware integration, samples, tests, and production-quality SDK deliverables. 
 - Lead complex debugging across kernel, toolchain, architecture, hardware, and driver boundaries using emulation, FPGA, and silicon. 
 - Establish automated build and regression strategy using Zephyr testing infrastructure and CI/CD systems. 
 - Drive upstream contributions, technical discussions, reviews, and maintenance strategy within the Zephyr ecosystem. 
 - Work closely with CPU architecture, SoC, FPGA, tools, validation, safety, and customer teams; convert product requirements into executable software plans. 
 - Mentor engineers, raise engineering quality, and provide technical direction without losing hands-on ownership. 

Ideally, You'll Have

- 8+ years of embedded software development experience, with substantial hands-on work in C and low-level platform software. 
 - Deep Zephyr RTOS expertise across kernel configuration, architecture or SoC ports, devicetree, Kconfig, west/CMake, board support, drivers, and test infrastructure. 
 - Strong understanding of RTOS internals, concurrency, interrupt architecture, memory management, boot flows, multicore systems, and real-time performance. 
 - Proven experience leading complex BSP, SDK, RTOS, or silicon-enablement programs from architecture through release. 
 - Experience with bare-metal firmware, first-board or first-silicon bring-up, device drivers, and hardware/software debugging. 
 - Strong debugging capability using GDB, OpenOCD, Segger J-Link, Lauterbach, trace tools, and hardware logs. 
 - Experience with CI/CD, test automation, Python or shell scripting, code review, release quality, and software configuration management. 
 - Ability to communicate architecture and execution trade-offs clearly to hardware, software, program, and customer stakeholders. 

Strong Differentiators

- Zephyr maintainer-level expertise or meaningful upstream contribution history. 
 - RISC-V architecture expertise, including privilege modes, interrupts, timers, SMP, cache or memory-ordering considerations, and toolchain integration. 
 - Experience with networking, Ethernet, TCP/IP, security, MCUboot, secure firmware update, or device management. 
 - Experience enabling RTOS software on pre-silicon models, FPGA, and production silicon. 
 - Exposure to functional safety or secure software development for automotive, industrial, or infrastructure applications. 

What You'll Get

- A charter to shape Zephyr strategy and execution for a new RISC-V platform. 
 - Direct access to CPU architects, platform software, FPGA, validation, and toolchain teams. 
 - Visible technical ownership spanning architecture, upstream ecosystem, customer enablement, and release quality. 
 - A path to grow as a principal technical contributor or broader technical leader. 

MIPS by GF is a microprocessor pioneer with deep roots in RISC-based computing. Today, MIPS is building RISC-V processor solutions for high-performance and embedded applications, combining CPU architecture expertise with platform software, tools, and ecosystem enablement. 

GlobalFoundries is an equal opportunity employer, cultivating a diverse and inclusive workforce. We believe having a multicultural workplace enhances productivity, efficiency and innovation whilst our employees feel truly respected, valued and heard. As an affirmative employer, all qualified applicants are considered for employment regardless of age, ethnicity, marital status, citizenship, race, religion, political affiliation, gender, sexual orientation and medical and/or physical abilities. 

All offers of employment with GlobalFoundries are conditioned upon the successful completion of background checks, medical screenings as applicable and subject to the respective local laws and regulations.

data.description:
About Coursera + Udemy

Coursera and Udemy are now one company, bringing together two mission-driven brands to create the world's most powerful platform for turning learning into progress. Together, we help more than 300 million learners and 12, 000+ enterprise customers build the skills they need for a world being reshaped by AI. Read more about the combined company by visiting our blog. 

Why join us now?

AI is transforming how people learn, work, and grow, and the need for new skills has never been greater. Coursera brings trusted content and credentials from leading university and industry partners, while Udemy brings a dynamic skills marketplace and global network of real-world experts. By combining these strengths, we can connect more people and organizations to the skills they need, when they need them. 

Shape What Comes Next

By joining our team, you'll have the opportunity to reshape how the world learns and applies skills-and help millions of people participate in the new economy. Bring your ideas, expertise, and perspective to meaningful work that can make a difference at global scale. 

Job Overview

Coursera is seeking a Senior AI Specialist to own the technical design and delivery of complex AI applications for business and customer needs. You'll turn ambiguous requirements into production-grade solutions, working across data exploration, experimentation, architecture, implementation, evaluation, and deployment. This is a hands-on senior IC role: you'll lead architectural decisions independently, build critical components, and resolve difficult problems across models, agents, applications, and data. You'll partner with Product Managers, Data Engineers, Software Engineers, LLMOps, and forward-deployed teams to deliver solutions within enterprise and customer environments. Your work will establish reusable approaches and technical standards that improve AI quality, reliability, security, and delivery across projects. 

About your skills: 

AI Systems Architecture - Design end-to-end applied AI solutions, combining models, retrieval, agentic workflows, and application services while balancing quality, scalability, security, and cost. 

AI Delivery & Reliability - Build production grade AI components and reliable data workflows, integrating enterprise data, models, and tools into tested, maintainable applications. Define how AI quality is measured and monitored, using evaluation frameworks, agent tracing

Technical Leadership - Own complex technical decisions, lead design and code reviews, AI evals, and guide cross-functional teams from experimentation through validated production deployment. 

What you'll be doing

- Own AI solution architecture - Translate ambiguous requirements into robust system designs, service boundaries, data contracts, and implementation plans. Lead build v/s buy decisions and document trade-offs across model quality, latency, throughput, reliability, security, and cost. 
 - Architect RAG systems. Design retrieval-augmented generation pipelines using vector databases, sparse and dense retrieval, hybrid search, metadata filtering, and reranking. Define document parsing, chunking, embedding, and indexing strategies. 
 - Evaluate and fine-tune models. Determine when model adaptation is warranted over prompting or retrieval. Curate training and validation datasets, implement supervised fine-tuning and parameter-efficient techniques such as LoRA, and benchmark against baseline models for task accuracy, safety, latency, and cost. 
 - Develop AI services and data integrations. Build critical Python/TypeScript services, APIs, and asynchronous workflows. Partner with Data Engineering on ingestion and indexing pipelines, including normalization of customer data, schema validation, incremental updates, lineage, and recovery. 
 - Build enterprise agentic systems. Develop stateful workflows with task decomposition, planning, multi-step tool use, dynamic tool selection, structured outputs, memory management, and multi-agent orchestration where justified. Build tool and MCP integrations with validated inputs, scoped permissions, and human approval for sensitive actions. Evaluate retrieval and agent quality against defined accuracy and grounding metrics. 
 - Implement AI security, and governance controls. Implement defenses against prompt injection, sensitive-data leakage, unauthorized tool execution, and retrieval access violations. Contribute threat models, adversarial tests, and evidence for governance reviews. Translate centrally defined policies into application controls for identity, tenant isolation, data residency, retention, and auditability. 
 - Adapt solutions to enterprise environments. Work with Engineering and forward-deployed teams to implement cloud, hybrid, and customer-controlled deployments. 
 - AI evaluation and production observability. Define evaluation datasets and measure retrieval quality, groundedness, task completion, tool correctness, latency, and cost. Combine deterministic checks, calibrated LLM-as-judge, and human review. Partner with LLMOps on CI/CD release gates, prompt and model versioning, tracing, and safe rollouts and rollbacks. 
 - Own technical quality and system reliability. Set and enforce quality standards across the team, with accountability for code quality, maintainability, and production reliability. Lead architecture and code reviews, mentor AI Specialists, and drive root-cause analysis across model, retrieval, application, and data layers. Improve developer productivity through reusable libraries, reference architectures, tooling, and runbooks. 

Qualifications

- 6+ years in applied AI, machine learning, or software development, including architecture and production ownership of complex AI systems. 
 - Experience applying enterprise AI controls, including scoped tool authorization, tenant isolation, PII handling, prompt-injection defenses, audit logging, and human approval for sensitive actions. 
 - Experience designing enterprise semantic layers or context graphs that connect business entities, relationships, and definitions across systems. 
 - Strong experience with cloud deployments using GCP/AWS including serverless technologies, CI/CD pipelines using GitHub, Docker and Kubernetes and model platforms such as Vertex AI, Bedrock, etc. 
 - Familiarity with centralized LLM gateways such as LiteLLM, covering multi-provider routing, fallbacks, rate limits, token budgets, caching, and access policies. 
 - Production-grade development using Python, TypeScript, and SQL, with typed interfaces, APIs, asynchronous processing, and automated testing. 
 - Build enterprise agentic systems using LangGraph, Mastra, or equivalent frameworks, including planning, multi-agent orchestration, state and memory management, checkpointing, and failure recovery. 
 - Applied knowledge of LLM inference and context engineering, including structured outputs, embeddings, hybrid retrieval, reranking, and evaluation-driven model selection or fine-tuning. 
 - Practical work with Databricks, Spark, and Postgres, spanning analytical and transactional workloads, batch and real-time pipelines, and normalization of messy customer data. 
 - AI evaluation using Braintrust or equivalent, including golden datasets, custom scorers, regression testing, and calibrated LLM-as-judge to measure task success, tool correctness, safety, and cost. 
 - Worked on enterprise AI observability layers, including agent traces, model and tool spans, prompt versions, error attribution, latency, token usage, and cost tracking.

data.title: PRINCIPAL, SOFTWARE ENGINEER
data.description:
Job SummaryAs a Principal Software Engineer for Global CRM (GCRM) specializing in Seller Acquisition & Onboarding, you will be the strategic architectural cornerstone of our marketplace's growth engine. This is a high-visibility, high-impact leadership role where you will design and scale the multi-platform infrastructure that powers the acquisition and integration of millions of global sellers. Fusing Salesforce-centric workflows with Google Cloud Platform (GCP) microservices, responsive front-end portals, data analytics, and advanced AI automation, you will establish a frictionless, intelligent, and highly secure onboarding experience at a massive global scale. 

Job Ad DescriptionAre you ready to redefine how a marketplace attracts and onboarding global sellers at scale? The GCRM team is looking for a Principal Software Engineer to architect the future of our Global Seller Onboarding and Acquisition Funnels. 

In this role, you will lead the technical strategy across a modern, multi-tiered tech stack. You will bridge the gap between enterprise Salesforce engineering, robust GCP cloud services, modern web-based front-ends, data analytics platforms, and next-generation AI/ML engines. If you are passionate about driving business growth through complex integrations, automating seller vetting, and designing "data-first, AI-ready" architectures that handle massive transaction volumes, this is the opportunity for you. 

About

About the TeamThe Global CRM (GCRM) team is the backbone of the Marketplace ecosystem. Within GCRM, the Seller Acquisition & Onboarding team is responsible for architecting and scaling the global platform that powers the end-to-end seller entry journey. Our mission is to build seamless, high-performance systems that manage: 

- Global Acquisition Funnels: Engineering robust lead capture and marketing-to-sales pipelines to attract high-quality global sellers. 
 - Intelligent, Automated Onboarding: Building secure workflows to verify, vet, and set up sellers efficiently with minimal human intervention. 
 - Multi-Platform Tech Integration: Designing complex, real-time integrations that seamlessly link Salesforce, GCP microservices, rich front-end seller portals, downstream data analytics, and predictive AI pipelines. 

As a Principal Engineer in GCRM, you will tackle distributed systems challenges, optimize global APIs, and define the architectural standards that empower our marketplace to scale internationally. 

What you'll do· Architect End-to-End Solutions: Define the technical vision and system architecture connecting Salesforce, GCP backends, front-end portals, and downstream AI/data analytics platforms. 

- Salesforce Architecture Leadership: Design enterprise-grade architectures where Salesforce serves as a primary system of record and engagement, implementing highly optimized custom workflows, LWC components, and robust APIs. 
 - Scale Cloud Services on GCP: Design, build, and deploy high-performance microservices, event-driven pipelines, and database solutions on Google Cloud Platform to complement the core CRM. 
 - Drive Front-End Portal Strategy: Guide the architectural direction of our seller-facing portals and internal tools, ensuring intuitive, high-performance, and responsive user experiences. 
 - Embed AI & Automation: Architect pipelines that integrate AI/ML and LLM capabilities directly into the onboarding journey (e. g. , automated document verification, seller risk scoring, and personalized onboarding tracks). 
 - Unlock Data Analytics: Work closely with data science and analytics teams to design pipelines that track seller funnel metrics, conversion rates, and friction points, converting data into actionable business strategy. 
 - Lead Technical Solutioning: Drive technical planning, high-scale third-party integrations, and system-level design reviews for multi-quarter initiatives across global teams. 
 - Mentor and Cultivate Talent: Champion engineering excellence by mentoring staff, senior, and junior engineers, conducting architecture reviews, and establishing clean-code and DevOps best practices. 
 - Collaborate Cross-Functionally: Partner with Product Management, Security, Compliance, and Business Operations to deliver compliant, secure, and user-friendly onboarding solutions. 

What You'll bringYou have a deep interest and passion for technology. You have a proven track record of driving critical business initiatives with Data, CRM, and Cloud architectures. You love writing and owning high-impact system designs, writing code, and collaborating with cross-functional partners who challenge you. You are a strategic thinker with excellent problem-solving, communication, and leadership abilities, comfortable leading technical direction in a fast-paced, agile global environment. 

- 10+ years of experience in software development with a heavy focus on enterprise solutions, distributed systems, and CRM-integrated architectures. 
 - Expertise in Salesforce Architecture: Advanced knowledge of Apex, Lightning Web Components (LWC), Salesforce Shield, and Governor Limits, with an emphasis on high-volume, multi-tenant data processing. 
 - Advanced Cloud Engineering (GCP): 4+ years of hands-on experience designing cloud-native solutions on Google Cloud Platform (including BigQuery, Dataflow, Pub/Sub, Cloud Run, or Kubernetes). 
 - Full-Stack & Front-End Mastery: Strong architectural experience with modern JavaScript frameworks (React, Angular, or LWC) used in building highly responsive seller-facing portals. 
 - AI, ML, and Data Pipelines: Proven experience implementing and integrating AI/ML models, agentic workflows, or Data Cloud platforms to automate complex workflow decisioning. 
 - Complex Integration & Messaging: Extensive experience with real-time integrations using Platform Events, Change Data Capture (CDC), Kafka, REST/SOAP APIs, and gRPC. 
 - Data Modeling & Analytics: Strong foundation in CRM and relational/non-relational cloud databases, ensuring optimized retrieval, analytics, and business intelligence reporting. 
 - DevOps & Security: Mastery of enterprise CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, Copado), automated testing, data masking, encryption, and secure-by-design principles for sensitive seller data. 
 - Strategic & Technical Leadership: Proven ability to influence executive stakeholders, drive architectural consensus across teams, and guide engineering organizations toward modern architectural patterns. 

About Walmart Global TechImagine working in an environment where one line of code can make life easier for hundreds of millions of people. That's what we do at Walmart Global Tech. We're a team of software engineers, data scientists, cybersecurity experts, and service professionals within the world's leading retailer who make an epic impact and are at the forefront of the next retail disruption. 

People are why we innovate, and people power our innovations. We are people-led and tech-empowered. We train our team in the skillsets of the future and bring in experts like you to help us grow. We have roles for those chasing their first opportunity as well as those looking for the opportunity that will define their career. Here, you can kickstart a great career in tech, gain new skills and experience for virtually every industry, or leverage your expertise to innovate at scale, impact millions and reimagine the future of retail. 

Work

Walmart's culture sets us apart, and we know being together helps us innovate, learn and grow great careers. This role is based in our Bangalore office for daily work, with the flexibility for associates to manage their personal lives

BenefitsBeyond our great compensation package, you can receive incentive awards for your performance. Other great perks include a host of best-in-class benefits, maternity and parental leave, PTO, health benefits, and much more. 

BelongingWe aim to create a culture where every associate feels valued for who they are, rooted in respect for the individual. Our goal is to foster a sense of belonging, to create opportunities for all our associates, customers, and suppliers, and to be a Walmart for everyone. 

At Walmart, our vision is "everyone included. " By fostering a workplace culture where everyone is-and feels-included, everyone wins. Our associates and customers reflect the makeup of all 19 countries where we operate. By making Walmart a welcoming place where all people feel like they belong, we're able to engage associates, strengthen our business, improve our ability to serve customers, and support the communities where we operate. 

Equal Opportunity EmployerWalmart, Inc. , is an Equal Opportunities Employer - By Choice. We believe we are best equipped to help our associates, customers and the communities we serve live better when we really know them. That means understanding, respecting and valuing unique styles, experiences, identities, ideas and opinions - while being inclusive of all people.

data.title: Infrastructure Specialist-Cloud Application Operations
data.description:
Introduction

A career in IBM Consulting is built on long-term client relationships and close collaboration worldwide. You'll work with leading companies across industries, helping them shape their hybrid cloud and AI journeys. With support from our strategic partners, robust IBM technology, and Red Hat, you'll have the tools to drive meaningful change and accelerate client impact. At IBM Consulting, curiosity fuels success. You'll be encouraged to challenge the norm, explore new ideas, and create innovative solutions that deliver real results. Our culture of growth and empathy focuses on your long-term career development while valuing your unique skills and experiences. 

Your Role And Responsibilities

As an Infrastructure Specialist: Cloud Application Operations, you will provide 24/7 technical support for cloud-based solutions, addressing issues related to application, DevOps, middleware, security, and infrastructure. You will handle Level 1. 5 remediation across the fleet using a standard workflow and incident handling process. 

Your Primary Responsibilities Will Include

- Provide Technical Support: Address issues related to application, DevOps, middleware, security, and infrastructure, utilizing various tools and technologies, including APIs, application services, IaaS, PaaS, SaaS, microservices, containers, Kubernetes nodes, middleware components, network, security, and infrastructure. 
 - Manage Incident Resolution: Receive and record incident information, select appropriate actions to resolve issues, and communicate the solution or action plan to the client, ensuring timely and effective resolution. 
 - Ensure Cloud Elasticity: Manage Application ID and provide cloud elasticity by auto-scaling resources based on business requirements, ensuring efficient resource utilization. 
 - Monitor Client Environment: Utilize monitoring tools like IBM APM, Dynatrace, AppDynamics, NewRelic, Runscope, Netcool OmniBus to monitor the client's environment, identifying potential issues and taking proactive measures. 
 - Deliver Service Management Reports: Provide daily, weekly, and monthly integrated service management reports across the solution, ensuring transparency and visibility into service performance. 

Preferred Education

Master's Degree

Required Technical And Professional Expertise

- Exposure to Cloud Technologies: Familiarity with cloud-based solutions, including IaaS, PaaS, SaaS, microservices, containers, and Kubernetes nodes, with the ability to address related technical issues. 
 - Experience with Monitoring Tools: Exposure to monitoring tools like IBM APM, Dynatrace, AppDynamics, NewRelic, Runscope, and Netcool OmniBus, with the ability to utilize them to identify potential issues. 
 - Understanding of ITIL Processes: Familiarity with ITIL processes, including Incident, Problem, Change management, and Integrated Service Level Management, with the ability to apply them in a cloud application operations context. 
 - Experience with Ticketing and Automation Tools: Exposure to ticketing tools like ServiceNow, IBM Control Desk & Remedy, and automation tools such as Rundeck and IBM Runbook Automation, with the ability to effectively utilize them. 
 - Knowledge of Cloud Application Architecture: Understanding of high-level cloud application architecture, with the ability to perform initial analysis on incidents and manage Application ID and cloud elasticity. 

Preferred Technical And Professional Experience

- Familiarity with Scripting Languages: Exposure to scripting languages such as Python, PowerShell, or Bash would be beneficial for automation and efficiency in cloud application operations. 
 - Knowledge of Cloud Security: Familiarity with cloud security best practices and compliance frameworks would be advantageous in ensuring the security and integrity of cloud-based solutions. 
 - Experience with Agile Methodologies: Exposure to Agile methodologies and DevOps practices would be valuable in collaborating with development teams and ensuring smooth deployment of cloud applications.

Dependability, clear communication, calmness under pressure, collaboration with developers and testers and proactive follow-up. data.description:
Who We Are

At Bluehost, we believe all small businesses deserve the opportunity to succeed online. Our mission is to give small businesses the confidence to think big. We're the all-in-one platform for small businesses to grow online with powerful simplicity, premium performance, smart tools and human support. 

This role is a part of Bluehost's innovation team, the group building the AI-native backbone of our platform while the rest of the business scales around us. You'll design async, production-grade backend systems that treat AI as a first-class citizen: multi-agent orchestration, retrieval-augmented generation, and provider-agnostic LLM integration, all woven into products millions of small businesses depend on. We want a true go-getter who can take an idea from whiteboard to production without waiting to be told how. 

What You'll Do & How You'll Make Your Mark

- Design and scale async REST/WebSocket APIs in Python (FastAPI or similar), using dependency injection, type hints, and clean, vertical-slice architecture 
 - Implement multi-agent workflows (sequential, concurrent, and handoff patterns) to route work among specialized LLM agents 
 - Integrate multiple LLM providers behind a provider-agnostic layer, enabling A/B testing and cost-aware routing rather than hard-coding a single vendor 
 - Build and maintain Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines against vector stores such as pgvector, Chroma, or a managed vector search service 
 - Design schemas and evolve data models (SQLAlchemy/SQLModel-style ORM plus migrations) that support both traditional application logic and AI-driven features 
 - Instrument services with structured logs, distributed tracing, and cost/latency metrics, holding a real bar for p95 response time under production load 
 - Maintain end-to-end CI/CD ownership, lint, type-check, test, package, and deploy, so releases are boring and safe 
 - Champion AI across the delivery lifecycle, not just code generation, and set the guardrails the team works inside: how generated code gets reviewed, how provenance and licensing are checked, and what customer data may enter a prompt 
 - Move ideas from concept to production fast, with real ownership over architecture and outcomes, not just tickets

Who You Are & What You'll Need To Succeed

- 5+ years building production backend systems in Python, with real async I/O experience 
 - Hands-on experience designing and scaling REST or async APIs, including dependency injection and clean service architecture 
 - Practical experience integrating LLM APIs (OpenAI, Gemini, or similar) and building AI-readiness into backend systems from the ground up 
 - Real experience with vector databases and RAG-style retrieval architectures, not just reading about them 
 - Strong relational database skills: schema design, query optimization, and migration discipline 
 - AI-augmented delivery: you use AI across the delivery lifecycle, not just code generation, and can say which models suit which problems and where you don't use them. You review AI-generated code knowing its failure modes, and you have set the guardrails others work inside - review expectations for generated code, provenance and licensing checks, and clear boundaries for what customer data enters a prompt and what a security or compliance review will ask for. 
 - End-to-end CI/CD ownership, from build and test through packaging and deployment 
 - A self-starting, go-getter mindset: comfortable with ambiguity, fast iteration, and owning a problem until it's actually solved 
 - Bonus: experience with multi-agent orchestration frameworks (Semantic Kernel, LangChain, or similar) and LLM cost/observability tooling

Why You'll Love Us

- We've evolved: We provide three work environment scenarios. You can feel like a Newfolder in a work-from-home, hybrid, or work-from-the-office environment. 
 - Work-life balance: Our work is thrilling and meaningful, but we know balance is key to living well. 
 - We celebrate one another's differences: We're proud of our culture of diversity and inclusion. We foster a culture of belonging. Our company and customers benefit when employees bring their authentic selves to work. We have programs that bring us together on important issues and provide learning and development opportunities for all employees. We have 20+ affinity groups where you can network and connect with employees globally. 
 - We care about you: At Bluehost, taking care of our employees is our top priority. We make sure that cutting edge benefits are in place for you. Some of the benefits you will have: We have partnered with some of the best insurance providers to provide you excellent Health Insurance options, Education/ Certification Sponsorships to give you a chance to further your knowledge, Flexi-leaves to take personal time off and much more. Building a community with one domain at a time, one employee at a time. 
 - Where can we take you? We're fans of helping our employees learn different aspects of the business, be challenged with new tasks, be mentored, and grow their careers. Unfold new possibilities with Bluehost #OTOD!

GlobalFoundries is seeking a Senior Staff SoC Design-for-Test Engineer to lead DFT execution for complex SoC subsystems, partitions, major functional areas, or multiple interdependent workstreams. - Lead review of product, architecture, and design specifications to define DFT strategy, requirements, risks, interfaces, and measurable closure criteria. 
 - Own DFT planning and execution for complex SoC subsystems, partitions, major functional areas, or multiple related workstreams. 
 - Architect reusable DFT solutions for scan and compression, ATPG, memory BIST and repair, test clocking and access, boundary scan, IJTAG, and mixed-signal integration. 
 - Lead DFT readiness, coverage closure, pattern validation, risk mitigation, and signoff recommendations for assigned technical areas. 
 - Solve advanced, novel, and nonrecurring DFT problems and guide root-cause analysis across design, implementation, manufacturing test, and silicon boundaries. 
 - Lead cross-functional and cross-site issue resolution and coordinate dependencies across DFT, architecture, RTL, DV, PD, firmware, analog, product engineering, and test teams.

 - undefined

Required Qualifications

- Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field with 5+ years of relevant industry experience; OR bachelor's degree in a related field with 6+ years of relevant industry experience. 
 - Demonstrated mastery of SoC DFT and recognition as a core technical contributor within the functional area. 
 - Expertise with scan insertion and compression, ATPG, memory BIST and repair, test clocking and access, boundary scan, and hierarchical DFT integration. 
 - Experience defining DFT implementation, verification, readiness, coverage, and signoff criteria for complex subsystems, partitions, major areas, or multiple workstreams. 
 - Deep understanding of fault models, structural test coverage, pattern quality, diagnosis, tester constraints, outgoing quality, test time, and test cost.

Job Description: Quality Engineer - Oracle Fusion Finance

We are seeking a highly skilled and motivated Quality Engineer with hands-on experience in Oracle Fusion Finance and automation testing tools. The ideal candidate will be responsible for developing and executing manual and automated tests to ensure product quality and support continuous improvement initiatives within our QA processes. 

Key Responsibilities

· Serve as the Senior Quality Engineer and Oracle Fusion Finance Subject Matter Expert (SME), ensuring quality across General Ledger (GL), Accounts Payable (AP), Accounts Receivable (AR), Fixed Assets (FA), Cash Management (CM), Expense Management, Tax, and Financial Reporting business processes. 

· Design, develop, execute, and maintain automated test scripts and test automation frameworks for Oracle Fusion Finance applications using tools such as Playwright, Opkey, or equivalent automation platforms. 

· Create and manage test strategies, test plans, test cases, and test execution activities using JIRA, Zephyr, Xray, or similar test management tools. 

· Collaborate with Product Owners, Business Analysts, Developers, Finance stakeholders, and business users to define testing requirements, validate business processes, and ensure comprehensive test coverage. 

· Perform integration testing, API testing, data conversion/migration testing, and database validation, including SQL-based data reconciliation between Oracle Fusion Finance and upstream/downstream systems. 

· Analyze test results, identify defects, perform root cause analysis, and partner with development teams to ensure timely issue resolution. 

· Ensure end-to-end requirements traceability, support audit and compliance requirements, and drive continuous quality improvements throughout the SDLC and Agile delivery lifecycle. 

Required Skills & Qualifications

· 7+ years of experience in QA Manual and Automation Testing for enterprise applications, including UI, REST API, and database testing. 

· Subject Matter Expert (SME) in Oracle Fusion Finance with hands-on experience in one or more of the following areas: General Ledger (GL), Accounts Payable (AP), Accounts Receivable (AR), Fixed Assets (FA), Cash Management, Expense Management, Tax, Financial Reporting, and Period Close Processes. 

· Strong functional understanding of Oracle Fusion Finance, with working knowledge of related Oracle Fusion modules such as Procurement, Project Portfolio Management (PPM), Supply Chain, and HCM to support end-to-end business processes and integrations. 

· Proven experience testing Oracle Fusion Cloud Financials applications, including business process validation, integration testing, regression testing, data conversion testing, financial reconciliation, and user acceptance testing (UAT). 

· Prior experience supporting Oracle E-Business Suite (EBS) to Oracle Fusion ERP migrations, including data validation, financial reconciliation, end-to-end business process testing, and parallel testing to ensure functional and financial consistency across both platforms. 

· Hands-on experience developing and maintaining test automation frameworks using tools such as Playwright, Opkey, or equivalent automation platforms. 

· Experience with test management and defect tracking tools including JIRA, Zephyr, Xray, or similar solutions. 

· Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices using tools such as Jenkins, Git, Azure DevOps, or equivalent platforms. 

· Strong proficiency in SQL scripting, financial data validation, reconciliation, and backend/database testing. 

· Excellent analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to quickly learn new technologies and finance business processes. 

· Strong verbal and written communication skills, with experience collaborating across Finance, business, functional, and technical teams. 

Preferred Qualifications

· Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, Finance, Accounting, or a related discipline. 

· Relevant Oracle Cloud Financials certifications, such as Oracle Fusion Cloud Financials Certified Implementation Professional, are highly desirable. 

· Experience implementing or supporting Oracle Fusion Financials Cloud in large-scale enterprise environments. 

· Exposure to Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC), Financial Reporting Center (FRC), Smart View, OTBI, BI Publisher, ADFdi, and cross-functional business process testing.
