Job Description

The Campaign Testing Analyst 1 (Associate) will be responsible for developing and maintaining test scenarios, test plan, test cases used for testing within Card marketing validation team. 

This team is tasked with analyzing credit card marketing campaign assets (online or offline), such as direct mail, online ads, emails, and microsites, to ensure both individual asset quality and overall campaign quality before they reach Chase Card customers. 

This position is part of Card Services, a key business within Chase's Consumer & Community Banking group. 

As a Business UAT Analyst within the Card Marketing Validation team, you will collaborate with Card Marketing, Marketing Channel Execution, and Card Legal, Compliance, and Controls teams to deliver marketing materials that are accurate, compliant, and functional to customers and prospects consistently. 

Job Responsibilities

- This team member will have the primary role for development of testing strategies including creating testing plans and scenarios, preparing test cases, conducting testing and reviewing results for final campaign manager sign-off. 
 - Interact with campaign management, project management and development teams to develop a strong understanding of the project/campaign and testing objectives
 - Develop and lead the test strategy/effort and generate scripts to perform testing cycles both manual and using automation
 - Review campaign requirements, specifications, user documentation, help files, and other project documentation - job aids/procedures to assure quality of the test suites to be developed
 - Work with appropriate business and technology leads to determine the acceptable range for test results and performance
 - Ensure proper version control and configuration management of all test objects developed and test environments used
 - Creation & maintenance of the job aids & procedures associated with the testing standards and used by Card marketing validation team
 - Support during production deployment of campaigns and perform "validation testing" during the off-hours/weekend release windows
 - Have a keen eye to identify process gaps and lean down processes

Required Qualifications, Skills, And Capabilities

- Minimum 4 years of experience in E2E campaign testing across emails, Direct mail, microsites with strong collaboration and project management skills. 
 - Experience in execution of automated test suites. 
 - Hands-on experience in both waterfall and Agile SDLC models. 
 - Knowledge & experience on JIRA tool with data extraction and data promoten insights for process efficiencies. 

About Us

JPMorganChase, one of the oldest financial institutions, offers innovative financial solutions to millions of consumers, small businesses and many of the world's most prominent corporate, institutional and government clients under the J. P. Morgan and Chase brands. Our history spans over 200 years and today we are a leader in investment banking, consumer and small business banking, commercial banking, financial transaction processing and asset management. 

We recognize that our people are our strength and the diverse talents they bring to our global workforce are directly linked to our success. We are an equal opportunity employer and place a high value on diversity and inclusion at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of any protected attribute, including race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital or veteran status, pregnancy or disability, or any other basis protected under applicable law. We also make reasonable accommodations for applicants' and employees' religious practices and beliefs, as well as mental health or physical disability needs. Visit our FAQs for more information about requesting an accommodation. 

About The Team

Our Consumer & Community Banking division serves our Chase customers through a range of financial services, including personal banking, credit cards, mortgages, auto financing, investment advice, small business loans and payment processing. We're proud to lead the U. S. in credit card sales and deposit growth and have the most-used digital solutions - all while ranking first in customer satisfaction. 

We offer a broad array of credit cards to meet the needs of individuals and small businesses, including Chase-branded and co-branded cards in partnership with well-known companies and organizations. Merchant Services is a leading provider of payment, fraud and data security for companies, capable of authorizing transactions across global currencies.

data.title: Software QA Engineer
data.description:
Role Overview

We are seeking a Software QA Engineer to join the team responsible for one of X-Rite's strategically important desktop software products. This product plays a critical role in our customers' workflows and has a large installed base worldwide. 

The primary focus of this role is validating product quality through manual testing, exploratory testing, and systematic regression testing. The successful candidate will work closely with software developers, product managers, application support teams, and fellow QA engineers to ensure the reliability, usability, and stability of the product. 

This position is ideal for a quality-focused professional who enjoys understanding complex software systems, investigating defects, and representing the voice of the customer throughout the development process. 

Key Responsibilities

- Execute functional, integration, system, and regression testing for a business-critical Windows desktop application. 
 - Design, maintain, and execute detailed test plans and test cases. 
 - Perform exploratory testing to identify defects and quality risks not covered by scripted test cases. 
 - Validate new features, bug fixes, and software releases. 
 - Reproduce, isolate, document, and verify software defects. 
 - Work closely with developers to investigate issues and validate resolutions. 
 - Participate in requirements reviews and sprint planning activities to help identify quality risks early. 
 - Verify software behavior across different configurations, workflows, and usage scenarios. 
 - Collaborate with Application Support teams to reproduce customer-reported issues. 
 - Assist in maintaining test documentation, test procedures, and quality records. 
 - Contribute to release readiness assessments and product quality evaluations. 

Required Qualifications & Professional Knowledge

- 3+ years of professional experience in software quality assurance. 
 - Experience testing Windows desktop applications. 
 - Strong knowledge of software testing methodologies and best practices. 
 - Experience creating and executing detailed test cases and test plans. 
 - Experience performing exploratory, functional, integration, and regression testing. 
 - Ability to investigate, reproduce, and clearly document software defects. 
 - Experience using defect tracking and test management systems. 
 - Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. 
 - Attention to detail and a structured approach to testing. 
 - Good written and verbal communication skills in English. 
 - Ability to collaborate effectively within globally distributed teams. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience testing commercial software products. 
 - Experience validating complex user workflows and business processes. 
 - Experience participating in release testing and software certification activities. 
 - Experience working closely with software development teams. 
 - Experience using Jira, Azure DevOps, or similar defect management tools. 
 - Experience working in geographically distributed engineering organizations. 
 - Familiarity with test case management solutions like QATouch. 

Nice to Have

- Experience testing Windows desktop applications
 - Basic understanding of software development concepts and software architecture. 
 - Exposure to test automation tools and automated testing concepts. 
 - Experience testing applications that interact with hardware devices. 
 - Experience with installation and upgrade testing. 
 - Familiarity with installer technologies such as MSI, WiX, or InstallShield. 
 - Familiarity with Agile software development processes. 

Education & Experience

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related technical discipline, or equivalent practical experience. 
 - 3+ years of software quality assurance experience. 
 - Experience testing commercial software products in a professional environment. 

Personal Attributes

- Strong passion for software quality and customer satisfaction. 
 - Curiosity and persistence when investigating difficult defects and intermittent issues. 
 - Strong attention to detail and a methodical testing approach. 
 - Ability to think from the customer's perspective and identify real-world usage scenarios. 
 - Good organizational and documentation skills. 
 - Collaborative mindset and ability to work effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders. 
 - Ownership mindset and commitment to delivering high-quality software releases. 
 - Comfortable working in a global organization with colleagues across multiple time zones. 
 - Appreciation for the business value and customer impact of mature software products with large installed customer bases. 

We recognize that people come with a wealth of experience and talent. We believe in the value of unique perspectives, and we welcome candidates from diverse backgrounds who may not meet every criterion to apply and bring their distinctive experiences to our team. 

We Offer

- A dynamic, international, and innovative work environment. 
 - Exciting technical challenges and expert colleagues with decades of experience in the field. 
 - A position in our Bangalore office with flexibility in the time schedule and hybrid work model. 
 - A human-sized organization where you'll have contact beyond the R&D department. 
 - Coaching and learning opportunities at every stage of your career. 
 - The opportunity to work on business-critical data platforms that support decision-making across the company. 
 - Be part of building products that address real-world challenges for customers across global industries. You'll have the opportunity to take ownership, influence technical decisions, and see your contributions create measurable business value. 
 - Direct collaboration with engineers, product managers, support teams, and business stakeholders across Europe, Asia, and North America. 
 - A culture that values technical excellence, continuous learning, and constructive challenges. 
 - The freedom to contribute ideas, drive improvements, and influence technical direction. 
 - Opportunities to take ownership of meaningful areas of product quality and see the impact of your work on customer success. 
 - QA engineers are trusted to contribute not only test results, but also insights, ideas, and improvements that help shape our products and development processes. 

Immerse yourself in a vibrant and dynamic workplace that spans industries such as printing, packaging, photography, graphic design, video, automotive, paints, plastics, and textiles. Join a team that thrives on pushing the boundaries of what's possible, where innovation meets impact, and cross-functional teamwork sets us apart. 

X-Rite Pantone, a Veralto company, provides complete end-to-end color management solutions for clients in every industry where color matters. At X-Rite Pantone, you'll deftly blend the art and science of color to help customers inspire, select, measure, formulate, communicate and match color so that users get color right the first time, every time. And along the way, you'll build a vibrant career through rich skill-building opportunities, on-the-job learning, and coaching and training that supports your continued development and growth.

Overview

WELCOME TO SITA

At SITA, we keep airports moving, airlines flying smoothly, and borders open. Our technology and communication innovations power the success of the global air travel industry. 

You'll find us in 95% of international airports, working closely with over 2, 500 transportation and government clients. Each partnership brings unique challenges, and we thrive on delivering fresh solutions and cutting-edge tech to keep operations running like clockwork. We don't just move the world forward-we're proud to be recognized as a Great Place to Work® by 79% of our employees and certified in most of our growing locations. Here, we feel empowered, supported, and inspired to grow. 

Are you ready to love your job?

The adventure begins right here, with you, at SITA. 

PURPOSE

Ensures the software is verified and validated against the criteria set out in the functional and non- functional specifications by defining test cases and ensuring their execution. 

Key Responsibilities

- Develop and execute automated test scripts for Web and API applications. 
 - Perform functional, integration, system and regression testing. 
 - Create and maintain test cases, test data and automation suites. 
 - Execute API testing and backend validation activities. 
 - Participate in Agile ceremonies and collaborate with cross-functional teams. 
 - Report, track and verify defects through resolution. 
 - Contribute to CI/CD pipeline automation and quality improvement initiatives. 

Qualifications

WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Analyze the new feature request together with scrum team and product owner and provide early suggestions to be considered for feature development. 
 - Work with Scrum team on day to day basis as a quality checkpoint for all development work. 
 - Design simplified but effective test cases and keeping regression test packs up to date with new and amended software or services. 
 - Maintain and run automation test scripts
 - Create and capture all test documentations
 - Defect management
 - Performance testing
 - Suggest best practices to improve the quality of the software. 
 - Help developers with automation test scripts. 
 - Highlight issues and risks at early stages to stakeholders. 

About Your Skills

- 2-5 years of experience in Software Testing and QA Automation. 
 - Hands-on experience with Selenium or Playwright. 
 - Strong programming skills in Java or Python. 
 - Experience with TestNG, Cucumber, Gherkin and BDD frameworks. 
 - Experience in API testing using Postman and/or REST Assured. 
 - Proficiency in SQL and database validation. 
 - Experience with Azure DevOps, Jenkins and CI/CD practices. 
 - Familiarity with Git, GitHub, Bitbucket or Azure Repos. 
 - Strong analytical, debugging and communication skills. 
 - Experience working in Agile/Scrum teams. 

NICE-TO-HAVE

- ISTQB Foundation Certification or equivalent testing qualification. 
 - Experience contributing to automation framework development and maintenance. 
 - Knowledge of Shift-Left Testing, Continuous Testing and Risk-Based Testing practices. 
 - Basic understanding of AI/GenAI testing concepts, including prompt validation, hallucination detection and response quality assessment. 
 - Exposure to testing AI-powered applications and automation-assisted testing approaches. 
 - Experience in aviation, airline, airport, travel or border management domains. 

What We Offer

We're all about diversity. We operate in 200 countries and speak 60 different languages and cultures. We're really proud of our inclusive environment. Our offices are comfortable and fun places to work, and we make sure you get to work from home too. Find out what it's like to join our team and take a step closer to your best life ever. 

🏡 Flex Week: Work from home up to 2 days/week (depending on your team's needs)

⏰ Flex Day: Make your workday suit your life and plans. 

🌎 Flex-Location: Take up to 30 days a year to work from any location in the world. 

🌿 Employee Wellbeing: We have got you covered with our Employee Assistance Program (EAP), for you and your dependents 24/7, 365 days/year. We also offer Champion Health - a personalized platform that supports a range of wellbeing needs. 

🚀 Professional Development: At SITA, we believe growth fuels innovation. Our learning ecosystem offers access to world-class platforms and programs designed to help you thrive. From LinkedIn Learning, Microsoft's Enterprise Skills Initiative, and Airport Council International -available to all employees-to specialized solutions like Pluralsight for technology upskilling, Harvard Business Publishing for people leadership, Stanford for strategic development and many others, we align learning opportunities with your Development Plan and our business priorities. Your development journey is supported every step of the way. 

🙌 Competitive Benefits: Competitive benefits that make sense with both your local market and employment status. 

SITA is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We value a diverse workforce. In support of our Employment Equity Program, we encourage women, aboriginal people, members of visible minorities, and/or persons with disabilities to apply and self-identify in the application process.

Join us in building transformative technology that reshapes one of the world's oldest and largest industries.

As a Software Engineer, you will drive the delivery of innovative features while ensuring robustness, scalability, and seamless integration with Parspec's AI-powered platform. 

You will collaborate closely with Product, Frontend, and AI teams to transform feature ideas into reliable solutions, actively participating in the product lifecycle from estimation to production deployment and ongoing support.

Infrastructure Management

Testing & Debugging

Why This Matters

Your contributions will be instrumental in building scalable backend systems that power Parspec's AI-driven platform. By delivering high-quality solutions and optimizing infrastructure, you will drive innovation in construction technology while enabling seamless user experiences for a rapidly growing market. 

Who You Are

You are a skilled backend engineer with 3+ years of experience who thrives in fast-paced environments. You have a proven track record of leading technical projects while collaborating across teams to deliver impactful results.

Preferred Qualifications

We think big, set a standard of excellence and are committed to diversity and a discrimination-free workplace. We welcome applicants from all walks of life to join us and help shape the future at Parspec.

Qualifications

data.title: Engineering Manager
data.description:
Engineering Manager

Realty of America India (Remote)

Location: Remote, India

Reports to: Director, Product & Engineering

Type: Full-time, Permanent/Contract

About Realty of America

Realty of America is a fast-growing, technology-first real estate brokerage. We support 3, 300+ agents today and are scaling rapidly toward 5, 000 and beyond. Our internal team has grown to roughly 80 staff across operations, brokerage, onboarding, agent experience, finance, and product engineering. We build our own internal tools, including our core platform Rex, alongside integrations into best-in-class third-party SaaS such as Brokerage Engine, SkySlope, Close, Follow Up Boss, RealScout, and others. As we scale, we need a strong engineering leader to own delivery, architecture, and team health for the systems that run our business. 

Why this role exists

Rex and our surrounding platform are the operational backbone of a brokerage scaling past 3, 300 agents. As agent count and staff headcount grow, engineering complexity grows with it. We need someone who can own a team end to end: set technical direction, hold the line on production hygiene, push back on product and business where needed, and build a team that gets stronger over time. This is not a ticket-execution role. It is ownership of outcomes for the areas under your team. 

What you will own

Engineering Leadership

- Facilitate discussions and lead decision-making on all engineering aspects of your team. 
 - Define and execute engineering plans for the areas under your ownership. 
 - Drive engineering best practices across the team. 
 - Define, implement, and maintain hygiene of production systems, both engineering and process, for your areas. 

Business & Delivery Ownership

- Own the health of the business functions directly served by your team. 
 - Challenge product and business on outcomes, channel feedback into execution, and be accountable for engineering output. 
 - Manage all relevant stakeholders, including business, product, operations, and clients or vendors. 

Team Building

- Hire, mentor, and retain a best-of-class engineering team. 
 - Build a team culture around ownership, technical rigor, and accountability. 

Architecture & Systems Design

- Design and develop solutions ranging from simple to complex, including large-scale distributed systems where relevant to Rex and its surrounding platform. 
 - Drive design and architecture of multiple subsystems alongside other senior engineers. 

What we are looking for

Required experience

- 8-10 years of software development experience, including 4+ years leading teams. 
 - Proven track record designing and implementing large-scale distributed systems. 
 - Proven track record building and managing high-performing software development teams. 
 - Practical experience driving design and architecture of multiple subsystems with senior engineers. 
 - BTech, MTech, or PhD in Computer Science or a related technical discipline, or equivalent experience. 

Required ways of working

- Excellent verbal and written communication, with the ability to present complex technical information clearly to a variety of audiences, including non-technical stakeholders. 
 - Judgment and initiative. We are looking for someone who proposes, pushes back, and owns outcomes, not someone who waits for direction. 
 - Willingness and proven ability to work hours that overlap meaningfully with US Central Time. 
 - Comfort being accountable for both the technical and business outcomes of your team's work. 

Nice to have

- Past experience with startups or other fast-paced, high-growth environments. 
 - Real estate, fintech, or other regulated-industry software experience. 
 - Experience scaling a platform through significant user or transaction growth. 

What we offer

- Competitive compensation, commensurate with experience. 
 - You report directly to the Director of Product
 - and shape engineering strategy for your area from day one. 
 - Remote-first, with the option of working from our India office once it launches. 
 - The opportunity to lead a team building the core platform for a brokerage scaling toward 5, 000+ agents.

Overview

As a Microsoft Data Center Technician (DCT) Manager, you will lead a team of technicians, providing expert guidance on performing hardware deployments, diagnostics on equipment, and hardware decommissions. You will support technician performance, prioritizing technician tasks while monitoring Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) and Service Level Agreements (SLAs). This opportunity will allow you to model leadership principles, provide training to technicians, and accelerate your career growth in the process. Microsoft's Cloud Operations & Innovation (CO+I) is the engine that powers our cloud services. As a CO+I DCT Manager, you will perform a key role in delivering the core infrastructure and foundational technologies for Microsoft's online services including Bing, Office 365, Xbox, OneDrive, and the Microsoft Azure platform. As a group, CO+I is focused on the personal and professional development of all employees and offers training and growth opportunities including Career Rotation Programs, Diversity & Inclusion training and events, and professional certifications. Our infrastructure is comprised of a large global portfolio of more than 200 data centers in 32 countries and millions of servers. Our foundation is built upon and managed by a team of subject matter experts working to support services for more than 1 billion customers and 20 million businesses in over 90 countries worldwide. With environmental sustainability and optimization at the forefront of our data center design and operations, we continue to grow and evolve as we meet the ever-changing business demands that hold Microsoft as a world-class cloud provider. Microsoft's mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond. 

Responsibilities

- Delivering success through empowerment and accountability by modeling, coaching, and caring while promoting a positive and effective team culture. Accountable for overall data center service compliance and quality. Monitor operational KPIs and ticket performance, identify gaps, and drive corrective actions to improve efficiency and service delivery. Drive continuous improvement by reviewing operational processes, identifying inefficiencies, evaluating process changes, and implementing sustainable improvements. Collaborate across teams and functions to address operational challenges, manage dependencies, mitigate risks, and ensure seamless service execution. Manage assigned projects, programs, and operational initiatives, ensuring effective planning, execution, resource coordination, and adherence to service delivery objectives. Demonstrate end-to-end ownership and accountability for 24/7 critical data center operations, proactively managing business risks, ensuring operational readiness and service excellence, and responding to incidents beyond standard working hours, including weekends, as required. Provide guidance on and holds team accountable for compliance with Data Center Services (DCS) business unit and service-level policies, procedures, deadlines, and service-change policies. Ensures technicians are trained on procedures for installation, deployment, replacement, and post-execution quality check processes. Verify post-execution quality checks have been performed appropriately by technicians and takes corrective action as needed. Escalate issues through appropriate channels and follow up on issue resolution, sharing knowledge related to issue resolution with appropriate teams. Review process changes to evaluate impact on service execution and share relevant information about change with stakeholders across functions and disciplines. Promote a culture of safety and empower technicians to take action, speak up, and report safety concerns and/or incidents. Embody our culture and values.

 - 4+ years' experience supporting IT equipment or related technology. 
 - 3+ years' experience working in a production, mission-critical 24x7x365 data center environment. 
 - Applicable certifications: Information Technology Infrastructure Library (ITIL) Foundation, ASICS/Inventory Control, CompTIA (A+, Server+, Network+), Basic Structure Cabling (BSC), Certified Data Center Professional (CDCP), Microsoft Certified Professional (MCP), Six Sigma Green Belt).

data.description:
About Revolut

Our Financial Crime team blends regulatory expertise with data-driven thinking to make sure our products meet legal and policy requirements and deliver real value to customers. In a fast-moving, digital environment, they stay one step ahead by finding smart, scalable ways to prevent financial crime.

data.title: Associate Lead - Software Engineer
data.description:
Location Name: Pune Corporate Office - Fountainhead

Job Purpose

The AI Engineer - Generative AI role exists to support the design, development, and deployment of GenAI applications using modern LLMs, prompt engineering, and RAG techniques. The position contributes to the organization's AI initiatives by building prototypes, fine?tuning models, and assisting senior engineers in implementing scalable GenAI solutions

Duties And Responsibilities

- GenAI Development
 - Build and test GenAI applications using LLMs (OpenAI, Azure, Vertex, etc. ). 
 - Create and refine prompts for different business scenarios. 
 - Implement basic RAG workflows using embeddings and vector databases. 
 - Assist in fine tuning domain specific models under senior guidance. 

B. Prototyping & POCs

- Support quick POC development for business use cases. 
 - Convert prototypes into working demos with minimal supervision. 
 - Document experiments, results, and prompt iterations. 

C. Engineering Support

- Develop simple APIs or integration components for GenAI features. 
 - Work with senior engineers on testing, debugging, and model evaluation. 
 - Follow coding best practices, clean documentation, and version control. 

D. Research & Continuous Learning

- Stay updated with the latest LLM models, tooling, and GenAI techniques. 
 - Evaluate model performance and experiment with new capabilities. 
 - Contribute ideas for improving current AI solutions. 

Key Decisions / Dimensions

- Model Selection & Customization
 - Choosing the right Speech To Speech, STT, TTS, and S2S models for various Indic languages and dialects. 
 - Deciding between open-source vs. commercial APIs based on latency, cost, and control. 
 - LLM/SLM Strategy
 - Selecting appropriate LLM/SLM architectures for dialogue management and negotiation logic. 
 - Deciding what to fine-tune, distill, or quantize, and what to leave generic. 
 - Edge vs. Cloud Architecture
 - Making trade-offs between on-device processing and cloud-based orchestration. 
 - Defining what runs locally for speed/privacy and what needs backend support. 
 - Emotion & Dialogue Logic Integration
 - Mapping emotional cues to appropriate TTS responses and negotiation tone. 
 - Designing fallback logic for unrecognized or hostile user responses. 
 - Voice Biometrics Algorithm Evaluation
 - Choosing and testing biometric algorithms for authentication and anti-spoofing. 
 - Deciding thresholds for matching, rejection, and fraud escalation. 

Major Challenges

Building a bot that doesn't just answer but negotiates with human-like reasoning. 

Running large models (Speech to Speech/LLM/STT/TTS) in low-latency, low-bandwidth environments without cloud dependency. 

Understanding caller emotions in noisy, multilingual conditions (anger, hesitation, sarcasm). 

Ensuring STT and TTS pipelines work well with dialect-rich, low-resource Indian languages. 

Preventing fraud via recorded calls or deepfake voices. 

Bot must learn from failed interactions

Required Qualifications And Experience

- Educational Background: Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field. 
 - Experience: 2 years of experience in AI/ML, with exposure to Natural Language Processing (NLP) and speech technologies. 
 - Bachelor's/Master's/PhD in Computer Science, AI, Data Science, or related fields. 
 - 7-12 years of experience across Data Engineering, ML Engineering, and AI solution delivery. 
 - Strong hands-on expertise with Python, SQL, cloud services (Azure/GCP/AWS), Spark, ML frameworks. 
 - Deep experience with LLMs, RAG architectures, vector stores, and GenAI platforms. 
 - Proven leadership experience managing Data/ML/AI teams. 
 - 
 - Strong interest and foundational knowledge in Generative AI. 
 - Ability to experiment, iterate, and think creatively with prompts. 
 - Good problem-solving and debugging skills. 
 - Basic understanding of model evaluation and data handling. 
 - Eagerness to learn, high curiosity, and good communication skills.

data.title: Senior Platform Software Engineer
data.description:
Job Description

Owns moderately complex components within platform services or SDKs; leads team-level improvements to integration frameworks and developer tooling. Performs deep debugging across a bounded set of distributed services, driving fixes that protect downstream consumers and upgrade paths. Analyzes usage, performance, and error budgets for specific platform surfaces; implements targeted resilience and capacity optimizations. Authors and curates team-scoped documentation, samples, and adoption guidance. 

Responsibilities

Key Responsibilities

Platform Software Development: 

- Own a bounded platform component (service module, SDK area) and evolve its contracts for multi-tenant use.

 - Implement targeted resilience/capacity patterns and document adoption guidance for team consumers.

- Designs and develops software, systems, and services aligned to pre-defined system architecture. 
 - Develops working knowledge of software architecture decisions and best practices.

 - Implements moderately complex performance optimization and scalability strategies in software design.

data.title: MLOps Engineer
data.description:
Insight Global is seeking an AI DevOps / MLOps Engineer to support and scale the infrastructure powering enterprise AI applications and services. This role focuses on the operational side of AI systems, ensuring model-driven applications are reliable, observable, secure, and production-ready. 

The ideal candidate is an infrastructure-focused engineer who has experience operating Kubernetes-based platforms, automating deployments, improving system reliability, and supporting AI workloads in production environments. 

What You'll Do

- Deploy, operate, and optimize AI services running on Kubernetes environments. 
 - Support MLOps and AI platform tooling, including workflow orchestration, model evaluation pipelines, and AI-enabled automation services. 
 - Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines using modern GitOps practices. 
 - Improve system reliability through health checks, readiness probes, autoscaling, rollback strategies, and resiliency patterns. 
 - Develop observability solutions across logs, metrics, dashboards, alerts, and operational runbooks. 
 - Troubleshoot complex production issues across containers, services, networking, secrets management, and cloud infrastructure. 
 - Collaborate with AI, platform, and operations teams to establish scalable operating practices for AI systems. 
 - Participate in incident response activities and drive continuous improvements based on lessons learned from production events

Required Qualifications

- 5+ years of experience in DevOps, MLOps, Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), Platform Engineering, or Cloud Infrastructure. 
 - Hands-on experience administering and troubleshooting production Kubernetes environments. 
 - Experience with machine learning platform technologies such as Kubeflow or similar workflow orchestration tools. 
 - Strong understanding of Docker, Helm, ArgoCD, GitOps methodologies, and modern CI/CD practices. 
 - Experience supporting production systems with monitoring, alerting, incident management, and operational support processes. 
 - Familiarity with Azure cloud services and AI technologies, including Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Search, RAG architectures, or LLM-powered applications. 
 - Strong understanding of reliability engineering concepts including scaling, retries, failover, health monitoring, and service recovery. 
 - Experience creating technical documentation, operational procedures, and runbooks. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience with service mesh technologies such as Istio. 
 - Experience with event-driven architectures and messaging technologies including Kafka, Event Hub, or Service Bus. 
 - Experience supporting Python-based application environments utilizing FastAPI, Uvicorn, or Gunicorn. 
 - Familiarity with SLO, SLI, incident response, and production support best practices. 
 - Experience supporting AI platforms, RAG pipelines, vector search applications, or enterprise LLM deployments. 

Ideal Candidate Profile

You are an engineer who enjoys building stable, scalable platforms that enable AI applications to operate reliably in production. You have a strong operational mindset, thrive in cloud-native environments, and are comfortable troubleshooting complex infrastructure challenges. Your background combines DevOps excellence with exposure to modern AI platforms and services. 

Technical Environment

- Kubernetes
 - Kubeflow
 - Docker
 - Helm
 - ArgoCD
 - GitOps
 - Azure
 - Azure OpenAI
 - Azure AI Search
 - CI/CD Pipelines
 - Observability & Monitoring
 - RAG Architectures
 - LLM-Based Services
 - Service Reliability Engineering Practices

Job Overview

Plan A Technologies is looking for a Senior Full Stack Developer with strong experience in . NET, Angular, and SQL Server databases to design, develop, and maintain scalable applications within a microservices architecture. The ideal candidate is comfortable working across backend and frontend development and has familiarity with AI-assisted development practices. 

Please note: you must have 10+ years of hands-on experience with . NET (with at least 2 years of experience with . NET 8. 0) and Angular 14+ and the ability to work on-site to be considered for this role. 

JOB RESPONSIBILITY

- Design, develop, and maintain applications using . NET 8. 0 and Angular. 
 - Build and maintain scalable microservices. 
 - Develop and optimize SQL Server databases. 
 - Implement and maintain solutions using Redis and RabbitMQ. 
 - Collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality software. 
 - Follow development best practices, including version control, code reviews, and CI/CD processes. 
 - Leverage AI-assisted development tools and automation to improve productivity and code quality. 

Experience

- 10+ years of hands-on experience with . NET with at least 2 years of experience with 8. 0
 - 8+ years of experience with Angular, including experience with Angular 14+. 
 - Proficiency in SQL Server 2019+. 
 - Proven experience with Microservices Architecture. 
 - Solid working knowledge of Redis and RabbitMQ. 
 - Familiarity with Agentic AI concepts. 
 - Excellent verbal and written English communication skills. 
 - Excellent organizational, problem-solving, and analytical abilities. 
 - Outstanding communication and interpersonal skills. 
 - Initiative and drive to do great things. 

Nice to Have

 - Experience using GitHub Copilot, including creating and updating instructions. md and . yaml configuration files. 
 - Exposure to AI-assisted software development and automation workflows. 

About The Company/Benefits

Plan A Technologies is a global engineering firm created to solve the toughest tech challenges facing today's businesses. Founded by software entrepreneurs Aron Ezra and Slav Kulik, Plan A helps organizations analyze their tech ecosystem to identify exactly what needs to be improved across their products and infrastructure-and then builds the solutions to fix it. 

Rather than offering theoretical ideas or software that never launches, Plan A combines elite engineering talent with custom-built, proprietary AI agents to deliver fast, secure, production-ready solutions. Its capabilities span proprietary AI agent deployment, custom software development, application modernization, data platforms, cloud migrations, systems integration, and practical technical advice. 

With more than 500 successful product deployments completed worldwide, Plan A helps organizations of every size-from ambitious startups to global enterprises-modernize their systems, automate complex operations, and stay ahead of the technology curve. 

Read more about us here: www. PlanAtechnologies. com .

Great colleagues and an upbeat work environment: You'll join an excellent team of supportive engineers and project managers who work hard but don't ever compete with each other. 

Benefits: Vacation, Brand New Laptop, and More: You'll get a generous vacation schedule, and other goodies. 

If this sounds like you, we'd love to hear from you!

data.title: Principal Platform Software Engineer
data.description:
Job Description

About the Company and Team

Oracle is a global technology company delivering enterprise software, database technologies, and cloud infrastructure that help organizations run critical business applications and services. 

Join Oracle's Database organization and contribute to the development and operation of scalable, reliable, cloud-native services. 

The role combines modern backend engineering, infrastructure automation, DevOps practices, and production operations. Engineers contribute across the full software lifecycle, from architecture and development through deployment, monitoring, troubleshooting, and continuous improvement. 

The team also embraces AI-assisted software development, using tools such as Codex to accelerate engineering workflows while maintaining strong standards for code quality, security, and reliability. 

As platform capabilities evolve, engineers will have opportunities to contribute to Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers and integrations that connect cloud services with AI agents. 

Job Summary

Oracle India is seeking a Principal Software Engineer (IC4) with 7+ years of professional software engineering experience to design, develop, deploy, and operate highly available cloud-native backend services. 

You will work on complex engineering challenges involving Java, SQL, distributed systems, microservices, infrastructure automation, and production service reliability. 

In this hands-on role, you will build scalable backend capabilities, improve deployment automation, strengthen observability, and troubleshoot complex production incidents. You will collaborate with engineering, Support, and Operations stakeholders to deliver reliable services and continuous platform improvements. 

You will also use Codex and other agentic development tools for code exploration, implementation, testing, debugging, and documentation, while independently reviewing and validating generated output. 

As the team's capabilities expand, you will contribute to the design, development, and operation of MCP servers and AI-agent integrations. 

The role is suited to an experienced engineer who combines strong backend development fundamentals with practical cloud engineering, production ownership, and a continuous-improvement mindset. 

Responsibilities

Key Responsibilities

- Develop cloud-native backend services: Design, build, test, and maintain reliable, scalable services using modern cloud technologies, Java, SQL, and Agile engineering practices. 
 - Automate infrastructure and deployments: Develop scripts, infrastructure configurations, and automated deployment workflows using technologies such as Terraform and CI/CD pipelines to support repeatable global service deployments. 
 - Apply AI-assisted development: Use Codex and other agentic coding tools extensively for code exploration, implementation, testing, debugging, and documentation. Independently validate generated output for correctness, security, performance, and maintainability. 
 - Ensure production service reliability: Respond to production escalations, lead incident recovery and root-cause investigations, and implement improvements to reduce recurring issues and strengthen service availability. 
 - Improve monitoring and observability: Instrument services, enhance diagnostics, and use monitoring systems, alerts, and dashboards to detect, investigate, and resolve operational problems. 
 - Collaborate across engineering and operations: Partner with Support, Operations, and project stakeholders to resolve technical challenges, coordinate service improvements, and maintain operational readiness. 
 - Drive engineering quality: Participate in code reviews, provide constructive feedback, improve engineering practices, and create technical and operational documentation that makes services easier to maintain and operate. 
 - Contribute to AI integration capabilities: Support the design, development, and operation of MCP servers and related integrations with AI agents as platform requirements evolve. 

Qualifications And Skills

Mandatory

Experience And Education

- 7+ years of professional software engineering experience, with a strong focus on backend development and production systems. 
 - Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, or equivalent software-development experience. 

Backend Software Engineering

- Strong hands-on programming skills in Java and SQL. 
 - Experience designing, developing, testing, debugging, and maintaining production backend services. 
 - Strong software engineering fundamentals, including code quality, maintainability, performance, and troubleshooting. 
 - Experience participating in code reviews and delivering reliable production software. 

Cloud and Distributed Systems

- Practical experience developing or operating cloud-native services. 
 - Understanding of distributed systems, microservice architectures, and highly available services. 
 - Ability to reason about scalability, service availability, failure handling, and operational reliability. 

DevOps and Infrastructure Automation

- Experience automating software deployments or installations using scripting and engineering tools. 
 - Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and version-control practices. 
 - Ability to contribute to service instrumentation and repeatable deployment workflows. 

Production Operations and Reliability

- Experience troubleshooting production software and investigating service failures.

data.title: Senior Automation Tester
data.description:
Eurofins Scientific is an international life sciences company, providing a unique range of analytical testing services to clients across multiple industries, to make life and our environment safer, healthier and more sustainable. From the food you eat, to the water you drink, to the medicines you rely on, Eurofins laboratories work with the biggest companies in the world to ensure the products they supply are safe, their ingredients are authentic and labelling is accurate. 

The Eurofins network of companies believes that it is a global leader in food, environment, pharmaceutical and cosmetic product testing and in discovery pharmacology, forensics, advanced material sciences and AgroScience contract research services. It is also one of the market leaders in certain testing and laboratory services for genomics, and in the support of clinical studies, as well as in biopharma contract development and manufacturing. It also has a rapidly developing presence in highly specialised and molecular clinical diagnostic testing and in-vitro diagnostic products. 

In over 37 years, Eurofins has grown from one laboratory in Nantes, France to over 65, 000 staff across a decentralised and entrepreneurial network of more than 950 laboratories in over 1, 000 companies across 59 countries. Eurofins companies offer a portfolio of over 200, 000 analytical methods to evaluate the safety, identity, composition, authenticity, origin, traceability and purity of biological substances and products. 

In 2024, Eurofins generated total revenues of EUR 6. 95 billion; and has been among the best performing stocks in Europe over the past 20 years.

data.title: Embedded Systems QA Engineer
data.description:
Department- Engineering / Quality Assurance  

Experience- 2 - 4 Years  

Qualification  - B. Tech in ECE / CS / EE or related engineering discipline  

Employment Type  -Full-Time  

Location  -Bangalore, India  

Test Planning & Strategy

- Design and maintain test plans, test cases, and traceability matrices covering functional, integration, regression, and boundary testing
 - Define test coverage for embedded software features, hardware-software interfaces, and system-level workflows
 - Participate in design and requirement reviews to identify testability gaps early in the development cycleCamera & Vision Systems Testing

- Validate camera initialization, configuration, frame acquisition, and image quality parameters against defined specifications

 - Verify correctness of OpenCV-based processing outputs - stitching, alignment, and defect detection results

- Validate REST API contracts - request/response correctness, error handling, edge cases, and performance under load
 - Test Angular-based frontend interfaces for functional correctness, state management, and integration with backend services
 - Build and maintain automated test suites using Python or equivalent scripting for API and regression coverage
 - Perform negative testing, boundary analysis, and stress testing on system services. System Integration & Protocol Validation

- Validate SECS/GEM communication flows - host-equipment message sequences, event reporting, and alarm handling per SEMI standards
 - Test RTSP/WebRTC streaming pipelines for latency, stability, and frame integrity under real-world network conditions
 - Verify end-to-end integration across subsystems: EFEM robot control, camera services, light controllers, and the REST API layer
 - Reproduce and isolate defects at the system integration level; work with engineers to root-cause and verify fixesDefect Management & Reporting

- Log, triage, and track defects with clear reproduction steps, severity classification, and supporting logs or captures
 - Prepare test summary reports, release sign-off documentation, and quality metrics for program review meetings
 - Maintain test environments and manage test data for repeatable, deterministic execution. 

Must-Have

- B. Tech in ECE, CS, EE, or a related engineering discipline
 - 2-4 years of QA/testing experience in embedded software or systems engineering environments
 - Hands-on experience testing REST APIs - using tools such as Postman, cURL, or custom scripts
 - Working knowledge of Linux-based environments; comfortable with CLI, log analysis, and shell scripting
 - Experience with Python for test automation or test tooling
 - Strong analytical thinking - able to break down complex system interactions into discrete, verifiable test scenarios
 - Familiarity with defect tracking and project management tools (Zoho, Jira, or equivalent)

Good to Have

- Exposure to SECS/GEM protocols or SEMI standards for semiconductor equipment communication
 - Experience testing video streaming protocols - RTSP, WebRTC, or GStreamer pipelines
 - Familiarity with camera SDKs, GenICam/GigE Vision, or OpenCV-based image processing
 - Experience with NVIDIA Jetson platforms or ARM-based embedded Linux systems
 - Knowledge of CI/CD pipelines and integrating automated tests into build workflows
 - Exposure to air-gapped or offline deployment environments

Technology Stack You'll Test

- Embedded compute: NVIDIA Jetson AGX Orin, Orin NX (JetPack 6. x, ARM64)
 - Vision systems: camera modules, light controllers, OpenCV image processing pipelines
 - Backend: C++ REST API services, Angular frontend
 - Protocols: SECS/GEM (SEMI E5/E30/E37), RTSP, WebRTC
 - Integration: EFEM robot interfaces, multi-subsystem orchestration
 - OS / Environment: Ubuntu Linux, air-gapped deployment setups

What We Offer

- Deep technical exposure to vision systems and semiconductor automation - a rare combination in QA roles
 - Direct collaboration with embedded engineers and system architects on complex, high-stakes products
 - A quality-first engineering culture where QA is a first-class function, not an afterthought
 - Competitive compensation commensurate with experience.

Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid. 

At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale - tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world. 

Join Visa and do work that matters - to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you.

Visa's Technology Organization is a global community of problem solvers and innovators shaping the future of commerce. We operate one of the world's most sophisticated payment and risk processing networks-capable of handling more than 65K secure transactions per second across 80M merchants, 15K financial institutions, and billions of consumers worldwide. Our teams tackle some of the most complex challenges in distributed systems, global-scale platforms, cybersecurity, data, and next-generation B2C and B2B experiences.

Job Description

Family Description

Applied R&D (AR) consists of target-oriented research either with the goal of solving a particular problem / answering a specific question or for multi-discipline design, development, and implementation of hardware, software, and systems including maintenance support. Supplies techno-economic consulting to clients. AR work is characterised by its detailed and complex nature in order to systematically combine existing knowledge and practices to further developing and incrementally improving products, operational processes, and customer-specific feature development. 

Subfamily Description

Software (SWA) comprises the definition, specification, and allocation of requirements from different sources utilising knowledge of systems engineering processes (specification & architecture). Contains processing of use case and feature requirements into conceptual models, operational scenarios, technical requirements, and functional description. Covers specification, design, implementation, and unit testing of Software (e. g. device drivers, microcode, hardware-related software & firmware) according to the requirements and architecture defined in the systems engineering process. Covers establishment and maintenance of Software Configuration Management (SCM) practices into software development projects, continuously building and integrating infrastructure tools and systems.

data.title: Pharmacovigilance Audit Manager
data.description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Pharmacovigilance Audit Manager based in India. 

This is an exciting opportunity for an experienced pharmacovigilance professional to lead audit activities and strengthen quality and regulatory compliance across a global healthcare environment. You will oversee risk-based audits and assessments of pharmacovigilance operations, internal processes, facilities, and third-party service providers. Working closely with cross-functional stakeholders, you will ensure adherence to applicable regulations, GxP standards, and internal quality requirements. You will also provide expert guidance on complex compliance matters, support regulatory inspections, and drive corrective and preventive actions. In addition to leading audits, you will mentor fellow auditors, contribute to training initiatives, and support continuous improvement across the organization. This fully remote position offers the opportunity to make a meaningful impact on patient safety, product quality, and regulatory excellence. 

Accountabilities

As Pharmacovigilance Audit Manager, you will lead the planning, execution, and reporting of pharmacovigilance audits while providing technical expertise on quality and regulatory compliance. You will work with internal teams and external partners to identify risks, strengthen audit processes, and ensure that corrective actions are effectively implemented. 

- Independently plan, conduct, and report routine and non-routine pharmacovigilance audits, assessments, and inspections in accordance with the annual audit schedule and applicable procedures. 
 - Lead risk-based audits of pharmacovigilance activities, data, internal facilities, and operational processes to verify compliance with corporate policies, internal standards, and regulatory requirements. 
 - Manage complex and business-critical audits, including due diligence, for-cause, cross-functional, and sensitive audits involving systems and service providers. 
 - Support fellow auditors throughout the planning, execution, and reporting stages of audit activities. 
 - Ensure consistent application of audit procedures, diagnostic tools, standard methodologies, and risk-based assessment approaches. 
 - Support the development, implementation, and monitoring of corrective and preventive actions (CAPA) following audit findings. 
 - Evaluate quality and pharmacovigilance agreements, compliance programs, annual product and promotional reviews, trackers, reports, and performance metrics. 
 - Assess the effectiveness of quality systems and compliance processes within local operating companies and third-party organizations. 
 - Ensure appropriate documentation practices and compliance with regulatory requirements, contractual obligations, and internal standards. 
 - Identify non-conformances, assess associated risks, and ensure appropriate corrective and preventive measures are implemented. 
 - Support local operating companies in preparing for regulatory inspections and maintaining inspection readiness. 
 - Participate in regulatory inspections in leadership capacities when required, including acting as inspection host or backroom lead. 
 - Identify auditor training needs, contribute to the development and maintenance of training materials, and deliver training sessions. 
 - Coach and mentor pharmacovigilance auditors, provide constructive performance feedback, and support their professional development. 
 - Review and approve relevant training curricula and ensure personal training requirements are completed on time. 
 - Supervise junior auditors and contractors when required, and deputize for the Audit Manager or Team Lead as needed. 
 - Lead and contribute to cross-functional projects, collaborating with key stakeholders to achieve organizational objectives. 
 - Share regulatory and business expertise, conduct peer reviews of audit reports, and provide independent advice on quality and compliance matters. 
 - Interpret and apply regulatory requirements and internal policies to complex or unusual compliance situations. 

Requirements

The ideal candidate is a highly experienced pharmacovigilance professional with substantial expertise in auditing, regulatory compliance, and quality management. You should demonstrate strong leadership capabilities, sound technical judgment, and the ability to manage complex audit activities within global, cross-functional environments. 

- Approximately 15 years of professional experience in pharmacovigilance. 
 - 3-5 years of specific experience in pharmacovigilance auditing. 
 - Bachelor's degree or equivalent qualification in a relevant discipline, such as Pharmacy, Life Sciences, Medical Sciences, or a related biomedical field. 
 - Proven expertise in pharmacovigilance and GxP requirements, particularly within complex international operating environments. 
 - Demonstrated experience independently planning, conducting, and reporting risk-based audits. 
 - Strong understanding of regulatory compliance frameworks, quality systems, audit methodologies, and corrective and preventive action processes. 
 - Experience assessing internal operations, third-party service providers, pharmacovigilance agreements, and compliance programs. 
 - Proven ability to drive business results through collaborative, end-to-end project delivery. 
 - Strong leadership, mentoring, and stakeholder management skills. 
 - Excellent analytical, critical-thinking, and problem-solving abilities. 
 - Familiarity with emerging AI capabilities and their potential application to business and compliance processes. 
 - Ability to work effectively within a matrixed organization and collaborate with stakeholders from diverse professional and cultural backgrounds.

data.title: Pharma/Clinical Operations QA/Test Engineer
data.description:
EazyML, Recognized by Gartner, EazyML (www. EazyML. com) specializes in Responsible AI. Our solutions facilitate proactive compliance and sustainable automation and The company is associated with breakthrough startups like Amelia. ai. 

You will be responsible for testing and validating GenAI- and Agentic AI-powered solutions for pharmaceutical Clinical Operations. This is a hybrid role combining Clinical Operations domain expertise with functional QA and software testing capabilities. 

You will help ensure that our AI solutions not only function correctly but also produce clinically accurate, meaningful, and reliable outputs. This includes understanding clinical trial workflows, reviewing requirements, developing and executing test cases, identifying defects, and validating AI-generated insights and recommendations. 

The ideal candidate has practical experience in Clinical Operations, understands software testing methodologies and basic QA automation, and is comfortable working with GenAI and Agentic AI technologies. You do not need to be an advanced programmer or AI engineer, but you should be able to work effectively with technical teams and evaluate solutions from both a functional and clinical operations perspective. 

Key responsibilities

Core QA and test planning

- Review business requirements, user stories, workflows, and acceptance criteria to ensure solutions meet clinical operations needs. 
 - Develop and execute functional, integration, regression, exploratory, and user acceptance test cases. 
 - Validate application functionality, reports, dashboards, conversational interfaces, and AI-powered workflows. 
 - Identify, document, reproduce, and track defects through resolution using Jira or similar tools. 
 - Maintain test plans, test cases, test data, execution results, and defect reports. 
 - Collaborate with developers, product managers, and domain experts to resolve functional issues and improve solution quality. 

Pharma clinical operations domain and preferably GxP validation

- Apply working knowledge of clinical trial processes, including study start-up, site selection, patient recruitment, screening, enrollment, site performance, monitoring, and trial execution. 
 - Validate clinical operations workflows, business rules, operational metrics, and AI-generated insights against real-world clinical trial practices. 
 - Assess the accuracy and relevance of trial performance metrics, including enrollment rates, screening failures, site productivity, study milestones, and operational risks. 
 - Understand the role of clinical systems such as CTMS, EDC, eTMF, and related clinical trial platforms. 
 - Review AI-generated clinical operations reports, summaries, and recommendations for domain accuracy, completeness, and practical usefulness. 
 - Apply awareness of Good Clinical Practice (GCP), data integrity, confidentiality, and regulated pharmaceutical environments. 
 - Support risk-based validation and appropriate documentation for solutions used in GxP-relevant workflows, where applicable. 

GenAI and LLM evaluation

- Evaluate GenAI-generated responses for factual accuracy, relevance, completeness, consistency, and alignment with supporting information. 
 - Identify hallucinations, unsupported claims, incorrect calculations, missing information, and misleading conclusions. 
 - Verify that AI-generated clinical insights and recommendations are grounded in appropriate source data and documents. 
 - Develop representative test scenarios, reference datasets, and expected outcomes for clinical operations use cases. 
 - Test AI responses across different prompts, clinical scenarios, input variations, and edge cases. 
 - Understand the non-deterministic nature of LLM outputs and apply appropriate evaluation criteria rather than relying solely on exact text matching. 
 - Collaborate with clinical domain experts and engineers to improve AI response quality and reliability. 

Agent and RAG testing

- Understand the fundamentals of Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) and AI agents, including how they retrieve information, use tools, and execute multi-step workflows. 
 - Test AI-powered workflows from a business-user perspective to ensure tasks are completed accurately and logically. 
 - Validate information retrieved from clinical trial documents, operational databases, and other approved sources. 
 - Check whether AI agents correctly interpret user requests, follow business rules, and produce appropriate outputs. 
 - Test exception handling, missing or conflicting information, and situations requiring human review or escalation. 
 - Verify that changes to data sources, prompts, models, or workflows do not introduce functional or domain-related errors. 
 - Identify potential risks involving sensitive clinical data, inappropriate information disclosure, or unsupported automated actions. 

Automation and CI/CD

- Execute and maintain automated functional and regression test cases using established QA tools and frameworks. 
 - Use tools such as Selenium, Playwright, Postman, or similar platforms for application and API testing. 
 - Identify opportunities to automate repetitive test scenarios and improve testing efficiency. 
 - Apply basic scripting or programming knowledge, preferably Python, to support test execution and data validation. 
 - Understand how automated testing fits into software development and CI/CD processes. 
 - Collaborate with engineering teams to develop and improve automated test coverage. 
 - Explore the use of GenAI tools to assist with test case generation, test data preparation, test automation, and defect analysis. 

Quality ownership

- Ensure solutions meet functional requirements and clinical operations expectations before customer delivery. 
 - Define and apply practical acceptance criteria for functional and AI-generated outputs. 
 - Communicate defects, test outcomes, quality risks, and release readiness to project stakeholders. 
 - Support user acceptance testing and customer validation activities. 
 - Maintain clear testing documentation and evidence of validation. 
 - Collaborate with domain experts and engineering teams to continuously improve solution reliability. 
 - Incorporate customer feedback and previously identified issues into regression testing. 
 - Help establish repeatable QA processes for GenAI- and Agentic AI-powered applications. 

Required qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Life Sciences, Pharmacy, Biotechnology, Clinical Research, Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related discipline. 
 - Approximately 4-8 years of relevant professional experience combining Clinical Operations, clinical systems, software QA, or functional validation. 
 - Strong working knowledge of pharmaceutical Clinical Operations, including the clinical trial lifecycle, operational processes, terminology, and performance metrics. 
 - Experience with functional software testing, test case development, defect tracking, regression testing, and user acceptance testing. 
 - Ability to interpret clinical operations requirements and translate them into realistic test scenarios. 
 - Working understanding of Generative AI, Large Language Models (LLMs), RAG, and Agentic AI concepts, including their capabilities and limitations. 
 - Familiarity with software test automation concepts and tools; advanced programming expertise is not required. 
 - Basic understanding of API testing, data validation, and scripting concepts. 
 - Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify both functional defects and clinically incorrect or misleading outputs. 
 - Good written and verbal communication skills and the ability to collaborate with business and technical teams. 

Nice to have

- Experience working with pharmaceutical companies, CROs, clinical technology vendors, or life sciences consulting organizations. 
 - Hands-on experience with clinical operations platforms such as CTMS, EDC, eTMF, or clinical analytics applications. 
 - Experience testing or validating GenAI applications, conversational AI solutions, RAG systems, or AI agents. 
 - Familiarity with AI evaluation frameworks such as Ragas, DeepEval, LangSmith, or similar tools. 
 - Basic Python, SQL, or JavaScript scripting experience. 
 - Experience with QA automation tools such as Selenium, Playwright, Postman, or pytest. 
 - Exposure to CI/CD environments, Git, GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, or Jenkins. 
 - Knowledge of GCP, GxP, GAMP 5, computer system validation, Computer Software Assurance (CSA), 21 CFR Part 11, and ALCOA+ data integrity principles. 
 - Experience validating clinical trial analytics, operational dashboards, KPIs, risk indicators, or AI-generated decision-support insights. 
 - Familiarity with data privacy, security, and responsible AI principles in pharmaceutical applications. 
 - Experience working in Agile development environments or with globally distributed technology teams.

data.description:
Job Description

What We Do

At Goldman Sachs, our Engineers don't just make things - we make things possible. Change the world by connecting people and capital with ideas. Solve the most challenging and pressing engineering problems for our clients. Join our engineering teams that build massively scalable software and systems, architect low latency infrastructure solutions, proactively guard against cyber threats, and leverage machine learning alongside financial engineering to continuously turn data into action. Create new businesses, transform finance, and explore a world of opportunity at the speed of markets. Goldman Sachs Engineers are innovators and problem-solvers, building solutions in Artificial Intelligence, risk management, big data, mobile and more. 

We are seeking entrepreneurial Agentic Software Engineers to join a newly formed AI Agentic Systems team. This team is tasked with solving firmwide, large-scale compute infrastructure challenges by architecting and deploying autonomous "swarms" of agents. These agents will interface seamlessly with human teams, and complex digital substrates to optimize, analyze, and manage our global technology footprint. 

As a founding member of this team, you will help incubate a new paradigm of software engineering-moving beyond static automation to dynamic, goal-oriented agentic systems that operate across the totality of the firm's business units. 

Key Responsibilities

- Agentic Orchestration: Design and deploy multi-agent systems (swarms) capable of autonomous planning, reasoning, and execution across distributed cloud environments. 
 - System Integration: Build robust interfaces between AI agents, and human stakeholders to ensure high-fidelity feedback loops and operational transparency. 
 - Infrastructure at Scale: Develop agentic solutions for complex compute infrastructure problems, including real-time observability, predictive optimization, and automated capacity planning. 
 - Substrate Development: Contribute to the "agentic substrate"-the underlying platform and tooling that allows agents to securely access data, execute code, and interact with firmwide APIs. 
 - Cross-Functional Incubation: Partner with diverse business units to identify high-impact use cases for agents, translating ambiguous business needs into technical agentic workflows. 

Required Qualifications

- Software Engineering Excellence: Strong proficiency in Python, Go, or C++ with a deep understanding of distributed systems and cloud-native architecture (AWS, Azure, or internal private clouds). 
 - Agentic Experience: Direct experience deploying LLM-based agents in production environments. Familiarity with frameworks such as LangGraph, AutoGPT, or custom-built orchestration layers. 
 - Problem-Solving Domains: Proven track record of applying agentic patterns to at least two of the following: 
 - Data Analysis: Autonomous synthesis of large-scale datasets. 
 - Observability: Self-healing infrastructure and automated root-cause analysis. 
 - Optimization: Dynamic resource allocation and cost management. 
 - Planning: Multi-step task decomposition and execution in non-deterministic environments. 
 - Entrepreneurial Mindset: Ability to thrive in a 0-to-1 environment, comfortable with ambiguity, and driven to build systems that have never existed before. 
Preferred Skills

- Experience with Digital Twin technology and its integration with real-time telemetry. 
 - Knowledge of Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning (MARL) or swarm intelligence principles. 
 - Familiarity with Model Context Protocol (MCP) and other emerging standards for agent-to-tool communication. 
 - Strong communication skills to bridge the gap between technical agentic logic and human-centric business processes. 

About Goldman Sachs

At Goldman Sachs, we commit our people, capital and ideas to help our clients, shareholders and the communities we serve to grow. Founded in 1869, we are a leading global investment banking, securities and investment management firm. Headquartered in New York, we maintain offices around the world. 

We believe who you are makes you better at what you do. We're committed to fostering and advancing diversity and inclusion in our own workplace and beyond by ensuring every individual within our firm has several opportunities to grow professionally and personally, from our training and development opportunities and firmwide networks to benefits, wellness and personal finance offerings and mindfulness programs. Learn more about our culture, benefits, and people at GS. com/careers . 

We're committed to finding reasonable accommodation for candidates with special needs or disabilities during our recruiting process. Learn more: https: //www. goldmansachs. com/careers/footer/disability-statement. html

Our client is a leading Non-Banking Financial Company (NBFC) specialising in Personal Loans (PL) and Loan Against Property (LAP), offering lending solutions to a diverse customer base.

 - Verification & RCU Quality Control
 - Review and validate Field Investigation (FI) reports to identify discrepancies and communicate findings to relevant teams.

 - Team Management & Operational TAT

 - Oversee field agents conducting Residence Verification (RV) and Office Verification (OV). 
 - Ensure timely completion of verification activities while maintaining defined Turnaround Time (TAT) and resolution benchmarks. 
 - Policy Recommendations & Process Improvement
 - Provide actionable feedback to the Credit and Risk Policy teams based on investigation findings and emerging fraud patterns. 
 - Identify fraud trends, operational vulnerabilities, and potential red flags across lending channels. 
 - Recommend improvements to existing policies, processes, and internal controls to strengthen fraud prevention. 

Required Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree or equivalent in any discipline. 
 - Proven experience in credit risk assessment, fraud detection, or related fields. 
 - Strong understanding of RCU and field verification processes. 
 - Experience managing vendors, agencies, or field teams involved in credit due diligence. 
 - Demonstrated ability to coordinate across functions (Sales, Finance, Legal) and manage stakeholder expectations. 
 - High integrity, strong attention to detail, and commitment to ethical standards. 

Preferred Qualifications

- 3-5 years of experience in credit risk, fraud control, or RCU within NBFCs or Banks. 
 - Hands-on experience managing RCU agencies, samplers, and field verification teams. 
 - Postgraduate degree in Finance, Business Administration, or related field. 
 - Exposure to early-warning systems, credit scoring models, or analytics tools. 
 - Experience driving process improvements and setting TAT (Turnaround Time) benchmarks in high-volume environments. 

Preferred Experience

- Experience working with NBFCs or Banks in credit or fraud risk roles. 
 - Familiarity with regulatory frameworks applicable to credit lending and data privacy.
