data.title: Senior Software Engineer — Embedded C / Firewall Client
data.description:
SonicWall  is a cybersecurity forerunner  with more than 30 years of expertise and is recognized as a leading partner-first company, ensuring our partners and their customers are never alone  in the fight against cybercrime. With the ability to build, scale and manage security across the cloud, hybrid and traditional environments in real-time, SonicWall provides relentless security against the most evasive cyberattacks across endless exposure points for increasingly remote, mobile and cloud-enabled users. With its own threat research center, SonicWall can quickly and economically provide purpose-built security solutions to enable any organization-enterprise, government agencies and SMBs-around the world. For more information, visit  www. sonicwall. com  or follow us on  Twitter,   LinkedIn,   Facebook  and  Instagram. 

About the Role

SonicWall is hiring a Senior Software Engineer to develop and maintain the Content Filtering Service client embedded in SonicOS - the firmware running on SonicWall firewall appliances worldwide. This module intercepts live traffic, queries the CFS rating servers in real time, and enforces URL-based content filtering policies at the packet level. This is security-critical code: a policy bug is a traffic bypass on a deployed security appliance. 

The codebase is in C with a split Control Plane / Data Plane architecture, multi-blade cache synchronization, and multiple firmware version upgrade paths. 

Responsibilities

- Maintain, harden, and extend the CFS client module across both the control plane and data plane. 
 - Own the binary UDP protocol implementation between the firewall and the CFS rating servers, ensuring correctness and compatibility across protocol versions. 
 - Develop and maintain complete IPv4 and IPv6 support across all code paths. 
 - Own the firmware upgrade and migration paths, ensuring they are atomic, failure-safe, and correctly handle all supported version transitions. 
 - Improve reliability of inter-blade cache synchronization on multi-blade appliances. 
 - Collaborate with the server-side on coordinated protocol changes. 
 - Document the concurrency model, upgrade invariants, and dataplane integration for long-term maintainability. 
 - Collaborate asynchronously with a US-based team and the India-based server team. Requirements

- Expert-level C  (not C++): disciplined manual memory management, pointer arithmetic, and systems design. 
 - Multi-core concurrency in C: reader-writer locks, spinlocks, atomic operations, and memory ordering. 
 - Kernel-level networking: deep understanding of how a packet moves through a firewall dataplane - TCP/UDP processing, flow cache, connection tracking. Userspace socket programming alone is not sufficient. 
 - Strong IPv4 and IPv6  across all code paths. 
 - Comfortable navigating and owning a large C codebase with multiple subsystems. 
 - Experience with network testing and debugging tools: packet capture (Wireshark/tcpdump), traffic generators, GDB. 
 - Good written English for remote, asynchronous collaboration. Nice to have: 

- Experience with multi-blade or multi-ASIC hardware platforms (Octeon/CVMX or similar). 
 - Understanding of symmetric encryption (AES-CBC, DES) at the C implementation level. 
 - Prior experience on a security appliance, network device, or UTM firmware codebase. 
 - Familiarity with TLV binary protocol design and versioning. 
 - Experience with C fuzz testing or sanitizers (AFL, AddressSanitizer, ThreadSanitizer). Education & Experience

At least 8 years of related experience with a Bachelor's degree; or 6 years with a Master's degree; or a PhD with 3 years' experience; or equivalent experience preferred. Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field preferred.

#Networking

data.title: Staff AI Engineer (Lead)
data.description:
Our Engineering organisation is scaling its AI Engineering capabilities under new leadership, creating an opportunity to shape the next generation of AI at Rapid7. We're looking for Staff AI Engineers to drive the design and delivery of sophisticated LLM and agentic AI systems, influencing technical direction across teams and solving complex, cross-functional challenges. You'll establish engineering best practices, guide architectural decisions and mentor other engineers, helping translate customer needs into scalable AI solutions that advance our product and platform capabilities. 

About The Team

AI is reshaping cybersecurity on both sides. Attackers can use AI to strike at machine speed, and only AI-powered defense can keep up. At the same time, organizations can only adopt AI with confidence if it is secure. Rapid7 sits at the intersection of security and AI, and we are building industry-defining products for this new era. 

Rapid7's AI Engineering team builds the AI that powers our security platform. We are AI engineers and applied scientists who take models from research to production, combining open-source and frontier LLMs, AI agents, and fast predictive models with more than 20 years of Rapid7 security expertise. Our work drives core use cases across Detection and Response, such as alert triage, threat investigation, and automated response, and Exposure and Remediation, such as vulnerability prioritization, attack surface risk assessment, and guided remediation. Together, these help customers stop threats faster and fix what matters most. 

About The Role

As a Staff AI Engineer, your primary responsibility will be to design, build and ship LLM and agentic AI systems across Rapid7's security products, owning the technical solutions for your area end to end. You understand LLMs from transformer internals to fine-tuning and inference optimization, stay hands-on with hard problems, and know where LLMs shine and where they fall short, choosing the right approach among LLMs, predictive AI and classical ML. Specifically, your focus will be to: 

- Lead the design and architecture of LLM and agentic AI systems within Detection and Response and Exposure and Remediation, contributing to the technical roadmap for your area
 - Recommend model strategy for your projects, including when to use frontier or open-source models and when to fine-tune, distill, or post-train
 - Fine-tune, distill and post-train open-source LLMs on security data, from data curation through training, evaluation and deployment
 - Apply and improve engineering practices for context engineering, inference optimization and evaluation, optimizing LLM inference to balance quality, latency and cost
 - Establish evals as the release gate for the AI systems you ship
 - Lead design reviews for your projects and work through complex technical trade-offs
 - Stay hands-on by prototyping and building critical model, training and inference code
 - Mentor engineers on your team and partner with Product and platform teams to align technical solutions with customer needs

The Skills And Qualities You'll Bring Include

- 8+ years of software or ML engineering experience (6+ with an advanced degree, 3+ with a PhD), including 2+ years building production LLM or agentic AI systems
 - A track record of leading the delivery of scalable, production-grade AI systems used by multiple teams or products, with impact across the organisation through technical leadership and mentoring
 - A deep understanding of LLMs, including transformer architecture, attention, tokenization and positional encodings, and how models are trained and served
 - Advanced PyTorch skills, including custom model code, training loops, mixed precision and distributed training (e. g. , FSDP, DeepSpeed)
 - Hands-on fine-tuning and post-training of open-weight LLMs, including full and parameter-efficient methods (LoRA, QLoRA), distillation, and preference or RL-based methods (e. g. , DPO, GRPO)
 - Experience with context engineering (retrieval, memory, and context management for long-running agent workflows) and defining evaluation strategy and benchmarks for LLM and agent systems
 - Strong knowledge of inference optimization, including prefill and decode, KV-cache management, continuous batching, speculative decoding and quantization, and serving at scale with vLLM, SGLang or TensorRT-LLM
 - Strong predictive AI, classical ML, distributed systems and Python fundamentals, with the judgment to make efficient, well-reasoned decisions between these approaches and LLMs based on accuracy, latency and cost
 - Lead AI projects or programs of moderate scope and risk, contributing to the execution strategy, breaking larger goals into milestones, and holding yourself and others to clear expectations and commitments
 - A strong communicator who can explain complex technical concepts and trade-offs to technical and non-technical audiences, building alignment around engineering decisions
 - Builds strong cross-functional partnerships across Engineering, Product and other teams to resolve dependencies, align technical approaches and deliver shared outcomes
 - Translates customer needs into scalable AI solutions, balancing customer value with technical quality and long-term maintainability
 - Embody our core values to foster a culture of excellence that drives meaningful impact and collective success. 

We know that the best ideas and solutions come from multi-dimensional teams. That's because these teams reflect a variety of backgrounds and professional experiences. If you are excited about this role and feel your experience can make an impact, please don't be shy - apply today. 

About Rapid7

At Rapid7, our vision is to create a secure digital world for our customers, our industry, and our communities. We do this by harnessing our collective expertise and passion to challenge what's possible and drive extraordinary impact. We're building a dynamic and collaborative workplace where new ideas are welcome. 

Protecting 11, 500+ customers against bad actors and threats means we're continuing to push the envelope just like we' ve been doing for the past 20 years. If you 're ready to solve some of the toughest challenges in cybersecurity, we're ready to help you take command of your career. Join us.

Summary of Position: 

Alcon is looking for a Principal Software Engineer in Bengaluru to design and build backend services and AI-driven capabilities for the Alcon digital platform. The role sits with the Digital Health Engineering team and spans two areas, core backend services and APIs built with Java, Spring Boot and AWS, and new AI services such as document understanding and conversational assistants. We are looking for a strong backend engineer who can design, build and run production-grade Spring Boot services, and who can also contribute to and drive AI initiatives. This means owning designs end to end, from APIs, data and security through cloud deployment, and from model, prompt and retrieval choices for AI features. You will also help set the engineering standard for the team. 

Key Requirements: 

- Designing, building and maintaining backend services and REST APIs with Java 21+ and Spring Boot, including data models, business logic, integrations and security
 - Applying sound distributed-systems practices: resilience (timeouts, retries, circuit breakers), idempotency, transaction handling and performance tuning. 
 - Contributing to and driving AI initiatives on the platform: proposing use cases, proving them with prototypes and taking them through to production
 - Designing and building AI-powered services such as conversational assistants, using Java 21+, Spring Boot and AWS Bedrock foundation models
 - Building retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) capabilities: document chunking, embeddings, vector search and grounding model answers in product, order and knowledge-base data
 - Securing service-to-service and user-delegated access with OAuth2, JWT validation. 
 - Owning the data layer for your services (PostgreSQL schema design, migrations, environment DDL) and deploying to AWS (Lambda, API Gateway, Secrets Manager, IAM roles)
 - Keeping services production-grade: automated tests, CI/CD, observability (Dynatrace, correlation IDs), current dependencies and clean Veracode SAST/SCA results
 - Reviewing designs and code, mentoring engineers and raising engineering standards across the team
 - Working in a Scrum team with product owners, QA and business stakeholders across India, Europe and the US
 - Providing technical leadership to a small group of engineers: setting direction, breaking down work and unblocking delivery. 

Key Requirements/Minimum Qualifications: 

- Bachelor's or Master's degree with 7+ years building backend and enterprise applications in Java 21+, Spring Boot and AWS, with strong REST API design, Spring Security, JPA/Hibernate and relational database skills (PostgreSQL preferred)
 - Distributed-systems fundamentals: resilience patterns (timeouts, retries, circuit breakers), idempotency, concurrency and transaction handling; performance tuning and batch processing
 - Engineering hygiene: automated tests (JUnit 5, Mockito, Spring Boot Test, Testcontainers), Git, Gradle or Maven, and CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps or Jenkins)
 - Hands-on experience shipping generative-AI features to production: LLM APIs (AWS Bedrock, OpenAI or Azure OpenAI), prompt engineering, structured data extraction from documents (PDF, Excel, images), evaluation or regression testing of model output, and RAG basics: embeddings, chunking and vector stores such as pgvector, Amazon OpenSearch or Bedrock Knowledge Bases
 - AWS experience: Lambda, API Gateway, IAM, Secrets Manager, S3, and infrastructure as code (SAM/CloudFormation or Terraform)
 - Solid grounding in API security: OAuth2, OIDC, JWT, token exchange (RFC 8693) and identity providers. 
 - Secure-coding mindset: able to resolve SAST/SCA findings and keep dependencies current without regressions
 - Production support: troubleshooting and root-cause analysis across logs, APM traces and the database
 - Clear written communication: design notes, API contracts and handover documentation that others can act on
 - Experience in Scrum teams with distributed stakeholders

Good to have

- SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris): CCv2, OCC/REST APIs, facades and populators, ImpEx, cron jobs, B2B accelerator; Spartacus/Angular storefront
 - AI agents and tool integration: Model Context Protocol (MCP), tool/function calling, Amazon Bedrock Agents or Microsoft Copilot Studio
 - Low-code AI agent and automation platforms: Microsoft Copilot Studio, Azure AI Foundry/Azure OpenAI, Power Automate, or Amazon Bedrock Agents
 - Python for model experimentation and evaluation tooling

data.title: Application Developer-AWS Cloud FullStack
data.description:
Introduction

A career in IBM Consulting is built on long-term client relationships and close collaboration worldwide. You'll work with leading companies across industries, helping them shape their hybrid cloud and AI journeys. With support from our strategic partners, robust IBM technology, and Red Hat, you'll have the tools to drive meaningful change and accelerate client impact. At IBM Consulting, curiosity fuels success. You'll be encouraged to challenge the norm, explore new ideas, and create innovative solutions that deliver real results. Our culture of growth and empathy focuses on your long-term career development while valuing your unique skills and experiences. 

Your Role And Responsibilities

As an Application Developer: AWS Cloud FullStack, you will work in a modern cloud-native environment, building solutions around microservices, API-driven architectures, and continuous release cycles. You will collaborate with teams to deliver scalable and resilient applications using Agile methodologies. 

Your Primary Responsibilities Will Include

- Develop Rich UI Applications: Design and implement rich user interface applications using Single Page Applications (SPA) or microfrontends, utilizing frameworks such as ReactJS or Angular. 
 - Build Scalable Backend Microservices: Develop scalable and resilient backend microservices based on 12-factor principles, exposing functionality via API and event interfaces, using programming languages such as Java, NodeJS, or Python. 
 - Implement Data Modeling: Design and implement data models using modern SQL and No-SQL modeling techniques, ensuring data consistency and integrity. 
 - Develop Event-Driven Applications: Build event-driven applications using Kafka, Zookeeper, and other hyperscaler cloud services, ensuring seamless communication between microservices. 
 - Manage AWS Services: Run and manage services on AWS, including PaaS, routing services, databases, event-driven services, observability, and DevSecOps tools, ensuring efficient and secure application deployment. 

Preferred Education

Master's Degree

Required Technical And Professional Expertise

- Cloud-Native Development Experience: Exposure to developing applications in a modern cloud-native environment, utilizing microservices, API-driven architectures, and continuous release cycles via Agile methodologies. 
 - Programming Language Proficiency: Experience with one or more programming languages, including Java, NodeJS, Python, or . Net, and proficiency in frameworks such as Springboot, Quarkus, Django, or Express Js. 
 - Data Modeling Knowledge: Experience with modern SQL and No-SQL modeling techniques, including data model design and implementation. 
 - Hyperscaler Cloud Services: Exposure to hyperscaler cloud services, including Kafka, Zookeeper, and AWS services such as EKS, ECS, Fargate, Lambda, and API Gateway. 
 - DevSecOps Tools: Experience with DevSecOps tools, including CodeBuild, CodeDeploy, CodePipeline, CodeCommit, and observability tools such as CloudWatch and X-Ray. 

Preferred Technical And Professional Experience

- Proficiency in Additional Frameworks: Experience with frameworks such as Quarkus, Django, or Express Js, in addition to Springboot, is beneficial for building scalable and resilient backend microservices. 
 - Knowledge of Multiple Programming Languages: Exposure to multiple programming languages, including Java, NodeJS, Python, or . Net, can enhance development capabilities in a modern cloud-native environment. 
 - Familiarity with AWS Services: Experience with various AWS services, including CloudFront, Lambda@Edge, and AWS MSKafka, can be advantageous in managing and deploying applications on AWS.

data.title: Full Stack Engineer
data.description:
DISH Network Technologies, an EchoStar Company, has been reimagining the future of connectivity for more than 40 years. Our business reach spans satellite television service, live-streaming and on-demand programming, smart home installation services, mobile plans and products, and now we are building America's First Smart NetworkTM. 

Today, our brands include EchoStar, Hughes, DISH TV, Sling TV, DISH Wireless, OnTech and GenMobile. 

Our Technology teams challenge the status quo and reimagine capabilities across industries. Whether through research and development, technology innovation or solution engineering, our people play vital roles in connecting consumers with the products and platforms of tomorrow. 

What Success Looks Like (Objectives)

- Architect, build, and maintain scalable web applications and microservices using Python backends and modern front-end frameworks. 
 - Design, deploy, and manage asynchronous, high-throughput backend services using FastAPI and lightweight REST APIs using Flask REST Framework / Flask-RESTful. 
 - Develop clean, reactive user interfaces (React, Vue, or Angular) optimized for cross-browser performance and UI/UX fidelity. 
 - Configure deployments for continuous delivery to Kubernetes environments with packaging Helm charts and containerization strategies. 
 - Automate configuration management using Ansible and write custom automation scripts in Python and Bash. 
 - Develop automation using python programming

Core Skills, Competencies, and Key Experiences (What you'll bring)

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent experience). 
 - 3-4 years of hands-on experience in a similar Engineer or DevOps role. 

Must have

- Hands-on experience with AWS cloud platforms and services (EC2, S3, Lambda, RDS), or other cloud/virtualization platforms like OCI or VMware. 
 - Strong expertise in Python web frameworks including FastAPI (async/await, Pydantic) and Flask / Flask REST Framework. 
 - Proficiency in JavaScript (ES6+), HTML5, CSS3, and modern SPA frameworks (React. js, Vue. js, or Angular). 
 - Solid understanding of relational (PostgreSQL) and NoSQL databases (MongoDB, Redis), alongside ORMs like SQLAlchemy. 

Nice to have

- Familiarity with AWS CodePipeline, AWS CDK, or cloud-native developer tooling. 
 - Experience with Helm charts for automated Kubernetes deployment management. 
 - Hands on experience with continuous delivery and deployment in AWS EKS
 - Good to have knowledge on AWS RDS with PostgreSQL

data.title: Lead Developer
data.description:
The Next Level of Fire & Life Safety Leadership

With more than two centuries of combined history, brands like Kidde, Kidde Commercial, Edwards, GST, Badger, and Aritech have been leading the way in protecting people and property around the world. Now, we're taking that leadership to the next level. Kidde Global Solutions brings together the most trusted and iconic brands in safety, building upon our shared experience and expertise to address the needs and challenges of more customers in more places. With an unmatched portfolio of solutions and services, and a commitment to constant innovation we're elevating the standards for an entire industry - and establishing the next level of fire and life safety leadership. 

At Kidde Global Solutions, you're joining a global technology leader in fire and life safety solutions and our employees are the heart of it all. With industry-defining brands in life safety and security, you'll be part of a legacy of leadership working with cutting-edge technologies that protect lives and property worldwide. As a leading fire safety brand, our mission is to provide solutions that protect people and property from the effects of fire and related hazards. We're committed to expanding our impact and providing dynamic opportunities for growth within our team. You'll be part of a company that prioritizes quality, integrity, collaboration, and customer care, with the resources, training, and incentives to ensure your success every step of the way. 

About This Role

This role includes developing Angular web screens, Node. js backend services, real-time communication features, REST APIs, and Linux-based deployment support. The developer will work closely with product, engineering, QA, DevOps and global R&D teams. 

Key Responsibilities

Angular Web Client

- Build and maintain Angular web pages using TypeScript. 
 - Create user-friendly screens for configuration, monitoring, alarms, events and diagnostics. 
 - Connect the web application with backend REST APIs and WebSocket services. 
 - Ensure the interface is responsive, reliable and easy to use. 

Node. js Web Backend

- Develop backend services using Node. js and TypeScript. 
 - Design and maintain REST APIs for the Angular web client. 
 - Support real-time communication using WebSockets and socket connections. 
 - Handle authentication, authorization, logging and error handling. 

Linux Deployment and Support

- Deploy and support Node. js services on Linux. 
 - Configure services so they start and recover automatically. 
 - Troubleshoot application, network, server and performance issues. 
 - Maintain secure settings, logs, certificates and deployment procedures. 

Basic Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree
 - 6+ years experience in software development

Preferred Qualifications

Technical Skills

- Strong experience in full-stack web application development. 
 - Good knowledge of Angular, TypeScript, HTML, CSS and responsive design. 
 - Good experience with Node. js, REST APIs and WebSockets. 
 - Understanding of authentication, authorization and secure coding practices. 
 - Experience with Linux environments, command-line tools and service deployment. 
 - Experience with Git or SVN, Jira, Jenkins or similar development tools. 
 - Ability to write unit, integration and automated UI tests. 

Testing Responsibilities

- Create automated tests for frontend and backend features. 
 - Test APIs, WebSocket communication and socket connections. 
 - Support integration testing, product verification and code reviews. 

Experience And Technical Qualifications

- Strong hands-on experience with enterprise web applications. 
 - Experience building scalable, secure and maintainable software. 
 - Ability to work across frontend, backend, database, testing and deployment areas. 

Behavioural Competencies

- Takes ownership and delivers work on time. 
 - Communicates clearly with team members and stakeholders. 
 - Works well independently and as part of a team. 
 - Shows curiosity, accountability and willingness to learn. 

Security Responsibilities

- Follow secure coding practices. 
 - Protect credentials, tokens, keys and configuration secrets. 
 - Use secure communication methods such as HTTPS and TLS. 
 - Support security logging, auditing and vulnerability checks. 

Desirable Experience

- Experience with security, access-control, alarm or industrial-control systems. 
 - Experience with real-time event processing and dashboards. 
 - Knowledge of automated security and dependency-scanning tools. 

Architecture Responsibilities

The developer will be responsible for maintaining clear boundaries between: 

- Keep frontend, backend, real-time communication and deployment components well organized. 
 - Design software that is reliable, secure, scalable and easy to maintain. 
 - Document interfaces, protocols, deployment steps and system behavior clearly. 

The system should remain cohesive and maintainable, with only the independent modules required to provide reliability, security, scalability and clear separation of responsibilities. 

Personal Attributes

- Able to work effectively across frontend, backend, protocol and Linux environments. 
 - Strong attention to protocol accuracy, security and data integrity. 
 - Able to diagnose issues across the browser, application, network and operating-system layers. 
 - Focused on reliability, maintainability and predictable system behaviour. 
 - Comfortable working with real-time, high-volume security information. 
 - Able to translate complex technical functions into clear operator interfaces. 
 - Capable of working within an established architecture. 
 - Able to collaborate with embedded, mobile, test and product-development teams. 
 - Capable of documenting interfaces, protocols, deployment processes and system behaviour clearly. 

World Leaders in Fire and Life Safety

Kidde Global Solutions is a world leader in fire & life safety solutions tailored for complex commercial facilities to homes. Through iconic, industry-defining brands including Kidde, Kidde Commercial, Edwards, GST, Badger, and Aritech, we provide residential and commercial customers with advanced solutions and services to protect people and property in a wide range of applications, all around the globe.

data.title: Senior Frontend Developer
data.description:
Accellor is an AI-native services firm focused on delivering measurable business outcomes through advanced AI, data, and engineering capabilities. We help global innovators and Fortune 100 enterprises modernize their architectures, scale operations, and operationalize intelligence across the enterprise. 

Our core focus centers on transforming advanced AI from proofs-of-concept into production-grade systems. Spanning AI solutions, robust data services, enterprise applications, and product engineering - we tailor our offerings to the distinct operational needs of industries such as healthcare, life sciences, telecom, retail, financial services, and technology. 

Operating as an extension of our clients' teams, we combine design thinking with technology-agnostic architectures to ensure faster time-to-value and seamless system interoperability. From initial strategy to full-scale deployment, we build intelligent, connected ecosystems that drive sustained enterprise value and redefine the future of transformation. 

Job Description

We're looking for a Senior Frontend (UI) Developer with a strong focus on UI development: someone who turns designs into polished, responsive and accessible interfaces, and has the practical frontend knowledge to make them work in real applications. You'll use AI tools as a normal part of how you build and review code. 

Responsibilities

- Turn Figma designs into pixel-perfect, responsive interfaces that work across devices and browsers. 
 - Build and maintain reusable UI components and contribute to the design system. 
 - Write clean, scalable HTML and CSS, including layouts, theming and design tokens. 
 - Add animations, transitions and micro-interactions that make interfaces feel polished. 
 - Ensure accessibility (WCAG) and consistent UI quality, working closely with designers. 
 - Build interactive features in React and connect them to backend APIs. 
 - Debug, test and optimise UI performance, and take part in code reviews. 

Requirements

- 3-5 years of UI or frontend development experience, with live work or a portfolio that shows UI quality. 
 - Expert HTML5 and CSS3, including Flexbox, Grid, responsive design and cross-browser behaviour. 
 - Experience with Tailwind CSS, SCSS or CSS-in-JS, and component tools such as Storybook. 
 - Hands-on experience with UI component libraries such as MUI (Material UI) and Radix UI, including customising and theming them. 
 - A strong eye for detail: spacing, typography and visual consistency. 
 - Comfortable working in Figma and collaborating closely with designers. 
 - Practical working knowledge of JavaScript, TypeScript and React (components, state, hooks and API calls). 
 - Comfortable with Git, code reviews and basic testing. 

AI Tools & Workflow

- Daily use of AI coding tools such as GitHub Copilot, Cursor or Claude Code to build and refine UI faster. 
 - Experience using design-to-code tools (e. g. Figma Dev Mode, v0) to generate first-pass components, then refining them to production quality. 
 - Ability to give AI tools clear context so their output follows the design system and team standards. 
 - Strong review habits: checking AI-generated UI for visual accuracy, accessibility and code quality. 

Good To Have

- Experience with UI animation libraries such as GSAP, React Spring or Lottie. 
 - Experience building AI-powered interfaces, such as chat or assistant UIs. 
 - Next. js experience or work on large-scale design systems. 

Benefits

Exciting Projects: We focus on industries like High-Tech, communication, media, healthcare, retail and telecom. Our customer list is full of fantastic global brands and leaders who love what we build for them. Collaborative Environment: You Can expand your skills by collaborating with a diverse team of highly talented people in an open, laidback environment - or even abroad in one of our global centres. 

Work-Life Balance: Accellor prioritizes work-life balance, which is why we offer flexible work schedules, opportunities to work from home, and paid time off and holidays. 

Professional Development: Our dedicated Learning & Development team regularly organizes Communication skills training, Stress Management program, professional certifications, and technical and soft skill trainings. 

Excellent Benefits: We provide our employees with competitive salaries, family medical insurance, Personal Accident Insurance, Periodic health awareness program, extended maternity leave, annual performance bonuses, and referral bonuses. 

Disclaimer: -

Accellor is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate in hiring or any employment decision based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or other applicable legally protected characteristic.

data.title: Staff Software Engineer
data.description:
The Company
PayPal has been revolutionizing commerce globally for more than 25 years. Creating innovative experiences that make moving money, selling, and shopping simple, personalized, and secure, PayPal empowers consumers and businesses in approximately 200 markets to join and thrive in the global economy. 

We operate a global, two-sided network at scale that connects hundreds of millions of merchants and consumers. We help merchants and consumers connect, transact, and complete payments, whether they are online or in person. PayPal is more than a connection to third-party payment networks. We provide proprietary payment solutions accepted by merchants that enable the completion of payments on our platform on behalf of our customers. 

We offer our customers the flexibility to use their accounts to purchase and receive payments for goods and services, as well as the ability to transfer and withdraw funds. We enable consumers to exchange funds more safely with merchants using a variety of funding sources, which may include a bank account, a PayPal or Venmo account balance, PayPal and Venmo branded credit products, a credit card, a debit card, certain cryptocurrencies, or other stored value products such as gift cards, and eligible credit card rewards. Our PayPal, Venmo, and Xoom products also make it safer and simpler for friends and family to transfer funds to each other. We offer merchants an end-to-end payments solution that provides authorization and settlement capabilities, as well as instant access to funds and payouts. We also help merchants connect with their customers, process exchanges and returns, and manage risk. We enable consumers to engage in cross-border shopping and merchants to extend their global reach while reducing the complexity and friction involved in enabling cross-border trade. 

Our beliefs are the foundation for how we conduct business every day. We live each day guided by our core values of Inclusion, Innovation, Collaboration, and Wellness. Together, our values ensure that we work together as one global team with our customers at the center of everything we do - and they push us to ensure we take care of ourselves, each other, and our communities. 

Job Summary: 

What You Need To Know About The Role
You'll be a Staff Software Engineer and a technical leader for the backend of PayPal's real-time decisioning platform. You'll set the technical direction for the rule engine and the services around it, and your decisions will shape how many teams across PayPal build on the platform. This is a hands-on role. You'll still design and write critical code, but your biggest impact will come from the approaches you define, the problems you spot before they happen and the engineers you help grow. You'll be a go-to voice for architecture across Bangalore, San Jose and Shanghai. 

Meet our team

data.title: Senior Developer (.NET)
data.description:
At Zurich Cover-More, we're proud to be one of the world's leading travel insurance and assistance providers. Each year, we protect more than 20 million travellers worldwide, making sure we're there every step of their journey with proactive care, personalised cover and specialist support. Zurich Cover-More partners with many of the world's best-known brands - think major airlines, travel giants, top banks, credit card providers, and large retailers - to deliver more care, more cover, for all. 

Launched in December 2024, Zurich Cover-More is the global travel brand of Zurich Insurance Group, one of the world's leading multi-line insurers. Our family of customer-facing brands includes trusted names like Travel Guard, Cover-More Travel Insurance, Travelex Insurance, Universal Assistance, World Travel Protection, Freely, and Blue Insurance. Together, we're redefining what it means to travel safely and with confidence. Whether it's a long-awaited holiday, a last-minute business trip, or an unexpected detour, we deliver in the moments that matter. 

About Travel Guard

This role is part of our Travel Guard team. Travel Guard is a leading travel insurance brand, serving millions of leisure and business travellers worldwide. Established in 1982 we offer a comprehensive portfolio of travel insurance solutions and global assistance services. Travel Guard operates service centres across Asia, Europe, and the Americas, ensuring 24/7 support to help travellers navigate unexpected circumstances that may disrupt their plans. Travel Guard became part of Zurich Cover-More in December 2024. 

What You'll Do

- You'll execute the full lifecycle of software development. You'll write well-designed, testable, and efficient code. 
 - You'll integrate software components into a fully functional software system. 
 - You'll develop software verification plans and quality assurance procedures. 
 - You'll test products in controlled, real-world environments before deployment. 
 - You'll comply with project plans, technical requirements, and industry standards. 

What We Are Looking For

- You'll hold a degree in Computer Science or a related discipline with a significant programming component. 
 - You'll demonstrate strong experience and knowledge of ASP. NET, C#/. NET Frameworks, and software design principles. 
 - You'll possess strong experience and knowledge of . NET web service frameworks, including WCF and REST APIs. 
 - You'll have strong proficiency in MSSQL, database design, and database performance tuning. 
 - You'll have solid experience with unit testing methodologies in . NET and C# environments. 
 - You'll be experienced in using source control applications such as Git. 
 - You'll demonstrate strong problem-solving skills and the ability to think critically in fast-paced environments. 
 - You'll possess excellent communication skills and a collaborative mindset, enabling you to work effectively within a team. 
 - You'll have experience working in Agile development environments. 
 - You'll have AWS cloud experience, including hands-on work with services such as EC2, Lambda, S3, API Gateway, CloudWatch, and CloudFormation or Terraform for infrastructure as code. 
 - You'll have experience deploying, monitoring, and optimizing . NET applications in AWS environments. 
 - You'll have a strong understanding of cloud security best practices and CI/CD pipelines, including tools such as AWS CodePipeline and GitHub Actions. 

Desirable: 

- You'll bring 8+ years of experience in ASP. NET C# software development. 
 - You'll have a good working knowledge of HTML, JavaScript, and CSS. 
 - You'll have experience working with SQL Server Integration Services (SSIS) and SQL Server Reporting Services (SSRS). 
 - You'll demonstrate strong knowledge of web security best practices. 
 - You'll have experience working in Test-Driven Development (TDD) environments. 
 - You'll have prior experience within the insurance industry, which will be considered an advantage. 

Why you'll love working with us!

We value optimism, caring, togetherness, reliability, results-orientation, and forward-thinking. 

We have more than 3000 employees worldwide. We are a global group of digital specialists, actuaries, marketers, doctors, nurses, case managers, claims specialists, finance experts, customer service and corporate services professionals. We share a global purpose to look after travellers, at every step of their journey. 

Career growth. This is an extremely exciting time for us at Zurich Cover-More, as we rapidly expand our business across the globe. We're committed to helping our people thrive through a comprehensive onboarding experience, continuous professional development, and a supportive work environment that empowers growth at every stage of your career. 

Take the time you need, for you and your community. We encourage you to take the time you need when you need it. We offer regular annual and personal leave benefits. 

Diversity and inclusion. We respect who you are and thoroughly embrace diversity. Wherever life has taken you, we welcome you to bring your whole self to work. Just be you - because that's exactly who we're looking for. 

Appy today and let's go to great places together!

Responsible for designing, developing and testing software to create Digital Energy Transmission suite of products and services tailored to the needs of the GE businesses and external customers. data.title: Product Quality Assurance Lead
data.description:
Transport is at the core of modern society. Imagine using your expertise to shape sustainable transport and infrastructure solutions for the future. If you seek to make a difference on a global scale, working with next-gen technologies and the sharpest collaborative teams, then we could be a perfect match. 

Why this role matters

At Volvo CE, we are transforming how the world builds and maintains infrastructure - moving from traditional diesel solutions to smart, sustainable electromobility. In this role, you will lead product maintenance and cost reduction initiatives for Compactors, ensuring that our products meet customer expectations in terms of quality. You will own the Product Maintenance process, driving initiatives to address feedback from Manufacturing or field. 

What You Will Do

You will work cross functionally within organization as well as with external dealer partners, focusing on providing solutions basis a structured and data backed problem solving methodology. Using your expertise, you will: 

- Lead product maintenance quality activities for locally built Compactors, guiding field-quality cases from early detection through solution validation and follow-up. 
 - Lead product-maintenance projects that improve quality, reduce warranty costs and failures, support manufacturability, and address regional feature needs. 
 - Lead cost reduction and supply obsolescence related initiatives as part of product life cycle management
 - Analyse field, warranty and failure data to identify emerging customer issues, understand their impact and prioritise cases for investigation. 
 - Drive root-cause analysis with cross-functional teams, agree on containment and corrective actions, and verify that implemented solutions are effective. 
 - Ensure containment actions are rapidly implemented to minimize customer impact and prevent escalation of quality issues in the field. 
 - Capture and deploy lessons learned from major quality cases to improve future product development and maintenance activities. 
 - Support customers, markets and internal teams with technical solutions, including when issues affect production, shipment or machine operation. 

Your Main Responsibilities

- Issue resolution: Coordinate investigation of field-quality issues, support rapid containment, and drive actions through the relevant phases of the DMAIC process. Drive verification of corrective actions to ensure sustainable resolution and prevention of recurrence of product quality issues
 - Cross-functional coordination: Align Design Engineering, Purchasing, Manufacturing, Operations, Product support and other stakeholders on priorities, actions, owners and timing. Facilitate lessons learned reviews and ensure knowledge is captured and shared across relevant functions. 
 - Customer and market support: Help resolve reported technical problems, through customer site visits when needed, and provide technical input to the product support team. 
 - Communication and reporting: Share regular updates on defined product quality metrics, warranty costs, case progress, risks and solution effectiveness with internal stakeholders. Ensure complete documentation and case status update in Chain tool. 
 - Meetings and follow-up: Chair cross-functional PM meetings, follow-up on cases in the Control phase, and support case-builder and regional meetings. 
 - Cost reduction initiatives and Manufacturing support: Lead and coordinate initiatives related to cost reduction implementation, design specific manufacturing issue resolution and supply obsolescence. 

Who You Are

You are a collaborative and decisive quality leader who can bring people together to solve complex product issues. You are comfortable working with ambiguity, prioritising competing concerns and motivating others to act. You bring strong communication, negotiation and organisational skills, along with process-management capability and sound knowledge of root-cause analysis / DMAIC process. You can interpret statistical information, explain technical issues clearly and lead cross-functional teams toward validated, effective solutions. You have demonstrated ability to coach, mentor and guide less experienced engineers and quality professionals while managing complex cross-functional initiatives with limited supervision

Your background

- Overall experience: more than 15 years, including: 
 - More than 5 years of Product development and product maintenance experience for Compactors
 - More than 10 years of experience in off-highway equipment engineering and development
 - Education: Bachelor's or Master's degree in Mechanical Engineering
What We Offer

- The opportunity to join a team of highly motivated and passionate individuals who are developing world class products (Diesel and Electromobility)
 - Exposure to global markets, customers and cross-functional teams
 - A culture that values safety, sustainability, innovation and continuous improvement
 - A collaborative environment where your experience is recognized and your ideas can make a visible impact

If this sounds like you, we would be happy to hear from you. Apply and help us build sustainable, high‐performing machines for the future of construction. 

We value your data privacy and therefore do not accept applications via mail. 

Who We Are And What We Believe In

We are committed to shaping the future landscape of efficient, safe, and sustainable transport solutions. Fulfilling our mission creates countless career opportunities for talents across the group's leading brands and entities. 

Applying to this job offers you the opportunity to join Volvo Group. Every day, you will be working with some of the sharpest and most creative brains in our field to be able to leave our society in better shape for the next generation. We are passionate about what we do, and we thrive on teamwork. We are almost 100, 000 people united around the world by a culture of care, inclusiveness, and empowerment. 

Part of Volvo Group, Volvo Construction Equipment is a global company driven by our purpose to build the world we want to live in. Together we develop and deliver solutions for a cleaner, smarter, and more connected world. By unleashing everyone's full potential, we build a more sustainable future for all our stakeholders. Come join our team and help us build a better tomorrow.

data.title: Sr. System Engineer/Team Lead
data.description:
The Role

As a Senior Systems Engineer / Team Lead in our Systems Engineering function, you will lead system validation, technical reviews and risk management for large-scale warehouse automation projects. You will ensure that integrated systems (mechanical, controls and software) meet performance, safety and reliability expectations. The role requires strong ownership across FAT, SAT and system performance validation, along with mentoring junior engineers and driving first-time-right execution. 

Key Responsibilities

1. Technical Review & System Validation

• Ensure alignment of system design with project requirements and operational expectations

• Own the validation strategy for the complete system, including mechanical, controls and software interfaces

• Identify design gaps early and drive corrective actions proactively

2. Risk Assessment & Mitigation

• Lead system-level risk assessment including functional, operational and safety risks

• Drive risk mitigation plans with cross-functional teams

• Ensure closure of critical risks before system deployment

• Continuously monitor system performance to identify emerging risks

3. FAT / SAT Ownership

• Own preparation and readiness for FAT and SAT activities

• Define, review and approve test cases for system validation

• Lead FAT/SAT execution and ensure first-pass success

• Analyse test results and drive improvements before final deployment

• Ensure alignment between system performance and customer expectations

4. Documentation & Reporting

• Ensure preparation and validation of acceptance test plans for the complete system

• Maintain structured documentation for validation, risk and compliance

• Generate technical reports and communicate findings to stakeholders

• Ensure traceability between requirements, validation and outcomes

5. Cross-Functional & Supplier Collaboration

• Work closely with Mechanical, Electrical, Controls, Software and Project teams

• Drive alignment across design, execution and commissioning phases

• Support issue resolution across the lifecycle, from design to site execution

• Coordinate with third-party equipment suppliers to align technical specifications, interfaces and testing requirements

6. Safety & Compliance

• Ensure compliance with safety standards such as ISO 13849, IEC 61508 and OSHA

• Validate safety mechanisms including emergency stops, interlocks and fail-safe operations

• Lead safety validation during FAT and commissioning

7. Site Support & Commissioning

• Travel to project sites (>30%) for commissioning, troubleshooting and validation

• Ensure system readiness for handover to the customer

• Support resolution of critical site issues and performance gaps

8. Mentoring & Capability Building

• Mentor junior systems engineers on validation, risk assessment and technical reviews

• Establish best practices, checklists and validation frameworks

• Support knowledge sharing and team capability development

9. Continuous Improvement

• Drive improvements in validation processes and systems engineering practices

• Capture learnings from projects and implement standardisation

• Stay updated with industry trends and emerging technologies

Preferred Candidate

• Bachelor's degree in Electrical, Mechanical, Mechatronics, Instrumentation, Robotics, Automation, Production or a related field

• 5+ years of experience in systems engineering or a similar field within automation or industrial projects

• Strong understanding of warehouse automation, material handling systems and order fulfilment

• Experience in FAT, SAT, commissioning and system validation

• Knowledge of controls, system architecture and software integration

• Proficiency in risk assessment and technical validation processes

• Strong analytical, problem-solving and communication skills

• Ability to work in cross-functional environments and drive technical alignment

Good to Have

• PLC platforms: Siemens

• Warehouse systems: WCS/WMS exposure

Function: Quality Assurance & Quality Control

Location: SIPCOT Chennai

Team

ROLE PURPOSE

Own the quality system and the delivered quality of machined and assembled aerospace components leaving the Chennai plant. The role carries single-point accountability for AS9100D certification, customer quality performance, supplier quality, and the inspection and metrology capability that supports both. It is a hands-on plant role, based at the manufacturing site and accountable to the plant leadership team. 

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

1. Quality Management System

- Maintain and continually strengthen the AS9100D / ISO 9001 QMS; act as Management Representative for the site. 
 - Plan and lead certification, surveillance, customer and internal audits; close findings within committed timelines with verified effectiveness. 
 - Own document and change control, configuration management, record retention, and management review inputs. 

2. Customer Quality

- Act as the single quality interface for customers - complaints, escapes, concessions, deviation requests and quality portals. 
 - Lead root cause and corrective action (8D / RCCA) with disciplined problem statements, containment, verified root cause and read-across to similar part families. 
 - Drive down DPPM, escapes and cost of poor quality; present quality performance in customer reviews and business reviews. 
 - Support customer approvals, source inspection visits, and first-article approval submissions. 

3. New Product Introduction

- Own the quality deliverables in APQP / AS9145 for new parts and transfers of work - PFMEA, control plans, process flow, MSA, capability studies and PPAP. 
 - Prepare and approve First Article Inspection Reports to AS9102; ensure drawing, GD&T (ASME Y14. 5) and specification requirements are correctly flowed to the shop floor. 
 - Review customer drawings, purchase order quality clauses and specification revisions for feasibility and risk at quoting stage. 

4. Supplier & Special Process Quality

- Approve, assess and develop suppliers and sub-contractors; maintain the approved supplier list and supplier scorecards. 
 - Control special processes - heat treatment, NDT, chemical processing, surface treatment, welding - through NADCAP-accredited or customer-approved sources. 
 - Flow down customer quality requirements, including counterfeit parts prevention (AS5553), traceability and certificate-of-conformance requirements. 
 - Manage supplier corrective actions and incoming inspection strategy. 

5. Product & Process Quality on the Shop Floor

- Set the inspection strategy across in-process, final and pre-despatch stages for CNC turned, milled and multi-axis machined parts. 
 - Own metrology and calibration - CMM, vision systems, surface finish and hardness testing, gauges and fixtures - with traceable calibration and MSA-backed measurement capability. 
 - Control non-conforming material: MRB discipline, segregation, disposition and rework/repair routings. 
 - Enforce FOD prevention, product identification and traceability, shelf-life, ESD and handling controls. 

6. Continuous Improvement & Team

- Use SPC, capability studies and Pareto-driven analysis to reduce scrap, rework and variation on high-runner part families. 
 - Build the quality organisation - structure, skill matrix, certification of inspectors, succession for critical metrology roles. 
 - Partner with Production, Engineering, Planning and Supply Chain so that quality decisions are taken at the point of manufacture, not at final inspection. 

QUALIFICATIONS & EXPERIENCE

Education

B. E. / B. Tech in Mechanical, Production, Industrial or Aeronautical Engineering. v

Experience

12-18 years in manufacturing quality, of which a minimum of 6-8 years in aerospace, defence or a comparably regulated precision engineering environment. At least 4 years leading a quality function or a substantial quality team. 

Essential exposure

AS9100D QMS ownership; CNC machined components; AS9102 FAI; 8D/RCCA; CMM-based inspection; supplier quality; direct customer-facing quality responsibility. 

TECHNICAL COMPETENCIES

- AS9100D and ISO 9001 - clause-level working knowledge, not certificate-level familiarity. 
 - GD&T to ASME Y14. 5; drawing and specification interpretation; datum scheme and tolerance stack judgement. 
 - Metrology - CMM programming and operation (PC-DMIS, Calypso or equivalent), optical and contact measurement, gauge design and R&R. 
 - APQP/AS9145, PPAP, PFMEA, control plans, MSA, SPC and process capability (Cp, Cpk, Ppk). 
 - Structured problem solving - 8D, 5-Why/ Ishikawa, Is/Is-Not, DOE basics. 
 - Machining process knowledge sufficient to challenge a process engineer on fixturing, tooling, coolant, thermal effects and surface integrity. 
 - Working awareness of export control and documentation discipline applicable to aerospace supply from an SEZ unit.

The Associate Engineering Manager acts as the senior engineering authority aligned to a dedicated pod and serves as the technical anchor for its domain. Sitting directly inside a single pod, the role provides system design judgement, holds final technical review authority for complex or high-risk changes, and maintains the domain context and knowledge artefacts required to ensure agent-generated output is accurate and trusted. 

The role plays a critical part in building visible engineering leadership, combining technical decision authority over what commits to production with widespread knowledge sharing across the broader engineering cohort. By maintaining specific domain knowledge while simultaneously increasing the universal knowledge base, the Associate Engineering Manager ensures that all future work can be picked up dynamically and is not entirely reliant on isolated domain expertise. 

In this role you will: 

Technical Authority and System Design: 

- Provide system design judgement on work produced by pod agents, ensuring architectural fit, scalability, and non-functional requirements are met. 
 - Hold final technical review authority for complex or high-risk changes prior to production deployment. 
 - Set and maintain the threshold at which change escalates from commit gates to principal-level review. 
 - Conduct rapid and accurate reviews of agent-generated code, specifications, and test suites to maintain continuous delivery flow. 

Domain Context and Knowledge Integrity: 

- Maintain specific domain knowledge while increasing the universal knowledge base, ensuring all future work can be picked up without total reliance on domain-specific expertise. 
 - Set feature-specific context in line with the overall context frameworks established by the platform team. 
 - Partner with Context Engineers to translate tacit domain knowledge into shared, machine-readable context repositories. 
 - Audit domain context repositories regularly to eliminate outdated logic, reduce context drift, and improve agent output precision. 

People Leadership and Capability Uplift: 

- Establish and enforce rigorous code review discipline across the team and defined commit gates. 
 - Support the Senior Engineering Manager with recruitment, onboarding, and capability assessment across the local engineering cohort. 
 - Identify capability gaps in the pod and design targeted technical uplift initiatives to address them. 

Knowledge Sharing and Technical Coaching: 

- Align to a single pod while actively increasing knowledge sharing and technical coaching across the wider engineering cohort. 
 - Mentor engineers on prompt orchestration, context formatting, and agent output evaluation techniques. 
 - Facilitate cross-pod technical huddles and post-mortems to disseminate learnings from complex production changes. 
 - Build reusable agent templates, prompt patterns, and automation workflows for use by the broader engineering organization. 

Standards, Quality and Governance: 

- Partner with Domain Architects and Associate AI Agent Evaluation Engineers to detect model drift, maintain safety boundaries, and enforce coding standards. 
 - Negotiate tooling, platform standards, and operational guidelines with central platform teams on behalf of the pod. 
 - Absorb traditional quality assurance accountabilities by embedding human-in-the-loop review controls directly into the engineering commit process. 

Production Accountability: 

- Act as the primary technical escalation point for production incidents within the domain. 
 - Diagnose root causes of non-deterministic system failures and ensure remediation tasks are integrated into the engineering backlog. 
 - Lead technical response efforts during severe domain outages to restore service quickly and minimize business impact. 
 - Conduct post-incident technical reviews to update domain context and prevent recurring failure modes in agent outputs. 

Essential: 

- Education: Tertiary degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field. 
 - Experience: Minimum of 12+ years of professional software engineering experience, including 4+ years at a Principal, Staff, or Lead level within complex domain environments. 
 - Technical Mastery: Advanced expertise in system design (front-end, back-end, integration), CI/CD pipelines, and broad agent orchestration frameworks. 
 - Generic AI Tooling: Deep understanding and practical experience with generic, modern AI/LLM tooling and orchestration methods that can adapt as technology evolves. 
 - Observability Platforms: Demonstrated ability to design evaluations and interpret observability data for non-deterministic systems using tools such as Sumo and Datadog. 
 - Architectural Literacy: Strong cross-domain architecture literacy with the ability to evaluate agent-generated code, conduct rapid technical risk assessments, and collaborate with enterprise architects. 
 - Leadership/Influence: Proven formal people management experience, specifically mentoring senior-level engineers and establishing robust technical governance. 

Preferred: 

- Industry Context: Experience within retail, e-commerce, omnichannel platforms, or fast-paced commercial technology environments. 
 - Transformation Leadership: Experience supporting organizational transitions to AI-native or pod-based engineering delivery models. 
 - Cloud Infrastructure: Certifications or deep experience in major cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP) or enterprise platform engineering.

Description

Ready to help drive automation across a global business at Scan-IT?

You enjoy finding smarter ways of working and turning manual processes into efficient, automated solutions. You solve problems, improve workflows, and build tools that make a real difference for users and teams. 

At Scan-IT, we use automation to simplify processes, improve efficiency, and support the continued growth of our global business. As an Automation Engineer, you will design, build, and maintain automation solutions that streamline workflows, reduce manual effort, and deliver measurable value across teams and regions. 

We're a global technology company powering international logistics at scale. As part of Scan-Group - operating across shipping and logistics, technology, and leisure - we build and run the technology behind Shipco Transport, one of the world's leading neutral NVOCCs, and sit at the heart of the infrastructure that keeps global trade moving. Backed by a strong international organization, we offer stability with the pace and energy of a growing tech team. 

Working closely with business stakeholders and technical teams, you will translate operational requirements into practical automation solutions that improve accuracy, consistency, and productivity. From developing new workflows to enhancing existing automations, you will play an important role in helping teams work smarter and more efficiently across the organization. 

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys hands-on development, solving problems, and creating automation solutions that make a tangible impact on how people work every day. 

What You'll Do. . . 

- Backend Automation & Data Pipeline Development: Design, develop, test, and deploy resilient backend automation pipelines, data transformations, and reconciliation engines using Python and modern scripting frameworks to process high-volume operational and financial transactions. 
 - Financial Reconciliation & Multi-Way Matching Engines: Engineer specialized data-matching algorithms and business rules to automate complex shared-service accounting workflows-specifically carrier freight invoice vouchering (cross-referencing vendor bills against buy accruals in Phoenix ERP within configurable tolerance thresholds) and Statement of Account (SOA) reconciliations. 
 - Workflow Optimization & Process Simplification: Analyze existing operational processes and evaluate opportunities to streamline workflows, eliminate manual touchpoints, and enhance data consistency. Work closely with shared service teams to assess whether business challenges can be resolved by standardizing source data formats, improving SOPs, or configuring ERP parameters before engineering automated software solutions. 
 - Cost-Effective AI Integration & Prompt Workflows: Apply AI-assisted automation, structured document parsing, and prompt-based pipelines where rule-based logic is insufficient. Evaluate the operational unit economics of AI components, ensuring that API query costs remain significantly lower than manual labor costs, and implement efficient schema parsing (JSON) to avoid excessive LLM token usage. 
 - Database Management & Transaction Auditing: Design and maintain relational database tables, state management stores, and task queues (SQL Server, PostgreSQL, Redis) to support transaction deduplication, audit logging, idempotent execution, and operational reporting across all automated workflows. 
 - API Development & System Connectivity: Build, consume, and support RESTful API integrations and backend microservices (e. g. , FastAPI/Flask) that bridge core systems (Phoenix ERP, domestic TMS platforms) with external logistics feeds, EDI translators, and shared service portals. 
 - Human-in-the-Loop Dashboard Integration: Develop and integrate backend data endpoints for lightweight Human-in-the-Loop (HITL) review interfaces (such as Streamlit, Retool, or custom web forms), enabling operations staff to review and adjust flagged line-item discrepancies seamlessly before final ERP commitment. 
 - Automation Support & Troubleshooting: Monitor backend automation pipelines, investigate data discrepancies, analyze system logs, and resolve production incidents to ensure reliable, uninterrupted, and fault-tolerant operation. 
 - Business Collaboration & Requirements Gathering: Work closely with business stakeholders, financial controllers, operational subject matter experts, and technical team members to translate functional business rules into practical technical specifications. 
 - Documentation & Knowledge Sharing: Create and maintain technical documentation, data dictionary mappings, API specifications, and operational runbooks to ensure smooth knowledge transfer and maintainability across the global tech organization. 

What You'll Need. . . 

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field. 
 - 3 to 5 years of progressive experience in software automation, backend data engineering, Python development, or technical automation roles. 
 - Advanced proficiency in Python with deep hands-on expertise in data manipulation and integration libraries (pandas, NumPy, openpyxl, SQLAlchemy, requests, pydantic). 
 - Experience with unit testing (pytest), automated CI/CD deployment pipelines (GitHub Actions / Azure DevOps), and data privacy controls. 
 - Strong experience building reconciliation and rules engines: Demonstrated track record of designing automated multi-way matching logic for financial or operational data (handling numerical tolerances, date windows, currency conversions, and discrepancy tracking). 
 - Solid understanding of Relational Databases & SQL: Proficiency in designing schemas, writing optimized complex queries, stored procedures, and managing state logging in SQL Server, PostgreSQL, or MySQL. 
 - Experience working with APIs and structured data: Hands-on experience developing and consuming RESTful APIs, handling webhooks, and parsing structured/semi-structured data (JSON, XML, CSV, Excel). 
 - Awareness of AI Cost Governance & Practical Application: Familiarity integrating LLM APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini) into backend workflows with a practical mindset-understanding when deterministic rules are superior to AI and how to evaluate API token costs against manual effort. 
 - Strong Process Analysis & Problem-Solving Skills: Ability to map complex processes, identify root causes of inefficiencies, and advocate for process optimization or SOP improvements prior to implementing automation. 
 - Familiarity with RPA and workflow automation tools (such as Power Automate, UiPath, or n8n) and experience collaborating with RPA developers on hybrid automations. 
 - Experience with version control (Git) and modern software engineering practices (unit testing, containerization with Docker, CI/CD). 
 - Domain knowledge in Logistics, Freight Forwarding, or Supply Chain Shared Services (familiarity with carrier invoicing, vouchering, SOA reconciliation, Bills of Lading, or ERP finance workflows) is a strong advantage. 
 - Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to translate technical logic to business stakeholders and support operational users effectively. 

Here's What We Offer. . . 

At Scan-IT, we pride ourselves on our vibrant and supportive culture. Join our dynamic, international team and take on meaningful responsibilities from day one. 

Innovative Environment: Explore new technologies in the transportation and logistics industry. 
Collaborative Culture: Work with some of the industry's best in an open and creative environment. 
Professional Growth: Benefit from continuous learning, mentorship, and career advancement. 
Impactful Work: Enhance efficiency and drive global success. 
Inclusive Workplace: Thrive in a diverse and supportive environment. 
Competitive Compensation: Receive a salary that reflects your expertise. 
Growth Opportunities: Achieve your full potential with ample professional and personal development opportunities. 

Join Scan-IT and be part of a team that's shaping the future of the transportation and logistics industry. 

Visit www. scan-it. com. sg and follow us on LinkedIn, Facebook and X.

QA Engineer - Email Testing and Automation

Suggested experience: 3-6 years

About the role

We're looking for a QA Engineer to ensure Kinnect's email deliverables are accurate, functional and ready for handover to Kotak Bank. 

You will test HTML emailers across agreed email clients and devices, identify defects and work with developers to resolve them. You should also be able to automate repeatable checks to improve the speed and reliability of testing. 

What you'll do

·  Build and maintain email QA checklists, test cases and an agreed email-client and device test matrix. 

·  Test email rendering using Litmus, Email on Acid or comparable tools. 

·  Review layouts across desktop and mobile environments, including agreed Outlook, Gmail, iOS and Android configurations. 

·  Check typography, spacing, images, alignment, responsive behaviour and supported dark-mode variations. 

·  Validate links, buttons, approved destinations and tracking parameters against the brief. 

·  Check final HTML against approved copy and design, including mandatory disclosures. 

·  Test personalisation placeholders and fallback content using approved test inputs where applicable. 

·  Check accessibility, image blocking behaviour and other agreed production requirements. 

·  Automate repeatable checks such as missing assets, incorrect URLs, absent alternative text or deviations from template rules. 

·  Record defects clearly, prioritise them with the team and retest fixes. 

·  Complete regression checks after revisions and document QA status before handover. 

What we're looking for

· Experience testing HTML emails or comparable digital communication deliverables. 

·  Hands-on experience with Litmus, Email on Acid or equivalent testing tools. 

·  A working understanding of HTML and CSS sufficient to investigate defects. 

·  Practical automation or scripting experience, with examples of checks you have automated. 

·  The judgement to combine automated checks with visual inspection. 

·  Strong documentation skills and attention to detail. 

·  Experience working with developers and project managers in short production cycles. 

Scope of the role

This role covers production QA of email assets. Live campaign deployment, sender reputation and overall deliverability management remain outside the scope unless separately agreed.

 - Familiarity with Agile/Scrum methodologies and CI/CD pipelines. 

Benefits

- Competitive salary and benefits package 
 - Opportunity to make significant contributions to a dynamic company 
 - Walking distance from Chakala metro station, making commuting easy and convenient. 

At Axis My India, we value discipline and focus. Our team members wear brand on sleeves, adhere to a no-mobile policy during work hours, and work from our office with alternate Saturdays off. If you thrive in a structured environment and are committed to excellence, we encourage you to apply.

- Qualify and audit new and existing suppliers to Husky standards.

 - Manage supplier part qualification activities. 
 - Support containment actions, root cause analysis, and corrective action implementation.

 - Conduct quality risk assessments for localization and dual-sourcing initiatives.

- Strong knowledge of quality systems, supplier quality management, and auditing. 
 - Excellent problem-solving skills using structured methodologies (8D, 5 Why, RCA). 
 - Ability to influence suppliers and drive corrective actions to closure. 
 - Understanding of manufacturing, assembly, and logistics processes. 
 - Strong analytical, project management, and decision-making skills. 
 - Effective communication and cross-functional collaboration. 
 - Willingness to travel domestically as required. 

Education, Experience & Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Mechanical, Manufacturing, Industrial, Electrical Engineering, or a related field. 
 - Minimum 5 years of experience in Supplier Quality, Manufacturing Quality, or Quality Engineering. 
 - Experience with electrical and electronic components such as PCBs, drives, motors, sensors, wiring harnesses, connectors, and control systems. 
 - Ability to read Electrical Schematics and cabinet layout drawings. 
 - Knowledge of IPC-A-610, IPC/WHMA-A-620, and UL standards are an asset. 
 - Working knowledge of APQP, PPAP, FMEA, Control Plans, MSA, and SPC. 
 - Experience with ISO 9001 Quality Management Systems. 
 - Fluent in written and spoken English.
