Company Description

NEC Software Solutions (India)

On 1st July 2021, Rave Technologies became NEC Software Solutions India. This change brought us under the global NEC Corporation brand. We are proud to be part of an organisation with 122 years of experience in evolution with technology and innovation. 

We have more than 30 years of experience in providing end to end IT services across the globe and have earned a reputation for delighting our customers by consistently surpassing expectations and helping them deliver robust, market-ready software products that meet the highest standards of engineering and user experience. Supported by more than 1300 exceptionally talented manpower, we are a hub for offshore support and technology services. 

We work with diverse industry verticals which include publishing, media, financial services, retail, healthcare and technology companies around the world. Our customers range from two-person startups to $bn listed companies. 

For more information, visit at www. necsws. com/india. 

About NEC Corporation

NEC Corporation is a Japanese multinational information technology and electronics company, headquartered in Tokyo, Japan. It is recognised as a 'Top 50 Innovative Company' globally and the NEC Group globally provides "Solutions for Society" that promote the safety, security, fairness and equality of society. Their main goal is to help create a safer society with their innovations in technologies. 

NEC Corporation has established itself as a leader in the integration of IT and network technologies while promoting the brand statement of "Orchestrating a brighter world. " NEC enables businesses and communities to adapt to rapid changes taking place in both society and the market as it provides for the social values of safety, security, fairness and efficiency to promote a more sustainable world where everyone has the chance to reach their full potential. 

For more information, visit NEC at https: //www. nec. com. 

Job Description

Job Description - Test Automation

Designation - Senior Test Analyst (5-8 years) / Lead Test Analyst (9 -12+ years)

Using a suite of modern tools, the Automation Tester will play a pivotal role in helping us to automate our move towards a truly continuous integration and continuous deployment environment. You will work with our product and development teams to ensure that we are constantly analysing the automated tests that we design and execute for each of our products. 

You will report to the QA Manager, work alongside the Test Lead, product and development teams to ensure a high standard of quality in our products. You will carry out automated functional testing on our products. You will have the chance to test modern products based on Microsoft . NET technology. 

You will design, maintain and execute suites automated tests using modern languages and tools such as C#, Visual Studio, Selenium, Playwright, Appium, Mocha, JavaScript, TypeScript and Microsoft Azure DevOps. 

You will be responsible for working through and developing our backlog to make constant improvements and additions to our existing automated tests. You will review and automate existing manual test cases. You will also be responsible for creating and reviewing defects, tracking their progress from their discovery through to their resolution, ensuring that they are adequately documented and tested. 

Over time your role will grow and become more varied as you begin to test a larger variety of products across the NEC SWS. We are constantly developing new and cutting edge, scalable solutions and we need a highly skilled QA expert who embraces problem solving on products built with new, well-structured code as well as elements of legacy code. 

You will be someone who likes to push boundaries and enjoys rising to a challenge. We are a committed and supportive team with a 'can do' mindset. 

Key Responsibilities

- Drive the implementation of modern test automation frameworks and tools. 
 - Oversee test architecture, ensuring scalability and maintainability of automation solutions. 
 - Promote shift-left testing practices and support developers in embedding quality. 
 - Implementation of automation frameworks for middleware and backend service-based applications in critical infrastructure design. 
 - Designing and executing automated tests on the latest revisions of the software. 
 - Participating in the development of our automated testing framework, assisting our move towards automated testing in a CI/CD environment. 
 - Interpreting requirements from existing manual test cases and specification documents. Liaising with Manual Testers and / or Business Analysts to understand the requirements. 
 - Liaising with the product and development teams to ensure that our backlog is up to date
 - Providing estimates regarding the test effort required to complete work. 
 - Raising bugs and liaising with the development team from discovery through to resolution
 - Setting up and configuring the testing environment and associated database(s)
 - Preparing the test execution report and sharing it with stakeholders. 

Required Technical Skills And Experience

- Experience with C# / Java Script/ Type Script
 - 6 to 10 years of experience in Test Automation using various tools such as Selenium, Playwright, Appium, Mocha etc
 - Experience developing and executing automated test cases for User Interfaces
 - Knowledge of software development in a web and desktop environment

Required Soft Skills And Experience

- Clear and concise communicator
 - Able to prioritise between several tasks at any one time
 - Able to work independently and as part of a team
 - Detailed and effective written communication skills for documenting the features tested and bugs found
 - Highly organized, detail oriented, extremely responsive
 - Be comfortable discussing technical aspects of projects with other testers, developers & business owners. 

Desirable Skills And Experience

- Experience using Azure DevOps
 - Experience using Selenium and Playwright or equivalent tools
 - Experience using BrowserStack or equivalent cloud-based tools
 - Experience with various reporting libraries such as Extent, Allure etc
 - Usage of latest AI tools. 
 - Experience implementing CI/CD pipelines
 - Experience testing User Interfaces and databases
 - You'll have ISTQB/ISEB Foundation certifications or equivalent certifications or be working towards achieving them. 
 - Experience coordinating with external/Offshore QA resources

Qualifications

Graduate

Additional Information

data.title: Staff QA Engineer
data.description:
Lattice Overview

There is energy here. . . energy you can feel crackling at any of our international locations. It's an energy generated by enthusiasm for our work, for our teams, for our results, and for our customers. Lattice is a worldwide community of engineers, designers, and manufacturing operations specialists in partnership with world-class sales, marketing, and support teams, who are developing programmable logic solutions that are changing the industry. Our focus is on R&D, product innovation, and customer service, and to that focus, we bring total commitment and a keenly sharp competitive personality. 

Energy feeds on energy. If you flourish in a fast paced, results-oriented environment, if you want to achieve individual success within a "team first" organization, and if you believe you can contribute and succeed in a demanding yet collegial atmosphere, then Lattice may well be just what you're looking for. 

Job Description

Job Summary

We are seeking an experienced Staff QA Engineer with deep expertise in SOC testing to join our team as a fully hands-on contributor. This role combines advanced functional and automation testing on SOC technologies with the ability to design and execute comprehensive test strategies based on real customer workflows. You will be responsible for creating robust test cases, developing sophisticated automation frameworks spanning SOC and firmware layers, and ensuring the highest quality of customer solutions. 

Key Responsibilities

- Design and develop comprehensive functional and automation test cases based on detailed analysis of customer workflows, requirement specifications and use cases
 - Create and maintain sophisticated test automation frameworks that interact with hardware, firmware layers, and software components
 - Execute hands-on testing across solutions, including validation of hardware-firmware integration and performance benchmarking
 - Develop expertise in domain specific solutions and translate their operational workflows into comprehensive test scenarios
 - Collaborate with firmware engineers, hardware teams, and product managers to understand technical requirements and customer expectations
 - Identify, document, and verify fixes for defects across the hardware, firmware, and application layers
 - Optimize test execution and automation frameworks to improve efficiency and reduce time-to-quality. 
 - Provide technical leadership in QA methodologies, best practices, and test automation architecture
 - Mentor junior QA team members and contribute to continuous improvement of testing processes
 - Generate detailed test reports and provide actionable insights to stakeholders on product quality and readiness

Required Qualifications

- 7+ years of hands-on QA engineering experience, with a minimum of 4+ years specifically in solutions testing, functional and automation testing
 - Demonstrated expertise in developing test automation frameworks and test cases for ASIC/SOC/firmware based systems
 - Strong understanding hardware description languages (Verilog, VHDL), and hardware/firmware design principles
 - Demonstrated experience in developed AI based automation frameworks to reduce time to testing
 - Proven experience with firmware layer testing and hardware-firmware integration validation
 - Proficiency in one or more test automation programming languages (Python, C, C++, SystemVerilog, or Tcl)
 - Experience with hardware test equipment, logic analyzers, oscilloscopes, and embedded system debugging tools
 - Proven ability to analyze solution workflows and translate them into detailed, executable test cases
 - Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to troubleshoot complex hardware-firmware-software integration issues
 - Experience working directly with customer environments and understanding production deployment scenarios
 - Excellent communication skills and ability to collaborate across cross-functional teams

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience with specific SOC platforms (Xilinx, Intel/Altera, or similar)
 - Familiarity with SOC design tools and simulation environments
 - Background in developing end-to-end customer solution testing strategies
 - Experience with continuous integration/continuous testing (CI/CT) frameworks and automated test pipelines
 - Knowledge of performance testing, load testing, and stress testing methodologies for hardware systems
 - Experience with version control systems (Git) and test management tools
 - Certification in QA methodologies or relevant technical certifications

Technical Skills Required

- Test Automation: Python, C/C++, SystemVerilog, Tcl, or similar programming languages
 - SOC Testing: Functional verification, integration testing, hardware-in-the-loop (HIL) testing
 - Debugging & Analysis: Proficiency with oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, JTAG debuggers, and waveform analysis
 - Communication Protocols: Experience with Ethernet, USB, PCIe, or other relevant embedded communication standards
 - Test Frameworks: Knowledge of or willingness to develop custom test harnesses and frameworks

Role Characteristics

This is a fully hands-on position requiring active participation in: 

- Writing and executing test cases and test plans
 - Developing and maintaining automation code and frameworks
 - Conducting hands-on testing and debugging with SOC hardware
 - Working directly with customer environments and gathering real-world testing scenarios
 - Collaborating with engineering teams on test strategy and implementation

Additional Information

This position requires a successful background and reference checks and satisfactory proof of your right to work in: 

India

Lattice recognizes that employees are its greatest asset and the driving force behind success in a highly competitive, global industry. Lattice continually strives to provide a comprehensive compensation and benefits program to attract, retain, motivate, reward and celebrate the highest caliber employees in the industry. 

Lattice is an international, service-driven developer of innovative low cost, low power programmable design solutions. Our global workforce, some 1, 000 strong, shares a total commitment to customer success and an unbending will to win. For more information about how our FPGA, CPLD and programmable power management devices help our customers unlock their innovation, visit www. latticesemi. com. You can also follow us via Twitter, Facebook, or RSS. At Lattice, we value the diversity of individuals, ideas, perspectives, insights and values, and what they bring to the workplace. Applications are welcome from all qualified candidates.

data.title: SW QA Engineer - Python & CLI Testing
data.description:
We are Siemens

Siemens Digital Industries Software is a leading provider of solutions for the design, simulation, and manufacture of products across many different industries. Formula 1 cars, skyscrapers, ships, space exploration vehicles, and many of the objects we see in our daily lives are being conceived and manufactured using our software. 

Siemens' workload management solutions - including Accelerator, PBS Professional, and Grid Engine -are trusted by some of the world's leading technology companies to run mission-critical computing workloads. 

We are looking for a Software QA Engineer who will play a key role in automating and validating complex, enterprise-grade systems across Linux and Windows environments. As part of our Quality Center of Excellence, you will collaborate with experts in security, performance, and automation testing while acting as a strong advocate for quality across the entire development lifecycle. 

Key Responsibilities

- Contribute across the full software development lifecycle within Agile scrum teams, ensuring quality from design to release. 
 - Collaborate closely with Product Management and R&D to review requirements, influence design, and validate solutions. 
 - Design and implement robust functional, stress, and performance test cases for complex client/server systems. 
 - Develop, maintain, and optimize automated test suites using Python, including backend and CLI-based testing.

data.title: Robotics_Engineer
data.description:
As a Robotics Engineer, you will be part of a highly motivated, experienced, and interdisciplinary team driving the development and deployment of advanced robotics and automation solutions across Siemens Energy. You will be responsible for robotic system integration, deployment, navigation, manipulation, perception, industrial automation, and operational optimization that address real-world industrial challenges and support the company's digitalization and automation strategy. 

A Snapshot of Your Day

Working closely with software engineers, automation specialists, you will translate business and operational requirements into scalable, production-ready robotic solutions. Your focus will be on ensuring robotic systems are reliable, safe, efficient, and fit for purpose throughout their lifecycle. Through hands-on engineering, field validation, and continuous improvement, you will help accelerate the adoption of robotics technologies that deliver measurable productivity, quality, and operational benefits across Siemens Energy facilities. 

How You'll Make an Impact (key responsibilities of role)

- Evaluate existing manufacturing processes to identify, justify, and prioritize automation and robotics opportunities. 
 - Establish robotics deployment strategies, operational plans, and technology roadmaps aligned with functional objectives. 
 - Evaluate and benchmark robotic platforms against business, operational, and safety requirements. 
 - Define robot selection criteria including payload, reach, accuracy, speed, safety, and lifecycle considerations. 
 - Deep expertise in actuation and motion hardware (servo, BLDC/stepper, drives, gearboxes, screws, linear, pneumatic, hydraulic) to optimize payload, reach, speed, torque, and precision. 
 - Specify and integrate transmission components including belts, pulleys, couplings, bearings, slew rings, cams, brakes, clutches, and cable/tendon drives. 
 - Design mechanical safety systems, guarding, compliant mechanisms, and fail-safe features to meet industrial safety and risk standards. 
 - Design and evaluate robotic cells, workcells, automation lines, and integrated production workflows. 
 - Specify end-effectors, tooling, vision, and sensing solutions for industrial use cases. 
 - Integrate robots using ROS/ROS2, APIs, SDKs, enterprise systems, and cloud-connected platforms. 
 - Integrate, test, debug, and validate perception, planning, control, and execution modules on physical robot hardware, including offline programming and adaptive control. 

What You Bring (required Qualification And Skill Sets)

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Robotics, Mechatronics, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related field. 
 - 5+ years of hands-on experience designing, deploying, and supporting industrial robotic and automation systems in production environments. 
 - Experience in mechanical design, automation and robotics in an innovation-driven environment. 
 - Strong knowledge of major robot platforms and ecosystem components. 
 - Proficiency in CAD software with strong analytical and problem-solving skills. 
 - Strong understanding of robot kinematics, manipulation, navigation, localization, perception, motion planning, and safety systems. 
 - Knowledge of PLCs, SCADA, MES, OPC UA, industrial protocols, and factory automation architectures. 
 - Experience with enterprise and factory-system integration, fleet management, diagnostics, validation, and troubleshooting. 
 - Deep understanding of safety standards, risk assessment, industrial compliance, and production support of robotic systems. 

Good-to-Have Qualifications

- Knowledge of deploying machine vision, robotic perception, and learning-based autonomy platforms. 
 - Control multi-robot deployments, fleet orchestration, monitoring, updates, and lifecycle management. 
 - Knowledge of NVIDIA hardware for GPU accelerated workflows and deployments.

Location: Noida

Experience: 8 to 14 years

Role: 

We are looking for a hands-on Principal Full Stack Architect (Node. Js) based to own the design and evolution of a cloud-native platform built on NestJS (TypeScript) backend and Next. JS (Frontend), Postgres SQL, Bull MQ, Redis and Microsoft Azure. You will define how our services provision, configure and manage Azure resources through an ARM-based control plane, and set the standards for reliable asynchronous processing - queue-driven workflows, idempotent operations, retries and failure recovery - across multiple engineering teams. 

Key Responsiblilties: 

This is an architecture-and-delivery role: you are responsible to lead the project, face the customer, gather the requirement and lead the development team, you will produce clear designs, review and shape critical code, and mentor engineers, write and review code and while remaining close enough to the code to prototype and validate your decisions. 

Core Architecture & platform design responsibilities: 

• Define the target architecture for NestJS microservices and APIs on Azure (App Service, Container Apps, AKS, Functions), including module boundaries, shared libraries, configuration and deployment topology. 

• Establish API design standards (REST/OpenAPI, versioning, pagination, error models, long-running operation contracts) and enforce them through reviews and tooling. 

• Drive non-functional design: scalability, availability, multi-region/DR, cost efficiency, observability and security by default. 

Queue, messaging & idempotency patterns Architecture Design Criteria: 

• Architect asynchronous workflows on Azure Service Bus, Storage Queues, Event Grid and Event Hubs; choose the right broker and semantics (at-least-once, ordering via sessions, dead-lettering, TTL, scheduled delivery). 

• Define and standardise idempotency: idempotency keys, deduplication windows, idempotent consumers, inbox/outbox, transactional outbox with the database, and exactly-once-effect designs. 

• Design retry and failure handling: exponential backoff with jitter, poison-message handling, circuit breakers, compensating actions (saga), and replay tooling. 

• Apply durable orchestration patterns (Durable Functions or equivalent) for long-running, multi-step provisioning with correct state, timeouts and cancellation. 

Leadership & delivery

• Author architecture decision records (ADRs), HLD/LLD documents and reference implementations; lead design reviews. 

• Mentor senior engineers, raise engineering standards, and partner with product, security, SRE and FinOps stakeholders. 

• Guide CI/CD (Azure DevOps / GitHub Actions), IaC pipelines, testing strategy (unit, contract, integration, chaos) and production readiness reviews.

This is hard, urgent, selfless work-but it's work worth doing. If you're driven by purpose and ready to bring your best to work that truly matters for patients, we invite you to join us. 

About Lilly

At Lilly, everything we do starts with patients. We unite caring with discovery to make life better for people around the world. Headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana, our global team of over 50, 000 employees work with urgency and purpose to discover and deliver life-changing medicines, strengthen how health is understood and managed, and support the communities we serve. We bring our best to this work because people depend on it. If you're driven by purpose and determined to make a meaningful difference for patients, we invite you to bring your skill and your commitment to Lilly. 

About Technology@Lilly

At Lilly, technology is not a support function. It is how a global medicine company operates, innovates, and delivers. Lilly in Hyderabad builds the capabilities that make this possible, cloud platforms, AI systems, and automation at enterprise scale, all in service of a purpose that makes this technology work genuinely distinctive, from advancing drug discovery to enabling connected clinical trials to keeping a global medicine company running at the standard patients deserve. 

About The Business Function

The Software Product Engineering (SPE) team is a specialized engineering group that delivers strategic solutions and differentiated capabilities. We take a forward-thinking approach, focusing on an enterprise platform and product mindset, ensuring that the solutions we build can be leveraged across Technology teams for broader impact and efficiency. 

Job Title: Principal Software Engineer

Role Summary

As a Principal Software Engineer, you will lead the design, development, and delivery of business-critical, AI-powered applications and agentic workflows across backend, frontend, and cloud-native systems. You will architect and build backend services and agent orchestration logic primarily in Go, Python, and Node. js, surface AI capabilities through modern React interfaces, and set the engineering standards that put large language model (LLM), retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), and agentic capabilities reliably into the hands of users. You will mentor engineers, drive technical excellence, and ensure our solutions are scalable, maintainable, and secure. 

What You'll Be Doing

- Lead the design and development of AI-powered application features and agentic workflows using LLMs, tool/function calling, and orchestration frameworks (e. g. , LangChain, LangGraph), setting the bar for reliability and quality. 
 - Architect, build, and maintain scalable backend services, APIs, and agent orchestration logic primarily in language agnostic environment preferably in Go, Python, and Node. js (Express. js), applying cloud-native and microservices patterns. 
 - Design and own RAG pipelines end-to-end - chunking, embeddings, vector search, retrieval quality, evaluation, and guardrails - to ground model outputs in enterprise data. 
 - Integrate LLM APIs and AI services (e. g. , Amazon Bedrock, Anthropic, OpenAI) into products, owning prompting, context management, evaluation, observability, and output safety. 
 - Develop user-facing interfaces using React (Material-UI, Redux Toolkit, React Router, Next. js) to surface AI features and agent interactions with a focus on performance, accessibility, and Core Web Vitals. 
 - Replace commercial off-the-shelf (COTS) systems and transform legacy applications into modern, agent-ready solutions on our AWS-hosted enterprise platform, retiring the old systems after cutover. 
 - Define and maintain engineering standards, including consistent local development setup, branch management, unit and integration testing, infrastructure as code, code quality checks, and CI/CD pipelines. 
 - Lead the authoring of technical documents - high-level design documents, architectural blueprints, technical standards, and AI engineering best-practice guidelines - to drive cross-team alignment. 
 - Leverage AI coding and reviewing tools (GitHub Copilot, Cursor) to accelerate development, improve code quality, and conduct AI-assisted code reviews; demonstrate strong prompt engineering to guide these tools toward optimal, context-aware, and secure code. 
 - Coach and mentor engineers on full-stack engineering, agentic/AI patterns, and the responsible, secure use of AI across the software development lifecycle. 
 - Collaborate across business, product, design, and engineering teams to deliver impactful features with measurable value. 
 - Analyse and debug software and AI/agent behaviour to enhance performance, reliability, and maintainability. 

How You Will Succeed

- Architect and ship reliable AI features by applying modern AI engineering workflows - prompt design, evaluation, iteration, and guardrails. 
 - Design and implement robust RESTful (and where needed GraphQL) APIs and microservices in Go, Python, and Node. js, with fault-tolerance, performance, and security in mind. 
 - Implement tool-calling and multi-step agent orchestration, and clearly distinguish true agentic workflows from deterministic pipelines when designing solutions. 
 - Build and measure RAG pipelines using embeddings, vector stores, and retrieval/evaluation metrics to continuously improve accuracy and reduce hallucination. 
 - Integrate AWS cloud services and manage infrastructure with CI/CD tools like GitHub Actions or Jenkins. 
 - Work with databases such as PostgreSQL (incl. pgvector), MongoDB, and vector stores to store and retrieve structured, unstructured, and embedded data efficiently. 
 - Build responsive, accessible React UIs that surface AI capabilities, applying component-based design, state management, and WCAG 2. 2 standards. 
 - Lead code reviews, guide engineers, and consistently deliver production-grade software.

data.title: DevOps Engineer
data.description:
Bay6 AI is hiring a senior DevOps engineer to turn our AWS estate into code: reusable pipelines, consistent environments, and secure, repeatable releases for our AI platforms. 

(Experience - 6-10 years)

About the role

- Bay6 builds three AI platforms on AWS: Connect6 (conversational AI), Agent6 (document and workflow agents on Airflow) and Model6 (ML scoring). We deliver each customer as configuration on top of them, often in the customer's own AWS account. Our engineers already ship to production through GitHub Actions and ECS across dozens of services. 
 - We now need someone to make that foundation repeatable and secure. You will own infrastructure as code, reusable CI/CD, and the multi-account AWS setup, working alongside our existing DevOps engineer and the platform owners. You will be one of two people in DevOps, and part of a small platform core team. 
 - We work AI-first. Engineers use Claude Code every day, and you will use it too: to write pipelines and automation, review changes, and automate the toil. 

What you will do

- Infrastructure as code. Make ECS, ECR, RDS (MySQL), S3, SNS, IAM and networking repeatable and versioned instead of built by hand. Build a reusable tenant setup that sets up a customer either in its own AWS account or in a shared one. 
 - Multi-account AWS. Shape our AWS Organization: OUs, a central platform account for shared services (MWAA, CI/CD, portals), and data accounts per customer. Lead account migrations without downtime. 
 - Reusable CI/CD. Replace per-repo, per-environment workflows with shared GitHub Actions templates. Build once, then promote the same image from dev to qa to prod by tag, with one-step rollback. 
 - Secure pipelines. Move deploys from long-lived keys to OIDC roles. Pin actions, manage secrets in AWS Secrets Manager or SSM, run secret scanning, and harden containers (non-root, minimal base images)
 - Observability and reliability. Add health checks, structured logs, Open Telemetry tracing, error tracking and alerting across services. Write runbooks and lead blameless postmortems. 
 - Airflow and AI workloads. Run Amazon MWAA for the Agent6 pipelines, and support Bedrock-based AI services: model access, quotas and cost per customer. 
 - Cost and compliance. Tag every resource by customer and environment, report cost per customer, and keep the change history our SOC 2 customers need. 
 - Raise the bar. Review infrastructure PRs, pair with developers and the other DevOps engineer, and make the paved road the easy road. 

What you bring

- 6+ years in DevOps, SRE or platform engineering, including 3+ years running production workloads on AWS. 
 - Hands-on with ECS (Fargate or EC2), ECR, RDS, S3, IAM, VPC and CloudWatch. 
 - AWS Organizations and multi-account design: OUs, cross-account roles, SCPs, or Control Tower. 
 - GitHub Actions at scale: reusable workflows, environments, OIDC to AWS, branch protection and rulesets. 
 - Docker: multi-stage builds, small and non-root images, image scanning. 
 - Security habits: least-privilege IAM, secrets management, secret scanning, dependency updates. 
 - Monitoring and incident response for live services, including on-call and postmortems. 
 - Scripting in Bash and Python (or Node). 
 - Clear written English: you document decisions as ADRs and runbooks, and explain trade-offs to developers and leads. 
 - Comfortable working with AI coding assistants, and checking their output. Nice to have

- Amazon MWAA or self-managed Apache Airflow in production. 
 - Amazon Bedrock, or running LLM-based services: quotas, model lifecycle, cost tracking. 
 - Multi-tenant SaaS: silo versus pooled tenancy, per-customer accounts, data isolation
 - SOC 2 or similar audits: change management evidence, access reviews. 
 - Monorepo CI (uv workspaces, npm workspaces or Nx) with affected-only builds. 
 - Atlassian (Jira, Confluence) and Microsoft 365 administration. 
 - AWS certifications (DevOps Engineer Professional, Solutions Architect). 
 - Hands-on use of Claude Code or similar tools for infrastructure work

Change the world. Love your job. 

Software at TI usually refers to embedded software (such as device firmware, device peripheral drivers, software frameworks, algorithms, etc. ) and the related software development tools (compilers, simulators, demo software, IDEs, etc. )

data.title: DFT Manager / Technical Lead – Design for Test, Silicon & DLP Technology
data.description:
TI DLP, the market leader, is looking for an experienced, highly motivated, fast-learner candidate to manage and lead the DFT team based in Bangalore. This group is known for developing Academy Award® winning projection technology for cinema & home as well as advanced light control products for high-end Industrial applications. Other major applications are Pico projectors for Laser TV, smartphones accessories, tablets, gaming consoles, automotive applications like heads-up-display & high-resolution headlights and light control applications like 3D printing, 3D scanning, spectral sensing. 

We are seeking a seasoned DFT Manager ready to own the complete DFT flow, driving DFT architecture, optimizing flows and test-time/cost, and collaborating with design and test team. This role requires deep technical expertise in DFT, working closely with cross-functional teams to drive quality, methodology, and testability roadmaps. 

Position/Role Manager - Design for Test (DFT)

What will you be doing in this role? (Responsibilities)

Provide technical and organizational leadership across the DFT domain, ensuring coordinated execution from architecture through silicon. 

- Define and establish DFT methodologies, flows, and best practices with a TI-wide charter - setting the quality benchmark that projects across TI measure themselves against
 - Serve as the primary technical representative of TI in design reviews and partner discussions, communicating complex DFT decisions with authority and clarity
 - Stand as TI's DFT quality authority - owning sign-off on the complete DFT flow across concurrent projects, with full accountability for scan insertion, memory BIST, boundary scan, ATPG, test compression, and DFT verification
 - Orchestrate cross-functional collaboration with design and test teams - eliminating flow bottlenecks, aligning execution priorities, and raising the implementation bar across every TI project
 - Evaluate and qualify new EDA tools, methodologies, and process nodes, driving adoption decisions with data-driven recommendations
 - Shape designs upstream - embedding design-for-test thinking into architecture and front-end decisions before they become costly constraints downstream
 - Elevate the DFT community at TI - mentoring engineers, standardizing implementation practices, and building institutional knowledge that outlasts any individual tape-out
 - Own the strategic direction of DFT at TI - your methodology decisions, quality standards, and technical judgments becoming the foundation upon which TI's next generation of products is built
 - Lead and manage the DFT team - setting goals, tracking execution, conducting performance reviews, and fostering a culture of technical excellence and continuous improvement

What do we expect from you? (Minimum Qualifications)

- 12+ years of hands-on experience in DFT / Design for Test
 - Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electronics Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or VLSI Design
 - Proven expertise in DFT flows using industry-standard EDA tools (Cadence toolchain)
 - Demonstrated ability to own and deliver complex designs independently from specification through signoff
 - Deep knowledge of scan architecture, BIST, ATPG, test compression, boundary scan, and DFT verification
 - Strong understanding of process node design rules and DFT implementation constraints
 - Prior experience managing or leading a team of DFT engineers
 - Strong written and verbal communication skills, with experience presenting technical content to internal stakeholders or external customers
 - Experience on silicon bringup

Preferred Skills / Experience

- 10-15 years of progressive experience in DFT with increasing ownership and scope
 - Prior experience in a managerial, methodology lead, or technical architect capacity - having defined DFT standards that others adopted and built upon
 - Familiarity with in-house or customized EDA flow development and scripting (Tcl, Python, Perl)
 - Exposure to power management architectures and low-power DFT implementation techniques

data.description:
In this hourly, remote contractor role, you will work as a Malayalam Quality Assurance Lead (QAL) to oversee quality, consistency, and trainer performance across Malayalam AI training projects. You will review AI-generated Malayalam content and trainer/QA work, evaluate output quality against project guidelines, provide precise written feedback, and ensure that all contributors follow the expected quality standards. 

You will assess work for accuracy, fluency, grammar, spelling, tone, cultural appropriateness, meaning preservation, instruction-following, formatting, and adherence to project-specific rubrics. You will spot recurring quality issues, communicate updates to trainers and QAs, support onboarding, maintain documentation, and help activate contributors who are not working consistently. This role requires strong Malayalam and English skills, excellent attention to detail, structured communication, and the ability to manage quality workflows across remote teams. 

This role is with SME Careers, a fast-growing AI Data Services company and subsidiary of SuperAnnotate, delivering training data for many of the world's largest AI companies and foundation-model labs. Your Malayalam quality leadership will directly help improve the world's premier AI models by ensuring that Malayalam training data is natural, accurate, culturally appropriate, well-documented, and aligned with client expectations. 

Selection process involves an AI interview, a domain-specific task, and an interview with a recruiter. 

Key Responsibilities

- Quality monitoring: Spot-check Malayalam items, identify quality issues, provide ongoing feedback through DMs, and escalate recurring or critical issues. 
 - Trainer and QA communication: Update trainers and QAs on Discord about new item guidelines, project changes, workflow updates, and quality expectations. 
 - Question handling: Respond to trainer/QA questions clearly and promptly, especially around Malayalam wording, register, translation fidelity, cultural context, Kerala usage, diaspora usage, and edge cases. 
 - Trainer/QA activation management: DM contributors who are inactive or not working, encourage activation, track follow-ups, and flag availability issues when needed. 
 - Documentation: Create and maintain Malayalam project documentation, including style guides, trackers, FAQs, quality notes, examples, honeypots, and onboarding materials. 
 - Onboarding and training: Schedule and run onboarding/training calls with trainers and QAs to explain project expectations, workflows, rubrics, quality standards, and Malayalam-specific style requirements. 
 - Quality alignment: Ensure all trainers and QAs apply Malayalam language guidelines consistently and understand updates as projects evolve. 
 - Process improvement: Identify recurring quality gaps, propose workflow improvements, and help build scalable QA processes for Malayalam-language projects. 

Your Profile

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Malayalam, Linguistics, Translation, Communications, Journalism, English, Education, Quality Assurance, or a relevant domain/related field. 
 - Native or near-native Malayalam proficiency with strong reading and writing skills. 
 - Strong grasp of the English language to follow project guidelines, communicate with teams, and provide clear feedback in English. 
 - 3+ years of professional experience in Malayalam writing, editing, translation, localization, content QA, AI training, education, annotation, or related language-review workflows. 
 - Strong understanding of Malayalam grammar, spelling conventions, punctuation, tone, register, regional variation, and cultural context. 
 - Ability to evaluate Malayalam content against detailed rubrics and identify issues such as mistranslation, literal phrasing, unnatural tone, hallucinated claims, ambiguity, or inconsistent terminology. 
 - Experience leading or supporting remote teams of trainers, annotators, reviewers, editors, or QAs is strongly preferred. 
 - Comfortable working in fast-moving remote environments using tools such as Discord, Google Sheets, Google Docs, trackers, dashboards, and project management systems. 
 - Highly detail-oriented and organized, with the ability to maintain style guides, FAQs, trackers, onboarding materials, honeypots, and other quality documentation. 
 - Experience with AI training, data annotation, large language models, prompt/response evaluation, or rubric-based LLM QA is a strong plus.

About this role: 

Wells Fargo is seeking a hands-on Principal Engineer to lead technical research, design, coding, implementation, and execution for Research and Systems Engineering (RSE). This role is ideal for a senior engineer who can move from strategy and architecture into working code, technical prototypes, test environments, and proof-of-concept solutions. The Principal Engineer will evaluate emerging technologies by building and testing them, determine how they can operate within Wells Fargo's available platforms, architecture, security, risk, infrastructure, and engineering constraints, and provide expert recommendations grounded in direct technical evidence. 

In this role, you'll be expected to personally develop prototypes, write and review code, design technical solutions, configure and integrate technologies, execute tests, troubleshoot issues, and document findings. You'll work closely with architects, platform owners, security and risk partners, and engineering teams to understand what is currently available within Wells Fargo, identify gaps or limitations, and determine whether a technology can be adopted, adapted, integrated, or should not move forward. Success requires strong engineering depth, curiosity, disciplined experimentation, sound technical judgment, and the ability to convert proof-of-concept results into practical implementation guidance. 

In this role, you will: 

- Lead hands-on design, coding, configuration, integration, testing, troubleshooting, and implementation for RSE research and proof-of-concept initiatives. 
 - Build working prototypes and reference implementations that validate technical feasibility, integration requirements, performance, security, resiliency, operability, and enterprise applicability. 
 - Write production-quality or near-production-quality code, automation, APIs, scripts, infrastructure definitions, test harnesses, and integration components needed to evaluate new technologies. 
 - Design and execute structured proofs of concept with defined technical questions, success criteria, assumptions, test scenarios, risks, dependencies, and measurable results. 
 - Install, configure, and test emerging technologies in approved environments using the platforms, tools, services, access models, and infrastructure available within Wells Fargo. 
 - Evaluate how proposed technologies align with Wells Fargo architecture, engineering standards, security controls, risk requirements, network patterns, identity and access models, data requirements, observability capabilities, and support processes. 
 - Identify technical gaps, constraints, integration challenges, required exceptions, operational impacts, and dependencies that may affect enterprise adoption. 
 - Provide expert, evidence-based recommendations on whether a technology should be adopted, adapted, integrated with existing capabilities, further tested, or not pursued. 
 - Translate proof-of-concept outcomes into implementable designs, reference patterns, reusable code, technical decision records, test evidence, runbooks, and engineering guidance. 
 - Partner with architects to validate target-state designs and ensure proposed patterns can be implemented within existing enterprise capabilities and constraints. 
 - Work directly with engineering teams to demonstrate solutions, resolve implementation issues, review code and designs, and guide the transition from experimental work to supported delivery.

data.title: Senior AI Test Engineer
data.description:
Senior AI Test Engineer

Location: Remote

About the Role

Alternative Path is looking for a Senior AI Test Engineer to lead quality assurance on a client engagement with a leading financial data and analytics company that has built AI agent systems (chatbots, RAG-based research/report generation, MCP-based tool-calling agents) on top of its proprietary datasets for its own clients. This is a senior, client-facing role: you'll own the test strategy for these systems end-to-end, working directly with the client's engineering team to validate accuracy, reliability, and safety before these agents reach financial industry end-users - where hallucinations or bad data retrieval carry real business risk. 

This is not conventional QA. You'll be building evaluation frameworks and datasets, running systematic evals, and defining quality bars for non-deterministic, LLM-driven systems operating over complex financial data. 

About Alternative Path

Alternative Path is a strategic operations consulting firm, founded in 2020, that helps growth-stage and enterprise organizations build high-performing, India-based teams across Technology Ops, Data Ops, Business Intelligence, and Finance. Every engagement is senior-led, and the firm has delivered 50+ engagements for clients across the US, Europe, and Australia. 

What You'll Do

- Own the test and evaluation strategy for the client's AI agent systems - chatbots, RAG-based research/report generation, and MCP-based tool-calling agents
 - Design and build eval suites covering accuracy, groundedness/faithfulness to source data, task completion, latency, and safety
 - Build and curate golden datasets reflecting real client use cases and financial-data edge cases (ambiguous queries, stale data, conflicting sources, numerical precision)
 - Use eval/observability tooling such as LangSmith (or equivalents - Ragas, DeepEval, Braintrust, Langfuse, PromptFoo) to trace, score, and monitor agent runs
 - Define and track RAG-specific metrics (retrieval precision/recall, hallucination rate, citation/source accuracy) - critical given the systems sit on top of financial datasets where correctness is non-negotiable
 - Evaluate MCP-based tool-calling behavior - correct tool selection, multi-step task execution, failure handling
 - Design regression testing so prompt, model, or data-pipeline changes don't silently degrade quality
 - Run structured red-teaming for hallucinations, prompt injection, and unsafe/incorrect financial outputs
 - Act as the primary quality point of contact with the client's engineering stakeholders - translating findings into clear, actionable risk assessments
 - Mentor/guide any junior QA resources staffed onto the engagement as it scales
 - Build automation to integrate evals into CI pipelines where feasible

What We're Looking For

Must-haves

- 3+ years in software QA/testing, with hands-on senior-level experience evaluating LLM-based or agentic AI systems (not just traditional QA)
 - Direct experience with eval frameworks/tools - LangSmith strongly preferred; also acceptable: Ragas, DeepEval, PromptFoo, Braintrust, Langfuse
 - Strong understanding of RAG architecture and how to independently evaluate retrieval quality vs. generation quality
 - Practical familiarity with MCP (Model Context Protocol) or comparable agent tool-calling frameworks
 - Strong Python skills for building test harnesses, scoring pipelines, and automation
 - Experience designing evaluation approaches for non-deterministic systems (probabilistic scoring, not binary pass/fail)
 - Comfortable working directly with client engineering teams - strong communication, able to explain quality risk to both technical and business stakeholders
 - Prior experience in a client services / consulting QA environment (this is a client-facing engagement, not an internal product team)Nice-to-haves

- Experience testing AI systems in fintech, capital markets, or data/analytics domains
 - Familiarity with financial data accuracy/compliance considerations (numerical precision, source traceability, audit trails)
 - Exposure to LLM red-teaming/safety evaluation practices
 - Experience with browser-automation agent testing (Playwright or similar)

data.title: Analog Test & Validation Engineer – Multiple Openings (3–15 Yrs) | Power, Audio, Connectivity, Data Converters & High-Speed Interfaces
data.description:
Join TI - Where Analog Innovation Powers the World's Toughest Challenges

Texas Instruments is hiring Analog Test & Analog Validation Engineers across multiple high-impact product groups - from AI datacenter power delivery to automotive high-speed interfaces, consumer audio, custom mobile ICs, precision data converters, and mid-voltage power regulators. If you're passionate about validating silicon that ships in millions of units worldwide, this is your opportunity to make an outsized impact. 

We are looking for engineers at all levels - 3 to 15 years of experience - to join as Senior Engineers, Leads, and Technical Experts in Analog Test & Validation. 

🔧 What You'll Work On

Our engineers validate the isolated power modules, gate drivers, and analog/mixed-signal ICs at the heart of next-generation power systems - SiC/IGBT EV traction inverters, GaN-driven datacenter power, telecom rectifiers, and server power stages. You'll help solve industry-defining challenges: reinforced isolation in postage-stamp footprints, ultra-low EMI, dynamic programmable outputs, and robust performance through extreme high-voltage transients. 

You will own test & validation from concept to silicon to production, working at the intersection of analog IC design, magnetics, and system architecture - backed by TI's global manufacturing scale and IP portfolio. 

📂 Open Groups - Choose Your Domain

1️⃣ Multiphase Power Products (MPP)

Validate high-performance multiphase DC/DC controllers and smart power stage solutions powering GPUs/CPUs/TPUs/Network Switches for AI infrastructure. Work directly with power architects at NVIDIA, Google, AMD, and AWS as busbar architectures evolve from 12V → 48V → 800V and IVRs, pushing limits on efficiency, transient response, and power density. 

2️⃣ Consumer Audio Amplifiers & Haptics (CAAH)

Validate industry-leading audio amplifier SoCs for phones, tablets, PCs, speakers, and TVs. Work on complex mixed-signal designs spanning Bandgap, PLL, Boost, Class D, and digital DSP IPs - balancing cost, performance, and execution speed for the consumer market. 

3️⃣ High-Speed Data Interface Group (Ethernet PHY & FPD-Link)

Validate differentiated high-speed SerDes SoCs for automotive and industrial markets: 

- Ethernet PHY: Robust Ethernet interfaces for driver monitoring, steering, and robotic control applications - validating performance against interference, ESD events, and aggressive cost/power targets. 
 - FPD-Link: Multi-gigabit (up to 20+ Gbps) proprietary interfaces for automotive sensors and displays, validating equalization circuits (CTLE, FFE, DFE), high-speed converters, and functional safety performance. 

4️⃣ Connectivity SoC - Central Analog Team (EP BU)

Validate analog/mixed-signal blocks embedded into Connectivity SoCs (BLE, UWB) used in automotive, industrial, and medical applications - Tire Pressure Monitors, car access KeyFobs, and more. Blocks include ADC, DAC, PLL, PGA, Filters, Crystal Oscillators, Temperature Sensors, LDO, Bandgap Reference, DC-DC converters, and Comparators. 

5️⃣ Custom Mobile Electronics - Power & Interface ICs

Validate custom IC system solutions for display/touch power, camera PMICs, charger power products, power switches/muxes, laser drivers, and high-speed communication interfaces for personal electronics - enabling next-gen differentiation for TI's mobile customers. 

6️⃣ Digital-to-Analog Converter (DAC) Product Line

Validate best-in-class high-performance data converter ASSPs for Test & Measurement, Industrial, and Automotive markets. Work across multi-sub-system chips featuring high-precision signal paths, complex analog conditioning/control loops, and high-power delivery systems. 

7️⃣ Mid-Voltage Regulators (Mid-Vin Buck)

Validate high-current mid-voltage power regulator solutions driving Enterprise, Industrial, AI, and Autonomous Driving applications. Collaborate with TI's advanced packaging and R&D teams to deliver industry-leading power density solutions. 

✅ What We're Looking For

- 3-15 years of experience in Analog Test and/or Analog Validation
 - Strong fundamentals in analog/mixed-signal circuit testing: data converters, PLLs, LDOs, bandgap references, power stages, gate drivers, amplifiers, or high-speed interfaces
 - Hands-on experience with lab equipment, test automation, characterization, and bench validation
 - Experience with ATE (Automated Test Equipment) platforms is a plus
 - Strong analytical and debugging skills; ability to collaborate cross-functionally with design, product, and applications teams
 - Bachelor's/Master's in Electrical/Electronics Engineering or related field

🌟 Why TI?

- Own silicon from concept to production on products shipping in millions of units across high-growth markets - AI/cloud infrastructure, EVs, automotive, and consumer electronics
 - Access to TI's global manufacturing scale, rich IP portfolio, and world-class engineering teams
 - Work on technologies directly enabling cleaner, more efficient power conversion for the AI and EV revolution
 - Collaborative, innovation-driven culture with growth paths from Senior Engineer to Technical Lead

About The Role

This is a hands-on technical leadership role for professionals who can lead development teams, guide solution design, mentor developers and senior developers, and closely partner with architects to deliver scalable enterprise solutions. As a Salesforce Lead, you will be responsible for translating business and platform strategy into high-quality technical solutions while ensuring adherence to architecture, governance, security, and engineering best practices. You will lead cross-functional teams building intelligent service management experiences across Service Cloud, Experience Cloud, Sales Cloud, Agentforce, Enterprise Service Management (ESM), ITSM, CMDB, IT Asset Management, and enterprise integrations. 

This role offers an opportunity to play a key leadership position in shaping the future of AI-powered service management and conversational enterprise platforms.

 - Identify skill gaps and define technical learning and certification roadmaps. 
 - Foster a culture of engineering excellence, collaboration, innovation, and continuous improvement.

AI & Platform Innovation

 - Evaluate new platform capabilities and recommend innovative solutions that improve service delivery and operational efficiency.

Must Have

 - Experience Cloud
 - Salesforce Platform

 - Strong experience with large-scale Salesforce implementations and enterprise delivery programs.

 - Strong understanding of:

 - DevOps & CI/CD
 - Release Management

 - Experience in Agile, Scrum, and DevOps-driven environments.

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience implementing Enterprise Service Management (ESM) and IT Service Management (ITSM) solutions.

Added Advantage

What We Are Looking For

We are seeking professionals who:

Why Join Us?

Join Us ?

data.title: Chief AI/ML Architect
data.description:
Overview of 66degrees

66degrees is an end-to-end AI transformation partner that guides enterprises from complex business challenges to clear, quantifiable outcomes. Our company is the culmination of several successful firms, each a leader in its own right in cloud, artificial intelligence, and data. This convergence of talent and expertise is how we help businesses reach their own "inflection point, " where chaotic data becomes a strategic asset, complexity becomes clarity, and AI becomes an engine for growth. Our ultimate vision is to be the catalyst for a future where every business operates as an intelligent enterprise, with autonomous systems unlocking human potential. 

At 66degrees, we believe in thriving through challenges and winning together. These values not only guide us in achieving our goals as a company but also for our people. We are dedicated to creating a significant impact for our employees by fostering a culture that sparks innovation and supports professional and personal growth along the way. 

Overview of Role

An AI/ML Architect at 66degrees designs and ships production AI systems for enterprise clients and leads the engineers who build them. The Architect is the senior technical person on an engagement: the primary technical point of contact for the client, the owner of the architecture, and the person the team takes direction from. 

The role is hands-on and client-facing in equal measure. Architects take a business problem, define the solution and the value it delivers, and then build and deploy it. They write and review code, make the architectural decisions, and stay with the system through production. They also run discovery, present to client executives, and are the face of 66degrees on the engagement. 

This role is based in India and works daily with US-based colleagues and clients. Engagements typically run 12 to 16 weeks and are delivered by a Delivery Manager, one or more Architects, and a team of engineers. 

Why this role

- 2026 Google Cloud AI Partner of the Year. This team's work won the Artificial Intelligence category this year, one of four Partner of the Year awards 66degrees has earned. You're joining the top of the Google Cloud AI ecosystem 
 - About 60% of the work is generative and agentic AI, in production, for clients up to the Fortune 10. The rest is classical ML and MLOps, so you build real agents without losing the rest of the craft. 
 - New problem, new client, every 12 to 16 weeks. You build range fast and never spend three years on one system 
 - The whole stack. Architects span infrastructure, software, data, ML, AI, and analytics. The role is built to make you a well-rounded technologist, not to keep you in one lane 
 - Player-coach all the way up. Growth here doesn't mean giving up the craft. Leaders still build, and the management track is open because the team keeps growing, not because someone has to leave 
 - No up-or-out, no partner-track politics. Nobody is competing to differentiate themselves; everyone is trying to be the best technologist in the room, which is why people share what they know 
 - The team has grown roughly tenfold in three years and people stay. The few who've left went on to top tech firms and AI startups

Responsibilities

Build

- Design the architecture for each engagement: data pipelines, classical ML, agentic and generative AI, and the production path on Google Cloud, with the trade-offs written down 
 - Write and review the code that matters: core logic, orchestration, evaluation, the parts an engineer shouldn't be guessing at 
 - Take systems to production and own them through handoff: deployment, monitoring, drift, retraining, incident response, and a client who can run it after we leave 
 - Choose the right approach for the problem, and defend it on cost, explainability, and fit rather than on what's fashionable

Lead the team

- Direct a team of engineers: write the brief with the reasoning, not only the tasks; confirm it landed before code is written; review the work 
 - Run a team where engineers raise problems early and are heard when they do 
 - Develop engineers: pairing, giving them the client call, making them present the design review, and telling the Delivery Manager who is ready for more 
 - Delegate real work and still own the hard parts. Not a solo builder; not a delegator who only checks in

Own the client relationship

- Run discovery: turn an ambiguous ask into a scoped plan with success criteria the client agrees to 
 - Hold the solution to what the client actually needs, and when scope and need diverge, raise it early with options and what each costs 
 - Raise risk the day you see it, up and across, in business terms, with options. Report "on track" only when it is 
 - Present to client executives: the design, the trade-offs, the status, and the recommendation, answer first 
 - Spot expansion: where the client's next problem is, and tell sales

Qualifications

Technical (required)

- Has personally designed and shipped production ML or AI systems, more than once, and owned them after launch. This is a hard requirement: an Architect who cannot point to systems they built and ran is not an Architect, whatever else is on the resume 
 - A data science foundation with range: several technique families (classification, forecasting, NLP, deep learning, recommendation, anomaly detection) each tied to a real business outcome. Depth in a few, breadth across the rest 
 - Has built a generative or agentic AI system that real users depended on: the architecture end to end, where the tools ran, how cost and latency were handled, and how quality was measured. A serious RAG system or single-agent workflow with real evaluation discipline qualifies; a chatbot demo does not 
 - Production fluency on a hyperscaler: Google Cloud preferred (Vertex AI, BigQuery, Cloud Run or GKE); deep AWS or Azure experience with a credible translation is acceptable 
 - Strong software engineering: expert Python and SQL, containers, CI/CD, and the habits that make code someone else can run 
 - Currently hands-on, with recent, specific examples of code written and architectural decisions made

Leadership and delivery (required)

- Currently leads a team of engineers or data scientists, delegating real work while owning the architecture and core logic 
 - A repeatable method for taking an engagement from discovery through handoff: phases, milestones, who does what, validation before anything ships 
 - A track record of reshaping scope when the original ask wasn't the right solution, and of making the business case for the change

Communication and judgment (required)

- Answers the question asked, first, then the detail. Adjusts depth for the audience: can explain a system to an engineer and to a CFO in the same hour 
 - Executive presence: speaks with conviction, holds a position under challenge, and is someone we would put in front of a client executive next week without coaching 
 - Raises risk before it becomes a problem, to the person who can act on it, with a proposed fix. Comfortable disagreeing with senior people when the work calls for it 
 - Comfortable operating with autonomy across a significant time-zone gap with US colleagues and clients

Education

- Bachelor's degree in computer science, data science, engineering or a related field, or equivalent experience

Preferred

- Consulting or professional services background, with fluency in SoWs, scope, and billable delivery 
 - Google Cloud certifications, or delivery alongside Google teams 
 - Experience with agentic frameworks and patterns in production: tool calling, state management, MCP, multi-step orchestration, policy-guarded loops 
 - Regulated-industry delivery (financial services, healthcare) where explainability and audit are requirements, not features 
 - Daily use of AI coding assistants and agents in your own work, with a view on where they help and where they get in the way 
 - Experience working with a US-based team from India, and a point of view on how to make it work

What the job demands

- The client sees you. You present the design, you deliver the bad news, you defend the recommendation. The strength of the 66degrees brand on an engagement is the Architect leading it 
 - The plan will be wrong sometimes. Client problems rarely arrive fully defined, and scope moves. Working out what's really needed and saying so is the job, not an exception to it 
 - Your engineers learn from you. If you raise risks, they will. If you don't, they won't. You set the standard for how the India team works 
 - The US is asleep for half your day. You will make decisions with incomplete direction and own them. This role works a shifted schedule: online through 2: 00 PM US Eastern (11: 30 PM IST), so that most of the US working day overlaps with yours 
 - It's hands-on. If your week has become meetings and status calls, this is not the role

About 66degrees And The AI/ML Practice

66degrees is a leading consulting and professional services company specializing in developing AI-focused, data-led solutions leveraging the latest advancements in cloud technology. With our unmatched engineering capabilities and vast industry experience, we help the world's leading brands transform their business challenges into opportunities and shape the future of work. 

At 66degrees, we believe in embracing the challenge and winning together. These values not only guide us in achieving our goals as a company but also for our people. We are dedicated to creating a significant impact for our employees by fostering a culture that sparks innovation and supports professional and personal growth along the way. 

The AI/ML practice spans roughly 100 specialists across the U. S. , Canada, the UK, France, and India, working across three pillars: agentic and generative AI; classical ML; and MLOps and AgentOps. The India team is being built to own engagements end to end, with a path from Engineer to Architect that runs through India. 

Please note, we cannot sponsor or transfer any visas, of any kind, at this time. 

66degrees is an Equal Opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to actual or perceived race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, national origin, age, weight, height, marital status, sexual orientation, veteran status, disability status or other legally protected class. 

AI Transparency & Disclosure

As an AI transformation partner, 66degrees leverages intelligent solutions to enhance our recruitment experience. We utilize AI tools-including LinkedIn Recruiter's Hiring Assistant and interview transcription technologies-to assist with sourcing, role analysis, and capturing interview highlights. 

These tools augment our process, but we "Commit to Our Craft" by ensuring all final hiring decisions are made by our human Talent Team. By applying, you acknowledge the use of these technologies to help us "Win Together" in finding the best fit for our team.

P-1348

At Databricks, we are passionate about enabling data teams to solve the world's toughest problems, from security threat detection to cancer drug development. We do this by building and running the world's best data and AI infrastructure platform, so our customers can focus on the high value challenges that are central to their own missions. Our engineering teams build technical products that fulfill real, important needs in the world. We always push the boundaries of data and AI technology, while simultaneously operating with the resilience, security and scale that is important to making customers successful on our platform. 

We develop and operate one of the largest scale software platforms. The fleet consists of millions of virtual machines, generating terabytes of logs and processing exabytes of data per day. At our scale, we observe cloud hardware, network, and operating system faults, and our software must gracefully shield our customers from any of the above. 

As a Staff Software Engineer working on the Data Platform team you will help build the Data Intelligence Platform for Databricks that will allow us to automate decision-making across the entire company. You will achieve this in collaboration with Databricks Product Teams, Data Science, Applied AI and many more. You will develop a variety of tools spanning logging, orchestration, data transformation, metric store, governance platforms, data consumption layers etc. You will do this using the latest, bleeding-edge Databricks product and other tools in the data ecosystem - the team also functions as a large, production, in-house customer that dog foods Databricks and guides the future direction of the product.

- Design and run the Databricks metrics store that enables all business units and engineering teams to bring their detailed metrics into a common platform for sharing and aggregation, with high quality, introspection ability and query performance. 
 - Design and run the cross-company Data Intelligence Platform, which contains every business and product metric used to run Databricks. You'll play a key role in developing the right balance of data protections and ease of shareability for the Data Intelligence Platform as we transition to a public company. 
 - Develop tooling and infrastructure to efficiently manage and run Databricks on Databricks at scale, across multiple clouds, geographies and deployment types. This includes CI/CD processes, test frameworks for pipelines and data quality, and infrastructure-as-code tooling. 
 - Design the base ETL framework used by all pipelines developed at the company. 
 - Partner with our engineering teams to provide leadership in developing the long-term vision and requirements for the Databricks product. 
 - Build reliable data pipelines and solve data problems using Databricks, our partner's products and other OSS tools. Provide early feedback on the design and operations of these products. 
 - Establish conventions and create new APIs for telemetry, debug, feature and audit event log data, and evolve them as the product and underlying services change. 
 - Represent Databricks at academic and industrial conferences & events. 

What We Look For

 - 4+ years of experience building large scale distributed systems
 - 5+ providing technical leadership on large projects similar to the ones described above - ETL frameworks, metrics stores, infrastructure management, data security. 
 - Experience building, shipping and operating reliable multi-geo data pipelines at scale. 
 - Experience working with and operating workflow or orchestration frameworks, including open source tools like Airflow and DBT or commercial enterprise tools. 
 - Experience with large-scale messaging systems like Kafka or RabbitMQ or commercial systems. 
 - Excellent cross-functional and communication skills, consensus builder. 
 - Passion for data infrastructure and for enabling others by making their data easier to access. 

About Databricks

Databricks is the Data and AI company. More than 20, 000 organizations worldwide - including adidas, AT&T, Bayer, Block, Mastercard, Rivian, Unilever, and 70% of the Fortune 500 - rely on the Databricks Data + AI Platform to build and scale data and AI apps, analytics and agents. Company Type: Product

Job Description

This is a Permanent role with a Startup client of SourcingXPress. 

Infrastructure Ownership (AWS)

- Own AWS infrastructure end-to-end: EC2, RDS (MySQL), Elastic Load Balancing, VPC/networking, IAM, S3, EFS, Route 53, and related services. 
 - Design and optimize EC2 fleet sizing, auto scaling, and application load balancer configuration for availability and cost efficiency. 
 - Tune Amazon RDS for MySQL: instance sizing, parameter groups, read replicas and replica lag, backups, snapshots, and point-in-time recovery. 
 - Drive AWS cost optimization through right-sizing, reserved instances/savings plans, storage lifecycle policies, and regular cost reviews. 
 - Codify infrastructure as code so environments are reproducible, reviewable, and version-controlled. 

CI/CD And Release Engineering

- Own and improve our CI/CD pipelines on Bitbucket Pipelines: faster builds, reliable test stages, PR checks, and safe, repeatable deployments. 
 - Introduce zero-downtime deployment strategies (rolling, blue/green) and clean rollback paths. 
 - Manage build artifacts, environment configuration, and secrets across development, staging, and production. 

Developer Tooling And Secure Access

- Build a secure, streamlined way for engineers to connect to EC2 and RDS-e. g. , AWS Systems Manager Session Manager, bastion-less access, port forwarding, and SSO-based short-lived credentials-replacing shared keys and ad-hoc access. 
 - Implement least-privilege IAM roles and policies, with access that is auditable and easy to grant or revoke. 
 - Provide self-serve tooling and documentation so developers can spin up, debug, and access environments without waiting on DevOps. 

Reliability, Observability, And Security

- Set up monitoring, logging, and alerting (e. g. , CloudWatch and/or Prometheus/Grafana) with clear dashboards for application and database health. 
 - Participate in production incident response, lead root-cause analysis, and write runbooks to prevent repeat issues. 
 - Own backup, disaster recovery, and data-retention practices for a multi-tenant SaaS platform holding customer data. 
 - Harden infrastructure security: patching, network segmentation, security groups, encryption at rest and in transit, and secret management. 

Collaboration

- Work closely with backend, frontend, and QA engineers and the product support team to remove infrastructure bottlenecks. 
 - Document architecture, runbooks, and standards, and share DevOps best practices across the team. 

Requirements

- 4-6 years of hands-on experience in DevOps, SRE, or cloud infrastructure roles, ideally supporting a production SaaS product. 
 - Strong AWS expertise: EC2, RDS, ELB/ALB, Auto Scaling, VPC, IAM, S3, CloudWatch, and Systems Manager. 
 - Database operations: experience running MySQL on Amazon RDS in production-performance tuning, read replicas, backups, and recovery. 
 - CI/CD: proven experience building and maintaining pipelines (Bitbucket Pipelines preferred; GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, or Jenkins is also fine) and Git-based workflows. 
 - Infrastructure as Code: hands-on with Terraform, CloudFormation, or AWS CDK. 
 - Linux administration: strong Ubuntu/Linux skills, including networking, SSH, Nginx/web servers, and process management. 
 - Scripting: solid Bash and Python skills for automation and tooling. 
 - Security: practical experience with IAM least-privilege design, secret management, and secure access patterns for servers and databases. 
 - Observability: experience setting up monitoring, logging, and alerting, and handling on-call incidents. 
 - Strong problem-solving, clear communication, and comfort working as the owner of a function. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience running Python/Flask (or Django) applications in production, including WSGI servers such as Gunicorn/uWSGI and background workers. 
 - Experience with multi-tenant SaaS architectures and their isolation, scaling, and data-safety concerns. 
 - Familiarity with Docker and container orchestration (ECS, EKS, or Kubernetes). 
 - Experience with caching and queueing systems such as Redis, Celery, SQS, or RabbitMQ. 
 - Exposure to zero-trust/secure access tools (AWS SSM, Tailscale, Teleport, AWS IAM Identity Center). 
 - Familiarity with supporting AI/LLM workloads on AWS (e. g. , Amazon Bedrock). 
 - AWS certifications (Solutions Architect Associate/Professional, SysOps Administrator, or DevOps Engineer Professional). 
 - Experience with SFTP/EFS-based file integrations and data migration infrastructure.
