To get the best candidate experience, please consider applying for a maximum of 3 roles within 12 months to ensure you are not duplicating efforts. 

Job Category

Software Engineering

Job Details

About Salesforce

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn't a buzzword - it's a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all. 

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You're in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce. 

Role Description

Salesforce has immediate opportunities for Software Engineers who want their lines of code to have significant and measurable positive impact for users, the company's bottom line, and the industry. You will be working with a group of world-class engineers to build the breakthrough features our customers will love, adopt, and use while keeping our trusted CRM platform stable and scalable. The software engineer role at Salesforce encompasses architecture, design, implementation, and testing to ensure we build products right and release them with high quality. 

We pride ourselves on writing high quality, maintainable code that strengthens the stability of the product and makes our lives easier. We embrace the hybrid model and celebrate the individual strengths of each team member while cultivating everyone on the team to grow into the best version of themselves. We believe that autonomous teams with the freedom to make decisions will empower the individuals, the product, the company, and the customers they serve to thrive. 

As a Senior Member of Technical Staff (SMTS), Software Engineering, your job responsibilities will include: 

Primary Responsibilities

- Design and build secrets management features: Deliver secure, well-tested components for our core Secrets product, contributing to the architecture for multi-cloud Infrastructure as Code (IaC) deployments used for secret storage, access, and distribution. 
 - Operate mission-critical services: Help build and run highly sensitive, "Tier 0" services - writing scalable, resilient code, participating in on-call, and debugging distributed-systems issues to keep secret access reliable and low-latency. 
 - Apply cryptography and zero-trust identity: Work hands-on with PKI, X. 509, and cryptographic primitives to implement features such as dynamic secret generation, automated key rotation, device identity, and zero-trust authentication, with guidance from senior technical leads on direction. 
 - Implement secure secret distribution: Build and harden features for secure credential delivery, supporting real-time and non-real-time communication across heterogeneous networks with strict access controls and a focus on minimizing blast radius. 
 - Raise engineering quality: Provide thorough code reviews, improve test coverage and tooling, and mentor junior engineers on the team. 
 - Salesforce has immediate opportunities for software developers who want their lines of code to have significant and measurable positive impact for users, the company's bottom line, and the industry. You will be working with a group of world-class engineers to build the breakthrough features our customers will love, adopt, and use while keeping our trusted CRM platform stable and scalable. The software engineer role at Salesforce encompasses architecture, design, implementation, and testing to ensure we build products right and release them with high quality. 
 - We pride ourselves on writing high quality, maintainable code that strengthens the stability of the product and makes our lives easier. We embrace the hybrid model and celebrate the individual strengths of each team member while cultivating everyone on the team to grow into the best version of themselves. We believe that autonomous teams with the freedom to make decisions will empower the individuals, the product, the company, and the customers they serve to thrive. 
 - Build and ship high-quality, production-grade software using modern engineering practices, with AI as a core part of your development workflow by pushing the boundaries of AI development tools to deliver secure, optimized, and high-quality code. 
 - Design and orchestrate complex systems where AI agents integrate seamlessly into human workflows, driving efficiency and innovation at scale. 
 - Contribute to building and maintaining the shared system context, an explicit repository of system designs, constraints, and standards that enables AI to operate accurately and reliably. 
 - Critically evaluate code (Human or AI-generated) for correctness, quality, security, and performance. 
 - A demonstrated, genuine AI-first approach to engineering. Using AI to move faster, build fluency across the stack, and contribute well beyond your core specialty. 
 - Experience using AI tools (e. g. , Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Codex, Cursor, etc. ) in development workflows. 
 - Advanced prompt engineering skills and the ability to write precise, structured prompts and cultivate the system context that makes AI outputs reliable, secure, and production-ready. 

Qualifications

- 5+ years of hands-on experience in a software development role at a product-based software technology company. 
 - 3+ years of development experience in public cloud environments (AWS preferred; GCP a plus). 
 - Hands-On Engineering & Data: Strong, hands-on programming expertise in Golang, Java, C#, Python, Rust, or C/C++, with experience building highly available, scalable services backed by relational and NoSQL databases (e. g. , Postgres, DynamoDB, Cassandra). 
 - Cloud-Native Architecture & Infrastructure: Solid working knowledge of cloud computing, including Infrastructure as Code (IaC), container orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes), and core distributed networking (TCP/IP, DNS, load balancing). 
 - Security & Open Source: Applied knowledge of cloud security design, Secrets Management (HashiCorp Vault experience a plus), PKI/X. 509, and OWASP principles. 
 - Engineering Craft & Collaboration: Proven ability to design and deliver well-architected components, work effectively across teams with strong problem-solving skills. 

Benefits & Perks

Comprehensive benefits package including well-being reimbursement, generous parental leave, adoption assistance, fertility benefits, and more!

World-class enablement and on-demand training with Trailhead. com

Exposure to executive thought leaders and regular 1: 1 coaching with leadership

Volunteer opportunities and participation in our 1: 1: 1 model for giving back to the community

For more details, visit https: //www. salesforcebenefits. com/

Unleash Your Potential

When you join Salesforce, you'll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and be your best, and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can do your best. Together, we'll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future - but to redefine what's possible - for yourself, for AI, and the world. 

Accommodations

If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please submit a request via this Accommodations Request Form. 

Please note that Salesforce uses artificial intelligence (AI) tools to help our recruiters assess and evaluate candidates' resumes and qualifications throughout the recruiting process. Humans will always make any candidate selection and hiring decisions. Please see our Candidate Privacy Statement for more information about how we use your personal data and your rights, including with regard to use of AI tools and opt out options. 

Posting Statement

Salesforce is an equal opportunity employer and maintains a policy of non-discrimination with all employees and applicants for employment. What does that mean exactly? It means that at Salesforce, we believe in equality for all. And we believe we can lead the path to equality in part by creating a workplace that's inclusive, and free from discrimination. Know your rights: workplace discrimination is illegal. Any employee or potential employee will be assessed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications - without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender expression or identity, transgender status, age, disability, veteran or marital status, political viewpoint, or other classifications protected by law. This policy applies to current and prospective employees, no matter where they are in their Salesforce employment journey. It also applies to recruiting, hiring, job assignment, compensation, promotion, benefits, training, assessment of job performance, discipline, termination, and everything in between. Recruiting, hiring, and promotion decisions at Salesforce are fair and based on merit. The same goes for compensation, benefits, promotions, transfers, reduction in workforce, recall, training, and education.

data.title: Senior Software Development Engineer
data.description:
How You'll Help Us Keep Climbing (Overview & Key Responsibilities)

We are seeking an experienced Senior Development Engineer to join the TPF Development and Support team and play a key role in supporting and enhancing mission-critical TPF applications. This position combines software development, production support, system monitoring, performance optimization, and operational excellence within a highly available airline technology environment. 

The successful candidate will be responsible for supporting system monitoring activities, participating in on-call rotations for batch and production systems, triaging application and system anomalies, and driving performance improvements with a focus on MIPS reduction. The role involves hands-on development and enhancement of TPF applications, collaborating closely with multiple TPF engineering teams to troubleshoot issues, implement improvements, and ensure the stability and reliability of production systems. 

Responsibilities

- Participate in the development, maintenance, enhancement, and optimization of TPF applications and systems. 
 - Analyze business requirements and translate them into effective technical designs and solutions. 
 - Utilize advanced programming expertise in TPF, TPFDF, TPF C, and Assembler within the zTPF environment. 
 - Develop, test, and maintain software and technical documentation in accordance with organizational standards. 
 - Support and troubleshoot application and production issues, optimize system performance, and ensure timely resolution of problems. 
 - Adhere to established SDLC processes, development standards, and best practices. 
 - Collaborate across multiple project teams and act as an informal technical leader when required. 
 - Provide technical guidance, mentoring, and hands-on support to junior developers. 
 - Partner with system and application owners to design and implement secure, reliable, and scalable solutions. 
 - Develop automation scripts and tools for infrastructure management, monitoring, testing, and resiliency validation. 
 - Collaborate closely with business stakeholders and cross-functional IT teams to deliver business value. 
 - Identify security vulnerabilities and implement remediation measures proactively. 
 - Develop and share reusable technical solutions and best practices across the organization. 
 - Recommend product and process improvements to enhance the end-user experience. 
 - Investigate technical issues impacting the organization and recommend effective solutions. 
 - Provide ongoing support for applications and services running in production environments. 
 - Continuously monitor and review application performance, capacity, infrastructure, data processing, and messaging systems. 
 - Triage and resolve high-priority production incidents and service outages. 
 - Participate in Agile development practices and mentor team members on engineering best practices. 
 - Foster a culture of collaboration, inclusion, continuous learning, and operational excellence. 
 - Demonstrate a strong commitment to safety, security, compliance, and reliability in all activities. 

What You Need To Succeed (Minimum Qualifications)

- Bachelor's degree in computer science, Engineering, Information Systems, or equivalent experience. 
 - 4-7 years of experience in TPF airline operations and application development. 
 - Strong expertise in TPF, zTPF, TPFDF, and Assembler. 
 - Experience providing production support and participating in on-call rotations. 
 - Proven experience in TPF performance optimization and MIPS reduction initiatives. 
 - Airline or travel industry experience preferred. 
 - Exposure to AWS cloud technologies and experience working in Agile development environments is a plus. 
 - Strong analytical, problem-solving, and troubleshooting skills. 
 - Ability to translate business requirements into scalable technical solutions. 
 - Experience managing multiple priorities and meeting delivery commitments. 
 - Experience debugging and supporting applications developed by other engineers. 
 - Strong verbal and written communication skills and ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams and stakeholders. 
 - Quick learner with the ability to adapt to new tools and technologies. 
 - Customer-focused mindset with a proactive approach to issue resolution. 
 - Commitment to code quality, documentation, and post-production support. 
 - Experience using AI-assisted development tools such as GitHub Copilot, Claude, or similar tools for coding, testing, documentation, and debugging. 
 - Ability to leverage Generative AI solutions to improve development efficiency and productivity. 
 - Experience identifying opportunities to introduce AI-driven capabilities into products and engineering workflows. 
 - Focus on automation, reducing manual effort, improving system reliability, and increasing team productivity. 
 - Strong team player with excellent collaboration skills and demonstrated commitment to continuous improvement. 
 - Ability to work effectively in a diverse and inclusive environment, strong stakeholder management and communication skills. 
 - Consistently prioritizes safety, security, and compliance and Passion for delivering high-quality software solutions. 

Behavioral Competencies

- Ability to produce high quality results, work in a collaborative environment by embracing diverse perspectives and with a solution-based approach. 
 - Adapt communication clearly and concisely based on team dynamics and expresses thoughts & ideas effectively. 
 - Ability to engage effectively with peers and stakeholders to build trust and reliable working relationships. 
 - Ability to understand business processes, implement innovative solutions, guide juniors on continuous improvement by constantly updating oneself on current technology & trends. 
 - Inquisitive to understand customer and business expectations while creating value addition on technical solutions. 

What Will Give You a Competitive Edge (Preferred Qualifications)

- Proven experience providing on-call production support in a TPF environment, including system performance optimization and MIPS reduction initiatives. 
 - Preferred background in the Airline industry, with an understanding of airline business processes and mission-critical operations. 
 - Exposure to AWS cloud technologies is a strong advantage. 
 - Demonstrated ability to effectively prioritize and manage work across multiple projects and deployment teams, while meeting client and business commitments. 
 - Passion for delivering high-quality, reliable software solutions and maintaining operational excellence. 
 - Experience identifying and implementing continuous process improvements that enhance efficiency and business outcomes. 
 - Strong collaboration skills with the ability to work effectively in a cross-functional team environment. 
 - Embraces and values diverse perspectives, experiences, and working styles, fostering an inclusive workplace culture. 
 - Maintains a strong commitment to safety, security, compliance, and risk management, consistently prioritizing the well-being of self, colleagues, customers, and organizational assets. 

About The Company

What started as a humble, little aerial crop-dusting operation called Huff Daland Dusters in 1924 has now grown into the U. S. global airline leader in safety, innovation, reliability, and customer experience. Headquartered in Atlanta, Georgia, Delta Air Lines is known for its operational excellence and award-winning customer service. 

Powered by our employees worldwide, Delta has led the airline industry in operational excellence for a decade while maintaining our reputation for award-winning customer service. With our mission of connecting the people and cultures of the globe, Delta strives to foster understanding across a diverse world and serve as a force for social good. 

In 2026, Delta Air Lines continued to earn global recognition for its performance, culture and operational excellence. Delta was named to Glassdoor's 2026 Top 100 Best Places to Work list for the ninth time, standing as the only airline recognized. Delta also secured the 11th spot on Fortune's World's Most Admired Companies list, marking its 13th consecutive year earning this distinction. Delta was also recognized by Cirium as the top on-time airline in North America for the fifth consecutive year, underscoring its unwavering commitment to reliability and customer experience. 

About The Delta Technology Hub (DTH), Bangalore

The DTH is one of Delta Air Lines' investments in world-class business capabilities and technology aimed at transforming how Delta Air Lines operates and provides world-class travel experiences to its customers through innovation and cutting-edge methodologies. By continuously reimagining processes and driving technology-led transformation, the Delta Technology Hub plays a pivotal role in Scripting The Future Of Aviation. The organization is certified by the Great Place to Work Institute (India). The Delta Technology Hub was a finalist for the iVolunteer Awards 2024/2025 in the "Leader in Employee Volunteering" category. This nomination highlights our remarkable volunteering initiatives and the outstanding practices we implement to encourage and support our employee volunteering program. 

For more information, please visit www. deltatechhub. com

Why join?

- Technology is a key enabler of the differentiated services that Delta provides. At the DTH, you get the opportunity to work on projects with a significant impact on business outcomes and customer experience. 
 - Deepen your knowledge by taking part in multifaceted learning and development programs -exposure to extensive internal and partner repositories, institutional affiliations, and industry SIG (Special Interest Groups) partnerships. 
 - Immerse yourself in an employee-centric culture. 
 - Develop deep and broad business acumen on airline operations while retaining focus on cutting-edge technology driven solutions. 
 - Avail a full range of benefits that support you and your family: Medical Insurance, Transportation to and from the DTH office, Complementary Cafeteria Meals, Special Travel opportunities and Travel Privileges, Car Lease Program, Paid time off, Parental Benefits and National Pension Scheme.

Job Title/Role: Senior Full-Stack Engineer (Java/Spring Boot, React)

Mode of hire: Full-Time

Base Location: Guindy, Chennai

Mode of work: Hybrid/ Roster Model

Shift Timing: General Shift

Experience: 4 to 7 Yrs

About Us

Access is a global leader in information management solutions, offering comprehensive services across the entire document and records management lifecycle. From secure offsite storage for paper and digital records to advanced software for privacy, retention, and document management, Access enables organizations to protect, govern, and maximize the value of their information. Our end-to-end services include backfile imaging and digital delivery, scanning and digitization, business process automation, and secure destruction, purges, shredding and data archiving. 

About The Role

As a Senior Full-Stack Engineer, you will play a key role in building scalable, secure, and high-performing applications that support Access' information management and digital workflow solutions. This role involves working across the frontend and backend, developing React-based user experiences, Java/Spring Boot services, APIs, and event-driven microservices in a cloud-enabled environment. You will collaborate with product, QA, DevOps, and engineering teams to deliver reliable solutions, improve system performance, and contribute to modern software development practices across the platform. 

Tech you'll work with

Backend: Java, Spring Boot (Web, Security, Validation), Spring Data MongoDB, Spring Data Redis, Spring Kafka, Spring Cloud Function; REST APIs plus a GraphQL (Apollo Federation) BFF layer. 

Frontend: React, TypeScript, Redux, React Hook Form, React Router, react-intl (i18n). 

Data & messaging: Apache Kafka (event-driven), MongoDB, Redis, relational DBs (PostgreSQL/SQL Server), AWS Timestream for time-series/event logging. 

Cloud & platform: AWS (ECS, Lambda, S3, SQS, Timestream, CloudWatch, API Gateway), Terraform (IaC across multiple environments), Docker/Compose, Auth0 (OAuth2/OIDC, SAML, MFA), CI/CD via Azure DevOps. 

Roles & Responsibilities

What you'll do

- Design and build features end-to-end - React micro-frontends and the Spring Boot services and APIs behind them. 
 - Develop and maintain event-driven microservices (Kafka producers/consumers) and REST/GraphQL APIs. 
 - Contribute to the module-federated frontend: shared component libraries, state management, performance, and accessibility. 
 - Integrate with cloud services (S3, SQS, Timestream, Redis, MongoDB) using the AWS SDK. 
 - Write automated tests (JUnit, Jest), participate in code reviews, and help evolve CI/CD pipelines. 
 - Collaborate with product, QA, and DevOps in an Agile team; troubleshoot across the stack using logging, and metrics. 

Required Skills

What we're looking for (required)

- 4 to 6 years of professional software engineering with production experience in both React and Java/Spring Boot. 
 - Primary - Backend-Java Spring boot , 3 to 4 years recent experience with Java 8 or later required). 
 - Backend: solid Java (8+ Version preferred 17/21) and Spring Boot - building REST services, working with Spring Security, and integrating databases (SQL and/or NoSQL). 
 - Frontend: strong React + TypeScript, modern JS/ES tooling, component-driven architecture, REST/GraphQL API consumption, and testing. 
 - Comfort with relational and NoSQL data stores (e. g. , PostgreSQL/SQL Server, MongoDB) and caching (Redis). 
 - Familiarity with Git, CI/CD, and writing tests at multiple levels. 
 - Ability to work across service boundaries in a distributed, microservices codebase. 
 - Experience handling PHI/PII or other sensitive data, including secure document transfer workflows (encryption in transit/at rest, access controls, audit logging). 

Qualification

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field. 

Nice to have

- Micro-frontend / Module Federation experience. 
 - Event-driven / Kafka messaging and microservices patterns (sagas, BFF, API gateways). 
 - Hands-on AWS (ECS, Lambda, S3, SQS, Timestream) and Terraform/IaC. 
 - Auth0 / OAuth2 / OIDC / SAML identity integration. 
 - GraphQL (Apollo Federation) and monorepo tooling (Yarn workspaces, Maven multi-module). 
 - Domain exposure to enterprise content/records management or healthcare data (HL7/FHIR, HIPAA). 
 - Experience with high-transaction-volume systems (throughput, scaling, and performance tuning) - highly preferred. 

Competencies

- Communication Skills 
 - Strong problem-solving 
 - Collaboration with cross-functional teams. 
 - Attention to details 
 - Continues Learning

At Databricks, we are passionate about enabling data teams to solve the world's toughest problems - from making the next mode of transportation a reality to accelerating the development of medical breakthroughs. We do this by building and running the world's best data and AI infrastructure platform so our customers can use deep data insights to improve their business. Founded by engineers - and customer obsessed - we leap at every opportunity to solve technical challenges, from designing next-gen UI/UX for interfacing with data to scaling our services and infrastructure across millions of virtual machines. And we're only getting started in Bengaluru , India ! As a software engineer with a backend focus, you will work with your team to build infrastructure for the Databricks platform at scale. 

The Impact You'll Have

Our backend teams cover a diverse range of domains, from core compute fabric resource management to service platforms and infrastructure. For example, you might work on challenges such as:

data.title: Software Engineer – SAP Commerce Cloud / Hybris
data.description:
Job Description

WHAT YOU'LL DO

As a Software Engineer in the Digital Transactions area, you will work on one of H&M's key e-commerce platforms, built on SAP Commerce Cloud / Hybris. You will be part of a product team responsible for developing, enhancing, and maintaining core customer-facing commerce capabilities such as cart, checkout, wishlist, order confirmation, customer journeys, and order-related integrations. 

This role is not limited to project delivery only. You will be part of the product engineering team that owns the application end to end, meaning you will contribute to new feature development, technical improvements, production stability, defect resolution, code quality, and continuous platform evolution. 

In addition to the above, your role will involve: 

- Developing and enhancing SAP Commerce Cloud / Hybris features across cart, checkout, wishlist, order confirmation, customer, product, pricing, promotions, delivery, and order-related flows
 - Building, extending, and maintaining OCC REST APIs used by frontend and composable storefront applications
 - Working with SAP Commerce layers including controllers, facades, services, DAOs, converters, populators, interceptors, events, cronjobs, impex, back office, Flexible Search, Solr, and Cloud Hot folder
 - Supporting checkout and transactional journeys involving cart calculation, delivery mode selection, payment flow, order placement, order confirmation, and downstream integrations
 - Contributing to integrations with external systems such as payment providers, OMS, ERP/ECC, CPI, pricing/promotion services, delivery systems, and event-driven platforms
 - Troubleshooting production and non-production issues by analyzing application logs, API payloads, database queries, Flexible Search results, stack traces, and monitoring dashboards
 - Participating in technical design discussions, impact analysis, estimation, implementation planning, and code reviews
 - Improving application performance, maintainability, scalability, and production readiness
 - Writing clean, testable, maintainable code and supporting unit testing, integration testing, and defect fixing
 - Collaborating in an agile product team and taking ownership of assigned features from development to release and post-release support
 - Supporting continuous improvement of the SAP Commerce Cloud platform in CCV2 environments

WHO YOU ARE

We are looking for people with strong hands-on SAP Commerce Cloud / Hybris engineering experience who can contribute independently and collaborate effectively with a larger product team. 

Skills & Experience: 

- Degree in Computer Science/Information Technology (B. Tech/B. E/MS/MTech) or a related field
 - 4-7 years of professional software engineering experience
 - Strong Java and Spring framework experience
 - Hands-on SAP Commerce Cloud / Hybris development experience
 - Good understanding of SAP Commerce Cloud architecture, extension structure, build process, and CCV2 deployment model
 - Experience with core SAP Commerce areas such as cart, checkout, pricing, promotions, orders, customers, products, catalogs, impex, cronjobs, interceptors, events, services, facades, converters, and populators
 - Experience building and extending OCC REST APIs
 - Good understanding of SAP Commerce backoffice, Flexible Search, Solr, and integration patterns
 - Experience working with SAP Commerce Cloud in CCV2 environments
 - Ability to troubleshoot production issues, analyze logs, debug code, and work with monitoring tools
 - Good understanding of e-commerce flows, especially cart, checkout, order placement, payment, delivery, and fulfilment-related integrations
 - Ability to write clean, maintainable, and production-ready code
 - Good communication skills and the ability to explain technical topics clearlyPreferred skills

- Experience with payment integrations, order integrations, OMS, ECC, CPI, or event-driven integrations
 - Experience with composable storefront or headless commerce integrations
 - Experience with SAP Commerce performance tuning, code quality improvements, and production-readiness topics
 - Experience working with APIs, integration payloads, logs, monitoring tools, and issue investigation
 - Experience with Solace, Kafka, or other event-driven messaging platforms is a plus
 - Experience with cloud-native commerce operations, CI/CD, monitoring, and DevOps practices is a plus
 - Ability to contribute to technical design, solution discussions, code reviews, mentoring, and complex troubleshootingAnd people who are: 

- Passionate about developing customer-centric commerce solutions
 - Strong problem solvers with the ability to think critically and investigate complex issues
 - Comfortable working in a fast-paced, agile, and collaborative environment
 - Proactive, responsible, and willing to take ownership of technical deliveries
 - Curious and continuously looking for ways to improve the platform, codebase, and customer experience
 - Good communicators who can collaborate with both technical and non-technical stakeholders
 - Open to learning, sharing knowledge, and supporting other team members

WHO YOU'LL WORK WITH

The Commercial domain enables us to create an elevated, inspiring, relevant, and seamless experience for our customers across all commercial channels and models - physical and digital, owned and partnerships - while driving profitable growth for our company. 

You will be part of the Digital Transactions area, working in a product engineering team responsible for H&M's online commerce capabilities. The team owns and maintains key transactional customer journeys across cart, checkout, wishlist, order confirmation, payment, delivery, and order-related flows. This is a product ownership environment, so the team is responsible not only for delivering new functionality but also for maintaining application stability, improving technical quality, resolving production issues, and continuously enhancing the platform. 

You will collaborate closely with software engineers, engineering managers, solution architects, product owners, business analysts, QA engineers, frontend teams, integration teams, platform teams, and other engineering teams to deliver scalable, secure, and customer-centric commerce solutions. Together, you will build, enhance, and operate scalable commerce capabilities that support H&M's global digital business. 

WHO WE ARE

H&M is a global company of strong fashion brands and ventures. Our goal is to prove that there is no compromise between exceptional design, affordable prices, and sustainable solutions. We want to liberate fashion for the many, and our customers are at the heart of every decision we make. 

We are made up of thousands of passionate and talented colleagues united by our shared culture and values. Together, we want to use our power, our scale, and our knowledge to push the fashion industry towards a more inclusive and sustainable future. 

Help us re-imagine fashion and together we will re-shape our industry. Learn more about H&M here. 

WHY YOU'LL LOVE WORKING HERE

At H&M, we are proud to be a vibrant and welcoming company. We offer our employees attractive benefits with extensive development opportunities around the globe. 

We offer all our employees at H&M attractive benefits with extensive development opportunities around the globe. All our employees receive a staff discount card, usable on all our H&M brands in stores and online. Brands covered by the discount are H&M (Beauty and Move included), COS, Weekday, Monki, H&M HOME, & Other Stories, ARKET, Afound. In addition to our staff discount, all our employees are included in our H&M Incentive Program - HIP. You can read more about our H&M Incentive Program here. 

In addition to our global benefits, all our local markets offer different competitive perks and benefits. Please note that they may differ between employment types and countries. 

JOIN US

Our uniqueness comes from a combination of many things - our inclusive and collaborative culture, our strong values, and opportunities for growth. But most of all, it's our people who make us who we are. 

Take the next step in your career together with us. The journey starts here. 

*We are committed to a recruitment process that is fair, equitable, and based on competency. We therefore kindly ask you to not attach a cover letter in your application. 

Additional Information

This is a full-time position apply by sending in your CV in English as soon as possible. Due to data policies, we only accept applications through the SmartRecruiters or career page.

data.title: Quality Care Manager
data.description:
Role purpose

The QCM heads the dealership's quality care team and ensures all sales operations are aligned with ARENA channel values and guidelines. The QCM ensures all enablers are in place for a delightful experience across the customer journey, and takes corrective action to improve Quality of Sales (QoS) standards. 

Key responsibilities

1. Ensure a delightful experience at every touch point of the customer journey, in line with ARENA experience standards. 

2. Ensure all staff follow ARENA guidelines and processes, including showroom, car display, test drive, delivery and facility management norms. 

3. Plan the daily delivery schedule at least one day ahead and share it in the morning meeting; ensure vehicles are checked and customer documents are ready a day before delivery. 

4. Ensure delivery at the requested and promised time using the delivery schedule app, with a delightful delivery ceremony as per ARENA standards. 

5. Ensure every vehicle is delivered with complete documentation; record any pendency, inform the customer and track it to closure as committed. 

6. Track pending bookings and proactively update customers in case of delay. 

7. Handle customer feedback, complaints and escalations with empathy; identify the root cause, resolve every grievance and maximise internal complaint capturing. 

8. Attend the morning meeting to review previous-day performance; review team performance on quality of sales parameters fortnightly and prepare an action plan with the CEO. 

9. Train the sales team regularly on sales quality aspects of dealership processes and update them on NPS improvement areas. 

10. Conduct customer engagement activities (including celebrating customer birthdays and anniversaries) and highlight best practices of RMs and company. 

Key competencies

1. Handling digital technology at the dealership (DMS, delivery schedule app, other company apps)

2. Professionalism

3. Self-motivation and ensuring implementation of Experience Standards

4. Understanding customer concerns across journey stages and resolving them

5. Using DMS reports for MIS reporting

6. Understanding customer expectations and taking corrective action

7. Good listening skills

8. Leadership in engaging other team members

9. Thorough knowledge of ARENA experience standards

10. Adherence to all quality check points

11. Pro-active, customer-centric approach

data.title: Engineer - QA [T500-30781]
data.description:
About Officeworks: 

Officeworks' purpose is "we bring big ideas to life at low prices". It's how we create shared value for customers, team members, suppliers, communities and shareholders. 

We are Australia's leading omnichannel retailer of complete technology solutions, stationery, furniture, art supplies, and learning resources. We also offer services including Print & Create, and Geeks2U. 

Our products and services provide solutions to our diverse range of customers across Australia from households, students, small to large sized businesses, governments and schools. 

Our culture is built on beginning with customer, doing the right thing, executing with accountability, and leading with ambition. We are one team who are proud to "wear the blues" and deliver for our customers. 

We are an inclusive, forward-thinking organization that encourages learning, continuous improvement and innovation. The work we do plays an important role in helping Australians work, learn, create and connect. 

About the Technology Function: 

By joining the Technology team in the GCC you will play a direct role in Officeworks' global digital transformation, contributing to world-class capabilities that sit at the heart of how the business operates and grows. The GCC will support Officeworks' purpose of helping to bring big ideas to life at low prices, ensuring technology remains a true enabler of customer value and operational excellence. 

This opportunity to join as a founding member of the new global hub is a chance to be part of the original build-out of our GCC. Early joiners will influence how the hub operates and help shape the future state of some of Officeworks' core technology ecosystem. 

These roles are best suited for people who enjoy: 

- Exposure to eCommerce and digital platforms, customer facing services enabled online and in retail stores, and an expanding presence into generative and agentic commerce - covering operations, security, development, automation, and solution architecture supporting global initiatives and modernising business critical systems being the forefront of global innovation and transformation, helping digitize the Officeworks business joining a place where your skills matter, your growth is intentional, and your work has visible impact on business outcomes. 

The role: 

Title: AI Engineer

Function: Technology

Location: Bengaluru

Why this role exists: 

The AI Engineer orchestrates the technical agents that produce code, tests, documentation and design mock-ups within a pod delivery model. The role translates product specifications into functional instructions for AI agents, running multiple agent workstreams in parallel across standard-complexity work while holding the pre-production commit gate for routine changes. 

The role evolves how engineering is executed. AI agents carry a significant share of test generation, documentation and code execution, while the AI Engineer remains fully accountable for system design judgement, code review, quality and all commitments to production. The role relies on AI-driven test coverage, agent-supported execution and human-in-the-loop validation to maintain high release standards. 

Where you will make a difference: 

In this role you will: 

Agent Orchestration and Delivery: 

- Translate product specifications from the Product Orchestrator into functional specifications and instructions that AI agents can execute, clarifying intent where requirements are ambiguous. 
 - Run multiple technical agents in parallel across standard-complexity work (coding, test case generation, documentation and visual design mock-ups) sequencing outputs so one stream is usable by the next. 
 - Apply base context, security policies, architecture patterns and coding standards established by the platform team to every agent run. 
 - Improve agent workflows continuously, sharing prompt techniques, context improvements and automation patterns across pods. 

Review, Quality Engineering, and Commit Gate: 

- Hold the pre-production commit gate on routine changes, ensuring no code reaches production without thorough review. 
 - Perform fast and accurate reviews of generated code, tests and specifications, identifying subtle errors, logical defects or plausible but incorrect outputs. 
 - Confirm that instructions given to technical agents have been executed to the expected standard before committing code. 
 - Design and execute test strategy for assigned workstreams, including functional integration and regression testing, building on AI-generated test coverage and agent-supported execution. 
 - Identify, document, and track defects to resolution, communicating severity and coordinating fixes with technical and functional stakeholders. 
 - Own non-functional outcomes for assigned workstreams, including performance, resilience, accessibility and security, and confirm architectural fit before commit. 
 - Escalate complex, high-risk or major architectural changes to the Senior AI Engineer or Principal AI Engineer for higher-level review. 

Context, Documentation and Knowledge Management: 

- Verify that technical documentation exists and is accurate, maintaining documentation as an active input to subsequent agent runs rather than an after-the-fact record. 
 - Maintain knowledge artefacts for workstreams so future code and agent outputs draw on detailed, reusable domain context over time. 
 - Contribute domain knowledge back to shared context repositories in line with central standards managed by Context Engineers. 
 - Maintain clear system provenance to distinguish agent-generated components from human-authored code. 

Production Support and Continuous Improvement: 

- Identify, troubleshoot and resolve reported defects and incidents promptly across the platform domains the pod touches, including participation in on-call rotations. 
 - Support and maintain existing platforms, integrations and legacy services alongside agent-based delivery flows during technical transition periods. 
 - Execute production verification testing during post-deployment and hypercare periods, confirming release quality before handover to steady-state support. 
 - Report observed drift, hallucinations or specification failures in agent tooling to Agent Integrity Engineers. 

Who you will be working with: 

In this role, you will: 

- Product Orchestration: Clarify specification intent and raise technical feasibility or workstream sequencing considerations with Product Orchestrators. 
 - Engineering Leadership: Seek higher-level review for complex or high-risk changes from Senior AI Engineers, Principal Domain Engineers, and Associate Engineering Managers. 
 - Architecture and Context Teams: Apply platform context libraries and feed domain knowledge back to Context Engineers, Solution Architects and Domain Architects. 
 - Platform and Integrity Specialists: Report agent drift or hallucination to Associate AI Agent Evaluation Engineers and collaborate with Platform Engineers on workflows and permissions. 

What success looks like: 

- Workstream Throughput: High throughput of reviewed and committed work delivered through parallel multi-agent workstreams. 
 - Commit Gate Quality: High review quality with minimal defects escaping to production, backed by rigorous verification. 
 - Context Artefact Accuracy: High standard of accurate, reusable documentation and context artefacts that continuously improve subsequent agent runs. 
 - Platform Stability: High stability, supportability, and swift issue resolution across owned platform domains and legacy components. 
 - Demonstrates behaviours aligned to Officeworks' values, contributing to a respectful, inclusive and high-performing culture. 

How will you lead: 

Individual Contributor: 

- Lives our Officeworks values and behaviours
 - Proactively contributes to a safe working environment, escalates appropriately if there are unsafe conditions or inappropriate behaviour
 - Operates in line with applicable Officeworks company policies and Code of Conduct
 - Demonstrates a strong sense of personal accountability and curiosity to learn and develop
 - Contributes to an inclusive and respectful environment where diverse perspectives are valued and everyone feels safe to speak up and belong

Our Values: 

Our values shape the way we work, our behaviours and how we interact with each other, our customers, suppliers and communities. We begin with customer, We do the right thing, We execute with accountability and We lead with ambition

Qualifications and work experience: 

Essential: 

- Education: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field. 
 - Experience: 6-8 years of software engineering experience, combining full-stack development with hands-on software quality assurance and testing across manual and automated methodologies. 
 - System Design Judgement: Demonstrated system design judgement to assess whether AI-generated code and technical output are fit for purpose, performant, and secure. 
 - Agent Orchestration: Practical experience or strong capability in orchestrating AI agents and developer tooling across parallel workstreams. 
 - Specification Literacy: Proven ability to write clear, precise functional specifications and prompts that produce accurate agent output. 
 - Quality Engineering: Demonstrated experience designing and executing test strategy (test planning, functional, integration and regression testing, test automation and defect management) across the software delivery lifecycle. 
 - Code Review Discipline: Experience conducting fast, accurate code reviews and managing pre-production commit gates, with an ability to identify plausible but incorrect logic. 
 - Operational Resilience: Experience supporting services in production, including incident handling and participating in on-call rotations across complex cloud architectures

Preferred: 

- Retail Commerce Architecture: Experience working with modern headless retail platforms and commerce developer tooling. 
 - Observability Tooling: Familiarity with modern log management and observability tooling such as Sumo Logic or Datadog. 
 - Cloud and CI/CD Infrastructure: Hands-on experience with cloud environments (AWS), Docker containerization, Git workflows, and modern CI/CD pipelines

data.title: Associate Engineer - QA [T500-30778]
data.description:
About Officeworks: 

Officeworks' purpose is "we bring big ideas to life at low prices". It's how we create shared value for customers, team members, suppliers, communities and shareholders. 

We are Australia's leading omnichannel retailer of complete technology solutions, stationery, furniture, art supplies, and learning resources. We also offer services including Print & Create, and Geeks2U. 

Our products and services provide solutions to our diverse range of customers across Australia from households, students, small to large sized businesses, governments and schools. 

Our culture is built on beginning with customer, doing the right thing, executing with accountability, and leading with ambition. We are one team who are proud to "wear the blues" and deliver for our customers. 

We are an inclusive, forward-thinking organization where diverse perspectives enable innovation, continuous improvement and better outcomes for our customers and teams. The work we do plays an important role in helping Australians work, learn, create and connect. 

About the Data and AI Hub: 

By joining the Technology team in the GCC you will play a direct role in Officeworks' global digital transformation, contributing to world-class capabilities that sit at the heart of how the business operates and grows. The GCC will support Officeworks' purpose of helping to bring big ideas to life at low prices, ensuring technology remains a true enabler of customer value and operational excellence. 

This opportunity to join as a founding member of the new global hub is a chance to be part of the original build-out of our GCC. Early joiners will influence how the hub operates and help shape the future state of some of Officeworks' core technology ecosystem. 

These roles are best suited for people who enjoy: 

- exposure to eCommerce and digital platforms, customer facing services enabled online and in retail stores, and an expanding presence into generative and agentic commerce - covering operations, security, development, automation, and solution architecture
 - supporting global initiatives and modernising business critical systems
 - being the forefront of global innovation and transformation, helping digitize the Officeworks business
 - joining a place where your skills matter, your growth is intentional, and your work has visible impact on business outcomes. 

Why this role exists: 

The Associate AI Engineer sits inside a Customer Platforms and supports by orchestrating AI agents to produce code, tests, and documentation, ensuring features across Officeworks' digital properties are built and maintained efficiently. The role is a full stack engineering role and bridges feature development and quality assurance by directing agent workflows and conducting critical reviews before code is committed to production. 

In addition to feature development, the role contributes to the ongoing operation, maintenance, and support of Customer Platforms systems in production. This includes monitoring system performance and health, identifying and resolving production issues, supporting incident and defect resolution, and implementing fixes and enhancements to ensure the reliability, stability, and continuous improvement of digital platforms

Where you will make a difference: 

In this role you will: 

Agent Workstream Orchestration: 

- Run single or paired agent workstreams across coding, test generation, and documentation workflows. 
 - Translate technical and product specifications into precise, structured instructions for AI agents to execute. 
 - Apply platform context, base coding standards, and security policies to every agent execution. 
 - Monitor parallel agent tasks and confirm that generated outputs satisfy specified functional requirements. 

Code Review and Quality Assurance: 

- Perform rigorous reviews of agent-generated code, automated tests, and technical documentation. 
 - Design and execute test cases across unit, integration, and end-to-end scenarios, extending beyond AI-generated coverage where gaps exist. 
 - Evaluate generated code for functional correctness, security vulnerabilities, performance, and architectural fit. 
 - Identify, document, and track defects to resolution, escalating severity and blockers to Senior AI Engineers where required. 

Documentation and Shared Context Management: 

- Maintain accurate, up-to-date documentation and knowledge artefacts to ensure context repositories effectively feed subsequent agent runs. 
 - Identify and resolve missing, outdated, or ambiguous context in shared repositories that negatively affects agent accuracy. 
 - Log technical decisions and specification updates to maintain end-to-end trace abilities for system workflows. 

Operational Support and Issue Resolution: 

- Support the investigation and resolution of production issues across the platform domains managed by the pod. 
 - Participate in on-call support rotations as required to maintain platform reliability and system availability. 
 - Support release verification and post-deployment checks to confirm features perform as tested before hypercare handover. 
 - Track runtime anomalies or recurring defects and feed learnings back into context documentation and agent guidance. 

Who you will be working with: 

- Pod Delivery Teams: Partner with Product Orchestrators and fellow pod engineers to translate specifications into executable agent workflows and deliver features in continuous flow. 
 - Platform and Architecture Specialists: Work with Context Engineers, Solution Architects, and Associate AI Agent Evaluation Engineers to align work with base contexts, security policies, and review frameworks. 
 - Operations and Enablement Teams: Collaborate with Platform Engineers, Associate AI Agent Operations Engineers, and the AI Enablement Manager to leverage shared tools, continuous integration pipelines, and observability platforms. 
 - Vendor and External Partners: Engage with external vendor support and technology partners as directed to resolve tooling issues or platform integration requirements. 

What success looks like: 

- Delivery Velocity and Quality: High review pass rate on submitted code and test artefacts, with minimal defects escaping to production environments. 
 - Capability Progression: Demonstrated growth in independent review judgement, prompt engineering literacy, and agent orchestration. 
 - Artefact Currency: High accuracy and completeness of shared context repositories and technical documentation contributed to the pod. 
 - Operational Resilience: Timely response to and resolution of domain incidents, maintaining reliable and secure platform performance. 
 - Demonstrates behaviours aligned to Officeworks' values, contributing to a respectful, inclusive and high-performing culture. 

How you will lead: 

Individual Contributor: 

- Lives our Officeworks values and behaviours
 - Proactively contributes to a safe working environment, escalates appropriately if there are unsafe conditions or inappropriate behaviour
 - Operates in line with applicable Officeworks company policies and Code of Conduct
 - Demonstrates a strong sense of personal accountability and curiosity to learn and develop
 - Contributes to an inclusive and respectful environment where diverse perspectives are valued and everyone feels safe to speak up and belong

Qualifications and work experience: 

Essential: 

- Education: Tertiary degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field. 
 - Experience: 3+ years of software engineering experience, with exposure to full-stack delivery, cloud-based systems, and hands-on software testing or quality assurance. 
 - Tooling Literacy: Practical experience utilizing AI-assisted coding and agent tools (e. g. , Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Codex) to build and test software. 
 - Full Stack Capability: Foundational knowledge across front-end, back-end, and integration technologies (e. g. , JavaScript/TypeScript, Node. js, React, REST APIs). 
 - Quality Engineering: Hands-on experience designing and executing test cases (unit, integration and end-to-end) and documenting defects to resolution, not just familiarity with testing principles. 
 - Software Quality: Understanding of software testing principles, including automated unit, integration, and end-to-end testing practices. 
 - Specification and Logic: Ability to interpret functional specifications, construct precise logic instructions, and review generated code for correctness. 
 - Collaboration and Process: Familiarity with modern continuous integration and delivery pipelines (CI/CD), Git version control, and continuous flow delivery models. 
 - Practical experience in software testing, quality assurance or test automation. 
 - Understanding of functional, integration and regression testing, with awareness of performance, resilience and security considerations. 
 - Ability to create and execute automated tests for assigned features and integrations, identify defects and support release verification. 
 - Exposure to Playwright, Postman, BrowserStack or equivalent tools. 

Preferred: 

- Retail and Commerce Exposure: Familiarity with modern omnichannel commerce platforms or digital retail environments. 
 - Observability Frameworks: Exposure to cloud logging and observability tooling such as Sumo Logic or Datadog. 
 - Cloud Technologies: Basic exposure to Amazon Web Services (AWS) or serverless cloud architecture patterns.

About Ginesys

Ginesys is India's leading retail technology platform, powering 1, 200+ customers and 50, 000+ users through the unified GinesysOne suite - ERP, Cloud POS (Zwing), Order Management (Browntape), GST Compliance (EaseMyGST), and BI (InsightX). We are evolving from a System of Records to a System of Intelligence through Ginesys. AI. 

About The Role

We are seeking a QA Engineer (Automation) to join our Product Engineering team and help drive the modernization of our Retail ERP platform. You will build automated tests that prove new services behave exactly like the existing system, down to financial, stock, and tax totals. 

This role requires strong API test automation and SQL skills, and comfort comparing large datasets. You will work inside development teams with Technical Leads, Architects, and DevOps. 

Key Responsibilities

- Design and build automated API, integration, and contract tests for new ERP services. 
 - Compare outputs of the existing and new systems on large datasets and report differences precisely. 
 - Write SQL reconciliation checks for financial, stock, and tax data. 
 - Automate checks for release and data migration steps (before/after counts, totals, timings). 
 - Integrate tests into CI/CD pipelines and keep them fast and reliable. 
 - Use AI tools to generate and extend test cases, and review what they produce. 
 - Log defects with clear data and steps to reproduce; verify fixes. 
 - Participate in sprint planning, estimation, and release readiness reviews. 

Required Technical Skills

Test Automation

- 3+ years of hands-on test automation experience, mainly API testing. 
 - Automation in C#, Java, Python, or JavaScript using tools such as RestSharp, Postman/Newman, Playwright, or pytest. 

Database

- Strong SQL skills; comfortable comparing and reconciling large datasets. 
 - Experience with PostgreSQL or SQL Server. 

CI/CD

- Experience running automated tests in CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions or Azure DevOps). 

AI-assisted Testing

- Comfortable using AI tools in daily testing work. 

Version Control

- Experience with Git. 
 - Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments. 

Team Responsibilities

- Work as part of the development team, not after it. 
 - Push for testability in design and code reviews. 
 - Share test standards and reusable test utilities with the team. 

Preferred Skills

- Contract testing (e. g. Pact) or OpenAPI-based testing. 
 - Data migration or reconciliation testing. 
 - Performance testing tools (JMeter, k6). 
 - Domain knowledge of retail, ERP, accounting, inventory, or POS systems is highly desirable. 

Educational Qualification

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related discipline. 

What You'll Work On

- Enterprise Retail ERP Platform
 - API-first Integrations
 - Data Migration and Reconciliation
 - High-volume Transaction Processing
 - Release and Deployment Quality
 - Cloud-native Modernization Initiatives

What We Look For

- Strong attention to detail. 
 - Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills. 
 - Comfort with data and numbers. 
 - Ownership mindset with a focus on quality. 
 - Good communication with development teams. 

Why Join Us

- Opportunity to modernize a large-scale enterprise Retail ERP platform. 
 - Work on cloud-native, event-driven, and distributed systems. 
 - Solve challenging scalability and performance problems. 
 - Collaborate with experienced architects and product engineering teams. 
 - Play a key role in shaping the technical direction of a mission-critical product. 

Benefits

We like to think that talent grows at Ginesys and stays at Ginesys. To ensure this, we provide our employees with the best working environment, the latest technology and continuous support. We go out of our way to retain the small business feeling with which we started and stimulate innovation and collaboration through teamwork and our non-hierarchical approach. We offer competitive salary, and other fantastic perks and benefits, such as: 

Ginesys Academy for holistic training and development Comprehensive health insurance coverage Excellent rewards and recognition policy

Transparent compensation policy with no unnecessary deduction in CTC Annual company off-site and a variety of events, celebrations throughout the year

Travelling opportunities between our offices across the country. Annual Ginesys walkathon & related sporting events. Quarterly Coffee with the CEO and more!

Here's our story; now tell us yours

Ginesys is India's best omni retail suite backed by Ginesys, the first integrated Retail specific ERP software for online retail, offline retail and distribution. It is the largest Indian company in the retail tech industry catering to both online and offline needs. 1200 + brands including (Manyavar, V-Mart, Skechers) are accelerating their businesses with Ginesys. With a team of 400+ employees, Ginesys One plans to revolutionize retail by being a single-stop cloud-based retail suite. We have a pan India presence with offices in major cities including Gurgaon, Kolkata, Bangalore, Hyderabad, Mumbai, Coimbatore & Goa and are expanding rapidly. We love the challenges of retail and are busy solving them to create a great retail tech suite. Ginesys core mission is to continue to build world-class internal service capabilities, in a bid to deliver outstanding external service value to customers. We are an ISO-certified and SOC compliant company having won myriad awards for our innovation and support. For further information, please visit our website http: //ginesys. in

Engineering discipline: Git in a peer-reviewed pull request workflow, CI/CD, Docker, and a consistent standard of maintainable, well-documented code.   Ownership: A track record of taking problems from an unclear requirement to production and staying accountable after release.

data.title: Senior DevOps Engineer
data.description:
We're looking for a DevOps lead to own our AWS based infrastructure end to end and build out

the team around it. Today that means a small team and a clear scope. As we grow, this

becomes the foundation for a larger DevOps group, so we're looking for someone who can run

things hands-on now and help shape what the function becomes. 

What you'll own

Infrastructure, end to end: Multi-environment architecture, containers and orchestration, 

release pipelines, runtime reliability, and cloud cost. 

Reliability and SRE practice: SLOs that reflect what users actually experience, observability

that surfaces problems before customers report them, and an on-call rotation that doesn't burn

people out. You'll run an incident command when things break and lead the review afterward. 

We'd like our reliability numbers to improve under you - fewer incidents, faster recovery, less

firefighting. 

Automation: Identifying automation opportunities where there are repetition patterns: 

provisioning, deployments, environment creation, rollbacks, routine ops. The aim is a team that

spends its time building rather than repeating itself. 

AI-native operations: We want agents to be part of how the team works day to day, not a side

project. Incident triage and log analysis, IaC generation and review, cost anomaly detection, 

runbook execution. You'd decide what agents can do in production, what needs human

approval, and how their actions get logged. 

Infrastructure security. You'll work closely with our security engineering team, and the

infrastructure side is yours to execute: IAM and least privilege, secrets management, secure

Terraform defaults, security gates in CI/CD, patching and image lifecycle. You'll also be involved

when something in the infrastructure needs investigating. 

Team and direction. Hiring, growing and supporting a small team of DevOps engineers, plus

the infrastructure roadmap - what we build, what we buy, what we retire, and what it costs. 

What we're looking for

● 6-10 years in DevOps, SRE or platform engineering, including time leading a team

● You've owned a complete infrastructure boundary - horizontal platform or business

vertical, either works. What matters is that it was substantial, consumer-facing, and

carried real traffic

● Infrastructure at consumer scale: high-volume production systems with meaningful traffic

peaks, where downtime is visible to customers and latency is a product problem

● Strong hands-on AWS, Kubernetes, Terraform, CI/CD and observability tooling

● Hands-on security understanding of AWS infrastructure - IAM, KMS, Secrets Manager, 

network controls, secure IaC

● You've hired DevOps engineers and helped them grow

● You already use agentic tooling in your daily work and have shipped something with it in

a DevOps context

● You've owned a cloud bill and brought it down without hurting reliability

Nice to have

● GPU infrastructure: provisioning, scheduling, utilisation

● LLM gateway operations - routing, rate limits, cost attribution, provider failover

● Experience in a regulated environment (RBI digital lending, DPDP, PCI-DSS)

● You've scaled a DevOps function through a period of fast growth

How you'll work

You'll report to engineering leadership and work closely with product, backend and security. This

is a hands-on role.

data.title: AI-Native Developer (Sandbox)
data.description:
Experience: 2+ years

Core Technologies: TypeScript, JavaScript, React, SQL

Development Approach: AI-assisted software development

Role Summary

We are looking for an AI-native developer who uses AI coding tools as a primary part of the software development workflow. You should be able to turn a loosely defined idea into working, tested software quickly-and take full responsibility for the quality of the code, including code generated by AI. 

You will work directly with the owner in short feedback cycles, build and validate changes in a safe sandbox environment, and collaborate with a dedicated tester before any release. All live releases will remain under the owner's control. 

Who You Are

- AI-first by habit: You regularly build with AI coding agents such as Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot or similar tools, and know how to use them effectively on real codebases. 
 - A sharp reviewer: You treat AI-generated code like a junior developer's pull request. You inspect it, challenge assumptions, verify behaviour and catch plausible but incorrect output before it ships. 
 - An owner, not a ticket-taker: You turn loosely described needs into clear requirements, ask the important questions and deliver end to end without constant follow-up. 
 - Fast and careful: You deliver small changes quickly but never mark work complete until you have tested and verified it. 
 - Product-minded: You notice confusing screens, inaccurate labels and awkward workflows, and improve the user experience proactively. 
 - Honest about status: You communicate whether work is done, partly done, untested or broken, and raise risks early. 

Key Responsibilities

- Translate product ideas and business requirements into working web application features. 
 - Use AI coding agents to accelerate implementation, debugging, refactoring, test creation and documentation. 
 - Review AI-generated code for correctness, security, maintainability, performance and consistency with the existing codebase. 
 - Build and maintain web applications using TypeScript/JavaScript and React; use Next. js where appropriate. 
 - Work with SQL databases, understand schemas, write queries, prepare migrations and independently validate data. 
 - Use Git confidently, including branches, merges, conflict resolution and clean commits. 
 - Write automated tests for important logic and manually test complete user journeys across desktop, tablet and mobile. 
 - Verify user-facing details, including forms, buttons, labels, calculations and workflows. 
 - Provide concise change notes, test evidence and simple instructions for non-technical stakeholders. 
 - Build and validate changes in an approved sandbox environment. Do not deploy to live systems; releases remain under the owner's control. 

Required Skills And Experience

- At least 2 years of experience building and maintaining real-world web applications. 
 - Strong TypeScript/JavaScript and React skills; Next. js experience is an advantage. 
 - Solid SQL knowledge, including schema understanding, queries, migrations and data validation. 
 - Confident use of Git, including branches, merges, conflict resolution and clean commits. 
 - Practical experience using AI coding agents as a core development tool, with the ability to assess and verify their output. 
 - Strong testing habits, including automated tests for logic and hands-on checks across desktop, tablet and phone screen sizes. 
 - Clear written English, including concise change notes and instructions for non-technical users. 
 - Strong ownership, product judgement, attention to detail and transparent communication. 

Good to Have

- Experience creating prompts, rules or workflows that make AI agents more reliable for a team. 
 - Experience with billing, payments, bookings or other systems where incorrect calculations can have financial consequences. 
 - Familiarity with cloud hosting and managed databases such as Vercel, Supabase or similar services. 
 - Proficiency in Hindi or Gujarati. 

How You Will Work

- Work directly with the owner through short feedback cycles: idea → working version → feedback → completion. 
 - Develop and test changes in an approved sandbox environment. 
 - Collaborate with a dedicated Software Tester who validates changes before release. 
 - Communicate progress, limitations, test results and risks clearly, without overstating completion. 

How Success Will Be Measured

- Changes are accepted on the first review wherever requirements and scope are clear. 
 - No work is left half-finished or delivered with known, unreported breakages. 
 - Useful software is delivered consistently each week without compromising correctness, security or maintainability. 
 - AI-generated code is reviewed and verified, with appropriate tests and clear change notes accompanying each change. 

Selection Process

- 20-minute introductory call: Discuss what you have built and how you use AI coding tools in your day-to-day work. 
 - Short paid practical task: Fix real issues in a test copy using your preferred AI tools, add relevant tests and write a change note. 
 - Review discussion: Walk through your solution, demonstrate where the AI made mistakes and explain how you identified and corrected them. 

We value developers who build quickly, think critically, test thoroughly and take ownership of the final result.

data.title: Apprentice Software Engineer
data.description:
About thinkbridge

thinkbridge builds the business systems growing companies run on: ERP replacements, connected systems, AI agents inside real workflows and modernized legacy software. We have built custom software for growing companies for more than 12 years. 

Today we deliver every system with thinkOne, our method that pairs our experts with our agentic engineering and delivery platform. The platform writes much of the code. Our people understand the client's business, work out the right solution and take it to production. A typical system goes live in about four months. Our commitments to clients are written into the contract before a build starts. 

Why work at thinkbridge

- About 80% of the job is thinking and problem solving: the rest is building. 
 - Our clients stay with us for four to five years on average, so you get to know their business well. 
 - Part of the working week is set aside for learning, so it doesn't eat into your evenings. 
 - You can move into a different role inside thinkbridge. 
 - We are Great Place to Work Certified and have an employee NPS above 90. See what our people say and the industry firsts behind our certification. 

Benefits: 

Benefits built for remote-first work

- Work from office - Baner, Pune. 
 - Shape your day around your life, as long as the work lands on time. 
 - Take time off when you need it. 
 - Weeks when the team gets together in person to work side by side. 
 - Learning time in working hours, and paid certifications. 

Five values guide how we build for clients and how we work with each other: Outcomes, Quality, Accountability, Communication and Care. 

In practice: 

- We take software to production. 
 - We check our work before anyone else has to. 
 - We stand by our commitments. 
 - We keep people informed in plain language. 
 - We treat a problem as ours to solve. 

We hire curious people who own the outcome. Meet the team that leads thinkbridge. 

About Role: 

We are seeking an Apprentice Software Engineer with bachelor's degree in computer science / IT OR have completed a 6-month certification in Full Stack Development from a reputed institute (CDAC, NIIT, etc. ) with strong fundamentals in programming, databases, and with a passion for problem solving via technology. The role offers hands-on experience, learning opportunities, and growth in software development and technology projects. 

Criteria For applying

Must have skills

- Must have Bachelor's degree in Engineering (CS OR IT) or completed a 6-month certification in Full Stack Development from a reputed institute (CDAC, NIIT, etc. ). 
 - Knowledge of Flowcharts, Pseudocode, basic algorithms, and SQL. 
 - Adaptive learner with the ability to pick up new technologies quickly. 
 - Strong analytical thinking, effective communication, and professional behaviour. 
 - Ability to explain final year project or any prior project works. 

Good to have skills

- Internship experience of 3-6 months. 
 - Familiarity with source control and code management. 
 - Any Professional certification in Full Stack. 
 - Strong written and verbal communication skills. 

Selection process: 

- Fundamental Assessment (30 Mins) - In office (Pen and paper test). 
 - Technical Exercise (60 Mins) - In office. 
 - HR Round. 

Program Overview: 

Selected candidates will undergo a 6-week assessment program at our Pune office. 

- Each week, candidates will undergo assessments around (SQL Server, . NET, C#, Angular) and based on their scores; they will either progress to the next stage or be discontinued from the program if the scores are below the required level. 
 - The program will run for the first two weeks from Monday to Saturday, 8: 00 AM to 8: 00 PM IST. After this period, the schedule will change, and the updated timings will be communicated in advance. 
 - After completing the 6-week program, candidates will attend a technical interview. Upon successfully clearing all assessments and the interview, they will receive an offer of 7. 5LPA. 

Service Agreement: 

- This role requires a minimum 3-year commitment with thinkbridge. (No documents/agreement signed or submitted, it's just a commitment). 

Probation: 

- After receiving the offer, you will begin a 6-months' probation period. 
 - During this time, you will gain hands-on experience working on real-world projects. 
 - You will also benefit from guidance and mentorship from experienced professionals to accelerate your growth. Note: There will be no reimbursement from the company for your travel and accommodation. After completing the program and probation, candidates will be required to work from office. 

New graduates

thinkSchool is where graduates start their careers at thinkbridge. 

Equal opportunity

thinkbridge is an equal opportunity employer. We hire on skills and character, and we treat every applicant fairly.
