data.title: Software Engineer
data.description:
About AlgoHire

AlgoHire is a technology company that designs, builds and operates digital platforms for hiring, skilling and public-sector workforce programmes. We partner with government departments and enterprises on large-scale systems, from citizen-facing portals to AI-driven recruitment products. 

One of our current engagements is Kaushalam, a state-wide employment and skilling platform we engineer and operate end to end: job matching, learning management and certification, running on event-driven services. 

About the role

- Position: Software Engineer
 - Experience: 0-2 years
 - Location: HyderabadAn engineering role with a strong product side. You'll work close to the people using the product, turn their needs into clear requirements, and take them all the way to production. 

Responsibilities

- Join discussions with government and partner teams, and turn their needs into structured requirements and technical plans. 
 - Build features across React, TypeScript, Node. js, Express and PostgreSQL. 
 - Work on event-driven services using Kafka, BullMQ and Redis. 
 - Contribute to AI features built on LLM APIs. 
 - Integrate with identity providers, third-party APIs, email and WhatsApp. 
 - Deploy with Docker on AWS (EC2, S3, ECR) and data centre infrastructure, and fix production issues. 
 - Follow features after release and feed what you learn back into the product. 

Technical requirements

- Strong JavaScript and TypeScript, including async/await, promises and the event loop. 
 - React with Vite, React Router, TanStack Query, Zustand and React Hook Form. 
 - Tailwind CSS, shadcn/ui and Radix UI for clean, responsive interfaces. 
 - REST APIs in Node. js and Express, with Zod, JWT authentication. 
 - PostgreSQL, Prisma/Drizzle, data modelling. 
 - Redis for caching and BullMQ for job queues. 
 - Docker and Docker Compose for multi-service setups. 
 - Git and GitHub workflows, and Postman for API testing. 
 - Comfort on the Linux command line and with web security fundamentals. 
 - Ability to explain how a system's parts interact and what happens when one fails. 

Product and delivery skills

- Owning work from scoping to release, and checking it works for users afterwards. 
 - Explaining trade-offs and timelines in plain language to non-technical people. 
 - Using AI coding tools like Claude Code or Cursor, and verifying what they produce. 
 - Experience on real projects with live users, or clients who relied on your work. 

Good to have

Exposure to Kafka, LLM APIs, AWS, Next. js, GitHub Actions, or Jest and Playwright. If you haven't touched these yet, you'll learn them here. 

What you will gain

- Senior engineers who review your code and pair with you on hard problems. 
 - Production work from day one, on platforms people use every day. 
 - Full stack exposure, from interface to deployment. 
 - A fast track into event-driven systems, cloud infrastructure and applied AI. 

Who should apply

You're a fresher with energy to spare: you build after hours, learn fast and get restless when work sits unshipped. You'll fit right in if: 

- You've shipped something people used, and fixed it when it broke. 
 - You've gone past a CRUD app: background jobs, auth, caching, migrations, slow queries. 
 - You can take a half-formed idea and run with it. 
 - You use AI tools to move faster, but understand every line you ship. 
 - You want a small team, quick feedback and real ownership. 

College project, internship or weekend build, it all counts. What's on your GitHub matters more than your degree.

data.title: Internal Audit Manager - Ops and Quality Assurance
data.description:
About Us

We're Reckitt, home to the world's best loved and trusted hygiene and health brands. Our purpose defines why we exist: to protect, heal and nurture in the relentless pursuit of a cleaner, healthier world. We are a global team united by this purpose. 

Join us in our fight to make access to the highest quality hygiene, wellness, and nourishment a right and not a privilege. 

About Global Business Services

Behind our iconic power brands that touch millions of lives daily - from Dettol and Lysol to Durex and Nurofen - lies a dynamic and vital engine: Reckitt's Global Business Services (GBS). Fuelled by a culture of positive energy and co-creativity - while learning together - OneReckitt GBS is at the forefront of our business, driving efficiency, standardisation, and innovation across our global operations. We're a fast-paced, purposeful team, constantly seeking to optimise our processes, leverage cutting-edge technology, and deliver exceptional value to every corner of Reckitt. We're not a traditional back-office function; we're a strategic powerhouse where diverse individuals with bright minds come together to solve complex challenges, shape future capabilities, and build a better global business that directly helps achieve Reckitt's mission. 

About The Role

As the Internal Audit Manager - Operations & Quality Assurance within Reckitt's Global Internal Audit Centre of Excellence, you will play a critical leadership role in shaping best‐in‐class audit delivery, strengthening methodology, and driving continuous improvement across the global audit function. Reporting to the Head of the COE, you will oversee global audit operations, lead the function's Quality Assurance programme, and ensure consistent application of audit standards, practices, and tools. 

You will directly manage a diverse team of audit delivery, data analytics, and IT&D professionals, building capability and embedding progressive ways of working. You will also collaborate closely with Audit Leaders and Domain Leads to enhance execution quality, drive operational excellence, and contribute to the digital enablement of the audit function. This is a highly visible role, central to ensuring that Internal Audit delivers impactful, value‐adding assurance across all regions and processes. 

Your responsibilities

- Oversee day-to-day Internal Audit operations, ensuring effective planning, resourcing, and delivery. 
 - Maintain and enhance audit methodologies, templates, standards, and governance processes. 
 - Support annual audit planning, resource management, portfolio oversight, and performance reporting. 
 - Develop dashboards and reporting to monitor audit progress, quality, and operational metrics. 
 - Partner with Data Analytics teams to drive digital enablement and operational efficiency. 
 - Lead the Quality Assurance & Improvement Program, ensuring compliance with audit methodology and standards. 
 - Conduct quality reviews and provide feedback to strengthen audit effectiveness and consistency. 
 - Support external assessments and continuous improvement initiatives across the audit function. 
 - Analyze quality trends, root causes, and performance insights to drive improvement actions. 
 - Lead, coach, and develop audit, data analytics, and IT&D team members within the COE. 
 - Support onboarding, training, capability building, and professional development programs. 
 - Foster a high-performance culture focused on collaboration, innovation, and continuous learning. 
 - Partner with Audit Leaders, Domain Leads, and stakeholders to ensure consistent audit delivery. 
 - Communicate operational insights, QA outcomes, and recommendations to senior management. 
 - Support management and audit committee reporting with relevant performance and quality metrics. 
 - Drive adoption of analytics, automation, digital tools, and innovative audit practices. 
 - Pilot and implement new methodologies, technologies, and process improvements. 
 - Contribute to initiatives that enhance audit effectiveness, efficiency, and overall value delivery. 

The experience we're looking for

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Accounting, Finance, Business, Engineering, or related field. 
 - Professional certifications such as CIA, CPA, CA, CISA, or Lean Six Sigma (preferred). 
 - 8-12 years of Internal Audit experience, with strong exposure to operational audits and audit quality reviews. 
 - Demonstrated experience in global or matrixed organisations, ideally within FMCG/Consumer Health or comparable industries. 
 - Strong understanding of IIA Standards, audit methodology, risk assessment, process evaluation, and quality principles. 
 - Proven ability to lead teams, coach others, and foster a high‐performance culture. 
 - Strong stakeholder management and influencing skills across diverse geographies. 
 - Comfortable working with ERP systems (SAP/JDE) and analytics/visualisation tools (Power BI desirable). 

The skills for success

- Data Analytics & Insights
 - Audit & Risk Management
 - Data Extraction & Transformation
 - Data Visualization & Reporting
 - Data Governance & Quality Management
 - Automation & Continuous Monitoring
 - Critical Thinking & Problem Solving
 - Stakeholder Management
 - Communication & Data Storytelling
 - Project & Delivery Management

What we offer

With inclusion at the heart of everything we do, working alongside our four global Employee Resource Groups, we support our people at every step of their career journey, helping them to succeed in their own individual way. 

We invest in the wellbeing of our people through parental benefits, an Employee Assistance Program to promote mental health, and life insurance for all employees globally. We have a range of other benefits in line with the local market. Through our global share plans we offer the opportunity to save and share in Reckitt's potential future successes. For eligible roles, we also offer short-term incentives to recognise, appreciate and reward your work for delivering outstanding results. You will be rewarded in line with Reckitt's pay for performance philosophy. 

Equality

We recognise that in real life, great people don't always 'tick all the boxes'. That's why we hire for potential as well as experience. Even if you don't meet every point on the job description, if this role and our company feels like a good fit for you, we still want to hear from you. 

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, disability or medical condition; colour, ethnicity, race, citizenship, and national origin; religion, faith; pregnancy, family status and caring responsibilities; sexual orientation; sex, gender identity, gender expression, and transgender identity; protected veteran status; size or any other basis protected by appropriate law.

data.description:
Secure Every Identity, from AI to Human

Identity is the key to unlocking the potential of AI. Okta secures AI by building the trusted, neutral infrastructure that enables organizations to safely embrace this new era. This work requires a relentless drive to solve complex challenges with real-world stakes. We are looking for builders and owners who operate with speed and urgency and execute with excellence. 

This is an opportunity to do career-defining work. We're all in on this mission. If you are too, let's talk. 

  

Staff Software Engineer, Platform & InfrastructureTagline: Build the engine that builds Okta. 

🚀 Your Mission: Define the Future of Developer Velocity at OktaAre you a software engineer who believes that an exceptional developer platform is the key to unlocking engineering-wide innovation? Are you obsessed with building the high-leverage tools, services, and automated infrastructure that make building, testing, and deploying software a seamless experience?

Okta's Platform & Infrastructure team is the central nervous system for all of Okta Engineering. We build and own the entire internal developer platform-the CI/CD pipelines, the build-and-test orchestration, and the multi-cloud infrastructure that powers it all. 

This isn't just about maintaining systems. It's about building a scalable, resilient, and blazing-fast "paved road" that empowers hundreds of engineers to ship high-quality code, multiple times a day. 

Our scale is immense. We run tens of thousands of automated tests for every single commit. As Okta grows, this CI/CD workload presents a monumental engineering challenge. 

Your primary goal will be to attack this problem head-on. You will be a key builder  in our quest to shrink massive, distributed compute jobs from hours or days down to just minutes. This role requires deep systems thinking, clever orchestration, and a passion for wringing every last drop of performance out of the infrastructure. 

💻 What You'll Do (The Impact)As a Staff Engineer, you are a technical leader, architect, and hands-on builder. You will: 

- Architect & Build: Design, code, and operate the next generation of our CI/CD platform, primarily using Go (Golang) and Python. 
 - Master Kubernetes: Leverage your deep Kubernetes (K8s) expertise to orchestrate our complex and ephemeral build, test, and deployment workflows at massive scale. 
 - Own the Multi-Cloud: Build services and automation that abstract and manage workloads extensively across AWS, GCP, and Azure, optimizing for cost, speed, and reliability. 
 - Build a Platform, Not Just Tools: Create robust, self-service, and elegant internal products for our engineers. You'll treat our internal developers as your first-class customers. 
 - Drive Innovation: You will not just use our build and CI systems, you will be responsible for building and scaling them. 
 - Mentor & Lead: Collaborate with peers, mentor other engineers, and set the technical direction for major platform initiatives. ✅ What You'll Bring (The Requirements)We are looking for a seasoned engineer who has built and scaled internal platforms before. 

- 5+ years of experience in Software Engineering  
 - Coding Skills: You are a strong software engineer first, with proven experience building and maintaining complex systems in Go (Golang) and/or Python. 
 - Kubernetes is a Must: You have deep, practical experience building, running, and troubleshooting workloads on Kubernetes. You understand pods, operators, scheduling, and networking inside and out. 
 - CI/CD as a Platform: You have architected, built, and/or significantly scaled CI/CD pipelines (e. g. , Jenkins, GitLab, Tekton, ArgoCD) as a platform for other engineers, not just as an end-user. 
 - Cloud Expertise: You have demonstrable experience working in major cloud providers (AWS, GCP, Azure) and understand the nuances of their core services. 
 - The Platform Ecosystem: You're fluent in the tools of the trade: Docker, container registries (like Artifactory), and modern build systems (like Gradle or Bazel). 
 - Platform Mindset: You are customer-obsessed (your customers are other engineers) and have a proven ability to lead complex, cross-functional projects to completion. 
 - Education: B. S. in Computer Science, equivalent technical experience, or just a proven track record of shipping incredible systems. L1-Hybrid

Your journey begins with an immersive, in-person onboarding experience designed to accelerate your impact and connect you to our mission and team from day one.

data.description:
About Officeworks: 

Officeworks' purpose is "we bring big ideas to life at low prices". It's how we create shared value for customers, team members, suppliers, communities and shareholders. 

We are Australia's leading omnichannel retailer of complete technology solutions, stationery, furniture, art supplies, and learning resources. We also offer services including Print & Create, and Geeks2U. 

Our products and services provide solutions to our diverse range of customers across Australia from households, students, small to large sized businesses, governments and schools. 

Our culture is built on beginning with customer, doing the right thing, executing with accountability, and leading with ambition. We are one team who are proud to "wear the blues" and deliver for our customers. 

We are an inclusive, forward-thinking organization where diverse perspectives enable innovation, continuous improvement and better outcomes for our customers and teams. The work we do plays an important role in helping Australians work, learn, create and connect. 

The role: 

Title: Senior AI Engineer

Function: Technology

Location: Bengaluru

About the Technology Function: 

By joining the Technology team in the GCC you will play a direct role in Officeworks' global digital transformation, contributing to world-class capabilities that sit at the heart of how the business operates and grows. The GCC will support Officeworks' purpose of helping to bring big ideas to life at low prices, ensuring technology remains a true enabler of customer value and operational excellence. 

This opportunity to join as a founding member of the new global hub is a chance to be part of the original build-out of our GCC. Early joiners will influence how the hub operates and help shape the future state of some of Officeworks' core technology ecosystem. 

These roles are best suited for people who enjoy: 

- exposure to eCommerce and digital platforms, customer facing services enabled online and in retail stores, and an expanding presence into generative and agentic commerce - covering operations, security, development, automation, and solution architecture
 - supporting global initiatives and modernising business critical systems
 - being the forefront of global innovation and transformation, helping digitize the Officeworks business
 - joining a place where your skills matter, your growth is intentional, and your work has visible impact on business outcomes. 

Why this role exists: 

The Senior AI Engineer sits inside a Customer Platforms pod and orchestrates the technical agents that produce code, tests, documentation and design artefacts. The role is a full stack engineering role that takes complete ownership of the quality engineering and testing, holding accountability for everything committed to production. 

The role exists to translate product specifications into functional agent tasks, maintain the human-in-the-loop review gate, and ensure system design integrity, non-functional performance and security standards are met. It plays a critical role in enabling continuous delivery across Customer Platforms while mentoring junior engineers and continuously improving agent workflows across pods. 

Where you will make a difference: 

In this role you will: 

Agent Orchestration and Execution: 

- Decompose Product Orchestrator specifications into functional tasks for technical agents. 
 - Run multiple agents in parallel across coding, test generation, documentation and design workflows. 
 - Sequence workstreams and manage technical dependencies to maintain high pod delivery velocity. 
 - Apply base context, security policies and platform standards to every agent execution cycle. 

Quality Control and Commit Gate: 

- Hold the human-in-the-loop review and commit gate independently on complex and high-risk change. 
 - Perform fast, accurate code and test reviews to ensure correctness, specification alignment and standards conformance. 
 - Owns end-to-end quality assurance accountability by designing agent test coverage and evaluation logic. 
 - Own defect management for the pod, from identification through root cause and resolution tracking, escalating systemic quality risks. 
 - Identify when agent workflows are insufficient and apply direct engineering intervention to resolve technical issues. 

System Design and Non-Functional Excellence: 

- Own architectural fit and system design judgement across the features delivered by the pod. 
 - Ensure non-functional outcomes, including performance, scalability, resilience and security, are met across all releases. 
 - Lead production incident resolution within the pod across touched platform domains. 
 - Contribute to domain design decisions as a consulted partner to the Solution Architects. 

Knowledge Governance and Workflow Improvement: 

- Maintain accurate, up-to-date documentation and knowledge artefacts to serve as context layers for future agent runs. 
 - Feed refined domain context back to central repositories in collaboration with Context Engineers. 
 - Continuously refine and optimize agent workflows and share best practices across engineering pods. 
 - Mentor engineers on test design, defect triage and quality engineering practice across the pod. 

Who you will be working with: 

- Pod Leadership and Delivery Teams: Partner with Product Orchestrators and fellow pod engineers to refine requirements, assess technical feasibility and execute workstreams. 
 - Architecture Teams: Consult with Domain Architects and Solution Architects on domain design, system architecture and escalation pathways. 
 - Capability and Platform Specialists: Collaborate with Context Engineers, Associate AI Agent Evaluation Engineers and Associate Platform Engineers to align on shared context, security standards and tooling. 
 - Vendor and Platform Partners: Liaise with external AI tooling providers and vendor technical support to resolve complex platform constraints and adopt new capabilities. 

What success looks like: 

- Commit Gate Integrity: Low commit gate escape rate on complex and high-risk production changes. 
 - Innovation and Scaling: Agent workflow improvements developed within the pod are successfully adopted across broader engineering teams. 
 - Operational Resilience: Rapid resolution of production incidents within the pod with minimal downtime or customer impact. 
 - Delivery Velocity: High throughput of automated coding and testing tasks achieved without compromising technical quality or architectural standards. 
 - Demonstrates behaviours aligned to Officeworks' values, contributing to a respectful, inclusive and high-performing culture. 

How you will lead: 

Individual Contributor

- Lives our Officeworks values and behaviours
 - Proactively contributes to a safe working environment, escalates appropriately if there are unsafe conditions or inappropriate behaviour
 - Operates in line with applicable Officeworks company policies and Code of Conduct
 - Demonstrates a strong sense of personal accountability and curiosity to learn and develop
 - Contributes to an inclusive and respectful environment where diverse perspectives are valued and everyone feels safe to speak up and belong

Our Values: 

Our values shape the way we work, our behaviours and how we interact with each other, our customers, suppliers and communities. 

We begin with customer: 

- We start with our customer' needs in every decision. 
 - We offer simple, helpful and affordable solutions. 
 - We listen, learn and continuously improve. 

We do the right thing: 

- We lead with integrity and care for our team communities and planet. 
 - We work together safely and treat everyone with respect, inclusion, and trust. 
 - We collaborate across teams and think Officeworks-wide. 

We execute with accountability: 

- We are accountable for our decisions, actions, results, and mistakes. 
 - We stay across the details and focus on delivering what matters. 
 - We move with pace and agility to deliver outcomes. 

We lead with ambition: 

- We set bold ambitions that help us to win and transform. 
 - We are courageous with new ideas. 
 - We focus on transformation, not incremental steps.

data.description:
Introduction

Job title: Senior DevOps / SRE Automation Engineer

Location: Bangalore

Experience: 5-10 years

The opportunity

You will work on world-class retail supply chain solutions, deploying and running enterprise applications, including GPU-powered AI/ML products, on Azure and Oracle Cloud. These applications run 24/7 and are business-critical: warehouses and stores depend on them for daily operations. In this cloud and SRE role, you will own their reliability: defining and meeting SLOs, responding fast to incidents, troubleshooting end to end, and engineering out recurring problems through automation. 

The opportunity

You will work on world-class retail supply chain solutions, deploying and running enterprise applications, including GPU-powered AI/ML products, on Azure and Oracle Cloud (OCI). These applications run 24/7 and are business-critical: warehouses and stores depend on them for daily operations. In this DevOps and SRE automation role, you will build the automation that keeps them running: infrastructure as code, CI/CD pipelines, self-healing workflows, and internal tools that remove manual effort from deployments, maintenance, and incident response, so the team can support more customers with less toil. 

Key Responsibilities

We are seeking a Senior DevOps / SRE Automation Engineer to join our growing team. In this role, you will: 

- Build automation that removes manual effort (toil) for the SRE team running business-critical retail supply chain applications on Azure and Oracle Cloud. 
 - Build reusable Terraform modules and Ansible roles to provision networks, VMs, containers, VPN, ExpressRoute, and FastConnect consistently. 
 - Build CI/CD pipelines (e. g. , Jenkins, GitHub Actions, or Azure DevOps) for infrastructure, Docker, and TomEE/Java releases, with automated testing, canary or blue-green deployments, and rollback. 
 - Build self-healing and auto-remediation workflows triggered by monitoring alerts (Prometheus, Grafana, Zabbix), such as service restarts, failover, disk cleanup, and scaling. 
 - Convert manual runbooks into tested, version-controlled automation and Python tools. 
 - Automate routine operations: OS patching, certificate renewal, backup checks, and Cloudflare and HAProxy changes. 
 - Automate on-demand builds of new customer and non-production environments. 
 - Integrate monitoring, ticketing, and on-call tools (e. g. , ServiceNow, PagerDuty, Microsoft Teams) through APIs for automated ticketing, alert enrichment, and ChatOps. 
 - Embed security into automation: secrets management (Azure Key Vault, OCI Vault, or HashiCorp Vault), policy as code, drift detection, and pipeline scanning. 
 - Measure toil and automation impact, prioritize work with the SRE team, and support major incidents as a business-hours escalation point. 

Job Description

Key criteria

Must-have

- 5-10 years in DevOps, SRE, cloud infrastructure, or platform engineering, including at least 3 years building automation for production workloads on Azure or OCI. 
 - Good Python and Bash skills, with Python used beyond one-off scripts (reusable tools, API integrations, or cloud SDK/CLI automation). 
 - Hands-on Terraform (modules, remote state) and Ansible (roles, playbooks) in production environments. 
 - Hands-on CI/CD pipeline design and maintenance with Jenkins, GitHub Actions, or Azure DevOps, using Git branching, code review, and release workflows. 
 - Solid hands-on experience with Azure or OCI (compute, storage, networking, and IAM); hybrid connectivity such as VPN, ExpressRoute, or FastConnect is a plus. 
 - Strong Linux administration (RHEL, Ubuntu) and hands-on Docker experience, including building and managing container images. 
 - Experience with monitoring and observability tools (e. g. , Prometheus, Grafana, Zabbix, or ELK), including using alerts to trigger automated actions. 
 - Understanding of production support and SRE practices (incident management, toil reduction, SLOs); exposure to HAProxy, Java on TomEE/Tomcat, or Oracle Database is an advantage. 

Good-to-have

- Kubernetes and Helm, or GitOps tools such as Argo CD or Flux. 
 - Image building with Packer, and infrastructure testing or scanning with tools such as Terratest, Molecule, or Checkov. 
 - Runbook or event-driven automation platforms (e. g. , Azure Automation, OCI Functions, Rundeck, or Ansible Automation Platform). 
 - Cloudflare automation through its API or Terraform provider (DNS, WAF, CDN, caching rules). 
 - Go or another compiled language, and exposure to AIOps, ChatOps, or using AI to accelerate automation. 
 - Certifications (Azure, OCI, AWS, HashiCorp Terraform, or Kubernetes CKA/CKAD) and exposure to GPU-based compute for AI/ML workloads. 
 - Retail or supply chain domain exposure, and strong written and verbal communication. 

About Us

Growth opportunities

- Opportunity to shape the automation and platform engineering roadmap for a 24/7 multi-cloud production environment. 
 - Scope to deepen expertise in Oracle Cloud (OCI), Azure, infrastructure as code, and CI/CD at scale. 
 - Opportunity for cross-skilling (retail products, SRE, Kubernetes, GitOps, AIOps, and company AI trainings) and enhancing skills to stay competitive in the future. 

Our values

Our values guide how we work with our customers and with each other. 

- Customer focus
 - Innovation at speed
 - Targeted focus
 - Team unity

Join us

SymphonyAI is a global leader in Vertical AI platforms. Our Eureka AI platform helps enterprises solve their most complex, high-value challenges across retail and consumer goods, financial services, industrial, and enterprise IT. 

Our retail division helps retailers and CPG manufacturers drive profitable growth with AI-powered solutions for demand forecasting, merchandising, supply chain, and store operations. Learn more at www. symphonyai. com.

The Observability team within Global Technology Platform at Walmart helps ensure the reliability, performance, and health of large-scale data platforms. By managing core observability capabilities-including logs, metrics, and traces-the team provides engineering teams with the visibility needed to monitor distributed systems, detect issues quickly, troubleshoot problems, and improve platform performance. 

Distinguished Engineer - Observability will define and drive the technical vision for observability at a massive scale. This is a senior technical leadership role for an engineer with deep expertise in distributed tracing and observability across complex, large-scale systems. This role will provide enterprise-level technical leadership for instrumentation, monitoring, and observability solutions that improve the reliability, performance, and operability of Walmart's technology ecosystem. 

You will work on some of the most complex Observability challenges in the industry, including high availability, scalability, reliability, performance engineering, automation, and operational excellence. As a Distinguished Engineer, you will operate as a hands-on technical leader, influencing platform strategy, guiding architectural decisions, mentoring senior engineers, and partnering closely with application teams to design and operate complex, high-scale systems. You will help build sophisticated tooling and platforms on top of open-source and commercial observability technologies, tailoring them to Walmart's scale, reliability, security, and developer productivity needs. 

What You'll Do

Define and drive Walmart's technical strategy for distributed tracing, observability architecture, instrumentation, and service health. 

Establish scalable architectural patterns for tracing and observability across complex distributed systems. 

Lead the design and evolution of high-performance, cloud-native backend services and APIs using Java, Golang, or Rust. 

Set technical direction for end-to-end service ownership, including architecture, implementation, testing, deployment, reliability, scalability, and operational excellence. 

Advance the use of OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, and Grafana to improve visibility into application and infrastructure behavior. 

Build and influence sophisticated tooling, automation, and platform capabilities that improve platform reliability, performance, observability, developer productivity, and operational simplicity. 

Partner with application engineering teams to design, review, and optimize observability architectures for complex distributed systems and high-throughput workloads. 

Establish technical standards, best practices, reference architectures, and operational patterns for observability usage across the organization. 

Influence senior engineering leaders, architects, product teams, and business stakeholders by clearly communicating technical strategy, trade-offs, risks, and execution plans. 

Mentor principal, Staff and senior engineers, raising the technical bar across observability engineering, distributed systems, performance engineering, and production operations. 

What You'll Bring

Bachelor's or master's degree in computer science, engineering, or a related technical field. 

18+ years of experience in software engineering, with a record of delivering large-scale distributed systems and platform architectures. 

Deep expertise in distributed tracing, observability, instrumentation, and monitoring for complex software environments. 

Proven experience designing and developing high-performance backend services and APIs using Java, Golang, or Rust. 

Demonstrated ownership of services across the full lifecycle, including architecture, implementation, testing, deployment, operations, reliability, scalability, and continuous improvement. 

Strong knowledge of observability practices and technologies, including OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, and Grafana. 

Experience using logs, metrics, and traces to improve system understanding, performance, and operational outcomes. 

Experience building automation, tooling, or platform capabilities around open-source or commercial database systems. 

Proven ability to define technical strategy, drive architecture across teams, and influence large-scale engineering direction without relying solely on formal authority. 

Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain complex database and platform concepts to senior technical and non-technical stakeholders. 

Strong track record of mentoring engineers, reviewing architecture, and raising engineering standards across a large organization. 

About Walmart Global Tech

Imagine working in an environment where one line of code can make life easier for hundreds of millions of people. That's what we do at Walmart Global Tech. We're a team of software engineers, data scientists, cybersecurity expert's and service professionals within the world's leading retailer who make an epic impact and are at the forefront of the next retail disruption. People are why we innovate, and people power our innovations. We are people-led and tech-empowered. 

We train our team in the skillsets of the future and bring in experts like you to help us grow. We have roles for those chasing their first opportunity as well as those looking for the opportunity that will define their career. Here, you can kickstart a great career in tech, gain new skills and experience for virtually every industry, or leverage your expertise to innovate at scale, impact millions and reimagine the future of retail. 

Work

Walmart's culture sets us apart, and we know being together helps us innovate, learn and grow great careers. This role is based in our Bangalore office for daily work, with the flexibility for associates to manage their personal lives.

Beyond our great compensation package, you can receive incentive awards for your performance. Other great perks include a host of best-in-class benefits maternity and parental leave, PTO, health benefits, and much more. 

Belonging

We aim to create a culture where every associate feels valued for who they are, rooted in respect for the individual. Our goal is to foster a sense of belonging, to create opportunities for all our associates, customers and suppliers, and to be a Walmart for everyone.

Our associates and customers reflect the makeup of all 19 countries where we operate. By making Walmart a welcoming place where all people feel like they belong, we're able to engage associates, strengthen our business, improve our ability to serve customers, and support the communities where we operate.

data.title: Software Engineer
data.description:
About Oren

We help companies collect, measure, validate and report their ESG data. 

ESG (Environment, Social and Governance) data is hard to collate, measure and improve. There are about 500 to 1000 different data points to consider - all of which live across the company's departments like HR, sales, procurement, operations, finance etc. Our platform automatically collects and makes sense of the data in real-time. We also give companies a real-time view of their progress against their sustainability goals. The automation also helps in eliminating the errors due to manual entry. 

Job Details

- Designation: Software Engineer
 - Experience: 2-4 years
 - Employment type: Full-time
 - Work mode: On-site, 5 days a week from the office
 - Working days: Monday to Friday
 - Location: Baner, Pune
 - Compensation: ₹12-18 LPA ( depends on your expereince)

About the Opportunity

We are a small, agile team building out a world-class sustainability data management platform. We're looking for a full-stack engineer with 2-4 years of experience, in person at our office in Baner, Pune. 

You'll own a slice of the product - e. g. supplier assessments or emissions calculations - with your scope of ownership increasing as you prove your ability to handle complex business problems. Ownership means understanding the customer's problem, deciding what ships and pushing back when the requirements don't make sense. 

We're an AI-native engineering team. Our monorepo ships with custom Claude Code plugins, including skills that formalize how we conduct ticket shaping, PR reviews, etc. 

Responsibilities

- Own feature areas end to end: the customer's why, the plan, the build, the tests, the release, and how it gets used. 
 - Work across the stack: Next. js, Radix and Tailwind on the front end, Express and tRPC on the server, Prisma and PostgreSQL for data. 
 - Drive agentic coding tools hard, and review their output as rigorously as a colleague's pull request. 
 - Keep calculation logic correct. ESG numbers get audited, so "mostly right" is not right. 
 - Own your deployments, debugging and performance work; our CI/CD is yours to improve. 

Requirements

- 2-4 years building and shipping production software. 
 - You use an agentic coding tool daily (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, whichever) and could write the code yourself. That is why we trust your review. 
 - Strong TypeScript and SQL; equally at home in Node. js and React/Next. js. 
 - [Critical] You work from an ambiguous brief, ask what the user actually needs, write the plan before the code, and can explain your trade-offs. 
 - Clear writing - plans and PR descriptions people can act on. 

Nice to Have

- A track record of building things people actually used. 
 - You have built your own tooling: scripts, skills, agents, CLIs. 
 - Interest in climate, sustainability or a regulated domain. 

How to Apply

If you want to own real problems end to end, email mansi@orennow. com with your resume and links to projects you've built that you're proud of.

data.title: Full Stack Developer
data.description:
About the Platform

The Digital Office Platform is a multi-tenant, configuration-driven government case-management platform that lets many independent government bodies each configure their own case lifecycle

- data model, intakeforms, versioned workflows, roles, SLAs, notifications, audit and reporting
 - and run real cases end-to-end withoutcustom code per tenant. It is built as ~20 independent Spring Boot microservices (engines), each owning its own PostgreSQL database, coordinated behind a Next. js web application, and deployed hosting-agnostic on sovereign/ government cloud using open-source components. Tenant isolationis by tenant_id; published workflow versions are immutable and live cases pin to their version; security and data boundaries fail closed. 

Role and Responsibilities

- Develop and enhance backend engines in Java 21 and Spring Boot 3. 3 (Spring Data JPA / Hibernate, SpringSecurity + JWT), following the shared clean-architecture layering (api → application → domain → infrastructure), the standard { success, data } response envelope and the domain-exception pattern used across the fleet. 
 - Build and extend core engine capabilities - business objects(dynamic object types, fields and JSONB records with versioning and audit), dynamic forms, versioned workflows and tasks, rules / decision tables, documents, notifications, search, reporting, dashboards, scheduler and integrations - as configuration-driven features. 
 - Develop web services and REST APIs with auto-generated OpenAPI (SpringDoc) docs, and build typed, fail-closed inter-engine clients; respect database-per-engine ownership (no cross-engine database reads - consume curated, tenant-scoped HTTP datasets). 
 - Develop the web application in Next. js 16 / React 19 with TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Zustand, react-hook-form + zod and recharts - dynamic tenant-configured forms, workflow and case screens, dashboards and the per-engine service/ API-client layer, serving all four actor classes. 
 - Implement and uphold tenant-scoped persistence: every query carries a bound tenant predicate, identifiers are allow-listed and never string-interpolated, and sensitive provider secrets are handled via the platform's encrypted, fail-closed mechanisms. 
 - Author Flyway migrations for the production path and keep the entity model, repositories and schema consistent; use UUID identifiers and per-engine schemasper the established conventions. 
 - Integrate third-party and government services (SMS / email / SSO / payment / external APIs) throughthe integration enginewith retry, circuit-breaker and data-transformation patterns; wire Redis caching and Apache Kafka event flows for cross-engine reactions (notifications, indexing, audit). 
 - Apply AI-assisted code reviewand technical enhancements; write unit and integration tests, participate in code reviews, and uphold secure-by-design and fail-closed coding practices. 
 - Work across the completeSDLC - functional and technicalspecifications, documentation, QA support, source control, maintenance and deployments. 

Qualifications and Experiences

- Bachelor's degreein any discipline with 3+ years of experience in full-stack web application development using Java / Spring Boot and React / Next. js. Required Skill Set

- Strong proficiency in Java 21, Spring Boot 3. 3, Hibernate / JPA, SpringSecurity + JWT, and REST web-service development with OpenAPI. 
 - Proficiency in Next. js/ React, TypeScript, HTML, CSS, JavaScript, Tailwind, Zustand and react-hook-form + zod. 
 - Solid working experience with relational databases (PostgreSQL 16), JSONBand GIN indexing, and version-control tools (Git). 
 - Understandingof microservice architecture and integration, multi-tenant isolation, clean / layered architecture, and configuration / metadata-driven design. 
 - Familiarity with Redis, Apache Kafka, Docker, and performance (JMeter/ Gatling), functional, unit and integration testing. 
 - Awareness of W3C / GIGW and accessibility guidelines and of Agile delivery. Desirable SkillSet

- Experience with workflow / BPM and rules engines(Camunda, Flowable, Drools). 
 - Experience buildingdynamic form / metadata-driven systemsand document / search/ notification subsystems. 

- Experience using AI-assisted development and code-review tools.

 - Demonstrated experience building data pipelines from financial or ERP source systems - JD Edwards (JDE) directly preferred, with EcoSys or Microsoft Dynamics also relevant - into a governed lakehouse or warehouse, including general ledger, cost, and project financial data. 
 - Experience connecting operational and financial data to core business reporting within a construction, EPC, energy, or other asset-heavy industry (e. g. , cost-to-complete, earned value management, project P&L). 
 - Prior experience in a hybrid onshore/offshore delivery model (dedicated onshore lead plus offshore engineering pod), ideally in the offshore lead role. 
 - Demonstrated experience leading or co-leading agile delivery teams, including sprint planning, backlog grooming, and daily standups. 
 - Strong written and verbal English communication skills, including the ability to lead meetings and discussions directly with onshore and client stakeholders. 
 - Working knowledge of iPaaS/integration middleware platforms, with Boomi strongly preferred; candidates without direct Boomi experience should demonstrate the ability to ramp quickly through structured knowledge transfer.

Ideal Candidate Profile:

 - Takes ownership of outcomes rather than assigned tasks alone, and raises concerns when something does not align.

data.title: Food Technology Manager – Micronutrient Premixes, Food Quality and Safety
data.description:
About The Role

GAIN is seeking to recruit a Food Technology Manager - Micronutrient Premixes, Food Quality and Safety to strengthen food safety and quality assurance for micronutrient premixes and fortified foods. Combining practical premix formulation expertise with sound quality judgement, you will help ensure that products supplied through the GAIN Premix Facility (GPF) meet agreed specifications, applicable standards and customer requirements. 

Alongside GPF supplier assurance and formulation work, you will provide technical support to GAIN country offices, food manufacturers, governments and partners on large-scale food fortification. You will also support micro, small and medium-scale enterprises (MSMEs) to improve food safety, quality and processing practices. 

Reporting to the Programme Lead, Large Scale Food Fortification, you will work closely with the GPF team, country programme teams, the GPF certification agent and partners including WFP and UNICEF. 

This role will be offered on a two (2) year fixed-term contract, subject to availability of funding, and is open to applicants based in a country where GAIN has an office in Africa or Asia i. e. India, Bangladesh, Pakistan, Indonesia, Kenya, Ethiopia, Tanzania, Uganda, Mozambique, Rwanda, Nigeria, Benin. GAIN encourages early applications and reserves the right to close the advert ahead of the advertised deadline if we receive a high volume of interest. 

Key Responsibilities Include

- Manage food safety and quality assurance for GPF premixes, maintaining and improving the quality management system and ensuring compliance with agreed specifications and customer requirements. 
 - Develop and validate procurement-ready vitamin and mineral premix formulations, including complex applications such as Ready-to-use Therapeutic Foods (RUTF), against customer, quality and food safety requirements. 
 - Assess and monitor suppliers, make approval recommendations, and review certificates of analysis, batch records and independent test results to support product-release decisions. Manage quality investigations, root-cause analysis and corrective and preventive actions. 
 - Provide technical support to GAIN country offices, manufacturers and millers on fortification, regulatory compliance and QA/QC systems, including optimising premix dosing equipment and resolving production bottlenecks. 
 - Support MSME food processors to improve food safety, quality and processing practices and meet market and regulatory requirements. 
 - Train food control agencies and inspectors on risk-based inspection, sampling and rapid testing, and advise government and standards bodies on feasible fortification, food safety and quality regulations. 
 - Develop compliance-study protocols for technical review and approval, contribute evidence and draft content to global premix production standards, and produce practical SOPs, QA/QC manuals and training tools. 
 - Coordinate consultants and technical studies, support laboratory-capacity development, and collaborate with NGOs, donors and industry associations on practical technical interventions. 

About You

You will bring extensive experience in the food or pharmaceutical industry, with strong expertise in food safety, quality assurance and regulatory compliance, and proven responsibility for QA/QC and product-quality decisions. Hands-on experience developing vitamin and mineral premixes for complex applications, such as Ready-to-use Therapeutic Foods (RUTF), is essential. You will be able to translate customer specifications and applicable standards into formulations that meet demanding quality requirements, drawing on sound technical judgement. 

You will have proven auditing experience and familiarity with food safety and quality frameworks such as FSSC 22000, HACCP and GMP, alongside technical competence in vitamin technology or related products. Relevant laboratory experience, or an equivalent combination of education and experience, will enable you to interpret technical documentation and quality evidence. 

You will be confident advising industry, regulators, governments and international partners, and contributing to the development of technical standards or guidelines in a multi-stakeholder setting. Strong analytical, organisational and interpersonal skills, excellent spoken and written English, and the ability to balance detailed work with broader priorities will be important to your success. 

Experience in large-scale food fortification programmes is desirable. Experience in low- and middle-income country food systems, including hands-on support to micro, small and medium-scale enterprise (MSME) food processors, would be a distinct advantage. Educational background in chemistry, food technology, food science or microbiology, together with relevant industry certifications is required. 

About Our Offer

Below are our offices in Africa & Asia. The starting gross salary ranges for this role are listed below, depending on location and experience. All figures are gross per annum.

Benin: XOF 17, 076, 732 - 19, 539, 060

Mozambique: USD 43, 992 - 50, 316

Pakistan: PKR 4, 095, 528 - 4, 680, 600

Rwanda: RWF 35, 180, 683. 20 - 40, 152, 465. 60

Tanzania: USD 36, 852 - 42, 096

Uganda: UGX 94, 217, 556 - 107, 742, 240

Working Conditions

All of our positions are based in one or more of GAIN's designated offices as stated on our job advertisements. Successful candidates will be based in one of GAIN's country offices and must have the existing right to live and work within a reasonably commutable distance of the relevant city / cities in which the role is advertised. Please note, that GAIN does not sponsor working visas and relocations. 

Use of Artificial Intelligence during interviews and assessments

GAIN is committed to ensuring a fair and authentic recruitment process. Candidates are expected to participate in interviews and recruitment assessments independently and to provide responses that reflect their own knowledge, skills and experience. The use of generative artificial intelligence (AI) tools or other technologies to generate, formulate or provide answers during a live or recorded interview, written tests or assessment is not permitted, unless expressly authorised by GAIN in advance. Candidates who require assistive technology for accessibility purposes should inform the recruitment team in advance so that appropriate arrangements can be made. 

GAIN reserves the right to withdraw an offer of employment for candidates who are considered to be ineligible under the above conditions during or after the recruitment process. Applicants must have the right to work and be currently based in the advertised country location, to be eligible to apply for this position. 

The Global Alliance for Improved Nutrition is committed to equality of opportunity and creating an inclusive environment where diversity is valued. We are keen to reflect the diversity of our society at every level within our organisation and therefore welcome applications from talented and committed people from all backgrounds, representing the diverse societies we operate in.

data.title: Contract Position Security Engineer
data.description:
[Skills & Assignment]

Experience: 6. 0 - 25 years

Max Experience: 25

We are seeking a Lead Software Security Engineer to lead a team of trainers who will develop high-quality training and evaluation tasks for frontier AI coding models and step in to perform tasks when there is a high volume. You will transform real-world open-source vulnerabilities-including CVEs, security advisories, and bug reports-into Harbor-format audit-and-patch tasks across multiple programming languages. 

This role combines software security research, vulnerability reproduction, benchmark development, automated testing, and technical review. The goal is to create realistic tasks that evaluate whether AI systems can identify, understand, exploit, and securely remediate software vulnerabilities without relying on superficial pattern matching or known patches. 

What does day-to-day look like

- Plan task deliveries by batch, assign work across pod members, and track daily throughput against phase-specific targets. 
 - Monitor pod progress, identify bottlenecks, and ensure tasks move through each stage of production on schedule. 
 - Lead weekly client reporting, communicate delivery status, and raise risks early, including tooling issues, rate limits, safety blocks, and resource constraints. 
 - Collaborate with the client to clarify requirements and align on scope, task volume, and difficulty changes. 
 - Conduct final reviews of completed tasks to ensure they meet the required quality, security, reproducibility, and evaluation standards. 
 - Calibrate Pod Leads and trainers on CWE classification, verifier robustness, task difficulty, and acceptance criteria. 
 - Use throughput and quality data to forecast staffing needs for each project phase. 
 - Initiate hiring and onboarding waves approximately three weeks ahead of projected capacity requirements. 
 - Maintain clear documentation of delivery plans, risks, quality findings, throughput metrics, and staffing forecasts. 

Requirements

- 6+ years of professional software engineering experience. 
 - Expert-level proficiency in at least one of Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, Java, C/C++, C#, Go, Rust, Ruby, PHP, Kotlin, or Swift. 
 - Strong understanding of software security concepts, including CWE, CVE, and the OWASP Top 10. 
 - Ability to reproduce vulnerabilities and write proof-of-vulnerability tests. 
 - Hands-on experience with security tooling, including sanitizers, fuzzers, and static-analysis tools such as CodeQL or Semgrep. 
 - Strong proficiency with Git, Linux, Bash, and Docker. 
 - Excellent technical writing and documentation skills. 
 - Ability to work independently in a fully remote, research-oriented environment. 
 - Strong judgment on verifier robustness and on scoring AI patches. Clear, supportive communicator with some experience mentoring others. 
 - Proven track record on this project or equivalent security-dataset work.

Role: Senior Automation Architect (AI agents, RAG, Python, 15+yrs)

Location: Remote

Job Type: Permanent

Job Overview

We are seeking a highly skilled Senior Automation Architect to design, build and scale an integrated, AI-driven testing platform that transforms the entire Software Testing Life Cycle (STLC). The successful candidate will be responsible for designing and implementing autonomous AI agents, automated testing strategies and frameworks, ensuring the highest quality of our software products. You will bridge the gap between modern generative AI frameworks, robust test automation engineering and scalable cloud infrastructure. 

Responsibilities

- Architect and build autonomous AI agents within a unified platform to automate core STLC phases, including requirement analysis, test case generation, test data synthesis, execution and defect triaging. 
 - Implement advanced Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines, Hybrid Search, context management and prompt engineering strategies to ensure high accuracy, hallucination reduction and domain-specific test generation. 
 - Design intelligent, self-healing automation frameworks utilizing Playwright, Selenium, Appium, leveraging Model Context Protocol (MCP) to connect AI agents directly with browser/mobile contexts and test management tools. 
 - Define architectural standards, conduct code and design reviews, mentor senior engineers and collaborate with enterprise stakeholders to drive the adoption of agentic testing solutions. 
 - Continuously improve test automation strategies and processes to ensure high-quality software delivery. Required Skills

- Hands-on experience building AI agents, implementing Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers/clients, designing RAG architecture, vector databases and advanced prompt engineering. 
 - Proficiency in Python (primary for AI/agent orchestration) and Java (for enterprise test frameworks)
 - Expert-level knowledge of Playwright, Selenium and Appium across web, mobile, and API layers. 
 - Experience with pgvector or dedicated vector stores for storing historical test runs, DOM snapshots, and defect embeddings. 
 - Experience with multi-agent orchestration frameworks (e. g. , LangChain, LangGraph, AutoGen, CrewAI, or custom agentic loops). 
 - Experience establishing evaluation metrics (DeepEval, RAGAS) to measure the reliability, accuracy, and ROI of AI-generated tests and self-healing actions. 
 - Working knowledge of React. js to build or oversee interactive dashboards, human-in-the-loop (HITL) review workflows and reporting interfaces. 
 - Experience integrating autonomous testing workflows into modern CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI) and containerized environments (Docker, Kubernetes). 
 - Experience with API testing tools like Postman or SoapUI and RestAssured Automation
 - Proficient in using database testing tools, including PostgreSQL and Amazon RDS
 - The candidate must have a bachelor's degree in computer science, Information Technology, or a related field. A master's degree or relevant certifications would be considered an advantage. 

Preferred Skills

- Experience with other automation tools like TOSCA, TestComplete, Cypress, BrowserStack, Katalon Studio
 - Knowledge of programming languages such as Javascript, Typescript, or C#.

 - Experience with performance testing tools like JMeter or LoadRunner. 
 - Knowledge of cloud platforms like AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud. 

Required Experience

About Position: 

We are looking for an experienced Snowflake Architect with 12 to 16 years of experience in designing, modernizing, and optimizing enterprise data platforms. The ideal candidate will possess deep expertise in Snowflake architecture, cloud data engineering, multi-tenant platform design, data security, and AWS services. This role will be responsible for defining end-to-end Snowflake-native architecture, ensuring scalability, regulatory compliance, security, and operational excellence while supporting large-scale multi-tenant data platforms.

- Own the end-to-end Snowflake architecture design for Proof of Concept (POC) and enterprise-scale implementations using a 100% Snowflake-native architecture approach.

 - Drive architectural decisions, platform standardization, and cloud modernization initiatives.

Expertise You'll Bring:

 - Strong hands-on experience with Snowflake Dynamic Tables and real-time data processing capabilities. 
 - Expertise in Snowflake Tasks, CRON scheduling, Streams, and orchestration patterns. 
 - Experience implementing Snowflake Openflow, CDC frameworks, and modern data ingestion architectures. 
 - Strong knowledge of multi-tenant architecture patterns, including schema isolation, Row-Level Security (RLS), and tenant governance frameworks. 
 - Extensive experience with SQL optimization, query tuning, performance engineering, and data modeling. 
 - Strong experience with AWS services including S3, Aurora MySQL, PrivateLink, IAM, VPC, and cloud security services. 
 - Experience designing secure enterprise platforms with encryption, auditability, and compliance controls. 
 - Understanding of data residency requirements and regulatory frameworks such as PIPEDA, OSFI, and SOC 2 Type II. 
 - Experience with Snowpark and API integration frameworks for modern cloud-native data workloads. 
 - Expertise in enterprise-scale data platform modernization and cloud migration initiatives. 
 - Strong understanding of security architecture, access management, and governance best practices. 
 - Experience working with Agile delivery teams and enterprise stakeholders. 
 - Excellent communication, leadership, and architecture governance skills. 
 - Ability to drive technical strategy, mentor engineering teams, and influence enterprise architecture decisions. 

Benefits:

data.title: Application Engineer
data.description:
We're not hiring someone to close tickets. We're hiring the person who drives the entire Grip app system: its roadmap, architecture, speed and health. You'll also help shape what we build next. 

If you build apps in your spare time just because you love it, try new tools the week they come out, and check the crash dashboard before anyone asks, read on. 

The app today

The Grip app is built in React Native. Most of the product runs as our web app inside a WebView, joined to the app by a native bridge. Your job is to drive the whole app system: take it fully native, keep it fast, safe and reliable, and make it work hand in hand with web and backend. 

What you'll do

01 · Drive the entire app system

- Own the app end to end: architecture, releases, app health, and the roadmap to a fully native app, which you shape with the leadership team. 
 - Make the calls on architecture, stack and the order in which screens move. 
 - Help drive the product roadmap too, with ideas from the app side, from user data and from the best apps out there. 02 · Stay ahead of app health

- Own the crash-free rate, ANR rate and app-open time, and watch them in Crashlytics, Sentry and New Relic without being asked. 
 - Catch regressions before users do, and trace any crash or ANR to its root cause. 
 - Set up the monitoring and telemetry the whole team relies on. 03 · Experiment, and automate your own workload

- Try new technologies and AI workflows early, and keep what works. 
 - Automate the repetitive parts of the job: builds, releases, checks, triage, task breakdown. 
 - Work out how app development fits into our AI-driven development process (AI SDLC), so app delivery is as fast as web. 04 · Build one ecosystem with web and backend

- Work with the web and backend teams to make everything the app shares with them (APIs, auth, data and events) more secure and robust. 
 - Design the architecture that lets every new feature go live on app and web on the same timeline, without one waiting for the other. 
 - Use shared API contracts and business logic, shared analytics events, and server-driven pieces where they help. 
 - Partner with the engineering manager on the process. The architecture is yours. 05 · Build in the guardrails

- Define the checks every release passes for security, accessibility, design and A/B experiments. 
 - Make releases safe and boring: CI, over-the-air updates, staged rollouts and rollback. 06 · Set the standard

- Your PRs, code reviews and incident write-ups become the team's benchmark. 
 - Come to us with "here's what we should improve" before anyone asks. What we're looking for

Must have

- Mobile: React Native (including the New Architecture: Fabric, TurboModules, JSI) or Flutter, in depth, plus enough native Android (Kotlin) and iOS (Swift) to build and debug native modules. 
 - Architecture: mobile app architecture, hybrid-to-native migrations, WebView and JS ↔ native bridges, strict TypeScript. 
 - App health: performance profiling (Hermes, Android Studio Profiler, Perfetto, Xcode Instruments) and crash, ANR and telemetry tools (Crashlytics, Sentry, New Relic). 
 - Delivery: mobile CI/CD (GitHub Actions, Fastlane), over-the-air updates, Play Console and App Store Connect. 
 - Quality: mobile and API security, accessibility on iOS and Android, feature flags and A/B experiments, and testing (Jest, React Native Testing Library, Detox or Maestro). 
 - AI: daily use of CLI agents such as Claude Code or Codex, and automations you've built for your own work. Strong plus

- You've led a hybrid-to-native migration or a native rewrite. 
 - You've built and shipped fully native apps (Kotlin with Jetpack Compose, or Swift with SwiftUI), not only cross-platform ones. 
 - Server-driven UI, UPI intent payments, SMS Retriever OTP or KYC SDKs. 
 - Fintech or other regulated B2C apps at scaleMindset

- Builder at heart: builds apps in their spare time, with personal and pet projects, because they love making apps, not just because it's the job. 
 - User-obsessed: gets excited about creating new experiences for users. 
 - Ahead of the curve: keeps up with frontier technology and AI, and experiments with new tools before they go mainstream. 
 - Automates: keeps cutting their own workload by automating processes and routine work. 
 - Proactive: spots crashes, ANRs and slowdowns on the dashboards before users report them. 
 - Owner: owns outcomes end to end and thinks about the product, not only the code. 
 - Partner: brings ideas, not just questions, and communicates clearly. Green flags and red flags

We'll move fast for you if

- You build apps for fun: personal and pet projects, released or not. Show us one. 
 - You've led a hybrid-to-native migration, a major React Native upgrade or a New Architecture move. 
 - You've traced a native crash or ANR to its root cause and can tell us the story. 
 - You've automated a real chunk of your own job, and can show us how. 
 - You've set up mobile monitoring, telemetry or release checks that a team relied on. 
 - You've worked with web and backend teams to make shared APIs, auth or events more secure. 
 - You've shipped one feature on app and web on the same day, and know what it took. 
 - You have a view on React Native versus fully native versus other stacks, backed by numbers. Not a fit if

- You've only worked in JavaScript and avoid Xcode or Android Studio. 
 - You close crash reports as "can't reproduce". 
 - You've never shipped to the app stores yourself. 
 - You wait to be told what to fix next. 
 - You only build apps when it's for work. 
 - You've never used AI tools beyond a chat prompt. What owning the app looks like

No fixed timeline. You drive it. 

- Know the app cold. Map the app, the bridge, the release flow and the monitoring, and ship your first fixes in your first weeks. 
 - Own the roadmap. Shape the native roadmap with leadership, and present the architecture, stack choice and migration order. 
 - Own the numbers. Crash-free rate, ANR rate, app-open time and product telemetry each have a baseline, a dashboard and a target that you set. 
 - Automate the busywork. Builds, releases and checks run themselves, and app work flows through our AI-driven development process as smoothly as web work. 
 - Work as one with web and backend. New features go live on app and web on the same timeline, shared APIs and auth are secure and robust, and every release passes the checks for security, accessibility, design and experiments. 
 - Become the reference point. When the team debates an app or product approach, they ask what you'd do. What you get here

- Your ideas, brought to life. The interests, experiments and ideas you'd normally save for a side project get to ship here, to real investors. 
 - A company that stays ahead of the curve. We experiment early with new technology and AI tools to build things customers love. 
 - Real ownership. The app, its roadmap and its architecture are yours to shape. We're building a team where AI-native isn't a buzzword. It's table stakes. The person we hire won't just build a native app. They'll give our investors the best experience we can offer, on every screen, and make the whole team better at building for mobile. 

If you're still reading and nodding, we'd like to meet you.

Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) is building next-gen AI-native software and engineering systems that accelerate data center delivery and simplify cloud operations at global scale. You will establish reusable platforms and engineering practices that help teams deliver faster while improving security, reliability, and maintainability. 

You will: 

- Lead architecture and technical direction for distributed services and platforms supporting data center planning, design, build, and operations. Define APIs, data models, service boundaries, scalability strategies, and failure handling across dependent systems.

 - Advance AI-native engineering across teams. Integrate AI-assisted development and coding agents into everyday workflows, including implementation, testing, documentation, code review, and maintenance. Establish repeatable practices that improve delivery speed and engineering quality. 
 - Build intelligent automation and self-service capabilities that simplify lifecycle workflows, improve operational decision-making, and reduce manual effort for data center builders and operators. Apply AI where it offers a clear, measurable advantage. 
 - Set standards for safe, reliable AI-assisted delivery. Ensure generated code and agent-driven changes meet requirements for correctness, security, maintainability, and supportability through automated checks, evaluations, and appropriate engineering review. 
 - Own production outcomes in a builder-operator model. Build, deploy, participate in on-call rotations, and use incidents, operational data, and retrospectives to improve reliability and reduce recurring toil. 
 - Raise engineering standards across multiple teams. Lead architecture and design reviews; strengthen observability, automated testing, continuous integration and delivery, deployment automation, and service ownership. 
 - Shape roadmaps with product management and leadership. Communicate recommendations, tradeoffs, risks, dependencies, and investment priorities clearly. Connect technical decisions to customer and business outcomes. 
 - Multiply engineering effectiveness. Mentor engineers, unblock difficult technical problems, and develop reusable components, interfaces, and patterns that teams can adopt. 
 - Measure and improve results. Use evidence to assess delivery lead time, service reliability, operational toil, and developer and operator productivity, including the impact of AI-assisted workflows. 

Preferred Qualifications: 

- BS, MS, or PhD in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

 - Demonstrated technical leadership across multiple teams, including setting architecture direction, resolving ambiguous problems, and delivering complex initiatives with measurable outcomes. 
 - Hands-on experience using AI-assisted development tools, coding agents, and automated engineering workflowsto deliver production software, with sound judgment about their capabilities and limitations. 
 - Experience establishing reusable engineering practices or platforms that improve team productivity, software quality, and operational effectiveness. 
 - Strong software development skills in one or more of Java, Python, Go, or JavaScript/TypeScript, with the ability to work across service, platform, and user-facing components. 
 - Strong understanding of databases, NoSQL systems, storage, and distributed persistence, including consistency, availability, and scalability tradeoffs. 
 - Proven end-to-end service ownership in a builder-operator model, including deployment, observability, incident response, on-call, and continuous improvement. 
 - Experience evaluating AI-enabled systems or agent workflows for correctness, reliability, security, and cost.

About the RoleWe are looking for a hands-on engineer to own complex technology initiatives from problem discovery to production-grade deployment and business outcomes. 

This is a senior individual contributor (IC) role focused on engineering depth, problem-solving, and architectural ownership-not team management. You will work directly with business stakeholders, design architectures, write production code, and build AI-native systems end-to-end. 

Key Responsibilities1. End-to-End Problem Ownership
 - Own complex technology initiatives across the full lifecycle: problem discovery, solution design, deployment, and post-launch outcomes. 
 - Engage directly with business stakeholders to clarify ambiguous requirements, define actual problem statements, and align on scope.

2. Architecture and Hands-on Engineering
 - Design and build scalable, reliable, secure, and maintainable software systems. 
 - Drive technical choices, evaluate tradeoffs, and write production-grade code across backend services, APIs, and data pipelines. 
 - Take projects from initial POCs to production deployment and long-term maintenance. 

3. AI and LLM Engineering
 - Design, train, evaluate, and deploy Large Language Models (LLMs), including training models from scratch. 
 - Build AI-native solutions that directly address core business workflows. 
 - Handle the end-to-end model lifecycle: data prep, architecture, fine-tuning/RAG, inference optimization, latency/cost control, and production monitoring. 

4. Delivery & Production Ownership
 - Deliver high-quality software on clear timelines by breaking complex tasks into milestones and proactively managing risks. 
 - Own testing, CI/CD, deployment, monitoring, incident response, and continuous evaluation for traditional and AI software. 5. Technical Judgment & Improvement
 - Maintain high engineering standards and document key architectural decisions. 
 - Continuously optimize systems to reduce complexity, lower operational costs, and improve system observability and developer productivity. Eligibility Criteria
 - Education: Bachelor's degree in CS, Computer Engineering, IT, or related technical field. (Master's in CS/AI/ML preferred; equivalent strong industry experience accepted). 
 - Experience: 6-10 years of hands-on software engineering experience delivering complex systems to production. 

Required Technical Expertise
 - Backend Engineering: Proficiency in Node. js, TypeScript/JavaScript, API design, async processing, and event-driven architecture. 
 - System Design: Expertise in distributed systems, scalability, database design, caching, messaging, and system integration. 
 - AI/ML & LLM Engineering: Deep understanding of deep learning, transformer architectures, tokenization, attention mechanisms, GPU utilization, and LLM internals. 
 - LLM Training: Direct experience training LLMs from scratch, fine-tuning, RAG, and serving models in production.

Profile & Mindset

Role Scope & Boundaries
