data.title: Lead AI/ML Engineer
data.description:
Position: Lead AI/ML Engineer

Experience: 8+ yrs

Location: Bangalore

Employment: Full time

Job Summary: 

We're looking for a Staff Engineer specializing in Agentic AI and Generative AI to join the team. Does this sound like a good role for you? In this role, you will be responsible for designing, developing, troubleshooting, and operating cloud-hosted AI applications and agentic platforms. You will collaborate with engineering, product, architecture, E2E and DevOps teams while contributing to architecture and design decisions that influence product direction. The ideal candidate will have strong software engineering experience with Python, REST APIs, distributed systems, cloud platforms, and modern AI technologies. We are looking for someone who can apply their experience with Large Language Models, Retrieval-Augmented Generation, agent orchestration, multi-agent patterns, evaluation frameworks, guardrails, and cloud-native deployment to build reliable, secure, scalable, and production-ready AI solutions. 

Below is the list of key qualifications: 

- Bachelor's or master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, or a related field. 
 - 8+ years of software development experience building enterprise-grade, customer-facing products and services, including at least 2 years of hands-on experience developing solutions using AI Agents, Skills, or Large Language Model technologies. 
 - Strong hands-on programming experience with Python, including object-oriented programming, asynchronous programming, concurrency, error handling, testing, packaging, and performance optimisation. 
 - Experience designing and implementing REST APIs and integrating internal and external services using structured JSON payloads, schemas, authentication, retries, rate limits, and resilient error-handling patterns. 
 - Experience building production-grade AI agents using frameworks such as Semantic Kernel, LangGraph, or LangChain. 
 - Experience with agent orchestration and multi-agent architecture patterns, including planning, tool selection, task delegation, workflow coordination, and communication between agents. 
 - Strong understanding of agent state, memory, context management, session management, checkpointing, and recovery for long-running or multi-step agent workflows. 
 - Experience designing and implementing agent evaluation frameworks, including quality, task completion, groundedness, safety, latency, reliability, and cost evaluations. 
 - Experience implementing AI guardrails, including input and output validation, prompt injection protection, access control, content filtering, structured responses, tool-use restrictions, and safe failure handling. 
 - Strong understanding of Large Language Models and transformer architectures, including attention mechanisms, tokenisation, context windows, model inference, and common model limitations. 
 - Experience with prompt engineering techniques such as system prompt design, few-shot prompting, structured prompting, tool or function calling, prompt templates, and prompt versioning. 
 - Experience designing and implementing Retrieval-Augmented Generation pipelines, including document ingestion, parsing, chunking, metadata enrichment, embedding generation, indexing, retrieval, re-ranking, citation, and response generation. 
 - Experience working with embeddings and vector databases or vector search platforms, including index design, metadata filtering, hybrid search, semantic search, and retrieval quality optimisation. 
 - Experience with context management and token optimisation techniques, including context selection, summarisation, compression, caching, prompt budgeting, and management of conversation history. 
 - Experience designing human-in-the-loop workflows for review, approval, exception handling, feedback collection, and escalation of sensitive or low-confidence AI decisions. 
 - Experience with model customization techniques such as fine-tuning, instruction tuning, parameter-efficient fine-tuning, or model adaptation, along with the ability to determine when fine-tuning is appropriate compared with prompting or RAG. 
 - Experience with AWS or GCP and their core compute, storage, networking, identity, security, logging, and monitoring services. 
 - Hands-on experience with Amazon Bedrock or equivalent managed Generative AI platforms, including model integration, inference configuration, security, observability, and cost management. 
 - Experience containerizing and deploying applications using Docker, with a sound understanding of container security, configuration, networking, resource management, and deployment fundamentals. 
 - Experience implementing CI/CD workflows using GitHub Actions or equivalent platforms for automated build, test, security validation, packaging, and deployment. 
 - Experience with AI and model observability, including monitoring of latency, availability, token consumption, cost, retrieval quality, model responses, evaluation scores, safety events, and production drift. 
 - Strong knowledge of software architecture, design patterns, data structures, algorithms, distributed systems, and cloud-native application design. 
 - Experience with test-driven development and automated testing using frameworks such as pytest, including unit, integration, API, workflow, evaluation, and end-to-end testing. 
 - Strong understanding of security, privacy, responsible AI, data governance, and secure software development practices for enterprise AI applications. 
 - Excellent problem-solving, analytical, debugging, and troubleshooting skills, with the ability to diagnose issues across application, AI model, agent, data, retrieval, and cloud infrastructure layers. 
 - Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to explain complex AI and software architecture decisions to technical and non-technical stakeholders. 
 - High energy, a positive attitude, and a strong sense of ownership for delivering reliable and high-quality products. 

Below is the list of preferred experience: 

- Experience developing enterprise applications using Java or Go. 
 - Experience with multiple agentic AI frameworks, particularly Semantic Kernel, LangGraph, and LangChain. 
 - Experience implementing Model Context Protocol-based integrations or similar standards for connecting AI agents with tools, data sources, and enterprise systems. 
 - Experience with vector databases or vector-enabled data platforms such as Amazon OpenSearch Service, PostgreSQL with pgvector, Pinecone, Weaviate, Milvus, or equivalent technologies. 
 - Experience with orchestration and deployment platforms such as Kubernetes, Amazon ECS, Amazon EKS, Google Kubernetes Engine, or serverless compute services. 
 - Experience with model and experiment tracking, prompt management, evaluation platforms, tracing, and LLM observability tools. 
 - Experience designing event-driven or asynchronous systems using messaging and streaming technologies such as Kafka, RabbitMQ, Amazon SQS, Amazon SNS, or Google Pub/Sub. 
 - Experience working with relational and NoSQL databases, including PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, DynamoDB, or equivalent technologies. 
 - Familiarity with responsible AI practices covering fairness, transparency, explainability, privacy, human oversight, and risk management. 
 - Experience improving AI application performance through semantic caching, request batching, streaming, model routing, fallback strategies, and inference cost optimization. 
 - Experience with infrastructure-as-code technologies such as Terraform, AWS CloudFormation, AWS CDK, or equivalent tools. 
 - Experience working in a SaaS product environment with multi-tenant architecture, enterprise identity, authorisation, auditability, and data-isolation requirements. 

Key Responsibilities

- Ensure the timely delivery of secure, reliable, and high-quality AI software that meets business requirements and maintains predictable performance in production environments. 
 - Design and develop cloud-native AI applications, agentic workflows, and reusable AI platform capabilities using Python, REST APIs, Large Language Models, and cloud services. 
 - Architect agent-based solutions using Semantic Kernel, LangGraph, LangChain, or related frameworks, selecting appropriate orchestration, state, memory, context, and multi-agent patterns. 
 - Design and implement Retrieval-Augmented Generation pipelines covering ingestion, document processing, chunking, embeddings, vector indexing, retrieval, re-ranking, grounding, citation, and response generation. 
 - Develop human-in-the-loop workflows that support review, approval, intervention, feedback, exception handling, and escalation for business-critical AI processes. 
 - Establish evaluation strategies and measurable quality criteria for agents, prompts, models, tools, and RAG pipelines, and integrate automated evaluations into the engineering lifecycle. 
 - Implement guardrails and security controls to reduce risks associated with prompt injection, sensitive data exposure, hallucinations, unauthorized tool usage, unsafe responses, and excessive agent autonomy. 
 - Optimize context usage, token consumption, latency, throughput, retrieval quality, model selection, and infrastructure cost while maintaining solution quality and reliability. 
 - Build and maintain REST APIs, asynchronous services, tool integrations, structured outputs, JSON schemas, and connectors required by AI agents and enterprise applications. 
 - Implement production monitoring and observability for AI applications, including application metrics, distributed traces, model interactions, agent execution paths, token usage, cost, evaluation outcomes, and safety events. 
 - Develop and maintain CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions or equivalent platforms, incorporating automated testing, AI evaluations, dependency scanning, container scanning, policy checks, and deployment validation. 
 - Deploy and operate AI services on AWS or GCP using appropriate containerized, managed, or serverless deployment patterns. 
 - Provide technical leadership and mentorship to engineers, guiding architecture, implementation, testing, debugging, secure development, and operational best practices. 
 - Conduct thorough design and code reviews, ensuring that implementations meet software quality, security, testability, observability, maintainability, and responsible AI standards. 
 - Collaborate closely with engineering teams, product managers, architects, security teams, data specialists, and stakeholders to define technical solutions, delivery plans, success criteria, and operational requirements. 
 - Evaluate AI models, frameworks, tools, and cloud services through structured prototypes and technical assessments, and recommend technologies based on quality, security, scalability, operability, and cost. 
 - Troubleshoot complex production issues across agents, prompts, models, tool integrations, RAG pipelines, vector indexes, APIs, containers, and cloud infrastructure. 
 - Communicate technical decisions, progress, risks, trade-offs, and recommended solutions clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders. 
 - Stay current with developments in Generative AI, agentic frameworks, Large Language Models, cloud AI services, evaluation methodologies, and responsible AI, applying relevant advances to improve product capabilities and engineering practices.

You will work alongside experienced Unity developers, artists, and designers to help build immersive and engaging experiences for our users, while gaining hands-on exposure to production-grade XR development.  - Scripting and Programming: Write clean, efficient, and maintainable C# code for XR interactions and systems, following team coding standards.

Qualifications

- Currently pursuing (or recently completed) a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Game Development, or a related field. 
 - Hands-on exposure to Unity through coursework, personal projects, hackathons, game jams, or prior internships.

 - Ability to work effectively in a collaborative, fast-paced environment and take feedback well. 
 - Genuine passion for XR technology and eagerness to learn and adapt to new advancements.

 - Exposure to the full XR development lifecycle - from prototyping on headsets to performance tuning and release. 
 - Potential to convert to a full-time Unity Developer role based on performance.

The objective is to evaluate whether AI systems can identify, understand, exploit, and securely remediate software vulnerabilities without relying on superficial pattern matching or known patches. 

Key Responsibilities

- Plan task deliveries by batch, assign work across pod members, and track daily throughput against phase-specific targets. 
 - Monitor pod progress, identify bottlenecks, and ensure tasks move through each production stage on schedule. 
 - Lead weekly client reporting, communicate delivery status, and raise risks early, including tooling issues, rate limits, safety blocks, and resource constraints. 
 - Collaborate with the client to clarify requirements and align on scope, task volume, and difficulty changes. 
 - Conduct final reviews of completed tasks to ensure they meet quality, security, reproducibility, and evaluation standards. 
 - Calibrate Pod Leads and trainers on CWE classification, verifier robustness, task difficulty, and acceptance criteria. 
 - Use throughput and quality data to forecast staffing needs for each project phase. 
 - Initiate hiring and onboarding waves approximately three weeks ahead of projected capacity requirements. 
 - Maintain clear documentation of delivery plans, risks, quality findings, throughput metrics, and staffing forecasts. 

Requirements

- 6+ years of professional software engineering experience. 
 - Expert-level proficiency in at least one of the following: Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, Java, C/C++, C#, Go, Rust, Ruby, PHP, Kotlin, or Swift. 
 - Strong understanding of software security concepts, including CWE, CVE, and the OWASP Top 10. 
 - Ability to reproduce vulnerabilities and write proof-of-vulnerability tests. 
 - Hands-on experience with security tooling, including sanitizers, fuzzers, and static-analysis tools such as CodeQL or Semgrep. 
 - Strong proficiency with Git, Linux, Bash, and Docker. 
 - Excellent technical writing and documentation skills. 
 - Ability to work independently in a fully remote, research-oriented environment. 
 - Strong judgment on verifier robustness and scoring AI patches. 
 - Clear, supportive communication skills and experience mentoring others. 
 - Proven track record on this project or equivalent security-dataset work.

Senior Software Engineer, Labor Planning & Forecasting

Hybrid, Bangalore or Pune, India

The Legion application is a high-performance data-driven Java enterprise application that implements sophisticated scheduling and optimization algorithms. As a Senior Software Engineer, you will be a member of the team responsible for the implementation and evolution of this application. You will need to be able to write secure, efficient, enterprise-quality Java code, and have a deep understanding of the techniques and technologies that are necessary for scalability and performance. You will also need knowledge and experience with data modeling and relational databases. Our application runs on AWS, so experience with containerization and cloud deployments is desirable.  - Thorough understanding of the product area
 - Assist with feature design along with CTO/Architect
 - Develop features keeping in mind best coding practices including performance and user experience
 - Own product quality
 - Test features before asking QA engineers to test
 - Write unit tests
 - Work with QA engineers to test the product end-to-end

 - Be able to demo the Legion product end-to-end
 - Devise robust solutions that enable product engineering teams to rapidly deliver features in a scalable and performant manner
 - Design, build, and support applications from End to End. 
 - Make data-driven technical decisions
 - Use your deep technical knowledge to debug and solve complex technical problems
 - Identify and resolve ambiguities in requirements in consultation with the various stakeholders
 - Contribute to the long-term team charter and quarterly planning

REQUIRED SKILLS AND QUALIFICATIONS

 - 7-8 years with backend technologies (Java, Spring Boot, MySQL)
 - 7-8 years working on building multi-tenant SaaS applications
 - 7-8 years experience with designing and building APIs
 - 5+ years delivering software in a cloud-based environment (AWS, GCP, Azure)
 - Professional software development experience
 - Proficiency in Java or C++, and object-oriented design skills
 - Application architecture and design patterns
 - Experience serving as technical lead throughout the full software development lifecycle, from conception, architecture definition, detailed design, scoping, planning, implementation, and testing to documentation, delivery, and maintenance is preferred
 - Knowledge of professional software engineering and best practices for the full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations
 - Experience in the development of distributed/scalable systems and high-volume transaction applications
 - Proven ability to lead projects from inception to production
 - Strong mastery in communication skills, software architecture design, writing technical documents
 - Strong personal work ethic focused on prioritization, being action-oriented, and being driven to achieve positive results

At Legion, we offer competitive compensation and benefits packages to all employees. As a fully remote employer, pay for positions is determined using local, national, and industry-specific survey data. 

We strive to make competitive offers allowing employees room for future growth. Salaries will be based on the applicant's location, level of experience, education, and specialized knowledge and skills. Additionally, we consider the external market rate, the amount we have budgeted internally, and internal equity within the company for the same position. 

Benefits include, but are not limited to: 

- Health Benefits
 - Paid Time Off and Paid Holidays
 - Parental Leave 
 - Equity 
 - Monthly Wellness Reimbursement
 - Monthly Lunch on Legion

ABOUT LEGION

Join Legion's mission to turn hourly jobs into good jobs. We're a remote, mission-driven team seeking exceptional talent to propel this vision. Embrace a culture that's collaborative, fast-paced, and entrepreneurial. With us, you'll grow your skills, work closely with experienced executives, and contribute significantly to our mission. 

Legion Technologies delivers the industry's most innovative workforce management platform. It enables businesses to maximize labor efficiency and employee engagement simultaneously. The award-winning, AI-driven Legion WFM platform is intelligent, automated, and employee-centric. It's proven to deliver 13x ROI through schedule optimization, reduced attrition, increased productivity, and increased operational efficiency. Legion delivers cutting-edge technology in an easy-to-use platform and mobile app that employees love. 

If you're ready to make an impact and grow your career, Legion is where you belong. Join us in making hourly work rewarding and fulfilling. 

BACKGROUND AND OPPORTUNITY

There are almost 75 million hourly workers in the United States, representing more than half of the entire workforce. Historically, managing hourly employees has been difficult due to high attrition (average of 60%) and high replacement costs (average of $3, 200 per employee in retail). The ongoing labor shortage and competition from the gig economy make it more difficult to attract and retain hourly employees. The top reasons hourly employees leave their jobs are a lack of schedule empowerment, poor communication with employers, and an inability to get paid early. Gen Z and the millennial workforce demand gig-like flexibility, modern technology, and compelling work options. Legion's mission is to turn hourly jobs into good jobs, serving the hourly workers who make up the majority of the US workforce. We believe in empowering employees and helping employers be efficient and innovative by enabling intelligent automation powered by Legion's Workforce Management platform to optimize labor efficiency and enhance the employee experience simultaneously. Legion WFM was built for the cloud with AI at the core and designed to handle the complexity of modern businesses and meet the needs of today's hourly employees. Our team is comprised of dedicated individuals from all backgrounds and experiences, globally distributed across all time zones. 

For more information, visit https: //legion. co

All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, age, disability, marital status, familial status, sexual orientation, pregnancy, genetic information, gender identity, gender expression, national origin, ancestry, citizenship status, veteran status, and any other legally protected status under federal, state, or local anti-discrimination laws.

We evaluate external equity and the cost of labor/prevailing wage index in the relative marketplace for jobs directly comparable to jobs within our company. Our posted salary range is based on national data and may be refined for a candidate's region/town/cost of living. For new hires, we strive to make competitive offers allowing the new employee room for future growth. Salaries will be based on the applicant's location, level of experience, education, and specialized knowledge and skills. Additionally, we consider the external market rate, the amount we have budgeted internally, and internal equity within the company for the same position. An employee/candidate with a stronger skill set will receive higher pay.

This Policy does not apply to our handling of data gathered about you in your role as a user of our consumer-facing services. When you interact with us as in that role, the Legion Privacy Policy applies. 

- Types of Personal Information We Handle

We collect, store, and use various types of personal information through the application and recruitment process. We collect such information either directly from you or (where applicable) from another person or entity, such as an employment agency or consultancy, background check provider, or other referral sources. This information includes: 

- Identification and contact information, and related identifiers such as full name, date and place of birth, citizenship and permanent residence, home and business addresses, telephone numbers, email addresses, and such information about your beneficiaries or emergency contacts. 
 - Professional or employment-related information, including: 
 - Recruitment, employment, or engagement information such as application forms and information included in a resume, cover letter, or otherwise provided through any application or engagement process; and copies of identification documents, such as driver's licenses, passports, and visas; and background screening results and references. 
 - Career information such as job titles; work history; work dates and work locations; information about skills, qualifications, experience, publications, speaking engagements, and preferences; and professional memberships
 - Education Information such as institutions attended, degrees, certifications, training courses, publications, and transcript information. 
 - Legally protected classification information such as race, sex/gender, religious/ philosophical beliefs, gender identity/expression, sexual orientation, marital status, military service, nationality, ethnicity, request for family care leave, political opinions, and criminal history. 
 - Other information such as any information you voluntarily choose to provide in connection with your job application. 
 - How We Use Personal Information

We collect, use, share, and store personal information from job applicants for our and our service providers' business and operational purposes in the recruitment process such as: processing your application, tracking your application through the recruitment process, contacting references with your authorization, conducting background checks you authorize, and making hiring decisions. We will also use job applicant information for internal analysis purposes to understand the applicants who apply and to improve our recruitment process. We may sometimes need to use applicant information for legal purposes, such as in connection with any challenges made to our hiring decisions. 

- With Whom We Share Personal Information

We will disclose job applicant personal information to the following types of entities or in the following circumstances (where applicable): 

- Internally: to other Legion personnel involved in the recruiting and hiring process. 
 - Vendors: such as technology service providers, travel management providers, human resources suppliers, background check companies, and employment agencies or recruiters, where applicable. 
 - Legal Compliance: when required to do so by law, regulation, or court order or in response to a request for assistance by the police or other law enforcement agency. 
 - Litigation Purposes: to seek legal advice from our external lawyers or in connection with litigation with a third party. 
 - Business Transaction Purposes: in connection with the sale, purchase, or merger. 
 - How to Contact Us About this Policy - If you have any questions about this Policy, please contact privacy@legion. co.

data.title: Director of Engineering
data.description:
About ArmorCode

ArmorCode is the agentic control plane for Unified Exposure Management: one platform that unifies, prioritizes, and remediates risk across applications, code, software supply chain, cloud, infrastructure, and AI. 

The ArmorCode Agentic AI Platform ingests findings from 400+ security tools, correlates them with business context in the Context Risk Graph, and puts Anya AI agents to work prioritizing, routing, and verifying fixes. 

The platform is proven at enterprise scale, processing 400B+ findings annually and supporting more than 5, 600 security professionals and 300, 000 developers. Global enterprises including Visa, PayPal, Volvo Group, and Johnson Controls use ArmorCode to shorten find-to-fix time and reduce risk. 

ArmorCoders believe in five core values: Hungry. Humble. Hardworking. Honest. Human. Our organization is powered by exceptional professionals who bring fresh ideas and passion to their roles, believing that nothing is beyond reach when our "5H" principles are applied. In their work and professional relationships, ArmorCoders commit to excellence and experiences that leave an impression. 

About The Role

The Director of Engineering owns how ArmorCode builds and delivers its product. This role leads Development and also manages Quality Engineering, and is expected to drive synergies between the two so that building and validating software work as one motion. The role is accountable for delivery predictability, release quality, and the people and org structure behind them. 

This is also the role that shapes how ArmorCode builds software in an AI-native world. Several teams already run agentic workflows. The Director sets the direction, standards, and accountability that move engineering from AI-assisted work toward genuine autonomy, and ensures the org, architecture, and talent are ready for what comes next. 

Reporting to the Head of Engineering, this role gives leadership an accurate, ongoing view of delivery, quality, and engineering health. It also carries direct ownership of engineering-level escalations on strategic enterprise accounts. 

What You'll Own

Your Org

- Lead Development and Quality Engineering, creating the shared practices and priorities that let the two functions reinforce each other
 - Actively redesign org structure as the product, headcount, and AI-driven ways of working evolve, including pod structure, reporting lines, and where Dev and QA boundaries should sit
 - Hire and develop engineering managers and QA leadership; set the hiring bar and build a bench capable of running each function independently
 - Own IDPs for all direct reports and key senior engineers; hold people accountable to growth plans with a clear 3-6 month review cycle
 - Own promotions, calibration, and performance processes for the org, including writing promotion narratives, running calibration sessions, and managing attrition directly
 - Handle escalations that span functions, such as a release delayed by both Dev and QA, or inter-team friction that blocks delivery

Development & Delivery

- Own delivery predictability across releases: planning, sprint health, dependency management, and on-time, high-quality shipping
 - Set engineering standards for architecture, code review, branching, and release practices as headcount and product surface area grow
 - Partner with Product and other engineering leaders to commit to realistic scope and timelines, and hold the line when they aren't
 - Drive technical direction for a platform that must scale across customers, integrations, and deployment models, and keep tech debt visible and managed
 - Own incident response practice for the product, including being available and accountable when production incidents involve strategic customers

Enterprise Customer Escalations

- Own engineering-level escalations for strategic enterprise accounts: debugging production issues, reviewing customer logs, coordinating fixes, and representing engineering directly with the customer or account team
 - Make the call on when an issue is ArmorCode's problem vs. a third-party integration, and own the communication when that distinction matters
 - Manage the follow-through on enterprise-specific requirements (private instances, dedicated tenants, custom integrations) from engineering's side

Quality Engineering

- Own quality outcomes at the org level, with Dev and QA sharing accountability for what reaches customers
 - Drive shift-left practices and bring QA closer to development, so quality is built in rather than checked at the end
 - Own org-wide quality metrics, including defect leakage, escaped defects, and regression stability, and report them to leadership
 - Hold the line on quality expectations under exec pressure: be the person who can explain what the numbers actually mean and push back where the bar is set unrealistically

AI & Agentic Work

- Set the vision for AI-native engineering at ArmorCode: how code is written, reviewed, tested, and released when agents are part of the team
 - Define org-wide standards for agentic work: what constitutes genuine autonomy vs. AI-assisted work, required eval harnesses, guardrails, and where human sign-off remains mandatory
 - Make model, tooling, and vendor decisions (which LLM for which workflow, build vs. buy) and own the tradeoffs
 - Hold managers accountable for agentic adoption through outcome review, not code review
 - Report the org's actual agentic maturity to leadership: what is genuinely autonomous, what is still AI-assisted, and the plan to close the gap
 - Build the skills, hiring profile, and ways of working the org will need as AI changes what engineers do

Strategy, Capacity & OKRs

- Set multi-quarter engineering strategy aligned with company priorities and where the ASPM market is heading
 - Own the FY capacity model for the org: maintenance load, integration overhead, headcount allocation, and the evidence-based case for budget changes
 - Define and track the metrics that indicate organizational health: delivery predictability, defect leakage, regression stability, incident resolution time, agentic workflow adoption
 - Own quarterly OKRs and monthly business reviews; report progress to the India Engineering Head, the Head of Engineering, and broader leadership
 - Make build vs. buy and vendor decisions for engineering tooling

Rubric

- An engineering rubric: criteria a release must meet before shipping and what constitutes an SLO breach
 - An agentic maturity rubric: the distinction between AI-assisted work and genuine agent autonomy, and the bar each function is held to
 - A people rubric for the management layer: criteria for IDP accountability, promotion readiness, and what "running a function independently" looks like at each level

Who You Are

Must Have

- 12+ years in software engineering, with a strong development background and a track record of leading large engineering teams
 - Has grown a team before, ideally from a handful of people into the 40-50 range, including making hard calls on org structure, not just steady-state management
 - Has owned delivery for a product with real release cadence and customer commitments, and can explain predictability in terms of data, not optimism
 - Has led AI/agentic adoption across a team or org, including model and vendor decisions, setting eval expectations, and knowing when a workflow is actually autonomous vs. just AI-assisted
 - Has managed or worked closely with QA, and knows the difference between a coverage number that means something and one that doesn't
 - Strong architecture judgment and genuinely hands-on comfort with cloud/AWS and scalable system design; comfortable in a war room when something breaks in prod
 - Comfortable owning enterprise customer escalations directly: can represent engineering credibly to a strategic customer, knows when to escalate and when to absorb
 - Can sit across the table from other engineering and product leadership and hold their own; this role is visible at that level
 - Willing to write code, scripts, or tooling themselves when that's the fastest path to unblocking the team, not just delegating

Strong Plus

- Experience running enterprise-grade private or dedicated cloud instances for large customers, not just multi-tenant SaaS
 - Exposure to LLM/GenAI tooling beyond general familiarity: decisions about prompt design, model selection, MCP or tool-call architecture, or eval harness design
 - Experience setting agentic engineering standards across multiple functions, not just within one team
 - Prior experience in a company going through real org restructuring, not just headcount growth, including navigating manager friction, attrition risk, and role ambiguity
 - Experience leading QA or a QA-to-engineering career path
 - Cybersecurity or SaaS background

Why You Will Love It

- Career Growth Opportunities: We believe in promoting from within and provide career progression paths, enabling our employees to advance in their careers
 - Work-Life Balance: We understand the importance of a healthy work-life balance, offering flexible hours and remote work options to promote a sustainable lifestyle
 - Collaborative Environment: Our company fosters a collaborative and inclusive workplace culture, where employees can collaborate and learn from each other's experiences
 - Employee Recognition: We value and recognize the contributions of our team members through awards, employee of the month programs, and other forms of acknowledgment. 
 - Competitive Compensation: We offer competitive salaries and performance-based bonuses, recognizing and rewarding the hard work and dedication of our team
 - Comprehensive Benefits: Our benefits package includes health insurance for employees and dependents, to support the overall well-being of our employees. We encourage learning and skilling, and aid our employees to continuously upskill themselves. 
 - Diversity and Inclusion: We are committed to diversity and inclusion, striving to create an environment where all employees feel valued, respected, and empowered

Join ArmorCode and lead the charge in reducing signal fatigue, prioritizing risk and streamlining key cybersecurity workflows. Apply today to be part of a close-knit team, dedicated to democratizing software security and helping build the safest software possible. 

Equal Opportunity

ArmorCode is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, genetic information, disability, or any other legally protected category. All qualified individuals are encouraged to apply and will receive consideration for employment regardless of their background or characteristics. We are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace where everyone is treated with respect and dignity.

data.description:
About Sirius AI

Sirius AI is an AI-first consulting and solutions firm serving financial services clients: banks, fintechs, payments companies and wealth managers. We help enterprises move from AI ideas to production-ready solutions using GenAI, agentic AI, ML platforms and advanced analytics, delivering measurable business impact. Our strength lies in combining FS domain expertise, hands-on AI delivery and enterprise-grade execution. 

Role Overview

We are looking for an Associate Director - AI Foundation Model Delivery to lead the delivery of foundation-model-based solutions for our financial services clients in the US. You will own how transformers-based models are selected, adapted, evaluated, deployed and governed in production, on time, on budget and to regulated-industry standards. 

This role sits at the intersection of applied research and enterprise delivery. You should be equally comfortable reviewing a fine-tuning experiment, debating model choice and inference cost with a client architect, and walking a model risk team through an evaluation pack. You will lead a team of AI and ML engineers, many of them early in their careers, and set the technical bar for how Sirius AI works with foundation models. 

Key Responsibilities

- Own end-to-end delivery of foundation model programs, from use-case framing and model selection through data preparation, adaptation, evaluation, deployment and ongoing monitoring. 
 - Lead model selection and build-vs-buy decisions across commercial and open-weight models, balancing accuracy, latency, cost, data residency and regulatory constraints. 
 - Direct model adaptation work including prompt engineering, RAG, supervised fine-tuning, parameter-efficient methods (LoRA/PEFT), instruction tuning and preference optimisation (e. g. DPO, RLHF). 
 - Oversee training and fine-tuning data pipelines: sourcing, curation, labelling, synthetic data generation, quality assurance and lineage, with strict handling of sensitive FS data. 
 - Build rigorous evaluation frameworks that combine automated benchmarks, domain-specific test sets, human review, hallucination and bias testing, safety and red-team evaluations. 
 - Take models into production with sound AIOps: versioning, reproducibility, deployment pipelines, inference optimisation (quantisation, distillation, batching, caching) and cost controls. 
 - Ensure every model meets enterprise AI governance, model risk management, security and privacy requirements, with audit-ready model documentation and validation evidence. 
 - Own delivery economics for foundation model work, including scope, estimates, GPU and compute budgets, staffing plans, utilisation and margin. 
 - Lead, mentor and grow a team of AI/ML engineers and data scientists; build training paths in foundation model techniques and FS domain knowledge. 
 - Build reusable assets such as fine-tuning recipes, evaluation harnesses, model cards and reference architectures that speed up delivery across engagements. 
 - Act as senior technical lead with client stakeholders and support pre-sales with solution design, model strategy, estimation and staffing plans. 

What We're Looking For

- Bachelor's or master's degree in computer science, Machine Learning, Statistics, Mathematics or a related field; a PhD is a plus. 
 - 8+ years of experience in AI/ML, data science or ML engineering, including at least 3-4 years working hands-on with LLMs or other foundation models. 
 - A proven track record of delivering foundation-model-based solutions into production in enterprise environments, with specific examples of fine-tuning, evaluation and deployment. 
 - Deep technical knowledge of transformer architectures, fine-tuning and alignment methods, RAG, model evaluation and inference optimisation. 
 - Strong Python skills and hands-on experience with frameworks such as PyTorch, Hugging Face Transformers, PEFT, vLLM/TGI and distributed training (e. g. CUDF, DASK, DeepSpeed, FSDP). 
 - Experience with cloud AI and GPU platforms (AWS SageMaker/Bedrock, Azure ML/Azure OpenAI, Google Vertex AI, Databricks) and AIOps tooling. 
 - Experience leading technical delivery teams in a consulting, AI services or product engineering environment, including developing junior talent. 
 - Ability to translate model trade-offs, risks and evaluation results into clear business and risk language for senior stakeholders. 

Good to Have

- Delivery experience with financial services clients in areas such as risk, fraud, compliance, credit, customer servicing or research. 
 - Familiarity with model risk management, model validation practices and responsible AI frameworks.

data.title: Senior Creatio Developer
data.description:
Company Description

SmartDev is an AI-powered software development company headquartered in Vietnam, part of the Verysell Group. We help global businesses deliver faster and build smarter - combining AI-driven development practices with deep expertise across fintech, healthcare, retail, and enterprise technology. Our team of engineers, architects, and AI specialists works across the full stack: from custom software and cloud solutions to generative AI, MLOps, and intelligent automation. At SmartDev, we believe that great architecture and AI-first thinking are a competitive advantage - and we build our teams accordingly. 

The company is at a pivotal point in our journey: transitioning from a pure IT outsourcing provider to an AI-enabled solutions partner. 

We have over 200 talented employees working both on-site and remote/hybrid at locations: 

- Danang: 81 Quang Trung, Hai Chau 1 ward, Hai Chau District, Danang
 - Hanoi: Zodiac building, 19 Duy Tan Street, Dich Vong Hau ward, Cau Giay District, Hanoi

Job Description

About The Role

SmartDev is a Creatio implementation partner delivering enterprise CRM programmes for banks. The current engagement is an on-premises banking CRM with fifteen integration interfaces to core banking and surrounding systems, five promotion environments, and the bank's own change control over every release. 

This is the technical core seat, and it is for someone already certified and already fluent in the platform. You write server-side logic and custom web services in versioned Creatio packages, build Freedom UI components where the standard palette is not enough, and own the integration contracts with the bank's systems. 

Two constraints are not negotiable here: the product core is never modified, only supported extension points are used; and external systems never touch the Creatio database directly - everything goes through OData, DataService and governed APIs. 

The third principle surprises most developers: you write code only where configuration genuinely cannot do the job. Your value on a low-code programme is measured as much by the code avoided as by the code shipped. 

Qualifications

Requirements

- Active Creatio Developer certification. Hard requirement for this opening; advanced-level certification is a significant plus. 
 - 3+ years developing on Creatio for real client implementations. 
 - Strong C# / . NET, plus working JavaScript and Angular for Freedom UI customization. 
 - Package architecture and versioning: file-system development backed by Git, dependency management, promotion across environments. 
 - Platform data access: EntitySchemaQuery, Entity, and the direct query classes, with the judgement to choose between them. 
 - Integration work you built yourself: REST/JSON, SOAP/XML, authentication, retries, idempotency, error handling. 
 - SQL Server performance: you can read an execution plan and fix a slow query rather than route around it. 
 - English at B2 or above. 

Strong advantages

- Banking or fintech domain. 
 - On-premises deployment and clio CLI automation. 
 - Redis, Docker, CI/CD pipeline construction. 
 - RTL or Arabic interface work. 
 - Experience mentoring developers new to the platform - you would be one of the most experienced platform people in the team. 

What You Will Own

- Server-side logic, custom services and Freedom UI components for assigned areas. 
 - Integration implementation against the bank's service bus and core systems. 
 - Code and configuration review across the team. 
 - Contribution to the practice's reusable accelerator set. 

Additional Information

What We Offer

- A senior seat in a practice being built now, with influence over its engineering standards. 
 - The integration block - the technically hardest and commercially most valuable part of the scope. 
 - An international banking programme with direct client exposure. 
 - Continued funded certification on the Creatio track. 
 - Competitive compensation, hybrid working, and a senior engineering organisation with SOC 2 Type II, ISO 27001 and PCI-DSS delivery credentials. 

Benefits

- International working environment with AI-driven strategic direction. 
 - 20 days of annual leave - Hybrid working mode. 
 - Premium healthcare package with PVI and comprehensive annual health check-ups
 - Competitive salary & 13th salary bonus
 - Lunch allowance to fuel your productivity. 
 - Engaging company culture with fun activities
 - Global collaboration - Work with both Vietnamese and international colleagues.

data.title: Software Development Engineer III
data.description:
Role: Software Development Engineer 3 - Backend

Function: Backend Engineering

Location: Aerocity, Delhi

Type: Full-time

Industry: Media Production, Broadcast Media, Online Media

About Company

The company is one of India's largest private FM radio networks. It reaches over 40 million listeners weekly across 49 cities, 1, 000+ towns, and 50, 000 villages. 

It is the only private FM station broadcasting from Jammu and Kashmir, with an international presence in Singapore and Bhutan. Its digital platform delivers curated music, news, and lifestyle content beyond traditional radio. 

A team of 740 media professionals powers a vibrant, creativity-driven culture rooted in local communities. Engineers work on real-scale problems - high-volume media delivery, content discovery, and personalization - with direct impact on millions of listeners. 

Position Overview

This role leads the design and delivery of production-grade backend services powering the company's audio, video, news, short-form content, and microdrama platform. The engineer will own architectural decisions, drive engineering standards, and mentor SDE 1/2 engineers across a distributed, high-traffic media ecosystem. Strong hands-on Go experience with production ownership is a hard requirement for this position. 

Role & Responsibilities

- Lead design and implementation of high-scale backend services for audio, video, news, microdrama, content discovery, and personalization. 
 - Build and own production Go services using REST, gRPC, messaging, caching, and relational/NoSQL databases on cloud infrastructure. 
 - Own architectural decisions, API contracts, technical trade-offs, and service reliability for complex business domains. 
 - Develop resilient BFF and API composition layers for web, mobile, partner, and internal clients. 
 - Drive code reviews, design reviews, testing strategies, engineering standards, and operational readiness across the team. 
 - Lead incident response, root-cause analysis, and engineering improvements to prevent recurrence. 
 - Mentor SDE 1 and SDE 2 engineers through pairing, technical guidance, and structured career development. 

Must Have Criteria

- 5-8 years of professional backend engineering experience, including distributed systems work. 
 - Strong hands-on production experience with Go - concurrency, context management, profiling, testing, and service design. 
 - Experience designing and operating scalable REST and gRPC APIs in production microservices or modular monolith architectures. 
 - Experience with relational and NoSQL databases, caching layers, distributed messaging, and asynchronous workflows. 
 - Demonstrated ownership of complex projects from technical planning through production deployment and ongoing operations. 
 - Proven ability to mentor engineers and measurably improve a team's engineering practices. 

Nice to Have

- Experience in a product-based company or high-traffic consumer platform (media, entertainment, streaming, news, or short-form video). 
 - Backend for Frontend (BFF) experience - API aggregation, GraphQL, channel-specific contracts, caching, and authorization. 
 - Experience with Node. js alongside Go, particularly for migration, integration, or legacy platform modernization. 
 - Production experience with Kafka or RabbitMQ, Redis, Elasticsearch, Kubernetes, Docker, and major cloud platforms. 
 - Experience with CDN, media transcoding, metadata, live or on-demand playback ecosystems, recommendation systems, or edge delivery. 

What We Offer

- Direct ownership of backend systems serving 40M+ weekly listeners across audio, video, and digital content. 
 - Opportunity to shape engineering culture, mentor a growing team, and drive adoption of Go and modern API patterns. 
 - Work on a platform spanning radio, streaming, short-form content, and microdrama - one of India's most diverse media ecosystems. 
 - Collaborative environment with product managers, architects, frontend, data, and platform teams.

data.title: Integration Architect - FHIR
data.description:
Job Title: FHIR Integration Architect

Job Type: Contractor

Location: Remote

About the Role

We're building an independent FHIR R4 interoperability layer that lets our CRM's clinical workflows starting with provider launch directly from inside the EHR, beginning with Oracle Health (Cerner) PowerChart. We need someone who can do both halves of this job well: design and personally validate the technical architecture, and lead the engineers full-stack, AI, and QA who build it. This is not a design-and-handoff role. You'll be in the SMART on FHIR launch flow when it breaks, in the code review when a mapping rule is wrong, and in the room when the team needs a call made. 

What You'll Own

Architecture & Solution Design

•        Own the end-to-end architecture of the FHIR layer - SMART on FHIR launch and OAuth2, the canonical data model, the EMR adapter framework, tenant isolation, and event-driven orchestration - and keep it extensible to future EMRs (Epic, athenahealth) and formats (HL7v2, X12) beyond the Cerner pilot. 

•        Make build-vs-buy and vendor decisions (self-hosted HAPI FHIR vs. a managed FHIR store; Keycloak vs. a commercial identity provider; build vs. adopt an interface engine) and can defend the reasoning to both engineers and non-technical stakeholders. 

•        Design the architecture against HIPAA-grade security and auditability requirements from day one - encryption, least-privilege access, audit trails - not as a pre-launch retrofit. 

•        Validate the architecture against real constraints: Oracle Health/Cerner's actual FHIR R4 conformance, US Core and Da Vinci PAS implementation guides, and the operational realities of a live, EHR-embedded launch - not just a reference diagram. 

Technical Leadership & Delivery

•        Lead a cross-functional engineering pod - full-stack engineers, AI/ML engineers, and QA engineers - setting technical direction, running code and design reviews, and removing blockers day to day. 

•        Translate the solution architecture into a sequenced, phased delivery plan (proof of concept → pilot → multi-client scale) and hold the team accountable to it. 

•        Own technical risk - surfacing integration blockers, vendor API gaps, and compliance findings early, and driving them to resolution rather than escalating and waiting. 

Integration, Standards & Compliance

•        Lead the Cerner/Oracle Health integration end to end: SMART App Launch (EHR launch, OAuth2/OIDC, fhirUser claims), Ignite APIs registration, and coordination with the client health system's Cerner administrators. 

•        Define and enforce conformance testing (ONC Inferno, US Core / Da Vinci PAS validation) before any integration is called production-ready. 

•        Partner with compliance and security stakeholders on HIPAA Security Risk Assessments, BAAs, and audit-trail requirements. 

Required Qualifications

•        8+ years in healthcare interoperability or integration engineering, including 3+ years in an architect or technical lead capacity. 

•        Deep, hands-on FHIR R4 experience - resource modeling, RESTful FHIR APIs, and at least one implementation guide (US Core at minimum). 

•        Direct experience implementing SMART App Launch (EHR and/or standalone launch), OAuth2/OIDC, and at least one major EHR's FHIR API - Cerner/Oracle Health experience specifically preferred given Phase 1 scope. 

•        Hands-on experience with HAPI FHIR or an equivalent FHIR server - server customization and multi-tenant partitioning are a strong plus. 

•        Cloud architecture experience on AWS or equivalent: containers, managed relational databases, event-driven services (queues/event buses), and core identity/security services. 

•        Proven experience leading or managing engineers - running reviews, setting direction, and being accountable for a team's delivery, not only your own. 

•        Working knowledge of healthcare data exchange beyond FHIR - HL7v2, X12, CDA - sufficient to plan for future extensibility. 

•        Solid understanding of HIPAA technical safeguards and healthcare data compliance requirements. 

Strongly Preferred

•        Direct, hands-on experience with Oracle Health (Cerner) Millennium / Ignite APIs and PowerChart SMART app registration - or the Epic App Orchard equivalent. 

•        Experience with Keycloak or another open-source identity provider, including custom extension/SPI development. 

•        Familiarity with Da Vinci implementation guides (PAS, CRD, DTR) and FHIR-based prior authorization workflows. 

•        Experience in patient support programs, prior authorization, or healthcare CRM domains. 

•        Experience standing up a healthcare integration function from near-zero on a small team, not only operating within an already-mature enterprise integration group. 

•        Familiarity with applying AI/ML to healthcare data mapping, document generation, or clinical NLP - relevant given the AI engineers on this team. 

Tech Stack You'll Work With

FHIR & integration standards - FHIR R4, SMART App Launch v2, US Core, Da Vinci PAS, OAuth2 / OIDC, HL7v2 (future-facing)

FHIR server - HAPI FHIR (JPA server), multi-tenant partitioning

Identity - Keycloak, custom SMART-launch extension (SPI)

Cloud / infra - AWS - Fargate/ECS, Aurora PostgreSQL, DynamoDB, API Gateway, WAF, EventBridge/SQS, Secrets Manager, KMS, CloudWatch/OpenSearch

IaC / delivery - Terraform or AWS CDK, CI/CD (GitHub Actions or CodePipeline), Docker

Target EHR (Phase 1) - Oracle Health / Cerner Millennium (Ignite APIs, PowerChart chart-toolbar launch)

Conformance testing - ONC Inferno test kit (incl. Da Vinci PAS), Synthea synthetic data

data.title: Head of AI Engineering & Center of Excellence (CoE)
data.description:
JOB DESCRIPTION

Head of AI Engineering

& Center of Excellence (CoE)

1. Role Overview

Our company is seeking a senior technology leader to establish and lead its AI Engineering Center of Excellence (CoE), driving the adoption of AI across enterprise engineering, insurance technology platforms, product development, and operational workflows. 

The Head of AI Engineering & CoE will define AI engineering strategy, establish reusable AI architectures and frameworks, enable AI-assisted software development, and deliver scalable, secure, measurable AI solutions. The role combines technical leadership, architecture governance, engineering enablement, and people development. 

A core objective is to turn individual AI experiments and isolated implementations into reusable enterprise capabilities that support Solartis's product-platform strategy. 

1. Key Responsibilities

A. AI Engineering Strategy and CoE Leadership

Establish the CoE charter, operating model, service offerings, engagement model, and delivery priorities. 

Develop an AI engineering roadmap aligned with product strategy, technology priorities, and business objectives. 

Identify opportunities to standardize AI capabilities and reduce duplicated implementations. 

Define reference architectures, reusable patterns, implementation guidelines, and approved technology frameworks. 

Partner with the CTO and engineering leadership to prioritize AI investments based on business value, feasibility, risk, and expected return. 

Establish processes to evaluate AI initiatives, productionize successful pilots, and retire ineffective or duplicated solutions. 

B. Enterprise AI Architecture and Shared Frameworks

Define scalable architectures for LLMs, SLMs, RAG, vector search, orchestration, and model integration. 

Design reusable AI services, APIs, SDKs, libraries, reference implementations, and deployment patterns. 

Establish patterns for model selection, prompt management, context engineering, embeddings, document processing, inference, and lifecycle management. 

Evaluate AI frameworks, models, infrastructure, and platforms for performance, cost, security, scalability, and maintainability. 

Define integration patterns for AI capabilities within existing platforms, services, applications, and development workflows. 

Guide build-versus-buy decisions across managed AI services, open-source models, and internally developed capabilities. 

C. AI-Assisted Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC)

Define and implement AI-assisted SDLC practices across requirements analysis, code generation, code understanding, test generation, code review, documentation, debugging, and maintenance. 

Establish standards for responsible use of AI coding assistants and developer productivity tools. 

Build reusable workflows and accelerators integrated with development environments, repositories, CI/CD pipelines, and quality processes. 

Measure impact on cycle time, defect rates, rework, code quality, and developer experience. 

Ensure AI adoption complements peer review, automated testing, security scanning, and release governance. 

Work with engineering leaders to drive adoption and develop team-level enablement plans. 

D. RAG, MCP, Agentic AI, and Reusable AI Services

Architect production-grade RAG solutions covering ingestion, parsing, chunking, metadata extraction, indexing, retrieval, reranking, and grounded generation. 

Establish reusable patterns for agents, tool orchestration, workflow automation, context management, and human-in-the-loop processing. 

Define appropriate Model Context Protocol (MCP) patterns for controlled access to enterprise tools, data, and services. 

Develop common components for model access, prompt/context management, retrieval, tool integration, evaluation, telemetry, and error handling. 

Define safeguards for permissions, data access, execution boundaries, auditability, failure recovery, and human approval. 

Apply agentic AI selectively where it delivers measurable value and avoid unnecessary complexity in deterministic workflows. 

E. AI-Assisted Insurance Content Processing and Parser Initiatives

Lead architecture for processing insurance documents, policy forms, underwriting guidelines, rating manuals, and related content. 

Guide pipelines that transform semi-structured and unstructured content into validated, structured insurance product definitions. 

Establish reusable capabilities for classification, parsing, extraction, semantic interpretation, rule identification, and structured output generation. 

Ensure extracted content is traceable to source documents and suitable for downstream product configuration and processing. 

Design human review and exception handling for ambiguous, incomplete, conflicting, or low-confidence outputs. 

Define evaluation datasets and measures for extraction precision/recall, completeness, rule interpretation, and downstream usability. 

Promote reusable parsers and validation components over isolated customer-specific implementations, in collaboration with insurance domain and platform teams. 

F. AI Engineering Standards, Quality, and Governance

Define standards for AI design, implementation, testing, deployment, monitoring, and maintenance. 

Establish evaluation frameworks for accuracy, groundedness, robustness, reliability, latency, cost, and use-case suitability. 

Implement safeguards against prompt injection, unauthorized data exposure, insecure tool execution, and other AI-specific threats. 

Define model and prompt versioning, traceability, observability, regression evaluation, and controlled production releases. 

Establish practices for sensitive data handling, access control, retention, audit logging, and external AI services. 

Partner with security, compliance, legal, and enterprise architecture stakeholders on applicable requirements. 

Ensure solutions have appropriate fallbacks, exception handling, human oversight, and production-readiness reviews. 

G. Technical Leadership, Mentoring, and Enablement

Provide technical leadership to AI architects and designated AI engineering teams, with accountability for architecture quality and capability development. 

Mentor existing architects in AI solution design, reusable architecture, model integration, evaluation, and production engineering. 

Establish architecture reviews, technical communities of practice, learning paths, workshops, and hands-on reference projects. 

Guide teams in evaluating alternatives, challenging assumptions, conducting impact analysis, and making sound technical decisions. 

Develop architecture decision records, implementation templates, reusable documentation, and engineering playbooks. 

Build internal capability so teams can implement AI solutions independently within agreed standards. 

H. Business Value, Delivery, and Continuous Improvement

Translate opportunities into prioritized initiatives with defined outcomes, milestones, resource needs, and success measures. 

Partner with product, engineering, and business teams to improve developer productivity, reduce manual effort, accelerate content processing, and strengthen platform scalability. 

Maintain visibility into AI initiative status, adoption, risks, operating costs, and realized benefits. 

Track production outcomes beyond proof-of-concept delivery and optimize duplicated capabilities, infrastructure, and model costs. 

Communicate progress, risks, decisions, and measurable outcomes to the CTO and senior leadership. 

3. Leadership and Decision-Making Expectations

Establish and execute the AI engineering roadmap within priorities agreed with the CTO. 

Own the technical direction and engineering standards of the AI CoE. 

Lead and develop AI architects and designated AI engineering resources. 

Make decisions within agreed enterprise architecture principles and delegated authority; escalate material cross-platform, security, and investment decisions as required. 

Challenge designs that introduce unnecessary customization, duplication, operational complexity, or technical risk. 

Balance innovation with engineering discipline, production readiness, maintainability, and measurable business outcomes. 

Influence teams beyond the direct reporting line and enable adoption across the organization. 

4. Required Qualifications and Experience

Bachelor's or master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, AI, Data Science, or a related discipline. 

Typically 15+ years of relevant software engineering, architecture, or technology experience, including substantial practical experience with AI/ML and modern AI application architectures. 

Demonstrated experience leading AI engineering initiatives, architecture practices, technical teams, or enterprise AI programs. 

Strong practical knowledge of LLM applications, RAG, embeddings, vector databases, prompt engineering, and model evaluation. 

Experience designing production-grade AI services, APIs, orchestration workflows, and reusable frameworks. 

Practical understanding of agentic AI, tool integration, workflow orchestration, and MCP where relevant. 

Experience with Python, APIs, distributed systems, CI/CD, automated testing, and cloud-based application deployment. 

Experience evaluating AI models and frameworks for quality, latency, cost, security, and operational complexity. 

Knowledge of AI application security, data protection, observability, model lifecycle management, and responsible AI practices. 

Demonstrated ability to mentor architects and engineers, influence technical direction, and establish standards across teams. 

Strong communication skills, including the ability to explain technical decisions to executives, business stakeholders, and engineering teams. 

5. Preferred Qualifications

Experience establishing an enterprise AI Engineering CoE or equivalent AI enablement function. 

Experience with comparable enterprise AI platforms and cloud-native AI services. 

Experience integrating AI-assisted software development tools into engineering workflows. 

Experience in insurance technology, policy administration, rating, product configuration, or document-intensive enterprise platforms. 

Experience with intelligent document processing, information extraction, rules extraction, or structured-content generation. 

Experience with enterprise knowledge systems, metadata-driven architectures, and reusable platform services. 

Familiarity with AI governance frameworks, evaluation methodologies, and production risk management. 

6. Leadership Profile

The ideal candidate combines deep technical credibility with the ability to establish a sustainable engineering practice. They can move between architecture design, hands-on problem solving, technical mentoring, organizational enablement, and executive communication. 

The candidate should build systems and teams that scale, establish standards without unnecessary bureaucracy, and translate emerging AI technologies into practical business capabilities. 

Ultimate expectation: Establish an AI Engineering CoE that strengthens Solartis's product-platform strategy, improves engineering effectiveness, accelerates AI adoption, and builds long-term organizational capability.

- Generational Wealth: A 5X valuation jump in 2 years makes our ESOPs a real path to financial upside. This role carries a leadership-level ESOP grant sized for someone who will own the outcome, not just contribute to it. 
 - Real Authority: You inherit a working platform, a paying enterprise customer base, and a 12-person organization, with the mandate and budget to reshape all three. 
 - Comprehensive Wellbeing: Plum Gold Health Benefits with zero waiting periods, and Dental & Vision cover. 
 - Pet-Friendly Culture: We provide support for Veterinary Care because your pets are family too. 
 - Work & Play at HSR: A standard 5-day week in a high-energy office featuring on-site cricket nets and a basketball court, plus international team offsites. 

Role Overview

You will own the entire technology organization - Engineering, QA, DevOps, and Delivery - and be accountable for its people, its architecture, its reliability, and its cost. You will work directly with the founders on company strategy and execution. We are looking for someone who has already run the stage we are entering: a platform doing an order of magnitude more than ours, and enterprise customers whose security teams do not take a founder's word for it. This is not a role for someone whose best work is behind them. It is for a player-coach who has scaled a B2B SaaS engineering org before and still wants to be in the code. 

Key Responsibilities

- Engineering Organization: Grow the technology organization from 12 to 40+ across Engineering, QA, DevOps, and Delivery. Hire and develop Engineering Managers and Tech Leads, run performance management, and put in place the hiring bar, career ladders, and rituals that let the org scale without losing its speed. 
 - Platform Architecture & Scale: Own the workflow orchestration engine and agentic execution substrate. Take it from 100M+ executions a month to 1B+, with multi-region deployment, tenant isolation, and 99. 99% availability, while paying down the architectural debt that any 0-to-1 system carries. 
 - AI Platform Strategy: Set the technical direction for the agentic layer, RAG and knowledge infrastructure, model routing, evaluation, and fine-tuning. Make the build-vs-buy calls, decide when a task needs a fine-tuned model versus a prompt, and hold the AI team to evaluation rigor that survives contact with enterprise data. 
 - Reliability & Operations: Define SLOs, run incident management and on-call, and own the observability stack (Grafana, Prometheus, Jaeger, LangFuse, LangSmith). Reduce mean time to detect and resolve for both classical failures and non-deterministic LLM failures. 
 - Enterprise Readiness & Security: Lead SOC 2 Type II and ISO 27001, data residency, and Meta/WhatsApp Business Platform compliance. Own security reviews and vendor due diligence with banks and regulated enterprises, and be the engineering signature on the answers. 
 - Delivery & Execution: Partner with product and the founders to turn the roadmap into a predictable delivery cadence. Own release management, quality gates, and the commitments the company makes to enterprise customers. 
 - Cost & Unit Economics: Own infrastructure and LLM spend as a line item. Drive gross margin through inference cost optimization, model routing, caching, and infrastructure right-sizing, and report on it like a P&L owner. 
 - Forward-Deployed Enterprise Engagement: Sit across the table from customer CTOs and architecture teams at Meta-, IndusInd-, and VFS Global-scale accounts. Win technical evaluations, unblock production deployments on-site, and translate what you hear into the roadmap. 
 - Hands-On Leadership: Write and review design documents, review critical pull requests, and build features end to end yourself when the org needs it - schema, service, API, and UI, shipped to production, not handed off. Own the deployment path: you can take a change through CI/CD, Kubernetes, and AWS without a DevOps engineer in the loop, and you understand the infrastructure well enough to make the on-call calls yourself. Debug production when it matters. Your credibility with the team is earned in the code. 

Our Tech Stack

- Core Platform: Node. js and TypeScript services, MongoDB clusters, Redis, event-driven pipelines (Kafka, BullMQ, RabbitMQ), Kubernetes and Docker on AWS, and a custom DAG-based workflow orchestration engine with durable, idempotent execution. 
 - AI and Orchestration: LangGraph for multi-agent workflows, Anthropic Claude via API (primary LLM), Claude Code and Antigravity for AI-assisted development. 
 - Search and Retrieval: AWS OpenSearch for full-text and semantic search, PGVector for vector similarity within Postgres, Pinecone and Qdrant for vector workloads. 
 - Backend and Infrastructure: Next. js, AWS Lambda, Postgres, Supabase. 
 - Observability: Grafana, Prometheus, Jaeger, Sentry, LangFuse, LangSmith. 
 - Design and Prototyping: Lovable for design reference and rapid UI scaffolding. 

What We're Looking For

- 10+ years of engineering experience, including 5+ years leading engineering organizations at B2B SaaS companies. You have managed managers, not just engineers, and have grown an org from roughly 10 to 50+ while keeping it shipping. 
 - You have run the stage we are entering. You have been the senior-most engineering leader while a company scaled from low single-digit millions to $20M+ ARR, and you know what breaks in the org, the architecture, and the customer relationships along the way. 
 - Distributed systems at a scale beyond ours: you have built or operated multi-tenant platforms handling 1B+ events or executions a month, across regions, at 99. 99% availability, and you carry the incident post-mortems to prove it. 
 - Genuine ML depth, not just LLM API fluency. You have trained or fine-tuned models, designed evaluation frameworks, and can reason about model behavior, training dynamics, and failure modes from first principles. You will be the person who raises the bar for our AI engineers, so you need to be able to see over it. 
 - Hands-on experience productionizing agentic systems and RAG - orchestration, tool use, memory and context management, retrieval quality evaluation, and the cost, latency, and reliability engineering that keeps them running under real enterprise load. 
 - You have led a company through SOC 2 Type II or ISO 27001 and passed security due diligence with banks or similarly regulated enterprises. Compliance is a system you have built, not a checkbox you have watched someone else tick. 
 - A proven hiring record: you have built interview loops, hiring bars, and career ladders, hired senior engineers and managers who stayed, and can show the org chart you left behind. 
 - Still technical, and provably so. In the last twelve months you have shipped a production feature from scratch, deployed it yourself, and been paged for it. You are fluent in the DevOps layer - Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD pipelines, AWS networking and IAM, infrastructure as code - not just conversant with it, and you can stand up or debug an environment without waiting on someone. The team should want you in the room when things break, and trust you to fix it. 
 - Fluent communication with founders, boards, and customer CTOs. You can defend an architecture to a bank's security team and explain a gross margin tradeoff to an investor in the same afternoon. 
 - Bonus: experience with the WhatsApp Business Platform, CPaaS or messaging infrastructure, CRM and marketing automation, or voice AI.

data.description:
Zscaler (NASDAQ: ZS) accelerates digital transformation so customers can be more agile, efficient, resilient, and secure. The Zscaler Zero Trust Exchange platform protects thousands of customers from cyberattacks and data loss by securely connecting users, devices, and applications in any location. Distributed across 200+ public data centers globally and thousands of private sites at the edge, the SASE-based Zero Trust Exchange is the world's largest in-line cloud security platform. 

We believe the future of work is Human + AI and are building an AI-native enterprise where human potential is amplified by machine intelligence to solve the world's hardest security challenges. Driven by deep customer obsession, we are committed to the mission, outcome, and to each other. We bring these commitments to life through three core behaviors: ownership and collaboration, trust through outcomes and impact, and a challenge culture with ongoing feedback. Ready to make an impact at the company pioneering security transformation in the AI era? Join us at Zscaler. 

Role

We are looking for a Sr. Staff Software Development Engineer. This is a hybrid role based in Bangalore, reporting to the Senior Manager, Software Development Engineering. You will join the Central Authority team working on the control plane for the Zscaler Internet Access (ZIA) product, which has redefined how security services are delivered in the cloud. You will bring your expertise in security protocols and services to a team that built the world's largest cloud security platform from the ground up.

data.description:
Staff Engineer - AI Data Platform | ML Infrastructure & Evaluation

Location: Viman Nagar, Pune (Hybrid 3 days onsite)

Experience: 7+ years

We are looking for a Staff Engineer to lead the architecture and technical direction of an AI Data Platform focused on ML infrastructure, model evaluation, observability, and production reliability. 

Role Overview

This role is focused on designing and owning the long-term architecture for ML evaluation and observability systems that measure model quality, identify regressions, and monitor AI performance in production. You will work closely with AI/ML platform and computer vision teams and provide technical direction across the engineering organization. 

Key Responsibilities

• Own the architecture and technical roadmap for a three-tier ML evaluation framework covering model-level benchmarking, end-to-end pipeline evaluation, and longitudinal performance analysis. 

• Define versioned test-set governance and regression-detection architecture to identify model and pipeline regressions before production. 

• Lead the technical direction for multimodal AI debugging and evaluation infrastructure. 

• Own production model observability, including tracing, performance monitoring, escalation tracking, alerting, and production health signals. 

• Define instrumentation standards across training and inference pipelines so model behavior can be measured end to end. 

• Establish approaches for model drift detection, false-positive management, confidence scoring, and model-quality monitoring. 

• Drive cost, latency, and accuracy trade-offs for production ML workloads, including inference and model escalation strategies. 

• Act as a technical escalation point for model-quality issues and lead root-cause investigations.
