data.title: Chief Technology Officer, Healthcare AI
data.description:
Hiring for Moative - via Flexiple, the recruiting partner on this role. 

About the Company

Moative is an AI company that partners with mid-market businesses in asset-heavy, regulated industries to co-build industry-specific agentic and machine-learning solutions, then scales them across the industry through revenue-share and equity-linked models. The founders have built and sold two companies, one of them in AI, and the 20+ person team of AI/ML engineers, data scientists and mathematicians comes from IITs, IISc, CERN, UZH and IBM Research. Its healthcare business builds AI agents that run revenue-cycle and administrative work for US healthcare practices. 

About the Role

As CTO for Moative's healthcare business, you'll lead technology for an AI management services organisation (AI MSO) for US healthcare practices. It combines operational expertise, data infrastructure and AI to manage and improve revenue-cycle and administrative workflows, automating tasks progressively with clear controls and human accountability. You'll own technology strategy, platform architecture and the engineering organisation, and stay hands-on in architecture, prototypes, code reviews and hard production problems. The role is based in Chennai (Bengaluru is possible), hybrid with 3 days a week in person with the founders and the healthcare AI pod. 

What you'll do

- Own technology strategy, platform architecture and engineering standards for the healthcare AI MSO
 - Work with founders, practice owners and billing leaders to assess workflows, set baselines and prioritise by business value and feasibility
 - Design solutions across EHRs, practice-management systems, clearinghouses and payer portals, covering payer-portal agents, voice payer follow-up, denial management and payment posting
 - Define the practice data architecture: claims, remittances, EOBs and denial codes as validated, traceable data, with isolation between practices and de-identified analytics
 - Set healthcare privacy, security and compliance controls, plus production evaluation, monitoring, escalation and release criteria
 - Make build-versus-buy, vendor and model decisions, and own engineering and infrastructure budgets
 - Hire and develop engineers, data scientists and technical leads, and represent Moative's technology to practice owners, partners and investors

What you bring

- 15+ years of engineering and technology leadership, with recent hands-on architecture, prototyping and production troubleshooting
 - You've built and scaled a product or technology business as a founder, CTO or senior engineering leader, with clear customer adoption and commercial results
 - Experience delivering healthcare or RCM products, with a practical grasp of billing workflows, claim submission, payer interactions, denials, appeals and payment posting
 - You've led teams that deploy and support AI in live operations, including LLM applications or agents with evaluation, monitoring and human escalation
 - Deep experience integrating and modelling fragmented operational data, including multi-customer platforms with clear data isolation
 - Strong Python, SQL and cloud architecture on AWS, Azure or GCP
 - Technical controls for sensitive healthcare data: access management, audit trails, secure logging, vendor access and incident response
 - Experience owning technology budgets and working directly with CXOs, founders and investors

Nice to have

- Building for US outpatient practices, MSOs or RCM companies
 - Taking a company through an acquisition, merger or exit, including technical diligence
 - Turning services engagements into reusable products
 - Healthcare data exchange (claims, remittances, EHR, clearinghouses), process mining, or browser and voice agents for operations

data.title: AI Engineer – Healthcare & RCM
data.description:
Hiring for Moative - via Flexiple, the recruiting partner on this role. 

About the Company

Moative is an AI company that partners with mid-market businesses in asset-heavy, regulated industries to co-build industry-specific agentic and machine-learning solutions, then scales them across the industry through revenue-share and equity-linked models. The founders have built and sold two companies, one of them in AI, and the 20+ person team of AI/ML engineers, data scientists and mathematicians comes from IITs, IISc, CERN, UZH and IBM Research. Its healthcare business builds AI agents that run revenue-cycle and administrative work for US healthcare practices. 

About the Role

You'll build and deploy AI agents, automations and data workflows for US healthcare revenue cycle management (RCM). You'll own each workflow end to end, from understanding how billing teams work today through deployment, evaluation and ongoing improvement. You'll work alongside AI/ML engineers, data scientists and domain specialists, directly with billing and operations teams. The role is based in Chennai, hybrid with 3 days a week in the office. 

What you'll do

- Build agents for payer-portal automation: claim status checks and EOB retrieval across inconsistent portal layouts
 - Build voice agents for payer follow-up, integrating speech-to-text and text-to-speech
 - Turn fragmented healthcare data (scanned PDFs, EOBs, ERAs, incomplete records) into validated, structured inputs
 - Analyse claim journeys and revenue-cycle bottlenecks and surface AI-assisted insights into practice performance
 - Evaluate accuracy and completion rates on representative test sets, and monitor failures and operating costs
 - Add retries, exception queues and human escalation to every workflow
 - Apply privacy and security controls: access restrictions, audit trails, and no patient data in logs or model inputs
 - Measure outcomes such as time saved, claims processed and turnaround, with the teams using the systems

What you bring

- 2-5 years of professional AI engineering (not just internships or academic projects), including systems used in real operations
 - You've deployed and supported an LLM application or AI agent in production, using RAG, tool calling or multi-step workflows, and can explain how it was evaluated, what failed and how you fixed it
 - Hands-on AI or automation work on healthcare RCM workflows such as claim status, AR follow-up, denials, payment posting or payer interactions
 - Strong production Python and SQL, API integration, and working JavaScript/TypeScript
 - Browser or UI automation with Playwright, Selenium or UiPath, with error handling and human escalation
 - Deployment and monitoring on AWS, Azure or GCP using containers, version control and automated testing
 - Experience handling sensitive data with access controls and secure logging

Nice to have

- Delivering for US healthcare providers, RCM companies or payer-facing operations
 - Practice-management or EHR integrations, payer portals, EOB or ERA data
 - Voice agents, MCP integrations, Kubernetes, serverless or event-driven architectures

data.title: Senior Electrical Engineer
data.description:
Hiring for Lapmaster Wolters - via Flexiple, the recruiting partner on this role. 

About the Company

Lapmaster Wolters is a global leader in high-precision machine tools, with over 200 years of history. Their machines lap, polish and grind surfaces to extreme flatness for 20+ industries worldwide. The company has 600+ employees and revenue above €250 million. 

Lapmaster Wolters is now expanding into advanced semiconductor packaging, one of the fastest-growing areas in chips, driven by AI and next-gen computing. LW Semiconductor India, based in Bangalore, is the new team designing and building this equipment. Joining now means working on cutting-edge semiconductor machines from the ground up. 

About the Role

Lapmaster Wolters is seeking a Senior Electrical Engineer to own the electrical and power design of semiconductor packaging machines, from concept through commissioning. Based on site in Bengaluru, you will work closely with mechanical, controls, and manufacturing teams to develop robust machine electrical systems for high-precision applications. This role is well suited to an engineer who enjoys turning system requirements into practical designs, solving issues on the shop floor, and supporting equipment through installation and customer handover. 

Key Responsibilities

- Design electrical architectures, schematics, panel layouts, wiring drawings, and power distribution for semiconductor packaging equipment. 
 - Select and integrate PLCs, motion components, sensors, drives, safety devices, and related electrical hardware. 
 - Own electrical BOMs, wiring standards, grounding, cable routing, and machine safety compliance. 
 - Support build, testing, FAT/SAT, debugging, and commissioning activities at the Bengaluru site and customer locations as needed. 
 - Work with cross-functional teams to resolve design gaps, reduce machine downtime, and improve system reliability. 
 - Prepare technical documentation, change records, and support engineering reviews throughout the project lifecycle. 

Requirements

- Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering or a related discipline. 
 - 6+ years of experience in machine design, industrial automation, or capital equipment engineering. 
 - Strong hands-on experience with electrical schematics, control panels, and machine power systems. 
 - Good understanding of PLC-based systems, motion control, sensors, safety circuits, and industrial communication. 
 - Ability to troubleshoot complex machine issues during assembly and commissioning. 
 - Experience working with semiconductor, packaging, or high-precision manufacturing equipment is preferred. 
 - Strong communication skills and the ability to work independently in an on-site engineering environment.

data.title: Lead Site Reliability Engineer
data.description:
Overview

About Business Unit: 

The Product team forms the crux of our pofwerful platforms and helps connect millions of customers worldwide with the brands that matter most to them. This team of innovative problem solvers develops and builds products that position Epsilon as a differentiator, encouraging an open and balanced marketplace built on respect for individuals, where every brand interaction holds value. Our full-cycle product engineering and data teams chart the future and set new benchmarks for our products, by using industry standard methodologies and sophisticated capabilities in data, machine learning, and artificial intelligence. Driven by a passion for delivering smart end-to-end solutions, this team plays a key role in Epsilon's success story. 

What You Will Enjoy In This Role

The Epsilon Activation Delivery Platform team builds the core frameworks and connectors powering our audience activation business, processing and moving trillions of user events every month to some of the world's largest advertising and Connected TV platforms, including Meta, Google, Amazon, LG, and Samsung. 

As our dedicated Quality & Reliability lead, you will define and drive the quality engineering and platform reliability strategy for the Activation Delivery Platform. You will architect scalable test automation and data-validation frameworks, establish CI/CD quality gates, and strengthen platform reliability through observability, SLOs, and disciplined incident management practices. 

You will play a critical role in establishing and driving engineering quality standards across an engineering team distributed across the US and India. Working closely with engineering leadership, data engineers, product managers, and partner teams, you will ensure that quality, reliability, and operational excellence are embedded throughout the software development lifecycle. 

Your work will directly contribute to delivering accurate, reliable, and resilient activation systems that meet our customers' expectations and support the scale and performance of our global business. 

Reporting Structure & Day-to-Day Collaboration

This role reports to the Senior Manager of Engineering and collaborates closely with data engineers, product managers, engineering leadership, and partner teams across the US and India. 

You will participate in architecture and design reviews, code reviews, release planning, and the end-to-end delivery of critical business capabilities. You will also work with broader People Cloud engineering teams to leverage and align with established engineering frameworks, platforms, processes, and reliability standards. 

Why We Are Looking For You

Operate at True Scale: Help ensure that pipelines processing and routing trillions of records every month remain accurate, observable, and resilient. The quality standards and reliability practices you establish will directly protect customer experiences and critical business outcomes. 

Shape Quality on a Modern Data Stack: Architect and implement test automation, data-validation, and observability frameworks across a modern big data ecosystem using Spark, Scala, Python, AWS EMR, and Databricks. Work with distributed data systems, testing data outputs, APIs, and integrations at a significant scale. 

Establish Engineering Quality Standards: Take ownership of defining and driving quality engineering practices for the Activation Delivery Platform, using and extending established frameworks, processes, and engineering standards across the broader People Cloud ecosystem. 

See Your Impact: Directly influence the reliability and quality of integrations connecting our business to the world's largest technology, social media, and Connected TV platforms, including Meta, Google, Amazon, LG, and Samsung. 

Elevate Engineering Excellence: Drive consistent adoption of quality engineering standards, automation practices, and reliability principles across a 12-person engineering team distributed across the US and India, enabling predictable releases, faster feedback cycles, and greater engineering confidence. 

Pioneer AI-Assisted Quality Engineering: Leverage AI-assisted development tools such as Cursor to accelerate test creation, debugging, failure analysis, and incident triage. Explore and introduce agentic workflows that improve the efficiency and effectiveness of quality and reliability engineering. 

Click here to view how Epsilon transforms marketing with 1 View, 1 Vision and 1 Voice. 

Responsibilities

- Own the Test Automation Strategy
 - Design and implement scalable test automation frameworks for Spark-based (Scala/Python) data pipelines and platform connectors. 
 - Establish comprehensive testing strategies covering unit, integration, contract, end-to-end, and regression testing. 
 - Integrate automated test suites into the development lifecycle to ensure consistent quality validation with every code change. 
 - Establish reusable testing patterns, engineering guidelines, and standard processes across the team. 
 - Validate Data Quality at Scale
 - Design and implement data-validation and data-quality frameworks to ensure schema integrity, completeness, accuracy, consistency, and freshness. 
 - Build automated validation and reconciliation mechanisms for large-scale distributed datasets. 
 - Establish quality checks across data ingestion, transformation, processing, and outbound activation pipelines. 
 - Ensure data integrity and correctness before information is delivered to external partners such as Meta, Google, Amazon, LG, and Samsung. 
 - Integrate data-quality checks into both CI/CD workflows and production environments. 
 - Build Quality Gates into CI/CD
 - Establish automated quality gates and release criteria across CI/CD pipelines. 
 - Define and enforce appropriate test coverage, code quality, security, and reliability thresholds. 
 - Implement automated regression testing and validation as part of continuous integration and deployment workflows. 
 - Promote safe deployment practices, early defect detection, and continuous feedback mechanisms. 
 - Align quality engineering practices with established People Cloud engineering standards and delivery processes. 
 - Drive Platform Reliability and Operational Excellence
 - Define and implement Service Level Objectives (SLOs), Service Level Indicators (SLIs), and Service Level Agreements (SLAs) for critical pipelines and platform connectors. 
 - Establish comprehensive observability through metrics, structured logging, distributed tracing, alerting, and operational dashboards. 
 - Monitor and improve the reliability, availability, performance, and resilience of AWS EMR and Databricks workloads. 
 - Drive effective incident management, root cause analysis, and preventive actions to minimize recurring issues. 
 - Establish reliability practices that improve Mean Time to Detect (MTTD), Mean Time to Recover (MTTR), and overall platform stability. 
 - Drive Engineering Standards and Continuous Improvement
 - Establish and champion quality engineering standards, development guidelines, and automation procedures across the engineering team. 
 - Collaborate with engineering leadership to integrate quality and reliability practices into architecture, design, development, and release processes. 
 - Find opportunities to improve engineering productivity, reduce technical debt, and strengthen platform resilience. 
 - Leverage existing People Cloud engineering frameworks, tools, and processes while finding opportunities for platform-specific improvements. 
 - Champion AI-Assisted Quality Engineering
 - Leverage AI-assisted tools such as Cursor to accelerate test development, debugging, code analysis, and failure investigation. 
 - Explore AI driven approaches for automated test generation, defect prediction, and intelligent failure analysis. 
 - Evaluate and introduce agentic workflows that can improve test coverage, accelerate incident triage, and reduce manual engineering effort. 
Qualifications

What You'll Bring with You

- 8-10 years of overall software engineering experience, with substantial experience in Quality Engineering, Test Automation, Data Quality, or Platform Reliability. 
 - Proven experience designing, architecting, and implementing scalable test automation frameworks, covering unit, integration, contract, and end-to-end testing. 
 - Strong programming skills in Python and/or Scala, along with fluent SQL skills for validating and reconciling large datasets. 
 - Hands-on experience testing distributed data pipelines, including data-quality and data-validation checks covering schema, completeness, accuracy, consistency, and freshness. 
 - Experience designing and implementing CI/CD pipelines with automated quality gates, coverage thresholds, and release standards. 
 - Working knowledge of Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) principles, including SLOs, SLIs, SLAs, observability, incident management, and root cause analysis. 
 - Practical experience with AWS cloud environments and exposure to distributed data processing frameworks such as Apache Spark on EMR or Databricks. 
 - Demonstrated ability to establish engineering standards, influence development practices, and drive adoption of quality and reliability practices across engineering teams. 
 - Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to troubleshoot complex distributed systems and data-related issues. 
 - Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to engage partners, understand business requirements, and translate them into effective technical solutions. 

Technical Skills

Must-have

- Strong programming proficiency in Python and/or Scala, with hands-on experience developing automation frameworks and engineering solutions. 
 - Strong SQL skills for large-scale data validation, reconciliation, and data-quality analysis. 
 - Hands-on experience with Apache Spark and distributed data processing environments. 
 - Experience designing and implementing test automation frameworks using PyTest, ScalaTest, JUnit, or equivalent frameworks. 
 - Strong understanding of unit, integration, contract, regression, and end-to-end testing methodologies. 
 - Experience building automated data-quality and validation frameworks covering schema integrity, completeness, accuracy, consistency, and freshness. 
 - Experience integrating automated testing and quality gates into CI/CD pipelines using Jenkins, Bamboo, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI/CD, or equivalent. 
 - Practical experience with AWS cloud services, particularly EMR, S3, and CloudWatch. 
 - Exposure to Databricks or equivalent distributed data processing platforms. 
 - Experience with REST API testing, integration testing, and contract validation. 
 - Working knowledge of SRE practices, including SLOs, SLIs, SLAs, incident management, and root cause analysis. 
 - Understanding observability practices, including metrics, logging, monitoring, alerting, and operational dashboards. 

Good-to-have

- Experience with data-quality frameworks such as Great Expectations, Deequ, or equivalent solutions. 
 - Experience with Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, and advanced Spark optimization techniques. 
 - Familiarity with observability tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, ELK Stack, or OpenSearch. 
 - Experience with distributed tracing, chaos engineering, resilience testing, and automated recovery mechanisms. 
 - Exposure AI-assisted development tools such as Cursor or GitHub Copilot for test generation, debugging, and code analysis. 
 - Experience exploring agentic AI workflows for automated test execution, failure analysis, and incident triage. 
 - Experience in AdTech/MarTech, programmatic advertising, identity resolution, audience activation, or data onboarding. 
 - Experience building and maintaining integrations with external advertising, social media, or Connected TV platforms. 
 - Experience establishing engineering quality standards and influencing practices across globally distributed engineering teams. 

Additional Information

Epsilon is a global data, technology and services company that powers the marketing and advertising ecosystem. For decades, we've provided marketers from the world's leading brands the data, technology and services they need to engage consumers with 1 View, 1 Vision and 1 Voice. 1 View of their universe of potential buyers. 1 Vision for engaging each individual. And 1 Voice to harmonize engagement across paid, owned and earned channels. 

Epsilon's comprehensive portfolio of capabilities across our suite of digital media, messaging and loyalty solutions bridge the divide between marketing and advertising technology. We process 400+ billion consumer actions each day using advanced AI and hold many patents of proprietary technology, including real-time modeling languages and consumer privacy advancements. Thanks to the work of every employee, Epsilon has been consistently recognized as industry-leading by Forrester, Adweek and the MRC. Epsilon is a global company with more than 9, 000 employees around the world. 

Our pillars aren't just words. They're how we show up every day. 

- People centricity: We focus on employee well-being in an environment where colleagues truly care about each other.

Our values guide us to create value for our clients, our people and consumers.

These pillars and values are our foundation-shaping our culture, guiding our decisions, and uniting us in common purpose.

We are looking for a Senior DevOps Engineer with strong expertise in Microsoft Azure, cloud-native architecture, CI/CD, Infrastructure as Code, Kubernetes, automation, DevSecOps/SecOps, and observability to build and operate highly available, scalable, secure, and resilient platforms for our products. 

The ideal candidate will have strong hands-on experience designing and implementing production-grade cloud infrastructure and deployment platforms, with a strong understanding of DevSecOps, cloud security, SRE principles, reliability engineering, automation, and security operations. 

This role will work closely with Engineering, QA, Product, Security, Architecture, and client teams to enable fast and reliable software delivery while maintaining the security, availability, performance, and compliance requirements expected in a product development environment. 

The role will also involve client implementations, technical solutioning, environment setup, deployment planning, production rollouts, troubleshooting, and technical discussions with client engineering and infrastructure teams. 

Key Responsibilities

Cloud & Platform Engineering

- Design and manage production-grade Azure infrastructure with focus on scalability, availability, security, and performance. 
 - Build and operate AKS/Kubernetes platforms, including deployments, scaling, networking, ingress, RBAC, secrets, and troubleshooting. 
 - Develop and maintain CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, Jenkins, or similar tools. 
 - Implement Infrastructure as Code using Terraform/Bicep and create reusable infrastructure modules and deployment patterns. 
 - Automate operational and engineering workflows using Python, Bash, or PowerShell. 

DevSecOps & SecOps

- Implement and continuously improve DevSecOps and SecOps practices across the software development and deployment lifecycle. 
 - Integrate security controls into CI/CD pipelines, including SAST, DAST, dependency scanning, container image scanning, secrets detection, and vulnerability management. 
 - Implement and manage cloud security controls covering IAM/RBAC, Entra ID, Key Vault, network security, private endpoints, NSGs, and secure workload configuration. 
 - Monitor security events, vulnerabilities, configuration risks, and infrastructure anomalies and coordinate remediation with engineering and security teams. 
 - Support security reviews, compliance requirements, audit activities, and production security assessments. 
 - Work with development teams to establish secure-by-design deployment and infrastructure patterns. 

Client Implementation & Delivery

- Lead or support end-to-end technical implementation of Solytics products across client environments, particularly enterprise and regulated environments. 
 - Work directly with client infrastructure, DevOps, security, networking, and application teams to understand environment requirements and implementation constraints. 
 - Own technical activities including environment readiness, infrastructure provisioning, connectivity, deployment, configuration, integrations, security controls, and production go-live. 
 - Troubleshoot complex implementation and production issues and drive them through resolution with internal and client stakeholders. 
 - Prepare implementation documentation, deployment guides, architecture diagrams, runbooks, and operational handover documents. 
 - Participate in client technical discussions, solution workshops, implementation calls, and production readiness reviews. 

Reliability & Observability

- Build observability using Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, Prometheus, Grafana, Open Telemetry, or equivalent technologies. 
 - Drive high availability, disaster recovery, reliability, performance, and capacity planning for production systems. 
 - Troubleshoot complex cloud, Kubernetes, networking, deployment, security, and production issues. 
 - Participate in RCA/post-incident reviews and implement corrective and preventive actions. 
 - Establish operational standards, monitoring, alerting, and incident response practices. 

Engineering Enablement

- Enable engineering teams through self-service infrastructure and standardized deployment patterns. 
 - Participate in architecture and design discussions to define scalable, reliable, and secure infrastructure patterns. 
 - Mentor engineers and contribute to platform architecture, DevSecOps, and engineering standards. 
 - Continuously improve automation, deployment processes, infrastructure efficiency, security posture, and operational reliability. 

Communication & Stakeholder Management

- Demonstrate excellent written and oral communication skills with the ability to explain complex technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. 
 - Act as a technical point of contact for DevOps, infrastructure, security, and deployment-related discussions with clients. 
 - Collaborate effectively across Engineering, QA, Product, Security, Architecture, Support, and client teams. 
 - Communicate implementation plans, risks, dependencies, incidents, timelines, and technical decisions clearly and proactively. 
 - Create high-quality technical documentation, implementation plans, architecture notes, runbooks, and incident/RCA reports. 

Key Requirements

- 8 to 12 years of hands-on DevOps / Cloud / Platform Engineering / SRE experience. 
 - Strong hands-on production experience with Microsoft Azure. 
 - Strong production experience with AKS, Kubernetes, and Docker. 
 - Strong hands-on experience designing and managing production infrastructure using Terraform or equivalent IaC. 
 - Strong CI/CD experience with Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, Jenkins, or similar. 
 - Strong understanding of Linux, networking, DNS, load balancing, TLS, IAM/RBAC, and cloud security. 
 - Strong understanding of DevSecOps, SecOps, vulnerability management, security monitoring, and secure software delivery practices. 
 - Experience with Azure services such as Key Vault, VNets, NSGs, Application Gateway, Load Balancer, Private Endpoints, Azure SQL, Storage, and related cloud services. 
 - Strong scripting/automation skills using Python, Bash, or PowerShell. 
 - Experience with monitoring, logging, alerting, incident management, and observability. 
 - Good understanding of SRE, HA/DR, production reliability, and capacity planning. 
 - Experience in enterprise/client implementations, preferably involving regulated or highly secure environments. 
 - Excellent written and verbal communication skills with strong stakeholder management capabilities. 
 - Strong Git and Agile/Scrum experience.

data.description:
About The Role

Grade Level (for internal use): 

08

Role Scope

The Data Research Specialist is an individual contributor role that develops deep proficiency in a niche dataset/workflow and owns the end-to-end data lifecycle for one or more datasets -from sourcing and rule design through validation, enrichment, delivery, and handover. The role moves beyond execution into designing how data is treated, with a measurable downstream impact on data quality, efficiency, and usability. 

Specialists maintain and evolve rule books and SOPs, provide UAT inputs, participate in solutioning, and begin direct interactions with vendors and internal partners. The role requires strong domain understanding, disciplined governance, and the ability to balance quality, speed, and risk while contributing to automation- and AI-enabled improvements. 

What You'll Do (Key Responsibilities)

Operational Delivery

- Collect, analyze, and validate US GAAP-based financial statement data (Balance Sheet, Income Statement, Cash Flow, and disclosures) from regulatory filings, earnings reports, and company publications 
 - Interpret complex financial disclosures and ensure accurate mapping, classification, and standardization of financial data in line with Compustat methodologies 
 - Perform detailed financial statement analysis, including cross‐statement checks, trend analysis, and reasonableness validation 
 - Ensure data integrity, consistency, and timeliness across financial datasets by following established research guidelines and quality standards 
 - Own the end-to-end data lifecycle for assigned datasets, including source selection, ingestion checks, rule application, validation and enrichment, publishing, and handover. 
 - Ensure SLAs for timeliness, coverage, and quality are met; track end-to-end KPIs, exception trends, and data drift indicators. 
 - Maintain and update rule books and SOPs as requirements evolve; communicate changes and readiness criteria to stakeholders. 
 - Support onboarding new datasets or sources through playbooks, sample evaluations, and readiness assessments. 
 - Participate in UAT cycles, providing domain test cases, acceptance criteria, and defect reproduction steps. 

Process Excellence

- Keep documentation, runbooks, controls, and SOPs audit-ready, ensuring strong handovers and traceability. 
 - Contribute risk assessments for changes in rules, sources, or workflows, including rollback and monitoring plans. 
 - Partner with Technology and Process Experts to design and optimize automation- and AI-enabled workflows under governance. 
 - Apply working knowledge of LLM/GenAI tools for extraction, validation, and quality checks. 
 - Run small pilots and experiments (e. g. , rule optimization, automation scripts, sampling) to improve efficiency, quality, and coverage. 
 - Provide SME inputs for data analysis, lineage documentation, and downstream integrations. 

Stakeholder Management

- Act as the point of contact for assigned datasets with peers, Data Stewards, cross-domain teams, Data Automation & Transformation, Quality teams, representing rule decisions within defined governance. 
 - Support seniors and other stakeholders by providing domain inputs to requirements, validating fixes, and refining data workflows. 
 - Begin liaising with vendor partners on clarifications, escalations, and data quality issues, supporting gap resolution actions. 
 - Support resolution of client queries/escalations with clear, data-backed responses; contribute to knowledge-sharing forums and working groups. 
 - Provide informal guidance to Interns through onboarding support as a buddy or micro-trainings (no formal people management). 

How Impact Will Be Measured (Success Metrics)

- Dataset quality KPIs (accuracy, completeness, consistency); reduced exceptions and cycle time 
 - Timely resolution of client/vendor issues; improved satisfaction 
 - Quality/maintainability of rule books and SOPs (audit outcomes; update cadence) 
 - Measurable efficiency and quality gains from UAT, automation, and process improvements. 

For This Role You'll Need to Have (Skills & Competencies)

Technical Skills

- Advanced Excel and solid SQL for investigations, reconciliations, and audits. 
 - Working knowledge of Python or similar scripting for basic automation and data checks (preferred). 
 - Familiarity with LLM/GenAI tooling and prompt design, including evaluation of metrics and guardrails. 
 - Understanding vendor data models and ingestion pipelines, with awareness of upstream/downstream impacts. 
 - Awareness of internal platforms and data ecosystems (e. g. , data lakes, workflow engines). 

Functional Skills

- Strong understanding of US GAAP financial statements (Balance Sheet, Income Statement, Cash Flow Statement) and their interrelationships 
 - Ability to analyze and interpret financial disclosures, footnotes, and management commentary 
 - Strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and ability to work with large and complex financial datasets 
 - Rule design and maintenance governing data treatment, enrichment, and delivery. 
 - Ability to resolve complex tickets and client queries independently. 
 - Support definition and refinement of data KPIs and control checks. 

Behavioral Skills

- Strong problem-solving and analytical thinking, with comfort navigating ambiguity within defined scope. 
 - Curiosity to understand downstream use cases and client impact, translating insights into rule or control improvements. 
 - Clear communication and ability to collaborate and influence within the assigned dataset or domain. 
 - Ownership mindset with ability to work with limited supervision and maintain disciplined documentation. 
 - Resilience under pressure, handling escalations with sound judgment on quality, timeliness, and defined risk controls. 
 - Demonstrates strong learning agility and digital acumen, with a continuous learning mindset and the ability to adapt to evolving tools and technologies. 

Preferred Education & Experience

- 2-4 years of experience in data research, data operations, or market/financial data roles. 

Key Interfaces & Stakeholders

- Associates and Specialists within Data Research & Operations. 
 - Data Stewards, Data Automation & Transformation, and Data Quality teams. 
 - Technology team which is responsible for platforms, tools, and pipelines. 
 - External vendors and, where applicable, clients via support channels

What's In It For You?

Our Mission

Advancing Essential Intelligence. 

Our People

We're more than 35, 000 strong worldwide-so we're able to understand nuances while having a broad perspective. Our team is driven by curiosity and a shared belief that Essential Intelligence can help build a more prosperous future for us all. From finding new ways to measure sustainability to analyzing energy transition across the supply chain to building workflow solutions that make it easy to tap into insight and apply it. We are changing the way people see things and empowering them to make an impact on the world we live in. We're committed to a more equitable future and to helping our customers find new, sustainable ways of doing business. Join us and help create the critical insights that truly make a difference. 

Our Values

Integrity, Discovery, Partnership

Throughout our history, the world's leading organizations have relied on us for the Essential Intelligence they need to make confident decisions about the road ahead. We start with a foundation of integrity in all we do, bring a spirit of discovery to our work, and collaborate in close partnership with each other and our customers to achieve shared goals. 

Benefits

We take care of you, so you can take care of business. We care about our people. That's why we provide everything you-and your career-need to thrive at S&P Global. 

Our Benefits Include

About This Role

Your Team

The Data Science & Artificial Intelligence (AI) team helps transform how technology, data, and AI drive better outcomes for clients and the business. The team partners closely with client-facing teams, product strategists, engineers, and business leaders to develop and scale AI-powered solutions that enhance productivity, improve decision-making, strengthen client engagement, and unlock commercial value. This is a highly impactful team focused on translating innovation into real-world business outcomes and advancing the future of AI-powered client engagement across the firm. 

Your Role and Impact

We are seeking a highly motivated AI Solutions Lead to join the Data Science & AI team. This role combines technical expertise in machine learning, generative AI, and data engineering with the ability to translate business challenges into scalable AI solutions. You will partner with stakeholders across Sales, Product Strategy, Chief Operating Officer (COO) functions, and Technology to identify opportunities, develop AI-driven products, and deploy solutions that drive measurable business outcomes. Success in this role requires intellectual curiosity, analytical thinking, hands-on technical skills, and the ability to collaborate across multidisciplinary teams. 

Your Responsibilities

In every role at BlackRock, you'll be expected to apply sound judgement and critical thinking to solve complex problems, adapt as the business evolves, and embrace the curiosity to explore new approaches and technologies while challenging outcomes. The scope of this role also includes the following responsibilities: 

- Develop artificial intelligence (AI), machine learning (ML), and advanced analytics solutions that drive commercial growth, improve client experiences, and enhance operational efficiency. 
 - Design, develop, evaluate, and deploy AI and machine learning solutions in partnership with engineering teams. 
 - Build intelligent AI-powered assistants, agentic workflows, and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) applications that deliver measurable business value. 
 - Establish experimentation, evaluation, monitoring, and performance measurement frameworks to assess business impact and solution effectiveness. 
 - Leverage modern cloud, data, and directed acyclic graph-based workflow orchestration frameworks for data and batch processing to build scalable AI solutions. 
 - Champion responsible AI practices, model governance, security, scalability, and reliability standards. 
 - Partner across product, engineering, business, and AI teams to advance enterprise AI capabilities and communicate insights effectively. 

Your Experience

- Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Statistics, Mathematics, Physics, Economics, or another quantitative discipline; advanced degrees are a plus. 
 - Demonstrated ability to build and deploy AI and machine learning solutions in production environments. 
 - Strong technical proficiency in Python, Structured Query Language (SQL), data engineering, and analytical platforms. 
 - Demonstrated expertise in machine learning, statistics, experimentation, and predictive modeling. 
 - Experience developing generative AI applications using Large Language Models (LLMs), prompt engineering, natural language processing (NLP), and related techniques. 
 - Experience in asset management, financial services, fintech, or modern cloud-based AI ecosystems is preferred. 
 - Strong communication, stakeholder management, problem-solving, and responsible AI practices. 

Our Benefits

To help you stay energized, engaged and inspired, we offer a wide range of benefits including a strong retirement plan, tuition reimbursement, comprehensive healthcare, support for working parents and Flexible Time Off (FTO) so you can relax, recharge and be there for the people you care about. 

Our hybrid work model

BlackRock's hybrid work model is designed to enable a culture of collaboration and apprenticeship that enriches the experience of our employees, while supporting flexibility for all. Employees are currently required to work at least 4 days in the office per week, with the flexibility to work from home 1 day a week. Some business groups may require more time in the office due to their roles and responsibilities. We remain focused on increasing the impactful moments that arise when we work together in person - aligned with our commitment to performance and innovation. As a new joiner, you can count on this hybrid model to accelerate your learning and onboarding experience here at BlackRock. 

Guidance on AI use for candidates

At BlackRock, AI has long been part of how we work - enhancing decision-making, improving operations, and helping us deliver better outcomes for clients. We encourage candidates to use AI thoughtfully to learn, prepare, and work more effectively; but during our interview process, we want to focus on getting to know you through your own experiences, thinking, and judgment. To support you, we've provided guidance on when and how to use AI during our hiring process so you can approach each step with confidence and showcase your best self. 

About BlackRock

At BlackRock, we are all connected by one mission: to help more and more people experience financial well-being. Our clients, and the people they serve, are saving for retirement, paying for their children's educations, buying homes and starting businesses. Their investments also help to strengthen the global economy: support businesses small and large; finance infrastructure projects that connect and power cities; and facilitate innovations that drive progress. 

This mission would not be possible without our smartest investment - the one we make in our employees. It's why we're dedicated to creating an environment where our colleagues feel welcomed, valued and supported with networks, benefits and development opportunities to help them thrive. 

To learn more about BlackRock, please visit Careers. BlackRock. com. We also encourage you to get to know us on LinkedIn, Instagram, YouTube, X, and TikTok. 

BlackRock is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to age, disability, family status, gender identity, race, religion, sex, sexual orientation and other protected attributes at law.

As a seasoned Staff Software Development Engineer in Data Platform team you will be at the forefront of designing, building, and optimizing the critical data infrastructure that handles hundreds of millions of requests per minute (RPM) for our ingestion services, processes billions of events daily from Kafka, and manages petabytes of data stored in S3. Team Leadership & Growth

- Knowledge Sharing: Write blogs and articles to help team members and the community
 - Architecture Breakdown: Break down high-level architecture into manageable services and tasks

 - ETL/Orchestration: Expertise in building, optimizing, and orchestrating complex ETL/ELT pipelines using tools like Apache Airflow, Prefect, or other workflow management systems. 
 - Databases: Strong SQL skills and experience with both relational (e. g. , PostgreSQL, MySQL) and NoSQL databases (e. g. , Cassandra, DynamoDB). 
 - Data Modeling: Advanced data modeling skills (dimensional, Kimball, data vault) for large, complex datasets. 
 - Problem-Solving: Exceptional analytical and problem-solving abilities, with a proven track record of debugging and optimizing complex distributed systems. 
 - Communication: Excellent communication, collaboration, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to articulate complex technical concepts to diverse audiences. 
 - Mentorship: Proven ability to mentor, guide, and technically lead senior and junior engineers.

Lean SuperIntelligence (LSI) is an AI lab building self-improving cybersecurity foundation models for enterprises. LSI publicly announced LSI-Offense-1 and LSI-Defense-1 on October 9, 2026, alongside the closing of its initial pre-seed financing. 

LSI-Offense-1 discovers, exploits and validates vulnerabilities; LSI-Defense-1 detects, investigates and responds to threats. The models improve through an offense-defense feedback loop inside LSI Cyber World Models, simulated enterprise environments that turn attack and defense outcomes into training signals. 

The models are designed for enterprise-controlled deployment, including on-premises and air-gapped environments, with customization on private enterprise data. Access is currently limited to selected design partners. 

Founded by Chandra Khatri, LSI brings together foundation-model builders and security researchers. Its announced backers include investors and angels with AI and security leadership experience at OpenAI, CrowdStrike, SentinelOne, Zscaler, Commvault and Gruve AI. These affiliations do not imply corporate investment by those organizations. 

Learn more: LSI website | Launch announcement | Financing and model news. 

ABOUT THE ROLE

We are hiring a Founding Full Stack Staff Engineer to build the product surface of our frontier security platform, from data model and services through to the interfaces security teams work in every day. 

You will own features end to end: backend services, agent-facing APIs, and the front end where findings, exploit evidence, and remediation workflows are reviewed and acted on. This is a senior individual-contributor role with broad architectural ownership and a direct line to design partners. 

RESPONSIBILITIES

- Own features end to end across data model, backend services, APIs, front end, telemetry, and rollout. 

- Build the interfaces security teams work in daily: finding triage, exploit evidence review, remediation and retest tracking, agent run inspection, and reporting. 

- Design backend services and APIs for scanning, agent execution, evidence storage, and integrations with code hosts, CI/CD, ticketing systems, and cloud accounts. 

- Build product surfaces on top of LLMs and autonomous agents, including streaming output, long-running task state, human approval steps, partial results, and graceful failure. 

- Turn AppSec workflows into product: finding deduplication, severity and reachability context, ownership routing, SLA tracking, and verification that fixes actually close the vulnerability. 

- Design schemas and pipelines for findings, agent trajectories, evidence artifacts, and audit trails. 

- Build multi-tenant foundations including authentication, authorization, RBAC, org and project scoping, audit logging, secrets handling, and tenant isolation. 

- Make agent behavior legible in the interface: what the agent did, what it proved, what it could not, and where a human needs to decide. 

- Own performance, reliability, latency, and cost across the stack, including inference and tool-execution cost surfaced to the user. 

- Set engineering standards for code review, testing, CI/CD, observability, incident response, and secure-by-default patterns, and treat our own attack surface as a first-class concern. 

- Prototype quickly with design partners, put working software in front of practitioners early, and decide what is ready to ship. 

- Partner with security researchers, agent-harness engineers, and product to move research capability into product without losing rigor. 

QUALIFICATIONS

- At least five years building and shipping production software, with meaningful time spent on cybersecurity products. 

- Strong full-stack ability: modern TypeScript and React on the front end, plus backend work in Go, Python, TypeScript, Java, or Rust. 

- Hands-on experience building application-security products, or closely adjacent ones such as code security, vulnerability management, attack-surface management, DevSecOps, offensive-security tooling, or SOC platforms. 

- Working security knowledge across common vulnerability classes, authentication and authorization, and secure design, with the ability to reason about the attack surface of what you build. 

- Experience designing APIs, data models, and asynchronous or long-running workflows. 

- Front-end craft on data-dense technical interfaces, including state management, streaming and real-time updates, and performance under large result sets. 

- Experience with cloud infrastructure, containers, CI/CD, and production operations. 

- Ability to scope ambiguous problems, make architectural decisions, and raise the bar for other engineers through code and review rather than process. 

- Clear technical writing and comfort working directly with security practitioners and design partners. 

- We value demonstrated ability over formal credentials, certifications, or a fixed number of years of experience. 

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

- Experience building products on LLMs or agents, including tool use, streaming, evaluations, prompt and model versioning, and latency and cost tradeoffs. 

- Product experience in autonomous pentesting, code security, SAST/DAST/SCA, vulnerability management, CTEM, EDR/XDR, or SOC automation. 

- Personal offensive-security depth such as CVEs, bug-bounty findings, advanced CTF performance, or published research. 

- Experience integrating with GitHub or GitLab, CI systems, Jira or ServiceNow, SIEM and EDR platforms, or cloud provider APIs. 

- Experience meeting enterprise requirements such as SSO, SAML, SCIM, audit logging, VPC or on-premise deployment, and air-gapped installs. 

- Experience with real-time systems, websockets, job queues, or event-driven architectures. 

- Design sensibility and the ability to own the user experience for technical workflows without a dedicated designer. 

- Understanding of AI and agent security risks including prompt injection, tool poisoning or misuse, excessive permissions, untrusted content, and sandbox boundaries. 

- Open-source contributions, technical writing, or prior founding-engineer and early-stage experience.

Founded in 2022, Ethereal Exploration Guild (The Guild) is building the World's First Fully Reusable Medium-Lift Launch Vehicle/Rocket, Razor Crest Mk-1 (RCM1). 

Based in India, the team has a combined flight heritage of over 75 launches from the PSLV and GSLV fleets, and more than 300 years of collective experience in the space industry. The Guild is also developing a 700, 000 sq ft facility dedicated to Upper Stage Engine Testing, which is going to be India's largest privately developed Engine Testing Facility. 

The Guild has also built and manufactured India's First Reusable Rocket Engine. 

We are looking for a self-motivated individual to join the Hands of the Guild as an Instrumentation Engineer. 

Please apply to the job using the link provided below: 

https: //forms. zohopublic. in/etherealexplorationguildpriva1/form/InstrumentationEngineer/formperma/8fFdWR88qzJd7mu76_IFj8c9GLRXCQMLvEoKXLJrwWU

Location: Anchorage - Space City, Srikalahasti, Tirupati, Andhra Pradesh

Job-Type: On-site, Monday - Saturday

Experience: 3-8 years

Full JD: https: //workdrive. zohoexternal. in/external/307ab0d59c23cd10e2291c57ee7e2d025973653ebf9d347b7f0d362514d5e940

Role Summary: 

As an Instrumentation Engineer, you will take end-to-end ownership of the instrumentation, data acquisition and control systems of our rocket engine and stage test facility - from sensor and wiring design to pre-test checkout and hot-fire data. You will work across propulsion, AIT, fluid systems and avionics teams, directly influencing test safety, data quality and how fast we turn around test campaigns. 

Core Responsibilities: 

1. Test Stand Instrumentation & Signal Chain

• Define the instrumentation list and channel plan: pressure, temperature (thermocouples/ RTDs), flow, load cells, strain, vibration, level and valve position

• Select and install sensors, transmitters and signal conditioning for cryogenic, high-pressure (300+ bar) and hot-fire environments

• Own calibration of the full chain (sensor to DAQ) and its records

• Solve noise, grounding and shielding issues to deliver clean, high-rate data

2. Wiring, Harnesses, Connectors & Termination Panels

• Design and build cable harnesses, field wiring and junction boxes between the test stand, bunker and control room

• Lay out termination/ marshalling panels, terminal blocks and patch panels

• Select connectors (MIL-type circular, Lemo, M12, thermocouple) for vibration, cryo and outdoor conditions

• Maintain wiring diagrams, interconnect drawings, cable schedules and I/O lists

3. Data Acquisition & Control Software (LabVIEW-first)

• Develop the facility DAQ and control software in LabVIEW on NI hardware (cDAQ/ PXI/ cRIO): acquisition, valve sequencing, live displays and logging

• Implement automated test sequences, redlines and abort logic

• Configure DewesoftX for high-speed and dynamic channels and synchronise it with the main DAQ

• Deliver post-test data packages ready for propulsion analysis

4. PLC, SCADA, Relays & Safety Interlocks

• Program and maintain PLCs for propellant feed, purge, pressurisation, cryo transfer and water systems

• Build and run SCADA/ HMI screens for remote operation, alarms and logging

• Design relay logic, solenoid valve drivers, igniter/ pyro firing circuits and emergency-stop chains

• Own hardwired safety interlocks and their fail-safe states

5. Communication Protocols & Integration

• Integrate instruments and controllers over Modbus RTU/ TCP, Profibus/ Profinet, EtherNet/IP, RS-232/ 485, CAN and OPC UA

• Set up the facility network between DAQ, PLC, SCADA and video, with time synchronisation (PTP/ IRIG-B/ GPS)

• Interface ground systems with vehicle and stage avionics for stage-level tests

6. Checkout & Test Campaign Execution

• Run pre-test checkout: continuity and insulation (megger) tests, end-to-end channel checks, valve and sequence dry runs

• Write and execute checkout procedures and test readiness reviews

• Sit on the test console during cold-flow and hot-fire tests

• Lead troubleshooting of failed channels and anomalies

Required Skills: 

• LabVIEW - DAQ and control applications on NI hardware (DAQmx, state machines, TDMS logging)

• Hands-on wiring, harnessing and panel building: terminations, crimping, connector selection

• PLC programming (ladder/ structured text) and SCADA/ HMI configuration

• Relay and interlock logic, solenoid drivers and E-stop circuits

• Sensors and signal conditioning: pressure transducers, thermocouples/ RTDs, flow meters, load cells, strain gauges, accelerometers

• Industrial protocols: Modbus, RS-232/ 485, Profibus/ Profinet or EtherNet/IP, CAN

• Working knowledge of DewesoftX

• Commissioning and checkout of instrumented systems in a test, plant or field environment

Qualifications: 

• B. E. / B. Tech in Instrumentation, Electronics & Instrumentation, Electrical, Electronics or Mechatronics Engineering

• Hands-on experience is valued more than academic credentials

Preferred: 

• Instrumentation and controls for rocket engine/ stage test stands, aero-engine test beds, or cryogenic/ high-pressure plants (ASU, LNG, oil & gas)

• Experience at ISRO (LPSC/ IPRC/ SDSC), DRDO, HAL test beds or a private launch vehicle company

• Hazardous-area work: intrinsic safety, Ex-rated equipment

• Familiarity with IEC 61131-3, ISA-5. 1 and IEC 61511 (SIS)

• cRIO/ FPGA in LabVIEW, or Python for post-processing

data.title: Technical Lead – ML Platform & MLOps
data.description:
About The Company

Who are we?

Myntra is India's leading fashion and lifestyle platform, where technology meets creativity. As pioneers in fashion e-commerce, we've always believed in disrupting the ordinary. 

We thrive on a shared passion for fashion, a drive to innovate to lead, and an environment that empowers each one of us to pave our own way. We're bold in our thinking, agile in our execution, and collaborative in spirit. 

Here, we create MAGIC by inspiring vibrant and joyous self-expression and expanding fashion possibilities for India, while staying true to what we believe in. 

We believe in taking bold bets and changing the fashion landscape of India. We are a company that is constantly evolving into newer and better forms and we look for people who are ready to evolve with us. 

From our humble beginnings as a customization company in 2007 to being technology and fashion pioneers today, Myntra is going places and we want you to take part in this journey with us. 

Working at Myntra is challenging but fun - we are a young and dynamic team, firm believers in meritocracy, believe in equal opportunity, encourage intellectual curiosity and empower our teams with the right tools, space, and opportunities. 

Technical Lead - ML Platform & MLOps (E3)

Location: Bengaluru

Experience: 6+ years

Company: Myntra

Build the Platform Behind AI at Myntra

Myntra is looking for a Technical Lead - ML Platform & MLOps to help build the next generation of infrastructure that powers machine learning across Myntra. 

This is not a conventional MLOps operations role. 

You will work on some of the hardest engineering problems at the intersection of Machine Learning, Distributed Systems, Kubernetes, GPU infrastructure, Cloud, Developer Platforms and SRE. 

The platform you build will enable Data Scientists and ML Engineers to move from an idea to production faster: 

Code → Features → Distributed Training → Experimentation → Model Registry → Deployment → Inference → Observability

You will have the opportunity to design and build foundational ML platform capabilities used across multiple ML teams, influence platform architecture, solve large-scale infrastructure challenges, and establish engineering standards for how ML workloads are built and operated at Myntra. 

We are looking for a strong hands-on engineer who enjoys building platforms, debugging complex distributed systems, and simplifying infrastructure for hundreds of ML and engineering users. 

What You Will Own

Build Myntra's ML Platform

- Architect, build and evolve scalable ML Platform and MLOps capabilities for large-scale production workloads. 
 - Create self-service infrastructure that allows Data Scientists and ML Engineers to train, experiment, deploy and operate models without managing underlying infrastructure. 
 - Design reusable platform abstractions, SDKs, APIs and tooling that dramatically improve ML developer productivity. 
 - Build systems for reproducibility, lineage, versioning, governance and lifecycle management across ML workflows. 
 - Drive architecture and technology choices for Myntra's ML infrastructure. 

Distributed Training & GPU Infrastructure

- Build infrastructure for large-scale distributed training across CPU and GPU clusters. 
 - Design and operate multi-node and multi-GPU training environments. 
 - Work with distributed computing frameworks such as Ray or equivalent technologies. 
 - Build intelligent scheduling, resource isolation and autoscaling capabilities for ML workloads. 
 - Improve utilization of expensive GPU infrastructure through scheduling, workload optimization and capacity management. 
 - Design fault-tolerant training systems with checkpointing, retries and recovery mechanisms. 

ML Workflow & Training Platform

- Build a world-class training platform supporting the complete ML development lifecycle. 
 - Design scalable orchestration for training, feature engineering, validation and deployment workflows. 
 - Build reusable workflow components using technologies such as Airflow, Ray and Kubernetes. 
 - Improve scheduling, dependency management, execution isolation and reliability for thousands of ML workloads. 
 - Enable experimentation across different compute environments without exposing infrastructure complexity to users. 

MLOps & Model Lifecycle

- Build end-to-end ML lifecycle capabilities covering: Experimentation → Training → Validation → Model Registry → Deployment → Monitoring → Retraining
 - Build experiment tracking and model management using MLflow or equivalent technologies. 
 - Enable reliable model versioning, approval, rollout and rollback. 
 - Build automated model validation and production-readiness workflows. 
 - Enable reproducible ML workflows across development, staging and production environments. 

Model Serving & AI Infrastructure

- Build highly scalable infrastructure for real-time, batch and asynchronous model inference. 
 - Design model-serving platforms running on Kubernetes and GPU infrastructure. 
 - Optimize serving systems for latency, throughput, availability and cost. 
 - Explore and adopt technologies such as Ray Serve, NVIDIA Triton, vLLM, SGLang or equivalent platforms where appropriate. 
 - Enable production deployment of traditional ML, deep-learning and emerging AI/LLM workloads. 

Platform Reliability & Observability

- Treat ML infrastructure as a production-grade distributed platform. 
 - Define and drive SLIs, SLOs, availability and reliability standards for ML platform services. 
 - Build deep observability across infrastructure, pipelines, training workloads and inference systems. 
 - Troubleshoot challenging production issues spanning Kubernetes, GPU workloads, distributed systems, networking, storage and ML pipelines. 
 - Drive root-cause analysis and systematically eliminate recurring operational issues. 
 - Design for high availability, fault tolerance and graceful recovery. 

Cloud, Kubernetes & Infrastructure

- Design scalable compute, networking and storage infrastructure for ML workloads. 
 - Build and operate ML systems on Kubernetes and cloud platforms. 
 - Automate infrastructure using Terraform or equivalent Infrastructure-as-Code technologies. 
 - Build secure, isolated and reproducible runtime environments. 
 - Drive infrastructure efficiency through autoscaling, workload placement and cost optimization. 

ML Developer Experience

A major part of this role is making complex ML infrastructure simple for users. 

You Will: 

- Build developer-facing platforms, SDKs, APIs and abstractions. 
 - Reduce the time required to move an ML experiment into production. 
 - Eliminate repetitive infrastructure work for Data Scientists and ML Engineers. 
 - Build standardized templates and paved roads for ML development. 
 - Improve debugging, discoverability and observability of ML workloads. 
 - Enable teams to focus on models and business problems rather than infrastructure. 

Technical Leadership

At E3, we expect you to go beyond implementing individual components. 

You Will: 

- Own architecture and technical direction for major ML Platform initiatives. 
 - Lead complex system-design discussions and technical reviews. 
 - Convert ambiguous problems into scalable platform solutions. 
 - Drive engineering excellence across reliability, scalability, performance and maintainability. 
 - Mentor engineers and raise the technical bar of the team. 
 - Influence architecture across ML, Data, Platform, SRE and Infrastructure teams. 
 - Evaluate emerging technologies and make pragmatic build-vs-buy decisions. 
 - Take critical systems from concept through architecture, implementation and production adoption. 

What We Are Looking For

Must Have

- 6+ years of strong hands-on software/platform engineering experience. 
 - Strong programming skills in Python. 
 - Deep hands-on experience with Kubernetes, containers and Linux. 
 - Experience building or operating large-scale distributed systems or platform infrastructure. 
 - Strong understanding of cloud infrastructure including compute, storage and networking. 
 - Experience building production-grade CI/CD and automation platforms. 
 - Experience with workflow orchestration such as Apache Airflow or equivalent systems. 
 - Experience with ML lifecycle tooling such as MLflow or equivalent platforms. 
 - Strong understanding of ML training and deployment workflows. 
 - Experience with Infrastructure as Code, preferably Terraform. 
 - Strong debugging and production troubleshooting skills. 
 - Experience building systems with monitoring, logging, metrics and alerting. 
 - Strong fundamentals in system design, reliability and distributed computing. 

Strong Differentiators

We would especially love to meet you if you have worked on: 

- Ray or other distributed computing frameworks
 - Distributed or multi-node ML training
 - GPU and multi-GPU infrastructure
 - Kubernetes-based ML platforms

Job Purpose: Lead - SCADA is responsible for the operational integrity, maintenance, and security of the SCADA systems within assigned plant segments. This role ensures the smooth functioning of control systems essential for monitoring and managing automated processes, contributing to operational efficiency, safety, and productivity. By providing technical expertise in SCADA programming, network management, and system troubleshooting, the Associate enhances the reliability and security of plant operations. Additionally, they play a key role in supporting business development through technical advisement, compliance management, and assisting in the evaluation of new SCADA technologies, ultimately contributing to both the operational and strategic goals of the organization. 

Responsibilities

Maintenance and Operation of SCADA Systems: 

Conduct regular maintenance checks on assigned SCADA systems within specific plant segments, ensuring they run smoothly and efficiently by performing system diagnostics, software updates, and addressing any minor technical issues to prevent interruptions in operations. 

Identify and troubleshoot any technical malfunctions in the SCADA systems, collaborating with other team members if necessary to resolve issues quickly and prevent unplanned downtime, which could impact plant productivity and safety. 

Network Security And Protocol Management

Regularly monitor and configure network security protocols within the SCADA system to ensure safe and uninterrupted data transfer across different plant sections by managing firewalls, intrusion detection systems, and encryption protocols that protect sensitive information. 

Set up, configure, and maintain essential SCADA-related infrastructure, such as servers, switches, and routers, to provide a secure and stable network environment that supports the SCADA system and prevents unauthorized access or data breaches. 

Technical Support For Business Development

Act as a technical advisor to the sales and business development teams, providing insights on SCADA system functionalities and potential upgrades that align with client needs by giving input on the feasibility, cost, and benefits of different SCADA solutions to aid in sales strategies and client presentations. 

Engage in discussions about emerging technologies in SCADA and related control systems, communicating potential benefits to the business development team to support marketing initiatives and promote advanced solutions that could attract new clients. 

Technical Review And Vendor Communication

Review technical specifications, industry standards, and product brochures when considering SCADA software purchases from vendors and carefully evaluate these documents to confirm the software meets plant requirements, is compatible with existing systems, and aligns with regulatory standards for SCADA. 

Maintain open communication with vendors, discussing product capabilities, licensing terms, and support services to ensure any SCADA system acquisitions are well-understood, fully documented, and meet the plant's current and future technical needs. 

SCADA System Programming And Development

Assist in developing user-friendly SCADA screens, custom databases, and reporting tools that enable efficient monitoring and analysis of plant data by designing clear, responsive interfaces that give operators real-time access to critical information and streamline workflows. 

Configure and manage SCADA system networks to support data integration across various plant segments. 

Safety And Compliance Management

Ensure that all SCADA system operations adhere to established safety protocols, regulatory standards, and industry best practices by routine checks and updates to safety features and compliance documentation, which help protect both personnel and equipment. 

Maintain accurate documentation for all licenses, support contracts, and compliance-related records associated with SCADA software and hardware to avoid compliance issues, supports system audits, and ensures clear tracking of all SCADA-related liabilities and assets. 

Data Analysis And Reporting

Collect and analyze SCADA data to generate insights into system performance, energy consumption, and operational efficiency. 

Develop and deliver detailed reports to management, including recommendations for system improvements. 

Maintain accurate logs of system events, alarms, and incidents for audit and compliance purposes. 

Energy Efficiency And Sustainability

Use SCADA data to identify opportunities for energy conservation and sustainable practices. 

Implement advanced control strategies to reduce energy waste and optimize resource utilization. 

Collaborate with the Energy Management team to achieve airport-wide energy reduction goals.

Job description: 

Quality Assurance Manager / Food Safety & Quality Operations

Department: Quality Assurance & Food Safety Operations

Job Location: Delhi (Factory / On-site)

Job Type: Full-time

Experience Required: 5-8 Years

Industry: Food & Beverage Manufacturing / Food Processing

Reports To: QA Manager / Head of Quality & Operations

Job Description

We are hiring an experienced and hands-on Quality Assurance / Quality Control (QA/QC) professional for food and beverage manufacturing operations in Delhi. 

The candidate will be responsible for daily shop-floor quality control, food safety compliance, production quality monitoring, process improvement, yield optimisation and implementation of FSSC 22000 v6 standards. 

The ideal candidate must have strong practical experience in beverage manufacturing quality control, production-floor supervision, inline quality testing, GMP/GHP, HACCP and food safety management systems. 

Experience in frozen food processing, IQF operations and cold-chain management will be an added advantage. 

Important: This is a factory-based operational role requiring active involvement on the production floor, not a purely documentation or laboratory-based QA position. 

Key Responsibilities1. Shop-Floor Quality Operations (Highest Priority)

- Supervise daily shop-floor quality assurance and quality control activities. 
 - Guide production line operators and shift teams to ensure compliance with SOPs, GMP, GHP and sanitation standards. 
 - Monitor inline quality parameters, including Brix, pH, filling volumes and seal integrity. 
 - Identify and resolve real-time production quality deviations. 
 - Coordinate with production teams to minimise downtime, product rejection and quality-related holds. 
 - Monitor production yield, wastage, scrap and process losses. 
 - Implement 5S, Kaizen and continuous improvement initiatives. 
 - Conduct line clearance and quality verification during product changeovers. 
 - Verify CIP/COP cleaning and sanitation effectiveness. 
 - Conduct daily shop-floor audits and process compliance checks. 
 - Train production operators on quality control procedures, CCP monitoring and food safety practices. 2. Beverage Manufacturing Quality Control

- Manage inline quality testing of beverage manufacturing processes. 
 - Monitor syrup preparation, batching, thermal processing and filling operations. 
 - Ensure quality control during pasteurisation and UHT processing. 
 - Test and monitor Brix, pH, acidity and CO2 levels. 
 - Monitor water treatment plant (WTP) quality. 
 - Conduct or coordinate microbiological testing for yeast, mould and thermophilic acidophilic bacteria (TAB).

data.description:
Who We Are

Applied Materials is the global leader in materials science and engineering solutions that are at the foundation of virtually every new semiconductor chip and advanced display in the world. Bangalore, IND

You'll benefit from a supportive work culture that encourages you to learn, develop, and grow your career as you take on challenges and drive innovative solutions for our customers. We empower our team to push the boundaries of what is possible-while learning every day in a supportive leading global company. Visit our Careers website to learn more. 

At Applied Materials, we care about the health and wellbeing of our employees. We're committed to providing programs and support that encourage personal and professional growth and care for you at work, at home, or wherever you may go. Learn more about our benefits. 

Technical Lead - Algorithm Developer

Location: Bangalore , Chennai & Mumbai. 

Role Overview

We are seeking an experienced Lead Algorithm Developer to drive the design, development, and production deployment of advanced 3D image reconstruction algorithms for next-generation X-ray inspection, metrology, and computational imaging systems. The role combines deep technical expertise, architectural ownership, hands-on algorithm development, and technical leadership to deliver high-fidelity volumetric reconstruction with strong accuracy, throughput, and robustness. 

Key Responsibilities

- Lead the architecture, design, implementation, and optimization of 3D reconstruction algorithms from concept through production deployment. 
 - Develop and improve tomographic reconstruction techniques for CT, XCT, and cone-beam CT, including analytical, iterative, model-based, and AI-assisted methods. 
 - Build algorithms for projection preprocessing, calibration, denoising, artifact correction, reconstruction, registration, segmentation, and volumetric analysis. 
 - Combine physics-based modeling, inverse-problem optimization, computer vision, and deep learning to improve reconstruction quality and system performance. 
 - Optimize large-scale 3D reconstruction pipelines for GPU, multithreaded, and high-performance computing environments. 
 - Define validation methodology and quality metrics using simulation, laboratory, and production datasets. 
 - Collaborate with systems, hardware, software, applications, and product teams to translate customer needs into scalable algorithmic solutions. 
 - Mentor algorithm engineers, conduct technical reviews, establish engineering best practices, and contribute to the technology roadmap. 
 - Drive innovation through prototypes, patents, publications, and differentiated production capabilities. 

Key Requirements

- Master's or Ph. D. in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Applied Mathematics, Physics, Biomedical Engineering, or a related discipline; a bachelor's degree with substantial relevant industry experience may also be considered. 
 - 8+ years of experience in algorithm development, computational imaging, image processing, computer vision, or a related technical field. 
 - At least 5 years of hands-on experience developing 3D image reconstruction or tomographic imaging algorithms. 
 - Proven experience delivering production-quality reconstruction algorithms for X-ray CT/XCT, cone-beam CT, microscopy, medical imaging, industrial inspection, or semiconductor metrology systems. 
 - Hands-on expertise with analytical and iterative reconstruction techniques such as filtered back projection, Feldkamp-Davis-Kress, ART, SART/SIRT, and model-based iterative reconstruction. 
 - Experience solving inverse imaging problems using numerical optimization, regularization, statistical estimation, compressed sensing, or Bayesian methods. 
 - Experience with projection-domain and image-domain corrections including detector calibration, denoising, ring and streak artifact reduction, beam-hardening correction, and motion or alignment compensation. 
 - Experience with large volumetric datasets, 3D registration, segmentation, feature extraction, defect analysis, and quantitative metrology. 
 - Strong programming skills in C++ and Python; MATLAB or equivalent scientific prototyping tools are beneficial. 
 - Experience with CUDA/GPU computing, parallel processing, multithreading, or high-performance computing. 
 - Strong foundation in linear algebra, numerical methods, optimization, probability, statistics, signal processing, imaging physics, and 3D geometry. 
 - Experience with NumPy, SciPy, OpenCV, ITK, VTK, CUDA, or equivalent scientific and imaging libraries. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience with semiconductor inspection, metrology, defect review, or advanced manufacturing systems. 
 - Knowledge of X-ray imaging physics, detector behavior, acquisition geometry, system calibration, and numerical simulation. 
 - Experience applying deep learning to reconstruction, denoising, super-resolution, segmentation, or artifact reduction using PyTorch or TensorFlow. 
 - Experience with point-cloud processing, surface extraction, mesh generation, multi-modal registration, or 3D visualization. 
 - Experience leading technical teams, mentoring engineers, owning architecture decisions, and coordinating cross-functional delivery. 
 - Patent filings, peer-reviewed publications, or recognized innovation in reconstruction, imaging, or computational methods.

Yes, 10% of the Time

Yes
