data.title: Director Of Engineering - Intelligence Platform & Applications
data.description:
About Truveta

Truveta transforms healthcare into intelligence. Built with and owned by US health systems united by a mission of Saving Lives with Data, Truveta powers breakthrough discoveries, auditable data fit for regulatory submissions, and AI that improves patient care. 

At Truveta, we are building something that has never existed before, bringing together healthcare, science, and technology to tackle some of the most important challenges in human health. Our mission calls us to think big, move with urgency, and build with purpose. We are looking for exceptional people who are energized by hard problems, inspired by the opportunity to improve health, and committed to building a company and culture where talented people can do their best work. 

Our team is a special combination of software, health, and big data experience. We are building a talented team of passionate, mission-oriented, and innovative thinkers. 

Who We Need

Join Truveta's Intelligence organization and lead a team of engineers building the next wave of healthcare AI. Your team will build adaptive agentic systems that keep learning, reason over complex data and real customer use cases, and drive real-world impact in healthcare. Guided by Truveta's mission of Saving Lives with Data, you'll help turn health data into intelligence that clinicians and researchers can use to make proactive, data-driven decisions. 

We're looking for an Intelligence Pod Lead at the Truveta India Development Center (IDC): a hands-on technical leader with depth in applied agentic AI and large-scale engineering, a solid grounding in machine learning fundamentals, and a record of helping the engineers around them do their best work. You'll set your pod's technical direction, own what it delivers from start to finish, and still write code and make the key architecture calls. You'll grow a high-performing team that ships scalable, self-improving AI agents and the platform systems that support them. These systems will learn from large and varied healthcare data and deliver useful insights through automation and reasoning. 

Location: Hyderabad, India. 

This Opportunity

Patients, clinicians, medical researchers and healthcare decision makers deserve the same large-scale innovation and AI that has already transformed how people work, create and communicate in many other fields. As an Intelligence Pod Lead, you'll turn ambitious AI ideas into reliable production systems that improve research and development, business strategy, operations and care delivery across healthcare. 

You'll own a focused problem space end to end: defining the technical roadmap, breaking down ambiguous problems, guiding design and evaluation, and making sure your team delivers measurable results. You'll be a force multiplier. Your judgment, mentoring and technical leadership will raise the bar for your pod and for the wider Intelligence organization. 

If you want purposeful work and the chance to influence how AI supports learning, decision-making and discovery in healthcare, this role lets you lead and keep growing. You'll work in a fast-moving, collaborative environment where your leadership directly shapes how healthcare becomes more connected, intelligent and impactful. 

What You'll Do

- Lead the team's technical direction. Define and own the technical vision, architecture and engineering roadmap for your pod's area, such as agentic workflows, knowledge curation and retrieval, structured reasoning and automated evaluation. Make pragmatic trade-offs between innovation, performance, cost and reliability. 
 - Architect agentic AI systems. Design multi-agent workflows with frameworks such as LangChain/LangGraph, AutoGen or CrewAI that combine reasoning, planning, memory and tool use. Apply strong context engineering, agent harnesses and deterministic guardrails so long-running agents stay reliable. Use interoperability protocols such as MCP, A2A and Agent Skills to build goal-driven systems that work smoothly with other agents and services, and use observability and evaluation tools such as LangSmith to drive continuous improvement. 
 - Drive knowledge curation and retrieval strategy. Oversee the design of retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) pipelines, knowledge graphs built from unstructured documents, embedding strategies and vector stores (e. g. , FAISS, Pinecone, Chroma, Azure AI Search) that ground reasoning in trusted healthcare data. 
 - Build and develop the team. Hire, mentor and coach engineers, set a high bar for engineering quality, and build a culture of ownership and fast, thoughtful iteration. Partner closely with product, data and engineering counterparts across time zones. 
 - Champion responsible AI. Make sure your team's systems reflect ethical AI principles and meet privacy, security and regulatory expectations for healthcare data, so healthcare intelligence advances responsibly at scale. Build in agent security (defenses against prompt injection and tool poisoning, sandboxing, and agent identity with least-privilege access) and human-in-the-loop safeguards against automation bias in clinical settings. 
 - Keep learning and help the team learn. Stay ahead of new AI architectures, agentic frameworks and approaches to reasoning and retrieval. Bring curiosity, humility and a bias toward iteration, and help the team adopt new ideas thoughtfully. 

Required Qualifications

- 8+ years of experience building and deploying scalable, production-ready ML systems in a collaborative engineering environment. 
 - 2+ years in a technical lead or similar role, including setting technical direction and mentoring engineers. 
 - A track record of taking complex ML or AI systems from concept to production with measurable impact. 
 - Deep, hands-on proficiency with agentic AI frameworks (e. g. , LangChain/LangGraph, AutoGen, CrewAI) and a working understanding of interoperability protocols such as MCP, A2A and Agent Skills. 
 - Experience building production agent harnesses with guardrails and context engineering. 
 - Experience designing and operating semantic search systems with knowledge graphs and/or RAG, vector databases and embeddings (FAISS, Pinecone, Chroma, Azure AI Search or similar). 
 - Strong expertise in agentic evaluation, including designing metrics, evaluators or reward models for continuous improvement, and evaluating agents at the agent and trajectory level. 
 - Strong software engineering fundamentals, with expert proficiency in Python and experience designing scalable systems in modern cloud environments (Azure, AWS or GCP). 
 - Excellent communication skills, including explaining technical trade-offs clearly to engineers, product partners and leadership, and working effectively across time zones and geographies. 
 - B. S. or M. S. in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence or a related technical field. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience with healthcare, life sciences or other regulated data (e. g. , EHR, claims, clinical text), including privacy and compliance considerations. 
 - Experience running ML experiments and training at scale, including distributed training, GPU optimization and inference serving. 
 - Experience with MLOps and LLMOps practices: CI/CD for models, observability, drift monitoring and production evaluation loops. 
 - Publications, open-source contributions or patents in applied ML, NLP or agentic systems.

data.description:
About The Company

Vistance Networks shapes the future of communications technology with solutions designed to deliver reliable, high-performing connectivity in a world that is always in motion. With more than 40 years of experience advancing communications infrastructure, the company helps service providers meet today's demands and prepare for what comes next, including the growth of 5G, private networks, cloud services, and the Internet of Things. 

Aurora Networks, a business of Vistance Networks and formerly known as CommScope's Access Networks Solutions, provides access network solutions for service providers around the world. Its portfolio includes HFC, PON, and broadband network products. Aurora Networks also develops Service Assurance software that helps providers monitor and manage networks, improve operational efficiency, and deliver a stronger broadband experience to their customers. 

About The Role

Vistance Networks is seeking a Principal Software Engineer to help innovate, design, develop, and maintain software for Aurora Networks Service Assurance products and systems. In this senior individual contributor role, you will work across a range of technologies and collaborate closely with product management, software engineering, and quality assurance teams. 

You will help translate customer and product needs into secure, scalable, and high-performing solutions. The role calls for a broad technical perspective, sound judgment, and the ability to understand system-level requirements while identifying detailed design considerations and dependencies. You will contribute to an Agile engineering environment focused on dependable delivery, continuous learning, and improvement. 

Qualifications

A bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Software Engineering, Computer Information Systems, or a related field is required. Candidates should have at least 12 years of relevant experience with a bachelor's degree, or at least 10 years with a master's degree, building and scaling software products for large-scale distributed systems. 

Successful candidates will bring advanced proficiency in Java, Kotlin, and Python, along with strong knowledge of software design patterns, data structures, and complex algorithms. Experience supporting AI and machine learning analytics use cases is valuable. You should also have experience designing, troubleshooting, and performance-tuning distributed applications on Linux, as well as strong knowledge of network programming and protocols such as sockets, TCP/IP, UDP, SNMP, gNMI, and gRPC. 

Hands-on experience with Spring Framework, Spring Boot, web services, microservices, REST APIs, and data pipeline technologies such as Kafka, Apache Airflow, or RabbitMQ is expected. Candidates should understand SQL, NoSQL, or hybrid database technologies and have experience with Docker, Kubernetes, and containerized application deployment. Strong communication, collaboration, analytical, leadership, and problem-solving skills are essential. Experience with telecom, cable, or PON network management, cloud-native architecture, and Azure or AWS is an advantage. 

Responsibilities

Partner with product management to clarify requirements, evaluate options, and shape practical, innovative solutions. Design, build, and maintain optimized, secure, scalable software for distributed systems. Assess architecture and implementation dependencies, and apply a system-wide perspective to technical decisions. 

Write comprehensive unit tests and collaborate with quality assurance engineers to support thorough system testing. Break down work, develop estimates, communicate progress, and deliver against agreed timelines and commitments. Contribute to engineering practices, processes, tools, and a culture of quality and continuous improvement. You may also take ownership of software modules and provide technical guidance to junior engineers. 

Benefits

At Vistance Networks, you can contribute to communications technologies used by service providers worldwide while working with colleagues who value innovation, customer focus, and collaboration. The company offers opportunities to develop your skills, grow your career, and help build solutions for evolving connectivity needs. You will join a dynamic engineering environment that encourages new ideas, continuous learning, and meaningful contributions to the future of broadband networks. 

Equal Opportunity

Vistance Networks is an Equal Opportunity Employer. The company does not discriminate in its employment practices on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, veteran status, disability, or any other status protected by applicable law. People with disabilities and veterans are encouraged to apply.

Supports team members in designing and architecting infrastructure and service and shares guidance on practices for reliability and functionality. Responsibilities

Capacity Ingestion and Management: 

- Supports team members designing and architecting infrastructure and/or service, sharing guidance on practices and terms for reliability and functionality.

 - Maintains a collaborative relationship with the software development team to develop infrastructures, ensuring features are reliable and scalable according to deployment requirements. 
 - Implements expectations for identifying opportunities for prototyping and manages prototyping initiatives (e. g. , testing new applications or infrastructures, assisting in onboarding) to explore novel approaches. 

Incident and Service Lifecycle Management:

Promotes inclusivity by actively seeking and listening to diverse perspectives, ensuring others feel heard and respected.

We are seeking an experienced and strategic Senior Manager - DevOps & DevSecOps to define, execute, and scale the DevOps and DevSecOps engineering strategy for CarelonRx engineering teams in India. - DevOps & DevSecOps Strategy and Engineering Excellence
 - Define and execute the DevOps/DevSecOps strategy and roadmap for India engineering teams aligned with enterprise priorities. 
 - Establish engineering standards for CI/CD, infrastructure as code (IaC), cloud-native development, security automation, and release management. 
 - Drive shift-left security adoption, embedding automated checks early in the software development lifecycle (SDLC). 
 - Develop reusable DevOps patterns, templates, and platform capabilities to prevent fragmented, one-off solutions. 
 - Reduce manual deployment friction and improve deployment consistency, repeatability, and reliability. 
 - CI/CD & Platform Engineering
 - Own and mature enterprise CI/CD capabilities using GitHub Actions, Harness, Azure DevOps, Jenkins, or equivalent platforms. 
 - Establish standardized pipelines covering build, test, security scanning, artifact management, deployment, and rollback. 
 - Implement policy-as-code and infrastructure-as-code using Terraform and cloud-native tooling. 
 - Partner with platform engineering teams to deliver self-service developer capabilities and golden paths. 
 - Security Integration (DevSecOps) & Compliance
 - Embed automated security controls across the SDLC: SAST, DAST, SCA, container/image scanning, secrets detection, IaC scanning, dependency management, and SBOM generation. 
 - Translate cybersecurity policies into automated engineering guardrails. 
 - Establish risk-based vulnerability remediation and exception-management workflows. 
 - Ensure pipelines and environments comply with healthcare regulatory standards for protected health information (PHI) and audit readiness. 
 - Cloud & Infrastructure Automation
 - Drive DevOps practices across multi-cloud environments (AWS, Azure, GCP). 
 - Promote automated infrastructure provisioning, environment management, and secure cloud configuration patterns. 
 - Support containerized and Kubernetes-based platforms, partnering with cloud engineering to maximize resiliency and scalability. 
 - Observability & Operational Excellence
 - Establish standards for logging, monitoring, tracing, telemetry, and alerting. 
 - Partner with SRE/operations to improve production reliability and proactively detect performance issues. 
 - Track core engineering metrics (DORA metrics, availability, deployment success, security vulnerability coverage). 
 - India Team Leadership & Global Collaboration
 - Lead, hire, and mentor a high-performing team of DevOps/DevSecOps engineers and technical leads in India. 
 - Function as a unified engineering organization with US stakeholders, ensuring clear governance across time zones. 
 - Build India capability toward full engineering and platform ownership, establishing robust support and escalation models. 
 - Developer Productivity & AI-Enabled Engineering
 - Identify and eliminate bottlenecks across developer workflows to maximize productivity. 
 - Evaluate and scale AI-assisted engineering for code analysis, security remediation, pipeline troubleshooting, and operational insights. 

Key Success Measures

- DORA Metrics: Deployment Frequency, Lead Time for Changes, Change Failure Rate, and MTTR. 
 - Automation & Adoption: CI/CD pipeline adoption, percentage of automated deployments, and IaC coverage. 
 - Security & Compliance: Pre-production vulnerability identification, critical/high vulnerability remediation time, and automated security coverage. 
 - Developer Experience: Onboarding speed, developer satisfaction, and reduction of manual production tasks. 

Required Skills & Competencies

- Experience: 6-15 years of technical and leadership experience in DevOps, DevSecOps, and Cloud Engineering. 
 - Cloud & Infrastructure: Strong technical experience with core AWS platform architecture (Organizations, Account Design, VPC, Subnets, segmentation strategies) and multi-cloud environments (Azure/GCP). 
 - CI/CD & Automation: Expertise in GitHub Actions, Harness, Azure DevOps, Jenkins, Terraform, and configuration management tools. 
 - Security Tooling: Deep hands-on knowledge of SAST, DAST, SCA, container scanning, and secret management. 
 - Leadership: Proven track record of building, leading, and scaling high-performing technology teams in a global GCC model.

data.title: Energy - Platform Engineer - CI/CD Pipeline
data.description:
Profile: Platform Engineer

About SolarSquare

At SolarSquare we are building the Home-Energy brand of future India. We help homes switch to rooftop solar and move away from traditional coal electricity. We are a full-stack D2C residential solar brand - designing, installing, maintaining (after-sales), and financing solar systems for home-owners across India. 

In a few short years we have scaled to become the leading residential solar brand in India. We are obsessed with quality, customer service, and innovating to make it simple for homes to switch to solar. We are looking for leaders to join us in this mission. 

What Platform Is Here To Do

Platform builds the systems every other team depends on and makes them simple to use. In practice that means: 

- Designing systems and the contracts between them so teams can work together without knowing each other's internals. 
 - Hiding complexity behind clean interfaces: one way to authenticate, publish an event, schedule work or call a vendor, instead of five. 
 - Treating cost as a design requirement. A service should be cheaper to run next quarter than it is today. 
 - Keeping the architecture small enough for one person to understand and able to scale without a rewrite. 
 - Defining the guardrails, templates and standards that engineers and coding agents both build within. 

What You'll Do

- Write TRDs precise enough for an agent to execute and clear enough for a new engineer to review, then drive them to production, checking and correcting what the agents produce. 
 - Build and run shared backend services such as authentication, event streaming, scheduling and deep linking, and the integrations that connect them. 
 - Find the same problem being solved in three places and replace it with one service, library or guardrail. 
 - Make the infrastructure calls for what you own (data stores, queues, caching, scaling, failure handling) and write down the trade-offs. 
 - Turn what works into org-wide practice: reusable skills, agent instructions, review checklists and sessions that bring other pods along. 
 - Question decisions, including leadership's, when the evidence points to a better way. 

You'll Fit If

- You have 3 - 6 years building backend systems in production, with strong fundamentals: data structures, concurrency, networking, and how databases and queues behave under load. 
 - You think in systems and interfaces. You can explain why a boundary sits where it does, and you notice when an abstraction has started costing more than it saves. 
 - You work hands-on with AI coding agents every day and have opinions, backed by experience, on where they help, where they fail and how to constrain them. 
 - You write well. Your design docs remove ambiguity instead of moving it somewhere else. 
 - You can't leave a known problem alone, and you insist on doing things the right way. When you find a better practice, you make sure the rest of the org adopts it, not only your team. 
 - You move fast because your designs are clear, not because you skip steps. You would rather cut scope than ship something you will need to apologise for. 
 - You know containers, Kubernetes, CI/CD and cloud infrastructure well enough to deploy and debug your own services without waiting on anyone. 
 - You judge your work by what it changed for the people using it: cost saved, hours removed, incidents that stopped recurring. 

The Tech You'll Work With

- AWS, Kubernetes, Terraform, CI/CD pipelines, Kafka, Redis, and Datadog, Prometheus and Grafana for observability, alongside coding agents and internal tooling built on top of them. 

(ref: hirist. tech)

data.description:
Our Company

We're Hitachi Digital, a company at the forefront of digital transformation and the fastest growing division of Hitachi Group. We're crucial to the company's strategy and ambition to become a premier global player in the massive and fast-moving digital transformation market. 

Our group companies, including GlobalLogic, Hitachi Digital Services, Hitachi Vantara and more, offer comprehensive services that span the entire digital lifecycle, from initial idea to full-scale operation and the infrastructure to run it on. Hitachi Digital represents One Hitachi, integrating domain knowledge and digital capabilities, and harnessing the power of the entire portfolio of services, technologies, and partnerships, to accelerate synergy creation and make real-world impact for our customers and society as a whole. 

Imagine the sheer breadth of talent it takes to unleash a digital future. We don't expect you to 'fit' every requirement - your life experience, character, perspective, and passion for achieving great things in the world are equally as important to us. 

Job Description

Job Summary: 

We are looking for an experienced Salesforce Architect to lead the design, implementation, and optimization of Salesforce solutions across the enterprise. The ideal candidate will have deep technical expertise in Salesforce architecture, a strong understanding of business processes, and the ability to align platform capabilities with strategic goals. You will serve as a trusted advisor to stakeholders, guiding technical teams and ensuring scalable and maintainable Salesforce solutions. 

Key Responsibilities

- Design and architect scalable Salesforce solutions across Sales Cloud, CPQ, PSA (Certinia)- Good to have, and other Salesforce products and managed packages. 
 - Lead end-to-end solution architecture for complex business problems. 
 - Collaborate with business stakeholders, developers, and administrators to define requirements and translate them into technical designs. 
 - Ensure architectural best practices are followed, including performance tuning, security, and integration. 
 - Review and approve technical designs and code to ensure quality and alignment with enterprise standards. 
 - Oversee data modeling, integration design, and data migration planning. 
 - Serve as the SME for all Salesforce-related initiatives, providing mentorship to technical teams. 
 - Stay updated on Salesforce platform enhancements and industry trends to guide long-term strategies. 

Required Qualifications

- 7-14 years of experience with Salesforce Development, including 4+ years in customisation, designing technical solution. 
 - Hands-on experience with Apex, Lightning Components, SOQL, and Salesforce APIs. 
 - Deep knowledge of Salesforce architecture patterns, governor limits, and security models. 
 - Proven experience in Salesforce integrations using middleware tools like Snaplogic, Mulesoft, Dell Boomi, etc. 
 - Strong communication and stakeholder management skills. 
 - Should be adaptable to overlapping work schedules across teams in USA and India.

data.title: Engineering Director - Subsystem Interoperability & AI-Driven Verification
data.description:
Job Title: - Engineering Director - Subsystem Interoperability & AI-Driven Verification

We Are

Synopsys is the leader in engineering solutions from silicon to systems, enabling customers to rapidly innovate AI-powered products. We deliver industry-leading silicon design, IP, simulation and analysis solutions, and design services. We partner closely with our customers across a wide range of industries to maximize their R&D capability and productivity, powering innovation today that ignites the ingenuity of tomorrow. 

You Are

You have spent two decades building verification teams and solving the problems that live between IP blocks, where clean interfaces meet messy reality and independently verified components refuse to cooperate. The gap between a Controller that passes all tests and a Controller-PHY-firmware combination that actually works in a customer SoC is where you live, and you have built the instincts to close it. 

You are technical enough to review a UVM testbench, debug a protocol violation three layers deep, and make the call on whether a coverage hole is real or academic. But you also know that verification at scale is not about heroic debug sessions, it is about building systems that catch problems before they become customer issues. You think in factories, not fire drills. 

What excites you now is applying AI to verification work that has resisted automation for years. You see LLMs, agentic workflows, and intelligent orchestration not as buzzwords but as tools that can finally turn interoperability from a bottleneck into a continuously running capability. You are ready to build that capability from the ground up at Synopsys, where the IP portfolio is real, the customer stakes are high, and the technical challenge is exactly the kind you have been preparing for. 

What You'll Be Doing

- Build and lead the Central Interoperability team from scratch, defining its technical strategy, organizational structure, verification methodology, execution model, and success metrics across high-speed interface IPs including UCIe, PCIe, CXL, DDR, HBM, Ethernet, and USB
 - Own end-to-end Controller-PHY interoperability qualification, from UVM environment bring-up and configuration management through verification execution, functional and structural coverage closure, protocol compliance, debug, and generation of customer-ready release evidence
 - Establish an always-on Interop Factory where new Controller, PHY, or firmware releases automatically trigger integration, regression suites, qualification workflows, and evidence generation without manual intervention
 - Drive interoperability verification beyond basic connectivity into protocol compliance, stress and error injection scenarios, CDC/RDC checks, timing constraints validation, and implementation readiness across the Controller × PHY × Firmware × VIP × Configuration state space
 - Make the factory AI-native by applying LLMs, AI agents, RAG, MCP, and intelligent workflow orchestration to environment generation, test plan development, regression selection, failure clustering, root-cause analysis, debug acceleration, and knowledge reuse across releases
 - Build a continuous learning loop where customer issues feed directly into root-cause analysis, prevention test creation, regression integration, and future release qualification, systematically converting field learning into improved product quality
 - Partner across Controller and PHY R&D teams, architecture, VIP development, firmware, methodology, applications engineering, and product management to create one accountable, transparent subsystem-readiness view for every release

The Impact You Will Have

- You will create a new verification capability that shifts interoperability left in the development cycle, reducing subsystem bring-up time for customers and increasing the number of qualified Controller-PHY-firmware configurations available at release
 - You will transform interoperability from a customer integration exercise into a continuously verified product capability, with reusable qualification evidence and clear release gates that reduce field issues and support escalations
 - Your factory will establish a scalable blueprint for subsystem verification across the broader Synopsys IP portfolio, creating reusable infrastructure, methodology, and AI-enabled automation that other teams can adopt
 - You will build a team culture that attracts top verification talent, mentors engineers into technical leadership roles, and keeps the organization technically engaged even as it scales
 - You will make AI-assisted verification real and measurable, demonstrating how LLMs and agentic workflows can accelerate debug, improve coverage strategies, and turn tribal knowledge into reusable intelligence
 - You will create predictable, data-driven subsystem readiness visibility for executives and customers, replacing subjective assessments with objective qualification metrics tied to real verification evidence
 - You will reduce the time from IP release to customer-ready subsystem from months to weeks by automating the integration, qualification, and evidence-generation workflows that currently require manual coordination

What You'll Need

- 20+ years of semiconductor design and verification experience with significant technical leadership responsibility building and scaling verification teams
 - Deep expertise in ASIC, SoC, IP, or subsystem verification using SystemVerilog, UVM, verification planning, functional and code coverage analysis, assertions, regression infrastructure, and complex multi-IP debug
 - Strong hands-on experience with high-speed protocols such as UCIe, PCIe, CXL, DDR, HBM, Ethernet, USB, or SerDes, including protocol compliance, Controller-PHY integration, and interoperability challenges
 - Proven track record integrating independently developed IP blocks and driving complex cross-functional technical programs across R&D, product, and applications teams
 - Strong scripting and automation skills using Python, Tcl, or equivalent for building verification infrastructure, regression frameworks, and intelligent workflow orchestration
 - Experience with CDC/RDC verification, formal methods, emulation or prototyping platforms, CI/CD for verification, or physical implementation flows is highly desirable
 - Exposure to LLMs, agentic AI, RAG, MCP, AI-assisted verification or debug tools, or intelligent engineering automation is strongly preferred and will differentiate your application

Who You Are

- You can sit in a technical review with verification engineers debugging a CXL protocol failure and walk out with a clear action plan, then turn around and explain the customer-readiness risk to a VP in two sentences without losing the technical nuance
 - You do not wait for perfect alignment across teams to get started, you define the interoperability strategy, build the initial environment, and prove the value before asking for full organizational buy-in
 - You recruit engineers who are better than you at specific things and you create the conditions for them to do their best work, whether that is deep UVM expertise, AI automation, or protocol-level debug
 - You have a point of view on what good verification looks like and you push back when a test plan is too shallow, a coverage model is missing critical scenarios, or a release gate is being bypassed without real justification
 - You are energized by building new capabilities from scratch, not inheriting mature organizations, and you are comfortable with the ambiguity, cross-functional negotiation, and technical problem-solving that comes with that
 - You stay technical, you still read code, review testbenches, understand coverage reports, and debug failures alongside your team, because that is how you earn credibility and make good decisions

The Team You'll Be Part Of

You will build the Central Subsystem Interoperability team from the ground up, establishing its charter, hiring its engineers, and defining its relationship to Controller R&D, PHY R&D, VIP, firmware, and product teams across Synopsys. This is a new capability being created to transform how independently developed IP becomes qualified, customer-ready subsystems. You will report into senior engineering leadership and work closely with architecture, methodology, and product management to establish the vision, execution model, and success metrics for this organization. Your team will become the accountable owner of subsystem readiness across high-speed interface IPs, with the mandate to build an always-on, AI-enabled interoperability factory that scales across the portfolio. 

Rewards And Benefits

We offer a comprehensive range of health, wellness, and financial benefits to cater to your needs. Our total rewards include both monetary and non-monetary offerings. Your recruiter will provide more details about the salary range and benefits during the hiring process.

Job Title: - Architect - Subsystem Interoperability & AI-Driven Verification

We Are

We deliver industry-leading silicon design, IP, simulation and analysis solutions, and design services. We partner closely with our customers across a wide range of industries to maximize their R&D capability and productivity, powering innovation today that ignites the ingenuity of tomorrow. 

You Are

You are a recognized technical leader who thinks in systems, not individual IP blocks. You understand where interoperability challenges emerge at architectural boundaries, configurations, initialization sequences, protocol interactions, firmware dependencies, clock and reset domains, implementation constraints and assumptions made between independently developed IP. Deep hands-on verification expertise combines with your ability to define technical strategy, influence architecture, and lead engineering transformation across organizational boundaries. You are equally comfortable defining a subsystem verification architecture, reviewing SystemVerilog/UVM environments, analyzing coverage, debugging a challenging Controller-PHY interaction in Verdi, developing automation in Python and presenting technical direction to senior R&D leadership. You don't simply debug interoperability problems. You architect them out of the system. The most complex cross-IP technical investigations energize you because solving them well means preventing entire classes of failures before they reach customers. At Synopsys, you will help build the next generation of subsystem interoperability verification across high-speed interface IPs, and you will pioneer how GenAI, LLMs, and agentic workflows transform verification from reactive debugging into continuous intelligent qualification. 

What You'll Be Doing

- Define the technical vision for subsystem interoperability spanning Controller, PHY, firmware, VIP, verification environments, and customer configurations across multiple high-speed interface IP families
 - Architect a scalable Interop Verification Platform that enables continuous integration, verification, and qualification across IP releases, solving the configuration challenge across Controller × PHY × Firmware × VIP × Protocol Mode × Customer Configuration using intelligent risk and coverage-based qualification
 - Establish reusable verification architectures, methodologies and golden reference environments covering functional verification, protocol compliance, error and stress scenarios, coverage, assertions, CDC/RDC and system initialization
 - Lead the most complex cross-IP technical investigations and drive systemic solutions across RTL, PHY, firmware, VIP, testbench and implementation boundaries when interoperability issues surface
 - Partner with Controller and PHY architects and R&D teams to influence interfaces, observability, design-for-verification and subsystem architecture early in the development lifecycle
 - Pioneer an AI-native verification architecture that applies GenAI, LLMs, RAG and agentic workflows across the verification lifecycle: specification to verification intent to environment to tests to regression to debug to qualification to learning
 - Architect AI-assisted generation of environments and tests, intelligent regression selection, automated log and failure clustering, coverage-gap analysis, protocol and waveform debug, root-cause recommendations, engineering knowledge retrieval and automated qualification evidence

The Impact You Will Have

- Transform interoperability from a late-stage integration activity into a continuous product capability that accelerates subsystem bring-up and qualification across Synopsys IP portfolios
 - Scale verification across increasingly complex IP configurations, enabling Synopsys to deliver subsystems that work together seamlessly before they reach customer environments
 - Convert field issues into permanent prevention tests and reusable engineering knowledge, reducing repeat failures and building institutional memory into the verification platform
 - Establish common interoperability methodology across multiple IP families including UCIe, PCIe/CXL, Ethernet, DDR/HBM, USB and AMBA/CHI, creating consistency and reuse across product lines
 - Create an AI-native verification architecture capable of scaling engineering expertise across products and organizations, fundamentally changing how Synopsys qualifies complex subsystems
 - Define compatibility matrices and qualification criteria that provide clear, evidence-based confidence that a specific Controller-PHY combination is customer ready, reducing integration risk and time-to-market
 - Mentor senior engineers and serve as a technical authority for subsystem interoperability, raising the bar for verification excellence across the organization

What You'll Need

- 15+ years of ASIC/IP/SoC verification experience with demonstrated technical leadership on complex verification programs where you defined architecture, influenced direction, and delivered results across organizational boundaries
 - Deep expertise in SystemVerilog, UVM, assertions, functional and code coverage, verification closure and complex debug, with hands-on experience building and reviewing sophisticated verification environments
 - Proven experience architecting reusable verification environments for IP, subsystem or SoC designs that scaled across multiple projects or product lines
 - Strong expertise in one or more high-speed protocols such as UCIe, PCIe/CXL, Ethernet, DDR/HBM, USB or AMBA/CHI, with deep understanding of protocol interactions, initialization sequences, and interoperability challenges
 - Hands-on expertise with industry-standard simulation and debug tools, VIP and coverage infrastructure, specifically VCS and Verdi or equivalent toolchains
 - Strong automation expertise in Python, Tcl or equivalent scripting languages, with a track record of building tools that improve verification productivity
 - Experience with CDC/RDC, formal verification, emulation/prototyping, CI/CD or distributed verification infrastructure is highly desirable, as is experience or strong interest in GenAI, LLMs, RAG, agentic AI and AI-assisted verification

Who You Are

- You can walk into a room where a Controller-PHY integration is failing in a customer configuration, debug the waveforms in Verdi, identify the root cause across firmware, RTL and protocol assumptions, and define the systemic fix that prevents similar issues across all future configurations
 - You influence technical direction and align teams without relying on organizational authority, using technical credibility, clear communication and a track record of solving hard problems to drive consensus
 - You mentor senior engineers by showing them how to think about verification architecture, not just how to write better tests, raising the technical bar for everyone around you
 - You balance deep technical work with strategic thinking, moving fluidly between reviewing a UVM testbench, defining a three-year verification roadmap, and presenting technical direction to R&D leadership
 - You see AI and LLMs not as hype but as tools that can fundamentally change how verification scales, and you are ready to architect how GenAI integrates into the verification lifecycle from specification to qualification
 - You push back when an interface design creates unnecessary interoperability risk or when a qualification plan lacks evidence, because you care more about building systems that work than making everyone comfortable

The Team You'll Be Part Of

You will work within the IP R&D organization at Synopsys, partnering closely with Controller and PHY architects, verification teams, firmware engineers, and VIP developers across multiple high-speed interface IP families. Your role sits at the intersection of these teams, defining the technical architecture and methodology that enables subsystems to work together seamlessly. You will collaborate with engineers in Bangalore and across global R&D sites, influencing technical direction and driving engineering transformation across organizational boundaries. This is a highly visible technical leadership role with direct impact on how Synopsys delivers complex IP subsystems to customers. 

Rewards And Benefits

We offer a comprehensive range of health, wellness, and financial benefits to cater to your needs. Our total rewards include both monetary and non-monetary offerings. Your recruiter will provide more details about the salary range and benefits during the hiring process.

data.title: Digital Verification Senior Engineer
data.description:
We Are

Synopsys is the leader in engineering solutions from silicon to systems, enabling customers to rapidly innovate AI-powered products. We deliver industry-leading silicon design, IP, simulation and analysis solutions, and design services. We partner closely with our customers across a wide range of industries to maximize their R&D capability and productivity, powering innovation today that ignites the ingenuity of tomorrow. 

You Are

You have spent the last few years building verification environments that actually catch bugs before tapeout, and you know the difference between a testbench that looks complete and one that actually stresses the design. UVM is not just a framework you have heard about, it is something you have used to build real testbenches, debug real failures, and close coverage gaps that mattered. 

You are comfortable reading a specification, asking the questions that are not written down, and turning that into a verification plan that makes sense. When a simulation fails at 3pm, you do not wait for someone to tell you what to do. You dig into waveforms, trace the issue, and figure out whether it is a test problem, an environment problem, or an actual design bug. 

Protocols are not intimidating to you. Maybe you have worked with one already, maybe you have not, but you know how to read a spec, understand timing diagrams, and build checkers that enforce the rules. You are the kind of engineer who wants to get better, who asks good questions, and who does not need to be the smartest person in the room to contribute something real. 

At Synopsys, you will work with people who have been doing this for years and who will help you grow. 

What You'll Be Doing

- Analyze design specifications and identify what needs to be verified, including functionality, interfaces, edge cases, and protocol compliance
 - Build and extend UVM-based verification environments in System Verilog, working alongside a technical lead to define architecture and reusable components
 - Write directed and constrained-random tests, implement functional checkers, and develop coverage models to track verification progress
 - Debug simulation failures by analyzing waveforms, logs, and coverage reports to isolate root causes in the testbench or design
 - Collaborate with design engineers to understand RTL changes and with the VIP team to integrate and leverage verification IP effectively
 - Contribute to test planning, code reviews, and process improvements that help the team close verification faster and with higher quality
 - Follow established verification methodologies and quality standards while identifying opportunities to improve flow efficiency

The Impact You Will Have

- Your verification environments will catch critical design issues before they reach silicon, saving months of debug time and reducing tapeout risk
 - The test scenarios and checkers you build will directly improve functional coverage closure and give the team confidence in design correctness
 - Your collaboration with design engineers will surface ambiguities and corner cases early, leading to cleaner RTL and fewer late-stage surprises
 - The verification IP and reusable components you help develop will be leveraged across multiple projects, accelerating future verification efforts
 - Your contributions to test planning and coverage analysis will help the team make data-driven decisions about when a block is ready to integrate
 - The questions you ask and the gaps you identify will strengthen specifications and improve the overall quality of the product
 - Your willingness to learn new protocols and methodologies will expand the team's capability and enable support for more complex designs

What You'll Need

- Bachelor's degree in Electronics Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a closely related field
 - At least 3 years of hands-on experience in digital design verification
 - Proficiency in Verilog and System Verilog, with a working understanding of UVM methodology and testbench architecture
 - Experience writing and debugging testbenches, including constrained-random testing, functional coverage, and assertion-based verification
 - Ability to read and interpret design specifications, timing diagrams, and interface protocols
 - Experience with a standard protocol such as AXI, PCIe, USB, or Ethernet is a plus
 - Familiarity with simulation tools like VCS, Questa, or Xcelium is a plus

Who You Are

- You can take a 50-page specification, pull out what matters for verification, and turn it into a test plan without needing someone to walk you through every line
 - When a test fails, you do not stop at "it is broken, " you trace it back to the root cause and explain what went wrong in a way that helps the designer fix it quickly
 - You manage your own work without needing daily direction, you know what is blocking you, what is next, and when to ask for help
 - You communicate clearly in English, both in writing and in conversation, whether you are documenting a coverage gap or explaining a simulation failure in a team meeting
 - You are comfortable working with people across functions, design engineers who need clear bug reports, VIP teams who need integration feedback, and leads who need status without fluff
 - Learning a new protocol or verification technique does not intimidate you, it is just part of the job, and you are willing to put in the work to get up to speed

Rewards and Benefits

We offer a comprehensive range of health, wellness, and financial benefits to cater to your needs. Our total rewards include both monetary and non-monetary offerings. Your recruiter will provide more details about the salary range and benefits during the hiring process.

Moative is an AI company that partners with mid-market businesses in asset-heavy, regulated industries to co-build industry-specific agentic and machine-learning solutions, then scales them across the industry through revenue-share and equity-linked models. The founders have built and sold two companies, one of them in AI, and the 20+ person team of AI/ML engineers, data scientists and mathematicians comes from IITs, IISc, CERN, UZH and IBM Research. Its healthcare business builds AI agents that run revenue-cycle and administrative work for US healthcare practices. 

About the Role

You'll build and deploy AI agents, automations and data workflows for US healthcare revenue cycle management (RCM). You'll own each workflow end to end, from understanding how billing teams work today through deployment, evaluation and ongoing improvement. You'll work alongside AI/ML engineers, data scientists and domain specialists, directly with billing and operations teams. The role is based in Chennai, hybrid with 3 days a week in the office. 

What you'll do

- Build agents for payer-portal automation: claim status checks and EOB retrieval across inconsistent portal layouts
 - Build voice agents for payer follow-up, integrating speech-to-text and text-to-speech
 - Turn fragmented healthcare data (scanned PDFs, EOBs, ERAs, incomplete records) into validated, structured inputs
 - Analyse claim journeys and revenue-cycle bottlenecks and surface AI-assisted insights into practice performance
 - Evaluate accuracy and completion rates on representative test sets, and monitor failures and operating costs
 - Add retries, exception queues and human escalation to every workflow
 - Apply privacy and security controls: access restrictions, audit trails, and no patient data in logs or model inputs

 - You've deployed and supported an LLM application or AI agent in production, using RAG, tool calling or multi-step workflows, and can explain how it was evaluated, what failed and how you fixed it

The ideal candidate will have strong hands-on experience designing and implementing production-grade cloud infrastructure and deployment platforms, with a strong understanding of DevSecOps, cloud security, SRE principles, reliability engineering, automation, and security operations. 

This role will work closely with Engineering, QA, Product, Security, Architecture, and client teams to enable fast and reliable software delivery while maintaining the security, availability, performance, and compliance requirements expected in a product development environment. 

The role will also involve client implementations, technical solutioning, environment setup, deployment planning, production rollouts, troubleshooting, and technical discussions with client engineering and infrastructure teams. 

Key Responsibilities

Cloud & Platform Engineering

- Design and manage production-grade Azure infrastructure with focus on scalability, availability, security, and performance.

 - Automate operational and engineering workflows using Python, Bash, or PowerShell. 

DevSecOps & SecOps

 - Integrate security controls into CI/CD pipelines, including SAST, DAST, dependency scanning, container image scanning, secrets detection, and vulnerability management. 
 - Implement and manage cloud security controls covering IAM/RBAC, Entra ID, Key Vault, network security, private endpoints, NSGs, and secure workload configuration. 
 - Monitor security events, vulnerabilities, configuration risks, and infrastructure anomalies and coordinate remediation with engineering and security teams. 
 - Support security reviews, compliance requirements, audit activities, and production security assessments. 
 - Work with development teams to establish secure-by-design deployment and infrastructure patterns. 

Client Implementation & Delivery

 - Work directly with client infrastructure, DevOps, security, networking, and application teams to understand environment requirements and implementation constraints. 
 - Own technical activities including environment readiness, infrastructure provisioning, connectivity, deployment, configuration, integrations, security controls, and production go-live. 
 - Troubleshoot complex implementation and production issues and drive them through resolution with internal and client stakeholders. 
 - Prepare implementation documentation, deployment guides, architecture diagrams, runbooks, and operational handover documents. 
 - Participate in client technical discussions, solution workshops, implementation calls, and production readiness reviews. 

Reliability & Observability

- Build observability using Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, Prometheus, Grafana, Open Telemetry, or equivalent technologies.

 - Troubleshoot complex cloud, Kubernetes, networking, deployment, security, and production issues. 
 - Participate in RCA/post-incident reviews and implement corrective and preventive actions. 
 - Establish operational standards, monitoring, alerting, and incident response practices. 

Engineering Enablement

- Enable engineering teams through self-service infrastructure and standardized deployment patterns. 
 - Participate in architecture and design discussions to define scalable, reliable, and secure infrastructure patterns. 
 - Mentor engineers and contribute to platform architecture, DevSecOps, and engineering standards. 
 - Continuously improve automation, deployment processes, infrastructure efficiency, security posture, and operational reliability. 

Communication & Stakeholder Management

 - Act as a technical point of contact for DevOps, infrastructure, security, and deployment-related discussions with clients. 
 - Collaborate effectively across Engineering, QA, Product, Security, Architecture, Support, and client teams. 
 - Communicate implementation plans, risks, dependencies, incidents, timelines, and technical decisions clearly and proactively. 
 - Create high-quality technical documentation, implementation plans, architecture notes, runbooks, and incident/RCA reports. 

Key Requirements

- 8 to 12 years of hands-on DevOps / Cloud / Platform Engineering / SRE experience. 
 - Strong hands-on production experience with Microsoft Azure. 
 - Strong production experience with AKS, Kubernetes, and Docker. 
 - Strong hands-on experience designing and managing production infrastructure using Terraform or equivalent IaC.

 - Strong understanding of Linux, networking, DNS, load balancing, TLS, IAM/RBAC, and cloud security.

data.title: Founding Full Stack Staff Engineer - Frontier Cyber Security
data.description:
Hiring for Lean SuperIntelligence - via Flexiple, the recruiting partner on this role. 

ABOUT US

Lean SuperIntelligence (LSI) is an AI lab building self-improving cybersecurity foundation models for enterprises. LSI publicly announced LSI-Offense-1 and LSI-Defense-1 on October 9, 2026, alongside the closing of its initial pre-seed financing. 

LSI-Offense-1 discovers, exploits and validates vulnerabilities; LSI-Defense-1 detects, investigates and responds to threats. The models improve through an offense-defense feedback loop inside LSI Cyber World Models, simulated enterprise environments that turn attack and defense outcomes into training signals. 

The models are designed for enterprise-controlled deployment, including on-premises and air-gapped environments, with customization on private enterprise data. Access is currently limited to selected design partners. 

Founded by Chandra Khatri, LSI brings together foundation-model builders and security researchers. Its announced backers include investors and angels with AI and security leadership experience at OpenAI, CrowdStrike, SentinelOne, Zscaler, Commvault and Gruve AI. These affiliations do not imply corporate investment by those organizations. 

Learn more: LSI website | Launch announcement | Financing and model news. 

ABOUT THE ROLE

We are hiring a Founding Full Stack Staff Engineer to build the product surface of our frontier security platform, from data model and services through to the interfaces security teams work in every day. 

You will own features end to end: backend services, agent-facing APIs, and the front end where findings, exploit evidence, and remediation workflows are reviewed and acted on. This is a senior individual-contributor role with broad architectural ownership and a direct line to design partners. 

RESPONSIBILITIES

- Own features end to end across data model, backend services, APIs, front end, telemetry, and rollout. 

- Build the interfaces security teams work in daily: finding triage, exploit evidence review, remediation and retest tracking, agent run inspection, and reporting. 

- Design backend services and APIs for scanning, agent execution, evidence storage, and integrations with code hosts, CI/CD, ticketing systems, and cloud accounts. 

- Build product surfaces on top of LLMs and autonomous agents, including streaming output, long-running task state, human approval steps, partial results, and graceful failure. 

- Turn AppSec workflows into product: finding deduplication, severity and reachability context, ownership routing, SLA tracking, and verification that fixes actually close the vulnerability. 

- Design schemas and pipelines for findings, agent trajectories, evidence artifacts, and audit trails. 

- Build multi-tenant foundations including authentication, authorization, RBAC, org and project scoping, audit logging, secrets handling, and tenant isolation. 

- Make agent behavior legible in the interface: what the agent did, what it proved, what it could not, and where a human needs to decide. 

- Own performance, reliability, latency, and cost across the stack, including inference and tool-execution cost surfaced to the user. 

- Set engineering standards for code review, testing, CI/CD, observability, incident response, and secure-by-default patterns, and treat our own attack surface as a first-class concern. 

- Prototype quickly with design partners, put working software in front of practitioners early, and decide what is ready to ship. 

- Partner with security researchers, agent-harness engineers, and product to move research capability into product without losing rigor. 

QUALIFICATIONS

- At least five years building and shipping production software, with meaningful time spent on cybersecurity products. 

- Strong full-stack ability: modern TypeScript and React on the front end, plus backend work in Go, Python, TypeScript, Java, or Rust. 

- Hands-on experience building application-security products, or closely adjacent ones such as code security, vulnerability management, attack-surface management, DevSecOps, offensive-security tooling, or SOC platforms. 

- Working security knowledge across common vulnerability classes, authentication and authorization, and secure design, with the ability to reason about the attack surface of what you build. 

- Experience designing APIs, data models, and asynchronous or long-running workflows. 

- Front-end craft on data-dense technical interfaces, including state management, streaming and real-time updates, and performance under large result sets. 

- Experience with cloud infrastructure, containers, CI/CD, and production operations. 

- Ability to scope ambiguous problems, make architectural decisions, and raise the bar for other engineers through code and review rather than process. 

- Clear technical writing and comfort working directly with security practitioners and design partners. 

- We value demonstrated ability over formal credentials, certifications, or a fixed number of years of experience. 

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

- Experience building products on LLMs or agents, including tool use, streaming, evaluations, prompt and model versioning, and latency and cost tradeoffs. 

- Product experience in autonomous pentesting, code security, SAST/DAST/SCA, vulnerability management, CTEM, EDR/XDR, or SOC automation. 

- Personal offensive-security depth such as CVEs, bug-bounty findings, advanced CTF performance, or published research. 

- Experience integrating with GitHub or GitLab, CI systems, Jira or ServiceNow, SIEM and EDR platforms, or cloud provider APIs. 

- Experience meeting enterprise requirements such as SSO, SAML, SCIM, audit logging, VPC or on-premise deployment, and air-gapped installs. 

- Experience with real-time systems, websockets, job queues, or event-driven architectures. 

- Design sensibility and the ability to own the user experience for technical workflows without a dedicated designer. 

- Understanding of AI and agent security risks including prompt injection, tool poisoning or misuse, excessive permissions, untrusted content, and sandbox boundaries. 

- Open-source contributions, technical writing, or prior founding-engineer and early-stage experience.

data.title: Engineering Manager - Agentic AI
data.description:
Location: Bangalore (Quarterly visit for 2 weeks)

Function: Software Engineering

Reports to: Director, Packaging Intelligence

About The Role

Esko is building Agentic AI as a shared platform capability that enables product teams to create reliable AI-powered workflows without independently rebuilding common foundations. The platform team provides reusable capabilities, engineering patterns, and production foundations; product teams retain ownership of their domain applications and customer experiences. 

This is a hands-on engineering leadership role combining line management with substantial direct technical contribution. You will lead and develop the Agentic AI team, help shape the platform's technical direction, and take end-to-end ownership of substantial technical areas. Success will be measured not only by what the team ships, but by the quality, adoption, and leverage the platform creates across Esko. 

You will work closely with product engineering, architecture, cloud platform, security, compliance, product management, and design to translate shared needs and legitimate domain differences into coherent platform capabilities. You will also contribute to Esko's broader AI direction and participate in customer or industry discussions where your technical perspective is valuable. 

What You Will Do

- Lead and develop the Agentic AI engineering team through clear goals, regular feedback, coaching, performance management, career development, and thoughtful allocation of ownership. 
 - Contribute directly to the design, implementation, and operation of substantial areas of Esko's shared Agentic AI platform. 
 - Help shape the platform's technical direction, architecture, interfaces, and engineering quality bar in collaboration with the wider platform and architecture community. 
 - Translate recurring product and engineering needs into reusable platform capabilities, while accommodating legitimate domain differences without creating product-specific forks. 
 - Establish strong engineering practices for reliability, security, observability, evaluation, performance, and compatibility for consuming teams. 
 - Work directly with product engineering teams to support adoption of the shared platform and help them take domain-specific agentic capabilities from exploration into production. 
 - Create an environment in which engineers can experiment, learn, challenge assumptions, and make evidence-based technical decisions while remaining accountable for production outcomes. 
 - Define and use meaningful measures of platform adoption, quality, operational performance, delivery effectiveness, and team development to guide priorities and improvement. 

What We Are Looking For

- Strong production software engineering experience in Python, TypeScript, Java, or a similar language, including designing, building, and operating reliable systems. 
 - Demonstrated experience leading and developing engineers, including line management, coaching, performance feedback, and creating meaningful technical ownership. 
 - Experience building a platform, API, or shared service used by multiple teams, with sound judgement about abstractions, interfaces, compatibility, and operational responsibilities. 
 - Experience designing or building production AI systems using large language models, tool use, or agentic workflows, together with a practical understanding of their limitations and risks. 
 - A track record of taking uncertain or early-stage technical ideas through evaluation, implementation, and adoption as dependable production capabilities. 
 - Ability to balance platform coherence with legitimate product and domain differences, and to make clear technical trade-offs when needs conflict. 
 - Experience collaborating across product engineering, architecture, infrastructure, security, and business functions in a global organization. 
 - Excellent written and verbal communication, with the ability to explain technical decisions clearly to engineering, product, and leadership audiences. 
 - Undergraduate, Master's degree or PhD in Computer Science / Machine Learning / Data Science / Artificial Intelligence, or related disciplines. 

Preferred Experience

- Experience in packaging graphics, prepress, CAD, or the wider graphic arts industry. 
 - Experience building or operating multi-tenant SaaS or cloud platform capabilities. 
 - Experience with AI evaluation, observability, security controls, governance, or other production foundations for agentic systems. 

What Success Looks Like

- Delivery of solutions conforming to agreed specifications and architecture that leverage agentic AI to solve valuable customer problems in a way that is explainable and repeatable - resulting in measurable productivity improvements. 
 - Teams across the business ship AI-powered capabilities that solve valuable customer problems by leveraging a shared foundation, rather than "re-inventing the wheel". 
 - Providing adequate space for ideation - and inspiration for team members to try new approaches, technologies and techniques. 
 - Team members are set meaningful, measurable goals - with training and development plans created to facilitate their ongoing personal and career development. 
 - Delivery of initiatives occurs in line with Esko's Software Development Lifecycle and in accordance with company policy and security best practices. 
 - The Agentic AI platform grows as a coherent whole rather than fragmenting into one-off, team-specific solutions. 
 - A class-leading set of capabilities provide a powerful base for Esko cross-functional teams to transform the value of our software using cutting-edge AI technologies. 

At Veralto, we value diversity and the existence of similarities and differences, both visible and not, found in our workforce, workplace and throughout the markets we serve. Our associates, customers and shareholders contribute unique and different perspectives as a result of these diverse attributes. 

Unsolicited Assistance

We do not accept unsolicited assistance from any headhunters or recruitment firms for any of our job openings. All resumes or profiles submitted by search firms to any employee at any of the Veralto companies, in any form without a valid, signed search agreement in place for the specific position, approved by Talent Acquisition, will be deemed the sole property of Veralto and its companies. No fee will be paid in the event the candidate is hired by Veralto and its companies because of the unsolicited referral.
