data.title: Sr Mgr Business Application
data.description:
We Are Teva

We're Teva, a leading innovative biopharmaceutical company, enabled by a world-class generics business. Whether it's innovating in the fields of neuroscience and immunology or delivering high-quality medicine worldwide, we're dedicated to addressing patients' needs now and in the future. Here, you will be part of a high-performing, inclusive culture that values fresh thinking and collaboration. You'll have the room to grow, the flexibility to balance life with work, and the opportunity to better health worldwide, together. 

Our Team, Your Impact

The Senior Manager, Business Application Validation is responsible for planning, coordinating, and delivering computerized system validation activities for global ITRD applications and projects. Reporting to the Director RDIT Business Applications, this role ensures that laboratory platforms are implemented, changed, and maintained in compliance with GxP, Data Integrity, and applicable regulatory requirements. The position provides day-to-day validation leadership across the project portfolio and works closely with application owners, laboratory business teams, Quality Assurance, project managers, technical teams, vendors, and contract validation resources. 

How You'll Spend Your Day

Validation Delivery & Project Leadership

- Lead validation activities for IT R&D projects from initiation through go-live, hypercare, and transition to operations. 
 - Develop and maintain validation plans, risk assessments, traceability, test strategies, validation reports, and supporting lifecycle documentation. 
 - Integrate validation deliverables, dependencies, and approval timelines into project plans. 
 - Coordinate business, technical, Quality Assurance, and vendor contributors to ensure timely completion of validation activities. 
 - Monitor validation risks, issues, deviations, and remediation actions, escalating material concerns to the Director RDIT Business Applications. 
 - Ensure validation documentation is complete, accurate, approved, and inspection-ready. 

IT R&D Portfolio Support

Provide validation leadership across all systems and projects within the IT R&D portfolio, including but not limited to: 

- Global Laboratory Informatics Platforms (e. g. ELN, LIMS, SDMS)
 - Clinical Platforms
 - Enterprise Quality and Regulatory Applications (e. g. Veeva, EDMS, QMS)
 - Infrastructure and Technology Projects
 - Cloud migrations
 - SaaS implementations
 - Major upgrades
 - Integrations
 - Cybersecurity-related changes impacting validated systems

Required Skills

Compliance, Quality & Continuous Improvement

- Apply risk-based validation practices aligned with GAMP 5, EU Annex 11, FDA 21 CFR Part 11, GxP, Data Integrity, and ALCOA+ principles. 
 - Partner with Quality Assurance to ensure validation approaches and deliverables meet internal and regulatory expectations. 
 - Support internal audits and health authority inspections by providing documentation, subject-matter expertise, and timely responses. 
 - Lead or support investigation and remediation of validation-related deviations, observations, and audit findings. 
 - Promote consistent use of approved validation procedures, templates, and tools. 
 - Identify opportunities to simplify validation execution, improve cycle times, and strengthen quality without increasing compliance risk. 

Team & Contract Resource Management

- Minimum 3-5 years' experience in a team leadership or people management role, with demonstrated experience managing, coaching and developing employees, setting priorities, allocating resources and ensuring successful delivery of team objectives. 
 - Provide day-to-day leadership, coaching, workload prioritisation, and performance oversight for assigned validation professionals and contract resources. 
 - Support recruitment and selection of contract validation resources, laise with procurement and approved vendors. 
 - Define role profiles, technical expectations, and required validation competencies for open assignments. 
 - Coordinate onboarding, training, system access, assignment, capacity, and offboarding of contract resources. 
 - Set clear objectives and deliverable expectations, monitor quality and productivity, and address performance or capability gaps promptly. 
 - Track utilisation, forecasts, purchase orders, and statements of work, highlighting budget or capacity risks to the Director RDIT Business Applications. 
 - Build validation capability within project teams through coaching, knowledge sharing, and practical guidance. 

Your Qualification And Experience

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Life Sciences, Information Systems, or a related discipline. 
 - 8+ years of experience in GxP-regulated environments, including substantial computerized system validation experience. 
 - Demonstrated experience leading validation delivery for laboratory, R&D, Quality, or other regulated technology projects. 
 - Experience coordinating cross-functional project teams and managing consultants or contract resources. 
 - Experience supporting regulatory inspections, internal audits, and remediation activities. 
 - Working knowledge of FDA 21 CFR Part 11, EU Annex 11, GAMP 5, GxP regulations, Data Integrity guidance, and ALCOA+. 
 - Practical experience with risk-based validation, SDLC, Agile delivery, change control, and supplier documentation. 
 - Preferred experience with laboratory informatics applications such as ELN, LIMS, SDMS, instrument integrations, cloud platforms, SaaS solutions and Veeva. 
 - Strong documentation, planning, facilitation, problem-solving, and stakeholder communication skills. 

Also good to have

Vendor & Stakeholder Management

- Coordinate validation deliverables produced by software vendors, system integrators, and service providers. 
 - Review vendor documentation for quality, completeness, traceability, and suitability for regulated use. 
 - Communicate validation status, risks, decisions, and resource needs clearly to project and IT R&D stakeholders. 
 - Build effective working relationships across laboratory functions, IT, Quality Assurance, procurement, and external partners. 

How We'll Take Care Of You

At Teva India, care is at the heart of how we work. From your first day, you'll be welcomed into a people-first culture built on inclusion, respect, and belonging. 

That support extends to you and your loved ones through benefits designed for real life. These include comprehensive medical insurance, OPD coverage, annual health checkups, term life and accident insurance, and confidential emotional wellbeing support through our Optum Employee Assistance Program. You'll also enjoy healthy meals at work, holistic wellbeing initiatives, and volunteering programs that help you give back to the community. 

Your growth matters too. You'll have opportunities to build future-ready skills, collaborate on projects with global teams, explore internal career opportunities, and learn through programs such as our AI-enabled Teva Twist program, R&D Academy, continuing education, and mentorship. 

Join our vibrant workplace, where we celebrate milestones, festivals, achievements, and community impact together. 

Already Working @Teva?

Make sure to apply through our internal career site on Twist-your one-stop shop for career development

Teva's Equal Employment Opportunity Commitment

Teva Pharmaceuticals is committed to equal opportunity in employment. It is Teva's global policy that equal employment opportunity be provided without regard to age, race, creed, color, religion, sex, disability, pregnancy, medical condition, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, ancestry, veteran status, national or ethnic origin or any other legally recognized status entitled to protection under applicable laws. We are committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace for all. If you are contacted for a job opportunity, please advise us of any accommodations needed to support you throughout the recruitment and selection process. All accommodation information provided will be treated as confidential and used only for the purpose of providing an accessible candidate experience.

data.title: Architect, IT Solutions, Copilot & Agentic AI Platforms
data.description:
Edwards Lifesciences is expanding its global technology capabilities with the launch of a new IT Innovation Hub in Pune, India. The Hub strengthens the technology foundation that supports our business worldwide, working in close partnership with teams across regions to deliver reliable, high-quality solutions at scale. Designed as a long-term investment, the Pune Hub will advance newer digital capabilities such as automation, data, AI, and cloud, and will include roles spanning end user services, application development, and enterprise platform teams. Together, these teams will help Edwards operate more efficiently and accelerate innovation in support of our mission of advancing patient care. 

As Edwards accelerates its AI-driven transformation, we are seeking an Architect, IT Solutions to serve as the enterprise technical authority for our two most strategic agentic AI platforms - Microsoft Copilot (M365 Copilot, Copilot Studio) and Moveworks. This is a multi-faceted architecture role that spans platform leadership, integration design, and end-to-end solution architecture. You will define how these platforms are built, extended, integrated, and governed across the enterprise. 

This role works alongside our existing Azure infrastructure architect and complements cloud expertise with deep, platform-specific technical authority. If you thrive at the intersection of enterprise architecture, applied AI, and business-facing delivery - and want to shape how a global lifescience company adopts agentic AI at scale - this is the role for you. 

How You'll Make An Impact

Platform Architecture Leadership - Copilot & Moveworks

- Own the enterprise platform architecture for Microsoft Copilot (M365 Copilot, Copilot Studio) and Moveworks - serving as the definitive technical authority on capabilities, extensibility, and best practices. 
 - Define the ecosystem blueprint, platform standards, extensibility patterns, and long-term technical roadmap for both platforms. 
 - Evaluate and recommend new platform features, plugins, connectors, and agentic AI capabilities as they emerge from Microsoft and Moveworks. 

Integration Architecture

- Design and govern the integration layer connecting Copilot and Moveworks to enterprise systems such as ServiceNow, Workday, JDE, Active Directory, HRIS, LMS, and CMDB. 
 - Define API strategies, event-driven patterns, connector frameworks, and messaging standards that enable secure, reliable, and scalable data flows across platforms. 
 - Partner with the Azure architecture team to ensure integration patterns align with cloud infrastructure, identity (Entra ID), and security standards. 

Lead Solution Architecture

- Provide end-to-end solution design and technical authority for all AI agent, copilot, and automation solutions built on these platforms. 
 - Lead architecture reviews, approve design decisions, and ensure solutions are production-ready, secure, and aligned with enterprise standards. 
 - Translate complex business requirements into scalable, repeatable architectural patterns and executable design strategies. 

Governance, Mentorship & Innovation

- Develop, institute, and maintain platform-specific design methodologies, development standards, security patterns, and operational best practices. 
 - Provide training, coaching, and technical mentorship to Forward-Deployed Engineers (FDEs), solution developers, and IT team members on Copilot and Moveworks architecture. 
 - Survey emerging developments in agentic AI - including multi-agent orchestration, RAG patterns, and tool-using agents - and recommend approaches that extend platform value. 
 - Develop and maintain architecture models, reference designs, integration maps, and documentation for current and proposed implementations. 

What you'll need (Required): 

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related technical field. 
 - Progressive IT experience, including significant depth in platform architecture, integration architecture, or solution architecture. 
 - Experience in an architect role working with cross-functional teams (within IT and/or business) on enterprise-level or complex system implementations. 
 - Deep expertise in at least one of the following: Microsoft Copilot ecosystem (M365 Copilot, Copilot Studio, Graph API, Graph Connectors, Copilot extensibility) or Moveworks platform (conversational AI, enterprise integrations, workflow automation). 
 - Strong integration architecture skills: REST/GraphQL APIs, event-driven architectures, enterprise connectors, middleware, and messaging patterns (e. g. , Azure Service Bus, Logic Apps, Power Automate). 
 - Proven ability to design end-to-end solution architectures for enterprise AI, automation, or digital workplace platforms. 
 - Experience defining platform standards, governance frameworks, and reusable architectural patterns at enterprise scale. 
 - Strong understanding of identity, security, and compliance requirements in enterprise AI deployments (e. g. , Entra ID, conditional access, DLP, data classification). 
 - Expert-level documentation and communication skills - ability to create architecture blueprints, integration maps, and present complex technical concepts to senior leadership and non-technical stakeholders. 
 - Strong interpersonal and leadership skills, including cross-functional negotiation, vendor management, and the ability to drive alignment across distributed teams. 

What else we look for (Preferred): 

- Hands-on experience with Microsoft Copilot Studio - building custom copilots, plugins, connectors, topics, and generative AI orchestration. 
 - Hands-on experience with Moveworks platform - configuring enterprise virtual agents, workflow automation, knowledge integration, and analytics. 
 - Experience with agentic AI patterns including multi-agent orchestration, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), tool-using agents, and planner-executor models. 
 - Experience integrating AI platforms with enterprise systems such as ServiceNow, Workday, SAP, Active Directory, LMS, and CMDB. 
 - Familiarity with Microsoft Power Platform (Power Automate, Power Apps) as an automation and extensibility layer. 
 - Experience deploying AI solutions in regulated industries (e. g. , medical device, pharmaceuticals, financial services) with attention to governance and responsible AI practices. 
 - Advanced degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related discipline. 
 - Professional certifications such as Azure Solutions Architect Expert, Microsoft 365 Administrator Expert, TOGAF, or equivalent architecture frameworks. 
 - Track record of mentoring engineers and building technical communities of practice. 

Why is this role different?

This is not a generic enterprise architect role. You will be the single technical authority for two of the most strategic AI platforms at Edwards Lifesciences - platforms that are actively transforming how our work, decide, and collaborate. You will shape the architecture, set the standards, and mentor the next generation of Forward-Deployed AI Engineers who build on these platforms every day. 

You will operate at the intersection of platform strategy, hands-on architecture, and business impact - with direct visibility to senior IT leadership and the opportunity to influence how a global healthcare company scales agentic AI responsibly. 

Recruiting scam alert: Read our notice about potential recruiting scams.

data.title: GTM Automation Engineer
data.description:
GTM Automation EngineerLocation: Bengaluru (Work From Office)

Employment Type: Full-time

Experience: 2+ years

Compensation: ₹5 - 8 LPA + Performance-Based Bonuses

About ZyluZylu is an AI-powered growth management platform helping salons, spas, and beauty businesses grow revenue, improve customer retention, and streamline operations. 

We serve businesses across India and international markets, including the Middle East and Southeast Asia. 

We're building an AI-driven growth engine to scale customer acquisition through intelligent automation, data, and technology. 

About the RoleWe're looking for a hands-on GTM Automation Engineer to build, integrate, and scale Zylu's inbound and outbound customer acquisition systems. 

You'll work closely with the founders and Growth team to automate prospect discovery, lead enrichment, qualification, personalized outreach, demo scheduling, trial activation, and conversion workflows. 

We don't expect you to rebuild what existing SaaS platforms already do well. We expect you to identify the right tools, integrate them effectively, build what's missing, and make the entire system work reliably. 

This is a technical, execution-focused role where success is measured by business outcomes, not the number of workflows built. 

Key Responsibilities1. Inbound GTM Automation
 - Automate lead capture, enrichment, scoring, routing, and follow-ups across websites, paid campaigns, organic channels, and trial sign-ups. 
 - Build AI-powered lead qualification, nurturing, and demo-booking workflows. 
 - Automate trial onboarding, activation, engagement, and conversion journeys. 
 - Integrate HubSpot with marketing, sales, product, and customer success systems. 
 - Improve lead response times, conversion rates, and sales productivity through automation. 

2. Outbound GTM Automation
 - Build automated prospect discovery, enrichment, segmentation, and scoring systems targeting salons, spas, and multi-location businesses. 
 - Leverage platforms such as Clay, Apollo, Instantly, and other GTM tools to identify and qualify decision-makers. 
 - Develop personalized, multichannel outreach workflows across email, WhatsApp, LinkedIn, and calling. 
 - Build signal-based prospecting workflows using new business openings, branch expansions, hiring activity, and other relevant market signals. 
 - Automate follow-ups, reply classification, lead qualification, meeting scheduling, and CRM updates. 3. AI Agents & Integrations
 - Build and deploy AI agents using n8n, LLMs, APIs, and custom code. 
 - Integrate existing SaaS platforms instead of unnecessarily developing custom solutions. 
 - Connect HubSpot, WhatsApp Cloud API, outreach platforms, and Zylu's internal systems. 
 - Implement monitoring, error handling, data validation, and workflow recovery. 
 - Ensure responsible data handling and compliance with applicable privacy laws and outreach platform policies. 4. Analytics & Optimization
 - Build dashboards tracking lead quality, qualified pipeline, demo bookings, conversion rates, and acquisition costs. 
 - Continuously experiment with automation workflows to improve acquisition efficiency and conversion. 
 - Identify manual bottlenecks across marketing and sales and eliminate them through automation. 
 - Document workflows and build repeatable systems that scale without proportional increases in headcount. Required Qualifications
 - 2+ years of hands-on experience building GTM, sales, marketing, or RevOps automation systems. 
 - Strong experience with n8n, Make, Zapier, or similar automation platforms. 
 - Practical experience with prospecting and enrichment tools such as Clay, Apollo, or equivalent platforms. 
 - Experience integrating CRMs such as HubSpot, Salesforce, or Zoho. 
 - Ability to work with REST APIs, webhooks, JSON, and Python or JavaScript. 
 - Hands-on experience using LLMs and AI agents to automate business workflows. 
 - Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a focus on measurable outcomes. 
 - Ability to independently design, deploy, troubleshoot, and maintain production workflows. 

Preferred Skills
 - Experience with WhatsApp Business Cloud API and email outreach infrastructure. 
 - Experience with AI coding tools such as Claude Code, Codex, or Cursor. 
 - Familiarity with SQL, marketing attribution, and funnel analytics. 
 - Experience with B2B SaaS, SMB acquisition, or local-business prospecting. 
 - Exposure to India, GCC, or Southeast Asian markets. 
 - Previous experience as a growth engineer, automation engineer, or early-stage startup operator. What Success Looks Like in 60 Days
 - A functioning inbound automation engine covering lead capture, enrichment, qualification, routing, and follow-ups. 
 - An automated outbound prospecting engine that discovers, enriches, and scores qualified salon prospects. 
 - At least two live outbound campaigns generating measurable qualified pipeline. 
 - Automated demo scheduling, follow-ups, and trial activation workflows integrated with HubSpot. 
 - At least five production-ready GTM automations with monitoring and documentation. 
 - A live dashboard tracking inbound and outbound pipeline performance. 
 - Demonstrable improvements in lead response time, qualified opportunities, and sales productivity. What You'll Get
 - Direct collaboration with Zylu's founders and Growth team. 
 - Ownership of the automation infrastructure behind a growing international SaaS business. 
 - Access to modern AI, automation, and GTM platforms. 
 - High autonomy, meaningful responsibilities, and measurable business impact. 
 - Opportunity to grow into a GTM Engineering or Growth Automation leadership role. Hiring Process
 - Initial Screening: Review of experience and previous automation projects. 
 - Founder Interview: Technical discussion covering architecture, problem-solving, and business judgment. 
 - Practical Challenge: Build a working GTM automation workflow using test data. 
 - Paid Work Trial: A short, 3 to 5-day paid work trial for shortlisted candidates. How to ApplySend us your resume along with examples of automation systems you've built, such as n8n workflows, CRM integrations, AI agents, prospecting systems, or growth automation projects. 

We're more interested in what you've built, how it works, and the business results it delivered than the number of tools listed on your resume.

data.title: Lead Data / ML Engineer
data.description:
About The Role

We are looking for a Lead Data / ML Engineer to take end-to-end technical ownership of a large-scale data and ML platform on AWS. You will design and build PySpark pipelines, bring ML models and LLM and agent-based capabilities into production, and own what you build from first design through to running it reliably in production. 

This is a hands-on role. Architecture and leadership experience is welcome, but you will still write code every day, and you will be the person others turn to when a pipeline breaks, a job slows down, or a design needs a second opinion. 



About The Work

You will work with high-volume consumer transaction data, turning it into insights and predictive models that help understand and anticipate consumer behaviour. The work spans large-scale data processing, feature engineering, machine learning, and applying LLMs and agents to enrich and make sense of the data. 



Experience: 7+ Years

Location: Kolkata (Rajarhat-Newtown)

Mode of Working: WFO / Hybrid / Remote

Timing: Ability to work in the US Eastern time zone. This may be relaxed to half day IST and half day US EST based on project needs. 

What We Are Looking For

- End-to-end ownership: you take a problem from design to production and stay accountable for it once it is live
 - Hands-on depth: you write, review and debug production code yourself, not only design it
 - Troubleshooting leadership: you help teammates diagnose failing jobs, performance problems and data issues, and leave them better at solving the next one
 - Practical judgement on LLMs and agents: you know where they add real value in a data pipeline and how to measure whether they are working



Key Responsibilities

- Design, build and optimize large-scale ETL/ELT pipelines in PySpark on AWS (EMR, Glue), with strong attention to partitioning, skew, shuffle and cost. 
 - Productionize ML models and feature pipelines, including training data pipelines, batch and real-time inference, and model serving on SageMaker. 
 - Build LLM and agent-powered capabilities into data workflows, such as document and entity extraction, classification and enrichment at scale, RAG pipelines, and tool-calling agents, along with evaluation and monitoring of their output quality. 
 - Orchestrate complex workflows with Apache Airflow (MWAA or self-managed), ensuring reliability, observability and SLA adherence. 
 - Architect storage across S3 (data lake), Redshift (warehouse) and RDS, applying best practices for data modeling, partitioning, compression and cost optimization. 
 - Build containerized data services with Docker and ECS/Fargate, with CI/CD through GitHub Actions. 
 - Develop event-driven and serverless processing with Lambda, SQS, SNS and EventBridge. 
 - Use AI coding assistants (Claude Code, Cursor, Kiro) to speed up delivery, and set the team's standards for reviewing and validating AI-generated code. 
 - Be the go-to person for production issues: lead root-cause analysis on failing or slow jobs, data quality incidents and model problems, and help teammates debug their own work. 
 - Review code, guide design decisions and help engineers on the team grow technically. 
 - Implement data quality, monitoring and alerting frameworks, and enforce data governance, security and access-control policies. 
 - Contribute to infrastructure as code using Terraform, CloudFormation or CDK. 



Required Qualifications

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science or a related field. 
 - 7+ years in data engineering or ML engineering, with at least 4 years of hands-on PySpark on production workloads at scale. 
 - Strong AWS production experience across EMR, S3, Redshift, RDS, Lambda, SageMaker and ECS. 
 - Practical, hands-on experience building with LLMs: prompt design, embeddings and vector search, RAG, agent or tool-calling frameworks, and evaluating LLM output quality. 
 - Solid understanding of the ML lifecycle: feature engineering, training and validation, model deployment and monitoring. 
 - Experience working with large transactional or behavioural datasets is a strong plus. 
 - Strong Python and SQL. TypeScript is a plus. 
 - Experience with Apache Airflow and Docker in production. 
 - A track record of owning systems end to end in production, including on-call or production support, and of helping other engineers troubleshoot. 
 - Strong grasp of data modeling, governance and security best practices. 



Good To Have

- AWS certifications (Data Engineer Associate, Machine Learning Specialty, Solutions Architect)
 - Experience with feature stores, MLOps tooling or model serving at scale
 - Infrastructure as code (Terraform, CloudFormation, CDK)
 - Experience optimizing costs for large AWS data workloads



Tech Stack At a Glance

- Compute & Processing: PySpark on EMR, Glue, Lambda, ECS/Fargate, SageMaker
 - LLM & Agents: LLM APIs, embeddings and vector stores, RAG, agent frameworks
 - Orchestration: Apache Airflow (MWAA), Step Functions
 - Storage & Warehousing: S3, Redshift, RDS (PostgreSQL / MySQL)
 - Containers & DevOps: Docker, ECS, GitHub Actions, Terraform
 - AI-Assisted Dev: Claude Code, Cursor, Kiro
 - Languages: Python, SQL, Bash

Job Description

We're looking for a Shopify Frontend Developer who lives and breathes theme customization. You'll own the look, feel, and performance of our Shopify storefront, building pixel-perfect pages and a storefront experience. This is a hands-on, high-velocity role for someone who can take a design or a rough idea and turn it into a live, conversion-friendly page the same week. If you love working in a rapid environment where your work goes live quickly and directly impacts revenue, this is for you. Responsibilities: - Customize and maintain our Shopify theme using Liquid, HTML, CSS/SCSS, and JavaScript. - Build and launch landing pages, product pages, collection pages, and campaign pages often on tight timelines. - Translate designs (Figma) into responsive, pixel-perfect, cross-browser-compatible pages. - Rapidly iterate on the storefront to support marketing pushes, sales, product launches, and A/B tests. - Optimize page speed and Core Web Vitals to improve load times and conversion. - Configure and customize Shopify sections, blocks, and theme settings so non-technical teammates can update content easily. - Integrate and configure Shopify apps (reviews, upsells, subscriptions, page builders, and analytics). - Ensure the storefront is accessible, mobile-first, and consistent with our brand. - Debug frontend and theme issues quickly and keep the store running smoothly. Requirements: - 1+ years of hands-on experience with Shopify theme development and customization. - Strong proficiency in Shopify Liquid. - Excellent command of HTML5 CSS3/SCSS, and modern JavaScript (ES6+). - Solid understanding of responsive, mobile-first design and cross-browser compatibility. - Experience building custom, reusable Shopify sections and blocks with theme settings. - Ability to translate Figma / design files into accurate, polished pages. - Comfort working in a fast-paced, rapid-turnaround environment with shifting priorities. - Familiarity with Git and version-controlled theme workflows. - Strong attention to detail and an eye for design and UX. Nice to Have: - Experience with Shopify Online Store 2. 0 metafields and metaobjects. - Basic JavaScript framework experience (React) or comfort with the storefront/Ajax APIs. - Knowledge of SEO and conversion rate optimization (CRO) best practices. - Experience with D2C storefronts and high-traffic sale events. Company Summary Healthfab is a leading startup that provides innovative yet affordable health and hygiene solutions. Our flagship product, GoPadFree, a leak-proof, reusable cotton period panty for women, is a crowd favorite. Backed by premier investors and armed with cutting-edge manufacturing capabilities, Healthfab is all set to disrupt the menstrual hygiene category with safe, comfortable, and eco-friendly alternatives! At Healthfab, Freedom to Flow is more than our brand essence; it's a belief. We're here to make periods feel natural, comfortable, and empowering, not limiting. Our products are designed to move with people, support them, and give them the confidence to live life the way they want, every single day of the month. data.title: Senior Principal Enterprise Software Engineer
data.description:
Careers that change lives start here. Medtronic is a global leader in healthcare technology with a Mission to alleviate pain, restore health, and extend life. Our 95, 000 employees work across more than 150 countries to put patients first - developing innovative medical technologies that improve the lives of 72+ million patients each year. Your unique talents will help shape the future of healthcare while building a career grounded in purpose, growth, and impact. 

A Day in the Life

The Senior Principal Enterprise Software Engineer provides architectural and technical leadership for complex medical device software products and platforms. This role defines software architecture, drives the development and verification of scalable and secure solutions, and provides technical direction across globally distributed engineering teams. The position combines hands-on engineering with system-level design leadership across embedded, mobile, enterprise, and connected software while supporting development in a regulated medical device environment. 

Primary Responsibilities

- Provide architectural and technical leadership across software products and platforms, aligning product designs with system and enterprise architecture. 
 - Define system-level software requirements and architectures, review design artifacts, and ensure requirements traceability, technical quality, scalability, security, and maintainability. 
 - Lead the design, development, and verification of high-integrity software for Class II and Class III medical device systems. 
 - Architect software for real-time data acquisition, processing, synchronization, and presentation across implantable devices and connected systems. 
 - Design and guide development of embedded, mobile, client/server, web, and cloud interfaces, including Bluetooth, Transmission Control Protocol/User Datagram Protocol (TCP/UDP), socket communication, and REST and SOAP services. 
 - Develop and promote reusable software frameworks, object-oriented design patterns, automation approaches, and test-first engineering practices. 
 - Evaluate technologies, frameworks, engineering tools, and development practices while leading technical and process improvements across teams. 
 - Influence technical strategy and product roadmaps while mentoring engineers and collaborating with product owners, architects, technical leads, verification and validation engineers, and global research and development partners. 

Required Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science Engineering and 20+ years of software engineering experience OR Master's degree in Computer Science Engineering and 17+ years of software engineering experience. 
 - Experience in software architecture, design, development, debugging, and testing using C# and . NET. 
 - Experience architecting and building AI assisted and AI native tools and solutions with demonstrable efficiency and productivity impact. 
 - Experience developing medical device software, including real-time data acquisition, processing, synchronization, or presentation. 
 - Experience designing embedded and connected software, including firmware or device drivers, Bluetooth communication, networking services, socket communication, and TCP/UDP communication. 
 - Experience translating system requirements into subsystem requirements and software designs using Unified Modeling Language (UML), requirements traceability, and object-oriented design principles. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience developing Class III medical device systems, implantable device software, device simulators, or mobile operating system applications for regulated medical systems. 
 - Knowledge of IEC 62304, ISO 13485, medical device cybersecurity, patient privacy, and secure software development practices. 
 - Experience with Agile methodologies, Test-Driven Development (TDD), automated software testing, and configuration management tools. 
 - Experience with operating system threading and scheduling, distributed computing, relational database design, web-based applications, and build systems. 
 - Experience working with cross-functional and geographically distributed teams, including software development, verification and validation, systems engineering, human factors, and quality engineering, 

Physical Job Requirements

The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by employees assigned to this position, but they are not an exhaustive list of all the required responsibilities and skills of this position. 





Recruitment Fraud Alert

We are aware of phishing scams targeting job seekers. Please keep the following in mind: 

Apply only through official Medtronic channels. All legitimate Medtronic recruiting communications come from approved Medtronic platforms and official @medtronic. com email addresses. 

Medtronic will never ask for payment or sensitive personal information (such as bank account or Social Security details) during early stages of the hiring process. Any such requests are not legitimate. 

If you receive a suspicious message claiming to be from Medtronic, do not respond, click links, or open attachments. 

If you have any questions, concerns regarding the authenticity of a communication alleged to have been made by or on behalf of Medtronic, please contact us immediately at AskHR@medtronic. com. 

Benefits & Compensation

Medtronic offers a competitive Salary and flexible Benefits Package

A commitment to our employees lives at the core of our values. We recognize their contributions. They share in the success they help to create. We offer a wide range of benefits, resources, and competitive compensation plans designed to support you at every career and life stage. 



This position is eligible for a short-term incentive called the Medtronic Incentive Plan (MIP).

data.description:
About Business

JOB DESCRIPTION

Adani Group: Adani Group is a diversified organisation in India comprising 10 publicly traded companies. It has created a world-class logistics and utility infrastructure portfolio that has a pan-India presence. Adani Group is headquartered in Ahmedabad, in the state of Gujarat, India. Over the years, Adani Group has positioned itself to be the market leader in its logistics and energy businesses focusing on large-scale infrastructure development in India with O & M practices benchmarked to global standards. With four IG-rated businesses, it is the only Infrastructure Investment Grade issuer in India. 

Adani Power Limited (APL): Adani Power Limited (APL), a part of the diversified Adani Group, is the largest private thermal power producer in India. We have a power generation capacity of 15, 250 MW comprising thermal power plants in Gujarat, Maharashtra, Karnataka, Rajasthan, Chhattisgarh, Madhya Pradesh, and Jharkhand, and a 40 MW solar power project in Gujarat. 

Job Purpose: This role is responsible to maintain and enhance the operational excellence and reliability of all Control & Instrumentation systems associated with Boiler systems. This role is pivotal for conducting on-field maintenance activities including routine maintenance, timely overhauls, and calibration of equipment to prevent failures and ensure continuous operation. 

Responsibilities

Lead - Field instrumentation (Boiler)

Operational Excellence And Equipment Reliability

Monitor the availability and functionality of all C&I systems related to Boiler area including firing systems, Mill fan, ASLD, CAMS, and MOV. 

Conduct routine maintenance of MOV, Boiler, and Auxiliaries to prevent equipment failures. 

Execute timely overhauls of the Boiler systems to maintain operational integrity. 

Troubleshoot and rectify breakdowns of equipment to ensure continuous operation. 

Coordinate with other departments to minimize maintenance delays and optimize equipment availability. 

Execute calibrations as per schedule and prepare detailed reports on findings and adjustments. 

Provide on-field support for Root Cause Analysis (RCA), Failure Mode and Effects Analysis (FMEA), Zero Forced Outage (ZFO) to enhance system reliability. 

Implement MoC (Management of Change) protocols to ensure safe and compliant modifications to equipment and processes. 

Technical And Process Improvement

Perform periodic backups of Boiler PLC and auxiliary systems to secure operational data. 

Provide resources and guidance to contractor technicians for routine maintenance tasks. 

Follow the established checklist for equipment maintenance to ensure thoroughness and accuracy. 

Maintain the FGD (Flue Gas Discharge) systems to ensure environmental compliance. 

Inventory Management And Documentation

Provide inputs to Team Leads for effective spares and inventory management, including the development of indigenous spares. 

Manage the procurement process for equipment and services, ensuring value for money and adherence to financial guidelines. 

Manage documentation and as-built drawings for the section. 

Business Sustainability

Implement and Follow IMS, AWMS, DISHA, CHETNA guidelines within the department. 

Maintain a culture of safety by providing proper training and ensuring adherence to safety protocols and ensuring zero accidents. 

Implement field related ZFO Action Items and AWMS initiatives. 

Adhere to BPT processes, technical audits, and compliance requirements. 

Report unsafe conditions, acts, and near misses in the work area to prevent incidents. 

Follow the guidelines of the work permit system to ensure safe working conditions. 

Ensure adherence to statutory compliances and regulations. 

Digitization And Automation

Execute comprehensive digitization strategies to optimize operational efficiency. 

Implement automation solutions to support overall organizational goals/strategy. 

Implement process and system improvements, adopting newer technologies and innovative ideas.

8+ years of experience in in C&I systems, preferably in power plant boiler operations. 

Preferred Industry

Experience in power generation, or related process industries with a focus on control and instrumentation systems.

Role Title : AVP , Quality Engineering (QE) Automation Architect ( L11 )

Company Overview: Synchrony (NYSE: SYF) is a leading consumer financing company that has been at the heart of American commerce and opportunity for nearly a century. Synchrony delivers credit and banking products that empower tens of millions of consumers to improve their financial lives and access what matters most. Leveraging innovative solutions that are shaping the future of retail commerce, Synchrony supports the growth and success of some of the nation's most respected brands, alongside hundreds of thousands of small and midsize businesses, including health and wellness providers. Committed to excellence in service and culture, Synchrony is proud to be named as #3 as a Great Place to Work® in India and is honored to be ranked the #1 Best Company to Work For® in the U. S. by Fortune magazine and Great Place to Work®. For more information, visit www. synchrony. com. 

Organizational Overview

The Quality Engineering Center of Excellence (QE COE) is a centralized team of Quality Engineering Leaders and Test Architects, that standardizes, scales, and governs software quality, test automation, and best practices across the organization. This team works closely with the Leaders in the Engineering verticals and other cross functional teams who are the key stakeholders. This role will work closely with other peer Test Architects in the team under the leadership of the QE Leader to rollout and institutionalize the AI driven QE strategies and solutions conceptualized by the team, in partnership with the Application Teams. 

Role Summary/Purpose

Quality Engineering (QE) Automation Architect

Drive the design and delivery of next-generation Quality Engineering solutions by blending proven testing methodologies with AI-powered approaches. This role will occasionally architect scalable testing frameworks, champion adoption of AI-assisted testing, and embed intelligent automation across the product development lifecycle and CI/CD pipelines to accelerate high-quality delivery. 

As an SME in AI-enabled test automation engineering, this role will partner with peer architects and stakeholders to define strategy, recommend the optimal tool stack aligned to the application landscape, and resolve complex automation challenges-delivering best-in-class, enterprise-wide automation expansion solutions. 

Key Responsibilities

- Architect and own scalable test automation frameworks for functional, regression, and non-functional testing; embed automation into CI/CD (Jenkins, GitHub, CloudBees) as required by the Application teams. 
 - Define and drive QE standards, best practices, and reusable libraries/patterns across engineering teams. 
 - Partner with QE leads in application teams to implement shift-left testing and quality-by-design. 
 - Design and implement AI-assisted testing solutions leveraging LLMs, RAG, and agentic workflows; lead prompt engineering and context design for reliable AI test agents (test generation, test data creation, defect triage/analysis). 
 - Drive adoption and standardization of modern automation tools/frameworks (e. g. , Playwright, Selenium). 
 - Enable self-service automation and quality reporting dashboards for engineering teams. 
 - Act as a QE technical leader, run architecture reviews, mentor QE Engineers/Architects on AI-driven quality patterns and tools, and resolve complex automation challenges. 
 - Create playbooks, training, and rollout plans; continuously evaluate/pilot emerging QE technologies and measure adoption and impact. 

Required Skills/Knowledge

- Experience: 12+ years in Software Quality Engineering, including 3+ years in test architecture and framework design. 
 - Automation Tools: Hands-on expertise in Playwright and/or Selenium, REST API testing, and modern JavaScript/TypeScript or Python automation frameworks. 
 - AI-Assisted Testing: Working knowledge of LLMs and context design for QE use cases. 
 - Experience in providing AI-assisted solutions for functional, UAT, performance and security testing. 
 - AI Tooling: Experience applying AI tools for test case generation, code review support, and defect triage. 
 - Agentic Workflows: Understanding of agentic AI patterns to build autonomous test agents and end-to-end workflows. 
 - Integration: Ability to integrate AI solutions with existing business processes and enterprise IT infrastructure
 - Communication & stakeholder management: Align and influence stakeholders through clear, concise communication. 
 - System thinking & architecture design: Design scalable QE architectures with end-to-end perspective. 
 - Problem formulation & solution design: Turn vague problems into measurable, practical solutions. 

Desired Skills/Knowledge

- Experience designing and building GenAI platforms. 
 - Exposure to cloud ecosystems such as AWS and Azure. 
 - Proven ability to integrate test automation into CI/CD toolchains (Jenkins, GitHub Actions, CloudBees). 

Eligibility Criteria

- Bachelor's Degree and a minimum of 12 + years of experience in Information Technology or Engineering. 

Work Timings 2: 00PM to 11: 00 PM IST

This role qualifies for Enhanced Flexibility offered in Synchrony India and will require the incumbent to be available between 06: 00 AM Eastern Time - 11: 30 AM Eastern Time (timings are anchored to US Eastern hours and will adjust twice a year locally). This window is for meetings with India and US teams. The remaining hours will be flexible for the employee to choose. Exceptions may apply periodically due to business needs) We are proud to offer flexibility at Synchrony. Our way of working allows you the option to work from home or workspaces in our Regional Engagement Hubs-Hyderabad, Bengaluru, Pune, Kolkata, or Delhi/NCR. Occasionally you may be required to commute or travel to Hyderabad or one of the Regional Engagement Hubs for in person engagement activities such as business or team meetings, trainings, and culture events

data.title: Engineer 3 - Business Systems
data.description:
The CRM Technologies team builds, scales, and operates Salesforce-based solutions that power MongoDB's customer lifecycle, from marketing engagement and lead management through sales execution, account management, renewals, reporting, and downstream operational workflows. 

The team partners closely with Marketing, Sales Operations, Revenue Operations, Finance, Customer Success, Data, and Engineering to deliver secure, scalable, and reliable business systems. The team continuously evolves the CRM and marketing technology ecosystem through automation, integrations, data quality improvements, and platform operations. 

Role Overview

We are looking for an Engineer III, Business Systems to design, build, and support the systems and integrations that enable MongoDB's top-of-funnel and lead-to-revenue processes. 

This individual contributor role will focus on marketing technology, lead lifecycle management, enrichment, campaign operations, account and territory management, activity management, outreach, annual planning, and inbound and outbound integrations. You will translate business requirements into scalable technical solutions using Salesforce, marketing automation platforms, integration tools, APIs, and data services. 

You will own delivery across the full solution lifecycle, including requirements analysis, solution design, development, testing, deployment, documentation, monitoring, and production support. You will also contribute to engineering standards, platform governance, data quality, and continuous improvement across the GTM Technology ecosystem. 

We are looking to speak to candidates who are based in Gurugram for our hybrid working model. 

What You'll Do

- Design, build, and support solutions for top-of-funnel and marketing operations processes
 - Develop and enhance lead capture, lead conversion, routing, qualification, scoring, and lifecycle management capabilities
 - Administer and integrate marketing and enrichment platforms such as FCI, LeanData, Ortoo, and related GTM applications
 - Build and maintain integrations between Salesforce, marketing automation, enrichment, outreach, analytics, data, and downstream business systems
 - Support campaign management, campaign attribution, audience segmentation, campaign member management, and marketing performance workflows
 - Develop scalable solutions for account management, territory planning, account assignment, ownership changes, and coverage models
 - Design and support partner management capabilities, including partner onboarding, partner data management, partner lifecycle workflows, referral and lead registration processes, partner attribution, and partner communications
 - Build and enhance partner portal experiences that provide secure access to leads, opportunities, campaign resources, enablement content, deal registration, performance insights, and relevant account information
 - Enable activity management and Outreach workflows across marketing, business development, sales, and partner teams
 - Design and support inbound integrations that create, enrich, qualify, and route leads and accounts into Salesforce
 - Partner with Marketing Operations, Sales Development, Sales Operations, Revenue Operations, Data, and Engineering to understand requirements and identify process gaps
 - Contribute to documentation, UAT, regression testing, runbooks, monitoring, and user enablement
 - Leverage AI-powered engineering tools such as Cursor, Claude Code, Agentforce, and GitHub Copilot to improve productivity, analysis, troubleshooting, and documentation while applying sound judgment around security, privacy, and accuracy

Responsibilities

Technical Delivery

- Translate business requirements into scalable marketing technology and Salesforce solutions using declarative configuration, custom development, APIs, and integration platforms. 

Marketing Technology Engineering

- Own and enhance capabilities across: 
 - Lead capture, conversion, qualification, and routing
 - Marketing enrichment and data normalization
 - Campaign and campaign member management
 - Account identification, matching, and hierarchy management
 - Territory planning and account assignment
 - Activity and engagement management
 - Outreach and business development workflows
 - Marketing attribution and lifecycle reporting
 - Annual planning and operational planning processes
Integration and System Design

- Design and support secure, reliable, and observable inbound and outbound integrations across Salesforce, marketing automation, enrichment, outreach, analytics, and enterprise platforms. 

Data Quality and Governance

- Establish reliable data flows and controls that improve completeness, accuracy, consistency, deduplication, consent handling, and governance across lead, contact, account, campaign, and activity data. 

Engineering Excellence

- Maintain high standards for modular design, test coverage, documentation, deployment processes, monitoring, CI/CD, and adherence to shared integration and Salesforce engineering patterns. 

Platform Optimization

- Proactively identify and resolve performance bottlenecks, integration risks, manual processes, technical debt, and opportunities to simplify the marketing technology architecture. 

Minimum Requirements

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience
 - 6+ years of hands-on Salesforce development or enterprise business systems engineering experience
 - Strong experience with Apex, Lightning Web Components, Flows, SOQL, Salesforce APIs, and platform automation
 - Proficiency in scripting and programming languages such as Python and JavaScript, with experience building reusable automation, data transformation, and integration services
 - Experience with React or comparable modern front-end frameworks
 - Experience with full-stack development, including front-end applications, back-end services, APIs, data models, authentication, testing, deployment, and operational support
 - Experience designing and supporting marketing technology, CRM, lead management, or revenue operations solutions
 - Experience building and supporting REST or SOAP API integrations and data synchronization processes
 - Strong understanding of Salesforce security, data governance, data quality, and scalable implementation practices
 - Strong analytical, troubleshooting, communication, and collaboration skills
 - Salesforce Platform Developer I or II certification required

Success Measures

In 3 Months

Develop a strong understanding of MongoDB's marketing technology and Salesforce architecture, top-of-funnel processes, lead lifecycle, campaign operations, integration landscape, and stakeholder environment. 

In 6 Months

Deliver meaningful enhancements across lead management, marketing integrations, enrichment, campaign management, routing, account management, or related GTM Technology initiatives. Establish yourself as a dependable technical contributor and trusted partner to Marketing Operations and Revenue Operations. 

In 12 Months

Become a trusted subject matter expert for marketing technology and top-of-funnel business systems. Drive scalable improvements across lead conversion, enrichment, campaign operations, territory planning, outreach, data quality, and inbound and outbound integrations while influencing engineering standards and platform strategy. 

About MongoDB

MongoDB is built for change, empowering our customers and our people to innovate at the speed of the market. We have redefined the data platform for the AI era, enabling builders to create, transform, and disrupt industries with software. MongoDB's unified data platform, the most widely available, globally distributed data platform on the market, helps organizations modernize legacy workloads, embrace innovation, and unleash AI. Our cloud-native platform, MongoDB Atlas, is the only globally distributed, multi-cloud data platform and is available across AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure. 

With offices worldwide and over 67, 000 customers, including AI-native startups and approximately 75% of the Fortune 100, relying on MongoDB for their most important applications, we're powering the next era of software. 

Our compass at MongoDB is our Leadership Commitment, guiding how and why we make decisions, show up for each other, and win. It's what makes us MongoDB. 

To drive the personal growth and business impact of our employees, we're committed to developing a supportive and enriching culture for everyone. From employee affinity groups, to fertility assistance and a generous parental leave policy, we value our employees' wellbeing and want to support them along every step of their professional and personal journeys. Learn more about what it's like to work at MongoDB, and help us make an impact on the world!

MongoDB is committed to providing any necessary accommodations for individuals with disabilities within our application and interview process. To request an accommodation due to a disability, please inform your recruiter. 

MongoDB is an equal opportunities employer.

Tech / B. E. / MCA / MSc Computer Science or equivalent. - Experience: 4-7 years. data.title: Engineering Lead (Founding)
data.description:
Job Description

As the first full-time technical leader at ADOSX, you will build the foundations that future teams inherit. You'll work directly with founders and the CTO to define the platform, engineering culture, and technical standards for an AI-native automotive operating system. On a four-person team, that means setting architecture and writing the load-bearing code. This is a hands-on leadership role, not a manager who delegates difficult problems. The core responsibilities for the job include the following: Data Access and Integrations: - Build lawful, reliable, and version-stable mechanisms to extract data from existing systems. - Work with customers and upstream system owners to solve integration challenges. - Handle heterogeneous schemas and data formats. - Create configuration-driven onboarding instead of code-driven implementations. The Reconciliation Engine: - Design confidence-based reconciliation across multiple source systems. - Detect confidently wrong matches, not just unmatched records. - Own exception handling, auditing, and measurable accuracy. The AI Grounding Layer: - Build constrained-query systems over free-form generation. - Implement RAG, trace enforcement, and explainable outputs. - Ensure every business number is verifiable. - Treat "I can't answer that" as a feature, not a failure. Multi-Tenant Foundations: - PostgreSQL Row-Level Security as the primary isolation mechanism. - Cross-tenant leakage testing in CI. - RBAC, audit trails, and data-protection foundations. Event-Driven Architecture: - Celery-based event flows. - Canonical data models. - Configurable integration patterns that keep onboarding a new dealer are a matter of configuration, not code. AI-Native Engineering Practices: - Define how the team uses AI coding agents. - Establish review standards and guardrails for AI-generated code. - Increase engineering leverage without compromising quality, correctness, or security. Technical Leadership: - Set conventions for code structure, API design, and testing. - Support junior engineers in owning features end-to-end. - Help shape engineering culture and future hiring practices. Requirements: - Around 8 years of experience building production systems. - Deep expertise in Python, Django, DRF, Celery, and PostgreSQL. - Experience managing ORM migrations under changing schemas. - Strong experience integrating messy external systems and reconciling data. - Practical LLM and RAG experience, with healthy scepticism toward model outputs. - PostgreSQL depth, including row-level security, performance optimisation, and multitenant patterns. - Pragmatic thinking about scale, knowing when a modular monolith and simple queues are the right choices. - Experience building with AI coding agents and establishing a team around them. - The judgement to challenge unrealistic timelines, scope, or technical assumptions. Nice to Have: - Fintech-grade or data-heavy reconciliation systems. - Enterprise or legacy system integrations. - Familiarity with ISO 27001 DPDPA, or related security practices. - Working knowledge of Next. js and React. You'll thrive here if: - You love ambiguity more than certainty. - You prefer ownership over instructions. - You think in systems, not tickets. - You enjoy getting your hands dirty with customers. - You learn by building rather than waiting. - You use AI as leverage, not as a substitute for judgement. - You want both the 01 and 1100 journeys. Company Summary ADOSX is redefining automobile retail in India with an end-to-end, AI-native platform purpose-built for the two-wheeler dealership ecosystem. With intelligence built into every workflow, ADOSX delivers real-time profit visibility, predictive service alerts, and automated decision support driving measurable revenue recovery, operational efficiency, and smarter dealer experiences. With AI-powered, cloud-native technology built for the economics of Indian 2W dealerships, ADOSX is enabling the most transparent, profitable, and data-driven retail operations in the industry. More to come soon and exciting times ahead. The future of automotive retail will not be software-enabled; it will be intelligence-driven and increasingly autonomous. ADOSX is building a world-class AI-native operating system for automotive retail in India, combining agentic workflows, unified data platforms, and real-time intelligence into a single platform that helps auto retail operate smarter, faster, and more profitably. We're currently a four-member founding team working directly with customers and building from idea to MVP. Backed by strategic investors from the automotive dealership ecosystem, our ambition is to redefine the auto-tech space in the next five years. Why Join Us Joining ADOSX is closer to building a company than joining one. You'll work directly with founders, own products end-to-end, and experience both the 01 and 1100 journeys while helping shape technology, culture, and customer outcomes. We believe in high ownership, customer obsession, curiosity, bias for action, and having the courage to challenge assumptions. We value builders over titles and outcomes over hierarchy. The truth is that early-stage startups are hard. There will be ambiguity, rapid change, and uncomfortable challenges. But there will also be extraordinary learning, genuine ownership, and the opportunity to create something that outlasts us. Many people learn more in two years at a company like ADOSX than in ten years elsewhere. If you want to help redefine how an entire industry operates, we'd love to build ADOSX together!

data.title: Senior Verification Engineer - HSIO Unit Level
data.description:
NVIDIA has been transforming computer graphics, PC gaming, and accelerated computing for more than 25 years. It's a unique legacy of innovation that's fueled by great technology-and amazing people. Today, we're tapping into the unlimited potential of AI to define the next era of computing. An era in which our GPU acts as the brains of computers, robots, and self-driving cars that can understand the world. Doing what's never been done before takes vision, innovation, and the world's best talent. As an NVIDIAN, you'll be immersed in a diverse, supportive environment where everyone is inspired to do their best work. Come join the team and see how you can make a lasting impact on the world. 

We are seeking hardworking, determined, and imaginative individuals to join our automotive verification group. As the owner of HSIO IP's unit level verification, you will contribute to projects crafting the future of automotive chips and systems. You will gain direct experience of chip working with high-performance CPU and memory sub-systems, NOC-based interconnect fabric, high-speed I/Os, and various advanced technologies used in our Tegra chips. 

What You'll Be Doing

You will develop UVM-based verification test benches and methodologies. These will verify complex rapid data transfer IO IPs and sub-systems such as USB, UFS, MPHY, Ethernet, and MACSEC. 

During the course of a project, you will drive the following aspects of verification for your unit: 

- Architect the testbenches and craft verification environment using SV and UVM methodology
 - Define test plans, tests and verification infrastructure for modules, clusters and systems
 - Build efficient and reusable bus functional models, monitors, checkers, and scoreboards
 - Implement functional coverage and coordinate the verification closure process for the unit
 - Work with architects, designers, FPGA, and post-silicon teams to ensure that your unit is robust

What We Need To See

- BTech or MTech in ECE, EE, CSE, or an equivalent degree is required. Candidates should have 4+ years of demonstrated ability in verification closure of complex units, sub-systems, or SOC level verification. 
 - Proven experience in High Speed IO verification (UFS/PCIE/XUSB), knowledge of 10G/1G Ethernet MAC and Switch
 - Experience in the latest verification methodologies like SV and UVM
 - Good debugging and analytical skills with exposure to industry-standard verification tools for simulation and debug
 - Good interpersonal skills, ability to work as a diligent teammate, and excellent communication skills to collaborate with cross-cultural global teams and work in a matrix organization

Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd

- Exposure on using AI (Claude and Curser) extensively for code development would be a big plus
 - A mentality towards constant improvement and looking to build a multiplier effect through your work and automation
 - Exposure to Formal verification would be excellent

We have some of the most experienced and dedicated people in the world working at NVIDIA. If you're creative and independent, with a genuine passion for adopting the newest technology, we want to hear from you. Join us and be part of something outstanding! We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, gender, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation. Widely considered to be one of the technology world's most desirable employers, NVIDIA offers highly competitive salaries and a comprehensive benefits package. As you plan your future, see what we can offer to you and your family www. nvidiabenefits. com/

data.title: Software Development Manager, AWS DynamoDB
data.description:
DESCRIPTION

AWS Utility Computing (UC) provides product innovations - from foundational services such as Amazon's Simple Storage Service (S3) and Amazon Elastic Compute Cloud (EC2), to consistently released new product innovations that continue to set AWS's services and features apart in the industry. As a member of the UC organization, you'll support the development and management of Compute, Database, Storage, Internet of Things (Iot), Platform, and Productivity Apps services in AWS, including support for customers who require specialized security solutions for their cloud services. 

Want to shape the future of a NoSQL database service that supports mission-critical workloads operating at more than 100 million requests per second? Let's take its speed and efficiency to the next level!

Amazon DynamoDB is a key-value and document database that delivers single-digit-millisecond performance at any scale. As a fast-growing service at the core of the AWS Cloud, our business and engineering decisions have widespread impact across AWS, Amazon, and beyond. Many of the world's fastest growing businesses such as Lyft, Airbnb, and Redfin, as well as enterprises such as Samsung, Toyota, and Capital One depend on the scale and performance of DynamoDB to support their mission-critical workloads. 

We are looking for an engineering leader eager to improve the discoverability, safety, and efficiency of DynamoDB. 

As a software development manager on the DynamoDB team, you will lead a team of passionate engineers to build reliable and highly scalable distributed systems. This is a good opportunity to pave the path for a new generation of cloud database services, grow as a technology leader, and work with some really smart people. To succeed in the role, you must be passionate about both solving deep technical challenges and being a great people manager. You must care deeply about system availability and reliability, and understand what it means to own a mission-critical service that handles hundreds of millions of requests per second, with sub-millisecond latencies and eight 9s of availability. You must be great fun to work with. Our company credo is "Work hard. Have fun. Make history". The right candidate will be smart, ambitious, love what they do and instinctively know how to make work fun. Building, motivating and mentoring a world-class systems & software engineering team is the most important part of this role. You should have a proven track record in recruiting and retaining top talent and excel in day-to-day people and performance management tasks. 

You must have a strong Agile product management and delivery experience. The successful candidate will create and implement product roadmaps for the team using Agile methodologies. This will include helping innovate and invent new value-add services layered on top of our existing services. You will need excellent technical project management skills to deliver product roadmap items as well as other cross-team projects. You will set the vision of how to evolve DynamoDB going forward. 

You must have a strong operational experience, with a track record of operating highly available fault tolerant systems. The right candidate will want to measure everything and be very data driven. They will excel at using metrics, monitoring and alarming to measure and improve the operational processes and performance of their team. The candidate must be comfortable operating in a fast moving, dynamic environment. 

If you want to test your limits, build a world-class team, and tackle challenges at a scale and level of impact rarely seen, join us!

We're continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth's Best Employer. That's why you'll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

data.description:
Job Description

Leads one or more platform teams; defines tactical and key strategic elements for middleware evolution serving multiple consumers. Accountable for performance, cost control, and reliability outcomes; escalations for distributed debugging and upgrade safety. Drives significant cross-team improvements to observability, SLOs, and resilience patterns. Engages stakeholders inside and outside the group; socializes migration plans and adoption playbooks. 

Responsibilities

About the Role

Oracle Health Database Services is seeking an experienced engineering leader to lead its Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) team, driving service reliability, operational excellence, automation, and technology transformation across business-critical database environments. 

The Senior Manager will be responsible for building and developing a high-performing SRE team, establishing engineering best practices, and driving initiatives that improve service availability, resilience, operational efficiency, and customer experience. The role requires strong people leadership, engineering management, and the ability to translate operational challenges into sustainable engineering improvements. 

A key focus will be defining and executing the SRE reliability roadmap, strengthening incident prevention and recovery capabilities, reducing operational toil, and driving automation and AI-led operational improvements. The manager will also lead engineering participation in modernization initiatives, including Cloud at Customer migrations, Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) Transformation, and AI Transformation. 

Key Responsibilities

- People Leadership and Team Development
 - Lead, mentor, and develop a geographically distributed team of SREs and database engineers. 
 - Drive hiring, onboarding, performance management, career development, and succession planning. 
 - Establish clear team objectives, ownership, accountability, and performance expectations aligned with organizational priorities. 
 - Build engineering capabilities across reliability engineering, automation, observability, cloud technologies, and operational excellence. 
 - Foster a culture of collaboration, innovation, continuous learning, and engineering ownership. 
 - Manage team capacity, operational coverage, and resource allocation while balancing production support with strategic engineering initiatives. 
 - SRE Strategy and Reliability Engineering
 - Define and execute the SRE strategy and reliability improvement roadmap aligned with organizational priorities and business objectives. 
 - Lead the evolution of SRE practices from reactive operational support toward proactive, engineering-driven reliability, emphasizing automation, incident prevention, and continuous improvement. 
 - Define measurable reliability objectives and track key metrics, including service-level objectives (SLOs), incident trends, mean time to detect (MTTD), mean time to recover (MTTR), recurring incidents, and operational toil. 
 - Leverage operational insights, service health metrics, customer impact, and technical risk assessments to prioritize engineering improvements and drive accountability. 
 - Drive proactive problem management, technical debt reduction, and systemic engineering improvements to prevent recurring incidents and strengthen service resilience. 
 - Partner with engineering, architecture, and infrastructure teams to improve long-term platform stability, scalability, and reliability. 
 - Operational Excellence and Incident Management
 - Provide leadership oversight for 24×7 operational readiness, monitoring, incident response, escalation, and service recovery. 
 - Ensure effective operational coverage, shift handoffs, escalation procedures, and coordination with established incident-management teams. 
 - Lead critical incident escalations, ensuring timely service restoration, effective stakeholder communication, and minimal customer impact. 
 - Establish strong root-cause analysis (RCA), corrective and preventive action (CAPA), and problem-management practices. 
 - Drive standardization and continuous improvement of Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), runbooks, operational workflows, and knowledge management. 
 - Improve operational efficiency through proactive problem identification, automation, and measurable improvements in incident prevention and recovery. 
 - Automation and AI Transformation
 - Define and execute an automation-first SRE strategy to eliminate repetitive manual tasks, reduce operational toil, and improve engineering productivity. 
 - Drive automation of operational workflows, maintenance activities, monitoring, health checks, diagnostics, and recovery procedures. 
 - Strengthen observability through proactive monitoring, actionable dashboards, intelligent alerting, and standardized diagnostic workflows. 
 - Lead adoption of AI-assisted diagnostics, intelligent automation, and AI-driven operational improvements with appropriate governance and controls. 
 - Promote reusable engineering tools, Infrastructure as Code (IaC), CI/CD pipelines, and standardized automation frameworks.

 - Drive cross-functional collaboration, stakeholder alignment, and transparent communication of engineering progress, risks, and delivery milestones.

 - Drive continuous improvements in database service availability, performance, scalability, and operational resilience.

Organizational Overview

The Quality Engineering Center of Excellence (QE COE) is a centralized team of Quality Engineering Leaders and Test Architects, that standardizes, scales, and governs software quality, test automation, and best practices across the organization. This team works closely with the Leaders in the Engineering verticals and other cross functional teams who are the key stakeholders. This role will work closely with other peer Test Architects in the team under the leadership of the QE Leader to rollout and institutionalize the AI driven QE strategies and solutions conceptualized by the team, in partnership with the Application Teams.

Quality Engineering (QE) Automation Architect

Drive the design and delivery of next-generation Quality Engineering solutions by blending proven testing methodologies with AI-powered approaches. This role will occasionally architect scalable testing frameworks, champion adoption of AI-assisted testing, and embed intelligent automation across the product development lifecycle and CI/CD pipelines to accelerate high-quality delivery. 

As an SME in AI-enabled test automation engineering, this role will partner with peer architects and stakeholders to define strategy, recommend the optimal tool stack aligned to the application landscape, and resolve complex automation challenges-delivering best-in-class, enterprise-wide automation expansion solutions. 

Key Responsibilities

- Architect and own scalable test automation frameworks for functional, regression, and non-functional testing; embed automation into CI/CD (Jenkins, GitHub, CloudBees) as required by the Application teams. 
 - Define and drive QE standards, best practices, and reusable libraries/patterns across engineering teams. 
 - Partner with QE leads in application teams to implement shift-left testing and quality-by-design. 
 - Design and implement AI-assisted testing solutions leveraging LLMs, RAG, and agentic workflows; lead prompt engineering and context design for reliable AI test agents (test generation, test data creation, defect triage/analysis). 
 - Drive adoption and standardization of modern automation tools/frameworks (e. g. , Playwright, Selenium). 
 - Enable self-service automation and quality reporting dashboards for engineering teams. 
 - Act as a QE technical leader, run architecture reviews, mentor QE Engineers/Architects on AI-driven quality patterns and tools, and resolve complex automation challenges. 
 - Create playbooks, training, and rollout plans; continuously evaluate/pilot emerging QE technologies and measure adoption and impact. 

Required Skills/Knowledge

- Experience: 12+ years in Software Quality Engineering, including 3+ years in test architecture and framework design. 
 - Automation Tools: Hands-on expertise in Playwright and/or Selenium, REST API testing, and modern JavaScript/TypeScript or Python automation frameworks. 
 - AI-Assisted Testing: Working knowledge of LLMs and context design for QE use cases. 
 - Experience in providing AI-assisted solutions for functional, UAT, performance and security testing. 
 - AI Tooling: Experience applying AI tools for test case generation, code review support, and defect triage. 
 - Agentic Workflows: Understanding of agentic AI patterns to build autonomous test agents and end-to-end workflows. 
 - Integration: Ability to integrate AI solutions with existing business processes and enterprise IT infrastructure
 - Communication & stakeholder management: Align and influence stakeholders through clear, concise communication. 
 - System thinking & architecture design: Design scalable QE architectures with end-to-end perspective. 
 - Problem formulation & solution design: Turn vague problems into measurable, practical solutions. 

Desired Skills/Knowledge

- Experience designing and building GenAI platforms. 
 - Exposure to cloud ecosystems such as AWS and Azure. 
 - Proven ability to integrate test automation into CI/CD toolchains (Jenkins, GitHub Actions, CloudBees). 

Eligibility Criteria

- Bachelor's Degree and a minimum of 12 + years of experience in Information Technology or Engineering.
