Job Overview

Arm is redefining what is possible in cloud and data center computing. Our Neoverse platforms are helping power the next generation of infrastructure - combining advanced silicon with the system software required to turn ambitious technology into production-ready solutions. 

We have a requirement for a Technical Director in the infrastructure solutions software team in our CE-SW group to join in a technical leadership role for a globally distributed software engineering team delivering highly complex software for our cloud and data center products

This is an opportunity to make an impact at scale!

Responsibilities

You will: 

- Provide technical direction and expertise to the team and ensure strong technical progress across SoC, firmware and system validation from pre-silicon through silicon bring-up and production readiness. 
 - Partner with senior leaders across hardware, software, architecture and product teams to align with technology and delivery strategy and drive key decisions at the organisation level. 
 - Actively analyse product requirements, architecture specs and industry standards to drive software design. Lead development practices for best-in-class software efficiency, quality, and predictability

Required Skills and Experience : 

- Extensive experience delivering complex system software and technical leadership of large, globally distributed engineering organizations within embedded or infrastructure SoC space. 
 - Strong technical background in System-on-Chip (SoC), firmware, platform software and system-level validation across pre-silicon and silicon environments. 
 - Deep expertise low-level systems, including bootloaders, device drivers, OS fundamentals (preferably Linux), and a good understanding of computer architecture. 
 - Excellent technical judgement, leadership and communication skills, with a proven ability to influence senior collaborators and drive decisions across engineering organizations. 

"Nice To Have" Skills and Experience : 

- Knowledge of server-class SoCs, including RAS, power management, PCI Express (PCIe), Compute Express Link (CXL), memory and virtualization. 
 - Familiarity with the Linux kernel, Trusted Firmware-A (TF-A), UEFI EDK II, OpenBMC or Kernel-based Virtual Machine (KVM). 
 - An ideal candidate would have acted in technical lead capacity for teams of 100+ engineers within SoC space. 

In Return: 

If you want to shape how the next generation of Arm infrastructure technology reaches production, you will have the opportunity to lead a critical engineering function, influence technology and product decisions, and build an internationally spread organization responsible for the quality and readiness of some of our most sophisticated infrastructure platforms. 

Join us and help define what world-class system validation looks like at Arm!

Additional Information

Please note that a relocation package (including visa sponsorship support) is available for this role, for candidates who require it. 

Salary Range

Cambridge: £168, 300 - £227, 700

Sophia Antipolis: €136, 800 - €185, 000

Bangalore: ₹11, 025, 000 - ₹18, 375, 000

We value people as individuals and our dedication is to reward people competitively and equitably for the work they do and the skills and experience they bring to Arm. Salary is only one component of Arm's offering. The total reward package will be shared with candidates during the recruitment and selection process. 

Our 10x Mindset

Our 10x mindset is about curiosity, ambition and creating impact that will be used by millions. We learn fast, prioritise collaboration and turn bold ideas into real technology. data.description:

At ModMed, we're not just building software-we're reimagining the healthcare experience. This "for doctors, by doctors" philosophy has allowed us to create an AI-enabled, specialty-specific cloud platform that places patients at the center of care. 

A Culture of Excellence

When You Join ModMed, You're Joining An Award-winning Team Recognized For Innovation And Employee Satisfaction. From Our Global Headquarters In Boca Raton Florida, And Extensive Employee Base In Hyderabad India, We Are a Team Of 4, 500+ Passionate Problem-solvers On a Mission To Increase Medical Practice Success And Improve Patient Outcomes

- Consistently ranked as a Top Place to Work

Job Description Summary: 

Our Mission & Vision

- Our Mission: To place doctors and patients at the center of care through an intelligent, specialty-specific cloud platform. 
 - Our Vision: A world where the software ModMed builds increases medical-practice success and improves patient outcomes. 
 - Our Core Values: Create customer delight | Save time | Innovate boldly, then make things happen | Align passion with purpose | Think big | Have fun | Do good. 
 - bold*The Role: Technical Visionary for Reliability and Developer Velocity As a Principal Site Reliability Engineer at ModMed, you are a primary architect of our technical future. You don't just solve problems; you anticipate the needs of a global healthcare platform years in advance. You will think big to define the standards for reliability, scalability, developer velocity, and security that allow our doctors to provide world-class care without interruption. This is a high-impact technical leadership role where you will innovate boldly, then make things happen, acting as a vital bridge between engineering, product, and business goals. By aligning passion with purpose, you will build a resilient infrastructure that serves as the backbone for modern medicine and consistently creates customer delight. 

Primary Responsibilities

Core Infrastructure Strategy & Architecture

- Architectural Strategy & Technical Governance: Define and execute the long-term architectural vision for our global AWS cloud ecosystem. Design high-performance, fault-tolerant, and cost-optimized multi-region topologies capable of scaling elastically to meet massive transaction volumes while enforcing rigorous cloud hygiene (Save time). 
 - Systemic Observability Ecosystems: Institutionalize "Observability as a Culture" across the enterprise. Architect unified, global telemetry standards using Datadog and OpenTelemetry, transforming raw logs, metrics, and distributed traces into actionable, predictive insights that elevate system reliability across all product engineering groups. 
 - Developer Platform Evolution & CI/CD Engineering: Revolutionize the corporate CI/CD philosophy and internal developer platform (IDP) strategy. Engineer systemic, highly automated pipeline improvements using tools like GitHub Actions, ArgoCD, ACK, CUE, and others to eliminate developer friction, optimize resource utilization, and accelerate the release velocity of hundreds of engineers. 
 - Enterprise Kubernetes Stewardship: Serve as the ultimate authority on container orchestration, microservices deployment, and service mesh architectures. Drive high-level initiatives to maximize Kubernetes cluster efficiency, auto-scaling dynamics, secure multi-tenancy, and immutable deployment patterns across the entire organization. 
 - Proactive Infrastructure Security & Compliance: Partner closely with SecOps to architect a zero-trust infrastructure fortress. Embed automated security guardrails and compliance controls into core Infrastructure-as-Code pipelines, ensuring seamless, continuous adherence to strict healthcare regulatory standards, including HIPAA and SOC 2 (Do good). 
 - Enterprise Triage & Resilience Engineering: Act as the premier technical escalation authority for critical, cross-system infrastructure failures. Spearhead complex, multi-layered root-cause analysis, lead deep-dive post-mortems, and champion engineering patterns that turn production incidents into systemic resilience upgrades. 

Technical Leadership & Culture Multiplication

- Engineering Force Multiplier: Act as a strategic force multiplier across the engineering ecosystem. Direct high-impact cross-functional initiatives, define and publish enterprise-wide best practices, influence organizational technology roadmaps, and mentor senior and staff-level engineers to foster an inclusive, collaborative culture of technical excellence (Have fun. Do good. ). 

Role Requirements & Qualifications Minimum Qualifications

- Education: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline with an IT focus. 
 - Experience: 8+ years of dedicated experience in cloud engineering, Cloud Engineering, or DevOps roles. 
 - Engineering Tenure: 13-15+ years of distinguished experience in Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), Cloud Architecture, or DevOps Platform Engineering, with a definitive track record of scaling high-concurrency, enterprise cloud environments. 
 - AWS Architectural Authority: Deep, authoritative mastery of the AWS ecosystem (including EC2, Lambda, RDS, S3, IAM, and advanced networking features) with proven experience executing massive scalability strategies and sophisticated cloud spend optimization structures. 
 - Advanced Platform Stack: Professional-grade expertise architecting and managing production-scale Kubernetes environments, comprehensive Datadog telemetry architectures, and modular Infrastructure-as-Code platforms utilizing Terraform or Terragrunt at scale. 
 - Strategic Engineering & Tooling: Expert-level software engineering capability in Python, Go, or Bash to construct intelligent automation engines, internal CLI tools, and infrastructure platforms that systematically eliminate operational toil. 
 - Executive-Level Influence: Exceptional communication and advisory skills, with a proven ability to translate complex, low-level technical trade-offs into clear strategic visions for executive leadership while remaining capable of conducting a rigorous, line-by-line code and architecture review. 
 - Mission Dedication: A strong desire to apply elite technical expertise toward modernizing healthcare infrastructure, protecting patient data integrity, and solving complex societal-scale challenges. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Education: Bachelor's in Engineering or MCA. 
 - Industry Credentials: Active AWS Certified Solutions Architect - Professional, AWS Certified DevOps Engineer - Professional, or relevant advanced Specialty certifications (Security, Advanced Networking). 
 - Distributed Systems Expertise: Direct experience managing high-throughput, event-driven streaming architectures (e. g. , Apache Kafka, AWS Kinesis) or high-scale data warehouse solutions (e. g. , Amazon Redshift, Snowflake). 
 - Community & Thought Leadership: A history of contributing to foundational open-source cloud-native projects, authoring technical white papers, or speaking at premier industry tech conferences (e. g. , AWS re: Invent, KubeCon). ModMed Core Behavioral Competencies To thrive in this role, you should naturally embody our foundational competencies:

 - Results Driven: Consistently achieves quality results, overcomes obstacles, and inspires others to do the same.

 - Customer Focus: Builds strong, positive relationships (internally and externally) and delivers customer-centric solutions. 
 - bold*ModMed Benefits Highlight: At ModMed, we believe it's important to offer a competitive benefits package designed to meet the diverse needs of our growing workforce. Eligible Modernizers can enroll in a wide range of benefits: 
 - Meals & Snacks: Enjoy complimentary office lunches & dinners on select days and healthy snacks delivered to your desk, 
 - Insurance Coverage: Comprehensive health, accidental, and life insurance plans, including coverage for family members, all at no cost to employees, 
 - Allowances: Annual wellness allowance to support your well-being and productivity, 
 - Earned, casual, and sick leaves to maintain a healthy work-life balance,

Please check senders' email addresses carefully. Additionally, ModMed will not ask you to purchase equipment or supplies as part of your onboarding process. If you are receiving communications as described above, please report them to the FTC website.

We do not:

Role Title : AVP , Quality Engineering (QE) Automation Architect ( L11 )

Company Overview: Synchrony (NYSE: SYF) is a leading consumer financing company that has been at the heart of American commerce and opportunity for nearly a century. Synchrony delivers credit and banking products that empower tens of millions of consumers to improve their financial lives and access what matters most. Leveraging innovative solutions that are shaping the future of retail commerce, Synchrony supports the growth and success of some of the nation's most respected brands, alongside hundreds of thousands of small and midsize businesses, including health and wellness providers. Committed to excellence in service and culture, Synchrony is proud to be named as #3 as a Great Place to Work® in India and is honored to be ranked the #1 Best Company to Work For® in the U. S. by Fortune magazine and Great Place to Work®. For more information, visit www. synchrony. com. 

Organizational Overview

The Quality Engineering Center of Excellence (QE COE) is a centralized team of Quality Engineering Leaders and Test Architects, that standardizes, scales, and governs software quality, test automation, and best practices across the organization. This team works closely with the Leaders in the Engineering verticals and other cross functional teams who are the key stakeholders. This role will work closely with other peer Test Architects in the team under the leadership of the QE Leader to rollout and institutionalize the AI driven QE strategies and solutions conceptualized by the team, in partnership with the Application Teams. 

Role Summary/Purpose

Quality Engineering (QE) Automation Architect

Drive the design and delivery of next-generation Quality Engineering solutions by blending proven testing methodologies with AI-powered approaches. This role will occasionally architect scalable testing frameworks, champion adoption of AI-assisted testing, and embed intelligent automation across the product development lifecycle and CI/CD pipelines to accelerate high-quality delivery. 

As an SME in AI-enabled test automation engineering, this role will partner with peer architects and stakeholders to define strategy, recommend the optimal tool stack aligned to the application landscape, and resolve complex automation challenges-delivering best-in-class, enterprise-wide automation expansion solutions. 

Key Responsibilities

- Architect and own scalable test automation frameworks for functional, regression, and non-functional testing; embed automation into CI/CD (Jenkins, GitHub, CloudBees) as required by the Application teams. 
 - Define and drive QE standards, best practices, and reusable libraries/patterns across engineering teams. 
 - Partner with QE leads in application teams to implement shift-left testing and quality-by-design. 
 - Design and implement AI-assisted testing solutions leveraging LLMs, RAG, and agentic workflows; lead prompt engineering and context design for reliable AI test agents (test generation, test data creation, defect triage/analysis). 
 - Drive adoption and standardization of modern automation tools/frameworks (e. g. , Playwright, Selenium). 
 - Enable self-service automation and quality reporting dashboards for engineering teams. 
 - Act as a QE technical leader, run architecture reviews, mentor QE Engineers/Architects on AI-driven quality patterns and tools, and resolve complex automation challenges. 
 - Create playbooks, training, and rollout plans; continuously evaluate/pilot emerging QE technologies and measure adoption and impact. 

Required Skills/Knowledge

- Experience: 12+ years in Software Quality Engineering, including 3+ years in test architecture and framework design. 
 - Automation Tools: Hands-on expertise in Playwright and/or Selenium, REST API testing, and modern JavaScript/TypeScript or Python automation frameworks. 
 - AI-Assisted Testing: Working knowledge of LLMs and context design for QE use cases. 
 - Experience in providing AI-assisted solutions for functional, UAT, performance and security testing. 
 - AI Tooling: Experience applying AI tools for test case generation, code review support, and defect triage. 
 - Agentic Workflows: Understanding of agentic AI patterns to build autonomous test agents and end-to-end workflows. 
 - Integration: Ability to integrate AI solutions with existing business processes and enterprise IT infrastructure
 - Communication & stakeholder management: Align and influence stakeholders through clear, concise communication. 
 - System thinking & architecture design: Design scalable QE architectures with end-to-end perspective. 
 - Problem formulation & solution design: Turn vague problems into measurable, practical solutions. 

Desired Skills/Knowledge

- Experience designing and building GenAI platforms. 
 - Exposure to cloud ecosystems such as AWS and Azure. 
 - Proven ability to integrate test automation into CI/CD toolchains (Jenkins, GitHub Actions, CloudBees). 

Eligibility Criteria

- Bachelor's Degree and a minimum of 12 + years of experience in Information Technology or Engineering. 

Work Timings 2: 00PM to 11: 00 PM IST

This role qualifies for Enhanced Flexibility offered in Synchrony India and will require the incumbent to be available between 06: 00 AM Eastern Time - 11: 30 AM Eastern Time (timings are anchored to US Eastern hours and will adjust twice a year locally). This window is for meetings with India and US teams. The remaining hours will be flexible for the employee to choose. Exceptions may apply periodically due to business needs) We are proud to offer flexibility at Synchrony. Our way of working allows you the option to work from home or workspaces in our Regional Engagement Hubs-Hyderabad, Bengaluru, Pune, Kolkata, or Delhi/NCR. Occasionally you may be required to commute or travel to Hyderabad or one of the Regional Engagement Hubs for in person engagement activities such as business or team meetings, trainings, and culture events

Supplier Change Quality Engineer (SCN/PQP)

Role Summary

This role manages the quality review of supplier change notifications (SCN) and their associated PQPs. The engineer ensures supplier data packages meet iQMS guidelines, identifies and communicates data gaps and risks, and works with suppliers, internal stakeholders and Quality approvers to close each SCNs on time and in compliance.

Job Description: Principal Software Engineer - AI Platforms & Knowledge Graphs

Role: Principal Software Engineer - AI/LLM Platforms

Experience: 10-15+ years

Level: Principal Engineer / Technical Architect

Domain: Enterprise AI, Knowledge Graphs, Generative AI, Distributed Systems

About The Role

We are looking for a highly accomplished Principal Software Engineer to lead the architecture, design, development, and evolution of enterprise-scale AI platforms, knowledge graph systems, and intelligent applications. 

The ideal candidate brings deep expertise in distributed systems, scalable software architecture, knowledge graphs, Large Language Models (LLMs), and production-grade AI engineering. 

This is a hands-on technical leadership role requiring strong engineering fundamentals, architectural depth, and the ability to build, deploy, scale, and maintain complex AI-powered systems for enterprise customers. 

The candidate should have practical experience working with multiple LLMs, understand their capabilities, limitations, and performance trade-offs, and be capable of making informed architectural decisions to deliver reliable, secure, and cost-efficient AI solutions. 

Key Responsibilities

- Enterprise Knowledge Graph Engineering
 - Architect, design, develop, and maintain scalable enterprise knowledge graph platforms. 
 - Build knowledge ingestion, entity extraction, relationship mapping, entity resolution, and graph enrichment pipelines. 
 - Design graph data models, ontologies, taxonomies, and semantic relationships. 
 - Develop high-performance graph querying, retrieval, and reasoning capabilities. 
 - Integrate knowledge graphs with enterprise data sources, applications, and AI systems. 
 - Implement GraphRAG, hybrid retrieval, and context-aware search architectures. 
 - Ensure scalability, reliability, data consistency, and performance of graph-based systems. 
 - AI & LLM Platform Engineering
 - Lead the architecture and development of production-grade AI applications leveraging Large Language Models. 
 - Design and implement RAG, GraphRAG, agentic AI, and intelligent workflow solutions. 
 - Integrate and orchestrate multiple proprietary and open-source LLMs, including GPT, Claude, Gemini, Llama, and other emerging models. 
 - Evaluate LLM capabilities, reasoning quality, latency, context handling, accuracy, cost, and suitability for different use cases. 
 - Develop model-agnostic architectures enabling flexible model selection, routing, and fallback strategies. 
 - Optimize prompt engineering, context management, inference performance, token consumption, and operational costs. 
 - Build LLM evaluation frameworks, monitoring, guardrails, and observability capabilities. 
 - Address hallucinations, retrieval quality, grounding, security, and reliability challenges in enterprise AI applications. 
 - Scalable Systems Architecture
 - Architect highly scalable, fault-tolerant, distributed systems supporting enterprise workloads. 
 - Design cloud-native, microservices-based, asynchronous, and event-driven architectures. 
 - Build high-throughput data pipelines and low-latency APIs. 
 - Drive performance engineering, horizontal scaling, caching, concurrency, and infrastructure optimization. 
 - Design secure, multi-tenant systems with robust isolation and enterprise-grade availability. 
 - Make architectural trade-offs across performance, reliability, maintainability, and cost. 
 - Production Engineering & Platform Reliability
 - Own the end-to-end engineering lifecycle, from architecture and implementation to production deployment and ongoing maintenance. 
 - Establish engineering standards for CI/CD, automated testing, deployment, monitoring, and incident management. 
 - Implement observability, distributed tracing, performance monitoring, and operational diagnostics. 
 - Drive system reliability, availability, security, and operational excellence. 
 - Troubleshoot complex production issues across distributed systems, graph databases, and LLM integrations. 
 - Continuously improve scalability, response times, resource utilization, and infrastructure costs. 
 - Technical Leadership
 - Provide technical direction and architectural leadership across engineering teams. 
 - Lead complex system design discussions, architecture reviews, and technology evaluations. 
 - Mentor senior engineers and establish strong software engineering practices. 
 - Collaborate with product, AI/ML, data engineering, infrastructure, and customer-facing teams. 
 - Translate complex enterprise requirements into robust technical solutions. 
 - Take ownership of critical architectural decisions and long-term platform evolution. 
 - Remain hands-on with design, coding, prototyping, debugging, and performance optimization. 

Required Qualifications & Experience

- 10-15+ years of software engineering experience, including significant experience designing and operating large-scale distributed systems. 
 - Strong proficiency in Python, Java, Go, or equivalent backend programming languages. 
 - Demonstrated experience architecting, developing, and maintaining enterprise-scale software platforms. 
 - Hands-on experience building and deploying knowledge graph or graph-based data systems. 
 - Strong understanding of graph databases, graph algorithms, semantic modeling, and knowledge retrieval. 
 - Practical experience building production AI applications using LLMs. 
 - Experience integrating multiple LLM providers and understanding model-specific capabilities, limitations, and engineering trade-offs. 
 - Strong understanding of RAG architectures, embeddings, vector databases, and hybrid retrieval. 
 - Expertise in cloud technologies such as AWS, Azure, or GCP. 
 - Experience with microservices, containers, Kubernetes, APIs, and distributed data processing. 
 - Strong knowledge of system design, scalability, concurrency, reliability, and performance optimization. 
 - Proven ability to independently drive complex engineering initiatives from design to production. 

Preferred Technical Experience

Knowledge Graph & Data Technologies

- Neo4j, Amazon Neptune, RDF, SPARQL, Cypher
 - Ontology Modeling, Entity Resolution, Graph Algorithms
 - Elasticsearch, OpenSearch, Graph Databases
 - Vector Databases: Pinecone, Weaviate, Milvus, pgvector

Generative AI & LLM Frameworks

- OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, Google Gemini, Llama, Mistral
 - LangChain, LlamaIndex, LangGraph
 - GraphRAG, Agentic RAG, Hybrid RAG
 - Embedding Models, Reranking, Semantic Search
 - Model Context Protocol (MCP), Tool Calling
 - LLM Evaluation, Observability, Guardrails

Scalable Architecture & Infrastructure

- AWS / Azure / GCP
 - Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform
 - Kafka, Redis, PostgreSQL
 - Distributed Systems, Microservices, Event-Driven Architecture
 - CI/CD, Monitoring, Distributed Tracing
 - High Availability, Fault Tolerance, Performance Engineering

What Makes an Ideal Candidate

We Are Particularly Interested In Engineers Who

- Have built and operated real enterprise-scale systems, not just prototypes or proof-of-concepts. 
 - Have designed knowledge graph platforms and solved real-world challenges around ingestion, retrieval, graph performance, and scalability. 
 - Understand the nuances of different LLMs and know when and why to use a particular model. 
 - Have experience taking AI applications from experimentation to secure, reliable, cost-efficient production deployments. 
 - Can operate comfortably across AI engineering, backend systems, data architecture, and cloud infrastructure. 
 - Are strong hands-on engineers who can influence architecture and engineering practices across multiple teams. 
 - Demonstrate deep technical judgment, ownership, and the ability to solve ambiguous, complex engineering problems. 

Success in This Role

Success Will Be Measured By The Ability To

- Deliver robust and scalable knowledge graph and AI platform capabilities. 
 - Improve platform performance, reliability, and operational efficiency. 
 - Accelerate the development and production deployment of enterprise AI applications. 
 - Establish reusable architectural patterns and engineering standards. 
 - Reduce technical complexity and improve long-term platform maintainability. 
 - Enable engineering teams to deliver complex AI solutions with greater speed and quality. 

Core Keywords: Principal Software Engineer, AI Platform Architect, Enterprise Knowledge Graph, GraphRAG, Generative AI, LLM Engineering, Multi-LLM Orchestration, Agentic AI, RAG, Distributed Systems, Scalable Architecture, Graph Databases, Cloud-Native Systems, LLMOps, AI Observability, Enterprise AI Applications, Technical Leadership.

Job Description

As a Design Manager at WSP, you will lead and manage design projects within the Water sector. Working closely with the Project Director and Project Manager, you will be responsible for overseeing engineering design activities and ensuring compliance with industry best practices and UK regulations. 

At WSP, our Design Managers are adaptable professionals who thrive in a variety of situations. They possess an innovative mindset, are willing to take on new challenges, and are comfortable working on significant and complex projects or programmes of work. We collaborate closely with external clients and internal multidisciplinary project teams to deliver successful outcomes. 

To ensure effective project delivery, we operate across WSP offices, client offices, and site locations, supporting programmes of strategic regional and national importance. 

Joining WSP offers an exceptional opportunity to take the next step in your career. You will have the chance to build on your experience and qualifications, achieve your professional ambitions, and benefit from excellent support for personal development and career growth within both local teams and the wider WSP business. 

Responsibilities

Key Responsibilities: 

- Provide leadership and direction for BIM and digital delivery across multiple UK Water projects and frameworks. 
 - Develop and implement BIM strategies aligned with business, client, and project objectives. 
 - Support business growth through digital solutions, innovation, and BIM capability enhancement. 
 - Contribute to regional and global digital transformation initiatives. 
 - Support business planning, forecasting, resource planning, and capability development activities. 
 - Promote a culture of technical excellence, collaboration, innovation, and continuous improvement. 
 - Support the development of BIM delivery roadmaps and long-term digital strategies. 

Project & Portfolio Oversight

- Provide oversight and governance for BIM delivery across a portfolio of projects. 
 - Ensure project teams consistently meet quality, program, budget, and client requirements. 
 - Monitor project performance, resource utilization, and delivery KPIs. 
 - Support BIM Managers and project teams in resolving complex technical and delivery challenges. 
 - Review project BIM Execution Plans (BEP), information management processes, and BIM deliverables. 
 - Ensure BIM deliverables align with ISO 19650 requirements, client standards, and WSP procedures. 
 - Identify delivery risks and implement mitigation plans. 

BIM Governance & Technical Excellence

- Establish and maintain BIM governance frameworks, standards, procedures, and quality management systems. 
 - Oversee the development and maintenance of BIM standards, templates, libraries, and workflows. 
 - Ensure compliance with: 
 - ISO 19650
 - Client BIM standards
 - UK Water standards
 - Information management requirements
 - WSP BIM procedures
 - Lead technical audits and quality reviews. 
 - Champion best practices in information management and digital delivery. 
 - Drive consistency across project teams and regions. 

Key Competencies / Skills

Leadership & Management

- Strong leadership and people management capabilities. 
 - Proven ability to manage multidisciplinary teams across multiple projects. 
 - Excellent coaching, mentoring, and stakeholder management skills. 
 - Strategic thinker with strong business awareness. 

Personal Attributes

- Excellent communication and presentation skills. 
 - Strong decision-making and problem-solving ability. 
 - Results-driven and accountable. 
 - Collaborative and culturally aware. 
 - Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced international environment. 

Qualifications

Qualifications & Experience

- Degree/Diploma/BE in Engineering. 

Experience

- Typically 15+ years of experience in BIM, CAD, and digital project delivery. 
 - Minimum 7+ years in BIM leadership or management positions. 
 - Extensive experience delivering multidisciplinary infrastructure and UK Water projects. 
 - Proven experience managing large BIM teams and multiple project portfolios. 
 - Demonstrated success in developing BIM standards, governance frameworks, and digital strategies. 
 - Experience working directly with clients, project directors, and senior leadership teams. 
 - Strong understanding of project delivery models, information management, and digital engineering workflows.

- Employment with WSP India is subject to the successful completion of a background verification ("BGV") check conducted by a third-party agency appointed by WSP India. 
 - Candidates are advised to ensure that all information provided during the recruitment process - including documents uploaded - is accurate and complete, both to WSP India and its BGV partner". 

About Us

WSP is one of the world's leading professional services consulting firms. We are dedicated to our local communities and propelled by international brainpower. We are technical experts and strategic advisors including engineers, technicians, scientists, architects, planners, surveyors and environmental specialists, as well as other design, program and construction management professionals. We design lasting solutions in the Transportation & Infrastructure, Property & Buildings, Earth & Environment, Power & Energy, Resources and Industry sectors, as well as offering strategic advisory services. Our talented people around the globe engineer projects that will help societies grow for lifetimes to come. 

With approximately 4, 000 talented people across 3 locations (Noida, Bengaluru & Mumbai offices) in India and more than 73, 000 globally, in 550 offices across 40 countries, we engineer projects that will help societies grow for lifetimes to come. 

At "WSP" we draw on the diverse skills and capabilities of our employees globally to compete for the most exciting and complex projects across the world and bring the same level of expertise to our local communities. We are proud to be an international collective of innovative thinkers who work on the most complex problems. Unified under one strong brand, we use our local expertise, international reach and global scale to prepare our cities and environments for the future, connect communities and help societies thrive in built and natural ecosystems. True to our guiding principles, our business is built on four cornerstones: Our People, Our Clients, Our Operational Excellence and Our Expertise. 

www. wsp. com

We are

- Passionate people doing purposeful and sustainable work that helps shape our communities and the future. 
 - A collaborative team that thrives on challenges and unconventional thinking. 
 - A network of experts channeling our curiosity into creating solutions for complex issues. 

Inspired by diversity, driven by inclusion, we work with passion and purpose. 

Working with Us

At WSP, you can access our global scale, contribute to landmark projects and connect with the brightest minds in your field to do the best work of your life. You can embrace your curiosity in a culture that celebrates new ideas and diverse perspectives. You can experience a world of opportunity and the chance to shape a career as unique as you. 

Our Hybrid Working Module

With us, you can operate in a flexible, agile, yet structured work environment and follow a Hybrid Work Model. 

- Maximize collaboration. 
 - Maintain product quality and cultural integrity. 
 - Balance community, collaboration, opportunity, productivity, and efficiency. 

Health, Safety and Wellbeing

Our people are our greatest asset, and we prioritize a safe work environment. Health, safety, and wellbeing are integral to our culture, with each of us accountable for fostering a safe workplace through our "Making Health and Safety Personal" initiative. Our Zero Harm Vision drives us to reduce risks through innovative solutions, earning recognition for our global health and safety practices with the prestigious RoSPA Health and Safety Awards for six consecutive years. 

Inclusivity and Diversity

WSP India is dedicated to fostering a sustainable and inclusive work environment where our greatest strength - Our People -feel valued, respected, and supported. We ensure an unbiased approach in hiring, promotion, and performance evaluation, regardless of age, gender identity, race, religion, sexual orientation, marital status, physical ability, education, social status, or cultural background. 

Imagine a better future for you and a better future for us all. 

Join our close-knit community of over 73, 300 talented global professionals dedicated to making a positive impact. Together, we can make a difference in communities both near and far. 

With us, you can. 

Apply today. 

NOTICE TO THIRD PARTY AGENCIES: 

WSP does not accept unsolicited resumes from recruiters, employment agencies, or other staffing services. Unsolicited resumes include any resume or hiring document sent to WSP in the absence of a signed Service Agreement where WSP has expressly requested recruitment/staffing services specific to the position at hand. Any unsolicited resumes, including those submitted to hiring managers or other business leaders, will become the property of WSP and WSP will have the right to hire that candidate without reservation - no fee or other compensation will be owed or paid to the recruiter, employment agency, or other staffing service.

data.title: Senior Lead Engineer - Verification
data.description:
Role

L&T Semiconductor Technologies (LTSCT) is seeking an experienced and highly motivated Senior Lead Engineer, Verification to play a key technical leadership role in the development of next-generation semiconductor products. 

This position provides an excellent opportunity to build a strong technical career while working on complex, state-of-the-art SoCs and IPs. As a Sr Lead Engineer, you will be responsible for driving verification strategy across IP, Subsystem, and SoC levels, leading verification architecture, mentoring engineers, and establishing reusable methodologies that improve quality and engineering productivity. 

You will collaborate closely with System Architects, RTL Designers, Physical Design, Analog/Mixed-Signal, Post-Silicon Validation, Firmware, and Software teams throughout the product development lifecycle. You will actively participate in architecture reviews, influence design decisions from a verification perspective, and define scalable verification methodologies that enable first-silicon success. 

Your responsibilities will include defining verification strategies, creating reusable SystemVerilog/UVM-based verification environments, developing comprehensive verification plans, selecting verification tools and methodologies, driving functional and code coverage closure, and ensuring timely project execution with the highest quality standards. 

Key Responsibilities

As a Sr Lead Engineer, you will independently lead complex verification activities or provide technical leadership to a team responsible for IP, Subsystem, and SoC verification. 

Technical Leadership

- Provide technical leadership for verification projects from architecture definition through verification signoff. 
 - Operate with a strong product and system-level mindset, understanding complete data flows and system interactions. 
 - Drive verification strategy based on product requirements and architecture specifications. 
 - Define scalable and reusable Testbench (TB) architectures for multiple projects. 
 - Serve as the Lead Verification Architect for reusable verification environments across product lines. 
 - Participate in architecture, micro-architecture, design reviews, and technical decision-making. 

Verification Methodology

- Develop reusable verification environments using SystemVerilog and UVM methodologies. 
 - Create comprehensive Verification Plans, Test Plans, Functional Coverage Plans, Assertions, and Verification Closure Metrics. 
 - Design and develop reusable Verification IPs (VIPs), Bus Functional Models (BFMs), scoreboards, checkers, monitors, and protocol-specific verification components. 
 - Integrate and validate internally developed VIPs with third-party commercial VIP solutions. 
 - Drive constrained-random verification, coverage-driven verification, assertion-based verification, and formal verification where applicable. 
 - Perform environment benchmarking, profiling, optimization, and performance tuning. 

Verification Execution

- Plan and execute verification activities from block-level through full-chip verification. 
 - Develop and execute regression strategies for functional, performance, and corner-case validation. 
 - Analyze regression results, debug complex failures, identify root causes, and drive timely closure. 
 - Drive functional, code, assertion, toggle, and FSM coverage closure to meet verification signoff goals. 
 - Ensure compliance with project quality metrics and verification signoff criteria. 

Team Leadership

- Lead and mentor verification engineers across multiple projects. 
 - Allocate work based on technical complexity, project priorities, and individual strengths. 
 - Conduct design reviews, code reviews, verification reviews, and technical audits. 
 - Guide engineers in debugging complex verification issues and adopting industry best practices. 
 - Foster a culture of technical excellence, innovation, collaboration, and continuous learning. 

Cross-Functional Collaboration

- Work closely with RTL Design, System Architecture, Analog/Mixed-Signal Design, Physical Design, DFT, Firmware, Software, FPGA Prototyping, Emulation, and Post-Silicon Validation teams. 
 - Collaborate effectively with globally distributed engineering teams across multiple geographic locations. 
 - Interface directly with customers to understand technical requirements, provide engineering solutions, and resolve critical issues with urgency. 

Methodology & Productivity Improvement

- Drive continuous improvements in verification methodologies, engineering processes, and development flows. 
 - Evaluate, benchmark, and recommend EDA tools, simulators, emulators, formal verification tools, and verification technologies. 
 - Work closely with EDA vendors to establish efficient verification flows and deployment strategies. 
 - Develop automation frameworks, regression infrastructure, verification dashboards, and productivity-enhancing solutions. 
 - Build automation using scripting languages such as Python, Perl, Shell, or Tcl to improve verification efficiency. 

Documentation & Knowledge Sharing

- Prepare verification architecture documents, user guides, methodology documentation, coding guidelines, and verification flow documentation. 
 - Maintain reusable verification assets and best-practice documentation. 
 - Conduct technical seminars, design reviews, methodology workshops, knowledge-sharing sessions, and internal training programs. 

Mentor junior engineers and support their technical and professional growth

Job Title: Gen AI Staff Software Engineer

Location: Bangalore

Business & Team

As we continue our pursuit of NPS +30, we need to transform the way we engage with our customers and colleagues. This requires a shift from a two-track digital versus assisted approach to a deeply personal and empathic end-to-end digital experience enriched and augmented by our colleagues. This will require self-healing adaptive work orchestration systems that blend the capabilities of colleagues, AI and APIs. These systems must handle the high frequency of exceptional circumstances arising during customer journeys while remaining compliant with policies and regulations, without the significant change and maintenance burden of today. The Gen AI Domain has been established to build the tools and capabilities needed across the Group, tapping into the promise of Generative AI through the "Transformer Banking" initiative. 

This domain within CDAO is focused on solution practices, tools and platforms required to successfully leverage Large Language Models, rather than the tools and capabilities required to create those models. This includes technology platforms and tools such as the Gen AI Hub, RAG tooling, knowledge management services, and LLM access and control planes; business platforms and tools such as Customer Conversation Manager and Customer Activity Manager; and practice capability co-creating patterns and practices for Gen AI usage with crews across CBA. 

The Gen AI Domain will provide services, tools and practices that enable crews across CBA to safely and effectively leverage Generative AI as components of more traditional solutions. We are looking for people who thrive in ambiguity, build strong team cultures, remain obsessed with customer needs, thoughtfully manage a wide variety of risks, and are passionate about transforming a large enterprise in a heavily regulated environment using Gen AI. 

Impact & Contribution

As a Staff Software Engineer for Gen AI, you will use deep technical expertise in engineering principles and Gen AI platforms to achieve business outcomes. You will provide core technology and domain knowledge to inform the crew's technical strategy and lead the design, enhancement and maintenance of solutions to complex Gen AI challenges. We are leading the world in AI ambition within Australia's largest bank and fintech. Together, we will engineer the future of banking with innovative Gen AI solutions. 

Reporting Line

Direct line reporting to the Principal Engineer, Gen AI, India. 

Roles & Responsibilities

- Develop and maintain robust, scalable systems to support the deployment and operation of generative AI models, ensuring efficient use of computational resources. 
 - Build Gen AI capability among engineers across knowledge engineering, prompt engineering and platform engineering. 
 - Knowledge Engineering: Identify and gather relevant domain-specific knowledge from various sources and structure it so that LLMs can understand and utilise it. 
 - Prompt Engineering: Build effective instructions for Gen AI models to generate more relevant, accurate and creative outputs. 
 - Platform Engineering: Collaborate with other teams to integrate AI solutions into existing workflows and systems. Configure and manage the underlying infrastructure to ensure scalability, reliability and high availability. 
 - Evaluate the performance of Gen AI models, identify improvement areas and iteratively refine models to enhance accuracy, efficiency and fairness. 
 - Provide strategic guidance and oversee medium-complexity system engineering initiatives and solutions. 
 - Oversee the design, development and maintenance of the Gen AI Hub, including infrastructure, tools and APIs. 
 - Work with Data Scientists and other teams to ensure the platform integrates seamlessly with existing workflows and meets user needs. 
 - Use technical expertise to solve platform issues, improve ways of working, and enhance and automate the existing platform using the latest automation tools. 
 - Stay current with advances in generative AI, including the latest research, model releases and performance developments. 
 - Develop and recommend infrastructure design best practices that support model fine-tuning, improve performance and efficiency, and enable effective troubleshooting during development and deployment. 
 - Embed security best practices throughout the development lifecycle to protect the platform from vulnerabilities and data breaches. 
 - Implement robust monitoring, logging and LLMOps practices to proactively identify and resolve potential issues. 
 - Ensure Responsible AI metrics are governed through appropriate system infrastructure, guardrails and monitoring. 

Essential Skills & Experience

- Technology delivery expertise, combining deep technical capability with the ability to deliver outcomes. 
 - High level of communication and negotiation skills, including the demonstrated ability to solicit opinions and accept feedback. 
 - Experience operating effectively as part of cross-functional teams. 
 - Proficiency in IT SDLC processes and written documentation and specification skills. 
 - Experience in Prompt Engineering, Platform Engineering and/or Knowledge Engineering disciplines. 
 - Minimum of 10 years of experience in a relevant field. 
 - Proven track record of building and leading a team of engineering professionals. 
 - Excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to identify creative solutions to complex problems. 
 - Strong cross-cultural communication skills and the ability to effectively manage collaboration across time zones. 

Technical Skills

- Cloud solution architecture, development, security and Infrastructure as Code across AWS and Azure. 
 - Python, TypeScript and/or C#. 
 - Prompt Engineering. 
 - Gen AI frameworks and tools such as LangChain and Semantic Kernel. 
 - Vector, graph and SQL databases. 
 - Non-deterministic automated testing. 
 - Machine Learning, including LLM fine-tuning. 
 - System Reliability Engineering. 
 - Secure Coding. 
 - Customer engagement systems. 
 - Workflow platforms. 

Education Qualification

data.description:
Meet the Team

The Silicon One ASIC delivers the silicon, optics, and hardware platforms for Cisco's core Switching, Routing, and Wireless products. With ~2, 100 employees across 16 countries, we design the networking hardware for Enterprises and Service Providers of various sizes, the Public Sector, and Non-Profit Organizations across the world. Cisco Silicon One (#CiscoSiliconOne) is the only unifying silicon architecture in the market that enables customers to deploy the best-of-breed silicon from Top of Rack (TOR) switches all the way through web scale data centers and across service provider, enterprise networks, and data centers with a fully unified routing and switching portfolio. Come join us and take part in shaping Cisco's ground-breaking solutions by designing, developing and testing some of the most complex ASICs being developed in the industry. 

You will be in the Silicon One development organization as an ASIC Implementation Technical Lead in Bangalore India with a primary focus on Design-for-Test. You will work with Front-end RTL teams, backend physical design teams to understand chip architecture and drive DFT requirements early in the design cycle. As a member of this team you will also be involved in crafting groundbreaking next generation networking chips. You will help lead to drive the DFT and quality process through the entire Implementation flow and post silicon validation phases with additional exposure to physical design signoff activities. 

Your Impact

- Responsible for implementing the Hardware Design-for-Test (DFT) features that support ATE, in-system test, debug and diagnostics needs of the designs. 
 - Responsible for development of innovative DFT IP in collaboration with the multi-functional teams, and play a key role in full chip design integration with the testability features coordinated in the RTL. 
 - Work closely with the design/design-verification and PD teams to enable the integration and validation of the Test logic in all phases of the implementation and post silicon validation flows. 
 - Your team will participate in the creation of Innovative Hardware DFT & physical design aspects for new silicon device models, bare die & stacked die, driving re-usable test and debug strategies. 
 - The job requires the candidate to have the ability to craft solutions and debug with minimal mentorship. 

Minimum Qualifications

- Bachelor's or a Master's Degree in Electrical or Computer Engineering required with at least 12 years of experience. 
 - Knowledge of the latest innovative trends in DFT, test and silicon engineering. 
 - Experience with Jtag protocols, Scan and BIST architectures, including memory BIST and boundary scan. 
 - Experience with ATPG and EDA tools like TestMax, Tetramax, Tessent tool sets, PrimeTime
 - Verification skills include, System Verilog Logic Equivalency checking and validating the Test-timing of the design
 - Experience working with Gate level simulation, debugging with VCS and other simulators. 
 - Post-silicon validation and debug experience; Ability to work with ATE patterns, P1687
 - Strong verbal skills and ability to thrive in a multifaceted environment
 - Scripting skills: Tcl, Python/Perl. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Verilog design experience - developing custom DFT logic & IP integration; familiarity with functional verification

data.title: Staff ASIC Digital Engineer (FPGA Prototyping, Emulation, System-Level Debugging) with 8 to 12 years of experience
data.description:
Sandisk understands how people and businesses consume data and we relentlessly innovate to deliver solutions that enable today's needs and tomorrow's next big ideas. With a rich history of groundbreaking innovations in Flash and advanced memory technologies, our solutions have become the beating heart of the digital world we're living in and that we have the power to shape. 

Sandisk meets people and businesses at the intersection of their aspirations and the moment, enabling them to keep moving and pushing possibility forward. We do this through the balance of our powerhouse manufacturing capabilities and our industry-leading portfolio of products that are recognized globally for innovation, performance and quality. 

Sandisk has two facilities recognized by the World Economic Forum as part of the Global Lighthouse Network for advanced 4IR innovations. These facilities were also recognized as Sustainability Lighthouses for breakthroughs in efficient operations. With our global reach, we ensure the global supply chain has access to the Flash memory it needs to keep our world moving forward. 

Description

Role Overview The Platform Engineering organization is looking for a self-driven, hands-on engineer who can bridge the communication and skillset divide between firmware, silicon design, and hardware validation. Your primary responsibility will be supporting our advanced prototyping and emulation platforms, with a specific focus on end users. The ideal candidate has a broad, systems-level knowledge base, with deep technical expertise in platform bring-up, hardware/software co-verification, and high-density FPGA deployments. Duties and Responsibilities

- Lead Project Bring-Up & Diagnostics: Partner with firmware and hardware teams during the critical early phases of project bring-up. Own the initial setup, environment configuration, and stabilization of emulation and prototyping platforms. 
 - Triage & Debug: Act as the first line of defense for complex system-level failures during bring-up. Rapidly isolate root causes across the hardware, FPGA/emulator configuration, and early boot-code boundaries. 
 - Partner with Customers: Work directly with product firmware engineers to break down execution barriers, unblock their development pipelines, and abstract away hardware complexities. 
 - Infrastructure Automation: Develop automation, monitoring scripts, and health-check reporting to maximize the reliability, utilization, and throughput of the emulation and prototyping farm. 
 - Knowledge Sharing: Document creative workarounds, capture debug methodologies, and build standardized playbooks for platform setup and troubleshooting. Desired

Skills

& Experience

- FPGA Prototyping & Support: Proven experience supporting large-scale FPGA prototyping platforms (e. g. , Synopsys HAPS, custom multi-FPGA boards). Understanding of FPGA synthesis, place-and-route constraints, and clocking strategies is highly valued. 
 - System-Level Debugging: Mastery of debugging tools and protocols (e. g. , JTAG, protocol analyzers, logic analyzers, in-circuit emulators) to trace signals and state machines during early platform bring-up. 
 - Emulation Platforms: Familiarity with hardware emulation architectures (e. g. , Cadence Palladium, Synopsys ZeBu) and how to map design code into an emulation environment. 
 - Hardware/Firmware Intersection: Solid understanding of the firmware development lifecycle and how it intersects with ASIC development, hardware description languages (Verilog/SystemVerilog), and FPGA design. 
 - Python Expertise: Advanced Python scripting skills to develop internal tools, parsing utilities for debug logs, and automated regression testing frameworks. 
 - Rudimentary Firmware

Skills: 

Ability to write and debug low-level diagnostic code or bare-metal software to validate platform functionality, without needing to own the production product firmware. 

- Systems Administration: Functional understanding of networking, UNIX/Linux, and Windows administration. Because the team manages a high volume of specialized prototyping seats, the ability to troubleshoot local environment, licensing, and OS-level issues is critical. 
 - Data Manipulation: Expertise in processing and analyzing usage metrics to optimize resource allocation across a global infrastructure. 

Qualifications

Qualifications

- Education: BS or MS in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or Computer Science. 
 - Experience: 8-15 years of experience working in or around pre-silicon development, hardware verification, or platform bring-up.

data.title: Sr Advanced Application Engr
data.description:
Job Description

The Honeywell Connected Industrial Technical Support organization supports customers worldwide across advanced process technologies. This position will provide senior-level technical and application support for Honeywell Advanced Process Control solutions and work closely with a global team to resolve complex customer issues. 

The successful candidate should combine strong process-control fundamentals with hands-on APC knowledge, troubleshooting capability, customer-facing communication skills, and the ability to work effectively across global engineering, product and customer teams. 

Responsibilities

- Provide advanced technical and application support for Honeywell APC solutions. 
 - Take ownership of complex customer issues from initial investigation through technical resolution. 
 - Troubleshoot APC application, configuration, model, performance, integration and related process-control issues. 
 - Work with customers and global Honeywell engineering teams to perform systematic root-cause analysis and develop effective solutions. 
 - Review application configuration and process/control data to identify performance or implementation issues. 
 - Support testing and technical evaluation of new APC releases and product enhancements. 
 - Deliver technical guidance and training to customers and internal teams. 
 - Create and improve technical knowledge content, troubleshooting guidance and best practices. 
 - Collaborate with product development, engineering and other Technical Support teams on complex or escalated issues. 
 - Share APC expertise and mentor less-experienced engineers. 
 - Maintain clear, timely and professional customer communication throughout technical case resolution. 

Qualifications

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Chemical, Process, Control, Instrumentation Engineering, or a closely related engineering discipline. 
 - 8+ years of relevant process automation/process-control experience, with significant exposure to APC. 
 - Strong understanding of Advanced Process Control and Model Predictive Control (MPC) concepts. 
 - Strong knowledge of process dynamics, regulatory control and PID control. 
 - Demonstrated troubleshooting and root-cause-analysis capability in industrial control/application environments. 
 - Excellent written and verbal technical communication skills. 
 - Strong customer-focused mindset and ability to work effectively within a global engineering organization. 

About Us

Honeywell Technologies is a global, pure-play automation company with a legacy of innovating to help solve the world's most mission-critical challenges, enhancing the quality of life for people and communities around the world. We serve the building, industrial and process sectors with a broad portfolio of services, solutions and products, underpinned by our Honeywell Technologies Accelerator operating system and Honeywell Technologies Forge intelligence layer. By combining the deep domain expertise of our more than 50, 000 employees with decades of data from our global installed base, we are uniquely positioned to lead the industrial sector's transition from automation to autonomy.

data.title: Embedded Quality Assurance Engineer
data.description:
Are you. . . 

- Interested in the physics behind how we perceive color and appearance?
 - Interested in innovation for precision measurement instruments?
 - Interested in working in a strong international R&D team?

If so, read on!

X-Rite Pantone is the leading company for color measurement systems and solutions, worldwide and over a wide range of markets (print and packaging, consumer electronics, automotive, textile, etc. ). Our products combine precision optical measurement systems with advanced algorithms, powerful embedded computing, and software. 

Role Overview - Embedded Quality Assurance Engineer - Bangalore (India)

As an Embedded Quality Assurance Engineer, you will play a key role in ensuring the quality, reliability, cybersecurity, and performance of X-Rite's embedded software solutions. You will work closely with software, firmware, systems, and product teams throughout the development lifecycle to validate new features, improve test automation, and ensure robust product releases. This role combines hands-on testing, test automation development, and collaboration with cross-functional teams in a global engineering organization spanning India, Europe, and the United States. You will contribute directly to the quality of our market-leading spectrophotometers, color measurement systems, and spectral imaging products. 

Key Responsibilities

- Design, develop, execute, and maintain comprehensive test plans and test cases for embedded software products. 
 - Develop and enhance automated test frameworks, regression test suites, and validation tools to improve quality and efficiency. 
 - Execute functional, integration, system, regression, and exploratory testing of embedded devices and associated software components. 
 - Analyze test results, investigate defects, and work closely with software and firmware engineers to identify root causes and verify fixes. 
 - Collaborate with development teams to ensure quality is integrated throughout the software development lifecycle. 
 - Support cybersecurity validation activities, including security testing and verification of security requirements. 
 - Assist in improving test coverage, automation capabilities, release readiness criteria, and quality metrics. 
 - Participate actively in Agile development processes, including sprint planning, reviews, and retrospectives. 
 - Acquire a strong understanding of customer use cases and product functionality to help ensure high-quality product releases. 
 - Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives through automation, AI-assisted testing, process optimization, and knowledge sharing. 

Required Qualifications

Bachelor or Master of Science in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field. 3-7 years of experience in software quality assurance, embedded systems testing, or test automation. 

Experience and training in most of the following areas are required: 

- Experience testing embedded Linux-based systems and software-driven hardware products. 
 - Experience developing automated tests using Python, PyTest, GoogleTest, or similar frameworks. 
 - Experience with software debugging, defect tracking, and test management processes. 
 - Familiarity with version control systems such as Git. 
 - Experience working with CI/CD environments and automated build pipelines. 
 - Understanding of software development lifecycles and quality assurance best practices. 
 - Experience working within Agile development environments (Scrum and/or Kanban). 
 - Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. 
 - Effective verbal and written communication skills in English. 
 - Ability to work independently while contributing effectively within a collaborative team environment. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience with Embedded Linux and Yocto-based systems. 
 - Experience with hardware-in-the-loop (HIL) and system-level automated testing. 
 - Familiarity with programming languages such as C, C++, Python, and Bash. 
 - Experience with tools such as GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins, or Azure DevOps. 
 - Familiarity with optical measurement systems, instrumentation products, or related industrial devices. 

Personal Attributes

- Strong ownership mindset with a passion for product quality and customer satisfaction. 
 - Curious, hands-on, and eager to learn new technologies and domains. 
 - Structured and detail-oriented approach to testing and problem solving. 
 - Collaborative team player with strong communication and influencing skills. 

We recognize that people come with a wealth of experience and talent. We believe in the value of unique perspectives, and we welcome candidates from diverse backgrounds who may not meet every criterion to apply and bring their distinctive experiences to our team. 

We Offer

- A dynamic, international, and innovative work environment. 
 - Exciting technical challenges and expert colleagues with decades of experience in the field. 
 - A position in our Bangalore office with flexibility in the time schedule and hybrid work model. 
 - A human sized organization where you'll have contact beyond the R&D department. 
 - Coaching and learning opportunities at every stage of your career. 

Immerse yourself in a vibrant and dynamic workplace that spans industries such as printing, packaging, photography, graphic design, video, automotive, paints, plastics, and textiles. Join a team that thrives on pushing the boundaries of what's possible, where innovation meets impact, and cross-functional teamwork sets us apart. 

X-Rite Pantone is proud to part of the Product Quality & Innovation segment of Veralto (NYSE: VLTO), a $5B global leader dedicated to ensuring access to clean water, safe food and medicine, and trusted essential goods. When you join Veralto's vibrant global network of 16, 000 associates, you join a unique culture and work environment where purpose meets possibility: where the work you do has an everyday impact on the resources and essentials we all rely on, and where you'll have valuable opportunities to deepen your skillset, pursue your ambitions, and grow your career. Together, we're Safeguarding the World's Most Vital ResourcesTM-and building rewarding careers along the way. 

Contact@shilpashetty

At Veralto, we value diversity and the existence of similarities and differences, both visible and not, found in our workforce, workplace and throughout the markets we serve. Our associates, customers and shareholders contribute unique and different perspectives as a result of these diverse attributes. 

Unsolicited Assistance

We do not accept unsolicited assistance from any headhunters or recruitment firms for any of our job openings. All resumes or profiles submitted by search firms to any employee at any of the Veralto companies, in any form without a valid, signed search agreement in place for the specific position, approved by Talent Acquisition, will be deemed the sole property of Veralto and its companies. No fee will be paid in the event the candidate is hired by Veralto and its companies because of the unsolicited referral.

data.title: Software QA Lead
data.description:
Hiring for Cotecna Inspection - via Flexiple, the recruiting partner on this role. 

About Company

Cotecna is a global provider of testing, inspection and certification services. Its digital products support customer portals, field inspection, laboratories, compliance records, certificates, document workflows and operational teams across high-stakes global supply chains. The company is strengthening the quality-engineering foundations behind these applications. 

Job Roles & Responsibilities

- Own the automation strategy while remaining hands-on with framework design, test development, debugging and execution across Cotecna's digital products. 
 - Build and evolve maintainable automation frameworks for web and API journeys; framework choice is flexible when the architecture and ownership evidence are strong. 
 - Integrate automated suites into CI/CD pipelines and establish reliable quality gates, reporting, triage and release-readiness criteria. 
 - Lead and mentor QA engineers, define standards and review practices, and improve coverage, speed, maintainability and production quality. 
 - Partner with product, engineering and business stakeholders on risk-based testing, defect prevention, go/no-go decisions and post-release improvement. 

Ideal Candidate Profile

- Six to ten years of QA or quality-engineering experience, including at least five years of recent hands-on automation and continued coding or framework work. 
 - Demonstrable ownership of an automation framework built from scratch or substantially architected; scripting only inside somebody else's framework is insufficient. 
 - Hands-on web automation using Playwright, Selenium, Cypress or an equivalent, plus API automation using Rest Assured, Postman, Karate or an equivalent. 
 - Personal ownership of integrating automated suites into Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Azure DevOps or a comparable delivery pipeline. 
 - Evidence of leading or owning QA for a team, including mentoring, standards and release or production-readiness decisions; quantified team size is preferred. 
 - Mobile automation, performance or security-aware testing, cloud or containers, and regulated or document-heavy systems are useful differentiators. 

Hiring Process

- Internal HM Review
 - Flexiple Interview

data.title: QA- Integration Test engineer
data.description:
Overview

TekWissen is a global workforce management provider throughout India and many other countries in the world. The job opportunity described below is for one of our clients, who has developed a core competence in creating and deploying cost-effective capabilities using an offshore-centric business model. 

Position: QA- Integration Test engineer

Location: Vadodara

Job Type: Full Time

Work Type: Onsite

Job Description

- The Client is seeking an experienced Senior QA Engineer with strong expertise in integration testing, API validation, database testing, and automation testing. 
 - The role focuses on ensuring the quality and reliability of end-to-end integrations across enterprise applications, including Workato-based workflows and ChurnZero (CZ) integrations. 
 - The successful candidate will validate data flows, business rules, API interactions, and system behavior, working closely with development, product, and integration teams to identify issues and deliver reliable integration solutions. 

Key Responsibilities

Integration Testing

- Design, prepare, execute, and maintain integration test plans, scenarios, and test cases. 
 - Validate end-to-end business workflows and data exchanges across multiple systems and applications. 
 - Verify data synchronization, completeness, accuracy, and consistency across integrated platforms. 
 - Identify, investigate, document, and track integration defects and data discrepancies through resolution. 
 - Collaborate with developers, product owners, and integration engineers to troubleshoot issues and validate fixes. 

Workato Platform Testing

- Test and validate Workato recipes, triggers, actions, mappings, connections, and workflow orchestration. 
 - Verify API requests and responses, payload transformations, business rules, and data handling within recipes. 
 - Validate error handling, retry mechanisms, exception paths, and recovery scenarios. 
 - Perform regression testing for recipe changes, enhancements, and newly implemented integrations. 

ChurnZero (CZ) Integration Testing

- Perform functional and integration testing of ChurnZero and connected enterprise applications. 
 - Validate customer data synchronization and the accuracy of customer-related records across systems. 
 - Verify health scores, customer journey events, usage data, and engagement workflows against defined requirements. 
 - Ensure business rules are correctly applied and data integrity is maintained across integration points. 

Data Flow & Database Validation

- Validate end-to-end data movement from source systems to target applications and databases. 
 - Write and execute SQL queries to verify data accuracy, completeness, consistency, and transformation results. 
 - Perform data reconciliation and investigate missing, duplicate, or inconsistent records. 
 - Analyze database records and integration logs to identify data quality issues and integration failures. 

API Testing & Performance Validation

- Design and execute functional, integration, and regression tests for REST APIs. 
 - Validate JSON payloads, request/response structures, authentication, authorization, status codes, and error handling. 
 - Use Postman and Swagger for API validation and documentation review. 
 - Execute API performance, load, and stress tests using JMeter, LoadRunner, k6, or similar tools. 
 - Analyze performance results, identify bottlenecks, and work with development teams to verify improvements. 

Automation & Quality Assurance

- Develop, maintain, and execute automated test scripts or integration test suites where appropriate. 
 - Identify opportunities to automate repeatable integration and regression scenarios. 
 - Participate in CI/CD quality gates and support test execution as part of build and deployment processes. 
 - Prepare test execution reports, defect records, test evidence, and root-cause analysis findings. 
 - Support UAT, production validation, and post-deployment testing activities. 

Collaboration & Continuous Improvement

- Work with cross-functional teams to understand integration requirements, acceptance criteria, and business outcomes. 
 - Participate in Agile ceremonies, test planning, reviews, and defect triage. 
 - Contribute to improving test coverage, test data practices, QA processes, and integration testing standards. 
 - Maintain clear documentation of test scenarios, results, dependencies, and known issues. 

Required Qualifications

Experience & Education

- 5+ years of QA experience, with a strong focus on integration testing and enterprise application testing. 
 - Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field; equivalent professional experience may be considered. 
 - Hands-on experience testing Workato recipes and integrations is required. 
 - Experience testing ChurnZero (CZ) integrations and customer success workflows is required. 

Technical Skills

- Strong understanding of integration testing, end-to-end workflow validation, and data flow testing across enterprise applications. 
 - Hands-on API testing using Postman, Swagger, REST APIs, JSON, and related tools. 
 - Knowledge of API authentication and authorization mechanisms, including OAuth, request/response validation, and error handling. 
 - Strong SQL skills and experience with database testing, data validation, and reconciliation. 
 - Experience with API performance testing tools such as JMeter, LoadRunner, or k6. 
 - Understanding of regression testing, test design techniques, defect lifecycle management, and QA practices. 
 - Familiarity with test automation concepts, scripting, and CI/CD-based quality validation. 
 - Working knowledge of Agile/Scrum and tools such as Azure DevOps or Jira. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience testing integrations involving Salesforce, Microsoft Dynamics 365, or other CRM and enterprise applications. 
 - Knowledge of automation frameworks and scripting languages used for test automation. 
 - Exposure to cloud platforms such as Microsoft Azure or AWS. 
 - Understanding of ETL/ELT concepts and enterprise data integration processes. 
 - Experience with DevOps practices, CI/CD pipelines, and automated deployments. 
 - Experience with production validation, integration monitoring, or support of business-critical interfaces. 

Preferred Candidate Profile

- Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills, with attention to detail and data accuracy. 
 - Able to independently plan and execute testing while collaborating effectively with cross-functional teams. 
 - Clear verbal and written communication skills, including the ability to explain technical issues and test findings. 
 - Strong ownership of quality activities from test planning through execution, defect resolution, and production validation. 
 - Able to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced Agile environment. 
 - Committed to continuous learning and improving integration and automation testing practices. 

Key Success Measures

- Comprehensive test coverage of Workato recipes, ChurnZero integrations, APIs, and end-to-end workflows. 
 - Early identification and clear reporting of integration defects, data discrepancies, and performance issues. 
 - Reliable validation of data accuracy and consistency across source and target systems. 
 - Effective regression and automation coverage for integration changes and releases. 
 - Timely support for UAT, deployments, and post-production validation with clear test evidence. 

Primary Skills

- Integration Testing | Workato Recipe Testing | ChurnZero (CZ) Integration Testing | API Testing (REST/JSON/OAuth) | SQL & Database Validation | Data Flow Testing | Postman | JMeter / LoadRunner

Required Competencies

- Must possess excellent communication skills - oral and written
 - Must possess knowledge of latest technology trends
 - Must be a keen learner - should be able to drive "Self Learning"
 - Must practice principle of "First Time Right"
 - Must have an Eye for Details 
 - Must have high Customer Orientation 
 - Must be adaptable to working in multiple / matrix work environment 
 - Must possess good systems thinking
 - Must possess good negotiation, analytical and interpersonal skills. Good leadership & team player qualities. 
 - High on personal integrity with ability to establish relationships and work in teams and should be able to influence stakeholders. Should poses independence, robust ethics and resilience. 

Educational Qualification

- ME (IT, Computer), BE (IT, Computer), MCA, MSC-IT, BCA

data.title: Lead Engineer II – Senior Engineer, Authentication and Authorization IRC302231

Description

We're building the identity and access layer that every service in our SaaS control plane depends on. You'll own the common auth stack - making sure the right principals get the right access, consistently, across every tenant and product surface. 

Requirements

You should have

- 5+ years building auth systems in production SaaS environments. 

- Strong Go or Python (ideally both); comfortable writing performant, well-tested service code in either. 

- Deep knowledge of OAuth 2. 0, OIDC, JWT, and SAML - not just using libraries but understanding what's happening underneath. 

- Experience with authorization policy engines (OPA, Casbin, or equivalent) and modeling complex permission structures. 

- Familiarity with multi-tenant isolation patterns and the security implications of getting them wrong. 

- Comfort in an AWS/EKS environment with secrets management (AWS Secrets Manager, Vault). 

Nice to have: SCIM provisioning, FIDO2/WebAuthn, zero-trust networking, SOC 2 audit experience, or prior work on a shared platform team serving internal consumers. 

Job responsibilities

What you'll do

- Design and operate the centralized authn/authz platform: token issuance and validation (OIDC/JWT), OAuth 2. 0 flows, API key management, and service-to-service identity. 

- Build and maintain the authorization model: RBAC and ABAC policies, tenant isolation enforcement, and fine-grained permission evaluation (Open Policy Agent or similar). 

- Expose auth as a shared internal service consumed by the rest of the control plane - clean APIs, well-documented contracts, and minimal coupling. 

- Partner with product and platform teams to implement SSO integrations (SAML, SCIM) and onboard enterprise identity providers. 

- Harden the auth layer: token rotation, secret management, audit logging, and threat modeling against common identity attacks.
