data.description:
Description

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we're the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain - and we're looking for talented people who want to help. 

As a Software Development Engineer II on our Infrastructure Supply Chain Automation team, you will build large-scale distributed applications using serverless technologies, data lakes, and NoSQL databases to automate the complex processes that keep AWS infrastructure growing ahead of customer demand. The team is expanding quickly with a strong pipeline of projects ready for you on day one, and we are actively investing in new features and AI adoption. If you enjoy building systems from the ground up and solving problems that require creative, unconventional thinking, this is the role for you. 

Key job responsibilities

- Design and build large-scale distributed applications using serverless technologies, data lakes, and NoSQL databases to automate infrastructure supply chain processes for AWS. 
 - Collaborate with internal teams such to understand scaling requirements, translating them into technical designs that account for performance, security, and long-term maintainability. 
 - Write high-quality, well-documented code across the full development lifecycle, from requirements gathering through deployment and operations, ensuring solutions can be maintained by engineers new to the codebase. 
 - Mentor junior engineers through code reviews and design discussions, actively training new team members on system architecture and operational practices. 
 - Identify root causes of operational issues and drive permanent fixes, improving system reliability through proactive monitoring and automation. 

A day in the life

You start your morning reviewing deployment metrics and triaging any operational alerts. By mid-morning, you are whiteboarding a new automation workflow with teammates, weighing tradeoffs around data structures, algorithms, and service dependencies. After lunch, you pair with a junior engineer on a code change, coaching them through the review process. Later, you pick up one of the projects waiting in the team's backlog, scoping the technical approach and drafting a design document for peer review.

data.title: Principal Software Engineer
data.description:
Overview

What happens when AI agents can rewrite millions of lines of code orders of magnitude faster than humans can review them? That question drives the Future of Scalable Software Engineering (FoSSE) team in Microsoft's CoreAI division. We build AI agents that transform some of the world's largest codebases, including Windows and Azure. Generating code is becoming the easy part; knowing whether to trust it is the real challenge. 

We combine AI agents with static analysis, testing, and formal verification to make large-scale software transformation practical and trustworthy, and we design tools that spend scarce human attention where it matters most. The team began in Microsoft Research and moved to CoreAI in 2025, and we continue to collaborate closely with Microsoft Research, so research depth meets production stakes every day. 

Here are the main problems we are currently working on: 

Migration at scale: We work on migrating hundreds of millions of lines of code, across Windows, Azure, Office, and other products, to work with new versions of dependent packages, new compilers and new platforms. Examples include increasing language-standards conformance of code, remediating CodeQL and other static analysis findings, and retargeting services from x86 to ARM. 

Language modernization: We move legacy C/C++ (and C#) codebases to Rust, with validation gates at every step. Differential testing against the original, held-out tests, and specification extraction with formal verification (such as Verus proofs) mean each migration is backed by evidence, not optimism. 

Specification-driven development: We help brownfield codebases adopt specification-driven development by inferring formal specifications for existing code. The specifications are grounded using execution traces and then used to generate concurrency and fault-tolerance tests, find subtle bugs, and ultimately create a validation guardrail for future AI-driven code changes. We are working with formal tools such as TLA+, F*, Lean and Verus in this work. 

You will be onsite at least three days a week and learn and grow through working with talented colleagues. 

Responsibilities

- Lead the design and delivery of agentic tools and infrastructure for one or more of our problem areas (such as migration at scale, language modernization, or specification-driven development). 
 - Set technical direction for a problem area end to end, from architecture to production adoption. 
 - Architect systems that let a small expert team drive transformations across hundreds of millions of lines of code. 
 - Define the validation strategies and quality bars that make agent-produced changes trustworthy at scale. 
 - Lead cross-organizational efforts with partner teams, such as Windows, Azure, compiler, and security teams, and with the research community. 
 - Turn ambiguous, fast-moving problems into roadmaps while staying flexible as models improve. 
 - Mentor senior engineers and raise the engineering bar across the team. 
 - Represent the team externally through talks, papers, and our blog. 

Qualifications

Required qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in computer science or related areas and 10+ years of experience. Or a Master's degree with 8+ years of experience. Or a PhD in computer science or related areas with 5+ years of experience. 
 - Experience coding in languages such as C, C++, C#, or Rust. 
 - Experience building developer tools using LLM-based agents. 
 - Experience with compilers and program analysis. 
 - Excellent technical design, problem-solving, and debugging skills. 
 - Strong communication and collaboration skills, customer obsession, and a passion for shipping high-quality products. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience with Rust and C/C++ interop and memory safety. 
 - Experience testing at scale, such as differential testing, property-based testing, or fuzzing. 
 - Experience with formal methods such as TLA+, model checking, F*, Lean, Verus, Dafny, or similar. 
 - Experience working with very large codebases and build systems. 
 - Interest or experience in human-AI interaction and developer experience design. 
 - Experience leading research-to-production transitions. 
 - Track record of leading technical efforts across teams or organizations. 
 - Publications or open-source contributions are a plus. 

Why join us

- Work on the hardest problems in agentic software engineering, at real scale. 
 - Join a small team with outsized leverage, where a handful of experts steer changes across hundreds of millions of lines of code. 
 - Blend research and engineering: ideas here ship to tools used by Windows, Azure, and other large teams. 
 - Build on, and contribute back to, the research community around TLA+, F*, Lean, Verus, etc.

data.title: SOC/Subsystem Verification Engineer
data.description:
About the Company

Cadence is a pivotal leader in electronic design, building upon more than 30 years of computational software expertise. The company applies its underlying Intelligent System Design strategy to deliver software, hardware and IP that turn design concepts into reality. Cadence customers are the world's most innovative companies, delivering extraordinary electronic products from chips to boards to systems for the most dynamic market applications including consumer, hyperscale computing, 5G communications, automotive, aerospace industrial and health. 

The Cadence Advantage

- The opportunity to work on cutting-edge technology in an environment that encourages you to be creative, innovative, and to make an impact. 
 - Cadence's employee-friendly policies focus on the physical and mental well-being of employees, career development, providing opportunities for learning, and celebrating success in recognition of specific needs of the employees. 
 - The unique "One Cadence - One Team" culture promotes collaboration within and across teams to ensure customer success. 
 - Multiple avenues of learning and development available for employees to explore as per their specific requirement and interests. 
 - You get to work with a diverse team of passionate, dedicated, and talented individuals who go above and beyond for our customers, our communities, and each other-every day. 

Location: Hyderabad

About the Role

A SOC/Subsystem Lead Verification Engineer is responsible for owning the verification strategy, planning, execution, and closure for a complex SoC block or subsystem. The role combines strong hands-on verification depth with technical leadership, cross-functional coordination, and delivery accountability. 

Responsibilities

- Lead verification of SoC or subsystem-level designs from architecture review through verification closure, ensuring functional correctness, coverage closure, and high-quality tapeout readiness. 
 - Drive methodology, team execution, debug, and alignment with design, architecture, firmware, emulation, and system teams. 
 - Define subsystem or SoC-level verification strategy, architecture, and execution plan. 
 - Review specifications, architecture documents, and micro-architecture for testability and verification completeness. 
 - Create and own verification plans, feature mapping, coverage models, and closure criteria. 
 - Lead development of UVM/SystemVerilog-based verification environments, reusable testbenches, checkers, scoreboards, monitors, and assertions. 
 - Drive test planning for protocol, performance, power, reset, interrupt, security, coherency, and error scenarios. 
 - Own regression strategy, triage, debug, and bug tracking to closure. 
 - Lead coverage closure across code coverage, functional coverage, assertions, and scenario coverage. 
 - Coordinate with design, DFT, firmware, architecture, emulation, and post-silicon teams. 
 - Mentor junior engineers and review verification code, test plans, and debug approaches. 
 - Identify verification gaps, schedule risks, and quality risks early and drive mitigation. 
 - Support formal verification, emulation, prototyping, and low-power verification where applicable. 
 - Drive signoff readiness and contribute to tapeout reviews. 

Qualifications

- 4-20years of experience in ASIC/SoC verification. 
 - Strong experience in subsystem or SoC-level verification ownership. 
 - Proven track record of leading verification closure for complex designs. 
 - Strong debugging skills across RTL, testbench, protocol, and system-level issues. 
 - Experience handling technically complex, cross-functional programs with schedule accountability. 

Required Skills

- Strong hands-on expertise in SystemVerilog and UVM. 
 - Solid understanding of verification methodologies, constrained-random testing, assertions, and coverage-driven verification. 
 - Experience with SoC fabrics and standard protocols such as AXI, AHB, APB, NoC, PCIe, USB, Ethernet, DDR, CXL, CHI, ACE, or similar, depending on domain. 
 - Experience in subsystem integration verification including resets, clocks, interrupts, boot flows, power states, and register validation. 
 - Working knowledge of SVA, formal verification concepts, CDC/RDC, and lint flows. 
 - Familiarity with emulation or FPGA prototyping is strongly preferred. 
 - Strong scripting skills in Python, Perl, Shell, or Tcl for automation and regression analysis. 
 - Experience with coverage and debug tools from major EDA vendors. 
 - Understanding of low-power verification using UPF/CPF is preferred. 
 - Exposure to firmware-hardware interaction and performance validation is a plus. 

Preferred Skills

- Lead a small to mid-sized verification team or act as technical lead for a larger program. 
 - Break down high-level milestones into execution plans and track delivery. 
 - Drive technical reviews and decision-making. 
 - Mentor engineers on methodology, coding quality, and debug efficiency. 
 - Communicate status, risks, dependencies, and closure metrics clearly to stakeholders. 

Pay range and compensation package

Location: Hyderabad

data.title: Lead Engineer II – Senior Engineer, Authentication and Authorization IRC302231
data.description:
Description

We're building the identity and access layer that every service in our SaaS control plane depends on. You'll own the common auth stack - making sure the right principals get the right access, consistently, across every tenant and product surface. 

Requirements

You should have

- 5+ years building auth systems in production SaaS environments. 

- Strong Go or Python (ideally both); comfortable writing performant, well-tested service code in either. 

- Deep knowledge of OAuth 2. 0, OIDC, JWT, and SAML - not just using libraries but understanding what's happening underneath. 

- Experience with authorization policy engines (OPA, Casbin, or equivalent) and modeling complex permission structures. 

- Familiarity with multi-tenant isolation patterns and the security implications of getting them wrong. 

- Comfort in an AWS/EKS environment with secrets management (AWS Secrets Manager, Vault). 

Nice to have: SCIM provisioning, FIDO2/WebAuthn, zero-trust networking, SOC 2 audit experience, or prior work on a shared platform team serving internal consumers. 

Job responsibilities

What you'll do

- Design and operate the centralized authn/authz platform: token issuance and validation (OIDC/JWT), OAuth 2. 0 flows, API key management, and service-to-service identity. 

- Build and maintain the authorization model: RBAC and ABAC policies, tenant isolation enforcement, and fine-grained permission evaluation (Open Policy Agent or similar). 

- Expose auth as a shared internal service consumed by the rest of the control plane - clean APIs, well-documented contracts, and minimal coupling. 

- Partner with product and platform teams to implement SSO integrations (SAML, SCIM) and onboard enterprise identity providers. 

- Harden the auth layer: token rotation, secret management, audit logging, and threat modeling against common identity attacks. 

- Drive adoption of consistent auth patterns across services, replacing one-off implementations.

Job Description

Job Summary

We are looking for a candidate to oversee manufacturing and production operations, managing equipment, process validation, handling change controls, deviations, incidents, and ensuring compliance with regulatory audits. Responsibilities include creating SOPs (Standard Operating Procedure), providing training, and applying expertise. 

Roles & Responsibilities

• You will be responsible for handling line operations, specifically production and manufacturing activities like CIP (Cleaning-in-place), SIP (Sterilizing-in-place), and batch manufacturing. 

• You will be responsible for handling equipment like Steam Sterilizer, Dry heat sterilizer, HVAC (Heating, Ventilation, and Air Conditioning), water system, compressed air, Nitrogen system, etc. 

• You will be responsible for process validation for Sterilization, Washing, Aseptic filling, and cleaning procedures. 

• You will evaluate change controls, deviation, and incident, (OOS) out of specification, (OOT) out of trend, and risk management. 

• You will prepare the production process SOPs (Standard Operating Procedures) and batch records. 

• You will provide training on GMP (good manufacturing practices). 

• You will apply knowledge of aseptic processes, Lean, OEE (Overall Equipment Effectiveness), and similar KPIs (Key Performance Indicators). 

• You will respond to queries and questions regarding regulatory audits such as US FDA (Food and Drug Administration). 

Qualifications

Educational qualification: A Bachelor's or Master's degree in Pharmaceutical Sciences, Chemical Engineering, or a related field

Minimum work experience: 7 years of experience in pharmaceutical manufacturing operations

Skills & attributes: 

Technical Skills

• Expertise in line operations, especially in manufacturing activities like CIP, SIP, and batch manufacturing. 

• Proficiency in understanding equipment such as Steam Sterilizer, Dry heat sterilizer, HVAC, water system, compressed air, Nitrogen system, etc. 

• Understanding of Process Validation for Sterilization, Washing, Aseptic filling, and cleaning procedures. 

• Knowledge for evaluation of change control, deviation, incident, out of specification, out of trend, and risk management. 

• Experience in preparing production process SOPs and batch records. 

• Understanding and application of Aseptic processes, Lean, OEE, and similar KPIs. 

• Hands-on experience in regulatory audits, particularly with agencies like the US FDA. 

• Good understanding of GMP and good laboratories practice. 

Behavioural skills

• Capacity to provide training on GMP and other relevant areas. 

• Collaborates seamlessly with cross-functional teams, promoting a cooperative and inclusive work environment. 

• Efficiently manages time to meet production schedules and deadlines without compromising quality. 

• Must have hands-on experience in sophisticated manufacturing machine and equipment. 

• Effective communication and training skills for user departments and service providers. 

Additional Information

Biologics

Currently operates in the Global Biosimilars business - a segment that is poised for attractive and sustained growth over the next 10-15-year time horizon. 

With a robust portfolio of biosimilar products across key therapeutic areas, covering ~US$80+ Bn in innovator sales - future business pipeline covers a variety of product classes and therapy areas, and new modalities. Fully integrated organization with over two decades of experience in developing, manufacturing and commercializing multiple biosimilar products. 

With a Product Development engine that has end-to-end capabilities - in-house clone development, upstream and downstream process development, bioanalytical development and proprietary formulation. 

Supported by a Clinical and Regulatory team with experience in executing complex biosimilar programs with innovative global trial designs. 

We have a proven experience in commercial-scale manufacturing across a variety of technology platforms with global quality standards and a highly competitive cost structure

Rich experience of commercializing high-quality biosimilars in multiple markets with over 900, 000 patients having benefited from our products till date. 

Benefits Offered

At Dr. Reddy's we actively help to catalyse your career growth and professional development through personalised learning programs. 

The benefits you will enjoy at Dr. Reddy's are on par with the best industry standards. They include, among other things and other essential equipment, joining & relocation support, family support (Maternity & Paternity benefits), learning and development opportunities, medical coverage for yourself and your family, life coverage for yourself. 

Our Work Culture

Ask any employee at Dr. Reddy's why they come to work every day and they'll say, because Good Health Can't Wait. This is our credo as well as the guiding principle behind all our actions. We see healthcare solutions not only as scientific formulations, but as a means to help patients lead healthier lives, and we're always attuned to the new and the next to empower people to stay fit. And to do this, we foster a culture of empathy and dynamism. People are at the core of our journey over the last few decades. They have been supported by an enabling environment that buoys individual ability while fostering teamwork and shared success. We believe that when people with diverse skills are bound together by a common purpose and value system, they can make magic.

data.title: QMS senior Engineer
data.description:
Company Description Arjan Impex is a leading manufacturer and exporter of food service products and pet products, serving global clients since 1996. Headquartered in New Delhi, India, the company has built a strong reputation for quality, reliability, and customer-focused solutions. Arjan Impex caters to the manufacturing and labeling needs of companies across more than 30 countries. With nearly three decades of industry experience, the organization emphasizes continuous improvement, product innovation, and adherence to international standards. Team members benefit from exposure to global markets and diverse manufacturing processes. 

Role Description The QMS Senior Engineer will oversee and enhance the Quality Management System across manufacturing operations at the Sonipat facility. This full-time, on-site role involves developing, implementing, and maintaining quality procedures, work instructions, and documentation in line with relevant standards and regulatory requirements. The QMS Senior Engineer will conduct internal audits, coordinate corrective and preventive actions, and analyze quality data to identify trends and drive process improvements. Day-to-day responsibilities include collaborating with production, engineering, and supply chain teams to ensure product quality, leading root cause analysis for nonconformities, and supporting customer and third-party audits. The role also includes training team members on QMS processes, promoting a culture of quality, and supporting certification and compliance initiatives. 

Qualification and Responsibility

B. tech Mechanical with 3 to 5 years experience

We are seeking a detail-oriented and proactive Senior Engineer - QMS to lead, maintain, and continuously improve our Integrated Management System (IMS) and plant-wide quality compliance. The ideal candidate will be an IMS Certified Internal Auditor with hands-on experience managing global customer technical audits (such as Walmart FCCA), driving structured 5S and Kaizen initiatives, maintaining SOP documentation, and leading root-cause problem-solving methodologies. 

Key Responsibilities

Bullet Audit Management (External & Customer Technical Audits): 

Bullet Lead end-to-end preparation, execution, and closure for all external, third-party, and customer technical audits (including Walmart FCCA, ISO surveillance/recertification audits, and buyer compliance audits). 

Bullet Coordinate cross-functional teams during audits, manage audit observations, and ensure 100% timely closure of non-conformances (NCs). 

Bullet Structured Internal Audits & IMS Compliance: 

Bullet Plan, schedule, and execute structured internal audits across all plant departments in alignment with IMS standards (ISO 9001, ISO 14001, ISO 45001). 

Bullet Track internal audit findings, verify effectiveness of corrective actions, and present audit metrics during Management Review Meetings (MRM). 

Bullet 5S & Kaizen Drive (Continuous Improvement): 

Bullet Design and drive structured 5S implementation across the shop floor, warehouses, and administrative areas through regular zone audits, scoring, and governance. 

Bullet Champion plant-wide Kaizen initiatives, mentoring floor teams to identify waste, improve process efficiency, and document measurable improvements. 

Bullet SOP & QMS Documentation Control: 

Bullet Draft, review, update, and control Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), Work Instructions (WIs), Quality Manuals, and process flowcharts. 

Bullet Ensure version control, document accessibility, and strict adherence to updated procedures across shop-floor operations. 

Bullet Root Cause Analysis & Problem Solving: 

Bullet Lead structured root-cause investigations for internal process failures, audit non-conformities, and customer complaints using 8D, 5-Why, Fishbone (Ishikawa), and CAPA frameworks. 

Bullet Validate the long-term effectiveness of implemented CAPAs to prevent recurrence. 

Required Qualifications & Skills

Bullet Education: B. E. / B. Tech / Diploma in Mechanical, Industrial, Production, or a related engineering discipline. 

Bullet Certifications: Certified IMS Internal Auditor (ISO 9001, ISO 14001, ISO 45001) from an accredited body. 

Bullet Technical & Audit Expertise: 

Bullet Proven track record handling factory capability and capacity audits (specifically Walmart FCCA or similar global retail/technical audits). 

Bullet Strong command over quality tools: 8D, 5-Why, CAPA, FMEA, and SPC. 

Bullet Practical experience establishing and sustaining structured 5S and Kaizen programs in a manufacturing environment. 

Bullet Soft Skills: Strong analytical and technical writing skills (for SOP creation), cross-functional stakeholder management, and assertive communication during external audits.

Your impact

Design Manager-CQV is responsible for leading and delivering end-to-end commissioning, qualification, and validation (CQV) programs for pharmaceutical, biotechnology, and medical device projects. This role combines technical subject matter expertise with project leadership, ensuring compliance with global regulatory standards while meeting project timelines, quality, and budget targets. 

The role requires deep experience in GxP environments, risk-based validation, and facility/equipment qualification, along with strong stakeholder and team management skills. The role will require an experienced, energetic, and committed CQV person with broad experience in C&Q, particularly biopharmaceuticals and having experience of >15 years. The person should have experience of leading CQV engineers for big projects and managing the C&Q documentation and execution lifecycle, from SLIA generation through to OQ/ PQ completion. They will work closely with cross-functional teams, including engineering, quality assurance, and manufacturing, to support the successful delivery of projects. 

- Lead and execute CQV activities across multiple CQV projects, ensuring timely execution and compliance with industry regulations. 
 - Act as an SME for CQV having technical authority for systems such as process equipments, process utilities, automation, HVAC and controlled environments. 
 - Manage multi-disciplinary teams including CQV engineers, vendors, and contractors. 
 - Serve as the primary CQV interface with clients, design teams and Quality & regulatory teams. 
 - Track project deliverables, budgets, risks, and timelines and provide regular project updates and status reports to stakeholders. 
 - Drive decision-making and resolve escalations with engineering team and client. 
 - Involve in GMP review of layouts and systems and ensure CQV requirements are embedded early in the design lifecycle. 
 - Review P&IDs, layouts, URS, FS/DS, equipment specifications and vendor documentation. 
 - Mentor and guide CQV engineers and junior staff. 
 - Establish best practices, templates, and standard methodologies. 
 - Drive continuous improvement and knowledge sharing within the team. 
 - Prepare C&Q plans in line with the strategic goals of the client and manage timely and compliant delivery of the plan. 
 - Ensure all commissioning and qualification procedures are implemented and adhered to at office and at site level. 
 - Complete the development, review and execution of validation plans, URSs/DQ/TMs/FATs/SATs/IQ/OQ protocols/reports. 
 - Ensure all CQV activities comply with relevant regulatory requirements (e. g. , FDA, EMA) and industry standards (e. g. , ISPE, ASTM) and meets data integrity (ALOCOA+) principles. Well versed in commissioning and qualifying CIP & SIP systems

Here's what you'll need

- Bachelor's degree in engineering, Life Sciences, or a related field. Advanced degree preferred. B. Pharm. , M. Pharm. , B. Tech or BE or MSc.

Key Responsibilities

Global AI/ML & Agentic Solution Delivery:

Business Partnership & Operational Knowledge

Global AI Training, Adoption & Awareness

- Own and drive continuous AI learning, enablement, and Responsible AI awareness across global It s teams.

 - Create practical guidance that helps employees use AI safely, responsibly, and effectively within approved policies and tools. 
 - Build a network of AI champions and reusable training assets to scale adoption across regions and functions. 
 - Track participation, adoption, proficiency, policy awareness, and feedback to continuously improve enablement programs. 

AI Operations, Support & Escalation

- Serve as the first-level escalation point for delivery, production, model, agent, data, integration, governance, and adoption issues related to AI/ML and Agentic AI. 
 - Lead structured triage, root-cause analysis, stakeholder communication, remediation, and preventive action for critical incidents. 
 - Establish operational readiness standards, service ownership, monitoring, alerting, runbooks, support handoffs, and incident response procedures. 
 - Monitor model and agent quality, latency, reliability, cost, drift, safety, and business performance after deployment. 
 - Escalate material risks and decisions promptly with clear impact, options, recommendations, owners, and resolution plans. 

Strategy Execution & Value Realization

- Reporting directly to Global Head, AI & Innovation to translate the Global AI Strategy into an executable roadmap and delivery portfolio. 
 - Support portfolio prioritization, investment planning, governance forums, executive reviews, vendor evaluations, and strategic partnerships. 
 - Identify opportunities to reuse platforms, data products, models, agents, and integration patterns across functions and regions. 
 - Define and report measurable outcomes, including business value, adoption, risk reduction, cycle-time improvement, quality, reliability, and cost efficiency. 
 - Continuously evaluate emerging technologies and recommend practical adoption paths aligned with business need, enterprise readiness, and risk tolerance.

 - Route, branch, vault, fleet, or field-service operations

data.title: Manager, Appraisal Review
data.description:
About The Team

The Appraisal Review team performs structured review of residential appraisal reports to help protect collateral quality, support underwriting decisions, and keep loans moving efficiently. The team partners with the Appraisal Desk, Processing, Underwriting, and external appraisal partners across Conventional, FHA, and other applicable loan workflows. 

Zillow Group is a strategic, mission-driven organization focused on delivering exceptional experiences and measurable outcomes. Our work spans cross-functional partnership, scalable programs and operational excellence in support of Zillow's mission. We bring deep experience working across diverse teams in a dynamic, high-growth environment, balancing strategic thinking with hands-on execution to drive meaningful business impact. We are seeking an experienced professional to support our workforce expansion in India. 

About The Role

As Manager, Appraisal Review, you will lead a team of Appraisal Review Specialists responsible for timely, consistent, and well-documented appraisal reviews. You will set the operating rhythm for queue prioritization, quality controls, escalations, and specialist development while ensuring the team operates within its defined authority and supports sound collateral-risk decisions. 

What You'll Do

- Lead, coach, and develop Appraisal Review Specialists; establish expectations for appraisal-review quality, clarity of conditions, turnaround time, and professional judgment. 
 - Own daily queue management, workload balancing, coverage planning, and prioritization against closing dates and service-level commitments. 
 - Oversee structured appraisal-review workflows in Encompass, Reggora, and applicable Appraisal Desk tools; ensure reviews, conditions, and statuses are complete and accurately documented. 
 - Monitor performance across quality, volume, aging, SLA adherence, rework, and escalation metrics; use trends to improve individual and team performance. 
 - Provide guidance on complex appraisal issues, including property characteristics, comparable selection, market conditions, value support, revision requests, desk reviews, final inspections, and ROVs. 
 - Ensure appropriate routing and escalation to Underwriting for matters outside specialist authority, including required FHA second-level sign-off and material collateral-risk concerns. 
 - Partner with the Appraisal Desk, Processing, Underwriting, Quality Control, and external partners to resolve appraisal issues and prevent closing delays. 
 - Run calibration, quality-review, coaching, and training routines; maintain current SOPs, checklists, job aids, and escalation guidance. 
 - Drive root-cause analysis of recurring defects, revision themes, and workflow bottlenecks; implement process or system enhancements to improve quality and efficiency. 
 - Ensure compliance with ZHL policies, agency and investor guidance, appraisal-independence requirements, and borrower-data privacy standards. 

This role has been categorized as an Office position. "Office" employees regularly work at the Zillow India office for approximately 80 to 100 percent of their time each month. Employees must live within a reasonable commuting distance of the office. Zillow has not defined a reasonable distance, and expects employees will use judgment in determining this for themselves and understand the implications re: time commitment and cost of daily commute. 

Who you are

- 5+ years of U. S. residential mortgage appraisal review, collateral underwriting, appraisal quality control, appraisal desk, or related mortgage-operations experience, including 3+ years of people leadership experience. 
 - Strong command of residential appraisal concepts, property types, market analysis, comparable selection, adjustments, reconciliation of value, and appraisal-report quality standards. 
 - Experience interpreting and applying Conventional and FHA collateral requirements; familiarity with VA, Jumbo, desk-review, appraisal-transfer, and ROV workflows is preferred. 
 - Demonstrated success managing teams to production, quality, defect, and turnaround-time metrics in a high-volume environment. 
 - Working knowledge of Encompass, Reggora, or comparable loan-origination and appraisal-workflow tools. 
 - Excellent analytical, written, verbal, coaching, and stakeholder-management skills, with sound escalation judgment. 
 - Strong working knowledge of UAD 3. 6 requirements, including the transition from legacy appraisal forms, bifurcation of the Form 1004D into the Restricted Appraisal Update Report and Completion Report, and updated UCDP data submission standards. 

Get to know us

At Zillow, we're reimagining how people move-through the real estate market and through their careers. As the most-visited real estate platform in the U. S. , we help people navigate buying, selling, financing and renting with greater ease and confidence. Whether you're working in tech, sales, operations, or design, you'll be part of a company reshaping an industry and helping more people make home a reality. 

Zillow is honored to be recognized among the best workplaces in the U. S. Zillow was named one of FORTUNE 100 Best Companies to Work For® in 2026, and included on TIME's America's Best Companies 2026 list, reflecting our commitment to creating an innovative, inclusive, and engaging culture where employees are empowered to grow. 

No matter where you sit in the organization, your work will help drive innovation, support our customers, and move the industry-and your career-forward, together. 

Zillow Group is committed to fostering an inclusive, innovative environment and to providing equal employment opportunities. We comply with applicable laws that prohibit discrimination in employment and recruitment. 

If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation during the recruitment process, please contact your recruiter directly. 

Qualified applicants will be considered for employment in accordance with applicable law.

data.title: Principal Software Engineer,  Shipping
data.description:
Description

You will build the optimization brain for Amazon's externalized logistics network - a system that couples first-mile route planning with middle-mile network optimization into a joint iterative loop, producing end-to-end recommendations that no single optimizer can reach alone. The technical challenge is real: solvers that take hours per run, a combinatorial search space that defies brute-force, model gaps that require deep-diving into solver internals, and convergence that must be proven across independently owned engines. This is not a scale or latency problem - it's a multi-system optimization convergence problem where you invent the pruning, approximation, and coupling strategies. Your recommendations will directly shape commercial decisions - which shippers to pursue, which geographies to grow, which contracts to reprice - giving this role rare direct business impact for a PE position. 

In addition, you will provide tech leadership to the fulfillment charter for Amazon Shipping where you will be responsible for increasing the label conversion rates that would be a key enabler for revenue growth; identify solutions such as dynamic network capacity management to build a resilient network topology; identify and build speed opportunities in the upstream planning systems; and solve unique challenges related to delivery addresses for an externalized supply chain business where orders are created outside amazon marketplace. 

You will also be responsible for architectural integrity and scalability of fulfillment systems by (1) identifying interface contracts with partner tech teams (2) making the architecture more nimble and self-serve for faster time-to-market of new capabilities (3) improving resiliency and availability of Tier-1 systems (4) optimizing the level of service orchestration within the fulfillment systems. 

Key job responsibilities

- Architect the joint FM-MM optimization loop: state-passing contracts, convergence detection, parallel execution, and checkpoint/restart
 - Solve computational tractability through smart pruning, lightweight solvers, and metaheuristic search at network scale
 - Drive cross-org alignment across 5+ organizations - securing stable interfaces and committed roadmap items
 - Translate optimization outputs into actionable recommendations for Operations (node mapping, capacity), Commercial (shipper targets, geographies), and Finance (cost-to-serve, contract economics)
 - Mentor a team of Applied Scientists and SDEs; set technical bar and build experimentation culture
 - Define and execute the phased roadmap: FM cost optimizer (Phase 1) → joint FM-MM optimizer (Phase 2) → decision engines that close the loop from network optimization to commercial strategy (Phase 3)
 - Own system validation and accuracy: design feedback loops from actual vs. predicted outcomes, detect degradation, and define refresh cadence

Basic Qualifications

- 12+ years of software development with increasing scope; 7+ years in system architecture
 - Demonstrated ability to take ambiguous problem spaces - where requirements, success metrics, and solution approach are all undefined - and drive them to concrete technical strategy and execution
 - Experience communicating with technical teams, business stakeholders, and leadership to collect requirements, describe technical designs, and align on product strategy
 - Track record of influencing technical direction across 5+ partner organizations without direct authority
 - Experience mentoring senior engineers and scientists
 - Experience building decision-support systems adopted by non-technical stakeholders

Preferred Qualifications

- M. S. /Ph. D. in Operations Research, CS, Applied Math, or related field
 - Expertise in logistics optimization: vehicle routing, network design, or supply chain planning at scale
 - Deep expertise in optimization systems, operations research, or simulation - building production systems that solve combinatorial optimization or search problems
 - Experience with iterative optimization or metaheuristic frameworks in production

data.description:
The Opportunity

We are looking for a Staff Software Engineer to shape the systems that give Hinge Health care-team members a clear, actionable view of the people they support. Member Records is the care-team-facing context layer within CareHub: it brings together member history, clinical context, active programs, program focus, indications, device and fulfillment status, onboarding progress, and program transitions so care teams can spend less time navigating fragmented systems and more time delivering personalized care. 

As a hands-on technical leader, you will help define the architecture and technical direction for Member Records while continuing to build production software. You will work across the user interface, backend services, APIs, and data models, partnering with Product, Design, Clinical, Quality, and adjacent engineering teams. You will turn complex healthcare workflows into reliable, intuitive experiences and lead work from discovery and technical design through implementation, launch, and operational support. 

This is an opportunity to own a meaningful product area end to end, influence technical decisions beyond your immediate team, and raise the quality, reliability, and effectiveness of the systems and engineers around you. 

What You'll Accomplish

- Lead the architecture and end-to-end delivery of complex, cross-service Member Records initiatives-from discovery through production-bringing clarity to ambiguous requirements, dependencies, and trade-offs. 
 - Set and advance a multi-quarter technical direction for Member Records in partnership with engineering and product leadership. 
 - Establish durable technical patterns for APIs, domain models, integrations, testing, observability, and secure handling of member data. 
 - Mentor and support junior engineers, providing thoughtful code reviews and real-time pairing. 
 - Integrate and leverage AI technologies to automate processes and enhance product features. 
 - Raise the engineering bar through high-quality design and code reviews, pairing, mentoring, hiring participation, and coaching other engineers toward greater technical ownership. 
 - Strengthen operational ownership by defining meaningful health metrics, improving incident response, and addressing root causes rather than symptoms. 

Hinge Health Hybrid Model

We believe that remote work and in-person work have their own advantages and disadvantages, and we want to be able to leverage the best of both worlds. Employees in hybrid roles are required to be in the office 3 days/week. 

This is a Bengaluru-based role that involves regular interaction and collaboration with Hinge Health colleagues in San Francisco, CA. 

- Time zones: San Francisco is in the Pacific Time Zone, which is 12 hours and 30 minutes behind India Standard Time (e. g. , 8am in San Francisco is 8: 30pm in Bengaluru). 
 - Hours: Applicants should be open to meetings in the late evening following India Standard Time to align with San Francisco working hours (8am - 6pm PT). 

Basic Qualifications

- Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science or related technical degree
 - 9+ years of professional software engineering experience, with meaningful experience delivering production software. 
 - 3+ years hands-on experience with TypeScript and modern React application development. 
 - 3+years backend experience with Node. js, service development, API design, and integration patterns. 
 - 1+ years of experience in mentoring and leading junior team members, collaborating effectively with cross-functional teams, and contributing to project planning and decision-making
 - Experience with using AI tools such as Github copilot or Cursor

Preferred Qualifications

- Full stack engineer with strong experience to backend technology like NodeJS, RDBMS
 - Exposure to microservices, distributed systems, containerization, 
 - Experience taking ownership of features from technical design through launch and ongoing production support. 
 - Strong understanding of software engineering fundamentals, including testing, observability, performance, availability, and secure development practices. 
 - Ability to communicate technical decisions clearly to both technical and non-technical partners. 
 - A collaborative, product-minded approach and the ability to work effectively in a remote, cross-functional environment. 
 - Familiarity with AI-assisted software development or integrating AI capabilities into production workflows. 

About Hinge Health

At Hinge Health, we're using technology to scale and automate the delivery of healthcare, starting with musculoskeletal (MSK) conditions, which affect over 1. 7 billion people worldwide. Our AI-powered, human-centered care model spans MSK, pelvic health, gastrointestinal (GI) and migraine care. With over 60 partnerships with health plans, PBMs and other ecosystem partners, Hinge Health is available to over 25 million people across more than 2, 900 employers. The company is headquartered in San Francisco with additional offices in Montreal and Bangalore. Learn more at hingehealth. com. 

What You'll Love About Us

- Inclusive healthcare and benefits: In addition to comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage, we provide employees and their family members with Group Medical Coverage (GMC), Group Term Life Insurance (GTL), and Group Personal Accident Insurance (GPA). 
 - Well-being & Growth: We offer a lifestyle stipend to support your overall well-being, along with learning and development opportunities to help you grow both personally and professionally. 
 - Ownership: Grow with us through discounted company stock through our ESPP with easy payroll deductions. 

Culture & Engagement

Hinge Health is an equal opportunity employer and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any kind. We make employment decisions without regards to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, veteran status, disability status, pregnancy, or any other basis protected by federal, state or local law. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. We provide reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities. If you feel you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, let us know by reaching out to your recruiter. 

By submitting your application you are acknowledging we are using your personal data as outlined in the personnel and candidate privacy policy. 

Beware of Phishing Attempts: We've noticed an increase in phishing where fraudsters impersonate employees and send fake job offers to steal sensitive information. We'll never ask for financial details during the hiring process and only use "@hingehealth. com" emails. If you receive a suspicious offer, stop communication and report it to the US FBI Internet Crime Complaint Center. To verify an email from our recruiting team, forward it to security@hingehealth. com.

data.description:
The Role

As a Senior Software Tester, you ensure software is reliable and release-ready through manual and automated testing, defect identification, regression testing, and close collaboration with SDT. Your goal is simple: find problems before users do. 

What You Will Own - Your Responsibilities

- Test planning & execution - design and execute functional, integration, regression, and edge-case testing for new features and releases. 
 - Manual & exploratory testing - identify defects that automated tests may miss through structured and exploratory testing. 
 - Test automation - develop, maintain, and improve automated regression test cases and contribute to expanding automation coverage. 
 - Defect management - document defects clearly with severity, impact, evidence, and reproducible steps; track defects through closure. 
 - Release & regression validation - verify fixes and ensure new releases do not introduce regressions into existing functionality. 
 - SDT collaboration - work closely with developers to analyse root causes, clarify defects, validate fixes, and improve overall product quality. 

Non-Negotiable Metric

- DEFECTS CAUGHT BEFORE RELEASE
 - TARGET: ≥ 75%
 - At least 75% of identified defects must be caught during testing before production release, with strong regression coverage and accurate defect reporting maintained across assigned releases. 

The Fight: What You will Fight: 

- The bug that reaches production. 
 - Fight missed defects, weak test coverage, recurring issues, ineffective fixes, and release risks. Ensure every critical defect is properly fixed, validated, and prevented from returning. 

WHO THRIVES HERE : Three Traits We Cannot Teach

- You think beyond the test case - Find edge cases, risks, and unexpected failures. 
 - You own the defect - Follow through until the root cause is fixed and the solution is validated. 
 - You communicate with clarity and courage - Raise risks early, provide evidence, and challenge quality gaps. 

The Wws Perks

- Structured learning - Build skills in testing, automation, and MERN applications. 
 - Manual + automation exposure - Work across functional, API, regression, and automated testing. 
 - Engineering collaboration - Partner with SDT, WIT, and AIT throughout the product lifecycle. 
 - Ownership & growth - Grow in test strategy, automation, defect analysis, and leadership. 
 - Quality-first culture - Help build reliable software and protect the user experience. 

Qualifications

- Experience - 3 years of professional experience in software testing / QA, with hands-on experience across manual and automated testing. 
 - Technical skills - strong understanding of functional, integration, regression, API, and exploratory testing; experience with test automation frameworks and defect-tracking tools. 
 - Engineering knowledge - working knowledge of web applications, REST APIs, databases, Git, CI/CD concepts, and software development lifecycle. 
 - Preferred exposure - experience testing JavaScript/MERN-stack applications and familiarity with automation scripting.

We're the perfect balance of established company and start-up. You will find a unique home here. 

And you'll recognize the names of our clients. Most of them are on The Global 2000. They trust us to give them the latest in controls, audit and analytics software every day. Industry analysts consistently rank us as a top supplier management solution, and you'll be helping build that reputation. 

Read more about apexanalytix - https: //www. apexanalytix. com/about/

Job Details

The Role

apexanalytix is seeking an engineering executive to serve as VP of Engineering, based in the United States, reporting to the Chief Product & Technology Officer (CPTO) and sitting on the CPTO's leadership team. The role leads the engineering behind our two customer journeys, Supplier Journey and Buyer Journey. It is accountable for delivering them predictably, at high quality, and in a way that teams can own and run in production. 

We are moving to the product operating model. Product, engineering and design are organized into four persistent trios, each funded against outcome goals: Supplier Journey, Buyer Journey, Data & Intelligence, and Platform. The VP of Engineering leads the Supplier and Buyer engineering leads and the US engineering teams in those journeys. With both journeys in one engineering organization, the moments suppliers and buyers share (onboarding, validation and payment status) have a single engineering owner. 

Quick Take -

The VP of Engineering is the engineering partner to the VP of Product and the Head of Design in each trio, and works closely with the Head of AI & Data, who leads the Data & Intelligence trio, including the engineering for the data products we sell, machine learning, data science, data engineering and the agent platform. The role also works with the SVP Engineering & Head of India GCC, whose Noida engineers work in these trios; the Chief Architect; the VP Technology Operations; and the Head of GRC. Experience leading engineering for enterprise SaaS products in empowered, outcome-funded teams is required. 

Trusted Advisor

- Advises the CPTO and the executive team on engineering capacity, delivery risk, technical debt and the engineering investment needed to meet product and revenue goals. 
 - Brings an honest, data-backed view of feasibility to product discovery and investment decisions, so the company commits to what it can deliver well. 
 - Represents engineering to clients and partners on complex integrations, escalations and roadmap commitments, alongside Product and Go-to-Market leaders. 

The Work -

Engineering for the customer journeys

- Journey engineering. Leads the Supplier Journey and Buyer Journey engineering leads and their teams. Supplier Journey covers onboarding and validation (bank, tax, sanctions), the supplier portal and self-service, and inquiries and payment status. Buyer Journey covers supplier risk and compliance, invoice and payment controls, duplicate and fraud prevention, and Assurance & Recovery. 
 - Shared moments. Owns engineering for the moments suppliers and buyers share, so they work as one workflow seen from two sides, with clear lead and partner teams for each. 
 - Agents in the workflow. Makes sure journey teams build the agent experiences inside their workflows (such as onboarding, inquiry handling and duplicate-payment triage) on the shared building blocks from Data & Intelligence, to the same engineering and production standards as the rest of the product. 

Partnership with Data & Intelligence

- Shared building blocks. Works with the Head of AI & Data so journey teams use the shared data, scores, models and agent building blocks well, through clear, stable interfaces rather than one-off integrations. 
 - Workflow data. Makes sure journey workflows capture clean, well-defined data that Data & Intelligence can use to enrich data products and improve models. 
 - Consistent standards. Agrees with the Head of AI & Data how models and agents move into production in journey workflows, so they meet the same engineering, production and audit standards. 

Delivery and engineering excellence

- Empowered teams. Builds persistent engineering teams that own outcomes with their product and design partners, not tickets handed to them. Engineers join discovery early to test feasibility and shape solutions. 
 - Predictable delivery. Is accountable for predictable, high-quality delivery against the outcomes each trio commits to. Runs the engineering operating cadence with product and design and fixes delivery problems at the root. 
 - Quality and practices. Raises the bar on code quality, automated testing, CI/CD, observability and secure development. Tracks and improves DORA measures, defect escape rate and incident trends. Drives practical, measured adoption of AI-assisted development. 
 - Production ownership. Ensures teams own what they build in production, including on-call, incident response and root-cause follow-through, working with SRE in Technology Operations. 
 - Architecture and standards. Contributes to the global architecture council chaired by the Chief Architect and co-signs standards that affect the journey trios. Makes sure teams follow them and pay down technical debt deliberately. 

Leadership and management

- Organization. Leads engineering leads, managers and senior engineers across the Supplier Journey and Buyer Journey teams. Designs team boundaries around the trios and hires or promotes the leaders needed to run them. 
 - Global teams. Partners with the SVP Engineering & Head of India GCC so that Noida engineers in journey teams work as full members of those teams, with one set of standards and practices. 
 - Talent. Owns hiring, development, career paths and retention for US engineering, including a technical track to staff and principal engineer. 
 - Budget and reporting. Owns the engineering budget for these teams, including headcount, tooling and vendors. Gives the CPTO regular reporting on delivery, quality, reliability and team health, with each metric backed by data that can be re-run. 

First-Year Priorities

- Organize engineering into persistent teams aligned to the Supplier Journey and Buyer Journey, and appoint or hire the engineering leads to run them. 
 - Agree first-year outcome goals and engineering plans with product and design leaders for both journey trios. 
 - Agree with the Head of AI & Data how journey teams use shared data and agent building blocks, and ship at least one agent experience in a journey workflow to production standards. 
 - Assign a lead team for each supplier-buyer shared moment, and deliver at least one measurable improvement to a shared workflow. 
 - Set a baseline for delivery predictability, DORA measures, defect escape rate and production incidents, and show measurable improvement against it. 
 - Make sure every team owns its services in production, with on-call, runbooks and service-level objectives agreed with Technology Operations. 
 - Establish career ladders and a hiring plan for US engineering, including the technical track. 

Required Skills

- 15+ years in software engineering, including 7+ years leading engineering organizations of 50+ engineers through managers and directors in enterprise SaaS. 
 - A proven record of delivering complex B2B products predictably and at high quality, and of turning around delivery or quality problems. 
 - Experience building integration-heavy, data-intensive workflow products for enterprise clients at scale. 
 - Experience working in empowered product teams under the product operating model, as an equal partner to product and design in discovery and delivery. 
 - Strong technical depth in cloud-native SaaS architecture, distributed systems, integration and data-intensive platforms, sufficient to lead design reviews and make sound technical calls. 
 - Hands-on familiarity with modern engineering practices: CI/CD, automated testing, observability, DevSecOps and AI-assisted development. 
 - Experience bringing AI and agent capabilities into production workflows with appropriate guardrails and quality measures. 
 - A track record of hiring, developing and retaining strong engineering leaders and senior engineers. 
 - Experience leading distributed teams across US and India time zones. 
 - Experience operating in security- and compliance-regulated environments (for example SOC 1, SOC 2 and ISO 27001). 
 - Strong executive presence, able to represent engineering credibly to the CPTO, the executive team, clients and, as needed, the Board. 

Preferred Skills

- Domain experience in procure-to-pay, accounts payable, supplier management, payment fraud prevention, risk or fintech. 
 - Experience building integrations with ERP systems such as SAP, Oracle or Microsoft Dynamics. 
 - Experience in a PE-backed or high-growth SaaS company, connecting engineering investment to revenue and margin. 

Over the years, we've discovered that the most effective and successful associates at apexanalytix are people who have a specific combination of values, skills, and behaviors that we call "The apex Way". Read more about The apex Way - https: //www. apexanalytix. com/careers/

Benefits

At apexanalytix we know that our associates are the reason behind our successes. We truly value you as an associate and part of our professional family. Our goal is to offer the very best benefits possible to you and your loved ones. When it comes to benefits, whether for yourself or your family the most important aspect is choice. And we get that. apexanalytix offers competitive benefits for the countries that we serve, in addition to our BeWell@apex initiative that encourages employees' growth in six key wellness areas: Emotional, Physical, Community, Financial, Social, and Intelligence. 

With resources such as a strong Mentor Program, Internal Training Portal, plus Education, Tuition, and Certification Assistance, we provide tools for our associates to grow and develop.

10+ years of experience in wireless communication / PHY software development, integration, debugging, or system troubleshooting.

Good understanding of PHY architecture, algorithms, implementation, and interaction with other layers. 

Strong experience in PHY log analysis, debugging, issue isolation, and root-cause analysis, including the ability to identify non-obvious failure mechanisms.

Strong C/C++ programming and debugging skills, with good Python/scripting skills for automation and analysis.

Exposure to AI/LLM-based developer tools or coding assistants.

Experience with automation, log-processing, or internal debugging/analysis tools.

Experience across multiple RATs, particularly 2G, 4G, and 5G. 

Experience with O-RAN / Open RAN or advanced 5G PHY features. 

Experience with MATLAB or similar tools for PHY analysis, modeling, or simulation. 

Experience with Linux, Git, ARM, SIMD/NEON/AVX, or optimized DSP implementations.

The initial focus will be on understanding the existing PHY implementation, logs, failure patterns, and troubleshooting methodologies. data.title: Cloud Application Modernisation Architect (f/m/d)
data.description:
What do we do?

Introducing Thinkproject Platform

Pioneering a new era and offering a cohesive alternative to the fragmented landscape of construction software, Thinkproject seamlessly integrates the most extensive portfolio of mature solutions with an innovative platform, providing unparalleled features, integrations, user experiences, and synergies. 

By combining information management expertise and in-depth knowledge of the building, infrastructure, and energy industries, Thinkproject empowers customers to efficiently deliver, operate, regenerate, and dispose of their built assets across their entire lifecycle through a Connected Data Ecosystem. 

What your day will look like

About The Role

We are looking for two Cloud Application Modernisation & Agentic Architects (f/m/d) to own the end-to-end refactoring of Thinkproject's application portfolio - 10 applications, 3 of which are major, mission-critical products. You will work as a pair, splitting application ownership between you, and you are expected to move fast: full refactoring across the portfolio within 6-8 months. 

This is not a design-and-delegate role. You will roll up your sleeves, conduct the refactoring hands-on, and manage the project simultaneously. You are both the engineer and the project manager. You will consume the Service Catalog built by the Cloud Infrastructure & Agentic Architect and the networking foundation laid by the GCP & Network Agentic Architect - and turn them into modernised, cloud-native applications that are more reliable, more scalable, fully observable, and cheaper to run. 

Time allocation (approximate): 

~50% hands-on application refactoring & migration | ~25% project management, planning & stakeholder coordination | ~15% collaboration with DevOps, SecOps, Compliance & SRE | ~10% observability, testing & validation

Key Responsibilities

Application Refactoring & Modernisation

- Own the end-to-end refactoring of your assigned applications - from assessment and design through implementation and validation
 - Apply 12-factor app principles, event-driven architecture patterns, and cloud-native design to legacy codebases
 - Migrate workloads from on-prem and legacy infrastructure to GCP-native services: Cloud Run, GKE, serverless functions, managed databases, Pub/Sub
 - Design for scalability and on-demand resource consumption - cost efficiency is a success metric, not an afterthought
 - Use LLM-assisted tooling (Claude Code, OpenCode, or equivalent) to accelerate refactoring, code modernisation, and IaC generation

Project Management & Delivery

- Own the migration plan for your applications: timeline, milestones, dependencies, risks, and rollback strategy
 - Track and report progress with precision - this is a time-boxed programme (6-8 months); delays must be surfaced early
 - Split application ownership with your paired architect: clear DRI per application, shared standards

Resilience & Rollback

- Define and test rollback plans for every application before migration begins - you have crisis experience and you use it
 - Handle incidents during migration with calm, methodical rollback and root cause analysis
 - Ensure every migrated application meets reliability and observability standards before handover

Collaboration

- Work closely with DevOps to integrate migrated applications into CI/CD pipelines and automated deployment workflows
 - Collaborate with SecOps and Compliance to ensure every migrated application meets security controls and certification requirements
 - Engage SRE teams to validate observability, SLO definitions, and alerting coverage post-migration
 - Consume and provide feedback on the Service Catalog - you are one of its primary consumers

What you need to fulfill the role

Required Skills & Qualifications

You have migrated complex, production applications from on-prem to cloud at scale, under time pressure, and lived to tell the story. Specifically: 

- Proven on-prem to cloud migration experience - at scale, under tight time constraints; you have delivered migrations, not just designed them
 - Strong proficiency across both Azure and Google Cloud Platform - networking, infrastructure, and PaaS layers
 - Deep hands-on experience with Docker, VMs, GKE and AKS node management, and serverless design patterns (Cloud Run, Cloud Functions, Azure Functions)
 - Strong 12-factor app knowledge - you apply it in code, not just reference it in presentations
 - Strong event-driven architecture experience - Pub/Sub, event streaming, async decoupling patterns
 - Crisis and rollback experience - you have handled production incidents during migrations, executed rollbacks cleanly, and conducted honest post-mortems
 - Proven focus on scalability and on-demand resource design - your migrations reduce cost, not just shift it
 - Proven hands-on agentic experience: must have used Claude Code, OpenCode, or equivalent LLM-based coding agents in real engineering workflows
 - Comfortable operating in ambiguity - 10 applications, varying legacy states, evolving requirements; you create clarity

Nice-to-Have (Bonus Skills)

- Strong cloud networking experience (VPCs, firewall rules, private connectivity)
 - FinOps awareness - cost attribution and rightsizing post-migration
 - Experience with SecNumCloud or C5 compliance in a migration context
 - Prior experience as both engineer and delivery lead on the same programme

Soft Skills

- Extreme ownership - you own the outcome for your applications, not just the tasks
 - Strong project management discipline: you track details, surface blockers early, and never let a deadline slip silently
 - Collaborative by default - you pair well with your counterpart architect and with DevOps, SecOps, SRE, and Compliance
 - Crisis-calm: you have been in production incidents during migrations and know how to lead through them
 - Intense technical curiosity - you follow the market, test new tools, and bring relevant innovations into the refactoring programme
 - Fact-driven communicator: you report progress with data, not narrative

What Success Looks Like

- Month 2: Application portfolio assessed; ownership split agreed with paired architect; migration plan per application documented with milestones, dependencies, and rollback strategy
 - Month 4: First 4 applications refactored and in production (2 major + 2 add-on) - observable, scalable, cost-attributed
 - Month 6: 7-8 applications fully migrated; third major application on confirmed migration path or complete; observability standard adopted across migrated apps
 - Month 8: All 10 applications refactored and live on GCP; full observability in place; reliability and scalability improvements measured and reported; FinOps baseline established per application

Success is defined as: more reliability, more scalability, full observability, lower cost - across all 10 applications. 

You're probably NOT a fit if

- You have designed cloud migrations but have not personally executed them in production
 - You need a stable architecture foundation before you start - legacy migration means working with what exists
 - You are a specialist in one cloud (Azure or GCP) but not both
 - You treat project management as someone else's job
 - You have not handled a production rollback under pressure

What we offer

- Multicultural team across 7 countries (Germany, France, UK, UAE, Spain, New Zealand, Australia)
 - Hybrid-first working
 - Continuous learning & certification budget 
 - Open, inclusive, and high-ownership culture
 - Learning programmes | Career growth | Leadership access

At Thinkproject, we run feedback cycles that are honest and frequent. We believe the best engineering cultures are built on trust, transparency, and shared ownership - not hierarchy. Our Pune team is a core part of a global organisation, collaborating across time zones with colleagues in Germany, France, the UK, UAE, Spain, New Zealand, and Australia. Hybrid working | Work from abroad | Flexible working hours | Thinkproject Academy | Free English lessons | Unlimited learning | Headspace community access | Women's Network | Corporate volunteering | Social events

We are a passionate bunch here. To join Thinkproject is to shape what our company becomes. We take feedback from our staff very seriously and give them the tools they need to help us create our fantastic culture of mutual respect. We believe that investing in our staff is crucial to the success of our business. 

Your Contact

Mehal Mehta

How To Apply

Submit your application at careers. thinkproject. com, including: 

- Salary expectations
 - Potential start date
 - A short write-up (max 300 words) on the most complex on-prem to cloud migration you have delivered - what went wrong, how you handled it, and what the outcome was, this is the most important part of your application

We are looking for a candidate who is result driven, self-motivated, and innovative with experience in leading a team and with hands-on experience in product design, testing and validations. 

A Day In The Life

- Use product domain expertise across multiple projects. 
 - Assist global engineering teams with New Product Development (NPD), cost optimization/reduction (VA/VE), and Reverse Engineering for legacy parts. 
 - Create, develop, and evaluate new product design concepts following ANSI, IEC, IEEE, IP standards. 
 - Finalize results of design reviews and design decision meetings; prepare detailed reports. 
 - Manage Product Data Management (PDM) and Bill of Materials (BOM). 
 - Collaborate with Cross-Functional Teams (CFT) by providing technical support. 
 - Perform mechanical calculations for stress, strain, thermal analysis, load distribution, and tolerance verification. 
 - Conduct detailed Tolerance Stack Analysis (TSA) to ensure manufacturability, assembly feasibility, and functional reliability. 
 - Apply advanced reverse engineering techniques for legacy parts, including material analysis, dimensional inspection, and CAD model recreation for design improvements or cost optimization. 
 - Utilize additive manufacturing (3D printing) for rapid prototyping, concept validation, and fixture development; understand material properties, print parameters, and limitations of 3D printing technologies. 

What will help you thrive in this role?

Bachelor of engineering in Mechanical. 

Minimum 10 - 12 yrs. Product design and leading a team, with focus on Medium/High Voltage connectors, Tools and Accessories, will lead and participate in New Product Development for distribution, substation, transmission products, prototype development, testing and validation till product launch. 

Knowledge of Casting, plastic designs, 3D printing & prototype development. 

Should have working knowledge in Autodesk inventor & Solid works. 

Knowledge in Auto CAD, Mold flow simulation, FEA analysis, Injection molding and casting process

Strong Knowledge on PLM, GD&T & Tolerance stack up study

Must have experience and knowledge in testing and/or product development. 

Must have experience and knowledge in DFMA

Hubbell Incorporated

Hubbell creates critical infrastructure solutions that power our customers, communities, people and the planet. Our company is strategically aligned around enabling grid modernization and electrification. As more products plug in to an aging grid, Hubbell solutions enable the transition to a more reliable, resilient and efficient energy infrastructure. Founded in 1888 our innovation has made us a leading global manufacturer of high quality electrical and utility solutions enabling customers to operate critical infrastructure reliably and efficiently. 

The company operates in two segments. Hubbell Utility Solutions (HUS) enable the grid to conduct, communicate and control energy across utility applications and Hubbell Electrical Solutions (HES) are essential to managing power across a wide range of industries and applications. Our vertical market solutions can be applied to markets including Data Centers, Renewables, Commercial Buildings, Industrial, Telecom and Transportation. Supporting both of our business segments is our corporate and Hubbell Unified Business Solutions teams that provide consistent process, tools technologies across our businesses. 

We are committed to operating sustainably and ethically while promoting an inclusive and supportive culture for our people to grow and develop in their careers. Our employees proudly work and serve our communities from our headquarters in Shelton, CT, across the United States and around the globe.
