data.title: Sr Engineer CAD Pre-Silicon Front End
data.description:
Role Overview

Velaura is building custom silicon for Physical and Embodied AI, and we are building it

from a blank sheet. The automation our design and verification engineers use to get

from RTL to a clean handoff shapes how fast that silicon comes together. 

You will own the front end automation that carries our silicon from RTL entry to a clean

handoff into DFT and implementation. The scope covers RTL design flows, verification

flows from simulation through prototyping, and the AI assisted tooling built over them. 

Success is measured two ways. Front end engineers get more done, and the tools they

rely on stay up through every phase of the design cycle. 

Responsibilities

- Own the RTL design flows including build, lint, CDC and formal checks. 
 - Own register generation and the generator driven flows behind interfaces and integration. 
 - Own the DV flows including testbench build, regression execution and coverage collection. 
 - Own emulation and FPGA prototyping build and bring up. 
 - Build and deploy AI assisted tooling across design and verification workflows, working with CAD and Engineering Infrastructure on compute and model access. 
 - Keep these flows available through the design cycle, managing tool versions and turning around bug, upgrade and maintenance requests quickly. 
 - Measure and improve design and verification productivity, and move proven workflows into standard practice. 
 - Partner with DFT and physical design on handoff readiness, owning the DFT side flows that sit in the front end. 

Required Qualifications

- 8 or more years of experience in design verification, design or CAD engineering, including ownership of a flow area. 
 - Strong SystemVerilog and RTL fluency with the ability to read and debug design and testbench code. 
 - Hands on experience building and running simulation and regression flows including testbench compile, coverage collection and results triage. 
 - Excellent Python skills and a track record of building tools that other engineers maintain. 
 - Working knowledge of front end design and verification EDA tools from Synopsys, Cadence or Siemens EDA. 
 - Working knowledge of Linux administration, distributed compute such as LSF or Slurm, and the storage and scaling constraints behind large regression workloads. 
 - Familiarity with databases and dashboarding tools such as Grafana for tracking flow health and regression metrics. 
 - Track record of supporting a live engineering flow with responsive issue turnaround, and the communication skills to work closely with design and verification engineers. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience with UVM, cocotb or Python based verification environments. 
 - Hands on experience applying LLMs or agentic systems to engineering workflows. 
 - Experience taking an SoC from RTL bring up through tapeout. 
 - Experience with emulation and FPGA prototyping platforms such as Palladium, Protium, Veloce or HAPS. 
 - Experience with retrieval augmented generation, fine tuning or evaluation frameworks for code models. 
 - Experience at an early stage semiconductor company. 

Compensation & Benefits

At Velaura, we believe exceptional talent deserves exceptional rewards. Compensation for this role includes a base salary and very competitive equity compensation, allowing team members to share in the company's long-term success. 

The base pay listed represents a good faith estimate that the Company reasonably expects to pay for this position at the time of hire. Actual compensation will depend on multiple factors, including the candidate's skills, qualifications, relevant experience, and geographic location. 

In addition to base salary and equity compensation, Velaura offers a comprehensive benefits package that may include medical, dental, and vision coverage; paid time off; flexible work arrangements; professional development opportunities; and other benefits designed to support the well-being and growth of our team. 

Velaura is committed to pay equity and transparency and regularly benchmarks compensation to ensure we remain competitive in the market. 

Why Velaura?

Velaura is building next-generation compute technology for cloud, edge, and Physical AI. Our solutions will enable robots, autonomous systems, drones, and other intelligent machines to operate efficiently in the physical world. 

This is an opportunity to help build foundational technology at a time when the industry is undergoing fundamental change. You will work alongside experienced leaders, architects, engineers, and operators who have delivered industry-defining products across mobile, cloud, semiconductor, and AI platforms. If you enjoy solving difficult problems, working across disciplines, and helping shape the future of Physical AI, we would love to hear from you. 

Equal Employment Opportunity and Accommodations

Velaura is an Equal Opportunity Employer that is committed to inclusion and diversity. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status. We also take affirmative action to offer employment

opportunities to minorities, women, individuals with disabilities, and protected veterans. 

Velaura is committed to working with qualified individuals with physical or mental disabilities. Applicants who would like to contact us regarding the accessibility of our website or who need special assistance or a reasonable accommodation for any part of the application or hiring process may contact us at: [email protected] . This contact

data.title: Senior Principal Staff Software Engineer (Technical Architect)
data.description:
Organization OverviewCompany Description

Help us build the "System of Action" that supercharges global manufacturing teams. QAD is entering a high-velocity era to architect the world's first AI-native, agentic ERP. We are moving beyond legacy "systems of record" to build an autonomous platform where humans and AI work as a tag team to redefine how factories operate. Join us at this pivotal moment to build our next generation platform, lead the next generation of the Adaptive Enterprise and turn global speed into strategy. 

Job Description

Ignite Your Future: Strategic Leadership

Are you a distinguished technical leader ready to own the cross-stack architectural vision for an intelligent, adaptive SaaS platform? Sitting directly above our Senior Staff Engineering roles, you will serve as the chief technical authority for our full stack systems. At QAD, we are redefining the supply chain through a single System of Action that connects people, processes, and data. As a Full Stack Technical Architect, you will bridge high-level strategy with hands-on execution-driving architecture across frontend, backend, microservices, and cloud infrastructure while setting technical standards across engineering teams. 

The Mission: Defining the Platform's Future

You Will Be The Executive Driver In Setting The Technical North Star For The Platform, Translating The Company's Business Strategy Into a Multi-year Engineering Roadmap, And Ensuring Architectural Alignment Across All Product Pillars. You Will Lead And MentorPrincipal-level Engineers, Leverage Executive-level Expertise In Highly Specialized Fields To Innovate At Scale, And Govern The Development Standards For Cloud-native Architectures, Microservices, And Agile Product Development Across All Teams. You Will Be Instrumental In Ensuring The Platform Delivers On Its Core Pillars

- Adaptive Applications: The intelligent backbone powering the manufacturing enterprise. 
 - Champion AI: Agentic AI for manufacturing that drives measurable productivity and growth. 

Your Impact/ What You Will Be Doing

- End-to-End System Architecture: Define, govern, and execute the multi-year technical vision and architectural roadmap across the complete application lifecycle-from modern frontends to resilient backend microservices. 
 - Full Stack Standards & Governance: Establish and enforce enterprise-wide design patterns, API contracts, micro-frontend/microservices blueprints, and code governance standards. 
 - Hands-on Technical Leadership: Conduct deep design reviews, author architectural decision records (ADRs), resolve systemic performance bottlenecks, and write critical reference code. 
 - Next-Gen AI & Platform Integration: Architect robust full stack frameworks that support Adaptive Applications and Agentic AI workflows embedded directly into user-facing enterprise applications. 
 - Cross-Functional & Strategic Alignment: Collaborate with Product Leadership, Engineering Directors, DevOps/SRE, and Senior Staff Engineers to translate complex business objectives into scalable architectures. 
 - Technical Mentorship & Elevation: Mentor Senior Staff, Principal, and Lead Engineers, setting the technical bar and driving engineering excellence across multiple feature pods. 

Core Technical Foundations / What We Are Looking For

- Frontend Architecture: Advanced mastery of modern web frameworks (React, Angular, or Vue. js), micro-frontends, design systems, state management, and web performance optimization. 
 - Backend & Microservices: Deep architectural expertise in distributed systems, REST/GraphQL APIs, event-driven designs, and runtimes like Java, Node. js, Python, or Go. 
 - Data & Cloud Infrastructure: Extensive experience with relational & NoSQL databases, message brokers (Kafka/RabbitMQ), and cloud-native architecture (AWS/GCP/Azure). 
 - Core Engineering & Governance: Foundational expertise in Data Structures, System Design, Security (OAuth/OIDC), CI/CD automation, and high-availability design

The Mindset

- Strategic Visionary: Strong conceptual and strategic thinking to understand the most advanced issues and implications, applying this knowledge to define and execute the future direction of the platform. Exercises independent executive judgment in setting organization-wide methods and evaluation criteria. 
 - Organizational Leader: Demonstrates end-to-end responsibility for the architectural and organizational health of the entire function. Capable of driving complex, multi-year solutions and influencing critical company-wide technology choices. 
 - Adaptability & Innovation: Eagerness to rapidly assess and strategically adopt cutting-edge technologies that create a competitive advantage. 
 - Proactive Executive: Takes initiative to anticipate future organizational, technical, and business needs, risks, or improvements without explicit direction, establishing new executive standards where necessary. 

Qualifications

Qualifications & Next Steps

- Education: Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical discipline. 
 - Experience: 14+ years of hands-on software development experience, including 5+ years acting as a Technical Architect or System Architect overseeing multi-team systems. 
 - Location: On-site technical leadership role based in Pune (3-4 days in-office per week). 

Additional Information

Why QAD?

data.title: Quality Head
data.description:
ONLY FOR PEOPLE FROM TEXTILE BACKGROUND & TEXTILE WORK EXPERIENCE

Company:   Diamond Exports

Location:   Agra, Uttar Pradesh

Industry:   Textiles, Home Textiles & Rugs

Department:   Quality Assurance & Quality Control

Position:   Head of Quality

Experience:   10-15+ Years (Textile Industry)

Job OverviewDiamond Exports is seeking an experienced and highly competent  Head of Quality Assurance & Quality Systems  with extensive experience in the textile manufacturing and export industry. 

The ideal candidate should have direct experience handling international buyers such as  IKEA, Walmart, and other leading global retailers, with a comprehensive understanding of their quality requirements, factory evaluation standards, and audit expectations. 

The primary responsibility of this position is to develop, implement, standardize, and continuously improve a robust, process-driven Quality Management System (QMS) across the organization. 

We are looking for a professional who can build sustainable quality systems, strengthen process controls, establish accountability, and create a culture of preventive quality management rather than relying solely on final product inspections. 

Key Responsibilities1. Quality Management System Development (Primary Responsibility)

- Design, develop, and implement a comprehensive factory-wide Quality Management System. 
 - Establish standardized SOPs, quality manuals, process controls, work instructions, and inspection procedures across departments. 
 - Develop systematic quality checkpoints from raw material procurement through manufacturing, finishing, packing, and dispatch. 
 - Establish clear quality responsibilities, accountability structures, and reporting mechanisms. 
 - Implement effective documentation, record-keeping, traceability, and process-monitoring systems. 
 - Establish preventive quality systems to identify and eliminate potential defects before they occur. 
 - Conduct regular system effectiveness reviews and drive continuous improvements. 

2. Buyer Standards & Factory Compliance

- Ensure adherence to quality requirements of international buyers, particularly IKEA and Walmart. 
 - Possess thorough knowledge of  FCCA (Factory Capability & Capacity Assessment)  and factory audit preparation. 
 - Develop and maintain systems that ensure continuous audit readiness. 
 - Coordinate buyer quality audits, internal audits, external inspections, and corrective action plans. 
 - Translate buyer-specific requirements into practical factory-level operating procedures. 
 - Ensure appropriate implementation of buyer quality protocols throughout production. 

3. Quality Tools & Process Improvement

- Demonstrate practical experience with internationally recognized quality management tools, including: 
 - Root Cause Analysis (RCA)
 - Corrective and Preventive Actions (CAPA)
 - 5 Why Analysis and Fishbone Diagrams
 - Pareto Analysis and Statistical Process Control (SPC)
 - Failure Mode and Effects Analysis (FMEA)
 - AQL Inspection Standards
 - Risk Assessment and Process Audits
 - PDCA and Continuous Improvement
 - Develop systems for defect analysis, quality trend monitoring, and prevention of recurring nonconformities. 
 - Implement measurable quality KPIs and department-wise performance monitoring. 

4. Sharp Tools & Product Safety Management

- Develop and maintain a comprehensive  Sharp Tools Management System  in accordance with international buyer requirements. 
 - Establish procedures for sharp tool issuance, identification, tracking, reconciliation, and control. 
 - Implement broken needle and sharp object control procedures wherever applicable. 
 - Establish effective lost-tool reporting, incident investigation, and corrective action procedures. 
 - Conduct periodic internal audits to ensure strict compliance with product safety protocols. 
 - Ensure staff training and accountability for all sharp-tool-related procedures. 

5. Manufacturing Quality Control

- Establish and monitor quality standards for raw materials, yarn, dyeing, weaving, finishing, and packing. 
 - Define incoming, in-process, and final inspection procedures. 
 - Develop standardized defect classification, inspection checklists, and acceptance criteria. 
 - Identify recurring manufacturing defects and implement permanent process improvements. 
 - Coordinate closely with production departments to reduce rework, rejection, and customer complaints. 
 - Strengthen first-time-right manufacturing practices. 

6. Internal Audits, Documentation & Traceability

- Develop a structured internal quality audit calendar. 
 - Implement effective audit documentation, compliance tracking, and corrective action verification. 
 - Establish material, production, inspection, and finished-product traceability systems. 
 - Ensure all quality records are accurate, accessible, and maintained in accordance with buyer requirements. 
 - Conduct periodic management reviews of quality performance and system effectiveness. 

7. Team Development & Quality Culture

- Lead, mentor, and develop the QA and QC teams. 
 - Define responsibilities, competency requirements, and performance expectations for quality personnel. 
 - Conduct regular training on SOPs, quality tools, buyer requirements, and product safety. 
 - Work with production and departmental heads to establish a culture of quality ownership. 
 - Drive continuous improvement through structured training, audits, and performance reviews. 

Required Qualifications & Experience
 - Bachelor's degree in Textile Technology, Textile Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Quality Management, or a related discipline. 
 - Minimum 10-15 years of relevant experience in textile manufacturing, home textiles, rugs, or export-oriented manufacturing. 
 - Proven experience managing quality systems for international buyers such as  IKEA and Walmart. 
 - Strong working knowledge of FCCA assessments, buyer audits, and factory quality requirements. 
 - Hands-on experience developing and implementing complete Quality Management Systems. 
 - Thorough understanding of sharp tools management, product safety controls, CAPA, risk assessment, and audit documentation. 
 - Practical knowledge of ISO 9001 principles and internationally recognized quality tools. 
 - Strong analytical, problem-solving, leadership, and cross-functional coordination skills. 
 - Excellent documentation, reporting, and communication capabilities. 

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)Performance will be evaluated primarily on: 

- Successful development and implementation of a comprehensive, sustainable Quality Management System. 
 - Standardization and effective implementation of SOPs across departments. 
 - Continuous readiness and successful completion of buyer quality audits, including FCCA where applicable. 
 - Reduction in internal defects, rework, rejection, and buyer complaints. 
 - Effectiveness of CAPA, preventive controls, and root cause elimination. 
 - Compliance with sharp tools management and product safety requirements. 
 - Improvement in process discipline, documentation, and manufacturing traceability. 
 - Development of a competent and accountable quality team. 

Ideal Candidate ProfileWe are specifically seeking a  system-oriented quality leader, not merely an inspection-oriented quality manager. 

The ideal candidate must be capable of independently assessing existing factory operations, identifying systemic weaknesses, building practical procedures, implementing strong preventive controls, and ensuring their consistent execution. 

The candidate should demonstrate the ability to transform quality management from a reactive, inspection-dependent function into a  structured, measurable, preventive, and continuously improving system  aligned with the expectations of leading international retailers. 

The ultimate objective is to establish a quality system that functions consistently at every stage of manufacturing, with minimum dependence on individual supervision and maximum process accountability.

We are seeking a highly skilled and motivated Software Engineer specializing in C++ and Adaptive AUTOSAR to join our ADAS development team. 

In this role, you will be responsible for designing and implementing the Vehicle Abstraction Layer (VAL). 

Your primary goal will be to decouple highlevel ADAS perception and planning algorithms from the underlying vehicle hardware and communication protocols, ensuring seamless integration, scalability, and safetycritical performance. 

Key Responsibilities Architect & Develop VAL Design and develop robust Vehicle Abstraction Layers that provide a standardized interface for ADAS applications to interact with vehicle actuators (steering, braking, acceleration) and sensors. 

Adaptive AUTOSAR Implementation Develop and integrate software components within an Adaptive AUTOSAR framework, focusing on ServiceOriented Architecture (SOA) and SOMEIP communication. 

C++ Software Engineering Write highperformance, memoryefficient, and MISRAcompliant C++ code (C++141720) optimized for embedded automotive platforms. Communication Protocols Implement and manage data exchange between highlevel ADAS controllers and lowlevel ECUs using protocols such as SOMEIP, DoIP, CANCANFD, and Ethernet. 

Hardware Abstraction Develop drivers and abstraction logic to hide hardware complexity, enabling easier porting of ADAS software across different vehicle platforms. 

Safety & Standards Ensure all software development adheres to functional safety standards (ISO 26262) and automotive coding guidelines (MISRA C++, AUTOSAR). 

Testing & Validation Perform unit testing, integration testing, and HardwareintheLoop (HiL) testing to validate the reliability and timing constraints of the VAL. 

Collaboration Work closely with Perception, Planning, and Control teams, as well as Hardware engineers, to define interface requirements and system specifications. 

Required Technical Skills Programming Advanced proficiency in C++ (C++ 11C++14C++17 preffered) and understanding of lowlevel memory management and concurrency.

data.title: Head of AI Engineering & Center of Excellence (CoE)
data.description:
JOB DESCRIPTION

Head of AI Engineering

& Center of Excellence (CoE)

1. Role Overview

Our company is seeking a senior technology leader to establish and lead its AI Engineering Center of Excellence (CoE), driving the adoption of AI across enterprise engineering, insurance technology platforms, product development, and operational workflows. 

The Head of AI Engineering & CoE will define AI engineering strategy, establish reusable AI architectures and frameworks, enable AI-assisted software development, and deliver scalable, secure, measurable AI solutions. The role combines technical leadership, architecture governance, engineering enablement, and people development. 

A core objective is to turn individual AI experiments and isolated implementations into reusable enterprise capabilities that support Solartis's product-platform strategy. 

1. Key Responsibilities

A. AI Engineering Strategy and CoE Leadership

Establish the CoE charter, operating model, service offerings, engagement model, and delivery priorities. 

Develop an AI engineering roadmap aligned with product strategy, technology priorities, and business objectives. 

Identify opportunities to standardize AI capabilities and reduce duplicated implementations. 

Define reference architectures, reusable patterns, implementation guidelines, and approved technology frameworks. 

Partner with the CTO and engineering leadership to prioritize AI investments based on business value, feasibility, risk, and expected return. 

Establish processes to evaluate AI initiatives, productionize successful pilots, and retire ineffective or duplicated solutions. 

B. Enterprise AI Architecture and Shared Frameworks

Define scalable architectures for LLMs, SLMs, RAG, vector search, orchestration, and model integration. 

Design reusable AI services, APIs, SDKs, libraries, reference implementations, and deployment patterns. 

Establish patterns for model selection, prompt management, context engineering, embeddings, document processing, inference, and lifecycle management. 

Evaluate AI frameworks, models, infrastructure, and platforms for performance, cost, security, scalability, and maintainability. 

Define integration patterns for AI capabilities within existing platforms, services, applications, and development workflows. 

Guide build-versus-buy decisions across managed AI services, open-source models, and internally developed capabilities. 

C. AI-Assisted Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC)

Define and implement AI-assisted SDLC practices across requirements analysis, code generation, code understanding, test generation, code review, documentation, debugging, and maintenance. 

Establish standards for responsible use of AI coding assistants and developer productivity tools. 

Build reusable workflows and accelerators integrated with development environments, repositories, CI/CD pipelines, and quality processes. 

Measure impact on cycle time, defect rates, rework, code quality, and developer experience. 

Ensure AI adoption complements peer review, automated testing, security scanning, and release governance. 

Work with engineering leaders to drive adoption and develop team-level enablement plans. 

D. RAG, MCP, Agentic AI, and Reusable AI Services

Architect production-grade RAG solutions covering ingestion, parsing, chunking, metadata extraction, indexing, retrieval, reranking, and grounded generation. 

Establish reusable patterns for agents, tool orchestration, workflow automation, context management, and human-in-the-loop processing. 

Define appropriate Model Context Protocol (MCP) patterns for controlled access to enterprise tools, data, and services. 

Develop common components for model access, prompt/context management, retrieval, tool integration, evaluation, telemetry, and error handling. 

Define safeguards for permissions, data access, execution boundaries, auditability, failure recovery, and human approval. 

Apply agentic AI selectively where it delivers measurable value and avoid unnecessary complexity in deterministic workflows. 

E. AI-Assisted Insurance Content Processing and Parser Initiatives

Lead architecture for processing insurance documents, policy forms, underwriting guidelines, rating manuals, and related content. 

Guide pipelines that transform semi-structured and unstructured content into validated, structured insurance product definitions. 

Establish reusable capabilities for classification, parsing, extraction, semantic interpretation, rule identification, and structured output generation. 

Ensure extracted content is traceable to source documents and suitable for downstream product configuration and processing. 

Design human review and exception handling for ambiguous, incomplete, conflicting, or low-confidence outputs. 

Define evaluation datasets and measures for extraction precision/recall, completeness, rule interpretation, and downstream usability. 

Promote reusable parsers and validation components over isolated customer-specific implementations, in collaboration with insurance domain and platform teams. 

F. AI Engineering Standards, Quality, and Governance

Define standards for AI design, implementation, testing, deployment, monitoring, and maintenance. 

Establish evaluation frameworks for accuracy, groundedness, robustness, reliability, latency, cost, and use-case suitability. 

Implement safeguards against prompt injection, unauthorized data exposure, insecure tool execution, and other AI-specific threats. 

Define model and prompt versioning, traceability, observability, regression evaluation, and controlled production releases. 

Establish practices for sensitive data handling, access control, retention, audit logging, and external AI services. 

Partner with security, compliance, legal, and enterprise architecture stakeholders on applicable requirements. 

Ensure solutions have appropriate fallbacks, exception handling, human oversight, and production-readiness reviews. 

G. Technical Leadership, Mentoring, and Enablement

Provide technical leadership to AI architects and designated AI engineering teams, with accountability for architecture quality and capability development. 

Mentor existing architects in AI solution design, reusable architecture, model integration, evaluation, and production engineering. 

Establish architecture reviews, technical communities of practice, learning paths, workshops, and hands-on reference projects. 

Guide teams in evaluating alternatives, challenging assumptions, conducting impact analysis, and making sound technical decisions. 

Develop architecture decision records, implementation templates, reusable documentation, and engineering playbooks. 

Build internal capability so teams can implement AI solutions independently within agreed standards. 

H. Business Value, Delivery, and Continuous Improvement

Translate opportunities into prioritized initiatives with defined outcomes, milestones, resource needs, and success measures. 

Partner with product, engineering, and business teams to improve developer productivity, reduce manual effort, accelerate content processing, and strengthen platform scalability. 

Maintain visibility into AI initiative status, adoption, risks, operating costs, and realized benefits. 

Track production outcomes beyond proof-of-concept delivery and optimize duplicated capabilities, infrastructure, and model costs. 

Communicate progress, risks, decisions, and measurable outcomes to the CTO and senior leadership. 

3. Leadership and Decision-Making Expectations

Establish and execute the AI engineering roadmap within priorities agreed with the CTO. 

Own the technical direction and engineering standards of the AI CoE. 

Lead and develop AI architects and designated AI engineering resources. 

Make decisions within agreed enterprise architecture principles and delegated authority; escalate material cross-platform, security, and investment decisions as required. 

Challenge designs that introduce unnecessary customization, duplication, operational complexity, or technical risk. 

Balance innovation with engineering discipline, production readiness, maintainability, and measurable business outcomes. 

Influence teams beyond the direct reporting line and enable adoption across the organization. 

4. Required Qualifications and Experience

Bachelor's or master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, AI, Data Science, or a related discipline. 

Typically 15+ years of relevant software engineering, architecture, or technology experience, including substantial practical experience with AI/ML and modern AI application architectures. 

Demonstrated experience leading AI engineering initiatives, architecture practices, technical teams, or enterprise AI programs. 

Strong practical knowledge of LLM applications, RAG, embeddings, vector databases, prompt engineering, and model evaluation. 

Experience designing production-grade AI services, APIs, orchestration workflows, and reusable frameworks. 

Practical understanding of agentic AI, tool integration, workflow orchestration, and MCP where relevant. 

Experience with Python, APIs, distributed systems, CI/CD, automated testing, and cloud-based application deployment. 

Experience evaluating AI models and frameworks for quality, latency, cost, security, and operational complexity. 

Knowledge of AI application security, data protection, observability, model lifecycle management, and responsible AI practices. 

Demonstrated ability to mentor architects and engineers, influence technical direction, and establish standards across teams. 

Strong communication skills, including the ability to explain technical decisions to executives, business stakeholders, and engineering teams. 

5. Preferred Qualifications

Experience establishing an enterprise AI Engineering CoE or equivalent AI enablement function. 

Experience with comparable enterprise AI platforms and cloud-native AI services. 

Experience integrating AI-assisted software development tools into engineering workflows. 

Experience in insurance technology, policy administration, rating, product configuration, or document-intensive enterprise platforms. 

Experience with intelligent document processing, information extraction, rules extraction, or structured-content generation. 

Experience with enterprise knowledge systems, metadata-driven architectures, and reusable platform services. 

Familiarity with AI governance frameworks, evaluation methodologies, and production risk management. 

6. Leadership Profile

The ideal candidate combines deep technical credibility with the ability to establish a sustainable engineering practice. They can move between architecture design, hands-on problem solving, technical mentoring, organizational enablement, and executive communication. 

The candidate should build systems and teams that scale, establish standards without unnecessary bureaucracy, and translate emerging AI technologies into practical business capabilities. 

Ultimate expectation: Establish an AI Engineering CoE that strengthens Solartis's product-platform strategy, improves engineering effectiveness, accelerates AI adoption, and builds long-term organizational capability.

Role Overview

We are seeking an experienced and visionary Senior Lead Python AI/ML Engineer with Generative AI Capabilities to lead the design, development, and deployment of next-generation artificial intelligence and machine learning solutions based out of our Chennai center (operating in a Hybrid work model). With 10 to 12 years of hands-on software and machine learning engineering experience, the ideal candidate will drive the convergence of traditional predictive ML models and modern Foundation Model / GenAI architectures. 

In this role, you will be instrumental in building high-scale, low-latency AI solutions applied to Fraud Mitigation, Risk Scoring, and Loss Prevention across US Retail Banking products

- Key Responsibilities

AI/ML & Generative AI Architecture

- Architect, build, and deploy production-grade Generative AI systems, including Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), autonomous agents, semantic search pipelines, and multi-modal AI workflows. 
 - Integrate state-of-the-art Large Language Models (LLMs)-including Google Gemini, Anthropic Claude, and open-source models (Llama, Mistral)-optimizing for latency, cost, and accuracy. 
 - Build domain-specific prompt engineering frameworks, fine-tuning pipelines (LoRA/QLoRA), model evaluation benchmarks, and guardrails to minimize hallucinations and bias. 
 - Lead the architecture of predictive ML algorithms (anomaly detection, graph neural networks, supervised/unsupervised classifiers) tailored to real-time risk assessment. 

Software Engineering & System Scalability

- Design resilient, low-latency, and horizontally scalable microservices and APIs in Python (FastAPI, Flask, AsyncIO) handling high-throughput transactional traffic. 
 - Integrate vector databases (e. g. , Pinecone, Milvus, Qdrant, Chroma, pgvector) with distributed caching and event streaming platforms (Kafka, RabbitMQ).

Fraud Analytics & Domain Innovation

- Collaborate closely with US-based and global Risk, Compliance, and Loss Prevention teams to build AI solutions targeting identity theft, account takeover (ATO), synthetic identity fraud, card-not-present (CNP) fraud, and transaction anomaly detection. 
 - Utilize unstructured data (investigator notes, SAR filings, customer interaction logs) via GenAI to automate fraud triage and investigative summarization. 
 - Ensure strict adherence to US Banking regulatory standards (FCRA, GLBA, Model Risk Management SR 11-7, Fair Lending, Explainable AI / XAI). 

Technical Leadership & Mentorship

 - Google Gemini & Anthropic Claude: Hands-on experience with API integration, function calling/tools, context caching, and prompt optimization specifically for Google Gemini (Pro/Flash) and Anthropic Claude (Opus/Sonnet/Haiku).

data.description:
About HeyMarvin

HeyMarvin is one of the fastest-growing research platforms in the galaxy. Some of the largest companies (such as Microsoft, Best Buy, LinkedIn, Sonos, and 7-11) use HeyMarvin as their secret weapon for building customer-centric solutions. 

Funded by notable investors like OpenAI CEO Sam Altman and first PayPal board member Scott Banister, HeyMarvin is an AI-native research system that integrates all your customer feedback and research into one central, searchable hub - so anyone can get the answers they need, when they need them. 

We are headquartered in Oakland, CA, with more than 100 passionate employees across three countries. We're united by our mission: To build a future where every strategic business decision is grounded in the voice of the customer. 

For more info, visit www. heymarvin. com. 

About The Role

We are looking for an experienced Backend Engineer to join a fast-growing, well-funded Silicon Valley-based startup. This role offers a high level of ownership, autonomy, and the opportunity to work in a collaborative, high-performance environment with competitive compensation. 

Key Responsibilities

- Design, develop and deploy backend services with a focus on high availability, low latency and scalability
 - 
 - Architect Distributed Systems: Design and implement robust microservices using Golang and Django that can handle concurrent processing of high-volume research data (e. g. , video, audio, and large-scale text datasets). 
 - Optimize AI Workflows: Build and refine asynchronous task queues (using tools like Celery or Redis) to manage long-running AI inference tasks without impacting the responsiveness of the user-facing API. 
 - Database Performance: Design and maintain efficient schemas for both relational databases (PostgreSQL) and specialized storage (Vector databases for AI search), ensuring millisecond-level query performance as data scales into the millions of records. 
 - Load Management: Implement caching strategies and rate-limiting to protect service integrity during traffic spikes from global enterprise customers. 
 - Build and operate infrastructure, toolset and deployment pipelines
 - 
 - Infrastructure as Code (IaC): Own and automate the provisioning of cloud resources on AWS (using Terraform or CloudFormation) to ensure environments are reproducible and scalable. 
 - CI/CD Optimization: Streamline the path from "code commit" to "production" by building automated testing and deployment pipelines that allow the team to ship multiple times a day with high confidence. 
 - Observability & Monitoring: Implement comprehensive logging, tracing, and alerting (e. g. , Prometheus, Grafana, or Datadog) to proactively identify performance bottlenecks and system health issues before they affect users. 
 - Developer Experience: Create internal CLI tools or scripts to simplify the local development environment and improve the velocity of the entire engineering team. 
 - Collaborate with other engineers to create beautiful products
 - 
 - API Stewardship: Design clean, well-documented, and intuitive RESTful or GraphQL APIs that enable frontend teams to build seamless and high-performance user interfaces. 
 - Full-Stack Synergy: Work closely with product designers and frontend engineers to understand the "Jobs to be Done, " ensuring that backend logic perfectly supports complex research workflows. 
 - Technical Mentorship: Participate in rigorous code reviews and architectural whiteboarding sessions, fostering a culture of high-quality code and continuous learning. 
 - Rapid Prototyping: Transition quickly from experimental AI features to production-ready services, balancing speed-to-market with long-term code maintainability. 
 - Handling and owning security and compliance aspects for the software that the team produces. 
 - 
 - Enterprise-Grade Compliance: Build and enforce the technical controls necessary to maintain SOC2, GDPR, or HIPAA compliance, ensuring customer data is treated with the highest level of privacy. 
 - Data Isolation: Implement strict multi-tenant architecture patterns to ensure that sensitive research insights from one organization (e. g. , Microsoft) are never accessible or leaked to another (e. g. , 7-11). 
 - Proactive Security: Conduct regular vulnerability scanning, dependency audits, and security reviews of the codebase to defend against OWASP Top 10 threats. 
 - IAM & Encryption: Manage complex Identity and Access Management (IAM) roles and ensure all sensitive data is encrypted both at rest and in transit. 
Qualifications

- 4-6 years of experience in backend engineering
 - Strong skills in: 
 - 
 - Python (Django)
 - Golang
 - Problem-solving and debugging
 - API development and database management
Good To Have

- Familiarity with DevOps practices (Docker, AWS, CI/CD)
 - Experience building scalable and distributed systems
 - Strong ownership mindset with the ability to work independently
 - Practical, solution-oriented thinker comfortable in fast-paced, low-process environments

Why Join Us?

Joining HeyMarvin as a Senior Software Engineer means being part of a high-growth, transparent, and empowering environment where your work has direct impact. You'll collaborate with talented teammates, work with modern technologies, and help build a world-class product at the intersection of AI, research, and enterprise software-while having the autonomy to shape both your role and the company's future. 

About The Team

You'll be joining a lean, high-performing team that values ownership, speed, and thoughtful execution. The team operates with minimal bureaucracy and emphasizes collaboration, continuous learning, and delivering meaningful outcomes. 

Compensation

₹30LPA, plus benefits.

Job Summary

App Development is responsible for designing, building, testing and maintaining secure, scalable and high-performing software solutions that support business, client and operational outcomes. The discipline translates business and technical requirements into reliable applications, services, interfaces and digital capabilities that can be safely operated, enhanced and scaled over time. 

Operating across software engineering, API development, database integration, testing, secure coding, DevOps and production support, App Development plays a critical role in delivering technology that is maintainable, resilient and aligned to enterprise standards. The discipline requires strong programming capability, sound engineering judgement, collaboration across technology and business teams, and the ability to balance speed of delivery with quality, security, reliability and long-term sustainability. 

Key Responsibilities

Solution Design & Application Development

- Design and build software applications, interfaces, APIs and services that meet business requirements while remaining secure, scalable, maintainable and performant. 
 - Translate functional and technical requirements into practical engineering solutions, selecting appropriate patterns, technologies and implementation approaches based on system context and delivery needs. 
 - Develop and maintain application components across relevant technology stacks, which may include web, mobile, backend, integration, database or platform-specific environments. 
 - Apply appropriate programming languages, frameworks and tools - such as Java, JavaScript, Python, Go, Kotlin, React, Angular, Android, HTML/CSS or equivalent technologies - where relevant to the application domain and platform context. 

Code Quality, Testing & Engineering Standards

- Write and maintain clean, readable, reusable and well-structured code that supports long-term maintainability and reduces avoidable technical debt. 
 - Conduct and participate in code reviews to improve quality, consistency, security and adherence to engineering standards. 
 - Develop and apply automated testing approaches, including unit, integration, API and regression testing, to strengthen delivery confidence and reduce defects. 
 - Improve engineering practices by applying standards for version control, branching, documentation, peer review, test coverage and maintainable design. 

Secure Development & Technology Risk

- Implement secure coding practices to protect applications, data and customers from security vulnerabilities and technology risks. 
 - Apply security fundamentals across application design and development, including authentication, authorisation, input validation, secrets management and secure API design where relevant. 
 - Identify and remediate common application security issues, including web, mobile, API and data-related vulnerabilities. 
 - Ensure development activities align with internal technology controls, software delivery standards and applicable governance requirements. 

API, Integration & Data Engineering

- Design and develop APIs, integration points and service interfaces that enable reliable data exchange between systems, platforms and digital channels. 
 - Develop and optimise database structures, queries and data access patterns to support performance, scalability and reliability. 
 - Apply database development and management practices across relevant database technologies, such as relational databases, MySQL or equivalent platforms, depending on application needs. 
 - Support distributed system design by considering service boundaries, transaction handling, latency, resilience and dependency management. 

DevOps, Deployment & Release Readiness

- Support application deployment through CI/CD practices, automated build pipelines, version control and controlled release processes. 
 - Collaborate with release, infrastructure and operations teams to ensure applications are deployment-ready and aligned to environment, configuration and operational requirements. 
 - Use DevOps practices, containerisation or orchestration technologies - such as Docker, Kubernetes or equivalent platforms - where relevant to improve delivery consistency and application portability. 
 - Prepare applications for production by ensuring appropriate configuration, documentation, operational handover and release readiness activities are completed. 

Application Performance, Reliability & Supportability

- Monitor and analyse application performance, errors, logs and operational metrics to identify reliability, scalability or user experience issues. 
 - Troubleshoot and resolve technical issues across application code, APIs, databases, integrations, infrastructure dependencies or runtime environments. 
 - Design and improve applications with supportability in mind, including observability, logging, error handling, recovery behaviour and operational diagnostics. 
 - Strengthen application resilience by identifying failure points, reducing recurring incidents and improving system behaviour under real-world operating conditions. 

Technical Problem Solving & Continuous Improvement

- Investigate and resolve complex technical problems using structured analysis, debugging, experimentation and collaboration with relevant specialists. 
 - Evaluate new tools, frameworks and engineering approaches where they improve maintainability, security, scalability, developer productivity or delivery efficiency. 
 - Simplify and refactor systems, code and workflows to reduce complexity, improve performance and address technical debt. 
 - Apply lessons learned from defects, incidents, reviews and delivery challenges to improve future engineering outcomes. 

Stakeholder Collaboration & Delivery Alignment

- Collaborate with product owners, business stakeholders, designers, testers, release teams, infrastructure teams and other engineers to align solutions with user and business needs. 
 - Communicate technical options, risks, dependencies and trade-offs clearly to support effective decision-making. 
 - Contribute to agile delivery practices by participating in planning, refinement, estimation, reviews and continuous improvement activities. 
 - Document technical designs, implementation decisions, interfaces and support information to enable maintainability, knowledge sharing and operational continuity. 

Skills And Experience

Priority Skills

- Software Engineering
 - Programming Principles
 - Application Programming Interface
 - Database Development
 - Distributed Systems
 - DevOps
 - Software Testing
 - Secure Coding
 - Web Application Security
 - Mobile Security

Other Skills

- Platform Management
 - Operating Systems
 - Computer Network
 - Database Administration
 - Functional Writing

Motivations

- Motivated by solving complex problems through technology and engineering creativity. 
 - Energised by learning, experimenting and continuously improving technical solutions. 
 - Thrives in collaborative environments where innovation, quality and craftsmanship are valued. 

Qualifications

- Experience contributing to the development of software solutions that support business, customer or operational outcomes. 
 - Experience working in collaborative, cross-functional delivery teams where requirements are translated into technology solutions. 
 - Experience applying structured problem-solving approaches to resolve technical challenges and improve system performance. 
 - Experience working within engineering environments that emphasise quality, maintainability, security and continuous improvement.

As we expand into India, our new teammates will be fully integrated with our U. S. teams, working on global projects and gaining exposure to top industry leaders. data.title: Global Practice Lead – Continuous Improvement & Process Intelligence
data.description:
Create a better future!

Do you want to make a difference in the world and contribute to a sustainable future? We believe we can develop technology and gain the knowledge to make that difference. We have launched our ambition, Mission Zero - enabling our customers to move towards zero emissions in mining We need your leadership skills, curiosity, and drive for change to fulfil our goal. Together, we enable our customers to produce the materials needed for a better future. 

Global Practice Lead - Continuous Improvement & Process Intelligence

We are seeking a thoughtful and highly experienced Continuous Improvement leader to shape how operational excellence is delivered across the enterprise. This role brings together proven Lean methodologies, Process Mining, automation and practical AI applications to simplify work, remove structural waste and deliver measurable business value. 

While operational teams focus on daily execution, you will create the improvement system that helps the business understand why recurring delays, rework and manual workarounds occur. You will convert operational experience and process evidence into focused interventions that improve productivity, quality, service, working capital and cost performance. 

The mission extends beyond individual improvement projects. You will build an enterprise capability that moves the business from reactive firefighting to proactive execution, converts local successes into common standards and develops the specialist talent required to sustain continuous improvement and AI-enabled transformation. 

Essential Functions & Key Result Areas (KRAs)

Create the Improvement System: Enterprise CI & AI Governance (30%)

- Enterprise Improvement Architecture: Own the Continuous Improvement framework, governance model and improvement portfolio. Integrate Lean, Kaizen, Process Mining, automation and practical AI into a common system for identifying, prioritising and delivering improvement opportunities based on business value. 
 - Outputs: Enterprise CI Governance Handbook, portfolio prioritisation model, benefit-validation framework, Process Mining roadmap, improvement methodology standards and central opportunity portfolio. 

Deliver Measurable Business Value: Operational Transformation (25%)

- Value-Led Improvement: Lead cross-functional initiatives that address recurring delays, process variation, rework, manual activity and structural inefficiencies. Ensure teams move beyond symptoms, identify root causes and deliver measurable operational and financial outcomes. 
 - Outputs: Approved improvement charters, root-cause assessments, future-state process designs, implementation roadmaps, corrective-action records, validated benefits reports and confirmed P&L savings. 

Scale What Works: Process Intelligence, Automation & AI (20%)

- AI-Enabled Improvement at Scale: Use Process Mining, operational data and AI-enabled tools to expose hidden waste, identify emerging constraints and guide automation opportunities. Translate proven local improvements into scalable digital processes and common enterprise standards. 
 - Outputs: Process opportunity heatmaps, automation business cases, predictive intervention models, scalable process standards, portfolio value reports and global deployment plans. 

Shape Leadership Decisions: Portfolio Steering & Business Alignment (15%)

- Decision-Ready Improvement Leadership: Translate complex process findings into clear business choices, financial implications, delivery risks and recommended actions. Use governance forums to align priorities, remove barriers and maintain accountability for value delivery. 
 - Outputs: SteerCo packs, decision papers, portfolio health reviews, value-realisation updates, risk escalations and management action trackers. 

Build Future Capability: Talent, Culture & Succession (10%)

- Specialist Capability Leadership: Develop CI Specialists, Lean Engineers and Process Mining Analysts while building broader confidence in Lean, automation and AI-enabled improvement. Establish succession plans and create a community that shares knowledge and scales proven practices. 
 - Outputs: Capability framework, role-based learning paths, coaching plans, certification roadmap, specialist development plans, succession pipeline and reusable knowledge library. 

Parameters for Success

- Business Value: Validated financial and operational benefits delivered through the improvement portfolio. 
 - Process Performance: Measurable reduction in delays, rework, process variation, manual work and avoidable complexity. 
 - Digital Enablement: Adoption of Process Mining, automation and AI-enabled improvement solutions. 
 - Enterprise Scale: Proven improvements translated into repeatable standards and adopted across functions and regions. 
 - Capability Strength: A strong specialist team, visible succession pipeline and growing improvement maturity across the business. 

Qualifications & Skills

Education

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Supply Chain Management, Operations, Engineering, Business Administration or a related discipline. 

Experience

 - Proven experience leading complex, cross-functional improvement programmes under a global mandate. 
 - Demonstrated delivery of measurable productivity, quality, service and financial improvements. 
 - Experience integrating Process Mining, automation, analytics or AI into Continuous Improvement practices. 

Technical & Certifications

Personal Capabilities

- Strong business judgement and practical leadership. 
 - Clear executive communication and constructive influence. 
 - Ability to simplify complexity and convert evidence into action.

 - Strong coaching, talent development and succession-planning capability. 

What We Offer

 - Schedule and conduct onboarding and training sessions covering project workflows, evaluation rubrics, quality standards, and Punjabi-specific language and script requirements
 - Ensure trainers and QAs apply Punjabi language guidelines consistently as projects, client expectations, and task requirements evolve
 - Monitor recurring quality patterns and recommend workflow, documentation, rubric, or training improvements
 - Support the development of scalable QA processes for Punjabi-language projects through structured feedback, calibration, documentation, and quality monitoring
 - Help ensure Punjabi AI training data is natural, accurate, culturally appropriate, well-documented, and aligned with client expectations
 - Support AI model improvement through quality reviews, trainer coaching, LLM evaluation, response analysis, and structured QA documentation

Requirements

- Education: Bachelor s or Master s degree in Punjabi, Linguistics, Translation, Communications, Journalism, English, Education, Quality Assurance, or a related field preferred
 - Native or near-native Punjabi proficiency, with strong reading and writing ability required
 - Ability to read and write Gurmukhi, Shahmukhi, or both required; candidates should specify the script(s) they can use
 - Strong English proficiency, with the ability to follow detailed project guidelines, communicate with remote teams, and provide clear written feedback
 - Strong working experience in Punjabi writing, editing, translation, localization, content QA, AI training, education, annotation, or related language-review workflows
 - Deep understanding of Punjabi grammar, spelling conventions, punctuation, tone, register, dialect variation, cultural context, and terminology
 - Ability to evaluate Punjabi content against detailed rubrics and identify mistranslation, literal phrasing, unnatural tone, hallucinated claims, ambiguity, and inconsistent terminology
 - Experience leading or supporting remote teams of trainers, annotators, reviewers, editors, or QA contributors strongly preferred
 - Strong communication, coaching, organization, and quality-management skills
 - Experience creating and maintaining style guides, FAQs, trackers, onboarding materials, honeypots, quality notes, and other project documentation preferred
 - Comfortable working in fast-moving remote environments using Discord, Google Sheets, Google Docs, trackers, dashboards, and project-management systems
 - Strong analytical judgment when evaluating AI-generated content, contributor quality, rubric adherence, and recurring workflow gaps
 - Previous experience with AI data training, data annotation, large language models, prompt/response evaluation, translation QA, or rubric-based LLM QA strongly preferred
 - Familiarity with AI tools such as ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, Perplexity, or similar platforms preferred
 - Reliable remote-work practices, confidentiality handling, self-direction, and consistency across structured quality workflows required

data.title: Principal Application Software Engineer
data.description:
Job Description

We are seeking a hands-on engineer with strong systems programming and distributed systems experience to own significant features in the OCI PostgreSQL Data Plane. You will work on complex engineering problems involving database execution, concurrency, persistence, recovery, and failure handling. 

You will contribute to technical designs, implement production-quality software, and collaborate with control plane, storage, networking, and infrastructure teams. This role requires independent ownership of substantial work, sound engineering judgment, and a commitment to operating reliable services. 

Career Level: IC4

Responsibilities

RESPONSIBILITIES

- Design, develop, test, and maintain PostgreSQL Data Plane components using C/C++ and other appropriate languages. 
 - Build and improve capabilities for replication, high availability, failover, backup and recovery, and database upgrades. 
 - Integrate PostgreSQL with OCI storage and infrastructure services, preserving data integrity and durability through failures. 
 - Analyze and optimize query execution, memory utilization, concurrency, and storage I/O performance. 
 - Develop database runtime and agent capabilities for configuration, patching, health monitoring, and lifecycle operations. 
 - Build automated tests, benchmarks, and fault-injection scenarios to validate correctness, scalability, and resilience. 
 - Investigate production incidents, perform root-cause analysis, and implement lasting fixes. 
 - Improve observability, deployment safety, and operational procedures; participate in a rotating on-call schedule. 
 - Own features from design through production rollout, contribute to design and code reviews, and mentor other engineers. 

Required Qualifications

- Bachelor's or master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. 
 - 7+ years of relevant software engineering experience, including development of production systems software, databases, or distributed services. 
 - Strong proficiency in C/C++, including memory management, concurrency, multithreading, and debugging. 
 - Solid understanding of data structures, algorithms, operating systems, networking, and distributed systems fundamentals. 
 - Experience with Linux development, troubleshooting, profiling, and performance analysis. 
 - Working knowledge of database internals, including transactions, write-ahead logging, replication, storage, and recovery. 
 - Strong problem-solving and communication skills, with demonstrated ownership of complex engineering deliverables. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience developing or extending PostgreSQL, including extensions, replication, or storage integration. 
 - Experience with cloud-scale storage, consistency models, crash recovery, and highly available database architectures. 
 - Experience operating multi-tenant managed services and diagnosing performance or reliability issues at scale. 
 - Familiarity with Terraform and infrastructure automation for repeatable test and deployment environments. 
 - Contributions to PostgreSQL or other open-source database and systems projects.

data.title: Software Engineer (PLC) -Control System Engineering
data.description:
Job Requirements

At Quest Global, it's not just what we do but how and why we do it that makes us different. With over 25 years as an engineering services provider, we believe in the power of doing things differently to make the impossible possible. Our people are driven by the desire to make the world a better place-to make a positive difference that contributes to a brighter future. We bring together technologies and industries, alongside the contributions of diverse individuals who are empowered by an intentional workplace culture, to solve problems better and faster. 

This position involves developing PLC and HMI control systems for semiconductor gas/chemical delivery equipment. Responsibilities include designing control logic, system integration, commissioning, and troubleshooting. The role involves designing control architectures based on customer requirements and leading the improvement of equipment stability and performance, as well as the standardization of automation. 

As a Senior Engineer, Lead the software programming, system design, and technical direction for chemical and specialty gas delivery equipment used in semiconductors. 

Proficient in PLC, HMI, C/C++, Java, and other PC-based languages at an expert level. Hold a technical vision for the assigned product areas in chemical equipment and translate complex requirements into scalable, high-performance, manufacturable solutions. Through cross-team collaboration, they contribute to engineering standardization and reliability and demonstrate technical leadership in both systems engineering and PLC software development. 

Key Responsibilities

PLC Software Development

- Understand PLC Software Development
 - Develop and maintain PLC software based on IEC 61131-3 standards. 
 - Design, program, test, and validate PLC logic for semiconductor gas and chemical delivery systems. 
 - Support Omron, Siemens, and LS PLC platforms. 
 - Develop reusable software modules and engineering standards

HMI & System Integration

- Configure and maintain HMI systems (Pro-face, MXon/M2I). 
 - Implement alarms, diagnostics, state monitoring, and data logging functions. 
 - Integrate PLC, HMI, instruments, motion devices, and network systems. 

System Engineering

- Analyze customer and product requirements and translate them into software and control system architecture. 
 - Define software-hardware interfaces and control philosophies. 
 - Support system design reviews and risk assessments. 

Troubleshooting & RCA

- Investigate field issues and implement corrective actions. 
 - Lead root cause analysis (RCA) activities. 
 - Optimize system performance, reliability, and maintainability. 

Manufacturing & Customer Support

- Support manufacturing, FAT, SAT, commissioning, and startup activities. 
 - Provide technical support during customer escalations. 
 - Develop manufacturing packages and technical documentation. 

Cross-Functional Collaboration

- Work closely with Mechanical, Electrical, Quality, Project Management, and Manufacturing teams. 
 - Collaborate with global engineering teams on platform standardization and product improvements. 
 - Participate in engineering change management (ECR/ECO) activities. 

Continuous Improvement

- Drive software standardization and code modularization. 
 - Contribute to technology roadmaps for next-generation control systems. 
 - Mentor junior engineers and share technical best practices

We are known for our extraordinary people who make the impossible possible every day. Questians are driven by hunger, humility, and aspiration. We believe that our company culture is the key to our ability to make a true difference in every industry we reach. Our teams regularly invest time and dedicated effort into internal culture work, ensuring that all voices are heard. 

We wholeheartedly believe in the diversity of thought that comes with fostering a culture rooted in respect, where everyone belongs, is valued, and feels inspired to share their ideas. We know embracing our unique differences makes us better, and that solving the worlds hardest engineering problems requires diverse ideas, perspectives, and backgrounds. We shine the brightest when we tap into the many dimensions that thrive across over 21, 000 difference-makers in our workplace. 

Work Experience

Minimum Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Automation Engineering, Software Engineering, Computer Science, or related field. 
 - Minimum 5 years of PLC software development experience. 
 - Strong hands-on experience with: Omron / Siemens / LS PLC
 - Experience with HMI development (Pro-face, MXon, M2I or equivalent). 
 - Knowledge of industrial communication protocols: Ethernet/IP, Modbus TCP/RTU, Profinet, EtherCAT
 - Experience in troubleshooting and debugging industrial automation systems. 
 - Ability to communicate effectively in an international engineering environment

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience with semiconductor equipment, gas delivery systems, chemical delivery systems, or process equipment. 
 - Experience supporting customer sites, installation, and commissioning activities. 
 - Experience with SCADA or industrial software platforms. 
 - Knowledge of functional safety and industrial cybersecurity. 
 - Experience leading technical projects or system architecture reviews. 
 - Experience collaborating with global engineering organizations.

data.title: Digital Manufacturing Engineer – Global Deployment
data.description:
Job Overview

JOB DESCRIPTION

The Digital Manufacturing Engineer - Global Deployment is responsible for driving Weatherford's global digital manufacturing transformation initiatives from the Baroda (Vadodara) facility, which serves as the organization's Digital Manufacturing Lighthouse. The role focuses on developing, piloting, validating, standardizing, and globally deploying advanced manufacturing solutions including MBOM governance, Model-Based Definition (MBD), Product Manufacturing Information (PMI), Creo CAM standardization, Oracle Fusion integration, Industry 4. 0 technologies, automation, machine vision, AI-assisted inspection, and RFID-enabled manufacturing processes. 

Working closely with Manufacturing, Engineering, Quality, Supply Chain, Operations, RD&E, and Digital/IT teams, the position is responsible for establishing scalable digital manufacturing standards, improving manufacturing execution, enhancing product traceability, supporting compliance with API and ISO standards, and delivering measurable improvements in safety, quality, productivity, cycle time, cost, and on-time delivery. The role also drives the replication of successful solutions across Weatherford's global manufacturing network through standardized deployment frameworks, governance models, training programs, and best-practice playbooks. 

Key Responsibilities

- Lead digital manufacturing transformation initiatives and Industry 4. 0 programs across global manufacturing facilities. 
 - Own the creation, validation, maintenance, and governance of Manufacturing Bills of Material (MBOM) aligned with Engineering BOMs (EBOM). 
 - Define and standardize routings, digital work instructions, manufacturing processes, and control plans. 
 - Establish MBOM as the single source of truth for manufacturing execution, automation, and quality systems. 
 - Lead the standardization of PTC Creo CAM across all Weatherford manufacturing locations. 
 - Develop and maintain common machining templates, tool libraries, holder libraries, machine definitions, post-processors, and machining strategies. 
 - Establish CAM governance including NC program naming conventions, revision control, approval workflows, and release processes. 
 - Develop, deploy, and maintain Model-Based Definition (MBD) and Product Manufacturing Information (PMI) standards. 
 - Ensure inclusion of GD&T, tolerances, dimensions, datums, material specifications, heat treatment requirements, weld symbols, surface finish requirements, inspection characteristics, and manufacturing notes within 3D models. 
 - Align MBD and PMI practices with ASME Y14. 5, ASME Y14. 41, and applicable ISO standards. 
 - Drive digital thread implementation linking MBD, EBOM, MBOM, CAM, manufacturing execution, and quality processes. 
 - Lead deployment of automation, robotics, machine vision, AI-assisted inspection, and RFID-based inventory and WIP tracking systems. 
 - Integrate automation requirements into New Product Introduction (NPI) and technology transfer activities. 
 - Develop scalable automation architectures and deployment standards for global implementation. 
 - Use Baroda as the pilot location for validating digital manufacturing technologies and standards. 
 - Develop and maintain Baroda Digital Manufacturing Standards, governance models, templates, and replication playbooks. 
 - Coordinate implementation and rollout of proven solutions across global manufacturing facilities. 
 - Support plant teams remotely and onsite during deployment activities. 
 - Monitor adoption, standardization, and digital maturity across all manufacturing locations. 
 - Translate MBOM structures into Oracle Fusion Product Information Management (PIM) item structures. 
 - Configure work definitions, routings, work centers, resources, labor allocations, equipment assignments, and manufacturing master data within Oracle Fusion. 
 - Lead Engineering Change Order (ECO) implementation and revision control activities. 
 - Ensure data integrity across ERP, PLM, manufacturing, and quality systems. 
 - Ensure compliance with API Q1, ISO 9001, HSE requirements, product traceability standards, and corporate governance requirements. 
 - Validate digital and automation solutions against machine safety, cybersecurity, and operational requirements. 
 - Conduct Job Safety Analyses (JSA/JHA) prior to production implementation. 
 - Manage project scope, schedules, budgets, resources, stakeholder communication, and risk mitigation activities. 
 - Develop business cases and ROI justifications for digital manufacturing and automation investments. 
 - Build and maintain Power BI dashboards and KPI reporting systems. 
 - Track and improve productivity, cycle time, throughput, labor efficiency, COPQ, scrap, rework, and on-time delivery performance. 
 - Collaborate with Manufacturing, Quality, Supply Chain, RD&E, Sourcing, Operations, and Digital/IT functions. 
 - Develop training materials, knowledge repositories, and global best-practice documentation. 
 - Train engineers, programmers, and plant personnel on CAM, MBOM, MBD, and digital manufacturing standards. 
 - Champion digital manufacturing adoption and standardization across the organization's global manufacturing network. 

Skills

- Digital Manufacturing & Industry 4. 0
 - Manufacturing Process Engineering
 - MBOM, EBOM & Manufacturing Routings
 - PTC Creo & Creo NC/CAM Programming
 - CNC Machining (Turning & Milling)
 - Model-Based Definition (MBD) & PMI
 - GD&T (ASME Y14. 5) & ASME Y14. 41
 - Oracle Fusion Manufacturing Cloud & Oracle PIM
 - ERP/PLM Systems (Oracle, SAP, Windchill, Teamcenter)
 - MES & Shop Floor Data Management
 - Manufacturing KPIs, Power BI & Analytics
 - Engineering Change Management (ECO)
 - Automation, Robotics & Smart Manufacturing
 - Machine Vision, AI Inspection & RFID Tracking
 - Digital Thread & CAM Standardization
 - Project & Stakeholder Management
 - Lean Manufacturing & Continuous Improvement
 - Change Management & Cross-Functional Collaboration
 - Global Manufacturing Deployments & Standardization
 - Strong Communication, Leadership & Problem-Solving Skills
 - Knowledge of API Q1, ISO 9001 & Product Traceability (Preferred)
 - PMP and/or Lean Six Sigma Certification (Preferred)
 - Experience in Oil & Gas, Aerospace, Energy, or Heavy Equipment Industries (Preferred)

Qualifications

- Bachelor's Degree in Mechanical, Industrial, Production, or Manufacturing Engineering; Master's Degree in Engineering, Manufacturing Systems, Industrial Engineering, Operations Management, or Engineering Management preferred. 
 - Min 10 years of experience in Manufacturing experience and 5 - 6 yrs in leading digital transformation initiatives, Process, Industrial, or Digital Manufacturing Engineering, preferably within Oil & Gas, Energy, Aerospace, Heavy Equipment, Defense, or other highly regulated manufacturing environments. 
 - Minimum 3 years of experience leading Digital Transformation, Industry 4. 0, Smart Manufacturing, Automation, or Factory Digitization initiatives with measurable business results. 
 - Hands-on expertise with PTC Creo (Creo NC/CAM), CNC Turning & Milling, CAM standardization, and manufacturing process optimization. 
 - Strong knowledge of MBOM, EBOM, Routings, Work Instructions, Manufacturing Process Development, Standard Work, Capacity Planning, and Manufacturing Data Governance. 
 - Experience with Oracle Fusion Manufacturing Cloud, Oracle PIM, Work Definitions, Routings, ECO Management, and ERP/PLM platforms such as Oracle, SAP, Windchill, and Teamcenter. 
 - Strong understanding of Model-Based Definition (MBD), Product Manufacturing Information (PMI), GD&T (ASME Y14. 5), ASME Y14. 41, and Digital Thread implementation. 
 - Knowledge of MES, Shop-Floor Data Collection, Manufacturing KPIs, Power BI, Dashboard Development, Reporting, and Data Analytics. 
 - Experience leading global or multi-site manufacturing deployments, enterprise CAM standardization, MBD/PMI implementation, and manufacturing transformation programs. 
 - Exposure to Robotics, Machine Vision, AI-Assisted Inspection, RFID, Factory Automation, CMM Programming, CAM-PLM Integration, OCI, FBDI, and REST/SOAP Integrations is preferred. 
 - Knowledge of API Q1, ISO 9001, Product Traceability, OT Cybersecurity, Technology Transfer, and Supplier Development Processes preferred. 
 - Strong Project Management, Stakeholder Management, Change Management, Communication, Training, and Cross-Functional Leadership skills. 
 - PMP Certification and/or Lean Six Sigma Green Belt/Black Belt Certification preferred. 
 - Ability to collaborate effectively with global teams across different regions, cultures, and time zones.

data.title: Architect AI DevOps
data.description:
Join our Team

About this opportunity: 

Join our team as an Architect - AI and DevOps, helping define and deliver secure, scalable and cost-effective AI solutions for enterprise environments. You will shape architectural standards and guide the adoption of Generative AI, large language models, intelligent agents and automation across technology platforms and delivery processes. Working with engineering, product, security and platform teams, you will connect strategic goals with practical solutions that are reliable, maintainable and ready for production. 

What you will do: 

- Define end-to-end AI and machine learning architectures that meet requirements for performance, availability, security, scalability and cost. 
 - Design enterprise solutions using large language models, prompt engineering, model tuning, efficient model deployment and secure integration. 
 - Architect knowledge solutions using Retrieval-Augmented Generation, embeddings, vector databases and semantic search. 
 - Design intelligent agents, tool integrations and workflow orchestration using APIs and the Model Context Protocol. 
 - Establish standards for automated delivery pipelines covering source control, testing, security checks, artifact management, deployment and validation. 
 - Design cloud-native solutions using AWS, Azure or Google Cloud, Docker, Kubernetes and microservices. 
 - Guide infrastructure automation, configuration management and Infrastructure as Code using Ansible and related tools. 
 - Embed privacy, access control, security, compliance and responsible AI practices, including human approval where appropriate. 
 - Promote effective monitoring, logging, performance improvement and production troubleshooting. 
 - Communicate architectural decisions clearly and support teams in delivering consistent, high-quality solutions. 

The skills you bring: 

- Experience designing and implementing enterprise AI, machine learning, cloud or DevOps solutions. 
 - Strong understanding of AI and machine learning architecture, deep learning, large language models and modern AI applications. 
 - Proficiency in Python and practical experience with PyTorch or TensorFlow. 
 - Experience with prompt engineering, Retrieval-Augmented Generation, embeddings, vector databases, model integration and performance optimization. 
 - Knowledge of AI agent frameworks, workflow orchestration, tool calling, API integration and the Model Context Protocol. 
 - Hands-on experience with Git, Ansible, CI/CD design, Python or Bash scripting, JSON and YAML. GitLab experience is an advantage. 
 - Familiarity with code quality and security tools, artifact repositories and container registries. 
 - Experience with AWS, Azure or Google Cloud, Docker, Kubernetes, microservices, networking and identity management.
