Office

As part of the Thermo Fisher Scientific team, you'll discover meaningful work that makes a positive impact on a global scale. Join our colleagues in bringing our Mission to life every single day to enable our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer. We provide our global teams with the resources needed to achieve individual career goals while helping to take science a step beyond by developing solutions for some of the world's toughest challenges, like protecting the environment, making sure our food is safe or helping find cures for cancer. 

The Position

This position is available in the DAIV System Team, a centralized DevOps and software infrastructure team based in Bangalore and supporting multiple software product development teams across the EMEA region. These teams develop desktop and web applications for data management, image processing, and visualization workflows. The DAIV System Team provides CI/CD infrastructure, software lifecycle management, developer tooling, AI enablement, and cybersecurity support across the software development lifecycle. 

As the DevOps Lead - Desktop Applications, you will provide technical leadership for the build, test, packaging, release, and lifecycle management capabilities used by our desktop software teams. You will define scalable engineering standards for complex, cross-platform C++/Qt and . NET products, while remaining hands-on in the implementation and operation of critical DevOps solutions. 

How You Will Make an Impact

- You will improve the reliability, security, and speed of desktop software delivery by creating consistent build and release capabilities across Windows and Linux environments. You will guide technical decisions, reduce duplication between product teams, and establish reusable tooling that improves developer experience and product quality. 
 - You will work closely with software engineers, architects, product teams, cybersecurity specialists, and other DevOps engineers in a distributed, international organization. 

In This Role You Will

- Provide technical leadership for DevOps practices, architecture, and tooling supporting desktop application development. 
 - Define and evolve the technical roadmap for cross-platform build, test, packaging, signing, and release infrastructure. 
 - Design, implement, and maintain reusable GitHub or GitLab CI/CD templates, shared automation, and central developer tooling. 
 - Lead the modernization of CMake-based build systems and pipelines for C++/Qt applications, including compiler, SDK, and third-party dependency management. 
 - Engineer and support reliable Windows and Linux build environments using PowerShell, Python, . NET, and other appropriate automation technologies. 
 - Establish secure software supply chain practices, including dependency governance, secrets protection, vulnerability scanning, software bills of materials, and artifact signing where applicable. 
 - Drive lifecycle management activities such as toolchain upgrades, platform migrations, deprecation plans, and remediation of obsolete components. 
 - Lead complex troubleshooting, root cause analysis, and corrective actions for build, pipeline, packaging, and release issues. 
 - Identify and operationalize appropriate AI-assisted development and DevOps capabilities to improve engineering productivity while meeting security and compliance expectations. 
 - Create engineering standards, technical documentation, reference implementations, and enablement material for product teams. 
 - Coach and support DevOps and software engineers through design reviews, technical guidance, and knowledge sharing
 - Use delivery and reliability metrics to identify waste, prioritize improvements, and demonstrate measurable outcomes. 

The Candidate

The ideal candidate is a hands-on Staff-level engineer with deep desktop build and release expertise, strong architectural judgment, and a track record of improving engineering practices across multiple teams. 

Besides that, you have: 

- Bachelor's or master's degree with 10 to 12 years of DevOps industry experience including proven technical leadership
 - Preferred fields of study: Computer Science, Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related technical field. 
 - Advanced experience designing, operating, and improving CI/CD and build infrastructure for commercial desktop software. 
 - Strong proficiency with Git and GitHub or GitLab, including pipeline architecture, reusable CI/CD components, runners or agents, and artifact or package management. 
 - Strong hands-on expertise with CMake and C++/Qt build workflows, including compiler and SDK management, third-party dependencies, and reproducible cross-platform builds. 
 - Strong experience with Windows and Linux build environments, PowerShell and Python automation, and working knowledge of . NET engineering or delivery workflows. 
 - Deep understanding of automated testing, packaging, release engineering, code signing, and secure software supply chain practices, including dependency governance, vulnerability scanning, secrets protection, software bills of materials, and artifact integrity. 
 - Experience defining technical architectures and roadmaps and leading toolchain upgrades, platform migrations, deprecation plans, and lifecycle management initiatives. 
 - Experience supporting and guiding engineers, defining cross-team standards, conducting technical reviews, and leading technical change without relying on direct authority. 
 - Strong problem-solving, root cause analysis, and incident management skills for complex build, pipeline, packaging, and release issues. 
 - Clear written and verbal English communication skills and the ability to work effectively in a distributed, multicultural environment. 
 - Experience with Agile/Scrum development methodologies and modern software engineering practices. 
 - Self-motivated, pragmatic, quality-oriented, and able to work independently while guiding teams effectively. 
 - Ability to travel occasionally for collaboration with global teams, potentially up to 15%.

data.title: Staff Software Engineer Cloud and AI
data.description:
Our Company: 

At Teradata, we believe that people thrive when empowered with better information. Teradata Autonomous Knowledge Platform activates enterprise intelligence by unifying data, knowledge and business context to achieve tangible outcomes. With Teradata, organizations can provide agents with full context for impact when it matters. Our solution lets businesses connect and scale on premises, in the cloud, or through a hybrid approach. Teradata delivers real business value with AI. 

What You'll Do

We are looking for an exceptional Staff Cloud & AI Platform Engineer to own and independently build a next‐generation enterprise‐scale deployment and orchestration platform. This role goes far beyond traditional CI/CD or infrastructure automation-it sits at the intersection of distributed systems, control‐plane architecture, SRE principles, and applied AI/agentic workflows. 

- Contribute to the design and implementation of a stateful deployment control plane that treats deployments as a continuous convergence problem. 
 - Enable safe, resumable, deterministic, and SLO‐governed rollouts across multi‐cloud, on‐prem, and customer environments. 
 - Implement the practical application of AI agents in DevOps by embedding intelligent decision‐making into deployment workflows. 
 - Apply AI agents for anomaly detection, failure diagnosis, rollout control, and automated mitigation. 
 - Ensure all AI‐assisted workflows preserve correctness, determinism, and full auditability. 

This is a high‐impact individual contributor role requiring deep technical judgment, delivery ownership, and the ability to turn abstract design into production‐grade systems. 

Key Responsibilities

- Design and implement a stateful deployment control plane with deterministic, resumable execution and rollback support. 
 - Build deployment workflows that reconcile desired vs. actual state using durable control loops. 
 - Support multi‐cloud, on‐prem, and customer environments with a single orchestration framework. 
 - Implement SLO‐governed promotion gates, error‐budget checks, and bounded retry policies. 
 - Enable deployment models including self‐service, wave‐based rollouts, blue‐green, managed updates, and maintenance windows. 
 - Define declarative, extensible workflow schemas with explicit dependencies, retries, and rollback semantics. 
 - Integrate deployment orchestration with CI/CD systems, artifact manifests, entitlement services, and downstream execution systems. 
 - Embed AI‐assisted decision logic into deployment workflows for anomaly detection, failure diagnosis, and rollout control. 
 - Ensure AI‐driven actions remain deterministic, auditable, reversible, and policy‐constrained. 
 - Develop infrastructure and automation frameworks using Terraform, Python, and cloud‐native services. 
 - Embed observability and telemetry into workflows to drive automated validation, retries, and rollback decisions. 
 - Provide hands‐on technical leadership, mentoring engineers and driving platform architecture across DevOps, SRE, and CloudOps teams. 

Who You'll Work With

This is an individual contributor role. You will collaborate with project team members and architects, and report to the Senior Engineering Manager. 

What Makes You a Qualified Candidate

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in computer science or related field
 - 8+ years of hands‐on experience in DevOps, platform engineering, cloud infrastructure, or distributed systems. 
 - Proven experience developing and implementation of stateful systems such as control planes, workflow engines, or orchestration platforms. 
 - Experience building or operating enterprise‐scale deployment systems across multi‐cloud, hybrid, or on‐prem environments. 
 - Deep expertise in CI/CD, release engineering, and deployment strategies including wave‐based, blue‐green, and managed rollouts. 
 - Practical experience applying SRE principles such as SLOs, error budgets, promotion gates, and automated rollback. 
 - Strong programming skills in Python, with the ability to build long‐running services and automation frameworks. 
 - Hands‐on experience with Infrastructure as Code, preferably Terraform, and cloud‐native services (AWS, Azure, and/or GCP). 
 - Experience integrating observability and telemetry (metrics, logs, traces) into automated systems for decision‐making. 
 - Demonstrated experience building or integrating AI‐assisted or agentic workflows into DevOps or operational systems. 
 - Ability to design safe, auditable, policy‐constrained automation, especially when applying AI or autonomous decision logic. 
 - Strong technical judgment and communication skills, with experience leading architecture across teams as an individual contributor. 

Why We Think You'll Love Teradata

We prioritize a people-first culture because we know our people are at the very heart of our success. We embrace a flexible work model because we trust our people to make decisions about how, when, and where they work. We focus on well-being because we care about our people and their ability to thrive both personally and professionally. We are an anti-racist company because our dedication to Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion is more than a statement. It is a deep commitment to doing the work to foster an equitable environment that celebrates people for all of who they are. 

Teradata invites all identities and backgrounds in the workplace. We work with deliberation and intent to ensure we are cultivating collaboration and inclusivity across our global organization. Job Description

We are seeking a hands-on engineer with strong systems programming and distributed systems experience to own significant features in the OCI PostgreSQL Data Plane. You will work on complex engineering problems involving database execution, concurrency, persistence, recovery, and failure handling. 

You will contribute to technical designs, implement production-quality software, and collaborate with control plane, storage, networking, and infrastructure teams. This role requires independent ownership of substantial work, sound engineering judgment, and a commitment to operating reliable services. 

Career Level: IC4

Responsibilities

RESPONSIBILITIES

- Design, develop, test, and maintain PostgreSQL Data Plane components using C/C++ and other appropriate languages. 
 - Build and improve capabilities for replication, high availability, failover, backup and recovery, and database upgrades.

data.title: IND Associate Software Engineer - Red Team Engineer
data.description:
IND Associate Software Engineer - GCC022

We're determined to make a difference and are proud to be an insurance company that goes well beyond coverages and policies. Working here means having every opportunity to achieve your goals - and to help others accomplish theirs, too. Join our team as we help shape the future. 

Red Team / Adversarial Simulation Engineer

The Opportunity

We're hiring a Red Team / Adversarial Simulation Engineer to help strengthen our offensive security capabilities. You'll support adversary simulation exercises and targeted testing mapped to MITRE ATT&CK, working alongside team members to identify risk and help improve defenses. 

You'll work closely with senior Red Team operators and security engineering partners to execute scoped exercises, produce clear evidence of exploitable paths, and translate offensive findings into practical risk reduction. 

What You'll Do

- Support operations: Assist in planning and execution of approved adversary simulation exercises across endpoints, identity, applications, cloud, and third-party integrations, with guidance from senior operators. 
 - Execute adversary tradecraft: Operate across initial access simulation, internal discovery, credential access testing, privilege escalation, lateral movement, command-and-control simulation, and objective-based actions within approved scope. 
 - Map procedures and findings to MITRE ATT&CK to keep tradecraft, reporting, and scenario design consistent across exercises. 
 - Track operational outcomes: Collect command output, screenshots, logs, timelines, access paths, affected assets, and constraints so findings are defensible and reproducible. 
 - Build technical depth: Help maintain lab environments, test infrastructure, and approved tooling while following established safety and OPSEC practices. 
 - Learn and share tradecraft: Contribute to team standards, document lessons learned, and participate in peer reviews of techniques, findings, and reports. 
 - Apply and assess LLMs: Use LLMs to support authorized offensive security operations, including research, scripting, analysis, tooling, and workflow automation, and evaluate LLM-enabled systems for weaknesses that could contribute to an attack path. 
 - Follow safety and compliance practices: Operate within defined scope, approvals, deconfliction steps, and engagement rules for all activities. 

What You Bring

- Experience: 1 to 3 years in offensive security, penetration testing, Red Team operations, adversary simulation, or hands-on security engineering with offensive testing exposure. 
 - Technical foundation: Solid working knowledge of Windows and Linux internals, cloud security, AI/LLM, common enterprise attack paths, and at least one major cloud platform such as AWS, Azure, or GCP. 
 - Framework fluency: Practical familiarity with MITRE ATT&CK, including the ability to map and demonstrate Red Team procedures against tactics, techniques, objectives, and enterprise risk. 
 - Scripting and tooling: Practical experience writing or modifying scripts in PowerShell, Python, Go, Rust, or C#, with enough depth to automate operator tasks, adapt approved tooling, handle output, and troubleshoot execution issues. 
 - Operator mindset: Ability to think through attack paths, adjust safely when assumptions fail, maintain discipline under scope constraints, and document what worked, what failed, and why. 
 - Communication: Clear technical writing, disciplined evidence handling, and the ability to explain attack paths, impact, and remediation context to technical audiences without overstating findings. 
 - Automated security testing: Experience planning and managing test execution across a range of automated security testing tools, validating results, tracking coverage, and delivering clear, actionable reports. 

Certifications (nice to have): OSCP, CRTO/CRTP, or similar hands-on security certifications.

data.title: Forward Deployed Engineer
data.description:
Blitzy is a Cambridge, MA based AI software development platform on a mission to revolutionize the software development life cycle by autonomously building custom software to unlock the next industrial revolution. We're transforming how enterprises build software, turning enterprise requirements into enterprise grade code with an agentic software development platform that can autonomously execute 80% of the quantum of software development work. We're backed by multiple tier 1 investors, and have proven success as founders of previous start-ups. 

Our Culture

Who We Are

Led by two pioneering co-founders we are one of the fastest growing companies in the U. S. , creating our own category of enterprise autonomous software development. We automate thousands of hours of software development for our customers, which includes strong representation within the Fortune 500. 

How We Work

- We move Blitzy Fast: Time is both our company's and our clients' most precious asset. We move quickly and decisively to innovate internally and deliver exceptional software externally. 
 - Championship Mindset: We operate like a professional sports team. We win as a team by holding ourselves and each other to high standards, collaborating in-person, and remaining focused on the mission. 
 - Passion for Invention: We're pushing the frontier of what's possible, requiring constant innovation and iteration. 
 - We Work for the Customer: We focus on delivering outsized value to the customers we work with and expanding those relationships into deep, meaningful partnerships. 

About The Role

We're looking for a Forward Deployed Engineer to join our Pune HQ2 team and work at the intersection of cutting-edge AI and complex enterprise software. You'll embed with customer engineering teams and help them transform how they build software with Blitzy. This isn't a hand-coding or traditional solutions engineering role. You'll onboard new teams, guide them through the platform, troubleshoot issues, and work with client engineers on architecture and priorities, with the goal of getting each team to run Blitzy independently. 

Our HQ2 FDE team deploys alongside customers around the world, working closely with US-based engineering and customer teams with regular time zone overlap for collaboration and handoffs. You'll partner with customer stakeholders across regions and help each engagement run smoothly from kickoff to steady state. 

Responsibilities

- Deploy Blitzy into complex enterprise environments, navigating technical constraints and translating customer business goals into practical technical solutions
 - Embed with customer teams during critical implementations, partnering with engineering leaders on sprint planning, architecture reviews, technical decisions, and production deployments
 - Build production-quality integrations, services, and extensions using Java 17 and Spring Boot 3. x, including Spring MVC, Spring Data JPA, Spring Security, and Actuator
 - Build and evolve REST APIs using a contract-first approach with OpenAPI/Swagger, with data persistence through PostgreSQL, Hibernate/JPA, and Liquibase
 - Package and deploy containerized services with Docker and manage dependencies through Maven, including BOMs and multi-module projects
 - Develop custom solutions, reusable patterns, scripts, and tools that accelerate customer adoption and demonstrate Blitzy's capabilities in enterprise environments
 - Debug complex issues spanning customer infrastructure, integrations, microservices, and the Blitzy platform, supporting production operations, health checks, metrics, and configuration management
 - Drive successful POCs and technical demonstrations that showcase advanced use cases, deliver measurable value, and expand into enterprise-wide deployments
 - Maintain high standards for testing, code quality, performance, and observability using JUnit 5, Cucumber/Gherkin, JMeter, Git, Logback/SLF4J, SpotBugs, and SonarQube
 - Identify recurring customer needs, technical patterns, and expansion opportunities that inform product priorities and enterprise adoption
 - Collaborate with product and engineering teams to translate field experience into platform improvements, technical documentation, reusable best practices, and contributions to the core product

Qualifications

- 10+ years of software engineering experience with a track record of shipping production code in enterprise environments
 - Deep hands-on expertise with Java 17, Spring Boot 3. x, Spring MVC, Spring Data JPA, Spring Security, Hibernate/JPA, and Actuator
 - Strong experience with REST APIs, OpenAPI/Swagger, PostgreSQL, Liquibase, Maven, Docker, and modern testing practices including JUnit 5, Cucumber/Gherkin, and JMeter
 - Experience building and operating microservices with CI/CD, cloud architecture, observability, production monitoring, and tools such as Micrometer, Dynatrace, SpotBugs, and SonarQube

We help global enterprise partners integrate Meta's foundation models and AI tools directly into their core products and infrastructure. We are hiring an experienced Staff Forward Deployed Engineer to act as the primary technical bridge between Meta's internal engineering teams and our enterprise clients. You will lead the architecture and rollout of large-scale AI systems, working side-by-side with engineering leaders at other companies to adapt our AI platform to their specific environments and constraints. Crucially, you'll take the friction you encounter in the field-like optimizing inference speeds, resolving interoperability issues, and connecting complex external data sources-and turn it into concrete technical proposals. Your hands-on experience will directly inform and shape the roadmap for Meta's core AI tools and ecosystem. If you want autonomy and the chance to lead complex technical deployments that define how the enterprise uses AI, we encourage you to apply. 

Forward Deployed Engineer, Enterprise AI (Bangalore) Responsibilities: 

- Architect Systems: Lead the technical design for major enterprise AI deployments. Ensure the solutions can scale, remain secure, and adhere to strict partner compliance requirements. 
 - Build Integrations: Design reliable connections between Meta's AI platforms and client infrastructure, including CRMs, data warehouses, and custom APIs. 
 - Drive the Roadmap: Serve as the definitive technical link between field deployments and internal platform teams. Synthesize real-world deployment challenges into strategic decisions that shape Meta's core AI products. 
 - Establish Standards: Define deployment patterns, build tooling, and set engineering standards that reduce technical debt and speed up future execution across the team. 
 - Lead and Mentor: Set technical direction, drive major cross-functional initiatives, and provide deep technical mentorship to uplevel the team and guide new engineers. 
 - Optimize at Scale: Identify and resolve complex performance, latency, and scalability bottlenecks to ensure reliable performance in live production environments. 

Minimum Qualifications: 

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, relevant technical field, or equivalent practical experience
 - Experience utilizing data and analysis to explain technical problems and provide detailed feedback and solutions
 - Demonstrated experience driving change within an organization and leading complex technical projects
 - 8+ years of programming experience in a relevant language OR 4+ years experience with a PhD

Preferred Qualifications: 

- Experience architecting and deploying large-scale software systems, including taking complex AI applications from early prototypes to enterprise-ready production
 - Experience architecting and scaling GenAI infrastructure across major cloud platforms (e. g. , AWS, GCP), leveraging advanced cloud services (compute, distributed storage, ML frameworks) to optimize model performance, manage compute costs, and ensure enterprise-grade reliability
 - Experience designing and implementing advanced AI testing systems (e. g. , automated evaluation loops to proactively catch hallucinations, reasoning gaps, or safety issues in live products)

We are looking for an experienced Quality Manager with strong hands-on experience in the Oil & Gas / Industrial Valve Manufacturing industry, particularly in the manufacturing and quality assurance of API 6D Ball, Plug and Butterfly Valves. 

The ideal candidate should have in-depth practical knowledge of API 6D requirements, valve manufacturing processes, inspection, testing, quality systems and customer requirements, with proven experience in leading and representing the Quality function during API audits and customer/third-party audits.

NCR rate

Rework and scrap

First-pass yield

On-time inspection

Customer complaints

CAPA effectiveness

Establish and monitor Corrective and Preventive Actions (CAPA).

Establish supplier quality requirements for critical valve components and materials.

Job Description

In This Role, Your Responsibilities Will Be: 

You will be responsible for the full project lifecycle, from requirements gathering and concept design to hardware/software engineering, simulation, testing, and commissioning. 

Project Engineering: 

- Lead end-to-end project engineering for high-current static generator excitation systems, from requirements review and concept development through detailed design, manufacturing support, FAT, site installation, and commissioning. 
 - Design excitation system electrical and mechanical layouts for high-current applications, typically in the 5, 000 A to 10, 000 A range, including cubicle arrangement, power circuit configuration, cooling provisions, and maintainability requirements. 
 - Perform sizing and selection of excitation system components, including transformers, rectifier bridges, thyristors/diodes, bus bars, disconnecting devices, breakers, protection devices, cooling equipment, controllers, I/O, and auxiliary power supplies. 
 - Develop and review electrical schematics, wiring diagrams, interconnection drawings, general arrangement drawings, BOMs, control logic, system architecture, and network topology documents. 
 - Engineer bus work and high-current power connections, including routing, clearance, creepage, thermal performance, short-circuit withstand, and manufacturability considerations. 
 - Coordinate with manufacturing, quality, suppliers, and system integrators to ensure the excitation system design is practical, cost-effective, manufacturable, and compliant with project specifications. 
 - Support manufacturing quality processes, including inspection plans, assembly reviews, test procedures, nonconformance resolution, and corrective actions for high-current excitation equipment. 
 - Implement control logic from SAMA diagrams, functional descriptions, and project-specific operating requirements. 
 - Configure and integrate communication protocols such as Modbus, OPC, IEC 61850, and DNP3, as applicable. 
 - Ensure compliance with applicable IEEE, IEC, NEC, ISO, HSE, and regional grid code requirements.

data.title: Principal DFT Engineer
data.description:
We are looking for a Principal HW DFT Engineer who will architect, implement, and validate in-vehicle networking devices as part of NXP's Automotive grade products. You will be responsible for advanced test strategies and implementation, verification and validation of pre/post tapeout of DFT features, overall test coverage improvements, and work closely with RTL and physical team on DFT timing constraints and closures. 

Main Job Tasks And Responsibilities

- Architecture & Strategy: Define and implement advanced DFT strategies, including Scan Architecture, JTAG, Memory BIST (MBIST), and Logic BIST (LBIST)
 - Implementation & Verification: Lead the integration of digital subsystems, perform scan insertion, and generate ATPG (Automatic Test Pattern Generation) patterns while ensuring high fault coverage. 
 - Silicon Support: Drive post-silicon validation and debug activities to root cause failures and improve manufacturing test efficiency. 
 - Collaboration: Coordinate with physical design and test engineering teams to ensure timing closure and that test patterns are operational immediately upon silicon arrival. 

Minimum Required Qualifications

- Education: B. S. /M. S. Electrical/Computer Engineering (or similar degrees)
 - Experience: Typically requires 10+ years of industry experience in SoC DFT implementation, verification, static timing closure, test coverage analysis and improvement, and silicon bring-up on ATE
 - Tool Expertise: Proficiency with industry-standard EDA tools from Mentor Graphics/Siemens (Tessent), Cadence, or Synopsys
 - Technical Skills: 
 - DFT - Scan insertion and architecture, ATPG: Proficiency in generating test vectors to detect manufacturing faults like stuck-at, transition, and advanced faults, Built-In Self-Test (BIST): Integration of Memory BIST (MBIST) for embedded SRAM/ROM and Logic BIST (LBIST) for autonomous logic testing, Boundary Scan & JTAG, Test Compression: Implementing techniques to reduce test data volume and application time, which is critical for large System-on-Chip (SoC) designs. 
 - Hardware Design & Implementation - HDL Proficiency: Strong command of Verilog or SystemVerilog for modifying RTL to insert test logic and writing test wrappers. Timing & Constraints: Knowledge of Static Timing Analysis (STA) and creating DFT-specific timing constraints (SDC files) to ensure test logic does not degrade functional performance. 
 - Verification & Debug - Simulation: Conducting gate-level simulations (GLS) and verifying DFT logic for correctness before fabrication. Post-Silicon Debug: Analyzing silicon data from Automated Test Equipment (ATE) to diagnose failures and improve manufacturing yield. 
 - Software & Tool Proficiency - EDA Tool Suites: Mastery of industry-standard tools such as Synopsys TestMAX/DFT Compiler, Mentor Graphics Tessent, and Cadence Modus. Scripting & Automation: Expertise in Tcl, Python, or Perl to automate test insertion flows, run simulations, and parse coverage reports.

data.title: Field Application Engineer – Robotics
data.description:
Field Application Engineer - Robotics (Mumbai)

Join the first company in India to design, manufacture and assemble robots and AMRs in-house. Based at our Mumbai factory, you will install, commission, program and troubleshoot robotic systems at customer sites: industrial robots, cobots, AMRs, AGVs, humanoids and robot dogs. Our range includes Yasaka industrial robots, FAIRINO cobots, and new-age Unitree humanoid robots and robot dogs (quadrupeds). 

About Luna Technologies

Luna Technologies Pvt. Ltd. provides industrial automation, robotics, motion control, mechatronics and pneumatics solutions to OEMs and manufacturers across India. It is headquartered in Navi Mumbai and has offices across the country. 

What You Will Do

• Install, commission, program and troubleshoot robots, cobots and mobile robots at customer sites, including AMR/AGV mapping and navigation. 

• Install and commission AMRs (autonomous mobile robots) and AGVs (automated guided vehicles) at customer sites: mapping, navigation and route setup, fleet configuration, trial runs and handover. 

• Deliver pick-and-place, material handling, palletizing, welding and machine tending applications. 

• Integrate robots with PLC, HMI, servo, vision and other automation systems, and optimise cycle times. 

• Run demos, application trials and customer training. 

• Provide on-site service and support to keep customer operations running. 

• Prepare service and commissioning reports and technical documentation. 

• Work with the sales, design and project teams, and share field feedback with our in-house robot design team. 

Products You Will Work With

Yasaka industrial robots, FAIRINO cobots, and new-age Unitree humanoid robots and robot dogs (quadrupeds). 

What You Will Learn

Robot and cobot programming and integration; real applications in welding, handling, palletizing and machine tending; PLC/HMI/servo integration; project execution and troubleshooting; and AMR and mobile robot deployment. 

Must Have

• Diploma / BE / BTech in Mechanical, Electrical, Electronics, Mechatronics, Instrumentation, Robotics or Automation. 

• 1-4 years in robotics, automation or field application engineering. 

• Basic industrial robot programming knowledge. 

• Strong troubleshooting, communication and customer-handling skills. 

• Willingness to travel to customer sites from the Mumbai base. 

Good to Have

• Knowledge of PLC, HMI, servo, sensors and industrial protocols such as Modbus, Profinet or EtherNet/IP. 

• Hands-on experience with Yasaka, FAIRINO, Unitree or other industrial robots, cobots, humanoids or quadruped robots. 

• AMR/AGV fleet setup, mapping and navigation; ROS experience. 

• Machine vision, Python scripting or offline robot programming. 

What We Offer

Hands-on work with robots built in-house and with Yasaka, FAIRINO and Unitree platforms, including new-age humanoid robots and robot dogs, principal and OEM training and certifications, a clear path to Senior Application Engineer, Robotics Specialist or Field Application Manager roles, performance incentives, travel support as per policy, paid leave, and statutory benefits. 

Luna Technologies Pvt. Ltd. is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

data.title: Senior Embedded Systems & IoT Engineer (ESP32 / Raspberry Pi)
data.description:
Location: Hyderabad, India (On-site)

Employment Type: Full-time

Experience: 5+ Years

About the RoleWe are looking for a hands-on Senior Embedded Systems & IoT Engineer (Technical Lead) to own the end-to-end development and integration of our IoT ecosystem, spanning ESP32-based embedded systems, Raspberry Pi controllers, connected devices, and cloud infrastructure. The role involves firmware development, hardware debugging, device provisioning, secure OTA updates, system integration, and deployment of reliable connected products. 

You will lead the IoT engineering team while remaining deeply involved in hands-on engineering, working closely with hardware manufacturers and internal cloud, application, and product teams. From defining the IoT architecture and developing firmware to troubleshooting PCBs, integrating electronics, and managing device fleets in production, you will take ownership of the complete IoT engineering lifecycle. 

Key Responsibilities1. IoT Architecture & Technical Leadership
 - Own the end-to-end IoT architecture, including cloud services, Control Core, Raspberry Pi-based local master, microcontrollers, connected devices, and peripherals. 
 - Define the architecture and communication mechanisms between cloud systems, local controllers, ESP32 boards, and connected devices. 
 - Lead and mentor the IoT engineering team, including firmware, device integration, and test engineers. 
 - Set technical priorities, review firmware and integration code, and ensure timely delivery of engineering milestones. 
 - Work closely with cloud, mobile application, and product teams to define device APIs, integration standards, and system interfaces. 
 - Drive technical decisions around reliability, scalability, security, and maintainability of the IoT ecosystem. 2. Embedded Firmware Development
 - Develop, modify, maintain, and optimize embedded firmware using C/C++ for ESP32, ESP32-S3, and other microcontroller platforms. 
 - Work with ESP-IDF, Arduino, or PlatformIO for firmware development and debugging. 
 - Implement GPIO control, PWM, UART, I2C, SPI, Wi-Fi, Bluetooth/BLE, and Ethernet connectivity (W5500). 
 - Develop firmware for controlling smart locks, LED lighting, fans, motors, relays, load switches, sensors, displays, and other peripherals. 
 - Implement watchdogs, brown-out detection, fault handling, and recovery mechanisms to ensure reliable device operation. 
 - Manage firmware flashing, configuration, versioning, releases, and testing records. 
 - Debug firmware issues independently and coordinate with the engineering team to resolve complex hardware-software integration problems. 3. Raspberry Pi & Linux System Integration
 - Set up, configure, and maintain Raspberry Pi 5-based controllers running Linux. 
 - Develop and maintain local master services and device integration scripts using Python and/or Node. js. 
 - Integrate GPIO, HAT peripherals, motor drivers, displays, cameras, audio/video equipment, and other connected hardware. 
 - Establish reliable communication between Raspberry Pi controllers, ESP32 boards, and connected peripherals. 
 - Implement local control, device coordination, offline operation, and recovery mechanisms. 
 - Troubleshoot Linux, hardware drivers, peripheral connectivity, and system-level integration issues. 4. Hardware Testing & Electronics Troubleshooting
 - Inspect, validate, and functionally test PCBs received from contract manufacturers and hardware vendors. 
 - Identify manufacturing defects, component failures, power supply issues, GPIO faults, communication problems, and wiring defects. 
 - Read and interpret circuit diagrams, schematics, PCB layouts, and component datasheets. 
 - Troubleshoot electronics at board and component level using multimeters, bench power supplies, oscilloscopes, and logic analyzers. 
 - Validate communication interfaces, sensors, actuators, connectors, and power systems. 
 - Coordinate with hardware manufacturers to resolve PCB design and production issues. 
 - Define repeatable board-level testing procedures, acceptance criteria, and quality-control processes. 5. Device Provisioning, Security & OTA Updates
 - Develop and maintain factory flashing and device provisioning workflows. 
 - Implement device identity, authentication, registration, and pod-binding mechanisms using claim codes, tokens, and device credentials. 
 - Manage firmware signing keys and secure device provisioning. 
 - Implement secure OTA firmware updates, including firmware validation, version management, and rollback mechanisms. 
 - Work with security mechanisms such as TLS, device certificates, secure boot, and signed firmware. 
 - Ensure secure communication between devices, local controllers, and cloud services. 6. IoT Cloud Connectivity & Fleet Management
 - Implement device-to-cloud communication using MQTT, HTTP/REST APIs, WebSockets, and other relevant IoT protocols. 
 - Integrate embedded devices with cloud services and backend APIs. 
 - Develop and maintain telemetry, device heartbeats, status reporting, and remote diagnostics. 
 - Implement fleet monitoring, alerting, logging, and device health management for deployments across multiple locations. 
 - Design mechanisms for handling network failures, offline operation, reconnection, and synchronization. 
 - Collaborate with cloud and application teams on device APIs and the Nova SDK, including door unlock, administrator device control, and kiosk status integrations. 7. Product Assembly & System Integration
 - Assemble and integrate PCBs, sensors, displays, motors, cables, connectors, power supplies, and electronic components into the final physical product. 
 - Perform wiring, cable harness assembly, connector termination, soldering, and cable management. 
 - Integrate smart locks, LED lighting, fans, camera shutters, screens, and other electronic subsystems. 
 - Validate communication and coordination across the complete electronic system. 
 - Perform end-to-end product testing and troubleshoot issues across firmware, hardware, power, wiring, and software integration. 
 - Ensure every assembled product meets functional, reliability, and quality requirements before deployment. 8. Manufacturing, Testing & Documentation
 - Work closely with contract manufacturers and board vendors on hardware bring-up, production testing, and quality assurance. 
 - Define test plans, acceptance criteria, and repeatable end-of-line testing procedures for every board and complete product unit. 
 - Coordinate factory flashing, firmware upgrades, hardware validation, and production releases. 
 - Maintain firmware release records, hardware revisions, test reports, and manufacturing documentation. 
 - Prepare technical architecture diagrams, wiring diagrams, troubleshooting guides, operational runbooks, and engineering handover documents. 
 - Support product deployment, field troubleshooting, and continuous improvement based on operational feedback. Required Skills & Experience
 - 5+ years of experience in embedded systems, IoT product development, electronics engineering, or connected hardware products. 
 - At least 2 years of experience leading or mentoring engineers in a technical capacity. 
 - Strong hands-on experience developing embedded firmware in C/C++ for ESP32, ESP32-S3, or similar microcontrollers. 
 - Good understanding of ESP-IDF, Arduino framework, or PlatformIO. 
 - Strong understanding of GPIO, UART, I2C, SPI, PWM, Wi-Fi, Bluetooth/BLE, and Ethernet. 
 - Practical experience with Raspberry Pi and Linux-based embedded systems. 
 - Working knowledge of Python and/or Node. js for device services, scripting, and hardware integration. 
 - Experience with IoT communication protocols such as MQTT, HTTP/REST, WebSockets, and TLS. 
 - Hands-on experience with OTA updates, device provisioning, firmware version management, and device authentication. 
 - Strong understanding of electronics, circuit diagrams, schematics, PCB layouts, and component-level troubleshooting. 
 - Practical experience using multimeters, oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, and bench power supplies. 
 - Hands-on experience with soldering, wiring, connectors, cable harnesses, and electronic product assembly. 
 - Experience integrating microcontrollers, sensors, actuators, displays, motors, and other peripherals into complete products. 
 - Experience working with hardware manufacturers, contract manufacturers, or PCB vendors. 
 - Strong debugging, problem-solving, technical ownership, and team coordination skills. 
 - Good written and verbal English communication skills, with the ability to collaborate across teams in India and the USA. 
 - Familiarity with Git and firmware development workflows. Good to Have
 - Experience with STM32, Nordic nRF, RP2040, or other embedded microcontroller platforms. 
 - Experience with ESP32-S3, W5500 Ethernet modules, and custom PCB development. 
 - Experience with secure boot, firmware signing, hardware security keys, and device certificates. 
 - Experience managing large-scale IoT device fleets across multiple locations. 
 - Experience with smart locks, access-control systems, kiosks, or commercial AV equipment. 
 - Familiarity with HDMI switching, cameras, audio systems, and display integration. 
 - Experience with Android Device Owner, Android kiosk mode, or dedicated-device management. 
 - Experience with motor drivers, relays, power electronics, sensors, and electromechanical systems. 
 - Experience taking connected hardware products from prototype to manufacturing and field deployment. 
 - Experience building consumer electronics, smart devices, appliances, or other physical IoT products.

We are seeking an experienced and strategic Director of Software Engineering to lead engineering for the Unify Energy platform. This role will provide technical, organizational, and delivery leadership for software and data capabilities serving the oil and gas industry. The Director will align engineering execution with customer and business priorities while advancing a secure, scalable platform that helps energy organizations manage high-value information, streamline operational workflows, and improve access to trusted data across the asset lifecycle. 

The Director will partner closely with Product Management, business leadership, Architecture, Information Security, DevOps, Data Engineering, Quality Engineering, Implementation, Customer Success, and other software teams. This leader will translate industry needs into an executable engineering strategy, coordinate cross-team dependencies, and ensure that product investments produce measurable customer, operational, and financial outcomes. 

The ideal candidate is a hands-on strategic leader with deep experience delivering complex SaaS and cloud-native platforms, leading distributed engineering teams, and building data-intensive solutions for regulated or asset-intensive industries. Oil and gas domain experience is strongly preferred, including familiarity with upstream, midstream, or downstream workflows; land, lease, well, facility, and asset records; regulatory information; document and data onboarding; and integration with industry and enterprise systems. 

Roles And Responsibilities

- Lead, mentor, and develop high-performing engineering teams responsible for the Unify Energy platform and related software, data, integration, and automation capabilities. 
 - Own the engineering strategy, technical roadmap, execution plan, and delivery outcomes for Unify Energy in alignment with product strategy, customer commitments, revenue goals, and long-term platform direction. 
 - Build strong working partnerships with oil and gas business leaders, customers, Product Management, Implementation, and Customer Success to understand industry workflows, prioritize the highest-value problems, and convert business outcomes into clear engineering plans.

 - Oversee the full software development lifecycle, from discovery and architecture through development, testing, deployment, monitoring, support, and continuous improvement. 
 - Drive delivery of scalable, secure, and maintainable capabilities that support energy information ingestion, normalization, indexing, classification, validation, search, retrieval, workflow, and reporting. 
 - Advance platform capabilities that enable Access to serve as a trusted steward of customers' physical and digital information assets by supporting metadata management, intuitive search, filtering, navigation, and map-based discovery within the SaaS platform. Lead the data engineering capabilities required to ingest, organize, and enrich customer data so it becomes more accessible, useful, and valuable across oil and gas workflows. 
 - Guide integration strategy for industry and enterprise systems, including data exchanges, APIs, batch interfaces, identity services, content repositories, GIS or spatial data, analytics platforms, and customer-specific systems of record. 
 - Lead data engineering and data quality practices for high-volume structured and unstructured information, including ETL/ELT, metadata management, lineage, reconciliation, observability, and reliable downstream consumption. 
 - Guide responsible use of AI and machine learning to improve document understanding, metadata extraction, classification, entity matching, search relevance, workflow recommendations, quality assurance, and operational efficiency. 
 - Ensure solutions are designed with appropriate attention to cybersecurity, privacy, records retention, legal hold, auditability, data residency, regulatory obligations, customer controls, and business continuity. 
 - Establish outcome-based planning and measurement. Define engineering and business KPIs for major initiatives, including delivery predictability, quality, reliability, adoption, customer value, operational efficiency, and revenue or retention impact. 
 - Partner with Architecture, Information Security, DevOps, Quality Engineering, Data Engineering, and Operations to establish technical standards, reusable patterns, release controls, service-level objectives, and operational readiness.

Job Title: Production & Quality Manager (Agro-Processing: Rice, Dal, & Flour Mills)

Location: Rai, Sonipat Haryana

Experience Level: 8-10 Years

Employment Type: Full-time

Job Overview

We are seeking an experienced Production & Quality Manager with 8 to 10 years of hands-on experience in agro-processing operations, specifically across rice mills, dal (pulse) mills, and flour (atta/maida) mills. 

In this dual-responsibility leadership role, you will oversee end-to-end plant operations, optimizing daily production yield, reducing downtime, ensuring strict adherence to quality assurance (QA/QC) standards, and managing food safety protocols (FSSAI, ISO, HACCP). 

Key Responsibilities

1. Production & Operational Management

- Oversee daily production targets and processing capacity for rice milling (cleaning, parboiling, husking, polishing, sorting), dal processing (dehulling, splitting, polishing), and flour milling (cleaning, conditioning, roller milling, sifting). 
 - Plan and execute production schedules to meet sales demands while optimizing machine efficiency and yield recovery rates. 
 - Monitor raw material intake (paddy, raw pulses, wheat) and manage yield loss/wastage at each processing stage. 
 - Lead preventive and predictive maintenance schedules for mill machinery (sorters, destoners, hullers, roller mills, plan sifters, dryers, and automated packaging lines) to minimize operational downtime. 
 - Drive continuous improvement (Kaizen/Lean principles) to lower energy consumption, operational costs, and processing losses. 2. Quality Assurance & Quality Control (QA/QC)

- Develop, implement, and maintain Quality Management Systems (QMS) across raw material receiving, in-process milling, and finished product packaging. 
 - Perform grading, moisture testing, grain inspection, purity checks, foreign matter identification, and milling recovery tests. 
 - Ensure strict adherence to food safety standards, hygienic manufacturing practices (GMP), and sanitation protocols (FSSAI, HACCP, ISO 22000). 
 - Manage internal and external audit compliance, maintaining all quality logs, batch records, and traceability metrics. 
 - Handle customer complaints regarding quality, conduct root-cause analysis (RCA), and implement corrective/preventive actions (CAPA). 3. Team Leadership & People Management

- Lead, mentor, and supervise shift supervisors, machine operators, quality technicians, and plant labor. 
 - Manage workforce allocation, shift rosters, and safety training to ensure zero workplace hazards. 
 - Conduct regular performance evaluations and skill-building workshops for plant staff. Required Qualifications & Skills

- Educational Background: B. Tech / B. E. in Food Technology, Agricultural Engineering, Chemical Engineering, or B. Sc / M. Sc in Food Science / Chemistry. 
 - Experience: 8 to 10 years of direct production and quality control experience in rice milling, pulse/dal processing, or wheat flour milling plants. 
 - Technical Knowledge: 
 - Deep understanding of milling mechanics (Bühler, Sortex, or similar automated processing machinery). 
 - Strong expertise in grain science (moisture absorption, breakage control, bran separation, gluten levels, mesh/particle sizing). 
 - Expertise in FSSAI regulations, HACCP principles, ISO 22000, and pest control management. 
 - Core Competencies: Yield optimization, preventive maintenance planning, analytical troubleshooting, team leadership, and budget management. Work Environment & Physical Demands

Leveraging its strong foundation in marine robotics, underwater inspection, and non-destructive evaluation (NDT), Planys integrates defence-grade electronics, sensing, and data analytics to deliver highreliability systems suitable for harsh operational environments. Required Qualifications

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics & Communication Engineering, Instrumentation Engineering, or a related discipline. 
 - 2-5 years of experience in electrical system integration, validation, testing, or qualification. 
 - Strong understanding of electrical schematics, wiring, connectors, PCB assemblies, and embedded electronic systems. 
 - Hands-on experience with electrical test equipment such as oscilloscopes, multimeters, power analyzers, signal generators, insulation resistance testers, and data acquisition systems. 
 - Experience in troubleshooting complex electrical and electronic systems. 
 - Familiarity with defence, aerospace, robotics, automotive, marine, or industrial embedded systems is preferred. 
 - Exposure to environmental qualification and EMI/EMC testing will be an advantage.

data.title: Senior Principal Software Engineer JIRA Search
data.description:
Overview

Jira Platform

Vision

Jira Platform will enable Jira to become the trusted, agent-native system of record and control plane for human and agent teamwork at enterprise scale. 

To Turn This Vision Into Reality, We Propose To Focus On The Three Forces We Believe Will Work Together To Create The Flywheel That Will Be Jira Platform, Helping Drive The Engine That Is Jira

AI TRANSFORMATION: Make Jira the agent‐native system of record and control plane for human+AI teamwork. 

ENTERPRISE READINESS Continue to invest in Enterprise features, and take advantage of the limited-time window due to Project Ascend to bring the world's largest and most demanding enterprises into the Cloud

EFFICIENCY As the underlying platform serving Jira cloud customers, and a growing agentic workload, we need to provide a platform that has sound unit economics, accelerates developer productivity, and delivers world-class reliability. 

Your future team

Jira Scalable Issue Search (JSIS) is a foundational investment in Jira platform, moving structured searches from a database-backed engine to OpenSearch. Operating at approximately 3 billion requests per day, JSIS is one of Atlassian's largest services. Its multi-tenant, distributed architecture positions search to deliver the performance and scale customers expect as Jira grows. 

More than 50 engineers across India and Europe, working alongside product managers, are driving this transformation. At JSIS's scale, every release can affect customers across geographies, making reliability, performance, and customer impact central to the team's decisions. This combination of technical depth and product focus gives the team the capacity to address adoption barriers while improving the search experience. 

The long-term opportunity extends beyond search: JSIS will provide the foundation for federated search across Jira portfolios and, ultimately, a shared search capability across Atlassian products. Building for that future will position the platform to support new search experiences and the higher request volumes anticipated from agentic APIs-turning today's architectural migration into a strategic advantage for the broader ecosystem. 

Responsibilities

- Own the technical evolution and long-term architecture of the team, shaping strategy for enterprise-scale data movement, governance, resiliency, and data health. 
 - Lead the largest architectural initiatives across Jira Platform, from strategy and milestones through delivery, adoption, and customer outcomes. 
 - Define and drive a 12-24 month roadmap for shared platform primitives, identify gaps, and make clear trade-offs on priorities. 
 - Raise standards for reliability, performance, observability, security, and operational excellence across systems handling critical enterprise data. 
 - Provide hands-on technical leadership via design reviews, deep investigations, incident reviews, and high-risk problem solving while mentoring Principal and senior engineers. 

Qualifications

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience
 - 12+ years of experience developing large scale distributed systems. 
 - 4+ years of experience providing architectural oversight and technical leadership. 
 - SQL/No-SQL datastores - preferably Postgresql and Opensearch
 - Data streaming (Kafka/Flink) and CDC eventing
 - Soft skills - Driving complex step-change initiative across distributed cross-org setup with influence/buy-in from senior leadership

We are looking for an Engineering Manager to lead our software engineering team in Bengaluru. This is a hands-on role. You'll spend roughly half your time writing and shipping production code - React, modern JavaScript- alongside the team. The other half is people, process, and direction: growing engineers, making architectural calls, and keeping delivery on track. 

You'll lead a team of Staff ReactJS/NodeJS Frontend Engineers, Senior Backend Engineers, and Senior Quality Engineers. We also expect you to be an active AI engineer - someone who uses tools like Claude Code, Cursor, and GitHub Copilot in daily work, not just someone who knows they exist. 

Key Responsibilities

- Team Leadership & Development:

 - Stay current with the team's stack: ReactJS, Node. js, Java/Spring Boot, relational and NoSQL databases, cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP), and CI/CD pipelines.

 - Project Delivery & Execution:

Required Qualifications

- Experience: 10+ years of progressive experience in software engineering, including at least 3+ years in a technical leadership or engineering management role. 
 - Technical Acumen: Strong foundational knowledge and practical experience in modern web development technologies, including: 
 - Frontend: Deep understanding of ReactJS, modern JavaScript (ES6+), TypeScript, and related state management libraries. 
 - Backend: Expertise in building scalable distributed systems using Java/J2EE (Spring Boot preferred) and/or Node. js. 
 - Databases: Experience with relational (e. g. , Oracle) and NoSQL databases (e. g. , MongoDB, Cassandra).

 - Quality Assurance Mindset: A strong understanding of software quality principles, test automation strategies (Jest, React Testing Library, Cypress), and CI/CD pipelines, with a commitment to delivering high-quality software. 
 - System Design: Experience in designing and architecting highly scalable, performant, and resilient web applications and services. 
 - Cloud & DevOps: Familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP) and containerization technologies (Docker, Kubernetes). 
 - Agile Methodologies: Demonstrated experience leading teams in an Agile/Scrum environment. 
 - Leadership & Mentorship: Proven ability to lead, mentor, and grow engineering teams. Strong communication skills, written and verbal. 
 - Problem Solving: Strong analytical and decision-making ability in complex technical and organizational situations. 
 - AI Engineering: Hands-on experience with agentic coding tools (Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, or similar) in real production work. You should have opinions on how these tools change the way code gets written and reviewed - not just awareness that they exist.

Preferred Qualifications

We are looking for an experienced and technically competent Manager - SMS Electrical & Instrumentation to lead electrical maintenance, instrumentation, automation, and control system activities in the Steel Melting Shop (SMS). The role involves ensuring reliable operation of SMS equipment, minimizing electrical and instrumentation breakdowns, optimizing maintenance practices, and supporting uninterrupted steel production. 

The position will be responsible for planning and executing preventive, predictive, and breakdown maintenance, managing electrical and instrumentation teams, ensuring equipment reliability, and implementing automation and process control improvements. The candidate should have strong hands-on experience in electrical and instrumentation maintenance of SMS equipment, particularly induction furnaces, ladle refining furnaces, continuous casting machines, and associated auxiliary systems. 

Key Responsibilities

A. Electrical Maintenance & Equipment Management

- Oversee electrical maintenance of SMS equipment, including induction furnaces, LF, CCM, EOT cranes, cooling systems, and auxiliary equipment. 
 - Ensure reliable operation of HT/LT systems, transformers, motors, MCCs, PCCs, VFDs, and electrical distribution networks. 
 - Plan and execute preventive, predictive, and breakdown maintenance activities. 
 - Monitor electrical equipment performance and implement corrective actions to minimize downtime. B. Instrumentation & Automation

- Oversee maintenance of PLC, SCADA, HMI, sensors, transmitters, control panels, and automation systems. 
 - Ensure reliable functioning of temperature, pressure, flow, level, and other process measurement instruments. 
 - Monitor and troubleshoot automation systems, control loops, interlocks, and process instrumentation. 
 - Coordinate with OEMs and technical teams for automation upgrades and system improvements. C. Maintenance Planning & Shutdown Management

- Prepare preventive maintenance schedules and annual maintenance plans. 
 - Plan and execute electrical and instrumentation maintenance during scheduled shutdowns. 
 - Conduct root cause analysis of recurring failures and implement reliability improvement measures. 
 - Monitor critical spares, maintenance budgets, and inventory requirements. D. Team Management & Safety

- Lead and supervise electrical and instrumentation engineers, supervisors, technicians, and contractors. 
 - Ensure compliance with electrical safety procedures, LOTO, work permits, and statutory requirements. 
 - Conduct technical training and improve team competency. 
 - Ensure compliance with applicable IMS, ISO, and EHS requirements. E. Performance Monitoring & Reporting

- Monitor equipment availability, breakdown frequency, and maintenance costs. 
 - Maintain electrical and instrumentation maintenance records and performance reports. 
 - Identify opportunities for improving equipment reliability, automation, and energy efficiency. 
 - Coordinate with SMS Operations, Mechanical, and other departments for smooth production activities. 

Key Performance Expectations

- Ensure high availability and reliability of SMS electrical and instrumentation equipment. 
 - Minimize electrical, instrumentation, and automation-related breakdowns. 
 - Ensure timely execution of preventive and predictive maintenance schedules. 
 - Maintain reliable operation of PLC, SCADA, VFDs, electrical drives, and instrumentation systems. 
 - Reduce equipment downtime through effective troubleshooting and root cause analysis. 
 - Ensure timely execution of shutdowns and major maintenance activities. 
 - Optimize maintenance costs and critical spare inventory. 
 - Ensure compliance with electrical safety standards and applicable statutory requirements. 

Required Qualifications & Skills

- B. E. / B. Tech in Electrical / Electronics & Instrumentation Engineering. 
 - 12-15 years of experience in electrical and instrumentation maintenance within the steel manufacturing industry. 
 - Strong hands-on experience in SMS electrical and instrumentation maintenance. 
 - In-depth knowledge of induction furnaces, ladle refining furnaces, continuous casting machines (CCM), and associated auxiliary systems. 
 - Strong knowledge of HT/LT systems, transformers, motors, MCCs, PCCs, VFDs, and electrical protection systems. 
 - Practical experience in PLC, SCADA, HMI, automation systems, sensors, transmitters, and process instrumentation. 
 - Knowledge of control circuits, interlocks, drives, and industrial communication systems. 
 - Experience in preventive, predictive, and breakdown maintenance practices. 
 - Experience in shutdown planning, commissioning, troubleshooting, and equipment reliability improvement. 
 - Knowledge of electrical safety, LOTO, earthing, and statutory compliance requirements. 
 - Experience in team handling, contractor management, and maintenance cost control. 
 - Good analytical, problem-solving, leadership, and coordination skills. 

Preferred Experience: 

- Candidates with 12-15 years of experience in SMS Electrical & Instrumentation maintenance in integrated steel plants will be preferred. 
 - Experience in induction furnace, LF, CCM, EOT crane electrical systems, and industrial automation. 
 - Candidates with proven experience in PLC/SCADA systems, VFDs, electrical troubleshooting, and maintenance team management will be given preference.

HMI Software Lead Developer- UAV Ground Control Systems (VC++, MFC, Win32)

Location: Hyderabad, India (On-site)

About the Role

We are seeking a highly technical and hands-on Software Lead to take ownership of our core Ground Control Station (GCS) and mission planning applications. In the mission-critical UAV sector, our ground control software acts as the central nervous system for flight operations, telemetry monitoring, and payload management. You will lead a dedicated engineering pod to architect, modernize, and scale our Windows-based applications, ensuring rock-solid reliability for complex flight profiles. 

What You Will Do

- Technical Leadership: Lead the architecture, design, and development of high-performance desktop applications used for UAV mission planning, live telemetry tracking, and payload control. 
 - Core Development: Write, review, and optimize complex multithreaded code using VC++, MFC, and Win32 APIs for Windows environments. 
 - Team Mentorship: Guide a team of software engineers, enforcing rigorous code quality, memory management practices, and peer review standards. 
 - Systems Integration: Interface ground software with UAV flight controllers and communication links using protocols like MAVLink, UDP/TCP, and custom serial interfaces. 
 - Safety & Compliance: Champion aerospace software standards (such as DO-178C guidelines where applicable) to ensure mission-critical reliability and fault tolerance. 
 - Legacy Modernization: Strategically decouple and refactor legacy MFC codebases into modular architectures to support future cross-platform or UI/UX scaling. 

What You Bring

- Experience: 6+ years of hands-on software development with a minimum of 2+ years in a technical leadership or team lead capacity. 
 - Core Stack: Deep, uncompromising expertise in C++, VC++, Microsoft Foundation Classes (MFC), and Win32 API. 
 - Concurrency: Strong command of multithreading, asynchronous I/O, IPC, and memory leak profiling in a Windows environment. 
 - Networking: Proven experience with network socket programming (TCP/UDP) for real-time, low-latency data streaming. 
 - Problem Solving: Exceptional debugging skills using Visual Studio tools, WinDbg, and performance profilers. 

- Standout Qualifications (Nice to Have)Prior experience in the aerospace, defense, or UAV industry developing GCS or avionics software. 
 - Familiarity with geographic information systems (GIS), map rendering (GDAL, QtLocation), or 3D rendering (OpenGL/DirectX). 
 - Knowledge of aerospace safety-critical verification processes (DO-178C, DO-330). 

Why Join Us?

You will be directly influencing the software that commands next-generation unmanned aerial systems. We offer a culture of high engineering rigor, competitive compensation, and the opportunity to build products that solve real-world logistical and defense challenges. 

How to Apply

Apply job here on LinkedIN. OR

data.title: Manager - Quality Management System (QMS)
data.description:
VACANCY FOR

MANAGER - QMS (Quality Management System and Process Owner)

Company Description: 

Established in 2009, Revata Engineering Pvt. Ltd. is a manufacturer of high-performance elastomers, sealing solutions, precision-machined components and oilfield products, serving customers primarily in the oil and gas sector. The company's head office and manufacturing facility are located at M. I. D. C. , Bhosari, Pune. Revata is certified to ISO 9001: 2015 and operates its own NABL-accredited material testing laboratory. 

Role Description: 

We are seeking an experienced Manager - QMS to take complete ownership of the company's Quality Management System. The incumbent will build the QMS around the actual flow of an order, from enquiry and contract review through purchase, production and inspection to dispatch. This includes defining what information each department receives, records and hands over, so that orders move through the plant without delays and every failure can be traced to its root cause. 

A key objective of the role is to take the company through API Spec Q1 certification. The role covers the design, implementation and maintenance of the QMS in line with API Spec Q1 and ISO 9001: 2015, including processes, SOPs, forms and formats, internal and external audits, customer QMS requirements and root cause analysis of nonconformities. The position reports to the Director, Operations & Technology, with direct access to the Managing Director on audit results, customer nonconformities and management review. Product inspection and release will continue to be handled by the QC team. 

This is a hands-on role that requires close interaction with all departments and a regular presence on the shop floor. 

Key Responsibilities: 

·            Own and maintain the company-wide QMS in accordance with API Spec Q1 and ISO 9001: 2015, and drive its continual improvement. 

·            Lead the company to API Spec Q1 certification, including the gap assessment against the 10th Edition, the implementation plan and timeline, internal readiness audits and the certification audit. 

·            Map the end-to-end business process from enquiry to dispatch, covering contract review, engineering, planning, purchase, stores, production, inspection and dispatch, and define clear inputs, outputs and responsibilities at each interface between departments. 

·            Prepare and maintain all QMS documentation, including system procedures, work instructions, SOPs, master lists, forms and formats, and ensure they are practical and easy to use on the shop floor. 

·            Establish and manage document and record control, including numbering, revision, approval, distribution, control of obsolete documents and record retention as per API Spec Q1. 

·            Define ownership for every procedure, form and record, and conduct training for each department on its applicable documents. 

·            Ensure contract review is carried out for every purchase order, and establish order-level quality planning, including inspection and test plans, material traceability and the documentation package issued by QC (inspection reports, material certificates and certificates of conformance). 

·            Manage the nonconformance and CAPA system across all departments, lead cross-functional root cause analysis (8D, 5 Why, fishbone) and verify the effectiveness of corrective actions before closure. 

·            Handle customer audits and respond to customer complaints and QMS nonconformities with root cause and corrective action reports within agreed timelines, including completion of customer supplier-qualification questionnaires. 

·            Plan, coordinate and face ISO 9001: 2015 surveillance and recertification audits, as well as API Spec Q1 audits once certification is achieved, and ensure timely closure of all findings. 

·            Plan and conduct internal audits as per the annual audit schedule, ensuring auditor independence. 

·            Prepare inputs for management review, conduct the review with the Managing Director and track action items to closure. 

·            Establish and maintain the risk assessment, contingency planning and management of change (MOC) processes as required by API Spec Q1. 

·            Work with Purchase on supplier evaluation and approval, maintenance of the approved supplier list, supplier performance monitoring and supplier corrective action requests. 

·            Ensure calibration, preventive maintenance, training and competency records are maintained by the respective departments as per the QMS. 

·            Define quality objectives and present a monthly QMS performance report covering nonconformities, CAPA status, customer complaints, audit findings, on-time delivery and cost of poor quality. 

·            Support the ERP implementation team in moving QMS forms and records onto the ERP platform. 

·            Coordinate with the NABL-accredited laboratory, which operates under ISO/IEC 17025, to ensure clear interfaces between the laboratory and the QMS. 

·            Raise nonconformities against any department where required and escalate unresolved issues to the Managing Director. 

Who Should Apply: 

Candidates who have independently established or restructured a QMS in a manufacturing organization under API Spec Q1, IATF 16949 or ISO 9001: 2015, and led it through certification and customer audits. The candidate should have experience in defining cross-functional processes and preparing procedures and formats that are used across departments. 

Experience in a make-to-order, low-volume, high-mix manufacturing environment such as oilfield equipment, valves, sealing products, forgings or precision machining will be preferred. Shortlisted candidates may be asked to present sample procedures or formats prepared by them, with confidential information removed. 

Must Have Qualifications: 

BE / BTech in Mechanical, Production, Industrial or Polymer Engineering, or equivalent. 

10 to 15 years of experience in manufacturing quality, with at least 5 years in a role responsible for the company's QMS. 

Proven experience in establishing a QMS from scratch or restructuring an existing one within the last seven years, including leading the certification audit. 

Has led, or played a key role in, taking an organization through API Spec Q1 or IATF 16949 certification, along with hands-on experience in implementing ISO 9001: 2015.
