data.title: VP, Engineering
data.description:
We're looking for a VP, Engineering This role is Office Based, Hyderabad Office

Vice President, Engineering

Cornerstone OnDemand | Executive Leadership | Remote-Flexible

About Cornerstone

Cornerstone helps organizations unlock the potential of their people through technology, content, expertise and specialized focus. Its solutions span learning, talent management, performance, recruiting and workforce development, serving millions of users across thousands of organizations worldwide. 

Cornerstone is embarking on a transformative journey to build WorkforceOS, a next-generation, AI-native Human Capital Management (HCM) platform that unifies the employee lifecycle into a single, intelligent operating system for the modern workforce. 

WorkforceOS will connect employee data, skills intelligence, learning, performance, talent and workforce capabilities to help organizations make smarter workforce decisions, develop their people and build the capabilities needed for the future. 

About The Opportunity

We are seeking a Vice President, Engineering to be a founding member of the WorkforceOS leadership team. 

This is an opportunity to define and build the technology foundation for a next-generation enterprise HCM platform. You will own the end-to-end engineering strategy, technical vision, architecture and execution for WorkforceOS, building a scalable, secure, resilient and AI-native platform that can serve global enterprise customers. 

You will have end-to-end ownership of the WorkforceOS engineering organization and technology architecture, with the autonomy to make key technology decisions and establish the engineering practices needed to build and scale the platform. You will partner with Cornerstone's centralized platform teams and engineering organizations across business lines to leverage shared capabilities, drive interoperability and ensure alignment with enterprise technology standards. 

A key aspect of this role will be balancing greenfield platform development with the modernization and reuse of existing Cornerstone technology and capabilities. You will also lead the technology strategy for transitioning customers from legacy HCM platforms to WorkforceOS, ensuring seamless migrations with minimal customer disruption, effort and business impact. 

You will build and lead a world-class global engineering organization spanning application engineering, platform engineering, AI/ML, data engineering, quality engineering, infrastructure and reliability engineering. 

Working in close partnership with Product Management, Design, Data Science and the broader Cornerstone technology organization, you will translate product vision into an exceptional technology platform and customer experience. 

This role requires a strong technology leader who combines architectural depth, engineering excellence, operational discipline and the ability to build and scale high-performing engineering organizations. 

In this role you will. . . 

- Technology Vision & Architecture
 - Define and own the technology vision, engineering strategy and end-to-end architectural direction for WorkforceOS. 
 - Architect and build a modern, cloud-native, API-first and AI-native enterprise HCM platform designed for global scale. 
 - Establish a modular, extensible and interoperable architecture that supports multiple HCM capabilities while enabling a unified employee and administrator experience. 
 - Own architecture decisions across application services, platform services, data architecture, integration frameworks and shared capabilities. 
 - Establish platform foundations that enable rapid product innovation, extensibility, configuration and customization without compromising upgradeability or maintainability. 
 - Drive a balanced technology strategy that leverages and modernizes existing Cornerstone capabilities while introducing new technology and architectural foundations where needed. 
 - Ensure seamless integration with Cornerstone's existing products, enterprise ecosystem and third-party platforms. 
 - Drive technology choices and architectural trade-offs that balance speed to market, scalability, cost efficiency, reliability and long-term maintainability. 
 - Establish architecture standards, design principles, technical governance and engineering best practices for WorkforceOS. 
 - Partner with centralized platform engineering and architecture teams to leverage shared infrastructure and services, drive interoperability and align with enterprise-wide technology standards, while retaining end-to-end ownership of WorkforceOS architecture. 
 - AI-Native Engineering & Innovation
 - Lead the engineering strategy for building AI-native capabilities into WorkforceOS. 
 - Establish the technical foundations for intelligent agents, AI-powered workflows, predictive intelligence, skills inference and personalized experiences. 
 - Drive the integration of large language models, machine learning, retrieval-augmented generation and agentic AI capabilities into enterprise workflows. 
 - Build secure and scalable AI infrastructure, including model orchestration, evaluation frameworks, observability, governance and cost management. 
 - Establish standards for responsible AI, data privacy, security, explainability and human oversight. 
 - Partner with Product Management and Data Science to identify and accelerate opportunities where AI can fundamentally simplify workflows and create differentiated customer value. 
 - Drive adoption of AI-assisted software engineering and modern developer tools to improve engineering productivity, quality and speed. 
 - Continuously evaluate emerging technologies and translate relevant innovations into competitive platform capabilities. 
 - Engineering Execution & Delivery Excellence
 - Own end-to-end engineering execution and delivery of the WorkforceOS product roadmap. 
 - Establish a high-performance engineering operating model that enables predictable delivery, rapid iteration and continuous innovation. 
 - Partner closely with Product Management to translate product strategy into executable technical plans, milestones and delivery commitments. 
 - Drive engineering productivity through modern development practices, automation, developer platforms and AI-assisted software engineering. 
 - Establish strong engineering disciplines across architecture and design reviews, code quality, testing, continuous integration, continuous delivery and release management. 
 - Drive a culture of engineering ownership, accountability and continuous improvement. 
 - Ensure engineering teams can deliver at speed without compromising quality, security or architectural integrity. 
 - Establish appropriate engineering metrics to measure delivery predictability, productivity, quality and customer impact. 
 - Continuously improve engineering effectiveness through automation, standardization, simplification and adoption of modern development practices. 
 - Platform Reliability, Security & Operational Excellence
 - Own the reliability, availability, scalability, performance and operational excellence of the WorkforceOS platform. 
 - Build a secure-by-design platform that meets the requirements of large, complex global enterprises. 
 - Establish robust practices for identity and access management, data protection, encryption, tenant isolation and regulatory compliance. 
 - Drive observability, incident management, disaster recovery, business continuity and service-level objectives. 
 - Ensure the platform is designed for high availability, resilience and predictable performance across global markets. 
 - Establish effective DevSecOps, Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) and platform engineering capabilities. 
 - Drive continuous improvement in cloud infrastructure efficiency, platform performance and total cost of ownership. 
 - Ensure enterprise-grade security, privacy and compliance requirements are addressed in partnership with Cornerstone's central security and compliance organizations. 
 - Data & Integration Architecture
 - Define the data architecture and engineering foundations that enable a unified workforce data model across WorkforceOS. 
 - Establish robust data ingestion, processing, storage and integration capabilities to support real-time and analytical workloads. 
 - Enable a consistent and extensible data foundation for employee records, organizational structures, skills intelligence, talent and workforce insights. 
 - Drive the development of enterprise APIs, event-driven architecture and integration frameworks. 
 - Ensure seamless connectivity with HRIS, payroll, ERP, identity management and other enterprise systems. 
 - Enable secure data access and interoperability across Cornerstone products and third-party ecosystems. 
 - Partner with Product and Data Science to establish the data foundations needed for AI, analytics and intelligent decision-making. 
 - Establish data governance, quality, lineage and lifecycle management practices that support enterprise-grade workforce data. 
 - Customer Migration & Platform Transformation 
 - Own the engineering strategy and technical execution for transitioning customers from Cornerstone's legacy HCM platforms to WorkforceOS. 
 - Design scalable, repeatable and highly automated migration frameworks that enable seamless customer transitions with minimal customer effort and business disruption. 
 - Develop strategies for data migration, transformation, validation and reconciliation, ensuring data integrity, accuracy, security and continuity throughout the migration lifecycle. 
 - Establish migration tooling, automation, compatibility frameworks and processes that accelerate customer onboarding and reduce migration costs. 
 - Design phased migration, coexistence and cutover strategies that allow customers to transition at scale while maintaining business continuity. 
 - Ensure continuity of critical customer workflows, integrations, configurations, historical data and user experiences during migration. 
 - Build robust validation, monitoring, rollback and recovery mechanisms to minimize migration risks and ensure customer confidence. 
 - Partner with Product Management, Customer Success, Professional Services and other customer-facing teams to define migration approaches that minimize customer involvement and accelerate time to value. 
 - Establish migration success metrics, including migration velocity, automation levels, data accuracy, customer effort, disruption and time to completion. 
 - Drive continuous improvements in migration efficiency and scalability, enabling the business to transition its installed customer base to WorkforceOS at scale. 
 - Engineering Organization & Leadership
 - Build, lead and develop a high-performing global engineering organization from the ground up, with end-to-end ownership across application engineering, platform engineering, AI/ML, data engineering, quality engineering, infrastructure and SRE. 
 - Recruit, develop and retain exceptional engineering leaders, architects and engineers across multiple technology disciplines. 
 - Establish the engineering organizational structure, technical leadership model and operating cadence needed to support WorkforceOS. 
 - Build a strong culture of engineering excellence, ownership, innovation, collaboration and accountability. 
 - Develop strong technical leadership and career progression frameworks, creating opportunities for engineers to grow and take on increasing responsibility. 
 - Establish clear engineering ownership across platform, product domains, infrastructure, data and AI capabilities. 
 - Drive a culture of continuous learning, technical experimentation and adoption of modern engineering practices. 
 - Build an inclusive and globally distributed engineering organization that can scale with the business. 
 - Develop an engineering talent strategy that attracts exceptional talent and creates a high-performance environment. 
 - Cross-Functional & Executive Partnership
 - Work closely with the GM of WorkforceOS to translate business strategy and product vision into technology strategy, investment priorities and execution plans. 
 - Partner closely with the VP of Product Management to jointly drive product delivery, roadmap execution, technical feasibility and customer outcomes. 
 - Establish strong partnerships with engineering and technology leaders across Cornerstone's business lines to drive architectural alignment, platform integration, technology reuse and ecosystem interoperability. 
 - Collaborate with GMs and product leaders across business lines to identify opportunities for shared technology investments, integration and innovation. 
 - Work closely with Cornerstone's CTO, CPO and broader technology leadership to align WorkforceOS with the company's technology strategy, architectural standards and long-term platform vision. 
 - Partner with centralized platform teams to leverage common infrastructure, services and capabilities while maintaining clear ownership and accountability for WorkforceOS engineering outcomes. 
 - Drive effective engineering operating cadences, technical reviews, delivery governance and executive communication. Partner with Sales, Customer Success and strategic customers to address technical requirements, enterprise architecture considerations and complex customer engagements. 
 - Represent WorkforceOS in executive forums, customer engagements and strategic technology discussions. 

You've Got What It Takes If You Have

- 18+ years of experience in software engineering and technology leadership, with significant experience building enterprise-scale software platforms. 
 - 8+ years of experience leading large engineering organizations, including managing senior engineering leaders. Proven experience building and scaling complex, multi-tenant enterprise SaaS platforms. 
 - Strong architectural expertise across cloud-native systems, distributed computing, microservices, APIs, event-driven architecture and enterprise integration. 
 - Demonstrated ability to design and deliver highly available, secure and scalable enterprise software. 
 - Experience building AI-enabled platforms or integrating AI, machine learning and generative AI capabilities into enterprise products. 
 - Strong understanding of data architecture, analytics platforms, data engineering and enterprise data governance. 
 - Experience establishing and scaling engineering organizations, technical leadership structures and engineering operating models. 
 - Proven track record of delivering complex, multi-year technology programs with strong execution discipline. 
 - Experience with cloud platforms, DevSecOps, SRE, CI/CD and modern software engineering practices. 
 - Experience with large-scale enterprise platform modernization, customer migrations or technology transformations is highly desirable. 
 - Demonstrated ability to work across organizational boundaries and influence technology decisions in complex, global engineering environments. 
 - Excellent communication, strategic thinking and executive stakeholder management skills. 
 - Experience leading globally distributed engineering teams. 

Leadership Attributes

- Technology Visionary: Able to define the technology foundation for a next-generation enterprise platform and make sound long-term architectural decisions. 
 - Engineering Craftsman: Sets high standards for architecture, software quality, engineering practices and operational excellence. 
 - AI-First Technologist: Understands how AI will transform software development, enterprise platforms and business workflows. 
 - Execution Focused: Converts ambitious technology strategies into predictable, high-quality delivery. Platform Thinker: Balances individual product requirements with reusable platform capabilities, extensibility and long term scalability. 
 - Customer Focused: Understands the importance of customer experience during platform transformation and prioritizes seamless migrations with minimal disruption. 
 - Transformation Leader: Has experience modernizing legacy platforms and executing complex technology transformations while maintaining business continuity. 
 - Organizational Builder: Has demonstrated the ability to build strong engineering organizations and develop exceptional technical leaders. 
 - Business Oriented: Understands the connection between engineering investments, product differentiation, customer outcomes and business growth. 
 - Collaborative Leader: Builds strong partnerships with Product, Design, Data Science and the broader technology organization. 

The Opportunity

This is a unique opportunity to architect and build the technology foundation of a category-defining, AI-native HCM platform. You will shape the engineering organization, platform architecture and technical culture that will power the future of WorkforceOS, while leading the transformation of Cornerstone's HCM technology and customer base onto this next-generation platform. 

Our Culture

Spark Greatness. Shatter Boundaries. Share Success. Are you ready? Because here, right now - is where the future of work is happening. Where curious disruptors and change innovators like you are helping communities and customers enable everyone - anywhere - to learn, grow and advance. To be better tomorrow than they are today. 

Who We Are

At Cornerstone, we believe in AI that works in the service of people, amplifying their judgment to drive high-performing, future-ready organizations forward. Cornerstone Workforce AITM, the intelligence platform for workforce readiness, brings together workforce and labor market data into a proprietary Cornerstone People GraphTM, translating signals into intelligence, targeting learning where it matters, developing critical skills, and surfacing hidden talent. Delivered as an open, enterprise platform across whatever application your people work in every day, Cornerstone Workforce AI is built for scale, security, and trust, with certified AI guardrails. As an industry leader, Cornerstone is helping approximately 7, 000 organizations, 140M+ users, across 186 countries build continuous workforce readiness. 

Check us out on LinkedIn , Comparably , Glassdoor , and Facebook !

data.description:

Company Description

Impel Ferrocast is a specialist in high-performance precision grey and ductile iron castings, offering low lead times, competitive pricing, and adherence to global industry standards. Established in 1994 and renamed in 2022, the company has grown into a leading supplier of superior-quality cast components for sectors such as automotive, power generation, hydraulics, agriculture, valves, and pumps. Impel Ferrocast partners with original equipment manufacturers and international brands to deliver end-to-end solutions, from prototype development to full-scale production runs and urgent shortage management. Its modern, state-of-the-art plant combines advanced technologies with expert technical teams to support rapid product development and robust Production Part Approval Process (PPAP). The organization is committed to continual improvement, customer-focused service, and staying current with emerging trends and best practices in the casting industry. 

Role Description

The Foundry Production Manager is responsible for overseeing all aspects of foundry operations, ensuring safe, efficient, and high-quality production of castings. This full-time, on-site role is based at the Impel Ferrocast facility in Coimbatore and involves managing daily melting, molding, core making, and pouring activities, as well as coordinating machining and finishing schedules. The role includes planning and monitoring production targets, optimizing resource utilization, and implementing continuous improvement initiatives to meet delivery, cost, and quality objectives. The Foundry Production Manager will lead and develop production teams, enforce safety and environmental standards, and collaborate closely with quality, maintenance, supply chain, and engineering functions. The position also requires supporting PPAP activities, resolving production issues, and maintaining strong communication with internal stakeholders and customers regarding capacity, timelines, and technical requirements.

data.description:
Work Schedule

Standard (Mon-Fri)

Environmental Conditions

Office

Thermo Fisher Scientific Inc. is the global leader in scientific solutions, generating an annual revenue of around $40 billion. Our Mission is to empower our customers to enhance global health, environmental cleanliness, and safety. Whether our customers are expediting research in life sciences, resolving intricate analytical issues, improving laboratory efficiency, advancing patient well-being through diagnostics, or pioneering life-altering therapies, we are committed to providing unwavering support. 

About The Team

Our Automation, AI, and Data (AAD) team empowers Thermo Fisher colleagues to integrate cutting-edge digital solutions into their daily workflows, enhancing innovation and efficiency. Our goal is to democratize automation, AI, and data, remove bottlenecks, and to bring clarity to new ways of working that prepare us for the future. By leveraging these advancements, we are better equipped to serve our customers and support our mission to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer. 

Role Overview

We are seeking a Senior Engineering Manager - Automation & AI Engineering to lead the design, delivery, and scaling of enterprise automation solutions while building the engineering capabilities to deliver Generative AI and Agentic AI initiatives. This role combines engineering leadership, technical strategy, people management, and delivery excellence to drive digital transformation. 

Key Responsibilities

Engineering Leadership

- Lead, mentor, and grow a high-performing Automation & AI engineering team. 
 - Establish engineering standards, best practices, and delivery governance. 
 - Own end-to-end delivery of enterprise automation solutions using UiPath and related technologies. 
 - Provide technical oversight for solution architecture, integrations, security, scalability, and production support. 
 - Collaborate with business, architecture, and platform teams to deliver measurable business outcomes. 
 - Build the roadmap for adopting Generative AI, Agentic AI, LLMs, and AI Agents within automation solutions. 
 - Partner with business stake holders in improving business outcomes using Automation and AI technologies

 - Hire, coach, and develop engineering talent while fostering a culture of innovation and continuous learning. 

Required Skills & Experience

- 15+ years in Software Engineering, Automation, or Enterprise Application Development. 
 - At least 5 years of experience in people management as an Engineering Manager or Sr Engineering Manager
 - Proven experience in leading engineering teams delivering enterprise-scale solutions. 
 - Strong hands-on experience with UiPath RPA, including Orchestrator, AI Center, Action Center, Document Understanding, queues, assets, triggers, robots, and deployment management. 
 - Experience with Agile, DevOps, CI/CD, SDLC, and engineering governance. 
 - Exposure to Generative AI, LLMs, OpenAI, Agentic AI, RAG, and AI Agents is highly desirable.

 - Experience conducting feasibility assessments, ROI analysis, process assessments, automation opportunity identification, and solution estimation. 
 - Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to translate business needs into practical, scalable, and value-driven technical solutions. 
 - Ability to communicate complex technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. 
 - Strong leadership, stakeholder management, mentoring, documentation, and presentation skills. 

Success Profile

The ideal candidate is an engineering leader who can build and scale teams, drive enterprise automation delivery, and establish the technical foundation for future GenAI and Agentic AI capabilities, balancing technical excellence with business impact.

data.title: Full Stack Engineer
data.description:
Join us as a Full Stack Engineer where you will spearhead the evolution of our infrastructure and deployment pipelines, driving innovation and operational excellence. You will harness cutting-edge technology to build and manage robust, scalable and secure infrastructure, ensuring seamless delivery of our digital solutions. 

To be successful as Full Stack Engineer you should have experience with: 

- Strong expertise in Java, Spring Boot, Microservices, REST APIs, JPA/Hibernate, and Test-Driven Development (TDD). 
 - Hands-on experience with ReactJS, Redux, JavaScript, HTML5, and modern front-end development frameworks. 
 - Strong knowledge of Oracle, MongoDB, PostgreSQL, SQL and NoSQL database technologies. 
 - Experience with containerized application development and deployment using OpenShift/Kubernetes. 
 - Hands-on experience with GitLab, CI/CD pipelines, SonarQube, Wiz, Prisma, Maven/Gradle and DevSecOps practices. 
 - Experience with messaging technologies such as IBM MQ, Kafka, or similar event-driven platforms. 
 - Experience working in Agile delivery teams within Banking or Financial Services environments. 
 - Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent. 

Some Other Highly Valued Skills May Include

- Experience leading development teams, code reviews, mentoring and technical decision-making. 
 - Knowledge of payment systems, corporate banking, lending, or transaction banking domains. 
 - Experience with observability and monitoring tools such as Grafana, Kibana and Splunk. 
 - Strong understanding of application security and secure coding practices. 
 - Experience in modernizing legacy applications to microservices-based architectures. 
 - Knowledge of Domain Driven Design (DDD), Event-Driven Architecture and API-led integrations. 

You may be assessed on key critical skills relevant for success in role, such as risk and controls, change and transformation, business acumen, strategic thinking and digital and technology, as well as job-specific technical skills. 

The role is based out of Pune. 

Purpose of the role

To design, develop and improve software, utilising various engineering methodologies, that provides business, platform, and technology capabilities for our customers and colleagues. 

Accountabilities

- Development and delivery of high-quality software solutions by using industry aligned programming languages, frameworks, and tools. Ensuring that code is scalable, maintainable, and optimized for performance. 
 - Cross-functional collaboration with product managers, designers, and other engineers to define software requirements, devise solution strategies, and ensure seamless integration and alignment with business objectives. 
 - Collaboration with peers, participate in code reviews, and promote a culture of code quality and knowledge sharing. 
 - Stay informed of industry technology trends and innovations and actively contribute to the organization's technology communities to foster a culture of technical excellence and growth. 
 - Adherence to secure coding practices to mitigate vulnerabilities, protect sensitive data, and ensure secure software solutions. 
 - Implementation of effective unit testing practices to ensure proper code design, readability, and reliability. 

Assistant Vice President Expectations

- To advise and influence decision making, contribute to policy development and take responsibility for operational effectiveness. Collaborate closely with other functions/ business divisions. 
 - Lead a team performing complex tasks, using well developed professional knowledge and skills to deliver on work that impacts the whole business function. Set objectives and coach employees in pursuit of those objectives, appraisal of performance relative to objectives and determination of reward outcomes
 - If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L - Listen and be authentic, E - Energise and inspire, A - Align across the enterprise, D - Develop others. 
 - OR for an individual contributor, they will lead collaborative assignments and guide team members through structured assignments, identify the need for the inclusion of other areas of specialisation to complete assignments. They will identify new directions for assignments and/ or projects, identifying a combination of cross functional methodologies or practices to meet required outcomes. 
 - Consult on complex issues; providing advice to People Leaders to support the resolution of escalated issues. 
 - Identify ways to mitigate risk and developing new policies/procedures in support of the control and governance agenda. 
 - Take ownership for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work done. 
 - Perform work that is closely related to that of other areas, which requires understanding of how areas coordinate and contribute to the achievement of the objectives of the organisation sub-function. 
 - Collaborate with other areas of work, for business aligned support areas to keep up to speed with business activity and the business strategy. 
 - Engage in complex analysis of data from multiple sources of information, internal and external sources such as procedures and practises (in other areas, teams, companies, etc). to solve problems creatively and effectively. 
 - Communicate complex information. 'Complex' information could include sensitive information or information that is difficult to communicate because of its content or its audience. 
 - Influence or convince stakeholders to achieve outcomes. 

All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship - our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset - to Empower, Challenge and Drive - the operating manual for how we behave.

data.title: Principal Core Infrastructure Engineer
data.description:
Job Description

Leads development and begins architecting components of scalable, elastic distributed systems. Defines and enforces scalability requirements for owned components; optimizes code and data paths for high‐throughput, hyper‐scale workloads; and leverages data plane platforms for large‐scale retrieval, storage, and processing. Designs fault‐tolerant, in‐service‐upgradable systems using redundancy, replication, failover, and policies for partitions, applying load‐shedding, throttling, and rate‐limiting to handle network unreliability while meeting SLOs. Establishes KPIs and telemetry; builds proactive dashboards and alerts; and designs complex validation (fault injection, brownouts), replication, and synchronization for correctness and durability. Proactively diagnoses and resolves production issues, mentors peers, and ensures operational readiness. Implements robust security controls, executes remediation, maintains compliance documentation, and develops IaC and automation that enable safe patching, updates, and rollbacks within change‐management plans. 

Responsibilities

Key Responsibilities

System Design & Architecture - System Scalability: 

-Lead the development and implementation, and begin to architect, components of scalable distributed systems that support horizontal and vertical scaling to meet system demands, including leveraging distributed state management tools. 

-Optimize code and/or systems for large-scale data processing and high-throughput requirements to support hyper-scale systems. 

-Define scalability requirements for owned components and ensure design and implementation requirements are met. 

-Design systems to scale with elasticity (e. g. , effectively scaling both up and down). 

-Leverage data plane platforms to effectively handle large-scale data retrieval, storage, and processing. 

-Design performance and load testing. 

System Design & Architecture - System Reliability Design: 

-Build and design fault-tolerant components and systems capable of withstanding in-service updates by implementing redundancy, replication, and automatic failover mechanisms. 

-Design systems to effectively handle service disruptions (e. g. , network partitions) by prioritizing consistency, availability, or partition tolerance. 

-Implement and optimize approaches to handle network unreliability, including load-shedding, throttling, and rate-limiting. 

-Design components and systems that are durable and adhere to service level objectives (SLOs), setting expectations for availability and durability of other computing services within the department. 

System Design & Architecture - System Reliability Performance: 

-Define key performance indicators (KPIs) and telemetry to identify gaps or issues in running systems. 

-Build and customize moderately complex dashboards, telemetry systems, and alerting mechanisms to proactively monitor components and system health. . 

System Design & Architecture - Correctness / Availability: 

-Design and implement functional and correctness requirements for feature sets and/or systems in new or existing systems. 

-Design complex test scenarios (e. g. , fault-injection, brown-out) to evaluate system correctness. 

-Implement data replication and synchronization techniques to maintain data integrity and availability. 

Operational Troubleshooting & Incident Management: 

-Take a proactive role in diagnosing, debugging, and resolving issues in active components and systems to support ongoing operation, and mentor others in these processes. 

-Implement strategies to prevent interruptions, ensuring no maintenance windows are required for customers and users when resolving issues. 

-Maintain expertise in owned components and systems to ensure effective troubleshooting and performance. 

-Meet operational readiness expectations through design and implementation. 

-Serve in operational support rotations, providing guidance in incident response and root cause investigations. 

Compliance & Security: 

-Implement robust security measures to protect data and applications in multi-tenant environments, including encryption techniques and access controls. 

-Execute remediation plans to address identified security gaps. 

-Ensure cloud infrastructure is in compliance with industry standards and regulations and that documentation is up to date. 

Automation & Change Management: 

-Develop and maintain automation scripts and tools (e. g. , Infrastructure as Code (IaC)) to manage cloud infrastructure. 

-Create and adhere to change management plans for patching, updating, and rolling back applications, and begin designing systems and components to allow for automation of these processes. 

Core Responsibilities

Planning & Execution: 

-Manages and coordinates moderately complex tasks, monitoring timelines and deliverables to ensure timely completion and adherence to requirements for a moderately-sized project or initiative. Efficiently delegates, monitors, and prioritizes work across multiple projects, providing technical oversight and adjusting plans to address shifts in resources or timelines. 

Collaboration & Partnership: 

-Collaborates across the organization to align on expectations and achieve shared objectives. Leverages understanding of business leaders, stakeholders, and/or customers to ensure proposed solutions meet their needs. Supports inclusivity by actively seeking and listening to diverse perspectives, ensuring others feel heard and respected. 

Problem Solving: 

-Identifies and addresses moderately complex issues by analyzing a wide range of data and/or information to identify solutions in accordance with standard practices. Proactively escalates unresolved or critical issues with a thorough assessment and suggests potential solutions. Reviews, contributes to, and documents problem solving strategies. 

Continuous Learning: 

-Pursues learning opportunities to expand knowledge and skills and/or tools in new areas and stays abreast of the latest industry trends and best practices. Proactively seeks and leverages ongoing feedback and training to improve skills. Coaches and mentors junior team members, fostering continuous learning and knowledge sharing within and across teams. 

Continuous Improvement:

Solicits feedback from others on ideas for alternative approaches and methods for continued improvement.

data.description:
Job Description: Principal Software Engineer - AI Platforms & Knowledge Graphs

Role: Principal Software Engineer - AI/LLM Platforms

Experience: 10-15+ years

Level: Principal Engineer / Technical Architect

Domain: Enterprise AI, Knowledge Graphs, Generative AI, Distributed Systems

About The Role

We are looking for a highly accomplished Principal Software Engineer to lead the architecture, design, development, and evolution of enterprise-scale AI platforms, knowledge graph systems, and intelligent applications. 

The ideal candidate brings deep expertise in distributed systems, scalable software architecture, knowledge graphs, Large Language Models (LLMs), and production-grade AI engineering. 

This is a hands-on technical leadership role requiring strong engineering fundamentals, architectural depth, and the ability to build, deploy, scale, and maintain complex AI-powered systems for enterprise customers. 

The candidate should have practical experience working with multiple LLMs, understand their capabilities, limitations, and performance trade-offs, and be capable of making informed architectural decisions to deliver reliable, secure, and cost-efficient AI solutions. 

Key Responsibilities

- Enterprise Knowledge Graph Engineering
 - Architect, design, develop, and maintain scalable enterprise knowledge graph platforms. 
 - Build knowledge ingestion, entity extraction, relationship mapping, entity resolution, and graph enrichment pipelines. 
 - Design graph data models, ontologies, taxonomies, and semantic relationships. 
 - Develop high-performance graph querying, retrieval, and reasoning capabilities. 
 - Integrate knowledge graphs with enterprise data sources, applications, and AI systems. 
 - Implement GraphRAG, hybrid retrieval, and context-aware search architectures. 
 - Ensure scalability, reliability, data consistency, and performance of graph-based systems. 
 - AI & LLM Platform Engineering
 - Lead the architecture and development of production-grade AI applications leveraging Large Language Models. 
 - Design and implement RAG, GraphRAG, agentic AI, and intelligent workflow solutions. 
 - Integrate and orchestrate multiple proprietary and open-source LLMs, including GPT, Claude, Gemini, Llama, and other emerging models. 
 - Evaluate LLM capabilities, reasoning quality, latency, context handling, accuracy, cost, and suitability for different use cases. 
 - Develop model-agnostic architectures enabling flexible model selection, routing, and fallback strategies. 
 - Optimize prompt engineering, context management, inference performance, token consumption, and operational costs. 
 - Build LLM evaluation frameworks, monitoring, guardrails, and observability capabilities. 
 - Address hallucinations, retrieval quality, grounding, security, and reliability challenges in enterprise AI applications. 
 - Scalable Systems Architecture
 - Architect highly scalable, fault-tolerant, distributed systems supporting enterprise workloads. 
 - Design cloud-native, microservices-based, asynchronous, and event-driven architectures. 
 - Build high-throughput data pipelines and low-latency APIs. 
 - Drive performance engineering, horizontal scaling, caching, concurrency, and infrastructure optimization. 
 - Design secure, multi-tenant systems with robust isolation and enterprise-grade availability. 
 - Make architectural trade-offs across performance, reliability, maintainability, and cost. 
 - Production Engineering & Platform Reliability
 - Own the end-to-end engineering lifecycle, from architecture and implementation to production deployment and ongoing maintenance. 
 - Establish engineering standards for CI/CD, automated testing, deployment, monitoring, and incident management. 
 - Implement observability, distributed tracing, performance monitoring, and operational diagnostics. 
 - Drive system reliability, availability, security, and operational excellence. 
 - Troubleshoot complex production issues across distributed systems, graph databases, and LLM integrations. 
 - Continuously improve scalability, response times, resource utilization, and infrastructure costs. 
 - Technical Leadership
 - Provide technical direction and architectural leadership across engineering teams. 
 - Lead complex system design discussions, architecture reviews, and technology evaluations. 
 - Mentor senior engineers and establish strong software engineering practices. 
 - Collaborate with product, AI/ML, data engineering, infrastructure, and customer-facing teams. 
 - Translate complex enterprise requirements into robust technical solutions. 
 - Take ownership of critical architectural decisions and long-term platform evolution. 
 - Remain hands-on with design, coding, prototyping, debugging, and performance optimization. 

Required Qualifications & Experience

- 10-15+ years of software engineering experience, including significant experience designing and operating large-scale distributed systems. 
 - Strong proficiency in Python, Java, Go, or equivalent backend programming languages. 
 - Demonstrated experience architecting, developing, and maintaining enterprise-scale software platforms. 
 - Hands-on experience building and deploying knowledge graph or graph-based data systems. 
 - Strong understanding of graph databases, graph algorithms, semantic modeling, and knowledge retrieval. 
 - Practical experience building production AI applications using LLMs. 
 - Experience integrating multiple LLM providers and understanding model-specific capabilities, limitations, and engineering trade-offs. 
 - Strong understanding of RAG architectures, embeddings, vector databases, and hybrid retrieval. 
 - Expertise in cloud technologies such as AWS, Azure, or GCP. 
 - Experience with microservices, containers, Kubernetes, APIs, and distributed data processing. 
 - Strong knowledge of system design, scalability, concurrency, reliability, and performance optimization. 
 - Proven ability to independently drive complex engineering initiatives from design to production. 

Preferred Technical Experience

Knowledge Graph & Data Technologies

- Neo4j, Amazon Neptune, RDF, SPARQL, Cypher
 - Ontology Modeling, Entity Resolution, Graph Algorithms
 - Elasticsearch, OpenSearch, Graph Databases
 - Vector Databases: Pinecone, Weaviate, Milvus, pgvector

Generative AI & LLM Frameworks

- OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, Google Gemini, Llama, Mistral
 - LangChain, LlamaIndex, LangGraph
 - GraphRAG, Agentic RAG, Hybrid RAG
 - Embedding Models, Reranking, Semantic Search
 - Model Context Protocol (MCP), Tool Calling
 - LLM Evaluation, Observability, Guardrails

Scalable Architecture & Infrastructure

- AWS / Azure / GCP
 - Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform
 - Kafka, Redis, PostgreSQL
 - Distributed Systems, Microservices, Event-Driven Architecture
 - CI/CD, Monitoring, Distributed Tracing
 - High Availability, Fault Tolerance, Performance Engineering

What Makes an Ideal Candidate

We Are Particularly Interested In Engineers Who

- Have built and operated real enterprise-scale systems, not just prototypes or proof-of-concepts. 
 - Have designed knowledge graph platforms and solved real-world challenges around ingestion, retrieval, graph performance, and scalability. 
 - Understand the nuances of different LLMs and know when and why to use a particular model. 
 - Have experience taking AI applications from experimentation to secure, reliable, cost-efficient production deployments. 
 - Can operate comfortably across AI engineering, backend systems, data architecture, and cloud infrastructure. 
 - Are strong hands-on engineers who can influence architecture and engineering practices across multiple teams. 
 - Demonstrate deep technical judgment, ownership, and the ability to solve ambiguous, complex engineering problems. 

Success in This Role

Success Will Be Measured By The Ability To

- Deliver robust and scalable knowledge graph and AI platform capabilities. 
 - Improve platform performance, reliability, and operational efficiency. 
 - Accelerate the development and production deployment of enterprise AI applications. 
 - Establish reusable architectural patterns and engineering standards. 
 - Reduce technical complexity and improve long-term platform maintainability. 
 - Enable engineering teams to deliver complex AI solutions with greater speed and quality. 

Core Keywords: Principal Software Engineer, AI Platform Architect, Enterprise Knowledge Graph, GraphRAG, Generative AI, LLM Engineering, Multi-LLM Orchestration, Agentic AI, RAG, Distributed Systems, Scalable Architecture, Graph Databases, Cloud-Native Systems, LLMOps, AI Observability, Enterprise AI Applications, Technical Leadership.

data.description:
Job Description

A flexible team of passionate developers working on real-time embedded software applications for broadband access products. 

We interact closely with our colleagues in Shanghai and have started contributing to the development of device virtualization that simulates and runs real world physical Nokia products on a cloud in a pure software based virtualized form. We work in an agile manner. 

As a team we also possess a deep understanding of the end-to-end functionality of our products, as our deliverables are gating for other SW application teams. The team consists of a mix of Software development and test engineers. 

Our goal is to bring our product innovations and evolutions to the market faster and at higher quality than the competition as part of a multi-disciplinary agile team of senior experts, supported by state-of-the-art development and test technologies, tools and processes. 

Getting Started with Us

You'll get ample opportunity to get acquainted with the organization, our way of working, and our products. During the training period, the team will support you with specific on-hands / on-the-job training. On top of that, you will have a wide variety of high-quality on-line training material at your disposal. Additionally, we make time to support each other when facing a next challenge and to celebrate achievements. 

How You Will Contribute And What You Will Learn

As part of our team, you will: 

- Acquire an overview of the broadband access products that Nokia offers and of the wide variety of hardware components present in our systems. 
 - Work on device virtualization that simulates and runs real-world physical Nokia products on a cloud in a pure software-based virtual platform. 
 - Collaborate with colleagues in Shanghai on the host framework development. 
 - Model new Hardware functionality in the host environment. 
 - Write test cases to validate the host simulation platform and automate them. 
 - Be accountable for the long-term quality of the software delivered. 

Key Skills And Experience

You have: 

- An engineering degree or a degree in Computer Science, Telecommunications, Electronics (or 5 years of relevant experience). 
 - Knowledge of real-time operating system concepts (interrupts, tasks, concurrency, etc. ). 
 - Ability to work fluently with Unix/Linux as an operating system. in particular Basic understanding of Linux networking: L2 forwarding, L3 routing, packet format, Linux bridge, Terminal Access Point /Virtual Ethernet interfaces. 
 - A high-level understanding of the hardware and software architecture of embedded Linux systems (e. g. , U-Boot, device tree, basic system buses like I2C (Inter-Integrated Circuit), (Quad)Serial Peripheral Interface, PCIexpress, Linux kernel, drivers, etc. ). 

It would be nice if you also had: 

- Knowledge of C/C++, Python, and Bash, Knowledge of virtualization and containers (e. g. , Docker). 
 - Eagerness and agility to learn quickly and embrace daily challenges and "Out-of-the-box" thinking. 
 - Capability of working independently after the necessary training. 
 - Fluency in English. 
 - Familiarity with Golang/Rust and Kubernetes (K8S) is a plus.

Position Overview

PayJoy is a mission-driven fintech company and Public Benefit Corporation committed to expanding financial inclusion for underserved consumers in emerging markets. Through ethical lending, transparent products, and innovative smartphone-based underwriting, PayJoy empowers millions to build credit, access essential technology, and achieve upward economic mobility. 

As the Senior Director of Engineering - International Squad, you will be PayJoy's founding engineering leader in India. Unlike other senior director roles at PayJoy that own a specific product domain, this role is intentionally cross-cutting. You will build and lead an international engineering squad that supports the full breadth of PayJoy's product portfolio, drives platform reliability and operational excellence, and owns the technical delivery of region-specific product initiatives for Southeast Asia and Africa. 

This is a greenfield opportunity. You will establish PayJoy's India engineering presence from scratch - hiring the team, setting the culture, defining local processes, and integrating a new site into PayJoy's established global engineering organization. The squad you build will contribute across Consumer products, Finance Engine, Lock platform, Payments, and Infrastructure, partnering closely with engineering and product leaders in the US, Mexico, and Colombia. 

You will operate as a player-coach: deeply technical, strategically minded, and capable of recruiting and mentoring a high-performing team in a new geography. This role demands someone who thrives in ambiguity, can build organizational muscle from scratch, and is energized by the challenge of connecting a new site to an established global engineering culture. 

This position is based in India (Bangalore, Mumbai, Chennai). It is a hybrid role with periodic travel to PayJoy's offices in San Francisco and Mexico City.

About The Job

Head of AI, Vertical AI Agents at Tamasha. live - India's Most Exciting Live Entertainment Platform. 

Location : Bangalore. 

Reporting to : Co-Founder. 

Team : AI. 

Type : Full-Time. 

Work mode : Onsite. 

About Tamasha. live

Tamasha. live is one of India's fastest-growing live entertainment and social gaming platforms, trusted by 2. 5 Million+ active users. Built on the belief that entertainment should be immersive, rewarding, and community-driven, Tamasha brings together games, creators, and live experiences in one vibrant ecosystem. Our growing portfolio of apps spans social connection, entertainment, and live gaming : Dosti, DostiPro, MastiPro, FriendChat, Playroom, Openly, Cricsignal, Prabhu ji and Audio Jockey. Now we are building the next layer : vertical AI agents that help people with everyday needs. Each agent is grounded in a domain and earns money from the real value it delivers, not by charging people to chat. 

The Role

You'll own the AI platform that every Tamasha agent runs on, and the business results those agents produce. The job is to make each agent predictable : it stays in character, remembers what matters, gets its domain right, and is safe and compliant, every time. This is a high-visibility role : you will report directly to the Co-Founder and work across Tamasha's multi-app ecosystem. 

What You'll Do

- Build the shared platform : a reusable agent framework, long-term memory, evaluations, guardrails and domain tools. 
 - Set the model strategy. Choose and combine open-source LLMs (Llama, Qwen, Gemma, Indic models), using hosted APIs only where they're worth it. Fine-tune (SFT, DPO, LoRA) when it improves quality or cuts cost. 
 - Own unit economics. Lower the cost per conversation with routing from small to large models, distillation, caching and quantised self-hosting. 
 - Make every agent predictable : persona consistency, memory design, accuracy, and safety on sensitive topics. 
 - Build evaluations, offline and online, including red-teaming, tied to conversation-to-transaction conversion and to retention. 
 - Work with domain experts to turn their knowledge into deterministic tools and grounded content. 
 - Protect user data : comply with the DPDP Act, and give users control over what agents remember. 
 - Hire, mentor and grow the AI team, starting with a Staff AI Engineer. 

What You'll Need

data.title: Lead Full-Stack AI Engineer
data.description:
Remote, full-time role for a Lead Full-Stack AI Engineer based in India. You will own the core platform of an AI-enabled drug-development product, working directly with the founder and a US-based Forward Deployed Engineer. A daily 3-hour overlap with US Pacific Time (typically Indian evenings) is required. 

Lead Full-Stack AI Engineer

Engagement Model: Full-Time / Employer of Record (EOR)

Compensation: Competitive Market Rate (Commensurate with Full-Stack & Multi-Agent AI Depth)

Location: India (Bengaluru, Hyderabad, or NCR preferred)

Target Experience: 5+ years of full-stack software engineering with demonstrable AI/Multi-Agent system depth, including 2+ years building and deploying production LLM / Multi-Agent AI systems. 

About INCEVO LLC

INCEVO LLC is a biopharmaceutical consulting firm delivering end-to-end program leadership, functional expertise, and BD due diligence to help life sciences companies advance therapies from discovery through regulatory approval. INCEVO is pioneering a proprietary AI-enabled drug-development platform- integrating real-time intelligence, regulatory insight, and predictive analytics to accelerate decision-making and de-risk portfolio investments - positioning the firm at the forefront of next-generation biopharma strategy. 

About the Role

We are seeking a Lead Full-Stack AI Engineer to take complete operational ownership of our core platform codebase-from database schemas and asynchronous backend microservices to responsive, highly polished user interfaces. In this high-velocity, high-agency role, you don't just write basic API wrappers; you build resilient, high-throughput systems that turn complex AI capabilities into fast, reliable enterprise product. You will work directly with the founder and our Forward Deployed Engineer to iterate product features, optimize LLM inference speeds, and enforce rigorous engineering standards across our stack. 

Why This Role Matters: As our Lead Full-Stack AI Engineer, you will own the technical engine powering our platform and drive it across the finish line into a polished, hardened, enterprise-ready product that performs flawlessly in live client programs. The domain problem is genuinely novel: orchestrating drug development with AI agents is an unsolved enterprise challenge, and you will build the UI components, backend microservices, and system reliability required to make it seamless for global pharma clients. If you want to architect production-grade agentic AI in one of the most important industries in the world, this is that role. 

What You'll Do

·            Drive Enterprise Production Polish & New Feature Surfaces: Refine, refactor, and expand our core web application (React, Next. js, TypeScript, Tailwind) to elevate it from a functional platform into a high-performance, enterprise-grade product. Own the addition of new UI components, micro-interactions, and backend workflows while maintaining clean, scalable frontend architecture. Translate client program needs into intuitive UI components with minimal friction. Incorporate architectural insights surfaced by our Forward Deployed Engineer from live client deployments to ensure new product surfaces reflect real enterprise client workflow needs. 

·            Architect Low-Latency Agentic Backends: Build and maintain asynchronous REST and WebSocket microservices (FastAPI / Node. js) handling multi-agent state persistence, tool calling, inter-agent orchestration (LangGraph), streaming tokens responses, and parallel data/document ingestion pipelines. Ensure every API endpoint is fast, reliable, and self-documenting. Performance and reliability under concurrent client load are non-negotiable. 

·            Optimize AI & RAG Pipelines: Implement, benchmark, and maintain production vector retrieval pipelines, hybrid search (BM25 + dense vector), evaluation harnesses (Ragas, TruLens), and multi-tier caching structures (Redis / semantic caching). Own execution repeatability and token efficiency across all LLM workflows. 

·            Ensure System Reliability & Observability: Write robust test suites (PyTest, Playwright), implement structured data validation (Pydantic), and build fallbacks and circuit-breakers for when downstream LLM APIs experience latency or outages. Proactively surface system bottlenecks before users encounter them - and translate reliability findings into concrete architectural improvements that make the platform progressively more resilient across every client deployment cycle. 

·            Maintain Engineering Hygiene: Strong Git discipline (atomic commits, clean rebase/PR workflows), structured pull requests, self-documenting code, and end-to-end CI/CD ownership (GitHub Actions). Every commit carries clear context and intentional changes. 

·            Collaborate Asynchronously: Operate autonomously with clear written documentation and maintain a mandatory 3-hour daily overlap with US Pacific Time for daily standup, sprint planning, and real-time collaboration. Work in close partnership with our US-based Forward Deployed Engineer - translating field-validated architectural requirements from live client deployments into platform improvements rapidly and precisely. Own the full handoff from architectural specification to live production code. 

You Might Thrive in This Role If You Have: 

·            Startup Velocity & High Agency: You care deeply about shipping clean, self-documenting code fast and iterating rapidly based on real user feedback. You flag blockers early and propose architectural solutions, not just problems. 

·            5+ Years of Full-Stack Engineering Depth: 5+ years of full-stack software engineering with demonstrable AI/Multi-Agent system depth, including 2+ years specifically spent building, deploying, and architecturally evolving production-grade LLM or Multi-Agent AI systems at enterprise scale. Strong proficiency across TypeScript, React/Next. js, Python (FastAPI/Pydantic), PostgreSQL, and Redis. 

·            Multi-Agent Systems & AI Expertise: Hands-on production experience with modern agentic frameworks (LangGraph, AutoGen, LlamaIndex workflows), structured JSON outputs, vector databases (Qdrant, Azure AI Search, pgvector), and API integrations (OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, NVIDIA NIM). You understand how LLM-based systems fail in production differently from traditional CRUD apps - and you make deliberate architectural decisions that prevent, detect, and recover from those failure modes at scale. 

·            Async & Performance Optimization Mastery: Deep working knowledge of Python asyncio, streaming token consumption, memory management, time-to-first-token (TTFT) reduction, and API rate-limit/retry handling. You know when to reach for a WebSocket versus a polling endpoint and why it matters for perceived performance. 

·            Azure Stack Familiarity: Practical experience with Azure Container Apps, Azure PostgreSQL, Azure Blob Storage, and Azure AI Search. Familiarity with Azure AD SSO and Key Vault is a strong advantage. You treat client program data with the same care a regulated pharmaceutical company would. 

·            Engineering Hygiene & IP Security: Strong Git workflow discipline (atomic commits, clean PR reviews, rebase hygiene), full CI/CD ownership via GitHub Actions, and clear written technical communication in English that non-technical stakeholders can act on. You treat INCEVO's codebase, agent architecture, and client program data as proprietary assets - maintaining strict IP security standards at every stage of development, deployment, and offboarding. 

·            Cross-Functional Engineering Collaboration: You work effectively with a US-based Forward Deployed Engineer who owns client-facing deployments and brings real-world architectural requirements from the field. You translate those requirements into platform improvements rapidly and precisely - closing the loop between client reality and core engineering execution. 

·            Biopharma or Life Sciences Context (Significant Advantage): Prior experience building software for pharmaceutical, clinical research, or regulated healthcare environments - including familiarity with clinical data schemas (ClinicalTrials. gov, CDISC), regulatory submission workflows, or GxP system validation concepts - is a meaningful differentiator. The founding team provides full domain context; what we need from you is the technical stack mastery and execution speed. 

Equal Opportunity & Confidentiality

·            Equal Opportunity Employer: INCEVO LLC is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate all qualified candidates regardless of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, or other legally protected characteristics. We believe that building AI systems for high-stakes, complex domains requires diverse perspectives, deep intellectual curiosity, and rigorous engineering standards. 

·            Work Authorization & Intellectual Property: All offers and engagements are contingent upon the successful execution of INCEVO LLC's standard Non-Disclosure Agreement (NDA) and Intellectual Property (IP) Assignment Agreement prior to commencement. For international engagements, employment is administered in full compliance with local labor laws via our authorized Employer of Record (EOR) platform.

data.title: QA Engineer - SDET
data.description:
About Us

Phyllo is a data gateway that allows social data to be accessed from source platforms (e. g. YouTube, Twitch, Upwork, Shopify, etc. ). We build the underlying infrastructure that connects with every creator platform, maintain a live data feed to the systems used by these platforms to manage creators' data, and provide a normalized data set so that businesses can use creators' data in a simple yet impactful way. Website: https: //www. getphyllo. com/

About The Role

As an SDET, you will take ownership of automation quality for assigned product areas across APIs, SDKs and web applications. You will design scalable automation solutions, strengthen regression coverage, integrate tests into CI/CD pipelines and proactively identify quality risks before they reach production. . 

This is an automation-first, hands-on role. You will build test suites that run on every code change, use AI tools to write and maintain tests faster, and review that AI output with a critical eye. You will work side by side with product managers and engineers to agree on what "working" means before code is written, and coach your team to grow from testers into automation engineers. 

What you'll be expected to do

- Build and own test automation (UI and API)
 - Set the test automation strategy: what to automate, at which level (API, contract, UI), and what to keep for exploratory testing. 
 - Design and maintain API test automation in code, covering functional, schema/contract, negative, authentication and data-accuracy checks against our OpenAPI specs. 
 - Build reliable end-to-end UI test suites using sound design patterns (page objects, stable locators, isolated test data) so tests stay fast and trustworthy. 
 - Run automated tests in CI/CD on every pull request and release, with clear quality gates and fast feedback to engineers. 
 - Use AI coding assistants and agents to draft test plans, generate scripts and test data, and triage failures, and review every AI-generated test as carefully as human-written code. 
 - Verify that data flowing through our APIs is complete, correct and consistent across platforms, including pagination, webhooks and rate limits. 
 - Track and reduce flaky tests, and report quality metrics (coverage, escaped defects, flake rate, pipeline time) that the team acts on. 
 - Work closely with product and engineering
 - Work with product managers early to turn requirements into clear acceptance criteria and test scenarios before development starts. 
 - Partner with engineers on testability, test data and shared ownership of quality. 
 - Reproduce and debug issues using logs, network traces and API responses, and give engineers precise, actionable bug reports. 
 - Explain quality risks and release status in plain language to product, engineering and leadership. 

You'll be a good fit if

- 3-5 years of experience in quality engineering, with at least 2 years building test automation (not only running manual tests). 
 - Hold a BS in Computer Science or have an equivalent combination of technical education and work experience. 
 - Write solid code in at least one language used for test automation: TypeScript/JavaScript, Python or Java. 
 - Have deep hands-on experience automating REST API tests in code (e. g. Playwright, REST
 - Assured, pytest, SuperTest), with a solid grasp of HTTP, OAuth/API-key authentication, JSON schemas and OpenAPI. Postman experience is welcome, but API tests must live in code and CI. 
 - Have built a UI automation framework with a modern tool such as Playwright (preferred), Cypress or Selenium. 
 - Run tests in CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins or similar) and work daily with Git, pull requests and code reviews. 
 - Use AI coding assistants regularly in your testing work, and can tell when an AI-generated test is wrong, shallow or passing for the wrong reason. 
 - Are comfortable debugging with logs, browser dev tools and SQL. 
 - Communicate and collaborate clearly, with the confidence to challenge unclear requirements with product managers and engineers. 

Nice to Have

- AI-driven UI testing: Playwright Test Agents (planner, generator, healer) or Playwright MCP used with coding agents such as Claude Code, Cursor or GitHub Copilot. 
 - AI-assisted API testing: Postman Agent Mode, KushoAI, or Keploy (regression tests generated from recorded API traffic). 
 - Agentic testing platforms: AI-native platforms such as testRigor, mabl, Katalon or QA. tech
 - Contract and schema testing: Pact, Specmatic, or Schemathesis (property-based and fuzz testing from OpenAPI specs). 
 - Testing AI features: Evaluating LLM-powered features with tools such as Promptfoo, DeepEval, LangSmith or Langfuse, including golden datasets and LLM-as-judge scoring. 
 - Performance testing: k6, JMeter or Gatling. 
 - Mobile testing: Appium or similar, for testing SDKs on Android and iOS. 
 - Accessibility: Automated checks with axe or similar, and familiarity with WCAG. 
 - API security: OWASP API Security Top 10 and basic API security testing. 
 - Infrastructure and reporting: Docker, cloud test environments (we run on Google Cloud), and reporting tools such as Allure, TestRail or Xray. 
 - Domain: Familiarity with social and creator platform APIs (YouTube, Instagram, TikTok and similar). 

What We Offer

- Hybrid Working Environment: Work both from the office and remotely as needed for a better work-life balance
 - Flexible Hours: Choose to work in the hours you feel the most productive
 - Innovate and Evolve: We're building a high-growth, high-autonomy culture. We rely less on job titles and more on cultivating an environment where anyone can contribute, the best ideas win, and personal growth is driven by expanding impact

What's in it for you?

We invest in our people and believe in hiring for high-potential and humble individuals who can rapidly grow their responsibilities as the company scales. You will infuse insights and ideas into business decision-making, solutions strategy, and the innovation roadmap for each product. 

Do you truly want to make a difference and revolutionize the creator economy through data? If yes, Phyllo is the perfect place for you.

Role Summary

We're hiring a Data Engineer with Python backend development experience to build scalable data pipelines and services. The role combines data engineering with backend API development, including integrating data platforms with applications and AI agents. 

The ideal candidate has hands-on experience with Python, SQL, Databricks, and Apache Spark. They should also understand REST APIs, relational and NoSQL databases, and how to improve Spark workloads for performance and scale. 

Key Responsibilities

- Design, build, and maintain data ingestion and ETL/ELT pipelines using Python, SQL, Databricks, and Spark/PySpark. 
 - Integrate data from APIs, databases, files, and third-party systems. 
 - Develop and maintain backend services and REST APIs using Python frameworks such as FastAPI, Flask, or Django. 
 - Build API integrations that allow applications and AI agents to access approved data and services. 
 - Design and work with relational and NoSQL databases, including schemas, data models, and queries. 
 - Optimize Spark jobs and Databricks workloads for performance, scalability, and cost. 
 - Apply distributed computing principles to process large datasets reliably. 
 - Implement data validation, error handling, logging, and monitoring. 
 - Troubleshoot pipeline, API, and database issues in development and production environments. 
 - Write tests and documentation, and participate in Git, code reviews, CI/CD, and deployment workflows. 
 - Collaborate with data, backend, AI/ML, product, and application teams. 

Basic Qualifications and Experience: 

- Master's OR Bachelor's degree in IT/Computer Science/Engineering. and 12 to 17 years of work experience

Required Skills

- Strong Python development skills. 
 - Strong SQL skills and experience with relational databases. 
 - Hands-on experience with Databricks and Apache Spark/PySpark. 
 - Experience building data pipelines and integrating data from multiple sources. 
 - Experience developing or integrating REST APIs. 
 - Working knowledge of NoSQL databases. Hands-on experience integrating APIs with AI agents or AI/ML applications. 
 - Understanding of Spark performance optimization, scalability, and distributed systems. 
 - Familiarity with Git, testing, debugging, and production support. 
 - Strong problem-solving and communication skills. 

Good to Have

- Experience with FastAPI, Flask, or Django. 
 - Experience with Delta Lake, Azure Data Lake, or Azure Data Factory. 
 - Familiarity with Airflow, Kafka, Docker, or Kubernetes. 
 - Experience with authentication and authorization for APIs. 
 - Experience supporting GenAI or machine learning data pipelines. 

Preferred Candidate Profile

We're looking for someone who can work across the data and backend layers: ingest and transform data, store it in suitable relational or NoSQL systems, and expose it through APIs for applications or AI agents. 

The candidate should be able to design, build, optimize, test, and support a solution such as: 

Source systems → Databricks/Spark processing → relational or NoSQL storage → Python API → application or AI agent
