data.description:
Job Description Summary

About our business

GE Vernova is a planned, purpose-built global energy company that includes Power, Wind, and Electrification segments and is supported by its accelerator businesses of Advanced Research, Consulting Services, and Financial Services. Building on over 130 years of experience tackling the world's challenges, GE Vernova is uniquely positioned to help lead the energy transition by continuing to electrify the world while simultaneously working to decarbonize it. 

At GE Vernova, our Hydro Power division stands at the forefront of the hydroelectricity generation industry. We are dedicated to designing, manufacturing, and installing cutting-edge equipment for hydroelectric power plants, as well as servicing and refurbishing existing facilities to ensure optimal performance and longevity. Our turbines and generators account for over 25% of the total installed hydropower capacity worldwide. With a dynamic team of 3, 600 professionals spread across more than 30 countries, we have the energy to change the world. Be part of a team that is not only shaping the energy landscape but also contributing to a more sustainable planet. Join us and make a difference with GE Vernova's Hydro Power business division!

Read more on www. gevernova. com

Job Description

About Position

As a Lead Engineer Control System, you will be responsible for project execution activities on Control System design and working for Hydro Control System COE. 

You will work autonomously and deliver as directed and under supervision of the Main Package Engineer (MPE, Control System COE) for the project or by the Control System Engineering Manager. 

You will perform hardware and software design of the various hydro Control system packages for one or more projects, on own DCS or on 3rd party control solutions. 

Role & Responsibilities

Work on power plant control system design deliverables, networking and cybersecurity solutions involving PLC, IO devices, Server configuration and deployment, network architectures, switch configuration and trouble shooting. Install and configure servers, network managed Switches, Routers & Firewalls, etc. , for a power plant control environment (usually Rockwell, Mark VIe control system). Should be able to define VLANs & Network segmentation. Read processing notice, create Functional Analysis documents and perform SW programming, logics, creation of static and dynamic mimics as per P&ID and standard faceplates using Automation design tools (RS Logix, Studio 5000, FT View, Control ST, Cimplicity, Workstation ST, etc. ), HMI configuration, Alarm display, etc. , simulation testing of software. Perform Soft IO configuration for standard communication protocols prevailing in the industry (Modbus, IEC61850, IEC60870-104, DNP 3, etc. ). Perform interlocking design, wiring principles, etc. testing of control panels at GE Vernova workshop or supplier premises, support FAT, etc. Implement secure design practices in system design and software programming. Day-to-day activities include, but not limited to -

- Perform contract analysis, concept design, reverse engineering, prepare work-statement document. 
 - Document technical data generated for the assigned project. 
 - Review supplier documents (IO list, P&ID, Minfex data of partners) and prepare/update IO list. 
 - Create supplier technical specification for BTS or BTP DCS solution, coordinate with suppliers & do technical follow up. 
 - Prepare/update Logic programs, HMI mimics views as per P&ID and standard faceplates. 
 - Prepare and update OMM document. 
 - Track project schedule and implementation plan. 

Other job needs -

- Undertake occasional short-term travel to customer and supplier premises for technical discussions, design follow-up, testing, FAT, etc. 
 - Perform Site Survey activities, mapping existing systems and compile design inputs. 
 - Prepare de-commissioning and dismantling needs (manuals) for the system. 

Nature of Products/Projects - Power plant control system (BTS or BTP) Partnership - This role calls for cross-functional interface, positioned on control design, with coordination with several process partners and customers. Collaborations include, but not limited to, interface within Engineering functions including Product development (NPI), Supply Chain and Customer facing organizations. Personal responsibilities -

- Deliver trainings programs to internal and external customers. 
 - Work on quality & productivity improvement and cost-out actions. 
 - Perform interface engineering, Site Support. 
 - Development of standards and design practice guides and use in project. 
 - Collaborate with global teams on project execution activities. 

Qualifications

Bachelor of Engineering Degree in Electrical/Electronics/Instrumentation/Control from accredited college or university 8 to 14 years of Controls Engineering experience with at least 5 years relevant experience in PLC hardware design and software programming. Should be aware of applicable standards and best practices in DCS design, including HW design, SW logic and User interface (HMI) design, control cubicle design and cybersecurity solutions. Should be aware global Cybersecurity standards such as IEC62443 & NERC-CIP. Tools Expertise - Rockwell Automation/ Mark VIe/Siemens/ABB/Emerson, etc. based Control System tools (RS Logix, Studio 5000, FT View, Control ST, Cimplicity, Workstation ST, SCALA, SICAM) Preferred industry experience - Power, Large EPC, Oil & Gas. Good command over written and spoken English is mandatory for global stakeholder and customer management. 

Desirable

Working experience on Rockwell Automation or Mark VIe based Control System is preferred, however similar experience on other reputed DCS systems like Siemens, ABB, Emerson, etc. is acceptable. Candidate with exposure in Cybersecurity domain will be an advantage. Able to manage and resolve conflicts in a fast-paced project execution environment. Clearly communicate and listen. Guide and motivate fellow team members. 

What Do We Offer?

- Environment: A multicultural & diverse environment with an enthusiastic team and supportive leaders. We have a pleasant and modern work infrastructure at our offices. 
 - Opportunities: We offer career growth opportunities, professional and personal trainings
 - Benefits: We offer a competitive salary with multiple benefits like subsidized meals, medical, accidental & life insurance coverage. We provide home office opportunity and flexible working hours (subject to business and HR approval)

Work model: Hybrid (3days office)

Inclusion & Diversity: At GE Vernova, we believe in the value of your unique identity, background, and experiences. We are committed to fostering an inclusive culture, where everyone feels empowered to do their best work because they feel accepted, respected and that they belong. 

Please click here to learn more: www. gevernova. com/sustainability/thrive

Additional Information

data.title: SOC Engineering Manager (IP Subsystems)
data.description:
We Are

Synopsys is the leader in engineering solutions from silicon to systems, enabling customers to rapidly innovate AI-powered products. We deliver industry-leading silicon design, IP, simulation and analysis solutions, and design services. We partner closely with our customers across a wide range of industries to maximize their R&D capability and productivity, powering innovation today that ignites the ingenuity of tomorrow. 

You Are

You have spent years building and leading teams that deliver subsystems and SoCs that actually ship, not just pass reviews. The difference between a subsystem that integrates cleanly and one that causes months of debug downstream is something you see coming from the architecture phase, and you know how to steer your team away from those cliffs before anyone writes RTL. You are technical enough to review a timing constraint file or debug a CDC violation yourself, but you also know when to step back and let your engineers solve it. Managing remote teams does not intimidate you because you have learned that clarity, trust, and rhythm matter more than proximity. You can sit in a customer call, extract what they actually need from what they say they want, and walk out with a plan your team can execute against. You think in workflows, not just deliverables. Automation, reusable frameworks, and AI-enabled tooling are not buzzwords to you, they are levers you pull to make your team faster and your subsystems more predictable. You push back when a requirement is vague or a timeline does not match reality, and you do it in a way that keeps the relationship intact. 

What You'll Be Doing

- Lead the architecture, RTL design, integration, and front-end sign-off of DesignWare IP Subsystems from requirements through release
 - Manage a local engineering team in Bengaluru, driving execution across design, verification, and implementation while coordinating with global stakeholders
 - Own customer communication and requirements translation, ensuring deliverables align with what customers actually need and ship on time
 - Drive front-end implementation flows including synthesis timing closure using Fusion Compiler, SpyGlass CDC/RDC checks, low-power architecture, and Formality equivalence checking
 - Work hands-on when needed, reviewing RTL, debugging integration issues, authoring verification plans, or resolving critical bottlenecks in the subsystem lifecycle
 - Champion AI-enabled methods, workflow automation, and reusable engineering practices to improve team productivity, quality, and cycle time across subsystem programs
 - Collaborate across implementation, verification, DFT, and hardening teams to ensure clean handoffs and tape-out readiness

The Impact You Will Have

- Your subsystems will integrate into SoCs powering AI, automotive, 5G, and IoT products used by millions of people globally
 - You will shape how Synopsys subsystems are architected and delivered, setting the standard for quality, predictability, and execution velocity
 - Your team will deliver subsystems that reduce customer integration risk and accelerate their time to market
 - You will build a culture of automation and reuse that makes every subsequent program faster and more reliable
 - Your technical judgment will prevent costly late-stage design issues and keep programs on track through tape-out
 - You will mentor engineers who will go on to lead subsystem and SoC programs themselves
 - Your leadership will directly influence the adoption of AI-enabled workflows and modern engineering practices across the IP organization

What You'll Need

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electronics Engineering or related field with 10+ years of overall experience
 - 4 to 5 years managing engineering teams, ideally remote or distributed teams, with a track record of on-time delivery
 - Strong hands-on ASIC or SoC front-end design experience including RTL design, IP/subsystem integration, and taking designs from architecture through front-end execution
 - Deep expertise in at least one or two interface protocols such as AMBA (APB, AXI, CHI), DDR, PCIe, Ethernet, USB, UFS, or UCIe
 - Experience with front-end implementation flows including CDC/RDC checks using tools like SpyGlass or VC SpyGlass, UPF and low-power intent, design/timing constraints, and DFT handoff
 - Proficiency in SystemVerilog, TCL, Perl, or Python for RTL coding, scripting, and automation
 - Exposure to ASIC tape-out process, ideally at least one or two tape-outs, and understanding of how subsystems move through verification sign-off, DFT insertion, and hardening
 - Exposure to AI-enabled tools and automation frameworks applied to design, verification, or execution efficiency is a plus

Who You Are

- You can extract detailed technical requirements from high-level customer specifications and turn them into executable work packages your team understands
 - You motivate engineers by giving them clarity, autonomy, and air cover when things get messy, not by micromanaging their work
 - You understand verification well enough to evaluate test plans, coverage metrics, and debug strategies even if you are not writing testbenches yourself
 - You can explain a complex timing closure issue or a CDC violation to a customer or executive in two sentences without losing the technical nuance
 - You track progress across multiple moving pieces, five programs, three customers, two tool bring-ups, and you know which one needs your attention today
 - You push for automation and reuse not because it sounds good but because you have seen what happens when teams rebuild the same thing three times

The Team You'll Be Part Of

You will join the Digital IP Subsystems Team within Synopsys Solutions Group in Bengaluru. This team develops DesignWare IP Subsystem solutions that integrate multiple IP blocks into pre-verified, configurable subsystems, helping customers accelerate SoC development and reduce integration risk. The team works closely with IP design, verification, implementation, and customer engineering teams globally. Your recruiter will share more about the team structure, current programs, and roadmap during the interview process. 

Rewards And Benefits

We offer a comprehensive range of health, wellness, and financial benefits to cater to your needs. Our total rewards include both monetary and non-monetary offerings. Your recruiter will provide more details about the salary range and benefits during the hiring process.

Leadership principles. 

At McCain, our leadership principles guide how we engage with customers, collaborate as a team, and achieve success. We focus on understanding customer needs, driving innovation, empowering people, and taking ownership to clear obstacles and deliver results. 

AI & Digital Capabilities. 

At McCain, AI and digital capabilities are part of how we work and innovate. We value curiosity toward emerging technologies and the thoughtful, responsible use of AI-enabled tools to improve outcomes as part of our future-ready culture. 

The McCain Experience. 

We are McCain. This statement is a testament to our collective strength and our individual value. Your contributions play a vital role in our success. Our winning culture is rooted in authenticity and trust, empowering us to bring out the best in one another. Here, you'll find opportunities to learn, grow, and thrive. Join us and experience why we're better together.

Your privacy is important to us. By submitting personal data or information to us, you agree this will be handled in accordance with McCain's Global Privacy Policy and Global Employee Privacy Policy, as applicable. data.title: Staff Software Engineer II
data.description:
About Blackhawk Network: 

Today, through BHN's single global platform, businesses of all kinds can tap into the world's largest network of branded payment solutions. BHN helps businesses grow revenue, increase loyalty, motivate and reward their teams, disburse funds and engage consumers. Branded payment solutions include the issuance and distribution of gift cards, egifts, corporate payouts and rewards, along with the technology to deliver these products in seamless, integrated ways. BHN's network spans the globe with more than 400, 000 consumer touchpoints. Learn more at BHN. com. 

Overview: 

The Staff II Software Engineer is a senior individual contributor who provides technical leadership across a platform or domain and drives complex, cross-team engineering initiatives from problem framing through production outcomes. This role translates business priorities into durable architecture, a sequenced technical roadmap, and high-quality implementation. The engineer remains hands-on while setting direction, resolving consequential technical trade-offs, and influencing teams beyond their immediate group. 

The role advances secure, resilient, scalable, and observable systems for Blackhawk Network's customers and internal teams. It strengthens engineering practices through design leadership, mentoring, and clear technical communication. The Staff II engineer also evaluates emerging capabilities, including AI, with a disciplined focus on customer value, security, privacy, regulatory obligations, and responsible adoption. This is an individual-contributor role and has no direct supervisory responsibility. 

Responsibilities: 

Functions

- Set technical direction for a platform or domain, connecting business outcomes to architecture, platform evolution, and a practical multi-quarter roadmap. 
 - Own and shape the technical backlog for the area: identify systemic risks and opportunities, prioritize foundational work, and make progress visible through measurable outcomes. 
 - Lead ambiguous, high-impact initiatives spanning multiple teams; clarify the problem, surface dependencies and risks, align stakeholders, and guide delivery through production adoption. 
 - Design and review architectures for distributed, event-driven, cloud-based systems, documenting key decisions, trade-offs, migration paths, and operational considerations. 
 - Make sound build, buy, and partner recommendations; evaluate technologies, libraries, vendors, and AI-enabled capabilities against business value, total cost, security, privacy, and operational fit. 
 - Deliver and evolve secure, performant, scalable, resilient, and observable services, contributing hands-on code and ensuring sound testing, deployment, release, and rollback practices. 
 - Raise reliability and operational maturity through service health measures, capacity and failure-mode analysis, production readiness, incident learning, and durable corrective actions. 
 - Partner with Security, Privacy, Risk, Compliance, Product, and other stakeholders to embed applicable payment-industry and regulatory requirements in designs and delivery plans. 
 - Contribute to responsible AI adoption within the platform or domain: identify suitable use cases, assess data and model risks, establish appropriate controls and validation, and monitor outcomes before expanding use. 
 - Establish and promote engineering standards and reusable patterns across teams through design reviews, technical documentation, and communities of practice. 
 - Coach and mentor engineers, strengthen technical judgment across the organization, and help teams resolve difficult design and delivery challenges without taking over their ownership. 
 - Communicate technical strategy and material risks clearly to engineering leaders and cross-functional partners; influence decisions through evidence and sound reasoning. 
 - Measure the customer, business, and operational impact of delivered capabilities and use feedback to refine the roadmap. 
 - Perform additional duties as assigned. 

Competencies

- Demonstrated ability to frame and solve complex, ambiguous technical problems that span services, teams, and business functions. 
 - Strong systems thinking: understands how architecture, data, security, reliability, developer experience, and operating cost interact over time. 
 - Makes timely, explainable decisions with incomplete information; weighs reversibility, risk, mitigation, and long-term consequences. 
 - Influences across organizational boundaries without relying on formal authority; builds alignment among stakeholders with differing priorities. 
 - Distills business and technical context into clear requirements, options, decision records, roadmaps, and delivery plans. 
 - Applies strong engineering judgment across design, implementation, testing, deployment, operations, and continuous improvement. 
 - Anticipates security, privacy, compliance, reliability, and scalability concerns and incorporates mitigations early in the lifecycle. 
 - Sets a high bar for technical quality while balancing pragmatic delivery, incremental change, and maintainability. 
 - Develops other engineers through coaching, constructive feedback, thoughtful reviews, and delegation of meaningful technical ownership. 
 - Communicates directly and clearly in writing and verbally, including when explaining trade-offs, uncertainty, and production risk. 
 - Adapts to shifting priorities and technology while sustaining progress on foundational work and longer-term platform health. 

Qualifications: 

Required Technical Skills

- Extensive experience designing and delivering distributed, service-oriented and event-driven systems in production. 
 - Strong knowledge of software architecture, design patterns, SOLID principles, object-oriented design, and service/API design. 
 - Expertise in Java 17 or higher and Spring Boot 3. 1 or higher, or comparable depth in a modern enterprise programming stack with the ability to work effectively in this stack. 
 - Strong understanding of transactionality, ACID properties, relational data modeling, SQL, and data integrity in distributed applications. 
 - Experience designing for security, privacy, availability, resilience, performance, observability, and operational supportability. 
 - Experience with automated testing, CI/CD, production monitoring, incident response, and safe release practices. 
 - Ability to assess emerging technologies, including AI/ML-enabled systems, for suitability, risk, and responsible use in a regulated or customer-sensitive environment. 

Preferred Technical Skills

- Experience with SQL and/or NoSQL data repositories. 
 - Experience using AWS Cloud Formation to define and deploy infrastructure on AWS; strong knowledge of core AWS services. 
 - Experience in payment systems, financial technology, or other highly regulated, high-availability environments. 
 - Experience with AI/ML platform architecture, AI governance, model or output validation, and production controls. 
 - Experience establishing platform roadmaps, architecture standards, or reusable engineering capabilities across multiple teams. 

Required Education and Experience

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related field and 10+ years of software development experience, or 12+ years of equivalent practical experience. 
 - Substantial experience building and operating production-grade distributed systems. 
 - Demonstrated technical leadership of complex initiatives involving multiple teams, with accountability for architecture and delivery outcomes. 
 - Programming experience in at least one modern software development language and willingness to remain hands-on. 

Preferred Education and Experience

- Experience delivering secure, scalable, resilient services at enterprise scale. 
 - Experience in an Agile or similarly iterative engineering environment. 
 - Experience with cloud infrastructure, preferably AWS. 
 - Experience mentoring engineers and improving technical practices across a team or engineering organization. 
 - Experience working with product, security, compliance, risk, and operations partners on technology decisions.

AI Business Solutions - Dynamics CRM Technical Senior Specialized: 

At EY, we're all in to shape your future with confidence. 

We'll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go. 

Join EY and help to build a better working world. 

About Global Delivery Services

Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY's strategy by ensuring effective support to EY's growth agenda. 

Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80, 000+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom. 

Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy & Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high-quality, value-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.

Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services. 

Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation. 

The Opportunity

We are seeking an experienced Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM Lead / Senior Consultant to design, deliver, and optimize enterprise-grade D365 and Power Platform solutions. This role combines deep technical expertise with solution ownership, team leadership, and stakeholder engagement to drive business outcomes across complex CRM environments. 

Your Key Responsibilities

- Lead the design, development, configuration, and implementation of Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM solutions aligned with business requirements and best practices. 
 - Architect and deliver end-to-end solutions across D365 modules including Sales, Customer Service, Marketing, and Field Service. 
 - Develop and customize CRM components such as entities, forms, views, dashboards, workflows, plugins, and integrations. 
 - Build custom solutions using C#, JavaScript, HTML, CSS, Dynamics 365 SDK, and Web API.

Skills And Attributes For Success

 - Solid knowledge of Power Platform including Power Apps, Power Automate, and Power BI. 
 - Strong understanding of CRM data models, security, and business processes. 
 - Experience designing scalable, maintainable system architectures.

Ideally, you'll also

 - Integrations using Azure Functions, Azure Logic Apps, and Azure Service Bus

What We Look For

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field. 
 - 5+ years of hands-on experience in Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM development and implementation. 
 - Experience working in Agile delivery environments (Scrum/Kanban). 
 - Microsoft Dynamics 365 or Power Platform certifications are preferred. 
 - Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to build trusted client and stakeholder relationships. 

What We Offer You

At EY, we'll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We'll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more. 

Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.

data.title: Senior Software Engineer - Developer Experience
data.description:
Be the one building AI-powered experiences where they matter most. 

At Genesys, we help organizations create better customer experiences through AI-powered experience orchestration. Our platform connects people, systems, data and AI to help organizations deliver more personalized service, improve operational efficiency and build stronger customer relationships. 

Help build, support and operate technology used by more than 8, 000 organizations in over 100 countries - moving AI from possibility to production in real-world enterprise environments every day. 

About The Role

The Senior Software Engineer - Developer Experience is a hands-on individual contributor focused on improving how engineers build, test, and deliver software across Genesys. You will design and deliver scalable tooling, automation, and development workflows that reduce friction, increase delivery velocity, and improve software quality. You will also help advance Genesys's AI-enabled software development lifecycle (AI-SDLC), applying sound technical judgment as AI capabilities and engineering practices evolve. This role has no direct reports; you will lead through technical ownership, mentorship, and collaboration. 

What You'll Do

Developer Experience & Platforms

- Design and deliver internal developer platforms, CI/CD pipelines, and reusable tooling that streamline code development, testing, and deployment workflows. 
 - Build and improve standardized development environments and paved workflows using GitHub, CI/CD automation, and testing frameworks to reduce setup time and inconsistencies across partner teams. 
 - Improve developer onboarding and day-to-day productivity by creating self-service capabilities, documentation, and paved paths for common engineering tasks. 

AI-SDLC, Automation & Quality

- Implement and continuously improve AI-enabled software development practices, evaluating emerging capabilities and incorporating effective approaches into development, testing, and delivery workflows while maintaining quality, security, and reliability. 
 - Automate build, test, and release processes across the software development lifecycle to reduce manual effort, improve consistency, and shorten delivery cycles. 
 - Use software delivery and quality metrics, including build success rates, test effectiveness, lead time, deployment frequency, and change failure rate, to identify bottlenecks, prioritize improvements, and measure impact. 

Engineering Delivery & Adoption

- Contribute to technical design and reusable frameworks for developer tooling and platforms, balancing developer usability, scalability, security, and operational reliability. 
 - Partner with platform, security, and application teams to deliver developer experience improvements aligned with enterprise standards and engineering needs, and support adoption by gathering feedback and iterating based on usage and impact. 
 - Mentor engineers through code and design reviews, pairing, and knowledge sharing to strengthen engineering practices within the team and partner teams. 

What You Bring

Required Qualifications

- Demonstrated understanding of how AI is changing software development, with the ability to evaluate emerging tools and practices, learn rapidly as capabilities evolve, and apply effective approaches to engineering workflows. 
 - Strong hands-on software engineering experience using Python, Java, or another modern programming language, with demonstrated experience designing and delivering production-quality software or developer tooling. 
 - Experience in developer productivity, DevOps, or platform engineering, with a track record of delivering complex technical initiatives and contributing to cross-team efforts. 
 - Strong experience with CI/CD systems, version control, automated testing frameworks, and cloud-native development environments (preferably AWS) or infrastructure projects. 
 - Experience using software delivery metrics such as deployment frequency, lead time, build reliability, or change failure rate to identify and improve engineering workflows. 
 - Ability to influence adoption of tools and practices through collaboration, technical judgment, clear communication, and effective partnership across engineering teams. 
 - Experience with developer infrastructure, observability, and testing technologies such as GitHub, Terraform, Honeycomb, Gremlin, Playwright, or comparable tools. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience integrating AI-powered developer tools, code assistants, agents, or automation capabilities into engineering workflows. 
 - Experience working in large-scale SaaS or distributed engineering organizations. 

If you bring many of these capabilities but do not meet every qualification listed, we encourage you to apply. We value demonstrated ability, sound engineering judgment, and the capacity to learn as technologies and practices evolve. 

Key Skills

- Developer Experience (DevEx)
 - CI/CD & Automation
 - AI-Enabled Software Development (AI-SDLC)
 - Software Quality & Testing
 - Technical Design & Collaboration

BUSINESS IMPACT

- Reduces developer friction and cycle time across development, testing, and release workflows through automation, self-service capabilities, and paved paths. 
 - Improves software delivery and quality indicators such as build reliability, lead time, deployment frequency, and change failure rate within supported engineering workflows. 
 - Expands effective adoption of standardized and AI-enabled development practices, helping engineering teams use emerging capabilities responsibly while maintaining quality, security, and reliability. 

Working at Genesys

- AI at enterprise scale - Build, support and operate AI-powered technology used by more than 8, 000 organizations worldwide. 150+ new AI features were released in the last fiscal year
 - A flexible-first culture - Join a global team of nearly 7, 000 employees with flexible ways of working designed to help people do their best work
 - Growth in the AI era - Build future-ready skills through mentorship, learning programs, leadership development and education support
 - Time to recharge and give back - Benefits include paid volunteer time, August Free Fridays, well-being resources and regionally tailored programs for employees and their families
 - Recognized globally - Genesys is Great Place to Work® certified in 17 countries and 94% of employees are proud to tell others they work at Genesys

Learn more about our culture, AI innovation and sustainability commitments through our Careers site and Sustainability Report. 

What Happens After You Apply

After you apply, here's what you can typically expect: 

- Our Talent Acquisition team reviews your application with the hiring team
 - A Talent Acquisition Partner will review your application and, if your background is aligned, schedule a Zoom interview. 
 - Next, you'll meet the hiring manager and other members of the interview team
 - We aim to keep the process focused and respectful of your time, with no more than five interviews in most cases
 - After interviews are complete, our team will follow up with the final steps

Every application is reviewed by a person. Response times may vary by role and location, but our team will keep you informed throughout the process. 

Stay Connected

Stay connected to learn more about how we're applying AI to customer and employee experience challenges and get notified when relevant opportunities become available. 

Get notified about relevant opportunities. 

Be the one building what's next - where AI, experience and impact come together. 

Employee Referral

If a Genesys employee referred you, please apply using the link they shared so we can connect your application to their referral. 

About Genesys: 

Genesys® empowers more than 8, 000 organizations worldwide to create the best customer and employee experiences. Genesys CloudTM is the Agentic Orchestration Platform that securely connects people, systems, data and AI across the enterprise with built-in governance and control. As a result, organizations can drive customer loyalty, growth and retention while increasing operational efficiency and teamwork across human and AI workforces. To learn more, visit www. genesys. ai. 

Reasonable Accommodations: 

If you require a reasonable accommodation to complete any part of the application process, or are limited in your ability to access or use this online application and need an alternative method for applying, you or someone you know may contact us at reasonable. accommodations@genesys. com. 

You can expect a response within 24-48 hours. To help us provide the best support, click the email link above to open a pre-filled message and complete the requested information before sending. If you have any questions, please include them in your email. 

This email is intended to support job seekers requesting accommodations. Messages unrelated to accommodation-such as application follow-ups or resume submissions-may not receive a response. 

Genesys is an equal opportunity employer committed to fairness in the workplace. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to race, color, age, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, marital status, domestic partner status, national origin, genetics, disability, military and veteran status, and other protected characteristics. 

Please note that recruiters will never ask for sensitive personal or financial information during the application phase.

data.title: Senior Release Engineer, Patching
data.description:
Job Description

Oracle's Automated Patching Framework (APF) builds and delivers software updates for Oracle Database, Exadata, Fleet Patching and Provisioning (FPP), Real Application Clusters (RAC), Oracle GoldenGate (OGG), Zero Data Loss Recovery Appliance (ZDLRA), and Autonomous Health Framework (AHF), across on-premises and cloud environments. APF is a business-critical platform that helps Oracle deliver patches to customers on schedule and improves the efficiency of development teams across the company. 

The framework includes services and tools built with Python, Java, Perl, PL/SQL, and Ant. Our team develops and operates these systems in a large-scale production environment. Engineers contribute across the full software lifecycle, from design and implementation to troubleshooting, performance tuning, and production support. 

We're looking for strong hands-on software engineers who enjoy solving complex automation problems and working across technologies and teams. 

Design, develop, troubleshoot, and debug software for Oracle's automated patching framework. You'll build and maintain tools and services using technologies such as Python, Java, Perl, Linux shell scripting, and PL/SQL. The role also includes providing internal production support, investigating and triaging issues, and improving the reliability and performance of the patching infrastructure. 

As a member of the software engineering team, you'll help define and implement software solutions, make changes to existing architecture as needs evolve, and contribute to technical direction across shared projects. The work is varied and often complex, requiring sound judgment and the ability to work independently. You may also lead projects or provide technical guidance to other developers. 

Responsibilities

Design, develop, and maintain APF (Automation Patching Framework) services, tools, and automation. 

Provide production support and investigate issues reported by internal customers. 

Lead or contribute to cross-functional technical discussions and shared projects. 

Improve the framework's architecture, code quality, reliability, and support processes using AI tools where appropriate. 

Take ownership of software throughout its lifecycle, including operation in a 24/7 production environment. 

Provide technical guidance to other developers and, where appropriate, lead projects.

data.title: Engineering Team Leader
data.description:
Job Description

Exceptional Hospitality Starts with You

Picture yourself brightening someone's day. When you join our Hotels team, that's exactly what you'll do every time you come to work! You will support the Chief Engineer in ensuring the smooth operation of all engineering functions, including hotel systems, plant and equipment, team management, sub-contractors, and maintenance of property structure and assets. As an Engineering Team Leader, you're not just overseeing the daily operations of physical building and systems maintenance and repairs - you're spreading the light and warmth of hospitality by delivering memorable experiences that make the stay for every guest. 

Responsibilities

Here's what you'll do during a typical day: 

- Ensure facility safety and compliance: Support the maintenance of the hotel's buildings, mechanical systems, electrical systems, HVAC, and life safety systems, ensuring compliance with local, state, and federal regulations
 - Supervise maintenance operations: Assign and oversee daily maintenance tasks, ensuring thorough documentation of completed work in the property management system. 
 - Supervise and develop the team: Train, schedule, and supervise maintenance team members, providing guidance and support to ensure high-quality work and performance
 - Oversee contractor work: Supervise external contractors and inspect completed work for quality and compliance
 - Respond to service requests: Ensure maintenance requests, guest concerns, and emergency situations are addressed promptly and efficiently
 - Supervise and develop the team: Train, schedule, and supervise maintenance team members, providing guidance and support to ensure high-quality work and performance
 - Equipment Maintenance & Efficiency: Repair and maintain all hotel systems and equipment, ensuring efficiency and informing management about deficiencies and stock control needs. 
 - Cost Management: Adhere to departmental operating expenses, evaluate products for reuse, monitor stock levels, and ensure the operation runs according to budgets and profit margins. 

Qualifications

At Hilton, our core values define what it takes to succeed here and guide the qualities we look for in every team member: 

A passion for spreading the light and warmth of Hospitality. Acting with Integrity and always doing the right thing. Inspiring others through Leadership. A belief that Teamwork drives the best outcomes. A sense of Ownership and accountability. And a focus on the Now, bringing urgency and discipline to every moment, knowing it can make a lasting impact. 

In Addition, This Role Requires The Following Minimum Qualifications

- HVAC, Electrical, or Plumbing/Gas Fitter trade-qualified advantageous
 - Must have sound general Engineering knowledge and trade background
 - At least 5 years in a Service Technician position or similar position with working experience in a 5-star hotel. 

About Us

Join an Award-Winning Workplace Culture

At Hilton, we don't just deliver exceptional experiences for our guests-we build an exceptional workplace for the Team Members who make it all possible. As a global leader in hospitality, we've welcomed more than 3 billion guests worldwide, all while staying true to our founding vision: to fill the earth with the light and warmth of hospitality. 

Our award-winning culture has earned us repeated recognition on the World's Best Workplaces list by Great Place to Work and Fortune. With our suite of world-class brands , and a company-wide commitment to providing the best stay for every guest, we're setting new standards for the future of travel. 

Whether you're starting your career or exploring something new, Hilton supports your journey every step of the way. Come for the job, stay for the career-and help us make every stay a little more magical. 

Curious about life at Hilton? Explore our Careers Blog to see why we're more than a great place to stay-we're a great place to work.

data.title: Associate, Electrical
data.description:
Job Description

This strategy is key to the WSP in India Buildings Mechanical Electrical Public Health (MEP) business as we position ourselves to address the challenges of a changing global economy. The role is the cornerstone of the establishment of a MEP Design Capacity in Noida working and adhering to WSP Global standards and promoting technical excellence, in addition to creating and building a team. This will involve recruiting, leading, developing a team of Engineers over a relatively short period of time. The successful candidate will stimulate and manage significant growth in a technically demanding environment to time, cost and quality targets. Cultural awareness, an open mind and excellent communication skills are essential requirements for the role. 

Responsibilities

A major element of this role is to liaise with the WSP in India design teams to ensure that the following essential elements of the role are satisfactorily completed: -

- Agree and confirm the project brief to anticipate and identify needs and expectations in conjunction with others. 
 - Agree the project deliverables and programme. 
 - Agree the resource in India that will be required to undertake the designs to complete the project brief in time and cost. 
 - Agree the project fees according to brief, resource required and programme. 
 - Be responsible for the quality of detailed design to WSP in India and Global Building Regulations standards ensuring technical reviews and sign off including complex calculations and co-ordination issues. 
 - Ensure design are co-ordinated and due consideration of Health & Safety, Construction Design Management and Quality Assurance standards. 
 - Regularly communicate and update the local Indian and wider Global project teams on programme delivery and quality issues through use of staff utilisation charts and Key Performance Indicator (KPI) reporting etc. 
 - Review outputs of Computer Aided Design analysis, and determine additional levels of checking needed. 
 - Where necessary, development of energy strategies incorporating renewable technologies and low energy designs to satisfy local authority planning requirements and compliance with Building Regulations Part L. 
 - Inform the Commercial Director of Professional Indemnity issues in line with WSP in India policy. 
 - Ensure all company standards & efficient working practices are adopted. 
 - Maintain an overview & understanding of the team workload & associated resource requirements, and work with other team leaders to ensure resources are fully utilised, identify & address effectively any surplus or shortfall in available staff
 - The successful candidate will be a dynamic self-motivated individual who will take on a Leadership role in project work, focused on delivery to the client and technical excellence. 
 - The role requires management of a number of projects and becoming involved in design at an early stage. 
 - The role includes management of fees, invoicing, project-resource management, mentoring and coaching junior members of the team. The ability to plan and design deliverables against British Engineering standards for each stage of a project is a pre-requisite. 
 - The role will include a short term secondment to the to visit some of the key WSP in India offices and WSP in India personnel to better understand WSP in India as a business and to assist with acclimatisation to the WSP in India methods of working. 
 - Lead the design process, set clear goals and monitor their progress closely and encourage the rest of the team to deliver appropriate and cost effective solutions to the agreed programme; support those more inexperienced by technical review, mentoring and advice. 
 - Lead from the front accepting design challenges and giving them due consideration with the support of others to achieve resolution. 

Establishment and growth of GCC

- Responsible for the recruitment of the design team, in liaison with the Head of GCC
 - Contribute to the design of operational processes, systems and measures
 - Working with Support Services, the local resources and the other disciplines to ensure that all hardware, software, workspace and IT infrastructure is in place
 - Provide the technical training, mentoring and support to members of the new team, ensuring that the team is capable in the use of the required standards, processes and software tools at the earliest opportunity. 
 - Provide highly visible, inspirational leadership and direction for the emerging Buildings team, ensuring the Noida based team feel part of the wider team
 - Liaise with the established leadership of the GCC facility across the globe. 
 - Promote WSP in India Vision and Values - see below. 
 - Support and promote team work within the team, and the wider business

Technical and Project Management

- Raise the level of technical competence within the teams
 - Implement delivery and quality measurement processes
 - Agree Key Performance Indicators (KPI s) with the Head of GCC monitoring and regularly reporting. Identify and implement improvements to increase KPIs accordingly
 - Promote technical excellence in all our projects
 - Undertake technical reviews and contribute to the concept design
 - Provide continuous feedback to the Head of GCC on the effectiveness of the protocols and processes in place with a view to continuous improvement

Commercial

- Implement the project delivery systems and structures
 - Support management of resource requirements versus project requirements
 - Support liaison with UK business to drive up utilisation of GCC team
 - Support and advise UK on implementation of GCC within fee bid

Qualifications

- The applicant will have proven experience in the design of Building Services with significant experience in a similar role or demonstration of a good track record. 
 - The applicant will have proven experience in the design of Engineering Building Services. 
 - Must be conversant with technical mechanical or electrical software, such as IES, Amtech, Hevacomp, Relux and Dialux. 
 - A sound understanding of Microsoft Outlook, Word, Excel, Project is essential. 
 - Must be fluent in English with an excellent understanding of technical terminology. 
 - A sound understanding of Microsoft Outlook, Word, Excel, and project is essential. 
 - Must be fluent in English with an excellent understanding of technical terminology. 
 - The applicant should ideally have obtained British Chartered Engineer status or equivalent, possess a degree in Mechanical or Electrical Engineering and possess membership to an accredited engineering body. 

BGV: 

- Employment with WSP India is subject to the successful completion of a background verification ("BGV") check conducted by a third-party agency appointed by WSP India.

data.description:
Optum is a global organization that delivers care, aided by technology to help millions of people live healthier lives. The work you do with our team will directly improve health outcomes by connecting people with the care, pharmacy benefits, data and resources they need to feel their best. - Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, Data Science, or related field, or equivalent experience

 - Experience working with AI technologies such as Generative AI, Large Language Models (LLMs), Microsoft Copilot, Azure AI Services, OpenAI technologies, or machine learning platforms

 - Experience building AI agents, copilots, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) solutions, or autonomous workflows
 - Experience with GitHub, DevOps, Infrastructure as Code, CI/CD pipelines, and cloud-native engineering practices
 - Experience leading large-scale digital transformation initiatives

data.title: Lead Engineer – Bridges – Ahmedabad / / Chennai
data.description:
It has been more than 60 years since SYSTRA has garnered expertise that spans the entire spectrum of Mass Rapid Transit System. SYSTRA India's valuable presence in India roots back to 1957, where SYSTRA worked on the electrification of Indian Railways. Our technical excellence, holistic approach and the tremendous talent provides a career that puts people who join us at the heart of improving transportation and urban infrastructure efficiency. 

Understand better who we are by visiting www. systra. in

Context

In India, SYSTRA is an international consulting and engineering company operating in the fields of Metros, High Speed Rail, Railways, Roads, Buildings, Urban planning, and Water Infrastructure for public and private organizations. 

CTR - Regional Technical Centre of Systra India takes care of the international production of major projects at Systra Group level. CTR team has expertise in design of High-Speed Rail, Metro, Conventional Rail, Bridges, Highways, Depots, Stations and Transport Planning. Starting from Feasibility/Concept stage to detailed design to IFC/Shop drawings, the disciplines involved have experience of designing in accordance with various international codes and delivered projects across the world. 

CTR team has successfully delivered some major projects in UK, UAE, Tanzania, KSA, Australia, Canada and Denmark. One of the major achievements of India CTR team has been the design of HS2 project in UK. We played an instrumental role in delivering 3 major Sublots on HS2 with our teams proactively engaging with the front office in UK and delivering beyond client expectations. This resulted in India team receiving many accolades from the contractor BBV and client HS2. 

CTR team in India is proficient in working on multi-disciplinary projects integrating Design, BIM and Drawing production in a seamless workflow incorporating different software. The technical and management teams within CTR get an opportunity to work and interact with other CTR teams within Systra Group from Paris, Poland, Dubai, Philippines and Brazil. 

Missions/Main Duties

- Take responsibility for Rail bridge design, Viaduct & Structure design. 
 - Having experience designing steel bridges and complex bridges. 
 - Assisting in the overall project management from conception to development and project completion
 - Responsible for managing the Engineers of different ranks, liaising with sub-agencies and building relationship with clients, architects, consultants, contractors. 
 - Co-ordinating work between different disciplines. 
 - Prepare reports and calculations in line with International Codes of Practice (AREMA, AASTHO, EURO, BS). 
 - Plan and deliver bridge surveys and inspections including recording of all relevant information
 - Can perform bridge assessment calculation and report. 
 - Manage delivery of projects - take responsibility for budget and resource deployment on projects. 
 - Take responsibility for project delivery to agreed budgets. 
 - Preparation of estimates for work items. 
 - Identify scope change items. 
 - Knowledge of working on big multidisciplinary projects on BIM. 
 - Coordinating work between different disciplines. 
 - Can prepare contractual claims arising out of any change in the contract conditions. 
 - Manage resources at a project level to ensure utilization and productivity is maintained
 - Ensure compliance of the Systra Group policies, particularly on ethics, safety and adherence to company ISO standards. 

Profile/Skills

- BE-Civil + M. Tech in Structural Engineering
 - 10 to 13 years of experience in the relevant field. 
 - Experience with software like Sofistik, Midas, Open Bridge and Oasys. 
 - Actively working towards professional qualification. 
 - Ability to work in a collaborative, multidisciplinary design team. 
 - Ability to complete assigned tasks with minimal supervision and provide support and mentoring to others. 
 - Ability to travel to client sites and other SYSTRA offices will be required. 

We commit to put people who join us at the heart of improving transportation and urban infrastructure efficiency. As we are growing, this is time to be a part of this challenging adventure. It's not a job - it's a career!

Senior Java Developer is a position responsible for establishing, designing, and implementing scalable, high-performance application systems and services in close coordination with the Business and Technology teams. A key function within Banking and International Clients Technology is the global client onboarding process at Citi. Our team is responsible for the enterprise platform that orchestrates mission-critical client onboarding workflows across multiple business domains, including Legal, Credit, KYC/AML, and Account Opening. We empower clients and operations teams with real-time event-driven information, interactive tools, and robust APIs to automate, streamline, and accelerate end-to-end onboarding lifecycles. 

We are looking for a talented, hands-on senior technologist with deep expertise in modern Java, Spring Boot, and Apache Kafka to help build the next generation of our global Client Onboarding Platform while driving performance and architectural excellence across the existing ecosystem. This role offers high visibility, technical ownership, and significant opportunity to shape how we serve our global institutional clients. 

Responsibilities: 

- Lead the hands-on architecture, design, and development of mission-critical, high-throughput microservices using modern Java (Java 17/21), Spring Boot, and RESTful/event-driven APIs
 - Architect and implement robust event-driven workflows and real-time streaming data pipelines using Apache Kafka (producers, consumers, partitions, schemas, and fault-tolerant message processing)
 - Design and implement highly concurrent, low-latency solutions utilizing advanced multithreading, concurrency patterns, and JVM performance tuning
 - Write clean, testable, maintainable, and secure code following modern software engineering best practices, design patterns, and enterprise security standards
 - Lead end-to-end SDLC activities from architectural design, technical specification, and implementation through to automated testing, CI/CD pipeline integration, and production deployment
 - Design and optimize data persistence layers across relational databases (Oracle, PostgreSQL) and NoSQL/document stores (MongoDB) ensuring data integrity, optimized indexing, and efficient querying
 - Continuously monitor, profile, and optimize application performance, reliability, and resilience using distributed tracing, metrics, and observability tools
 - Partner with Solution Architects, Product Owners, and cross-functional engineering teams to define system enhancements, evaluate technical trade-offs, and deliver complex business workflows
 - Investigate, troubleshoot, and resolve high-impact technical challenges in distributed production environments, leading root-cause analyses and permanent remediation
 - Provide technical leadership, establish coding standards, conduct comprehensive peer code reviews, and mentor mid-level and junior developers across the team

Qualifications: 

- Minimum 10+ years of hands-on enterprise Application Development experience with strong backend engineering expertise
 - Deep, expert-level proficiency in Core Java (Java 11/17/21), object-oriented design, collections, memory management, and multithreading/concurrency models
 - Extensive hands-on experience building and deploying production-grade microservices using the Spring ecosystem (Spring Boot, Spring Data JPA/Hibernate, Spring Security, Spring Cloud)
 - Strong hands-on expertise with Apache Kafka and Event-Driven Architecture, including topic design, consumer groups, offset management, message serialization, and event streaming patterns
 - Proven experience in designing, building, securing, and versioning scalable RESTful APIs
 - Strong database skills working with relational databases (e. g. , Oracle, PostgreSQL) including query optimization, indexing, and transactions, as well as document stores (e. g. , MongoDB)

 - Familiarity with containerization and cloud platforms (Docker, Kubernetes / Red Hat OpenShift) and modern CI/CD deployment pipelines
 - Exposure to Kotlin is a significant advantage
 - Demonstrated technical leadership, excellent analytical and debugging skills, and strong verbal and written communication abilities

Education: 

- Bachelor's degree/University degree or equivalent experience
 - Master's degree preferred

IND Lead Software Engineer - GCC093

We're determined to make a difference and are proud to be an insurance company that goes well beyond coverages and policies. Working here means having every opportunity to achieve your goals - and to help others accomplish theirs, too. Join our team as we help shape the future. 

Position Overview

We are seeking an AI/ML Engineer who will be responsible for architecting, building and deploying production-grade AI systems This is a highly hands-on role requiring deep expertise in ML engineering, MLOps, LLM architecture, and Generative/Agentic AI concepts and tooling exposure. This role is well-suited for someone who brings intellectual curiosity, a bias toward action, and a collaborative mindset, and who is looking to deepen their AI/ML engineering expertise while taking on increasing responsibility over time________________________________________

Key Responsibilities

- Design and implement production-grade AI/ML and Agentic AI solutions that drive end-to-end transformation across pricing, underwriting, and sales. 
 - Partner with Cloud, AIOps, Data Science, LOB IT, Enterprise Architecture, and Data teams to provision infrastructure, deploy services, and operate scalable AI platforms using modern DevOps practices. 
 - Leverage AI Platform, agent development standards, and agent frameworks to build, deploy, monitor and maintain agentic solutions & AI/ML pipelines. 
 - Architect and build highly available, scalable, secure, and fault-tolerant AI/ML systems, applying modern distributed system patterns such as event-driven, pub/sub, and point-to-point architectures. 
 - Design and implement agent memory, evaluation, and feedback mechanisms to enable quality, safety, and reliability-driven tuning and continuous improvement. 
 - Develop advanced context engineering, adaptive prompting, multi-agent coordination, and RAG/Agentic RAG systems using techniques such as HyDE, RAPTOR, and GraphRAG to improve accuracy and relevance. 
 - Write high-quality, production-ready Python (e. g. , asyncio, FastAPI, Pydantic) and instrument AI observability using OpenTelemetry, offline evaluation, and drift monitoring, while leveraging enterprise AI platforms and standards. 

________________________________________

Required Skills & Experience

Experience Range - 4 to 6 Years

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in computer science , Software Engineering, Data Science, or a closely related discipline. 
 - Professional experience in ML, Software Engineering, or a related role, including 3+ years delivering AI/ML solutions in production. 
 - Strong Python development experience, building and operating production services and APIs. 

Generative AI & Agentic Systems

- Experience developing full-stack agentic solutions using agent frameworks such as ADK, A2A, MCP, LangChain, LangGraph, or CrewAI, and familiarity with commercial and open-source foundation models. 
 - Experience building and operating advanced RAG and Agentic RAG systems using modern techniques and methodologies. 
 - Experience with agentic monitoring, observability, and model evaluation frameworks to assess quality, safety, and performance in production. 

ML, Platforms & Cloud

- Hands-on experience with ML and AI frameworks such as PyTorch, Hugging Face, Pandas, NumPy, and related libraries. 
 - Hands-on experience with at least one public cloud AI/GenAI platform (e. g. , AWS SageMaker/Bedrock or Google Vertex AI, Vertex AI Search, and RAG Engine). 

Software Engineering, DevOps & Security

- Experience designing and delivering production-grade APIs and microservices using modern software engineering practices. 
 - Hands-on experience with DevOps and CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure as code (e. g. , Terraform), GitHub collaboration, and cloud deployments. 
 - Experience with DevSecOps tools such as Nexus, SonarQube, Checkmarx, and mcp-scan. 

Ways of Working & Communication

- Experience working in lean, agile environments (e. g. , SAFe or similar frameworks). 
 - Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to explain complex technical concepts to technical and non-technical stakeholders, influence decisions, and work effectively across teams. 

________________________________________Nice to Have

- Knowledge of automated testing, validation gates, canary deployments, and rollback strategies for ML and Agentic AI systems. 
 - Experience designing and implementing data pipelines for ML and Agentic AI workloads using modern data platforms (e. g. , Snowflake, Airflow, S3/Glue/EMR/Redshift, Apache Iceberg, or equivalent). 
 - Experience working in insurance or other regulatory environments. 
 - Ability to partner with governance, risk, compliance, and security teams to ensure responsible AI through techniques such as bias mitigation, disparate impact analysis, and counterfactual testing.

data.title: Team Leader - Digital IC design
data.description:
Company Description

Since its spin-off in September 2025 AUMOVIO continues the business of the former Continental group sector Automotive as an independent company. The technology and electronics company offers a wide-ranging portfolio that makes mobility safe, exciting, connected, and autonomous. This includes sensor solutions, displays, braking and comfort systems as well as comprehensive expertise in software, architecture platforms, and assistance systems for software-defined vehicles. In the fiscal year 2024 the business areas, which now belong to AUMOVIO, generated sales of 19. 6 billion Euro. The company is headquartered in Frankfurt, Germany and has about 87. 000 employees in more than 100 locations worldwide. 

Responsibilities

Job Description

The group manager-Digital IC Design is responsible for leading a digital design team. He/she is also responsible for coordinating the Bangalore activities regarding digital IC design. 

The group manager is responsible for the technical, commercial, and quality requirements of the project being met. 

The group manager is responsible for monitoring, coaching, and optimizing the digital design development process and methodology. 

The group manager supports the acquisition of new projects and participates in defining strategy goals

Detailed Task Description

- Disciplinary team guidance
 - Coordination of the Bangalore digital team regarding resources, processes, methods, and tools
 - Set up the project plan, incl. all relevant documents (project time schedule, development cost, team, risks, etc. ) together with the IC developers

 - Evaluate technical and development risks (analysis, mitigation plan, escalation, etc. ) together with IC developers

 - Execute all milestone reviews together with the development team and report the results to the customer and line management
 - Acquisition of new digital projects
 - Regularly review the verification document (validation plan) together with the IC developers
 - Apply consistent configuration and change management
 - Apply quality assurance management (use of lessons learned, peer reviews, risk assessment, etc. )
 - Identify & implement improvement of digital IC development processes, methodology, and tools
 - Strategic planning, cross-functional alignment, budget management, proactive problem solving, early cost assessment, and growing up the competencies in the Bangalore site. 
 - Empowering the innovation culture within the team. 
 - Leading the efficiency topic within the digital design and verification team. 

Qualification and experience

- Master of Science in Electrical Engineering or similar qualification
 - 12+ years' experience in leadership and digital design of automotive product development
 - Proven experience in digital design development processes and methods for ASIC & FPGA implementation
 - Experience in Design, verification methodologies & development tools
 - Leadership experience as a team leader or group or program manager

Skills

- Leadership skillset
 - Initiative (self-confidence, takes ownership, and acts proactively). 
 - Decision-making
 - Result orientation
 - Strong analytical skills
 - Self-Organization
 - Communication skills (make a positive personal impact)
 - Customer focus (anticipates and understands the customers' needs)
 - Motivation and Inspiration (operates with integrity and demonstrates dynamism)
 - Team skills (operates as a team player and contributes to team goals)

Qualifications

Master of Science in Electrical Engineering/Microelectronics/VLSI design or similar qualification. 

Bachelor of science with advanced course in VLSI Design

Additional Information

- Integrated circuits and mixed-signal experience (e. g. , high-voltage analog CMOS and BCD)
 - 10+ years experience in IC digital design and verification
 - Automotive product development
 - IC design/synthesis tools, good understanding of the physical design flow, plus (e. g. , Siemens, Cadence, Synopsys)
 - Office tools (e. g. , MS Office, Visio)
 - Worked on IPs (e. g. , SPI, I2C, HDMI, RSDS, OpenLdi, PSI5, Ethernet, CAN. . . )
 - VDHL, Verilog
 - UVM test methodology
 - System Verilog, SystemC (optional)

Working in an international development network

Ready to take your career to the next level? The future of mobility isn't just anyone's job. Make it yours! Join AUMOVIO. Own What's Next.

data.title: Mgr, Software Engineer
data.description:
Own Every Moment at NetApp

At NetApp, your ideas power innovation. We lead in intelligent data infrastructure-delivering unified storage, integrated data services, and solutions that help organizations unlock the full potential of their data, from AI to multicloud. 

Ready to innovate and contribute to our path to $10B? Here, you'll collaborate with passionate teams, tackle real-world challenges, and see your impact in how customers transform and grow. If you're ready to bring curiosity, creativity, and drive to every moment, NetApp is where your journey begins. Join teams that innovate to elevate, drive results, and excel together across every function. 

Job Summary

Are you passionate about open-source technologies or solving distributed computing problems at scale? Do you love learning and working with a diverse range of technologies and people? We're looking for a collaborative and curious Lead Software Engineer to join our development team at NetApp Instaclustr (www. instaclustr. com). 

Our mission at NetApp Instaclustr (www. instaclustr. com) is to make it easy for customers around the globe to run powerful open-source applications at scale - like Cassandra, Kafka, PostgreSQL, OpenSearch, Cadence, and ClickHouse, across both on-premises data-centres and in the cloud. 

The NetApp Instaclustr development team is responsible for building, maintaining and operating the platform that allows us to provision and reliably keep thousands of distributed application servers running worldwide. 

Job Requirements

8 or more years of commercial experience regularly delivering quality software and overcoming technical challenges. 

Demonstrated experience with leading people. 

Proficiency in Java, SQL and at least one other modern programming language - and openness to learning more. 

Strong communication skills and a humble and collaborative nature - essential for working harmoniously with multiple teams. 

A curious mindset with a keen interest in how your work will positively impact customers. 

Eagerness to tackle new challenges and continuously grow you and your team's software engineering skills. 

Working with a wide range of technologies and tools, such as: Java, SQL, Python, Typescript, Rust, Terraform, Ansible, Jenkins, Debian, and more. 

Working with major cloud providers. Our systems run on AWS, Azure and GCP. 

Responsibilities

Lead one of the teams of 5-10 engineers that makes up our product development team. You can expect that some of your time will be spent helping your team head in the right direction, and some will be spent being hands-on with our technology and systems and doing your own development tasks. 

Take end to end ownership of one or more aspects of our managed platform, which takes care of the whole lifecycle: provisioning infrastructure, installing applications and, most importantly, keeping the applications running reliably in production. 

Work with a Product Manager to set team priorities, and work with a senior software engineering manager to plan and manage the work of your team. 

Develop the skills and careers of the engineers in your team. 

Work with other Lead Software Engineers to support each other in developing complex solutions or agreeing on the best approach to solve problems which affect everyone. 

Apply DevOps best practices as part of a global team that operates 24x7. This may include participating in on-call support roles to assist in keeping our management platform running smoothly. 

Education

IC - Typically requires a minimum of 12 years of related experience. Mgr & Exec - Typically requires a minimum of 8 years of related experience. 

At NetApp, we embrace a hybrid working environment designed to strengthen connection, collaboration, and culture for all employees. This means that most roles will have some level of in-office and/or in-person expectations, which will be shared during the recruitment process. 

Equal Opportunity Employer: 

NetApp is firmly committed to Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) and to compliance with all federal, state and local laws that prohibit employment discrimination based on age, race, color, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, religion, disability or genetic information, pregnancy, protected veteran status, and any other protected classification. 

Why You'll Thrive at NetApp

At NetApp, you won't wait for the perfect moment-you'll make it. The early planning, the extra thought, the bold idea that turns good into great: That's how our people operate and how we continue to push the boundaries of data infrastructure. 

NetApp is the trusted partner for organizations transforming data into opportunity. As the only enterprise-grade storage service natively embedded in Google Cloud, AWS, and Microsoft Azure, we empower customers to run everything from traditional workloads to enterprise AI with unmatched performance, resilience, and security. 

Our culture

We celebrate mold breakers, bold thinkers, and problem solvers. We reward initiative, impact, and ownership. We provide flexibility so you can balance professional ambition with your personal life. Here, differences are not just welcomed-they drive everything we do. 

If you're ready to innovate, rise to the challenge, and own every moment - make your next move your best one. Apply now. 

Submitting an Application

To ensure a streamlined and fair hiring process for all candidates, our team only reviews applications submitted through our company website. This practice allows us to track, assess, and respond to applicants efficiently. Emailing our employees, recruiters, or Human Resources personnel directly will not influence your application. 

AI Disclosure

For select roles, some stages of our hiring process may use artificial intelligence tools to help evaluate applications and candidate selection. These tools support-rather than replace-human decision-making.
