data.title: Applied AI Engineer - Firm Enterprise Solutions Director
data.description:
Summary

Position Summary

Director, Applied AI Engineering

Role Overview: As a Director, Applied AI Engineering , you will shape and own the engineering strategy and technical direction for your service line-translating business objectives into engineering strategy, mapping business capabilities to the enterprise technology landscape, and defining how GenAI and agentic capabilities are built directly into the products we deliver. You will develop and execute a forward-looking technology roadmap that drives simplification, scalability, and efficiency-rationalizing the landscape and integrating the service line's portfolio within the wider enterprise across multiple upstream and downstream systems. Leading across product groups and the service line, you will stay hands-on in your craft-shaping architecture, integration, design, and code-while driving the standards and enterprise reference architectures that engineers build against. 

Your leadership will be pivotal in delivering tangible value across the service line's product and AI investments, aligning technical solutions with business and technology strategy, and advancing Applied AI engineering across the organization. You will bring extensive engineering craftsmanship and deep expertise across software and data engineering, enterprise and integration architecture, and AI/ML and GenAI, together with an exemplary track record of high-quality, outcome-focused delivery at scale. The ideal candidate is a role-model engineering leader who leads by doing -owning strategy, elevating standards, developing engineers and emerging leaders, and building trusted relationships with stakeholders from engineering teams to senior executives and service-line leadership. 

Key Responsibilities: 

- Accountable for defining, communicating, and continuously refining the engineering strategy for the service line-translating business objectives into actionable strategy, mapping business capabilities to the enterprise technology landscape, defining how GenAI and agentic capabilities are built directly into the products we deliver, and shaping how those products integrate within the enterprise across multiple upstream and downstream systems-in alignment with the Business Strategy and US Deloitte Technology strategy. Collaborate with diverse stakeholders and executives, including businesses and enabling areas as well as product, engineering, experience, delivery, security, and infrastructure teams, across all organizational levels. 
 - Champion, own, and execute the integrated Applied AI engineering, architecture, and technology strategy and its implementation roadmap across the service line-driving simplification, scalability, and efficiency, and actively rationalizing the landscape by removing unnecessary systems, integrations, and bottlenecks. Ensure the organization is well-informed about objectives, KPIs, maturity, compliance, and progress. Promote a culture of reuse, quality, and speed-keeping an eye on leverage of existing assets and on the inference, token, and cloud cost of what we build, to maximize outcomes and minimize total cost. 
 - Define, measure, and drive the achievement of KPIs and NFRs spanning system performance, scalability, security, reliability, interoperability, auditability, and maintainability, and own engineering health and delivery KPIs across the product groups and the service line. Establish and evolve Applied AI engineering, enterprise and integration architecture, and AI/ML/GenAI reference architectures, standards, and best practices-including spec- and context-driven development, evaluations, AI agent orchestration, and the AI and Agentic SSDLC that carries work from discovery to production to operations with full automation and quality checks through the SSDLC lifecycle. Remain hands-on with design, architecture, integration, and code-contributing to product group and service line velocity and staying engaged with engineers across the SSDLC-while reviewing standards and code, driving tech-debt reduction, and experimenting with new technology. 
 - As a recognized engineering leader, mentor and develop engineers and emerging leaders, building the engineering talent bench across the product groups and the service line. Coach modern Applied AI engineering practices-full-stack and micro-services, integration tools and practices, cloud-native design, AI/ML/GenAI and agentic systems, data engineering, application-level infrastructure-as-code, and advanced deployment techniques (Blue-Green, Canary, A/B testing) that minimize downtime. Lead by example through thought leadership-showcasing experiments internally, speaking at conferences, publishing whitepapers or blogs, and leading R&D collaborations, including with academia and communities. Cultivate a growth mindset and modern engineering behaviors across the organization. 
 - Embrace an iterative and incremental approach to Applied AI product engineering and integration architecture, favoring action and rapid learning over extensive upfront planning. Apply a leaning-forward approach and empirical methods to navigate complexity and uncertainty, ensuring each iteration delivers value and stays aligned with customer and business goals. 
 - Maintain a relentless focus on solving the most critical challenges faced by customers and users, aligning technical solutions with business outcomes. Minimize unnecessary technical complexity and avoid overengineering-features, functionality, and integration approaches that do not add value-and drive teams toward peak performance through continuous learning and collaborative execution. Collaborate, challenge, and own technical decisions advocated by business or other groups that do not fit or advance the enterprise ecosystem. 
 - Possess deep expertise in modern Applied AI engineering and architecture practices, with a keen ability to identify inefficiencies and opportunities for innovation across the technology landscape and the product lifecycle. Continuously enhance the engineering operating model to be lean, adaptable, and responsive-guiding and transforming the organization to embrace lean principles and foster a culture of innovation. 
 - Establish and evolve enterprise reference architectures, coding standards, and engineering and quality benchmarks that ensure robust, secure, scalable, and reliable/resilient solutions. Ensure appropriate, responsible technology adoption-developing explainable, scalable, reliable, and secure AI and agentic products-and proactively identify technical risks, developing mitigation strategies through proactive problem-solving and contingency planning, ensuring operational excellence and resilience across the product groups and the service line. 
 - Influence, persuade, and drive decision-making across the organization. Communicate effectively in both written and verbal forms, crafting clear, structured arguments and technical trade-offs supported by evidence. 
 - Engage stakeholders at all levels-from team members and middle management to senior executives and service-line leadership-building collaborative, constructive relationships and co-creating momentum and value across the organization. 

The team: US Deloitte Technology Product Engineering has modernized software and product delivery, creating a scalable, cost-effective model that focuses on value/outcomes that leverages a progressive and responsive talent structure. As Deloitte's primary internal development team, Product Engineering delivers innovative digital solutions to businesses, service lines, and internal operations with proven bottom-line results and outcomes. It helps power Deloitte's success. It is the engine that drives Deloitte, serving many of the world's largest, most respected companies. We develop and deploy cutting-edge internal and go-to-market solutions that help Deloitte operate effectively and lead in the market. Our reputation is built on a tradition of delivering with excellence. 

The successful candidate will possess: 

- Excellent interpersonal and organizational skills, with the ability to handle diverse situations, complex projects, and changing priorities, behaving with passion, empathy, and care. 

Required Qualifications: 

- A bachelor's degree in computer science, software engineering, data science, machine learning, or related discipline. Experience is the most relevant factor. 
 - 12+ years of full-stack software engineering experience with most of the following: Angular, React, NodeJS, Python, C#, . NET, Java, SQL/NoSQL, REST/SOAP/GraphQL, SSO/MFA, PyTorch, TensorFlow, LangChain, LangGraph, as well as unit and integration testing frameworks. 
 - 8+ years of experience architecting and delivering enterprise solutions on modern technology stacks (e. g. , API Gateways, Message Brokers, Queuing Services, Workflow Automation & Orchestration, ETL/ELT, Event Streaming, Real-Time Data Processing, Service Mesh) and cloud-native engineering, using FaaS, PaaS, and micro-services on any of the cloud hyperscalers such as Azure, AWS, or GCP, including leveraging their AI/ML services such as Azure OpenAI, AWS Bedrock, or Vertex AI, plus application-level infrastructure-as-code and cost-aware engineering (FinOps accountability). 
 - 5+ years of experience building AI/ML and agentic applications, with hands-on GenAI experience across LLM integration (OpenAI, Anthropic, or open-source models), RAG pipelines, prompt engineering, vector databases, evaluations, and AI agent orchestration. 
 - 5+ years of experience in establishing enterprise engineering standards, including actively leading, mentoring, and guiding large engineering teams in the adoption and continuous improvement of these standards. 
 - Prior software engineering experience with the understanding of Business Context Diagrams (BCD), sequence/activity/state/entity relationship/data flow diagrams, OOP/OOD, data structures, algorithms, and code instrumentations, and AI-augmented spec-driven development. 
 - Prior experience using methodologies & tools such as XP, Lean, DevSecOps, SRE, ADO, GitHub, SonarQube, MLflow, and agentic AI frameworks (e. g. LangFuse, LangSmith, or equivalent multi-agent orchestration tools) etc. to deliver high-quality products rapidly. 

Other: 

- Ability to travel 10%, on average, based on the work you do and products you build.

Staff BSP Software Engineer: 

Staff BSP (Board Support Package) Engineer will lead and drive embedded Linux platform development, board bring-up, and hardware-software integration for next-generation embedded systems.

MX processor platforms. The candidate should be proficient in Yocto-based Linux build systems and have a deep understanding of hardware-software interfaces, device tree configurations, and low-level debugging. 

What you will do: 

- Lead the design, development and integration of Embedded Linux Board Support Packages (BSPs). 
 - Drive Linux kernel development, customization, configuration, debugging, and optimization. 
 - Work extensively with NXP i. MX processor families, including platform initialization, bootloader integration, and board-level software enablement. 
 - Develop, integrate, and debug Wi-Fi, display and USB drivers, ensuring reliable connectivity and display functionality. 
 - Maintaining/updating the embedded Linux Yocto distribution and develop and maintain Yocto-based build systems, including custom layers, recipes, kernel configurations, and image generation. 
 - Collaborate with hardware engineering teams to validate board designs, debug hardware-software integration issues, and resolve platform-level challenges. 
 - Perform hardware-level debugging using tools such as JTAG debuggers, oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, and other lab equipment. 
 - Analyze and optimize system boot time, memory utilization, CPU performance, and overall platform stability. 
 - Design and implement power management strategies for low-power embedded systems, including suspend/resume and power optimization. 
 - Establish and maintain CI/CD pipelines for embedded Linux development, including automated builds, integration testing, and release processes. 
 - Mentor engineers and provide technical guidance across BSP, kernel, and embedded platform development activities. 

Required Qualifications

- Bachelor's/master's degree in Electronics and Communication, Embedded system, Electrical /Electronics Engineering, or a related field. 
 - 7 to 9 years of total professional in embedded systems. 
 - Strong experience in embedded systems development on NXP i. MX processor families. 
 - Strong understanding of embedded boot processes, including Boot ROM, U-Boot, Linux boot flow, and root filesystem initialization. 
 - Familiarity with ARM-based SoC architectures, memory management, interrupts, DMA, GPIO, I2C, SPI, UART, USB and other hardware interfaces. 
 - Experience developing and debugging Wi-Fi, display, and USB peripheral drivers.

data.description:
Our Mission

At Palo Alto Networks®, we're united by a shared mission-to protect our digital way of life. We thrive at the intersection of innovation and impact, solving real-world problems with cutting-edge technology and bold thinking. Here, everyone has a voice, and every idea counts. Who We Are

In order to be the cybersecurity partner of choice, we must trailblaze the path and shape the future of our industry. This is something our employees work at each day and is defined by our values: Disruption, Collaboration, Execution, Integrity, and Inclusion. We weave AI into the fabric of everything we do and use it to augment the impact every individual can have. If you are passionate about solving real-world problems and ideating beside the best and the brightest, we invite you to join us!

We believe collaboration thrives in person. That's why most of our teams work from the office full time, with flexibility when it's needed. This model supports real-time problem-solving, stronger relationships, and the kind of precision that drives great outcomes. 

Job Summary

We are seeking a Senior Staff Software Engineer to own medium-sized features in our connectors framework from design through production. In this role, you will work independently on diverse problems that require weighing many factors, and you will find simple solutions that keep the framework easy to maintain. You will write the designs for features in your component, rewrite modules with a solid grasp of the overall architecture, and mentor junior engineers along the way. 

What You'll Do

- Own Medium-Sized Framework Features: Take a framework feature from design to production. Examples include checkpoint and resume for long-running syncs, per-credential rate limiting, or write-operation support in the no-code connector framework. 
 - Design Within Your Component: Write functional and design specifications for features in your area of the framework, and argue your design decisions in reviews. 
 - Break Down Ambiguity: Turn vague or complex requirements into simple, well-scoped pieces, and keep making progress when the path is unclear. 
 - Rewrite and Improve Modules: Refactor or rewrite framework modules and services, with a solid understanding of the overall architecture, performance, deployment, and debugging. 
 - Protect Data Accuracy: Make sure the features you build handle deletions, partial failures, and retries without corrupting the identity inventory. 
 - Debug Complex Issues: Fix complicated framework issues and customer escalations, and join support calls alongside senior engineers and PM. 
 - Apply AI-First Practices: Build AI-assisted workflows for your component, and rigorously evaluate AI-generated code and configuration to prevent hallucinations, security gaps, and logic defects. 
 - Practice Secure Engineering: Handle customer credentials, tokens, and tenant isolation correctly in everything you build, and resolve security findings in your area. 
 - Mentor on Quality: Mentor junior engineers on code quality, testing, and documentation. 
 - Deliver on Commitments: Do what it takes, including sensible trade-offs, to deliver on time. 

Nice to Have

- Identity & Access Security Domain: Direct experience with IAM, PAM, IGA, or Secrets Management platforms. Familiarity with SCIM or entitlement modeling. 
 - Declarative Integration Frameworks: Experience extending low-code or no-code integration platforms, or transformation languages such as JSONata or JSONPath. 
 - Workflow & Job Orchestration: Experience with distributed job schedulers, queues, or durable workflow engines, such as Agenda, SQS, Kafka, or Temporal. 
 - Hybrid Connectivity: Experience with agents or gateways that run inside customer networks and connect back to a cloud service. 
 - Quality & Observability Tooling: Fluency with Jest or Vitest, contract testing, JMeter for load testing, and monitoring tools such as Datadog. 

Impact

As a Senior Staff Software Engineer on the connectors framework, you will be a go-to engineer for your area of the platform. The features you own will shape how accurately and reliably identity data reaches our product. Your impact will be measured by the quality and durability of the features you deliver, how well you handle ambiguity, and the growth of the engineers you mentor. 

Qualifications

- Backend Mastery: Deep hands-on experience building enterprise-grade services with Node. js, TypeScript, Express. js, and MongoDB. 
 - Data Sync & Pipelines: Experience building data sync or ETL pipelines that handle idempotency, retries, pagination, and rate limits. 
 - Integration Protocols: Practical experience with REST, SCIM 2. 0, GraphQL, and SOAP APIs, plus OAuth 2. 0 and other enterprise authentication schemes. 
 - Cloud Experience: Experience building and operating services on AWS. 
 - Design Documentation: Able to write clear functional and design specifications that explain trade-offs. 
 - Production Debugging: Experience debugging complicated production issues and customer cases. 
 - Development Processes: Expert understanding of development processes and tools, including issue tracking, source control, and CI/CD. 
 - AI Tooling & Output Verification: Expertise in prompt and context engineering, with peer-review rigor to verify AI output for correctness and security. 
 - Customer Understanding: Good understanding of customer use cases, problems, and considerations. 

Qualifications

Our Commitment

We're trailblazers that dream big, take risks, and challenge cybersecurity's status quo. It's simple: we can't accomplish our mission without diverse teams innovating, together. 

We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for all qualified individuals with a disability. If you require assistance or accommodation due to a disability or special need, please contact us at accommodations@paloaltonetworks. com. 

Palo Alto Networks is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity in our workplace, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran status, race, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or other legally protected characteristics. 

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

data.title: Sr Manager, Full-Stack Engineering
data.description:
Experience: 9-12 years of software engineering experience, with substantial hands-on experience developing modern React applications

Location: Mumbai | Hybrid

Role Purpose

We are seeking a highly experienced, hands-on Full-Stack Engineering and React SME to provide technical leadership for modern web-based analytics applications across the Analytics Gateway portfolio. 

The role combines hands-on engineering, solution architecture, and technical leadership. The successful candidate will build production applications while establishing reusable engineering patterns, standards and platform capabilities that can be adopted across multiple project teams. 

The individual will be expected to operate across the full application lifecycle, spanning React/TypeScript front-end engineering, Python backend services, API integration, enterprise authentication and authorization, Snowflake connectivity, automated testing, CI/CD, cloud deployment, security and production observability. 

This is not a traditional people-management position or a pure front-end role. It requires a senior engineer who can remain hands-on while acting as a technical SME and design authority across multiple initiatives. 

Key Responsibilities

Front-End Engineering

- Design and build scalable, production-grade applications using React and TypeScript. 
 - Establish component-driven UI architectures supporting reusable components, modular development and consistent user experiences. 
 - Implement robust approaches for routing, client and server state, asynchronous data retrieval, error/loading states and caching. 
 - Build responsive, accessible applications supporting desktop and tablet experiences. 
 - Develop data-intensive interfaces using visualization libraries such as Highcharts, ECharts, D3 or equivalent. 
 - Optimize application performance through appropriate use of lazy loading, code splitting, memoization, virtualization, pagination and caching. 
 - Establish reusable design systems, component libraries, and Figma-to-code patterns across multiple applications. 
 - Apply appropriate accessibility standards such as WCAG 2. 1 AA. 

Backend & API Engineering

- Design, develop and maintain backend services using Python with Flask and/or FastAPI. 
 - Design well-structured REST APIs covering contracts, schema validation, versioning, pagination, standardized error handling and API documentation. 
 - Own frontend/backend integration end to end, including API contracts, schema evolution and backward compatibility. 
 - Integrate applications securely with enterprise platforms and cloud data services. 
 - Develop performant data-access patterns for Snowflake and other cloud data platforms, with appropriate consideration for connection management, query performance and caching. 
 - Maintain appropriate separation between presentation, service/business logic and data-access layers. 

Security & Enterprise Engineering

- Apply secure-by-design engineering principles throughout the application lifecycle. 
 - Implement enterprise authentication patterns utilizing SSO, OAuth2/OIDC and/or SAML. 
 - Design application authorization using RBAC and entitlement-based access controls, ensuring protected resources and data permissions are enforced server-side or at the appropriate data/service layer. 
 - Apply OWASP-aligned secure coding practices covering injection, XSS, CSRF, authentication/session risks and dependency vulnerabilities. 
 - Ensure credentials, tokens and secrets are managed securely and never exposed within client-side code. 
 - Participate in SAST/SCA/DAST scanning, dependency management, vulnerability remediation and application-security reviews. 
 - Implement appropriate audit logging and access traceability for enterprise applications. 

Cloud, DevOps & Production Engineering

- Containerize web applications and backend services using Docker. 
 - Build and maintain automated CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Azure DevOps or comparable platforms. 
 - Deploy and support applications on AWS/cloud-based container environments. 
 - Implement structured logging, application/API metrics, performance monitoring and operational dashboards. 
 - Use observability platforms such as Grafana, CloudWatch, AppDynamics, Datadog or equivalent. 
 - Diagnose production issues, perform root-cause analysis and implement preventative improvements. 
 - Establish appropriate environment configuration, dependency management and release/versioning practices. 

Quality Engineering

- Establish automated testing across unit, component, integration, API and end-to-end layers. 
 - Use modern test frameworks such as React Testing Library, Jest/Vitest and Playwright/Cypress or equivalent. 
 - Establish API and frontend/backend contract-testing practices. 
 - Define practical code-quality and test-coverage expectations. 
 - Promote automated quality checks within CI/CD pipelines. 

Architecture, SME & Technical Leadership

- Serve as the React and full-stack engineering SME across multiple analytics initiatives. 
 - Define and maintain reusable reference architectures, application scaffolding, shared components and engineering standards. 
 - Lead technical design and code reviews across internal and partner/vendor engineering teams. 
 - Evaluate architectural options and make pragmatic decisions covering scalability, maintainability, security, performance and delivery complexity. 
 - Set standards covering coding, branching, testing, security, accessibility, documentation and definition of done. 
 - Guide teams on technical feasibility, estimates, engineering trade-offs and build-versus-buy decisions. 
 - Identify and manage technical debt, modernization opportunities and dependency/lifecycle risks. 
 - Mentor engineers through design reviews, pairing, reference implementations and technical documentation. 
 - Influence teams without direct reporting authority and drive adoption of common engineering standards. 
 - Communicate technical decisions, risks and recommendations effectively to architecture, security, product and senior business stakeholders. 

Required Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering or related field required
 - 9-12 years of professional software engineering experience. 
 - Approximately 5+ years of substantial hands-on experience with React and modern JavaScript/TypeScript development. 
 - Strong knowledge of React architecture, hooks, component design, routing, state/data management and frontend performance. 
 - Demonstrated experience designing and developing backend APIs, preferably using Python/FastAPI. 
 - Proven ownership of end-to-end full-stack applications from architecture and development through testing, deployment and production support. 
 - Strong understanding of REST API architecture and frontend/backend integration patterns. 
 - Strong SQL skills and experience integrating applications with relational databases or cloud data platforms. 
 - Experience implementing authentication and authorization for enterprise applications. 
 - Practical understanding of application security and OWASP-aligned secure development practices. 
 - Hands-on experience with Git, CI/CD, Docker and cloud deployment. 
 - Strong automated-testing discipline across frontend and backend services. 
 - Demonstrated ability to troubleshoot application performance and production issues. 
 - Experience conducting architecture/design and code reviews. 
 - Proven ability to establish engineering standards and influence multiple engineering teams. 
 - Strong communication skills with the ability to translate complex technical topics for non-technical stakeholders. 
 - Experience working within Agile delivery environments. 

Work Location Assignment: Hybrid

data.description:
Our Mission

At Palo Alto Networks®, we're united by a shared mission-to protect our digital way of life. We thrive at the intersection of innovation and impact, solving real-world problems with cutting-edge technology and bold thinking. Here, everyone has a voice, and every idea counts. If you're ready to do the most meaningful work of your career alongside people who are just as passionate as you are, you're in the right place. 

Who We Are

In order to be the cybersecurity partner of choice, we must trailblaze the path and shape the future of our industry. This is something our employees work at each day and is defined by our values: Disruption, Collaboration, Execution, Integrity, and Inclusion. We weave AI into the fabric of everything we do and use it to augment the impact every individual can have. If you are passionate about solving real-world problems and ideating beside the best and the brightest, we invite you to join us!

We believe collaboration thrives in person. That's why most of our teams work from the office full time, with flexibility when it's needed. This model supports real-time problem-solving, stronger relationships, and the kind of precision that drives great outcomes. 

Job Summary

We are seeking a Senior Staff Software Engineer to own medium-sized features in our connectors framework from design through production. In this role, you will work independently on diverse problems that require weighing many factors, and you will find simple solutions that keep the framework easy to maintain. You will write the designs for features in your component, rewrite modules with a solid grasp of the overall architecture, and mentor junior engineers along the way. 

What You'll Do

- Own Medium-Sized Framework Features: Take a framework feature from design to production. Examples include checkpoint and resume for long-running syncs, per-credential rate limiting, or write-operation support in the no-code connector framework. 
 - Design Within Your Component: Write functional and design specifications for features in your area of the framework, and argue your design decisions in reviews. 
 - Break Down Ambiguity: Turn vague or complex requirements into simple, well-scoped pieces, and keep making progress when the path is unclear. 
 - Rewrite and Improve Modules: Refactor or rewrite framework modules and services, with a solid understanding of the overall architecture, performance, deployment, and debugging. 
 - Protect Data Accuracy: Make sure the features you build handle deletions, partial failures, and retries without corrupting the identity inventory. 
 - Debug Complex Issues: Fix complicated framework issues and customer escalations, and join support calls alongside senior engineers and PM. 
 - Apply AI-First Practices: Build AI-assisted workflows for your component, and rigorously evaluate AI-generated code and configuration to prevent hallucinations, security gaps, and logic defects. 
 - Practice Secure Engineering: Handle customer credentials, tokens, and tenant isolation correctly in everything you build, and resolve security findings in your area. 
 - Mentor on Quality: Mentor junior engineers on code quality, testing, and documentation. 
 - Deliver on Commitments: Do what it takes, including sensible trade-offs, to deliver on time. 

Nice to Have

- Identity & Access Security Domain: Direct experience with IAM, PAM, IGA, or Secrets Management platforms. Familiarity with SCIM or entitlement modeling. 
 - Declarative Integration Frameworks: Experience extending low-code or no-code integration platforms, or transformation languages such as JSONata or JSONPath. 
 - Workflow & Job Orchestration: Experience with distributed job schedulers, queues, or durable workflow engines, such as Agenda, SQS, Kafka, or Temporal. 
 - Hybrid Connectivity: Experience with agents or gateways that run inside customer networks and connect back to a cloud service. 
 - Quality & Observability Tooling: Fluency with Jest or Vitest, contract testing, JMeter for load testing, and monitoring tools such as Datadog. 

Impact

As a Senior Staff Software Engineer on the connectors framework, you will be a go-to engineer for your area of the platform. The features you own will shape how accurately and reliably identity data reaches our product. Your impact will be measured by the quality and durability of the features you deliver, how well you handle ambiguity, and the growth of the engineers you mentor. 

Qualifications

- Backend Mastery: Deep hands-on experience building enterprise-grade services with Node. js, TypeScript, Express. js, and MongoDB. 
 - Data Sync & Pipelines: Experience building data sync or ETL pipelines that handle idempotency, retries, pagination, and rate limits. 
 - Integration Protocols: Practical experience with REST, SCIM 2. 0, GraphQL, and SOAP APIs, plus OAuth 2. 0 and other enterprise authentication schemes. 
 - Cloud Experience: Experience building and operating services on AWS. 
 - Design Documentation: Able to write clear functional and design specifications that explain trade-offs. 
 - Production Debugging: Experience debugging complicated production issues and customer cases. 
 - Development Processes: Expert understanding of development processes and tools, including issue tracking, source control, and CI/CD. 
 - AI Tooling & Output Verification: Expertise in prompt and context engineering, with peer-review rigor to verify AI output for correctness and security. 
 - Customer Understanding: Good understanding of customer use cases, problems, and considerations. 

Qualifications

Our Commitment

We're trailblazers that dream big, take risks, and challenge cybersecurity's status quo. It's simple: we can't accomplish our mission without diverse teams innovating, together. 

We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for all qualified individuals with a disability. If you require assistance or accommodation due to a disability or special need, please contact us at accommodations@paloaltonetworks. com. 

Palo Alto Networks is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity in our workplace, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran status, race, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or other legally protected characteristics. 

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines. 

Is role eligible for Immigration Sponsorship? No. Please note that we will not sponsor applicants for work visas for this position.

data.title: Chief Testing and Commissioning Expert- BID Position
data.description:
SYSTRA is one of the world's leading engineering and consulting groups specializing in public transport and mobility solutions. For over 65 years, the Group has been committed to helping cities and regions develop by creating, improving and modernizing their transport infrastructure and systems. 

Context

In India, SYSTRA is an international consulting and engineering company operating in the fields of Metros, High Speed Rail, Railways, Roads, Buildings, Urban planning, and Water & Environment for public and private organizations. 

Our engineers work with passion to deliver the most reliable, cost-effective and made-to measures solutions allowing end users to move seamlessly. 

SYSTRA's unique expertise is backed with a reputation built through technical excellence delivered on projects. Thanks to our know-how of our employees spread across India, we are present at all stages from upstream studies to operation and maintenance. We provide a comprehensive solution to manage all kinds of missions: Detailed Design Consultant, Project Management, Independent checking services. 

SYSTRA India's comprehensive know-how and expertise in Railways provides a wide spectrum of solutions for any challenge (Building a new rail link, doubling the capacity, gauge conversion, upgrading a network, improving the performance of existing lines, etc. ). 

Our extensive experience encompasses, Bridges, station buildings, Depots, Earthwork & Track Works, Power Supply and Transmission, Signaling & Telecommunications, Rolling Stock, Utilities diversion and yard re-modelling etc. 

Our services cover the entire life cycle of the project implementation. 

Currently, we are bidding for Semi High Speed Rail projects across India. The position of Chief Testing and Commissioning Expert is the key position in these BIDs. 

Missions/Main Duties

- System Integration Strategy & Planning: 📝 Develop the comprehensive Master Testing and Commissioning Plan (MTCP). This includes defining the T&C strategy, budget, schedule, and necessary resources for all railway subsystems (Signaling, Power, Rolling Stock, Telecoms, Track, etc. ) and ensuring their successful technical and operational integration. 
 - Statutory Compliance and Safety Certification: Act as the primary technical point of contact for obtaining Statutory Clearances and Safety Certification from regulatory authorities (e. g. , Commissioner of Railway Safety). This involves managing the preparation and submission of all critical safety dossiers and test reports. 
 - Lead System Integration Testing (SIT): 🔗 Direct the complex interface testing between major subsystems, such as validating the communication and functional response between the Signaling System (e. g. , ETCS), the Rolling Stock (trains), and the Power Supply/Traction system. 
 - Operational Readiness & Trial Run Management: Oversee all stages of trial and dynamic testing, including running trains at maximum projected speeds to validate ride quality, braking performance, and system stability under real-world conditions. This culminates in declaring the line ready for shadow operation. 
 - Defect Management and Resolution: Establish and enforce a rigorous process for managing Non-Conformities (NCs) and defects found during T&C. The expert is responsible for tracking all open items to closure and verifying that corrective actions do not negatively impact other system interfaces. 
 - Handover, Training, and Documentation: Lead the formal Handover Process to the Operations and Maintenance (O&M) team. This includes approving final system manuals, maintenance procedures, and ensuring the operational staff is fully trained and competent to safely run the railway. 

Profile/Skills

- Qualification: Graduate in Engineering with working knowledge of reading, writing and speaking in English [additional marks for PG in Engineering]
 - Minimum Experience: 20 years post minimum qualification in any Rail based Passenger Transit System [additional marks for more experience in any Rail based Passenger Transit System*]
 - Relevant Experience: 5 years' experience for two works of Planning and supervising Trial tests and commissioning of subsystems of Rail based Passenger Transit system and obtaining statutory approvals for Commercial operation as Chief Testing and Commissioning Expert or equivalent position [additional marks for more experience; experience in position one level below allowed with less weightage]
 - Eligible Assignment**(see below): Must have experience of 1 Eligible Assignment as Chief Testing and Commissioning Expert or equivalent position for a full-time continuous deployment period not less than 2 years [additional marks for more Eligible Assignments; less weightage for position one level below]
 - Rail-based Passenger Transit System shall mean
 - High Speed Transit System / Regional Rail Transit System (with operational speed of 160kmh and above) OR 
 - Urban/Suburban/Intercity/Mass Rapid Transit System (MRTS) [excluding LRT with design PHPDT less than 20000/Tram/Monorail Systems]
 - Shall mean experience of working as a personnel of General Consultant / Project Management Consultant / Employer's Personnel in a work / project in a Rail based Passenger Transit System with operational speed of 160 kmph or more comprising: 
 - Construction of Civil structures (at-grade/elevated/underground) AND 
 - Installation of Systems (Track, Rolling Stock, Traction & Power Supply, Signalling)

Including Detailed Design or Proof checking of designs; Bid Process Management; Project and Interface Management; Construction Supervision and System Installations and Testing & Commissioning

We commit to put people who join us at the heart of improving transportation and urban infrastructure efficiency. As we are growing, this is time to be a part of this challenging adventure. It's not a job - it's a career!

data.description:
SYSTRA is one of the world's leading engineering and consulting groups specializing in public transport and mobility solutions. For over 65 years, the Group has been committed to helping cities and regions develop by creating, improving and modernizing their transport infrastructure and systems

Context

In India, SYSTRA is an international consulting and engineering company operating in the fields of Metros, High Speed Rail, Railways, Roads, Buildings, Urban planning, and Water & Environment for public and private organizations. 

Our engineers work with passion to deliver the most reliable, cost-effective and made-to measures solutions allowing end users to move seamlessly. 

SYSTRA's unique expertise is backed with a reputation built through technical excellence delivered on projects. Thanks to our know-how of our employees spread across India, we are present at all stages from upstream studies to operation and maintenance. We provide a comprehensive solution to manage all kinds of missions: Detailed Design Consultant, Project Management, Independent checking services. 

SYSTRA India's comprehensive know-how and expertise in Railways provides a wide spectrum of solutions for any challenge (Building a new rail link, doubling the capacity, gauge conversion, upgrading a network, improving the performance of existing lines, etc. ). 

Our extensive experience encompasses, Bridges, station buildings, Depots, Earthwork & Track Works, Power Supply and Transmission, Signaling & Telecommunications, Rolling Stock, Utilities diversion and yard re-modelling etc. 

Our services cover the entire life cycle of the project implementation. 

Currently, we are bidding for Metro Rail projects across India. The position of Chief Quality Assurance Expert (Civil) is the key position in these BIDs. 

Missions/Main Duties

- Quality Management System (QMS): Establish, implement, and continually improve the project's Quality Management System in accordance with national/international standards and client requirements. 
 - Quality Planning: Develop and maintain project-specific quality assurance plans, inspection & test plans, and related procedures for all construction and system activities. 
 - Supervision and Auditing: Lead quality audits and inspections across all project phases, verifying compliance with approved designs, material specifications, and construction practices.

Konovo provides healthcare organisations with access to over 2 million healthcare professionals and patients, the largest network of its kind globally. With a workforce of over 300 employees across 5 countries: India, Bosnia and Herzegovina, the United Kingdom, Mexico, and the United States, we collaborate to support some of the most prominent names in healthcare. We are an established but fast-growing business- powered by innovation, data, and technology. Konovo's capabilities are delivered through our cloud-based platform, enabling customers to collect data from healthcare professionals and transform it into actionable insights using cutting-edge AI in conjunction with proven market research tools and techniques. 

Our Whitefield-based India team is our innovation hub and foundation for scaling product and technology globally. It is also our center of excellence for building scalable platforms, AI-enabled capabilities, and next‐generation healthcare technology. As a Lead Quality Assurance Engineer, you will define how quality is engineered across our platform, not just how software is tested. This is a hands-on role for someone who believes quality is built into engineering from day one. If you are highly technical, deeply execution-focused, and passionate about scaling quality through automation, observability, and AI, Lead Quality Assurance Engineer is for you. 

How You'll Make an Impact: 

- Define and scale quality engineering standards, quality gates, and release-readiness frameworks across multiple squads. 
 - Architect end-to-end test strategy covering UI, API, database, integration, security, and performance testing. 
 - Drive shift-left quality practices across the SDLC; partner with developers to embed quality in PRs and release cycles. 
 - Implement risk-based testing and prioritization to uncover hidden gaps early and focus effort on the highest-impact areas. 
 - Design, build, and scale enterprise automation frameworks; expand end-to-end automation for critical business workflows. 
 - Reduce manual regression through intelligent automation; improve stability, minimize flaky tests, and strengthen CI/CD quality signals. 
 - Partner with Konovo's global LLM Innovative Technology Team (LITE) team to integrate AI into QE (test generation, defect classification, automated RCA, trend prediction, flaky detection, release health dashboards). 
 - Define performance benchmarks, identify bottlenecks across services/APIs/data flows, and drive scalability, reliability, and response-time improvements. 
 - Establish continuous monitoring and observability standards; track pipeline health, failures, and release stability in real time. 
 - Own end-to-end QA delivery across global teams -drive risks/blockers to closure and provide executive-ready quality metrics, trends, and recommendations. 

What We're Looking For: 

- 8+ years in software testing/quality engineering, including test automation and/or test architecture, in product environments. 
 - Proven QA leadership across multiple engineering teams, with strong ownership and clear cross-functional communication. 
 - Hands-on depth in UI/API automation, integration & database testing, performance testing, and building test frameworks. 
 - Strong CI/CD quality engineering and observability exposure (e. g. , Jenkins/GitHub Actions, Grafana) plus cloud familiarity (AWS/Azure/GCP). 
 - Proficient in Java/Python/JavaScript (or similar) and modern automation tooling (e. g. , Playwright/Cypress, K6, JMeter, Agentic AI, MCP servers). 
 - Mentor and grow engineers through clear feedback and hands-on support. 
 - Operate effectively in ambiguous, global, fast-moving environments. 
 - Apply and experiment with AI-enhanced engineering workflows with strong judgment and responsibility. 

Why Join Konovo?

- Be part of a mission-driven organisation that is empowering life science researchers and data scientists with the broadest ecosystem of healthcare audiences and an intelligent, AI-enabled platform - so insights aren't just collected, they're connected. 
 - Join a fast-growing global team with opportunities for professional growth and advancement. 
 - Build technology that enables faster, smarter healthcare research and improves global patient outcomes. 
 - Enjoy a collaborative and hybrid work environment that fosters innovation and flexibility. 
 - Experience a workplace that puts employees first, offering a workplace designed for growth, well-being, and balance. 
 - Become a part of an organisation that prioritizes your well-being with comprehensive benefits, including group medical coverage, accident insurance, and a robust leave policy. Our employee-centric policies ensure a rewarding and fulfilling work experience. 
 - Make a real-world impact by helping healthcare organisations innovate faster. 

If you're eager to build a meaningful career in healthcare market research and you're smart, nice, and driven to make an impact we'd love to hear from you!

Apply now to be part of our journey.

data.title: Lead SDET
data.description:
Sprinto is an Autonomous Trust Platform that centralizes trust requirements across security frameworks, vendors, and customers. 
Sprinto autonomously executes tasks needed to maintain trust across compliance, audits, risk management, vendor risk, privacy, and AI governance, enabling organizations to maintain a strong, reliable trust posture without draining operational bandwidth and resources on repetitive tasks. 

Backed by top-tier investors such as Accel, Elevation, and Blume Ventures, we've raised $31. 8M in funding to fuel our mission. Trusted by over 4, 000 organizations across 75 countries, Sprinto helps organizations stay audit-ready, manage real-time risks, and scale fearlessly. With 300+ native integrations and AI-driven automation, Sprinto supports 200+ global security standards natively, including SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR, HIPAA, PCI-DSS, and more. Sprinto's extensible architecture enables organizations to build and support an infinite number of custom integrations and frameworks. 

Founded in 2020 by second-time founders Girish Redekar and Raghuveer Kancherla, Sprinto powers compliance for organizations like Whatfix, Encora, Anaconda, Whatnot, Ultrahuman, WeWork, Everstage, AI Foundation, HackerRank, and many more. 

Life as a Sprinter -
Nobody succeeds at Sprinto by staying in their lane. 

We are organized around problems, not job titles. Sprinters take ownership beyond their role, solve hard problems, and care deeply about the impact they create. If something can be improved, fixed, or built, we don't wait for permission; we step in. 

Being remote means we rely less on proximity and more on trust. We write things down, communicate openly, and move quickly because great teams aren't built by sitting together, they're built by pulling in the same direction. 

We believe progress beats perfection, feedback is a gift, and doing the right thing matters, even when nobody is watching. 

And while we move with urgency, we never move alone. 

The mission -
Where you'll leave your mark?

- Own quality outcomes, not activities - the question is never "how many test cases did you write this sprint, " it's "what quality metric moved and what did you build to move it. "
 - Drive CI pass rate to 90%+ and keep it there - the percentage of pipeline runs that pass without manual intervention
 - Own bug leakage rate - target under 2-3% of bugs escaping QA to staging or production, with a root cause analysis you own for every bug that gets through
 - Build the system that keeps flaky tests out of the suite - preventing flakiness from entering and quarantining it when it does
 - Shape automation coverage at the right layer - E2E where it matters, API where it's faster and more reliable, unit where developers should own it - not just chasing a coverage percentage
 - Stay 50-60% hands-on - writing Playwright TypeScript to evolve the framework, building diagnostic tools that analyse test-run data for flakiness patterns, and reviewing PRs to catch structural problems in AI-generated test code
 - Build AI-native quality infrastructure - systems that use LLMs, agents, and AI tooling to solve quality problems at scale, like pipelines that auto-analyse every PR for risk across security, product, and UX dimensions
 - Deliver engineering-wide quality impact - at least one initiative per quarter that changes how developers or PMs ship, not just how QA tests. Our current guardrail system prevents 90 bugs per month without manual QA; that's the bar
 - Partner and present - sit with product engineers to define quality gates before features ship, and present quality metrics (CI pass rate, bug leakage, flaky test trends) to engineering leadership

The kind of builder we're looking for -

- An engineer who has chosen quality as their specialisation - this is not a pure coding role and not a management role; it lives exactly in between (: 40-50% strategy, cross-functional collaboration, and mentoring)
 - Engineering-wide in scope, not QA-internal - you want to improve how the entire engineering organisation thinks about quality, not just how the QA team works
 - AI-native, not AI-assisted - you don't just use Copilot for test authoring; you build quality systems on LLMs and agents, and you can test AI features themselves - validating agent behaviour, checking LLM output quality, and handling non-deterministic systems
 - A test pyramid thinker, not just an E2E automator - with developers now writing feature automation themselves, you push testing responsibility to the developer layer while QA owns integration, workflow, and AI feature quality. A candidate who only thinks Playwright and E2E is too narrow
 - Fluent in the modern stack - Playwright, TypeScript, CI pipelines, and the data behind them
 - Comfortable influencing without authority - defining quality gates with product engineers and changing developer behaviour through systems, not mandates

How we care for our Sprinters?

- Work wherever you are: We are 100% remote, so you get to choose if you want to work from home, a cafe, the hills, or the beach
 - Co-working, on the house: If co-working is your jam, we offer a generous annual allowance
 - We care about your learning: We are invested in seeing you grow and commit USD 1, 000 annually to help you level up your skills
 - We count your spark, not your leaves: Unlimited leave so you can reset when you need to
 - Your Safety Net, Woven In: Health insurance with coverage up to INR 10 lakh for you and your family, accident protection of an additional INR 10 lakh, and life insurance worth 3x your annual salary
 - Workspace setup of your dreams: We chip in INR 35, 000 to help you build a setup that works for you

Inclusion & Diversity -
At Sprinto, talent, curiosity, and ownership matter more than where you come from. We hire people for the problems they can solve, the impact they create, and the way they help others succeed-not their background, identity, or personal circumstances. We believe the best teams are built when people with different perspectives come together around a shared ambition to build something meaningful. 

We're proud to be an equal opportunity employer and are committed to creating a fair, inclusive, and accessible hiring process for everyone. 

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

data.title: Senior Staff Software Engineer
data.description:
Our Mission

At Palo Alto Networks®, we're united by a shared mission-to protect our digital way of life. We thrive at the intersection of innovation and impact, solving real-world problems with cutting-edge technology and bold thinking. Here, everyone has a voice, and every idea counts. If you're ready to do the most meaningful work of your career alongside people who are just as passionate as you are, you're in the right place. 

Who We Are

In order to be the cybersecurity partner of choice, we must trailblaze the path and shape the future of our industry. This is something our employees work at each day and is defined by our values: Disruption, Collaboration, Execution, Integrity, and Inclusion. We weave AI into the fabric of everything we do and use it to augment the impact every individual can have. If you are passionate about solving real-world problems and ideating beside the best and the brightest, we invite you to join us!

We believe collaboration thrives in person. That's why most of our teams work from the office full time, with flexibility when it's needed. This model supports real-time problem-solving, stronger relationships, and the kind of precision that drives great outcomes. 

Job Summary

We are seeking a Senior Staff Software Engineer to own medium-sized features in our connectors framework from design through production. In this role, you will work independently on diverse problems that require weighing many factors, and you will find simple solutions that keep the framework easy to maintain. You will write the designs for features in your component, rewrite modules with a solid grasp of the overall architecture, and mentor junior engineers along the way. 

What You'll Do

- Own Medium-Sized Framework Features: Take a framework feature from design to production. Examples include checkpoint and resume for long-running syncs, per-credential rate limiting, or write-operation support in the no-code connector framework. 
 - Design Within Your Component: Write functional and design specifications for features in your area of the framework, and argue your design decisions in reviews. 
 - Break Down Ambiguity: Turn vague or complex requirements into simple, well-scoped pieces, and keep making progress when the path is unclear. 
 - Rewrite and Improve Modules: Refactor or rewrite framework modules and services, with a solid understanding of the overall architecture, performance, deployment, and debugging. 
 - Protect Data Accuracy: Make sure the features you build handle deletions, partial failures, and retries without corrupting the identity inventory. 
 - Debug Complex Issues: Fix complicated framework issues and customer escalations, and join support calls alongside senior engineers and PM. 
 - Apply AI-First Practices: Build AI-assisted workflows for your component, and rigorously evaluate AI-generated code and configuration to prevent hallucinations, security gaps, and logic defects. 
 - Practice Secure Engineering: Handle customer credentials, tokens, and tenant isolation correctly in everything you build, and resolve security findings in your area. 
 - Mentor on Quality: Mentor junior engineers on code quality, testing, and documentation. 
 - Deliver on Commitments: Do what it takes, including sensible trade-offs, to deliver on time. 

Nice to Have

- Identity & Access Security Domain: Direct experience with IAM, PAM, IGA, or Secrets Management platforms. Familiarity with SCIM or entitlement modeling. 
 - Declarative Integration Frameworks: Experience extending low-code or no-code integration platforms, or transformation languages such as JSONata or JSONPath. 
 - Workflow & Job Orchestration: Experience with distributed job schedulers, queues, or durable workflow engines, such as Agenda, SQS, Kafka, or Temporal. 
 - Hybrid Connectivity: Experience with agents or gateways that run inside customer networks and connect back to a cloud service. 
 - Quality & Observability Tooling: Fluency with Jest or Vitest, contract testing, JMeter for load testing, and monitoring tools such as Datadog. 

Impact

As a Senior Staff Software Engineer on the connectors framework, you will be a go-to engineer for your area of the platform. The features you own will shape how accurately and reliably identity data reaches our product. Your impact will be measured by the quality and durability of the features you deliver, how well you handle ambiguity, and the growth of the engineers you mentor. 

Qualifications

- Backend Mastery: Deep hands-on experience building enterprise-grade services with Node. js, TypeScript, Express. js, and MongoDB. 
 - Data Sync & Pipelines: Experience building data sync or ETL pipelines that handle idempotency, retries, pagination, and rate limits. 
 - Integration Protocols: Practical experience with REST, SCIM 2. 0, GraphQL, and SOAP APIs, plus OAuth 2. 0 and other enterprise authentication schemes. 
 - Cloud Experience: Experience building and operating services on AWS. 
 - Design Documentation: Able to write clear functional and design specifications that explain trade-offs. 
 - Production Debugging: Experience debugging complicated production issues and customer cases. 
 - Development Processes: Expert understanding of development processes and tools, including issue tracking, source control, and CI/CD. 
 - AI Tooling & Output Verification: Expertise in prompt and context engineering, with peer-review rigor to verify AI output for correctness and security. 
 - Customer Understanding: Good understanding of customer use cases, problems, and considerations. 

Qualifications

Our Commitment

We're trailblazers that dream big, take risks, and challenge cybersecurity's status quo. It's simple: we can't accomplish our mission without diverse teams innovating, together. 

We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for all qualified individuals with a disability. If you require assistance or accommodation due to a disability or special need, please contact us at accommodations@paloaltonetworks. com. 

Palo Alto Networks is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity in our workplace, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran status, race, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or other legally protected characteristics. 

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines. 

Is role eligible for Immigration Sponsorship? No. Please note that we will not sponsor applicants for work visas for this position.

data.description:
Secure Every Identity, from AI to Human

Identity is the key to unlocking the potential of AI. Okta secures AI by building the trusted, neutral infrastructure that enables organizations to safely embrace this new era. This work requires a relentless drive to solve complex challenges with real-world stakes. We are looking for builders and owners who operate with speed and urgency and execute with excellence. 

This is an opportunity to do career-defining work. We're all in on this mission. If you are too, let's talk. 

At Okta, our motto is "Always On"  and nowhere do we embrace that more than in Technical Operations. We strive to build the most reliable and performant systems on the planet through the skillful use of automation. If you like to be challenged and have a passion for solving large-scale automation, testing, and tuning problems, we would love to hear from you. The ideal candidate is someone who exemplifies the ethics of, "If you have to do something more than once, automate it" and who can rapidly self-educate on new concepts and tools. 

You will work on: 

- Leading the architecture, design and rollout of the internal developer platform which would span CI/CD, tooling, infrastructure as code (IAC) integrations as well as modernization efforts
 - Enhance existing automation for fleet management and build new features as per the needs of the infrastructure platform  
 - Spearhead initiatives and projects that enhance engineer productivity by identifying and mitigating bottlenecks in the development flow
 - Mentoring, managing, and leading a team of SWEs & SREs with a broad range of expertise and experience
 - Triaging and troubleshooting complex production issues to ensure reliability and performance. 
 - Working closely with our stakeholders across the organization to ensure our new capabilities are aligned to our competing constraints of reliability, security, and delivery velocity
 - Partnering directly with recruiting and people ops to hire and retain the best talent in the world
 - Keep sharp eyes on our metrics, including vulnerability scanning and security posture, cloud spend, RPO and RTO, and toil overhead, and ensure our projects are driving our metrics in the right direction
 - Supporting a 24x7 online environment as part of an on-call rotationYou are an ideal candidate if you: 

- Platform-as-Product Mindset: Proven track record of building and scaling internal developer platforms (IDP) that treat internal engineering teams as customers, focusing on reducing cognitive load and improving developer velocity. 
 - Engineering Excellence in Tooling: Deep experience in the "Software" part of SRE-leading teams to build robust, automated tooling for CI/CD orchestration, Kubernetes operators, or self-service infrastructure provisioning (IaC). 
 - Automation First: A history of transitioning teams from manual "toil-heavy" operations to automated, code-driven workflows that interact safely with high-scale cloud production environments. 
 - Are always willing to go the extra mile: see a problem, fix the problem. 
 - Are passionate about encouraging the development of engineering peers and leading by example
 - Have experience managing teams running large-scale production Java/Tomcat and containerized services in AWS (EC2, ECS, KMS, Kinesis, RDS) or other cloud providers.   
 - Have deep knowledge of CI/CD principles, Linux fundamentals, OS hardening, networking concepts, and IP protocols. Minimum Required Knowledge, Skills, Abilities, and Qualities: 

- Overall experience 8+ years & 2+ years of engineering management experience leading SWE teams
 -   SRE, DevOps, or Platform Engineering teams, with the ability to remain hands-on technically. 
 - Strong hands-on expertise in AWS and GCP, particularly Amazon EKS, Kubernetes, cloud-native infrastructure, and production operations. 
 - Proven automation experience with Infrastructure as Code (e. g. , Terraform), scripting, and CI/CD, with a strong focus on cloud and Kubernetes security, IAM, and security automation. 
 - Strong leadership, communication, and problem-solving skills, with a BS in Computer Science or equivalent practical experience. #P12775_3245168

The Okta Experience

 - Developing Talent and Fostering Connection + CommunityWe are intentional about connection. Our global community, spanning over 20 offices worldwide, is united by a drive to innovate. Your journey begins with an immersive, in-person onboarding experience designed to accelerate your impact and connect you to our mission and team from day one.
