data.title: Lead Full-Stack Engineer (1230PM - 930PM IST)
data.description:
Lead Full-Stack Engineer

Location: Pune, India

Model of Work: Hybrid

Working Hours: 12: 30 PM to 9: 30 PM IST, a nine-hour workday that provides overlap with US Central Time stakeholders. 

About Quorum Software

Quorum Software connects people and information across the energy value chain. Twenty years ago, we built the first software for gas plant accountants. Pipeline operators came next, followed by land administrators, pumpers, and planners. Since 1998, Quorum has helped thousands of energy workers with business workflows that optimize profitability and growth. Our vision for the future connects the global energy ecosystem through cloud-first software, data standards, and integration. The trusted source of decision-ready data for 1, 800+ companies, Quorum Software makes the essential connections that let us work better together in the connected energy workplace. For more information, visit quorumsoftware. com

Be a part of our legacy

Quorum Software is the world's largest provider of digital technology focused solely on business workflows that empower the next evolution of energy. From emerging companies to supermajors, throughout every region of the globe, customers rely on Quorum's proven innovation and unmatched global expertise to streamline business operations and make data-driven decisions that optimize profitability and growth. Our industry-leading solutions are transforming energy companies across the entire value chain, helping visionary leaders evolve their organizations into modern energy companies. 

Who We Are Looking For

Are you excited by challenges? Do you enjoy working in a fast-paced, international and dynamic environment? Then now is the time to join Quorum Software, a rapidly growing company and industry leader in oil & gas transformation. 

The Opportunity

Quorum is seeking a Lead Full-Stack Engineer to own the technical design, development, and long-term success of a portfolio of AI-native platforms and operational solutions within Cloud Operations. 

This is a hands-on technical leadership role for an engineer who enjoys building products, establishing practical engineering standards, and owning production outcomes. You will serve as the primary technical lead and code owner while partnering with Cloud Operations, engineering peers, architects, platform teams, and business stakeholders. 

The initial focus is QPOP, the Quorum Platform Operations Portal, an Azure-native internal platform that brings service management, change management, estate visibility, customer relationships, and operational workflows into a unified experience. As the portfolio grows, the role will also deliver governed AI agents, agentic workflows, and Model Context Protocol (MCP) integrations. 

What You Will Own

- Application architecture and code quality across the assigned portfolio, including module boundaries, integrations, data models, testing standards, and production readiness. 
 - Engineering standards for code review, automated testing, CI/CD quality gates, documentation, observability, security, and an AI-enabled software development lifecycle (AI SDLC). 
 - Technical delivery from design through production support, working with partner teams rather than operating as a standalone contributor. 
 - Repository governance, including code ownership, reusable development patterns, AI-development guidance, prompt and agent assets, evaluation criteria, and review controls. 

What You Will Do

- Deliver full-stack application modules from design through build, integration, verification, release, and ongoing support. 
 - Build workflow integrations with enterprise platforms such as Azure DevOps, Microsoft Entra ID, Salesforce, PagerDuty, Microsoft Fabric, and related internal systems. 
 - Design reliable integration patterns using idempotency, webhooks, retries, reconciliation, failure recovery, and traceable audit records. 
 - Implement enterprise authentication and authorization using OIDC/OAuth 2. 0, Microsoft Entra ID, and role-based access control. 
 - Build metadata-driven forms, service catalogs, request workflows, and rules-driven user experiences. 
 - Design and develop governed AI agents, MCP servers, assistants, and agentic workflows that take approved actions through well-defined tools, permission checks, human approval points, and complete audit trails. 
 - Embed AI-assisted engineering into the SDLC, including planning, code generation, test creation, documentation, code review, security validation, and controlled promotion, while ensuring engineers remain accountable for every change. 
 - Deliver applications and infrastructure through GitHub Actions, OIDC, Bicep, and controlled promotion across development, non-production, and production environments. 
 - Create automated unit, integration, API, and end-to-end tests that provide confidence in releases. 
 - Participate in the appropriate production support and on-call rotation, with shared operational ownership across the team. 
 - Document architecture, operational procedures, key decisions, and support requirements as part of normal delivery. 
 - And other duties as assigned. 

Required Qualifications

- Strong hands-on experience delivering production full-stack applications using modern React, Next. js, TypeScript, and server-side APIs. 
 - Demonstrated technical leadership and long-term ownership of a production codebase, including architecture decisions, engineering standards, code review, and mentoring. 
 - Experience delivering production software through an AI-enabled SDLC using tools such as Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Cline, Roo Code, Windsurf, or equivalent platforms. 
 - Ability to explain how AI-generated code, prompts, agent behavior, and tool integrations were reviewed, tested, evaluated, corrected, secured, and governed before production release. 
 - Experience building enterprise integrations using REST APIs, webhooks, asynchronous messaging, retries, reconciliation, and failure recovery. 
 - Strong SQL data modeling experience, including schema migrations, entity resolution, and traceable audit records. 
 - Experience implementing enterprise identity and authorization using OIDC/OAuth 2. 0 and role-based access control. 
 - Proficiency with CI/CD and Infrastructure-as-Code using GitHub Actions and Bicep, Terraform, or comparable technologies. 
 - Strong automated testing experience across unit, integration, API, and end-to-end testing. 
 - Production troubleshooting and observability experience across logs, metrics, traces, health checks, dashboards, and alerts. 
 - Clear written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to work effectively across international teams. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Claude Code experience, including planning modes, subagents, repository guidance, hooks, skills, automated evaluations, or headless CI execution. 
 - Experience building and operating LLM assistants or AI agents with tool use, streaming responses, conversation state, evaluations, observability, safety controls, and orchestration of actions against real systems. 
 - Experience designing or consuming MCP servers and working with Anthropic APIs, Azure AI Foundry, Azure AI Search, model gateways, or equivalent AI platforms. 
 - Experience building metadata-driven forms, low-code platforms, service catalogs, or rules-driven user interfaces. 
 - Experience with Azure DevOps work-item APIs and service hooks. 
 - Experience with Fastify, Prisma, PostgreSQL, Azure Service Bus, Azure Container Apps, Azure App Service, and Azure Key Vault. 
 - Experience with durable orchestration using Azure Durable Task Scheduler, Temporal, or an equivalent platform. 
 - Experience with Microsoft Graph, Okta APIs, Microsoft Fabric, Power BI REST APIs, or Cloudflare Zero Trust. 
 - Experience with Tailwind CSS and shadcn/ui. 

Success In The First 90 Days

- Become productive in the application architecture, codebase, delivery pipeline, and operational model. 
 - Deliver a semi-production application into production for use by its intended audiences, with defined acceptance criteria, appropriate controls, operational documentation, monitoring, and a support model. 
 - Implement or improve module-level RBAC, health endpoints, automated testing, and observability where applicable. 
 - Build effective working relationships with Cloud Operations, architecture, platform, security, and business stakeholders. 
 - Participate in technical planning, production-readiness reviews, and the applicable support model. 

Technology Environment

The current environment includes Next. js, React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, shadcn/ui, Microsoft Entra ID, Azure Container Apps, Azure App Service, Bicep, GitHub Actions with OIDC, Azure Key Vault, Application Insights, Azure Service Bus, Azure Database for PostgreSQL, Prisma, Fastify, Microsoft Fabric, Azure AI Foundry, Azure AI Search, Anthropic Claude enterprise APIs, Cloudflare Zero Trust, and Vitest. Candidates are not expected to have prior experience with every technology listed. 

Additional Details

- Visa Sponsorship: Employment eligibility to work with Quorum Software in India is required as the company will not pursue visa sponsorship for this position. 

Quorum Diversity Statement: At Quorum, we are committed to fostering, cultivating, and preserving a culture of belonging. We want to be the place where a diverse pool of talented people join us, stay with us and do their best work. With a diverse team of employees, we grow and learn better together. The collective sum of the individual differences, life experiences, knowledge, innovation, self-expression, and talent that our employees invest in their work represents not only part of our culture, but our reputation and our achievements. We are fully focused on equity and equality and believe deeply in diversity of race, gender, sexual orientation, age, religion, ethnicity, national origin, ability, neurodiversity and all the other characteristics that make us unique. 

Quorum Business Solutions and Quorum Software are Equal Opportunity Employers. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, ancestry, veteran status, disability, genetic information, or any other basis protected by law. 

Those applicants requiring reasonable accommodation to the application and/or interview process should notify a member of the Human Resources Department

Recruitment Scam Alert: Quorum Software does not charge fees, request payments, conduct interviews via messaging apps, or request the installation of software at any stage of the recruitment process. All legitimate recruitment activities are conducted exclusively through our official careers website (www. quorumsoftware. com/careers) and email addresses ending in @quorumsoftware. com. Any communication that does not originate from these official channels should be considered unauthorized and may be reported to [email protected]

data.title: DevOps Engineer
data.description:
An extraordinarily talented group of individuals work together every day to drive TNS' success, from both professional and personal perspectives. Come join the excellence!

Overview

The Software area is responsible for the development of computer programming systems and applications including the design, coding, testing and deployment of products and solutions to meet firm obligations. 

Responsibilities

Position Summary: 

The Senior AWS DevOps Engineer provides technical leadership in architecting and scaling cloud‐native automation, observability, and performance engineering frameworks across mission‐critical payment platforms. The role emphasizes deep AWS expertise spanning compute, networking, security, IaC, and CI/CD, to ensure highly available, secure, compliant, and high‐throughput web applications. This position drives cloud modernization initiatives, builds enterprise‐grade automation ecosystems, and mentors engineering teams in advanced DevOps and AWS best practices. 

Primary Duties And Responsibilities: 

- Design and develop AWS‐based deployment and test automation frameworks, leveraging services such as AWS CodePipeline, CodeBuild, Lambda, CloudFormation, and ECS/EKS. 
 - Lead the creation and optimization of load, regression, and performance test suites, integrating them into cloud‐native CI/CD systems. 
 - Guide and mentor teams in performance testing, automation, and best practices using modern AWS and DevOps tooling. 
 - Collaborate with development, operations, and support teams to troubleshoot and resolve complex issues, including Level‐3 customer escalations in cloud environments. 
 - Review and enhance test plans, automation scripts, and infrastructure definitions, ensuring quality, reliability, and security alignment. 
 - Design and manage containerized workloads leveraging Amazon ECS, EKS, Fargate, and ECR; implement blue/green and canary deployment strategies. 
 - Implement enterprise‐grade observability using CloudWatch, AWS X‐Ray, CloudTrail, OpenTelemetry, AWS Health Dashboard, and centralized logging architectures with Amazon OpenSearch and Kinesis Data Firehose. 
 - Manage secure, compliant environments leveraging AWS IAM, IAM Identity Center, KMS, Secrets Manager, Systems Manager, GuardDuty, Security Hub, WAF, Shield, and VPC security controls. 
 - Lead troubleshooting and root‐cause analysis of complex distributed applications, analyzing logs, traces, and metrics across VPCs, ALB/NLB, Route 53, and multi‐account AWS organizations. 
 - Optimize cloud costs and performance using AWS Compute Optimizer, Cost Explorer, Trusted Advisor, Auto Scaling groups, and serverless optimization patterns. 
 - Work effectively within Agile/Scrum teams, driving continuous improvement, reliability engineering, and DevOps culture adoption across Systems Test and SRE teams. 

Qualifications: 

- A bachelor degree in Engineering or equivalent
 - 10+ years of DevOps and Test Engineering experience, including 4+ years in technical leadership roles. 
 - Strong expertise with AWS services, cloud automation, and IaC (CloudFormation, Terraform, CDK). 
 - Solid understanding of relational databases such as MySQL, MariaDB, and MS SQL. 
 - Hands on experience with Gitlab, CI/CD implementation, AWS/other cloud services. 
 - Scrum, Agile, Kanban development models

Optional Desired Qualifications: 

- Demonstrated experience validating high‐throughput, resilient, cloud‐native web applications and APIs. 
 - Strong written and verbal communication skills suitable for cross‐functional technical leadership. 
 - Ability to rapidly learn new AWS services, DevOps tools, and best practices-and effectively coach others to adopt them. 

Education And Certifications: 

- Computer science degree or equivalent work experience within a professional software environment. 
 - Payment industry experience highly desired

data.title: Program Manager - GeoAnalytics
data.description:
About Us

WRI India, an independent knowledge organisation registered as India Resources Trust, provides objective information and practical proposals to foster environmentally sound and socially equitable development. Through research, analysis, and recommendations, WRI India puts ideas into action to build transformative solutions to protect the earth, promote livelihoods, and enhance human well-being. Know more: wri-india. org

Job Highlight

WRI India is seeking a Manager - GeoAnalytics to strengthen the GeoAnalytics team's capabilities in geospatial analytics, software engineering and digital product development. This role will have a dual focus: leading the development and operationalization of Climate Lens, WRI India's integrated climate intelligence and decision-support platform, while managing and contributing to the development of geospatial software applications and analytical solutions across WRI India's programmes. 

The position will combine product management, technical leadership, software development and project coordination. The successful candidate will work closely with research and programme teams to translate complex environmental, climate and urban challenges into robust, scalable and user-oriented digital solutions. 

The role will be responsible for ensuring that analytical methodologies and research outputs are translated into reusable digital products, supported by sound software architecture, reliable data infrastructure and effective user experiences. The candidate will also contribute to building shared technical capabilities, reusable software components and engineering standards within the GeoAnalytics team. 

What You Will Do

The role will be structured around two complementary areas of responsibility. 

- Climate Lens - Digital Product Development and Management (50%)

Lead the end-to-end development, implementation and continuous improvement of Climate Lens, ensuring that it evolves into a scalable and operational climate intelligence platform supporting evidence-based planning, adaptation and investment decisions. 

Product Strategy and Management

- Lead the product development roadmap for Climate Lens, translating the platform vision, strategic objectives and programme requirements into defined product features, development priorities and implementation plans. 
 - Work closely with GeoAnalytics, Cities and other programme teams to identify user needs, define product requirements and translate climate research methodologies into digital workflows. 
 - Define product specifications, functional requirements, user journeys, workflows, wireframes and feature-level development plans. 
 - Coordinate product development activities across research, design, data science and software engineering teams, ensuring alignment between analytical requirements and technical implementation. 
 - Manage product priorities, timelines, resources, dependencies and delivery milestones. 

Technical Development and Integration

- Lead the development and operationalization of Climate Lens 
 - Oversee the development of shared platform capabilities, including climate data integration, climate hazard and vulnerability assessment, risk prioritization, adaptation planning, scenario modelling and decision-support functionalities. 
 - Drive the digital productization of WRI India's Climate Hazard Vulnerability Assessment (CHVA) methodology into standardized, configurable and reusable analytical workflows. 
 - Coordinate the integration of the Urban NbS FinLink finance-search functionality into Climate Lens, ensuring that users can access project assessment and climate finance discovery capabilities across the three geographic applications. 
 - Work with software developers and technical partners to define system architecture, APIs, databases, data pipelines and integration requirements. 
 - Ensure that the platform is modular, interoperable, scalable and designed for future expansion across cities, states and thematic applications. 

Product Quality, Validation and Adoption

- Establish product development processes, including prototyping, technical validation, user acceptance testing (UAT), release management and continuous improvement. 
 - Coordinate pilot testing and stakeholder consultations with government agencies, urban local bodies and other intended users. 
 - Define product performance indicators and monitor platform adoption, user engagement, analytical utilization and institutional uptake. 
 - Translate user feedback and implementation experience into product enhancements and development priorities. 
 - Develop product documentation, user guides, technical specifications and onboarding materials. 
 - Support institutional partnerships, technical presentations and resource mobilization related to Climate Lens. 
 - GeoAnalytics and Software Development (50%)

Lead and contribute to the development of geospatial software applications, data-driven solutions and reusable technology components across WRI India's programmes and projects. 

Application Development

- Design, develop and maintain full-stack web applications, geospatial platforms, dashboards and digital tools to address programme and research requirements. 
 - Develop backend services, APIs and frontend applications using appropriate modern software development frameworks and technologies. 
 - Develop and maintain geospatial data services and workflows using technologies such as PostGIS, GeoServer, GDAL, GeoPandas and Google Earth Engine. 
 - Build reusable software components, libraries and modules that can be applied across multiple WRI India products and projects. 
 - Contribute to the development of open-source, interoperable and publicly accessible digital products, including platforms aligned with Digital Public Infrastructure (DPI) principles. 
 - Integrate geospatial analytics, data visualization and AI/ML capabilities into digital applications where relevant. 

Engineering Standards

- Establish and promote good software engineering practices, including coding standards, version control, documentation, code reviews and testing. 
 - Support the implementation of pipelines, deployment processes, cloud infrastructure and application monitoring. 
 - Evaluate emerging geospatial technologies, open-source frameworks and AI-enabled development approaches for their potential application within WRI India. 
 - Mentor and provide technical guidance to developers, research associates and other members of the GeoAnalytics team. 
 - Maintain technical documentation, reusable code repositories and institutional knowledge resources. 

Project Coordination and Collaboration

- Coordinate with programme teams to understand project requirements, define technical scope and ensure timely delivery of analytical and software development outputs. 
 - Manage technical work plans, development milestones, resource requirements and project dependencies. 
 - Provide technical guidance to project teams and support the integration of geospatial and software solutions into programme activities. 
 - Contribute to research publications, technical reports, proposals, presentations and other institutional knowledge products. 

What You Will Need

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Geoinformatics, Geography, Geospatial Science, Remote Sensing or a related technical discipline. 
 - 6-8 years of relevant professional experience in software development, geospatial technology, digital product development or a related field. 

Potential Salary and Benefits: INR 18, 00, 000 to 24, 00, 000 Annum

"Salary shall be commensurate with experience, skills, and internal parity. WRI India offers a generous and comprehensive benefits package. "

Location: New Delhi

Duration: 1 Year (Extendable based on performance and project requirements)

Start date: As soon as possible

List Of Documents To Be Attached

- Cover Letter
 - Resume

Only shortlisted applicants will be contacted for interview purpose. 

How To Apply

Qualified applicants should apply online at wri-india. org career section. All applications must be submitted online through this career portal in order to be formally considered. Only select applicants will be contacted for interview. There will be a writing test conducted with final candidates. Please do not contact program staff directly for this position. 

Kindly note that WRI India's recruitment process does not involve any payment at any stage. Applicants will never be asked to share bank account or financial information as part of the application. All official communication and offer letters are issued only through authorised WRI India email IDs. 

Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion (DEI) @WRI India

WRI India values and promotes diversity, equity and inclusion across all areas of our work and workforce. Integrating these values into our actions fosters a progressive and collaborative culture and can also enhance our impact. It is our responsibility to create a welcoming working environment for people of diverse cultures, backgrounds and experience to learn together. We are responsible for fostering a safe and inclusive workplace where questions, concerns and information about diversity, equity and inclusion are part of our ongoing dialogue and development. 

Learn more about WRI India's commitment to Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion (DEI). Click Here

People-centric To The Core

We keep our people at the center of everything we do - from a welcoming work environment to benefits and a culture that encourages staff to stay healthy, happy, engaged, and growing. 

Some Of The Non-monetary Benefits That Our Staff Get

Health benefits: We cover health insurance for you and your loved ones for up to INR 8 lakhs

Term Insurance: Our term insurance policy covers life coverage of 50 lakhs per staff member

Employee Assistance program: Promoting mental well-being and supporting staff in achieving a satisfying work-life balance

Health & Nutrition: Personalized diet recommendation from a certified dietitian based on the physical health condition and lifestyle

Flexible work schedule: Alternative work arrangements for all who are eligible by nature of their job

Learning culture: Workshops and trainings to empower staff, encourage new learning opportunities

Rest and Recharge weeks: We encourage staff to take time off to rest, rejuvenate, upskill, and pursue their interests. 

Our leave policy: Avail personal time off at 36 per year, along with public holidays, maternity, paternity, and adoption leaves. 

Equal employment @WRI India

We believe in equal employment, it is our policy to recruit and provide opportunities for advancement in all job classifications without regard to caste, religion, sex, age, marital status, sexual orientation, parental status, or disability.

data.title: Principal Software Engineer
data.description:
Overview

Azure AI Infrastructure team is looking for passionate engineers to build the largest deep-learning infrastructure service at Microsoft. In this role you will be tasked with building new components to bring the latest innovations in AI Infrastructure onto the Azure ML platform. You will partner with top engineering talent within Azure AI Infrastructure and across Azure to work on cluster orchestration, job scheduling, storage, networking, containerization and operating system integration. Your work will enable various AI languages and run-times on Azure AI Infrastructure to bring distributed deep learning training and inferencing to life. In addition, you will build infrastructure components required to build, deploy, monitor and service highly available and scalable Microsoft Service Fabric and Kubernetes clusters under your care. You will lead development and customer support from the frontline and establish architecture, service excellence guidelines and a high-quality bar. 

Candidates have a track record for delivering engineering and service excellence on a mid-to-large scale service. 

Who are We?

We are engineers on Azure AI Infrastructure. We believe that building a planet-scale AI Supercomputer from the ground-up which addresses the fundamental pain-points of data scientists and AI practitioners and takes AI to the unprecedented scale is an opportunity of a lifetime. If you share the same dream as us, come join us!

What Is Azure AI Infrastructure?

High scale AI workloads are always testing the limits of the infrastructure stack. Large-scale model training and inference with huge data volumes of training data on hundreds-thousands of GPUs make it a true engineering challenge. Azure AI Infrastructure is a globally distributed, multi-tenant service that provides robust, cost-effective AI infrastructure (compute, networking and storage) for AI training and inferencing. By abstracting workloads from underlying infrastructure, Azure AI Infrastructure creates a shared pool of resources that can be dynamically provisioned for full utilization of expensive GPU compute, and enabling data scientists to productively build, scale, experiment, and iterate their models on top of a robust, performant, scalable and cost-effective distributed infrastructure built for AI. In Azure AI Infrastructure, we are constantly seeking to apply the ideas from AI, ML, distributed systems, distributed databases, machine learning, information retrieval, networking, and security. 

Responsibilities

- Work on the architecture, design, and development of the AI Infrastructure services that support large scale AI training and inferencing 
 - Develop, test, and maintain backend services written in C#, Go, Rust, C++, hosted on Kubernetes 
 - Enhance systems and applications to ensure robustness, efficiency, maintainability, low latency, tight cloud security 
 - Provide operational support and DRI responsibilities for the product 
 - Develop and foster a deep understanding of the machine learning systems and concepts and their usage by our customers 
 - Collaborate closely with engineers, data scientists within the team, internal Microsoft Research teams and external enterprises to build better solutions together 
 - Provide vision, expertise, and technical leadership to other team members 
 - Help to grow talent in these areas

Qualifications

Required Qualifications

A master's or bachelor's degree in computer science or a related field

10+ years of experience with coding in one of C#, C or C++, Rust, go

Experience working with the Linux operation system, Kubernetes Networking, SDN, and Kubernetes cluster orchestration

Experience with improving service operations or engineering fundamentals

Collaboration skills

Experience building and shipping production software or services

Preferred Qualifications

Master's Degree or Ph. D. in Computer Science or related technical field AND 8+ years technical engineering experience with coding in languages including, but not limited to, C, C++, C#, Java, JavaScript, or Python. 

Experience in development in the Kubernetes ecosystem

Experience working on cloud infrastructure including compute, networking, storage, and identity services

Experience in working on Kubernetes Networking and Software Defined Networking systems

Experience in building large scale cloud services, distributed systems, or operating systems

This position will be open for a minimum of 5 days, with applications accepted on an ongoing basis until the position is filled. 

Microsoft is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, citizenship, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, immigration status, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran or military status, race, ethnicity, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable local laws, regulations and ordinances. This role ensures that reliability, availability, scalability, observability, resiliency, and operational excellence are embedded across the software delivery lifecycle and production ecosystem. 

The SRE Architect will work closely with product, engineering, operations, cloud, infrastructure, and leadership teams to establish reliability standards, modernize operational practices, drive automation, and enable measurable service health improvements across the organization.

data.title: Senior CQV Engineer
data.description:
At Jacobs, we're challenging today to reinvent tomorrow by solving the world's most critical problems for thriving cities, resilient environments, mission-critical outcomes, operational advancement, scientific discovery and cutting-edge manufacturing, turning abstract ideas into realities that transform the world for good. 

Your impact

The Sr. CQV Engineer will be responsible for leading the efforts for commissioning, qualification, and validation of equipment/ systems, and processes in the production of Drug substances/ Drug Product/ Sterile Facilities/ API/ OSDs, as well as the Utility system, HVAC system and Area. 

The role will require the leadership of an experienced, energetic, and committed Senior CQV person with broad experience in C&Q, particularly biopharmaceuticals. 

The person should have experience of leading a team of CQV engineers for a project and managing the C&Q documentation and execution lifecycle from SLIA generation through to OQ completion. The lead will work closely with cross-functional teams, including engineering, quality assurance, and manufacturing, to support the successful delivery of projects. 

Key Responsibilities

- Lead and coordinate CQV projects, ensuring timely execution and compliance with industry regulations. 
 - To prepare C&Q plans in line with the strategic goals of the client and manage timely and compliant delivery of the plan. 
 - Ensure all commissioning and qualification procedures are implemented and adhered to at office and at site level. 
 - Track progress of C&Q activities as required and provide regular project updates and status reports to stakeholders. 
 - Ensure effective resource planning, including coordinating materials, spares and consumables for commissioning and qualification activities. 
 - Identify and mitigate project risks while ensuring project deliverables meet required quality and compliance standards. 
 - Provide leadership in team meetings and facilitate problem-solving discussions to ensure project milestones are met. 
 - Act as the primary point of contact between clients, internal teams, and external vendors to drive project success. 
 - Management of Contractors and Vendors, document control, punch list management. 
 - Participate in design, constructability, and commissioning reviews to ensure technical aspects are covered in the Commissioning Plan and schedule. 
 - Well versed with risk-based approaches to C&Q (e. g. , ASTM E2500, ISPE)
 - Conduct risk assessments and gap analysis for process equipments/ systems, facilities and utilities, to identify critical process parameters and control strategies. 
 - Developing system boundaries for the system at an early stage of C&Q. 
 - Complete the development, review and execution of validation plans, URSs/DQ/TMs/FATs/SATs/IQ/OQ protocols/reports. 
 - Experienced in commissioning and qualifying CIP & SIP systems. 
 - Participate in design document reviews and ensure that quality aspects are included in design. 
 - Review vendor documents (CTOPs/ VTOPs) to support commissioning and qualification requirements. 
 - Ensures C&Q non-conformances or deviations are minimized during execution of CQV activities. For issues that do arise ensure they are closed out in a timely manner. 
 - Track and confirm closure of actions items identified through FAT, HAZOP, Design Qualification and other reviews. 
 - Perform shakedown during commissioning and qualification of systems on site. 
 - Field Walkdowns of systems as part of transfer of ownership of the system from Construction. 
 - System Startup activities

Working Conditions

- The position requires travel and/ or deputation to other sites or manufacturing facilities. 
 - Ability to work in a cleanroom environment and adhere to gowning requirements. 
 - Flexibility to work outside of regular business hours as needed to support project timelines

Here's what you'll need

- Bachelor's degree in engineering, Life Sciences, or a related field. Advanced degree preferred. B. Pharm. , M. Pharm. , B. Tech or BE or MSc. 
 - 10-15 year's experience in CQV within the pharmaceutical or biotechnology industry, specifically in drug substance manufacturing. 
 - Candidates must have proven experience of carrying out commissioning and qualification activities on multiple projects. 
 - Have functioned as CQV Lead level for at least one Project. 

Technical Skills

- Experience with paperless validation software such as KNEAT and/ or Valgenesis. 
 - In-depth knowledge of cGMP, FDA, EMA, and other relevant regulatory requirements. 
 - Strong project management skills with the ability to handle multiple priorities across national and international locations. 
 - Experience with process validation and computer system validation. 
 - Experience on DCS/ PCS system such as Delta-V, 800xA, etc. 
 - Familiarity with Construction management software such as EIDA, PIMS, Aconex, is an advantage. 
 - Familiarity with paperless validation software such as KNEAT and Valgenesis is an advantage. 

Soft Skills

- Strong problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and a results-oriented mindset. 
 - Strong project management and organizational skills. 
 - Effective communication and interpersonal skills. 
 - Ability to work independently and as part of a team. 

At Jacobs we value people. Having the right balance of belonging, career and lifestyle enables us to consistently deliver and exceed clients' expectations. 

Working alongside industry leaders, you will have the opportunity to develop your career working on key projects in an environment which encourages collaboration, knowledge sharing and innovation. To support your professional growth, Jacobs flexible working arrangements, extended leave options and a host of social, health and wellbeing events and initiatives will underpin our commitment to you. 

At Jacobs it's all about what you do, not where you are, which counts!

We value collaboration and believe that in-person interactions are crucial for both our culture and client delivery. We empower employees with our hybrid working policy, allowing them to split their work week between Jacobs offices/projects and remote locations enabling them to deliver their best work. 

Your application experience is important to us, and we're keen to adapt to make every interaction even better. If you require further support or reasonable adjustments with regards to the recruitment process (for example, you require the application form in a different format), please contact the team via Careers Support. 

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, or disability.

At WSP, our Design Managers are adaptable professionals who thrive in a variety of situations. Leadership & Management

Personal Attributes

Qualifications & Experience

About The Role

We are looking for an experienced Senior Linux Systems Automation Engineer to join the Cloud Infrastructure team. The role focuses on Linux OS migrations from CentOS to Rocky Linux, infrastructure automation using Ansible, and production Linux system support. 

The candidate will also support the ELK stack and contribute to its migration to Datadog. Experience working with distributed teams and providing operational support during US morning hours is required.

 - Proven experience executing Linux OS migrations or large-scale upgrades. 
 - Strong troubleshooting skills across operating systems, networking, and processes. 
 - Ability to work independently and collaborate with distributed teams across time zones. 
 - Willingness to provide regular support overlap with US morning hours. 

Recruiter Note: Prioritize candidates with strong hands-on experience in Ansible, Red Hat Linux administration, and CentOS-to-Rocky Linux migrations. Azure Cloud Architecture is also listed as a mandatory skill. 

I can also prepare quick HR screening questions with expected answers to help you shortlist candidates for this role.

data.title: Python Data Engineer
data.description:
Job Title: Senior Python Engineer - Technical Lead

Department: IT Factory

About Business line/Function: The IT factories team is responsible for building and maintaining applications that support information system steering. A new application is being developed for user entitlement controls, execution and management. 

Position Purpose

You will be the senior engineer and the technical anchor of the team with global ownership of the application. You will take an application that has been prototyped and tested against synthetic data, harden it for production use on real entitlement data, and take it through integration, user acceptance testing and release. You will then lead the build of the control's execution engine and the subsequent modules. 

This is a hands-on engineering role, not a management one. You will also be the person who sets the standards the rest of the team works to - code review, test coverage, deployment discipline and documentation - and who onboards the engineers who join after you. 

Because the platform handles identity and entitlement data for the bank's corporate and institutional business, evidence and auditability are not optional extras. Every control outcome must be reproducible and every change traceable. You should be comfortable working to that standard. 

Responsibilities

Direct Responsibilities

- To build a web application with three distinct user populations and a sequential approval workflow, integrated with enterprise single sign-on. You will harden the existing prototype, integrate it with live data, take it through UAT and release it to production. 
 - Build a controls execution engine, that executes control rules against the curated data model on schedule, records the outcome of every run, raises findings, routes them through a review workflow and generates the committee reporting packs. 
 - Build workflow and approval services, deterministic state machines implementing multi-stage approval with segregation of duties, record locking and immutable audit trails. 
 - Asynchronous processing - background job execution for long-running tasks such as report generation and campaign creation. 
 - Continuous integration with automated linting, type checking and test execution, artefact publication and deployment to Linux servers. 

Specific Qualifications

Technical Skills: 

- Strong command of modern Python (3. 11+), including type hints and static type checking. Demonstrable experience building and operating production services, not scripts. 
 - Web service frameworks. Production experience with FastAPI, or equivalent depth in Django or Flask with a clear ability to transfer. Familiarity with data validation libraries and automatically generated API specifications. 
 - SQL and relational data modelling, at depth. Strong in SQL - complex joins, window functions, query plans and performance tuning. Design normalised schemas, reason about keys and cardinality, and write set-based logic rather than looping in application code. PostgreSQL experience preferred. 
 - Data pipelines and ETL. Practical experience building ingestion and transformation pipelines: reading from source systems, landing data, transforming it into a curated model, and implementing reconciliation and data-quality checks. You will not own the pipelines day to day, but you must be able to work on them competently and provide cover. 
 - Workflow and state management. Experience implementing approval workflows, state machines or case management, including validation rules and audit logging. 
 - Automated testing as a matter of routine - unit and integration - with meaningful coverage of business logic. Experience with pytest. 
 - Linux and deployment. Comfortable operating on Linux servers: service management, log management, troubleshooting a live application. Experience with CI/CD pipelines and artefact repositories. 
 - Version control and code review. Disciplined use of Git, branch protection and pull request review. Experience reviewing other engineers' work constructively. 
 - Communication in a distributed team. You will work daily with a stakeholder in London and periodically with infrastructure, identity and data-protection teams. Clear written English and the confidence to raise a problem early are essential. 

Nice To Have

- Identity and access management domain knowledge - entitlements, roles, segregation of duties, access recertification, or experience with an IAM platform such as SailPoint. 
 - Workflow orchestration - Apache Airflow, or an enterprise scheduler such as Control-M or Autosys. 
 - Front-end capability - server-rendered templating with Jinja2 and HTMX, or a component framework such as Angular. 
 - Asynchronous task frameworks - Celery with Redis or an equivalent broker. 
 - Regulated-environment experience - delivery within a bank or other regulated institution, including change management, security assessment and penetration testing cycles. 
 - Reporting and analytics - designing data models consumed by Power BI or a comparable tool

Behavioral Skills

- 
 - Self-motivated and passionate about delivering exceptional results, with a strong desire to take ownership of complex technical problems and drive them to resolution. 
 - Platform Thinking & Ownership: Ability to think holistically about the platform, considering the interactions and dependencies between different components and systems. 
Education Level: Bachelor of Engineering or equivalent. 

Location: Mumbai

About BNP Paribas Group

BNP Paribas is the European Union's leading bank and key player in international banking. It operates in 65 countries and has nearly 185, 000 employees, including more than 145, 000 in Europe. The Group has key positions in its three main fields of activity: Commercial, Personal Banking & Services for the Group's commercial & personal banking and several specialized businesses including BNP Paribas Personal Finance and Arval; Investment & Protection Services for savings, investment, and protection solutions; and Corporate & Institutional Banking, focused on corporate and institutional clients. Based on its strong diversified and integrated model, the Group helps all its clients (individuals, community associations, entrepreneurs, SMEs, corporates and institutional clients) to realize their projects through solutions spanning financing, investment, savings and protection insurance. In Europe, BNP Paribas has four domestic markets: Belgium, France, Italy, and Luxembourg. The Group is rolling out its integrated commercial & personal banking model across several Mediterranean countries, Turkey, and Eastern Europe. As a key player in international banking, the Group has leading platforms and business lines in Europe, a strong presence in the Americas as well as a solid and fast-growing business in Asia-Pacific. BNP Paribas has implemented a Corporate Social Responsibility approach in all its activities, enabling it to contribute to the construction of a sustainable future, while ensuring the Group's performance and stability. 

About BNP Paribas India Solutions

Established in 2005, BNP Paribas India Solutions is a wholly owned subsidiary of BNP Paribas SA, European Union's leading bank with an international reach. With delivery centers located in Bengaluru, Chennai and Mumbai, we are a 24x7 global delivery center. India Solutions services three business lines: Corporate and Institutional Banking, Investment Solutions and Retail Banking for BNP Paribas across the Group. Driving innovation and growth, we are harnessing the potential of over 10000 employees, to provide support and develop best-in-class solutions. 

Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion

At BNP Paribas, we passionately embrace diversity and are committed to fostering an inclusive workplace where all employees are valued, respected and can bring their authentic selves to work. We prohibit Discrimination and Harassment of any kind and our policies promote equal employment opportunity for all employees and applicants, irrespective of, but not limited to their gender, gender identity, sex, sexual orientation, ethnicity, race, colour, national origin, age, religion, social status, mental or physical disabilities, veteran status etc. As a global Bank, we truly believe that inclusion and diversity of our teams is key to our success in serving our clients and the communities we operate in. As a global Bank, we truly believe that inclusion and diversity of our teams is key to our success in serving our clients and the communities we operate in.

data.title: Software Development Engineer III (Mobile)
data.description:
ABOUT QUINCE

Quince is a destination for builders, creators, innovators, and operators who want to come together and challenge the status quo. Our mission is simple: make really high quality essentials for really low prices, fairly and sustainably. We deliver on that mission through a unique manufacturer-to-consumer (M2C) model eliminating the layers of traditional retail that add cost and result in consumers paying more than they need to. We find, build relationships with, and work directly with the manufacturing partners behind some of the world's finest products. From there, our teams design smart, efficient operational processes and build and deploy proprietary technology, AI, and analytics to help us scale fast. 

What began with a small assortment of elevated basics has quickly grown into a cross-category brand spanning apparel, accessories, home goods, and more. Today, tens of millions of people across a growing number of countries come - and return - to Quince because they trust us to deliver. 

OUR CULTURE

Quince is a culture built for builders by builders. Our way of working starts with a blank sheet of paper. We question conventional thinking, use technology and data to uncover new opportunities, and move quickly to turn ideas into reality. We aren't interested in replicating how others do retail. We're building a better way - at a speed and scale unlike anything that's been done before. 

- We dream big and chase the hard problems others shy away from. Rejecting long-held assumptions is part of our company's DNA. Where conventional wisdom says you have to choose - soft or durable, speed or rigor, quality or price - we ask why that trade-off has to exist in the first place. 
 - Our pace is fast and the bar is high because our customers expect a lot from us and we refuse to let them down. We believe the best results come from challenging ourselves, learning from one another, and building on each other's strengths. 
 - Here, responsibility is not determined by role, tenure, or seniority. Every team member - no matter their level - has the opportunity to drive our business and shape our trajectory. 

If you're someone who likes to imagine new possibilities and build better systems rather than plug-in to outdated ones, Quince is the place for you. 

THE ROLE

Software Development Engineer III - Mobile

We're looking for a Software Development Engineer III - Mobile to join our growing engineering team and help build high-performance mobile experiences for Quince customers. In this role, you will design, develop, and optimize React Native applications that deliver fast, reliable, and seamless experiences at scale. 

You will take ownership of complex mobile engineering problems, with a strong focus on performance, scalability, and user experience. You'll work closely with Product, Design, and Backend teams to build scalable solutions while contributing to the evolution of Quince's mobile architecture and engineering practices. 

This role is ideal for an engineer who is deeply passionate about mobile performance, enjoys solving complex React Native challenges, and is willing to go beyond standard implementations to deliver an exceptional customer experience. 

Responsibilities

Mobile Application Development

- Design, develop, and maintain high-performance mobile applications using React Native. 
 - Build scalable, reusable, and maintainable components following modern mobile engineering best practices. 
 - Take ownership of complex technical problems across the React Native application stack. 
 - Evaluate and adopt appropriate libraries, frameworks, and architectural patterns as the mobile platform evolves. 
 - Contribute to internal libraries and platform capabilities where existing solutions do not adequately address engineering requirements. 

Performance & Optimization

- Drive mobile performance improvements across rendering, startup time, memory usage, responsiveness, and application stability. 
 - Identify and eliminate unnecessary re-renders and inefficient render cycles. 
 - Optimize large lists and complex UI interactions to deliver smooth experiences across a wide range of devices. 
 - Analyze application performance and proactively identify bottlenecks before they impact customers. 
 - Establish and promote performance engineering best practices across the mobile team. 

React Native & Native Platform Engineering

- Work deeply with React Native internals and modern React Native architecture. 
 - Build and optimize solutions using technologies such as FlashList, React Native Reanimated, React Native Gesture Handler, and Expo. 
 - Investigate complex framework and platform-level issues across iOS and Android. 
 - Work with TurboModules and native platform capabilities when React Native abstractions are insufficient. 
 - Write and debug native iOS and Android code when required to solve performance or platform-specific problems. 

Quality & Reliability

- Develop and maintain comprehensive test cases to ensure application quality and reliability. 
 - Debug complex production and development issues across the mobile stack. 
 - Establish practices that improve application stability, performance, and release quality. 
 - Participate in code reviews and provide thoughtful feedback on architecture, implementation, performance, and maintainability. 

Cross-Functional Collaboration

- Partner with Product, Design, Backend, and other engineering teams to define and implement scalable mobile solutions. 
 - Translate product and customer requirements into robust technical designs and implementation plans. 
 - Collaborate across teams to identify technical dependencies, trade-offs, and opportunities for improving the overall customer experience. 
 - Communicate technical decisions and complex mobile engineering concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. 

Technical Leadership & Mentorship

- Mentor junior and mid-level engineers and help raise the technical bar across the mobile team. 
 - Promote clean coding practices, performance optimization, testing, and engineering excellence. 
 - Contribute to technical discussions, architecture decisions, and long-term mobile engineering strategy. 
 - Stay current with developments in React Native, mobile platforms, and modern application performance techniques. 

Qualifications

Required: 

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field. 
 - 5-8 years of professional experience in software, frontend, or mobile engineering. 
 - 2+ years of hands-on experience building production applications with React Native. 
 - Strong proficiency in JavaScript and TypeScript with a deep understanding of React Native fundamentals. 
 - Strong understanding of mobile application architecture, rendering, state management, and performance optimization. 
 - Hands-on experience optimizing React Native applications, including render cycles, unnecessary re-renders, memory usage, and application responsiveness. 
 - Experience troubleshooting complex React Native issues and identifying root causes across the JavaScript and native layers. 
 - Experience with modern React Native libraries such as FlashList, React Native Reanimated, React Native Gesture Handler, and Expo. 
 - Proficiency with debugging and profiling tools such as Flipper, React DevTools, and Chrome DevTools. 
 - Familiarity with iOS and Android platform fundamentals and the ability to investigate platform-specific issues. 
 - Experience with TurboModules and writing native iOS/Android code when required. 
 - Strong problem-solving skills and a strong bias toward performance, quality, and customer experience. 
 - Strong communication and collaboration skills with the ability to work effectively across functions. 

Preferred: 

- Experience building and scaling consumer-facing mobile applications with a large customer base. 
 - Deep understanding of React Native performance profiling and optimization. 
 - Experience working with the New React Native Architecture, including JSI, Fabric, and TurboModules. 
 - Experience developing native modules or integrating third-party native SDKs across iOS and Android. 
 - Experience with mobile CI/CD, automated releases, and tools such as Expo Application Services (EAS). 
 - Experience with mobile observability, crash reporting, performance monitoring, and analytics. 
 - Experience in e-commerce, retail, or other high-scale consumer applications. 
 - Experience mentoring engineers and driving mobile engineering standards across a team. 

WHY QUINCE?

Joining Quince means being part of a mission-driven team reshaping retail. You will work alongside talented colleagues, tackle meaningful challenges, and contribute to building a more sustainable, accessible future for customers and partners alike. 

EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & HIRING INTEGRITY

Quince provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applications for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran or military status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws. 

Quince is committed to providing reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation to complete your application or to perform the essential functions of a role at Quince, please let us know by completing this accommodation form. We review all requests individually and will work with you to determine appropriate accommodations on a case-by-case basis. 

Employment is contingent upon successful completion of a background check. Quince will conduct background checks in compliance with applicable federal, state, and local laws. 

Security Advisory: Beware of Frauds

At Quince, we're dedicated to recruiting top talent who share our drive for innovation. To safeguard candidates, Quince emphasizes legitimate recruitment practices. Initial communication is primarily via official Quince email addresses and LinkedIn; beware of deviations. Personal data and sensitive information will not be solicited during the application phase. Interviews are conducted via phone, in person, or through the approved platforms Google Meets or Zoom-never via messaging apps or other calling services. Offers are merit-based, communicated verbally, and followed up in writing. If personal information is requested to initiate the hiring process, rest assured it will be through secure and protected means.

data.title: Software Development Manager, PV Sports and Linear Tech / Live Events Publishing
data.description:
Description

Want to change the way people watch Live Sports? Passionate about building, owning and operating massively scalable systems? Prime Video is re-inventing the live sports experience by merging high-quality live streaming, immersive interactive features, and exclusive access to some of the world's most loved sports properties - including the NFL, NBA, English Premier League and UEFA Champions League soccer, Roland-Garros (French Open), the US Open and more. We move at the speed of live events, shipping fast, iterating constantly, and building across a rapidly expanding set of technologies. And we're doing it at a scale only Amazon is capable of. The Prime Video Sports team is a single-threaded owner for Sports experiences, uniquely positioned to execute our vision across the entire Prime Video stack to deliver the most compelling experiences to our customers. 

We are a team of builders - from new graduates to seasoned architects - who value ownership, open debate, and learning through experimentation. We make decisions together, move fast, and hold each other to a high bar. If you're a leader who thrives in that kind of environment, read on. 

Who Are We

The Live Events Publishing team is part of Prime Video Sports & Linear org, responsible for the end-to-end systems that bring live sports content to customers. We are the owner, steward, and authority responsible for the sports catalog that powers the live sports experience for Prime Video customers worldwide. We build the automation, tooling, and AI-powered capabilities that enable operators and systems to publish content quickly and accurately for events like NBA, Fox Sports, and other major live programming. Our Bangalore team is a growing engineering hub, and this role is central to scaling our impact. 

About the role: As a Software Development Manager on the LEP team, you will lead a team of engineers building and operating the suite of services that fulfill our vision: the world's richest, most reliable, and lowest-latency catalog - enabling sports fans worldwide to discover, purchase, and consume sports content in any format, on any device. You will set the technical direction, hire and grow engineers, and drive the bar for all phases of the software development lifecycle. 

What We're Looking For

We are looking for a highly talented Software Development Manager to help build fast, scalable, robust systems to crystallize and execute this vision. The successful candidate is expected to be a hands-on technical manager who sets a high bar for all phases of the software development lifecycle, while hiring, coaching, developing, and growing a team of engineers. We seek someone with an insatiable curiosity and appetite for learning, who can build and nurture an AI-native engineering team capable of leveraging emerging AI technologies in our solutions. We value a proactive mindset and a genuine passion for making complex systems simple. Your ability to build a culture of innovation and adaptability will be key as we integrate AI throughout our engineering practices. 

Key job responsibilities

Lead and grow a team of software engineers, owning their project assignments, performance coaching, and career development while building a strong hiring pipeline

Define and communicate your team's roadmap and technical strategy to management, principal stakeholders, and partner teams, aligning priorities with customer needs

Facilitate systems design, architecture, and scaling discussions, making sound trade-offs across reliability, latency, and maintainability for the live sports catalog

Partner with product management and peer engineering managers to scope work, estimate effort, and deliver high-quality software that improves the live sports viewing experience worldwide

Champion operational excellence by establishing metrics, monitoring practices, and automation that keep your team's services healthy and your customers well-served

A day in the life

You start by syncing with product and partner engineering leads to scope upcoming work or unblock in-flight deliveries. Mid-morning you might review a design document with your engineers, pressure-testing assumptions around latency and scale for a new publishing workflow. After lunch you check operational dashboards, then shift to a one-on-one where you coach a team member through a promotion plan. Later you contribute to your team's technical strategy, weighing customer impact against engineering cost before wrapping up with a status update to stakeholders. 

About The Team

The Prime Video Sports Publishing (LEP) team is the owner, steward, and authority responsible for the sports catalog that powers the live sports experience for Prime Video customers worldwide. The team builds and operates the suite of services behind our vision to be the world's richest, most reliable, and lowest-latency catalog - enabling sports fans to discover, purchase, and consume sports content on any device. 

We are a team that values inclusiveness, respect, and mentorship. Our technology choices and designs are driven by engineers, not handed down from above. We have a strong voice in shaping the product, pitching ideas up the chain rather than the other way around. 

Basic Qualifications

- 8+ years of engineering experience
 - 3+ years of engineering team management experience
 - 8+ years of leading the definition and development of multi tier web services experience
 - Knowledge of engineering practices and patterns for the full software/hardware/networks development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, certification, and livesite operations
 - Experience partnering with product or program management teams
 - Experience designing or architecting (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems
 - 3+ years of designing or architecting (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience in communicating with users, other technical teams, and senior leadership to collect requirements, describe software product features, technical designs, and product strategy

data.title: Principal SOC Modeling Engineer
data.description:
The Software (CE-SW) group is responsible for developing and improving the software ecosystem around Arm's next generation architectures and systems. This means working with processors and other hardware technology not yet available to the public. You will join a team of Software Engineers who share a passion for leaving their mark on the future of computing. 

We are looking for software engineers to join the Arm Fast Models team responsible for building high-performance software models of Arm-based systems. These models enable early software development, architecture exploration, and system validation before silicon is available. Members of the modelling team transform hardware designs and specifications into high-performance software representations of hardware systems and components. 

In this role, you will develop functional models of CPUs, system IP, and complete Arm's reference platforms using C++ and SystemC, working closely with hardware and software teams across Arm. 

If you are similarly passionate about innovative technologies, then we would love to hear from you!

Key Responsibilities Include

- Develop, test, and maintain high-performance functional models of Arm system-level IP using C++ and SystemC. 
 - Build virtual platforms representing complete Arm's reference platforms to enable early firmware, OS, and application development before silicon availability. 
 - Collaborate with hardware architects and RTL designers to understand IP specifications and ensure accurate behavioral modelling. 
 - Work with open-source and software engineering teams to enable software bring-up on virtual platforms and diagnose system-level issues. 
 - Integrate multiple IP models to create scalable system-level simulations. 
 - Participate in planning and execution of development roadmaps, working with project managers and global engineering teams. 

Required Skills and Experience

- Minimum 15-20 years of proven experience. 
 - Strong C/C++ programming skills with experience in developing large-scale software systems. 
 - Experience in SoC or IP modelling using C++, SystemC, or TLM. 
 - Good understanding of computer architecture, microarchitecture, and SoC design concepts. 
 - Experience with software development practices including debugging, testing, and performance optimization. 
 - Experience using version control systems such as Git/Gerrit. 
 - Understanding of RISC-based architectures and familiarity with CPU instruction sets. 
 - Ability to work effectively independently and within distributed global teams. 
 - Strong interpersonal skills, excellent written and spoken English. 

Nice to Have

- Experience with Programmer's View (PV) modelling and SystemC TLM-2. 0 methodologies. 
 - Knowledge of Arm architecture or Arm system IP (CPU, interconnects, GIC, SMMU, etc. ). 
 - Experience building SoC virtual platforms or full-system simulators. 
 - Background in low-level software, firmware, bare-metal programming, or device drivers. 
 - Experience in supporting to large-scale multi-site software projects. 

Why Join Us

- Work on modern virtual platforms used across the Arm ecosystem. 
 - Experience with hardware validation labs and test farms. 
 - Collaborate with world-class engineers across global Arm teams. 
 - A clear path for career progression, with scope to evolve into technical leadership or management roles. 

Our 10x Mindset

At Arm, we believe progress happens when people are empowered to think bigger and push beyond what seems possible. Our 10x mindset is about curiosity, ambition and creating impact that will be used by millions. We learn fast, prioritise collaboration and turn bold ideas into real technology. We look for people who are inspired by this way of working and want to grow in an environment where bold ideas are welcomed. Discover how the 10x mindset shapes life at Arm: https: //careers. arm. com/10x-mindset

Use of AI in Your Application

At Arm, we embrace the benefits AI can bring, including in recruitment. You may use AI to support your preparation, such as improving the clarity of written responses, practicing interview questions, or learning more about our industry. However, your application and interview responses must reflect your own thinking, experience, and abilities. We want to understand your authentic perspective, creativity, and approach to problem solving. As such, you may not use AI to complete assigned tasks as part of any assessments. If you plan to use AI-supported or assistive technologies as part of a reasonable adjustment, please contact accommodations@arm. com so we can support you. 

Recruitment Adjustments and Accommodations

At Arm, we want to build extraordinary teams. If you need an adjustment or an accommodation during the recruitment process, please email accommodations@arm. com . To note, by sending us the requested information, you consent to its use by Arm to arrange for appropriate accommodations. All accommodation or adjustment requests will be treated with confidentiality, and information concerning these requests will only be disclosed as necessary to provide the accommodation. Although this is not an exhaustive list, examples of support include breaks between interviews, having documents read aloud, or office accessibility. Please email us about anything we can do to accommodate you during the recruitment process. 

Hybrid Working

Arm's approach to hybrid working is designed to create a working environment that supports both high performance and personal wellbeing. We believe in bringing people together face to face to enable us to work at pace, whilst recognizing the value of flexibility. Within that framework, we empower groups/teams to determine their own hybrid working patterns, depending on the work and the team's needs. Details of what this means for each role will be shared upon application. In some cases, the flexibility we can offer is limited by local legal, regulatory, tax, or other considerations, and where this is the case, we will collaborate with you to find the best solution. Please talk to us to find out more about what this could look like for you. 

Equal Opportunities

Arm is an equal opportunity employer, committed to providing an environment of mutual respect where equal opportunities are available to all applicants and colleagues. data.title: Software Development Engineer in Test (Python Testing)
data.description:
Software Development Engineer Test Engineer (Python Testing)

Experience: 9-12yrs

Location: Bangalore

CORE RESPONSIBILITIES

1. Automation Architecture & Hands-On Engineering

○ Architect, scale, and maintain a modular, zero-flake E2E, API, and integration automation framework built on Python 3. 10+ (pytest) and Microsoft Playwright. 

○ Build resilient Playwright automation for complex stateful browser interactions, including interactive canvas and node-graph workflow editors, real-time token-streaming chat interfaces (SSE and WebSockets), multi-tab and multi-user RBAC sessions, Shadow DOM elements, and network route interception and mocking. 

○ Treat test infrastructure as production software by enforcing strict static typing (mypy), fast linting (ruff), strict schema validation (Pydantic), clean design patterns (Page Object, Screenplay, and Fixture factories), and rigorous pull-request code reviews. 

2. Full-Stack Platform, Data & GenAI Quality

○ Validate REST, GraphQL, gRPC, and Model Context Protocol (MCP) interfaces, including optimistic concurrency and locking, idempotency, rate limiting, and asynchronous background workflows. 

○ Build automated validation pipelines across heterogeneous data backends, verifying SQL query generation, semantic metric calculations, enterprise ontology graph traversals, cloud object storage ingestion, and vector similarity search retrieval. 

○ Partner with AI Engineers to operationalize automated evaluation suites (RAGAS, DeepEval, LLM-as-a-Judge, and golden dataset benchmarks) measuring hallucination rates, groundedness, context recall, tool-call accuracy, Time-to-First-Token (TTFT), and token/cost regressions. 

3. CI/CD Release Governance, Performance & Security

○ Orchestrate containerized, parallelized (pytest-xdist and Playwright sharding) smoke, contract, and regression suites inside CI/CD pipelines with sub-15-minute PR feedback loops and automated QA to UAT to Production promotion gates. 

○ Drive performance, concurrency, load, and fault-injection testing (Locust and k6) to validate high-throughput agent executions, concurrent workflow graphs, and graceful degradation during upstream LLM or database throttling. 

○ Validate enterprise security boundaries including OAuth 2. 0, OIDC, SAML/SSO, RBAC/ABAC permissions, multi-tenant data isolation, and OWASP Top 10 risks for both Web and LLM Applications (prompt injection, PII leakage, and excessive agency). 

○

4. Engineering Leadership & Operational Excellence

○ Recruit, mentor, and upskill top-tier SDETs, coaching engineers from script-level testing into modern software engineering and system-level architectural thinking. 

○ Partner closely with Product Management, Platform Engineering, and SRE leaders during design reviews to enforce shift-left testability and observability from day one. 

○ Own platform quality SLAs and executive reporting, driving measurable improvements in Defect Escape Rate (DER), Mean Time to Detect (MTTD), Automation Stability (>99% non-flaky pass rate), and Release Lead Time. 

COMPLETE TECHNOLOGY LANDSCAPE

Should bring deep hands-on mastery of our core automation stack and strong working fluency across our broader platform ecosystem: 

○ Core Languages & Tooling: Python 3. 10+ (asyncio, typing, uv, Poetry, ruff, mypy), TypeScript / JavaScript (ES6+, Node. js), SQL (ANSI SQL, CTEs, analytical queries), Bash / Zsh. 

○ UI & Browser Automation: Microsoft Playwright (Python and TypeScript bindings, BrowserContexts, storageState authentication reuse, Trace Viewer, HAR replay, Network Interception, Canvas and Visual Regression), Chrome DevTools Protocol (CDP), Axe-core (WCAG accessibility testing). 

○ Python Testing Ecosystem: pytest, pytest-xdist (parallel sharding), pytest-asyncio, Pydantic v2, httpx, aiohttp, requests, Hypothesis and Faker (property-based and synthetic test data generation). 

○ API, Streaming & Contract Testing: REST (OpenAPI 3. x), GraphQL, gRPC / Protobuf, Server-Sent Events (SSE), WebSockets, Model Context Protocol (MCP), Schemathesis, Pact, WireMock. 

○ AI, LLM & Agent Evaluation: DeepEval, RAGAS, LLM-as-a-Judge pipelines, Golden Dataset curation, RAG retrieval metrics (precision, recall, faithfulness, groundedness), deterministic NLP metrics (F1, Exact Match), prompt and model regression harnesses. 

○ Databases, Vector & Storage Systems: PostgreSQL, Cloud Data Warehouses (BigQuery, Snowflake), Vector Databases (pgvector, Milvus, Qdrant, Pinecone), Graph and Ontology Stores (Property Graphs, RDF), Redis, Cloud Object Storage (Google Cloud Storage, AWS S3, Azure Blob). 

○ Asynchronous & Event Messaging: Kafka, RabbitMQ, Celery (testing distributed task queues, retries, dead-letter queues, and eventual consistency). 

○ Performance, Load & Resilience: Locust (Python-native distributed load testing), k6, API and LLM latency profiling (p50/p95/p99, TTFT, tokens/second), fault and latency injection. 

○ CI/CD, Cloud & Containers: Docker, Docker Compose, Kubernetes (K8s), GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins, GCP / AWS / Azure. 

○ Test Reporting & Observability: Allure Report, ReportPortal, TestRail / Xray, OpenTelemetry, Datadog, Grafana, Sentry, Langfuse / Arize Phoenix (LLM tracing and diagnostics). 

○ Security & Identity: OAuth 2. 0, OIDC, SAML / SSO, JWT, Multi-tenant RBAC / ABAC, OWASP ZAP, OWASP Top 10 for Web and LLM Applications. 

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS

○ 9+ years of progressive experience in Software Engineering in Test (SDET) or Quality Engineering, including 3+ years directly managing, mentoring, and scaling SDET teams on complex SaaS, cloud, data, or AI platforms. 

○ Expert-level proficiency designing production-grade Python (pytest) and Microsoft Playwright automation frameworks from scratch, including custom fixtures, parallel execution runners, dynamic state handling, and anti-flake architecture. 

○ Strong experience testing distributed microservices, stateful workflows, real-time streaming APIs, and relational and non-relational data layers. 

○ Proven track record embedding containerized automation suites into CI/CD pipelines to gate multi-environment enterprise releases without slowing developer velocity. 

○ Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or equivalent practical software engineering experience. 

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

• Direct experience building automated evaluation and regression pipelines for LLM Agents, RAG architectures, Semantic Layers, or Workflow Orchestration platforms. 

• Hands-on experience automating visual canvas or DAG builders (such as React Flow, HTML5 Canvas, or WebGL interfaces) and MCP-based tool integrations. 

• Prior experience building internal developer productivity tools, synthetic test-data platforms, or ephemeral preview test environments on Kubernetes.
