data.description:
Our Mission

At Palo Alto Networks®, we're united by a shared mission-to protect our digital way of life. We thrive at the intersection of innovation and impact, solving real-world problems with cutting-edge technology and bold thinking. Here, everyone has a voice, and every idea counts. If you're ready to do the most meaningful work of your career alongside people who are just as passionate as you are, you're in the right place. 

Who We Are

In order to be the cybersecurity partner of choice, we must trailblaze the path and shape the future of our industry. This is something our employees work at each day and is defined by our values: Disruption, Collaboration, Execution, Integrity, and Inclusion. We weave AI into the fabric of everything we do and use it to augment the impact every individual can have. If you are passionate about solving real-world problems and ideating beside the best and the brightest, we invite you to join us!

We believe collaboration thrives in person. That's why most of our teams work from the office full time, with flexibility when it's needed. This model supports real-time problem-solving, stronger relationships, and the kind of precision that drives great outcomes. 

Job Summary

We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer with 4+ years of software engineering experience to architect, build, and deploy custom Agentic AI applications integrated with our Salesforce ecosystem. In this role, you will bridge modern generative AI technologies (LLM orchestrations, autonomous agent loops, tool calling, and RAG) with enterprise CRM infrastructure. You will design autonomous and semi-autonomous AI agents that execute complex, multi-step business workflows, interact directly with Salesforce data and APIs, and safely escalate to human teams when necessary. 

Key Responsibilities

- Agentic Application Architecture: Design, build, and maintain agentic solutions using tools like LangGraph, ADK, LangChain, AutoGen, CrewAI etc. 
 - Salesforce Integration & Tool Calling: Implement robust REST/SOAP integrations, Webhooks, Platform Events, and Apex Invocable Methods allowing AI agents to query SOQL, update CRM records, and trigger Salesforce Flows autonomously. 
 - Context Grounding & RAG Pipelines: Build Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines connecting vector stores (e. g. , Pinecone, Weaviate, pgvector) to supply real-time context to LLMs while mitigating hallucinations. 
 - Workflow Automation & Agent Governance: Define function calling schemas, tool definitions, dynamic planning loops, and fallbacks. Implement safety guardrails, prompt evaluation suites, rate limiting, and seamless human-in-the-loop (HITL) handoffs. 
 - Observability & Reliability: Set up agent monitoring, evaluation metrics, and tracing to track execution paths, latency, context usage, and token costs. 
 - Cross-Functional Leadership: Partner with Salesforce Architects, Product Managers, and security teams to translate complex CRM requirements into reliable AI features adhering to enterprise compliance and data governance standards. 

Qualifications

Required Technical Skills & Qualifications

- Software Engineering Foundation: 3+ years of professional backend software engineering experience building scalable microservices, REST APIs, and asynchronous message queues. 
 - Agentic AI & LLM Systems: 2+ years of hands-on experience developing production AI agents, autonomous decision loops, multi-agent coordination, and function-calling/tool-use paradigms. 
 - Salesforce Core Knowledge: Proven experience interacting with Salesforce APIs (REST/Composite/Bulk), SOQL/SOSL queries, Connected Apps, OAuth flows, and Apex (Invocable Actions, Triggers). 
 - Programming Languages: Advanced proficiency in Python or TypeScript/Node. js for AI backend systems. 
 - Vector Databases & Embeddings: Direct experience with semantic search, embeddings generation, and vector engines (e. g. , Pinecone, Qdrant, ChromaDB, PGVector). 
 - Cloud & DevOps: Proficiency in cloud infrastructure (AWS/GCP/Azure), containerization (Docker, Kubernetes), serverless computing, and CI/CD pipelines. 
 - Domain Knowledge: Solid understanding of B2B Sales processes, Partner Relationship Management (PRM), and the end-to-end Opportunity-to-Quote (Q2C) lifecycle. 

The Team

You will be part of a growing, passionate, and dynamic team with an opportunity to work on challenging and exciting projects centered on what we believe is one of the most significant mission statements in the world. We also strive to be the most people-centric company ever!. That means we're constantly working to make your experience amazing, and you are part of the team breaking boundaries of what the workplace can be!. 

Our Commitment

We're trailblazers that dream big, take risks, and challenge cybersecurity's status quo. It's simple: we can't accomplish our mission without diverse teams innovating, together. 

We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for all qualified individuals with a disability. If you require assistance or accommodation due to a disability or special need, please contact us at accommodations@paloaltonetworks. com. 

Palo Alto Networks is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity in our workplace, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran status, race, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or other legally protected characteristics. 

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines. 

Is role eligible for Immigration Sponsorship? No. Please note that we will not sponsor applicants for work visas for this position.

data.description:
About Sirius AI

Sirius AI is a US-headquartered AI consulting services and products company with operations in India. We work with financial services enterprises to deliver data-driven solutions across multiple geographies. Our teams build AI, data-platform, and cloud-native solutions focused on measurable business outcomes. 

Role Overview

We are looking for a hands-on DevOps Engineer with 4-5 years of experience to help build, automate, secure, and operate reliable cloud infrastructure and delivery pipelines. The role will work closely with engineering, AI/ML, data, security, and product teams to support development and production environments across AWS and Azure. 

Key Responsibilities

Cloud Infrastructure & Automation

- Provision, configure, and maintain cloud infrastructure across AWS and Azure. 
 - Implement and maintain Infrastructure as Code using Terraform; exposure to CloudFormation, Bicep, or ARM templates is beneficial. 
 - Support environment setup and configuration across development, staging, and production. 
 - Assist with cloud cost monitoring, resource optimization, backup practices, and operational hygiene. CI/CD & Release Engineering

- Build, maintain, and troubleshoot CI/CD pipelines using Jenkins, GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, or AWS CodePipeline. 
 - Automate build, test, deployment, and rollback workflows; support safe release practices across environments. 
 - Work with Git-based version control and artifact repositories such as JFrog Artifactory, Nexus, or Azure Artifacts. Containers & Kubernetes

- Build and maintain container images using Docker and deploy containerized applications. 
 - Support Kubernetes workloads on Amazon EKS and/or Azure AKS, including deployments, services, ingress, configuration, and troubleshooting. 
 - Use Helm for packaging and deployment; exposure to Argo CD or Flux CD and GitOps practices is an advantage. Monitoring, Reliability & Incident Support

- Configure and maintain monitoring, alerting, dashboards, and logs using Prometheus, Grafana, CloudWatch, Azure Monitor, or Log Analytics. 
 - Investigate application and infrastructure incidents, perform initial root-cause analysis, and document corrective and preventive actions. 
 - Support service reliability through health checks, capacity monitoring, backup validation, and operational runbooks. DevSecOps & Access Management

- Integrate security and quality checks into delivery pipelines using tools such as SonarQube, Trivy, Checkov, AWS Inspector, or Microsoft Defender for Cloud. 
 - Manage application secrets using AWS Secrets Manager, Azure Key Vault, or HashiCorp Vault. 
 - Follow least-privilege access, secure configuration, patching, and change-management practices; support compliance requirements where applicable. Scripting & AI/ML Platform Support

- Write scripts and automation using Python, Bash, Shell, or PowerShell to reduce manual operational work. 
 - Support infrastructure and deployment needs for AI/ML workloads, including model-serving environments and GPU workloads when required. 
 - Collaborate with AI/ML and engineering teams to improve deployment repeatability, observability, and operational readiness. 

Required Qualifications

- 4-5 years of hands-on experience in DevOps, cloud engineering, platform engineering, or a related role. 
 - Practical experience with AWS and/or Azure cloud services; willingness to work across both platforms. 
 - Hands-on experience with CI/CD pipelines and Infrastructure as Code, preferably Jenkins or GitHub Actions/Azure DevOps and Terraform. 
 - Working knowledge of Docker and Kubernetes; experience with EKS or AKS is preferred. 
 - Experience with monitoring, logging, troubleshooting, and supporting production or production-like environments. 
 - Comfortable scripting in Python, Bash, Shell, or PowerShell. 
 - Understanding of cloud networking, IAM/RBAC, secrets management, and basic security best practices. 
 - Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience. 

Preferred Skills

- Exposure to AI/ML or MLOps tools such as MLflow, Kubeflow, Amazon SageMaker, Azure Machine Learning, or OpenSearch. 
 - Experience with GitOps tools such as Argo CD or Flux CD. 
 - Exposure to policy-as-code tools such as OPA or Sentinel. 
 - Experience in fintech, BFSI, or other regulated environments. 
 - Relevant certifications such as AWS, Azure, CKA/CKAD, or Terraform Associate. 

What Success Looks Like

- Reliable, repeatable infrastructure provisioning and application deployments. 
 - Faster and safer releases through automation and clear rollback procedures. 
 - Improved visibility into platform health through useful alerts, dashboards, and logs. 
 - Timely incident support, clear documentation, and actionable follow-up improvements. 
 - Effective collaboration with engineering and AI/ML teams.

About the Role

As a Lead Developer, you will own and evolve the core platform services that power our AI-driven products. You will design and build production-grade APIs, LLM-based extraction and enrichment pipelines, and agentic workflows - ensuring they are reliable, performant, and scalable. 

You will work closely with AI engineers, front-end developers, and product stakeholders to translate investment use cases into robust back-end solutions.

- Design, develop, and maintain back-end services and REST APIs using Python and FastAPI, serving both internal and external consumers.

 - Develop and maintain agentic AI workflows using LangGraph, including tool orchestration, multi-step reasoning chains, and feedback loops. 
 - Extend and operate the MCP server layer (FastMCP), enabling seamless integration of AI capabilities into third-party tools and workflows. 
 - Design and maintain data models and query patterns in MongoDB Atlas, leveraging both its document database and vector store capabilities for RAG pipelines.

 - Cloud & Infrastructure: Practical experience with AWS services, containerisation (Docker, Kubernetes/EKS), and orchestration tools such as Apache Airflow. 
 - API Design: Proven ability to design, build, and document RESTful APIs that are clean, versioned, and production-ready.

data.title: Senior Software Engineer (Development & Quality)
data.description:
About Kaseya

Kaseya is the leading provider of AI-powered IT management and cybersecurity software, serving Managed Service Providers (MSPs) and internal IT organizations worldwide. Our comprehensive platform helps organizations efficiently manage, secure, and automate their IT environments, driving operational efficiency and long-term business success. 

Backed by Insight Partners, a leading global software investor, Kaseya has experienced sustained double-digit growth and continues to expand its global footprint. Today, Kaseya supports customers in more than 20 countries and manages over 15 million endpoints worldwide. 

Founded in 2000, Kaseya was built by builders - and we're still building. We look for people who create rather than wait, who see a hard problem and lean in, and who treat challenges as raw material. At Kaseya, everyone plays a role in shaping the future of IT: whether you're in engineering, product, sales, marketing, customer support, or operations, your work helps protect, defend, and optimize IT environments across the globe. 

We're building teams that grow, perform, and make an impact. If you're driven by the itch to make things better - a product, a process, a career - you'll fit right in. 

At Kaseya, we don't just raise the bar. We build it. 

Senior Software Engineer (Development & Quality)

Why Kaseya?

Join a fast-growing company transforming the IT management and cybersecurity industry. At Kaseya, we are modernizing how software is designed, built, tested, and operated by combining strong engineering fundamentals with AI-native development practices. 

You will have the opportunity to influence not only the architecture and scalability of our platform services, but also how engineering teams leverage AI-assisted development, automation, and quality engineering practices to deliver reliable software faster. 

Join the Kaseya growth rocket ship and see how we are #ChangingLives!

Job Summary

We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer to help design, develop, and maintain scalable backend services, APIs, distributed systems, and cloud-native platform capabilities that power Kaseya products. 

This is a hands-on software engineering role focused on building reliable, secure, and maintainable SaaS applications. The ideal candidate is passionate about software architecture, distributed systems, cloud technologies, engineering excellence, and software quality. 

Unlike traditional development environments where quality ownership is separated, our engineers own the full software lifecycle. You will design, develop, test, deploy, and support your solutions while building automated validation alongside the features you create. Successful candidates combine strong software engineering skills with a quality-first mindset and leverage automation to ensure reliability, maintainability, scalability, and release confidence. 

What You Will Do

- Design and implement scalable backend services, APIs, and distributed applications using Java and modern cloud technologies. 
 - Build and maintain highly available SaaS platform capabilities and microservices architectures. 
 - Write clean, maintainable, and well-tested code. 
 - Own features throughout the entire lifecycle from design and implementation through testing, deployment, and production support. 
 - Build automated tests and validation frameworks alongside feature development. 
 - Develop automated coverage for functional, integration, API, regression, resiliency, and system-level scenarios. 
 - Improve software quality through testability, observability, diagnostics, telemetry, and automation. 
 - Participate in architecture and design discussions and contribute to technical decision-making. 
 - Investigate customer-reported issues, production incidents, and service degradations. 
 - Perform root-cause analysis and implement preventative solutions to avoid future recurrence. 
 - Troubleshoot complex issues using logs, metrics, traces, database analysis, and code-level debugging. 
 - Improve platform reliability, scalability, security, performance, and maintainability. 
 - Design and implement CI/CD pipelines that automate build, testing, deployment, security scanning, and release processes. 
 - Collaborate with Product, Security, Architecture, Platform, and Engineering teams to deliver customer-focused solutions. 
 - Participate in code reviews, architecture reviews, sprint planning, and technical mentoring activities. 
 - Leverage AI-assisted engineering tools to accelerate software development, testing, debugging, documentation, and codebase analysis. 
 - Utilize AI-assisted testing techniques to improve test generation, coverage, and engineering productivity. 
 - Help establish engineering best practices around AI-generated code validation, automation, and responsible AI-assisted development. 

What You Bring

Required Qualifications

- 7+ years of software engineering experience building SaaS applications, distributed systems, enterprise platforms, or cloud-native services. 
 - 5+ years of experience developing backend services using Java. 
 - Strong proficiency with Java and modern backend development frameworks such as Spring Boot and Spring Cloud. 
 - Experience building and maintaining scalable APIs, distributed systems, and microservices-based architectures. 
 - Experience building automated tests and validation capabilities as part of the software development lifecycle. 
 - Experience developing automated test frameworks and validation tooling using technologies such as JUnit, TestNG, REST Assured, Selenium, Playwright, or similar testing frameworks. 
 - Strong understanding of software design, object-oriented programming, APIs, databases, debugging, and version control. 
 - Experience developing automated coverage for API, integration, regression, and distributed-system testing. 
 - Experience implementing and maintaining CI/CD pipelines and automated deployment processes. 
 - Experience working with AWS, Azure, or GCP cloud environments. 
 - Strong troubleshooting, debugging, and root-cause analysis skills. 
 - Understanding of software quality engineering principles, test automation, and CI/CD practices. 
 - Experience using AI-assisted development tools such as coding assistants, code generation tools, or intelligent debugging solutions. 
 - Strong communication and collaboration skills with the ability to work effectively across cross-functional teams. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience with Spring Boot, Spring Cloud, Hibernate, Kafka, RabbitMQ, or similar technologies. 
 - Experience with PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQL Server, Oracle, or other relational database technologies. 
 - Experience with cloud-native, microservices-based, or event-driven architectures. 
 - Experience building test frameworks, automation libraries, quality engineering tooling, or validation platforms. 
 - Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, and containerized development or testing environments. 
 - Experience with Infrastructure as Code technologies such as Terraform, CloudFormation, or similar tools. 
 - Experience integrating security scanning, observability, automated testing, and quality gates into CI/CD pipelines. 
 - Experience contributing to modernization, migration, or platform transformation initiatives. 
 - Experience integrating AI-powered capabilities, LLMs, agents, or AI services into software products. 
 - Familiarity with modern AI engineering concepts such as prompt engineering, RAG, tool usage, evaluation frameworks, and agent-based systems. 

What Success Looks Like

A successful Senior Software Engineer at Kaseya: 

- Builds scalable, secure, and high-quality backend services and platform capabilities. 
 - Owns features end-to-end from design through production support. 
 - Demonstrates strong ownership of both software development and quality. 
 - Develops automated validation alongside feature implementation. 
 - Solves complex scalability, reliability, and distributed systems challenges. 
 - Improves the performance, security, reliability, and maintainability of platform services. 
 - Rapidly diagnoses issues and implements long-term corrective solutions. 
 - Partners effectively across Product, Security, Architecture, Platform, and Engineering teams. 
 - Leverages AI-native engineering practices to improve productivity and accelerate delivery. 
 - Continuously grows expertise in distributed systems, cloud-native technologies, automation engineering, and modern software development practices. 

Additional Information

Kaseya provides equal employment opportunity to all employees and applicants without regard to race, religion, age, ancestry, gender, sex, sexual orientation, national origin, citizenship status, physical or mental disability, veteran status, marital status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

The Opportunity

As Engineering Manager -DTT (Traction Transformer) at GEC India, you will lead a multidisciplinary engineering organization delivering tender, order, product, and technology engineering services to global traction transformer factories and business units. You will translate business priorities into a clear engineering strategy, build scalable competencies and capacity, and establish robust governance for safe, compliant, high-quality, and on-time execution. Working closely with HUB engineering leaders, factories, product management, project management, supply chain, quality, and customers, you will drive standardization, digitalization, innovation, and continuous improvement while developing a strong leadership pipeline and an engaged, high-performing team. 

How You'll Make An Impact

- Define and execute the GEC India engineering strategy and capability roadmap for traction transformers in alignment with Business Unit, Global Product Group, HUB, and factory priorities. 
 - Lead engineering delivery for tenders, customer orders, design modifications, product development, value engineering, and lifecycle support, ensuring committed quality, cost, and schedule targets are achieved. 
 - Establish effective governance for project allocation, design reviews, technical risk management, escalation, change control, documentation, and engineering release processes. 
 - Ensure traction transformer designs meet contractual requirements, applicable railway and transformer standards, customer specifications, internal design rules, and safety and regulatory expectations. 
 - Own capacity and workforce planning, competency mapping, succession planning, recruitment, onboarding, and technical development for electrical, mechanical, and related engineering disciplines. 
 - Develop team and technical experts, set clear objectives, coach performance, and foster an inclusive culture of accountability, collaboration, knowledge sharing, innovation, and continuous learning. 
 - Manage resource utilization, productivity, external engineering spending, and cost recovery while balancing demand across factories, HUBs, and projects. 
 - Define and monitor KPIs for on-time delivery, first-time-right quality, engineering hours, productivity, utilization, cost performance, customer satisfaction, and competency development; implement corrective actions where required. 
 - Drive design standardization, modularization, reuse, digital engineering, automation, and deployment of common tools and processes across the traction transformer engineering network. 
 - Partner with factories and cross-functional teams to resolve complex technical issues, support root-cause analysis, capture lessons learned, and improve product quality, manufacturability, reliability, and total cost. 
 - Build trusted relationships with global stakeholders and customers, communicate priorities and risks transparently, and represent GEC India in technical and operational reviews. 
 - Ensure compliance with applicable external and internal regulations, procedures, information-security requirements, and engineering guidelines. 
 - Live Hitachi Energy's core values of safety and integrity by taking responsibility for your actions while caring for colleagues and the business. 

Your Background

- Bachelor's degree in electrical or mechanical engineering; a master's degree or formal qualification in engineering or business management is preferred. 
 - Typically, >14 years of progressive transformer engineering experience, including substantial experience in traction transformers and at least 5 years in people or functional leadership. 
 - Strong knowledge of traction transformer design, including electrical and mechanical design interfaces, dielectric and thermal performance, short-circuit withstand, losses, noise, insulation systems, cooling, materials, and manufacturing constraints.

 - Working knowledge of applicable IEC, EN, railway, quality, and safety standards; familiarity with customer-specific and regional requirements is an advantage. 
 - Experience with engineering tools, product lifecycle management, design automation, digital workflows, and structured problem-solving methods such as Lean or Six Sigma are desirable. 
 - Proven ability to build and scale engineering teams, manage budgets and capacity, develop talent, lead change, and collaborate effectively across cultures, functions, and time zones. 
 - Strong commercial awareness, decision-making, stakeholder management, negotiation, communication, and presentation skills. 
 - Fluent spoken and written English is required; additional languages are an advantage.

data.title: Senior Software Development Engineer - AI Native Platform
data.description:
About Autonomize AI

Autonomize AI is building the intelligence layer for healthcare. Our Genesis platform replaces brittle, manual knowledge workflows with AI agents that reason, retrieve, and act - reducing administrative burden so clinicians can focus on patients. 

We're looking for engineers who don't just integrate AI into software - they think in agents, design for inference, and treat LLMs as first-class infrastructure. 

The Opportunity

You'll architect and ship across the full Genesis stack: agentic pipelines, backend APIs, data infrastructure, and clinical-facing UI. You'll work directly with founders and customers. You'll own things end-to-end. 

This is not a role where you bolt AI onto existing CRUD. You'll be making foundational decisions about how intelligent systems are designed, evaluated, and operated at scale in a regulated industry. 

You're a Fit If You Have

- AI-native engineering is your default mode
 - You've built production systems where LLMs are doing real work - not demos, not PoCs
 - You've designed and shipped RAG pipelines, multi-agent workflows, or tool-using agents in production
 - You understand prompt engineering as an engineering discipline: versioning, evaluation, regression testing

data.title: Senior Software Development Engineer, Post Trade
data.description:
About Us

DriveWealth is on a mission to make investing easier. We believe that everyone should have the ability to control their financial future, and that access to financial markets should not be limited by geography, wealth, or legacy systems. We are a global B2B financial technology organization dedicated to democratizing access to financial independence around the world. Our mission is realized through an API-based platform, empowering our partners to offer seamless investing and trading experiences to clients worldwide, all from their mobile devices. Our technology provides partners with a modern, extensible toolkit, enabling traditional investment workflows and innovative techniques like fractional share ownership. DriveWealth has evolved into a global platform offering trading of US equities, mutual funds, ETFs, fixed income, and options. 

There's never been a better time to build a category-defining business and there has rarely been a team better positioned for this opportunity. Our culture blends the pace and agility of a fintech start-up with the impact, stability, and discipline of Wall Street. We encourage creativity and experimentation while ensuring institutional-grade execution and regulatory compliance in everything we do. Join us and help build the future of global investing!

About The Role

We are seeking a Senior Software Development Engineer to join our Post Trade Engineering team. In this role, you will lead the design, development, and implementation of our brokerage systems. You will work closely with our engineering team and other stakeholders to create scalable, low-latency, and highly available trading systems. 

What You'll Do

- Build new products and features while supporting and enhancing existing ones, owning the technical architecture, design, and delivery of high-performance, low-latency brokerage systems using Java
 - Partner with Product and Operations to understand requirements, translate them into implementable technical features, and deliver them
 - Design and build event-driven architectures using Kafka, packaged with Docker and deployed on Kubernetes
 - Support production applications by triaging, troubleshooting, and resolving issues, drawing on an understanding of system integration, scripting, and test planning. 
 - Build observability, resilience, and recoverability into applications. 
 - Assess the health and performance of software applications and databases, and provide software and technology solutions
 - Define specifications, develop components, modify the existing software stack, prepare test data, and prepare functional specifications
 - Analyze service and application performance using various programming languages, tools, and techniques

You Bring

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or related field, or equivalent experience
 - At least 7 years of experience in Software Engineering with expertise in Java and spring framework. 
 - Proficient in developing and maintaining robust REST APIs and implementing sophisticated event-driven architectures using Kafka, deployed on Kubernetes. 
 - Capital Markets or financial technology background (required), with a focus on the trade lifecycle. 
 - Experience with Jira, Git, and shell scripting(writing scripts to extract and transform data)
 - Proficient in NoSQL, SQL, and stored procedures, such as in PostgreSQL and MySQL
 - Understanding of Test-Driven Development and how to write effective unit and integration tests
 - Working knowledge of CI/CD tools and practices, such as JFrog Artifactory, GitHub Actions, Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools such as Terraform or AWS CloudFormation etc
 - Experience with a 24/7, highly available architecture
 - Experience with Amazon Web Services (AWS) (required)
 - Experience with Scrum and other Agile processes
 - Strong analytical, communication and problem-solving skills

Location

This role is open to candidates in the following locations: Hyderabad, IN

- This role is expected to come into the office on a cadence set by the Hiring Manager/Team. 
 - If you're not based in one of the locations listed above, this role is not a fit, and we cannot accommodate remote work outside these locations. 

Working at DriveWealth

We do our best work when we're in the same room. To maintain the speed our partners expect, our New York, Chicago, and Lithuania teams work in office on a hybrid schedule. We've found that being physically side-by-side is the only way to solve complex problems in real-time and stay truly accountable to the products we ship. When you're here, you're working directly with the people making the decisions. 

To support that work, we provide competitive compensation, equity, and a 401(k) match. We also offer Medical insurance, Dental insurance, Vision insurance, Disability insurance, and Paid Parental Leave, along with a wellness reimbursement, a company-provided phone, and a personal development allowance. Finally, we value the time you spend away from the office with generous Paid Time Off (PTO) and observed holidays. 

Work Authorization

Applicants must possess the legal right to work in the country where the position is located at the time of application. DriveWealth requires all employees to provide original documentation verifying their work authorization on or before their first day of employment. 

For US-based roles: Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States on a full-time basis without the need for current or future visa sponsorship. DriveWealth does not provide visa sponsorship or support for employment authorization, including transfers, at this time. Offers of employment are strictly contingent upon an individual's ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the Company. 

How We Think About AI

We leverage AI to work smarter and move faster. We seek AI-curious talent who are proactive about using emerging tools to increase signal quality, reduce friction, and improve outcomes to deliver products faster, provide better service to our partners, and to streamline processes. Your ability to leverage our internal tools and technology to drive results is as important to us as your core domain expertise. 

Compensation

Pay is generally based on the level, complexity, responsibility, location, and job duties/requirements of the specific position. We then source candidates with the requisite skills, expertise, education, training, and experience. If you are selected for an interview, please feel welcome to speak to a recruiter about our compensation philosophy and other available benefits. This role is eligible for base, bonus, equity, 401(k) match, and heavily subsidized benefits and perks. 

Equal Employment Opportunity

To build technology and products that are used and loved by people and solve real-world problems, we need to build a team with many different perspectives and experiences. We are an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. We encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply. 

Agency Disclaimer

DriveWealth does not accept agency resumes. Do not forward resumes to our jobs alias, employees, or any other organization location. DriveWealth is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes.

Design it, build it, and own it in production. 

Anyone can draw a system diagram. What sets great architects apart is what happens after: whether the design holds when traffic grows tenfold, whether security survives a real audit, and whether teams can still build on it two years later. 

Techdome designs and runs production-grade platforms in FinTech, Healthcare, AI, SaaS, and more, including our own products JustInterview. ai (AI hiring) and Sparrow (API testing). What You'll Do

 - Drive cloud-native delivery: MERN platforms on AWS/GCP/Azure with Kubernetes, CI/CD, IaC, and secrets management.

This role combines hands-on Python engineering, advanced SQL development, and practical exposure to Financial Crime Compliance processes. You will work with business, compliance, data, and engineering stakeholders to deliver reliable solutions across KYC, AML, Transaction Monitoring, Sanctions, and Fraud.

We are seeking a hands-on software engineer with strong Python and advanced SQL skills and relevant Financial Crime Compliance domain experience. The successful candidate will develop and support data-intensive applications, analytical workflows, and rule-based solutions used in customer due diligence, transaction monitoring, sanctions screening, fraud detection, investigations, and regulatory reporting.

- Design, develop, test, and maintain Python applications, services, utilities, and data-processing workflows.

Financial Crime domain knowledge

Role: Lead Quality Assurance, 

Good to have knowledge on silver, & other jewelry metals. 

The role is based at Mumbai and reporting to the Head Merch. & Sourcing

Business Context and Opportunities

A global conglomerate, the Aditya Birla Group is in the League of Fortune 500. Anchored by an extraordinary force of over 150, 000 employees belonging to 100 nationalities, the Group is built on a strong foundation of stakeholder value creation. Backed by seven decades of responsible business practices, the Group operates leading businesses across metals, chemicals, textiles, cement, financial services, fashion retail, telecom, and renewable energy, with over 50% of revenues generated from international operations. 

The group expanded its Retail Footprint, leveraging the trust and synergy built over the years in luxury retail by launching its Jewellery brand Indriya, in June 2024. 

India's jewellery market is at an exciting inflection point. For decades, jewellery has largely been associated with weddings, family occasions, inheritance and long-term value. A new generation is now expanding what jewellery can mean. For Gen Z and young consumers, jewellery is increasingly about self-expression, identity, mood, styling, gifting and everyday confidence. It is no longer reserved only for milestone moments. It is becoming part of how young people show up each day, at college, at work, at a café, at a concert, on social media and in the moments that define their personal style. 

Project Tiara is our attempt to build a distinctly new-age jewellery brand for this generation. 

The brand is currently in its conceptualisation stage as a separate and independent business under the legal entity Novel Jewels (the creators of Indriya), backed by the trust, ambition and scale of the Aditya Birla Group. 

The Core Idea

Project Tiara is a jewellery brand will speak to young consumers who want jewellery that is stylish, affordable, versatile and relevant to their lives. It will focus on everyday wear, trend-responsive drops and pieces that can be worn, stacked, layered, mixed, matched and made personal. 

Where the Brand Will Play

Project Tiara is being imagined for the fast-growing daily wear and self-purchase jewellery space. This is a large, under-branded opportunity in India, where young consumers are actively looking for jewellery that feels more current, more expressive and more accessible than traditional fine jewellery. 

The brand will likely operate across digital-first channels, selective physical experiences, pop-ups and omni-channel journeys. It will be designed for a consumer who discovers on Instagram, engages through content, browses online, walks into stores and expects a seamless experience across all touchpoints. 

How We Aim to Differentiate

Project Tiara will be different from traditional jewellery brands in both product and personality. 

This brand will not simply sell jewellery. It will create a new buying behaviour, where jewellery becomes part of everyday identity, styling and self-expression. 

Why This Is Exciting

Project Tiara gives us the opportunity to build a brand from the ground up: the consumer lens, product strategy, design system, brand voice, digital ecosystem, supply chain model, retail experience and growth engine. 

It will also serve as an innovation sandbox for Novel Jewels, allowing us to experiment with new designs, faster drops, creator collaborations, digital storytelling, consumer communities and more agile ways of building a jewellery brand. 

The 3 to 5 Year Ambition

Over the next 3 to 5 years, the ambition is to build Project Tiara into a meaningful, scalable, national Gen Z jewellery brand. The plan is to create a strong digital-first foundation, build repeat-led consumer behaviour, expand through selective offline formats and create a brand that young India sees as expressive, aspirational and accessible. 

Project Tiara will also help Novel Jewels engage consumers early in their jewellery journey, creating a long-term relationship that can grow with them as their life stage, income and jewellery needs evolve. 

Why Join Us

This is a rare opportunity to be part of a founding team for a new consumer brand within one of India's most respected business groups. The team will have the chance to shape the brand's identity, product language, consumer experience, content engine, commercial model and growth journey from the very beginning. 

We are looking for people who are entrepreneurial, consumer-obsessed, culturally aware, digitally fluent and excited by the idea of building something that can redefine how young India experiences jewellery. 

Project Tiara is not just a new brand. It is a chance to reimagine jewellery for a new generation.

Description

The Music Catalog Quality team at Amazon Music serves a key role in developing solutions to ensure and improve the quality of catalog metadata and content across the music streaming experience. We create solutions that detect, measure, and remediate quality issues in music metadata - including artist information, track attributes, versions, content tags, and provide actionable insights that enable continuous improvement of the catalog. We leverage a host of scientific and engineering technologies to accomplish this mission, including Generative AI, classical ML, Natural Language Processing, Computer Vision, and automated data validation pipelines. 

As an Applied Science Manager on the team, you will lead a team of scientists to define and execute a transformative vision for holistic catalog quality measurement, metadata enrichment, and content integrity. Your team will own the science solutions for foundational quality detection frameworks, metadata validation and correction technologies, state-of-the-art algorithms to identify and resolve catalog anomalies (violative content, duplicative/low value content, misattributed tracks, incorrect metadata), and/or agentic AI solutions that help internal teams quickly surface and fix quality issues to ensure customers receive accurate, complete catalog experiences. 

Key job responsibilities

You independently manage a team of scientists. You identify the needs of your team and effectively grow, hire, and promote scientists to maintain a high-performing team. 

You have a broad understanding of scientific techniques, several of which may fall out of your specific job function. 

You define the strategic vision for your team. You establish a roadmap and successfully deliver scientific solutions that innovate on catalog quality detection, metadata enrichment, and content integrity. 

You define clear goals for your team and effectively prioritize, balancing short-term quality improvements and long-term innovation in catalog intelligence. 

You establish clear and effective metrics and scientific process to enforce consistent, high-quality artifact delivery and measurable catalog quality improvements. 

You proactively identify risks and bring them to the attention of your manager, customers, and stakeholders with plans for mitigation before they become roadblocks. You know when to escalate. 

You communicate ideas effectively, both verbally and in writing, to all types of audiences. You author strategic documentation for your team. You communicate issues and options with leaders in such a way that facilitates understanding and that leads to a decision. 

You work successfully with customers, leaders, and engineering teams. You foster a constructive dialogue, harmonize discordant views, and lead the resolution of contentious issues. 

About The Team

We are a team of scientists and MLEs focused on music catalog quality and metadata intelligence. You will work with colleagues with deep expertise in ML, NLP, CV, Gen AI, and data quality systems with a diverse range of backgrounds. We partner closely with top-notch engineers, product managers, content operations teams, and other scientists with expertise in music metadata, content classification, and building scalable modeling and software solutions that keep the Amazon Music catalog accurate, complete, and trustworthy.

We are looking for a talented, detail-oriented and enthusiastic System Development Engineer who is passionate about quality and is enthusiastic about new digital products. The creation of software services and tools to drive the software development process towards higher quality. The development will be from the concept stage to the launch stage and ensuring the highest level of quality for your deliverable. 

In This Role, You Will

You will have an enormous opportunity to make a large impact on the design, architecture, and implementation of next generation products used every day, by people you know.

Investigate, prototype and deliver new and innovative system solutions .

Using a combination of open source and proprietary technologies, we build next generation devices for media consumption, whether mobile or in the home. data.description:
Harness is the AI Software Delivery Platform company, led by technologist and entrepreneur Jyoti Bansal (founder of AppDynamics, acquired by Cisco for $3. 7B). Harness has raised approximately $570M in funding and is valued at $5. 5B, backed by leading investors including Goldman Sachs, Menlo Ventures, IVP, Unusual Ventures, Citi Ventures, and more. As AI accelerates code creation, the real bottleneck has shifted to everything after the code - testing, deployments, application security, reliability, compliance, and cost optimization. Harness brings AI and automation to this "outer loop, " helping teams ship software faster while maintaining security and governance throughout the entire software delivery lifecycle. 

Powered by Harness AI and the Software Delivery Knowledge Graph, the Harness Platform applies deep context and intelligent automation across the software delivery lifecycle with governance and policy-driven controls embedded throughout the platform. 

Over the past year, Harness powered over 185M deployments, 82M builds, 18T flag evaluations, 8M security scans, 9. 1B optimized tests, 3T protected API calls, and helped manage $2. 8B in cloud spend - enabling customers like United Airlines, Morningstar, and Choice Hotels to accelerate releases by up to 75%, reduce cloud costs by up to 60%, and achieve 10x DevOps efficiency. 

With a global team across 26 offices and 27 countries, Harness is shaping the future of AI software delivery - and we're looking for exceptional talent to help us move even faster. 

Position Summary

Harness is seeking an exceptional Engineering Manager to lead the team building the Harness Cloud platform, the infrastructure foundation powering Continuous Delivery (CD) and several other Harness products. This is a unique opportunity to lead engineers building one of the industry's most scalable cloud-native execution platforms, responsible for securely orchestrating build infrastructure across thousands of virtual machines, Kubernetes clusters, and bare-metal systems. 

As an Engineering Manager, you'll lead a highly technical team responsible for architecting, scaling, securing, and operating the cloud platform that powers millions of build executions. You'll partner closely with Product Management, SRE, Customer Success, and Principal Engineers to deliver highly available infrastructure that enables developers worldwide to build software faster, more securely, and at massive scale. 

This role is ideal for leaders who enjoy solving complex distributed systems challenges, growing high-performing engineering teams, and remaining deeply engaged in technical architecture and execution. 

About The Role

The Harness Cloud platform forms the foundation for Continuous Delivery (CD) and several other Harness products. As an Engineering Manager, you'll lead a team responsible for scaling and evolving the cloud infrastructure that powers our global software delivery platform. 

You Will

- Lead a team building the Harness Cloud platform, including lifecycle management of a large fleet of virtual machines, bare-metal infrastructure, and Kubernetes environments. 
 - Drive the architecture, scalability, security, and reliability of distributed cloud infrastructure powering millions of CI workloads. 
 - Partner with Product Management to define technical roadmaps and deliver capabilities that improve platform scalability, reliability, performance, and customer experience. 
 - Work closely with Principal Engineers to define long-term technical strategy and architecture for the Harness Cloud platform. 
 - Collaborate with Cloud Engineering, SRE, and Customer Success teams to diagnose and resolve complex production issues across distributed infrastructure. 
 - Foster engineering excellence through architecture reviews, design discussions, peer code reviews, and operational best practices. 
 - Lead incident response, postmortems, and continuous improvements in observability, resiliency, and operational maturity. 
 - Recruit, mentor, and grow engineers and technical leaders while building an inclusive, high-performing engineering culture. 
 - Balance execution of customer commitments with long-term investments in platform scalability, automation, and developer productivity. 

About You

Proven Engineering Leader

- 3+ years of experience leading high-performing engineering teams delivering distributed infrastructure or cloud platform services. 
 - Proven track record of mentoring engineers while driving technical execution and organizational growth. 

Distributed Systems

Strong Understanding Of

- Distributed systems
 - Virtual Machine lifecycle management
 - Container technologies
 - Networking
 - Storage systems
 - Kubernetes
 - High availability and fault tolerance

Technical Leadership

- Proven ability to build highly scalable saas services
 - Experience authoring architecture documents and technical specifications. 
 - Ability to break down complex technical problems into executable engineering plans. 
 - Comfortable driving technical decisions across multiple engineering teams. 

Operational Excellence

Experience With

- Production operations
 - Incident management
 - Observability
 - Monitoring
 - Logging
 - Performance optimization
 - Capacity planning
 - Reliability engineering

Customer Focus

- Passionate about building infrastructure that improves developer productivity. 
 - Comfortable partnering with customer-facing teams to diagnose production issues and influence product direction. 

Harness In The News

- Accelerating Our Mission to Bring AI to Everything After Code
 - Goldman Sachs leads investment in software delivery startup Harness at $5. 5 billion valuation
 - How Harness runs 16 "startups within a startup" at scale | Jyoti Bansal
 - Harness Research Shows AI Visibility Crisis Fueling Security Nightmare
 - Harness has been named to the Inc. Power Partner list for software delivery success

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex or national origin. 

At Harness, we care about your privacy and are committed to protecting your personal data. For additional information on this topic, you can visit our privacy Portal: https: //harness-privacy. relyance. ai/

Note on Fraudulent Recruiting/Offers

We have become aware that there may be fraudulent recruiting attempts being made by people posing as representatives of Harness. These scams may involve fake job postings, unsolicited emails, or messages claiming to be from our recruiters or hiring managers. 

Please note, we do not ask for sensitive or financial information via chat, text, or social media, and any email communications will come from the domain @harness. io. Additionally, Harness will never ask for any payment, fee to be paid, or purchases to be made by a job applicant. All applicants are encouraged to apply directly to our open jobs via our website. Interviews are generally conducted via Zoom video conference unless the candidate requests other accommodations. 

If you believe that you have been the target of an interview/offer scam by someone posing as a representative of Harness, please do not provide any personal or financial information and contact us immediately at security@harness. io. You can also find additional information about this type of scam and report any fraudulent employment offers via the Federal Trade Commission's website (https: //consumer. ftc. gov/articles/job-scams), or you can contact your local law enforcement agency.

data.title: Director - Business Intelligence
data.description:
The Data Experience (DEx) practice builds the data foundations, pipelines, and products that power Dentsu's media and marketing effectiveness work across Carat, iProspect, and Dentsu X. We are seeking a Director, Data Engineering to lead our offshore (DGS) engineering capability - owning the architecture, quality, and delivery of the data platform that everything downstream depends on. 

This is a senior leadership and hands-on engineering role. You will set the standard for how DEx ingests, models, and serves media and marketing data on Databricks, and you will do it as a modern practitioner - using AI-assisted data development (Databricks Genie, Copilot, Claude Code) to move faster and raise quality. You will lead and mentor a team of DGS engineers while staying close enough to the code to set the bar yourself. This role demands deep Databricks expertise and a genuine understanding of what media data means, not just how to move it. 

Job Description: 

Core Skills & Requirements

Databricks & Data Engineering

- Deep, hands-on Databricks expertise: Spark, Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, Lakeflow / Delta Live Tables, Medallion architecture, and performance tuning. 
 - Expert-level SQL and strong Python for data engineering; production experience building and operating pipelines at scale. 
 - Solid grasp of data modeling, orchestration, data quality, and governance - building for reuse and maintainability, not one-off delivery. 
 - Experience with the surrounding ecosystem (Azure, lightweight ETL / data-prep tooling such as Trifacta or dbt) is a strong plus. 

AI-Assisted Data Development

- Hands-on experience developing data solutions with AI tooling - Databricks Genie, GitHub / Databricks Copilot, Claude Code, or comparable AI coding agents. 
 - Able to use AI assistants to accelerate pipeline build, transformation logic, and debugging while maintaining correctness, governance, and quality. 
 - A builder's mindset: comfortable pairing with AI tools as a force multiplier for the team, not a novelty. 

Media & Marketing Data Fluency

You must understand not just how to engineer the data, but what the data means. 

- Strong command of media and marketing data: what impressions, spend, clicks, and conversions represent, and how they relate. 
 - Understanding of how reach and frequency work - served vs. viewable impressions, de-duplicated reach, and frequency capping - and the implications for how data must be modeled. 
 - Familiarity with conversion tracking and attribution mechanics - pixels, tags, post-click vs. post-view, and lookback windows. 
 - Knowledge of how media data connects across campaigns, placements, creatives, and channels, and how spend flows through to outcomes. 
 - Practical experience with media taxonomies and naming conventions as the foundation of trustworthy, joinable data. 

Leadership

- Proven experience leading and developing an engineering team, ideally in an offshore / DGS or global delivery model. 
 - Ability to set architecture and code standards, review work critically, and raise the quality bar across a team. 
 - Strong communication across time zones with onshore leads and stakeholders. 

Preferred / Nice To Have

- Experience with streaming / near-real-time ingestion patterns. 
 - Familiarity with trafficking / ad ops platforms (CM360, Prisma, DV360, TTD) and how their data lands in the platform. 
 - Exposure to semantic / metrics layers and how engineering choices affect downstream reporting (Power BI, dbt metrics). 
 - Experience in an agency, ad tech, or marketing analytics environment. 
 - CI/CD, testing, and DataOps practices for data pipelines. 

Qualifications

- 12+ years in data engineering, with several years in a leadership or director-level capacity. 
 - Demonstrated deep Databricks / Lakehouse expertise in production. 
 - Demonstrated domain knowledge of media and/or marketing data (hard requirement). 
 - Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.

data.title: Senior Software Engineer C++ | Low Latency Trading Systems
data.description:
About BestEx Research

BestEx Research is a financial technology and research firm specializing in building sophisticated execution algorithms and transaction cost modeling tools servicing multiple asset classes. The firm provides high-performance algorithmic execution services to hedge funds, CTAs, asset managers, and banks through a traditional electronic broker and in a broker-neutral Software as a Service (SaaS) model. 

Its cloud-based platform, Algo Management System (AMS), is the first end-to-end algorithmic trading solution for equities and futures that delivers an entire ecosystem around execution algorithms, including transaction cost analysis (TCA), an algorithm customization tool called Strategy Studio, a trading dashboard, and pre-trade analytics in a single platform. The platform is currently live for U. S. , Europe, and Canadian equities and global futures trading. 

BestEx Research is disrupting a $100 billion industry by challenging the status quo of stale, black-box solutions from banks and offering next-generation execution algorithms that combine performance improvement with transparency and customization. BestEx Research uses leading-edge technology to support its low-latency, highly scalable research and trading systems, with its backend in C++, research libraries in C++/Python and R, and web-based technologies for delivering its front-end platforms. 

BestEx Research's mission is to become the leader in automation and measurement of execution across asset classes globally and significantly reduce transaction costs for our clients. 

Visit for more information about our mission, products, research, and services. 

Why Join Us?

BestEx Research's Bangalore office is not an "offshore center. " It's a core engineering and research hub, working on the exact same problems and projects as our U. S. team. You will be part of the global brain trust, solving some of the hardest problems in trading, systems, and data science. 

What You'll Love: 

- Zero bureaucracy, zero silos-engineers directly collaborate with traders, researchers, and the management team
 - Direct ownership of subsystems
 - Daily opportunity to learn from pioneers in HFT, low-latency systems, and algo trading
 - A high-trust environment, where performance speaks louder than hierarchy. 
 - Competitive compensation in India, including equity and cash bonuses
 - Ability to transition between various teams and projects, whether related to trading systems, algorithmic trading or system tooling
 - 5-week structured training program: 
 - Market microstructure and trading mechanics
 - Algorithmic execution and strategy design
 - Exchange simulators and performance testing
 - Market data systems and real-time analytics
 - Hands-on exercises using production research data
 - Continuous professional development, with refresher courses, advanced sessions, and on-demand training tailored to your growth
 - Global exposure: Opportunities to collaborate with, visit, or relocate to our U. S. , Singapore, or London offices, based on performance and business needs

Your Role: Build What Most Engineers Never Get to Touch

You'll be part of a lean, focused team building ultra-low-latency trading systems, real-time exchange simulators, execution algorithms, and alpha forecasting models. Our engineers own the stack-from C++ nanosecond-sensitive infrastructure to Python-based research platforms. 

This role is ideal for someone who thrives at the intersection of research and engineering-comfortable building systems, testing hypotheses, and working directly with data that moves markets. 

What You'll Work On

Designing and developing system architecture: 

- Core trading systems and algorithmic trading frameworks
 - High-performance execution algorithms for global markets
 - Exchange simulators and tick-level backtesting frameworks
 - Market data adaptors and exchange connectivity adaptors

Building from scratch: 

- Trading systems for new asset classes and execution algorithms
 - Performance optimizations for low-latency, high-throughput systems

Enhancing existing systems: 

- Add support for new features and improve scalability and reliability

Collaborating closely with: 

- A global team of quants, traders, and senior engineers to design cutting-edge solutions

Analyzing and optimizing system performance: 

- Across application, OS, and hardware layers to achieve industry-leading performance
 - Work primarily with C++17 in a high-impact, low-bureaucracy environment

Requirements

You Should Have: 

- Bachelor's or Master's from a top-tier CS or Engineering program (IIT/NIT/BITS preferred but not required)
 - At least 5+ years software development experience with C++
 - Expert-level knowledge of C++ and excellent software design skills
 - Expert-level knowledge of TCP/IP and multithreading
 - Excellent problem solving and analytical skills
 - Excellent communication skills and ability to articulate ideas
 - An attitude of constant curiosity and growth, as well as the ability and desire to mentor others
 - While domain experience is a plus, we welcome strong engineers from other industries

Bonus Points For

- Database optimization and experience with research or market data pipelines
 - Prior work on trading platforms, FIX engines, or exchange protocols
 - Contributions to open-source C++/Python performance tools, ability to work with large datasets
 - Prior experience developing trading systems or execution algorithms
 - Knowledge of relational databases, database optimizations, and SQL
 - Experience with Python/R

Our Mission

You call. You wait. You call again. In every other part of your life, you book in seconds. In healthcare, you're blocked. 

We're here to give power to the patient. 

For nearly 20 years, we've built the leading healthcare marketplace - helping tens of millions of people find and book the care they need. Now, we're going further: building our infrastructure beyond Zocdoc's marketplace to power access to care wherever patients search, from provider websites and insurance directories to search engines, AI platforms, and more. 

Healthcare still lacks something every other major consumer industry takes for granted: a seamless way to go from seeking to getting. We don't want to own the front door to care; there isn't one. We want to make sure all of those doors open when patients are knocking. 

Fixing healthcare starts with fixing access to it. And we're still just getting started. 

Your Impact on Our Mission

A Site Reliability Engineer at Zocdoc plays a foundational role in enabling the entire engineering organization to move quickly, safely, and with confidence. Our mission is to design, automate, and operate the infrastructure and tooling that power every build, deployment, and runtime environment across the company. DevOps engineers ensure that systems are secure by default, observable, cost-efficient, and reliable, while reducing friction for developers and minimizing operational risk. 

We strive to eliminate repetitive manual work through thoughtful automation, build standardization, and continuous improvement. We look ahead - anticipating scaling challenges, security needs, and system weaknesses - so that engineers can focus on delivering value to patients and providers without being burdened by infrastructure complexity.

data.title: SRE II
data.description:
Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) at Equifax is a discipline that combines software and systems engineering for building and running large-scale, distributed, fault-tolerant systems. SRE ensures that internal and external services meet or exceed reliability and performance expectations while adhering to Equifax engineering principles. 

SRE is also an engineering approach to building and running production systems - we engineer solutions to operational problems. Our SREs are responsible for overall system operation and we use a breadth of tools and approaches to solve a broad set of problems. Practices such as limiting time spent on operational work, blameless postmortems, proactive identification, and prevention of potential outages. 

Our SRE culture of diversity, intellectual curiosity, problem solving and openness is key to its success. Equifax brings together people with a wide variety of backgrounds, experiences and perspectives. We encourage them to collaborate, think big, and take risks in a blame-free environment. We promote self-direction to work on meaningful projects, while we also strive to build an environment that provides the support and mentorship needed to learn, grow and take pride in our work. 

What You'll Do

- Work in a DevSecOps environment responsible for the building and running of large-scale, massively distributed, fault-tolerant systems. 
 - Work closely with development and operations teams to build highly available, cost effective systems with extremely high uptime metrics. 
 - Work with cloud operations team to resolve trouble tickets, develop and run scripts, and troubleshoot 
 - Create new tools and scripts designed for auto-remediation of incidents and establishing end-to-end monitoring and alerting on all critical aspects 
 - Build infrastructure as code (IAC) patterns that meets security and engineering standards using one or more technologies (Terraform, scripting with cloud CLI, and programming with cloud SDK). 
 - Participate in a team of first responders in a 24/7, follow the sun operating model for incident and problem management. 

What Experience You Need

- BS degree in Computer Science or related technical field involving coding (e. g. , physics or mathematics), or equivalent job experience required 
 - 2-5 years of experience in software engineering, systems administration, database administration, and networking. 
 - 1+ years of experience developing and/or administering software in public cloud 
 - Experience in monitoring infrastructure and application uptime and availability to ensure functional and performance objectives. 
 - Experience in languages such as Python, Bash, Java, Go JavaScript and/or node. js 
 - Demonstrable cross-functional knowledge with systems, storage, networking, security and databases

data.title: Senior UX Engineer
data.description:
Introduction To Demandbase

Demandbase is the only pipeline AI platform that empowers GTM teams to automate growth at scale. With a unified view of data, insights, actions, and outcomes, B2B enterprises can seamlessly align and execute their account-based GTM strategies with confidence. Thousands of businesses trust Demandbase to maximize revenue, minimize waste, and consolidate their data and tech stacks - all in one platform. 

As a company, we're as committed to growing careers as we are to building world-class technology. We invest heavily in people, our culture, and the community around us. We have also continuously been recognized as One of The Best Places To Work in the San Francisco Bay Area by Fortune, and One of The 60 Best Companies To Sell For by Selling Power. Our offices are located in San Francisco, New York, Austin, Seattle, India, and the United Kingdom. 

About The Role

Demandbase is building toward an AI-first future, where intelligent, agentic experiences help customers understand what matters, make decisions, and take action faster. We are looking for a Senior UX Engineer to help make that future real. 

This is a UX role with deep engineering capability, not a traditional frontend engineering role. You will start with the customer problem and use design, code, and AI to turn ideas into exceptional production experiences. 

You will sit at the intersection of Design, Product, AI, and Engineering, helping us move from concept to high-quality implementation faster. Beyond building experiences yourself, you will create the workflows, patterns, tools, and guardrails that help our Design organization get better experiences into the product with greater speed and fidelity. 

You will also help establish UX Engineering as a new function at Demandbase, bringing UX culture and the voice of the customer closer to our India Product and Engineering teams while partnering deeply with our US-based Design organization. 

What You'll Do

- Build polished, production-ready Demandbase AI experiences from concept through launch. 
 - Start with customer needs and translate design intent into thoughtful, high-quality working experiences. 
 - Partner closely with Design, Product, AI, and Engineering to explore and ship new agentic interaction patterns. 
 - Create workflows that help designers move from ideas and prototypes into production more effectively. 
 - Close gaps between design intent and implementation through hands-on development and structured pre- and post-launch reviews. 
 - Identify experience-quality issues earlier and help teams prioritize improvements faster. 
 - Use AI-assisted development extensively to accelerate exploration, implementation, testing, and iteration. 
 - Create reusable components, patterns, tools, and guardrails that improve quality across teams. 
 - Bring strong UX craft and customer advocacy into the India Product and Engineering organization. 
 - Teach and mentor designers and engineers, helping establish durable AI-enabled ways of working. 
 - Help define what great UX Engineering looks like at Demandbase. 

What We're Looking For

- 8+ years of exceptional UX and product judgment, with a strong understanding of customer workflows and needs. 
 - Strong frontend engineering skills and experience shipping complex web applications to production. 
 - Ability to move fluidly between design thinking, interaction design, prototyping, and production code. 
 - Deep experience with modern frontend technologies such as React and TypeScript. 
 - Highly proficient with AI-assisted development tools and comfortable using AI throughout the development lifecycle. 
 - A builder mindset: curious, resourceful, comfortable with ambiguity, and motivated to make ideas real. 
 - Experience creating reusable systems and patterns, not only one-off implementations. 
 - Strong attention to usability, accessibility, performance, interaction details, and product quality. 
 - Strong communication and influence across Design, Product, and Engineering. 
 - Experience working effectively across distributed and global teams. 
 - A desire to help other designers and engineers become more effective builders. 

What Will Make You Stand Out

- You have built AI-native, conversational, or agentic product experiences. 
 - You can show work where understanding the customer changed what you ultimately built. 
 - You have personally taken an experience from concept or Figma into production code. 
 - You have helped establish a UX Engineering, Design Engineering, or Design Systems practice. 
 - You actively experiment with AI development workflows and can explain where AI helps, where it fails, and how you validate its output. 
 - You have created tools or workflows that made an entire design or engineering team more effective. 
 - You care as much about the shipped customer experience as the original design. 

What Success Looks Like

You will help Demandbase: 

- Ship AI experiences faster with a higher quality bar. 
 - Catch gaps between design intent and implementation earlier. 
 - Build reusable interaction patterns for emerging AI experiences. 
 - Give designers better ways to get their work into production. 
 - Strengthen the partnership between Design, Product, and Engineering across the US and India. 
 - Bring a stronger voice of the customer into the India organization. 

Most importantly, you will help ensure that as Demandbase becomes more AI-first, the experience becomes more useful, understandable, trustworthy, and human. 

Benefits

Our benefits include Group Medical, Personal Accident, and Term Life Insurance for comprehensive protection. Preventive healthcare covers dental, vision, and OPD needs, complemented by strong mental health support. We also provide a fitness benefit, car lease policy, and gratuity for long-term financial well-being. 

Our Commitment to Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion at Demandbase

At Demandbase, we believe in creating a workplace culture that values and celebrates diversity in all its forms. We recognize that everyone brings unique experiences, perspectives, and identities to the table, and we are committed to building a community where everyone feels valued, respected, and supported. Discrimination of any kind is not tolerated, and we strive to ensure that every individual has an equal opportunity to succeed and grow, regardless of their gender identity, sexual orientation, disability, race, ethnicity, background, marital status, genetic information, education level, veteran status, national origin, or any other protected status. We do not automatically disqualify applicants with criminal records and will consider each applicant on a case-by-case basis. 

We recognize that not all candidates will have every skill or qualification listed in this job description. If you feel you have the level of experience to be successful in the role, we encourage you to apply!

We acknowledge that true diversity and inclusion requires ongoing effort, and we are committed to doing the work required to make our workplace a safe and equitable space for all. Join us in building a community where we can learn from each other, celebrate our differences, and work together. 

Unsolicited Submissions

At Demandbase, we value thoughtful partnerships and direct connections with candidates. We're not accepting unsolicited resumes or outreach from third-party recruiting agencies. Any unsolicited submissions will not be reviewed, and no fees will be paid.
