data.description:
Job Summary

- App Development is responsible for designing, building, testing and maintaining secure, scalable and high-performing software solutions that support business, client and operational outcomes. The discipline translates business and technical requirements into reliable applications, services, interfaces and digital capabilities that can be safely operated, enhanced and scaled over time. 
 - Operating across software engineering, API development, database integration, testing, secure coding, DevOps and production support, App Development plays a critical role in delivering technology that is maintainable, resilient and aligned to enterprise standards. The discipline requires strong programming capability, sound engineering judgement, collaboration across technology and business teams, and the ability to balance speed of delivery with quality, security, reliability and long-term sustainability. 

Key Responsibilities

Solution Design & Application Development

- Design and build software applications, interfaces, APIs and services that meet business requirements while remaining secure, scalable, maintainable and performant. 
 - Translate functional and technical requirements into practical engineering solutions, selecting appropriate patterns, technologies and implementation approaches based on system context and delivery needs. 
 - Develop and maintain application components across relevant technology stacks, which may include web, mobile, backend, integration, database or platform-specific environments. 
 - Apply appropriate programming languages, frameworks and tools - such as Java, JavaScript, Python, Go, Kotlin, React, Angular, Android, HTML/CSS or equivalent technologies - where relevant to the application domain and platform context. 

Code Quality, Testing & Engineering Standards

- Write and maintain clean, readable, reusable and well-structured code that supports long-term maintainability and reduces avoidable technical debt. 
 - Conduct and participate in code reviews to improve quality, consistency, security and adherence to engineering standards. 
 - Develop and apply automated testing approaches, including unit, integration, API and regression testing, to strengthen delivery confidence and reduce defects. 
 - Improve engineering practices by applying standards for version control, branching, documentation, peer review, test coverage and maintainable design. 

Secure Development & Technology Risk

- Implement secure coding practices to protect applications, data and customers from security vulnerabilities and technology risks. 
 - Apply security fundamentals across application design and development, including authentication, authorisation, input validation, secrets management and secure API design where relevant. 
 - Identify and remediate common application security issues, including web, mobile, API and data-related vulnerabilities. 
 - Ensure development activities align with internal technology controls, software delivery standards and applicable governance requirements. 

API, Integration & Data Engineering

- Design and develop APIs, integration points and service interfaces that enable reliable data exchange between systems, platforms and digital channels. 
 - Develop and optimise database structures, queries and data access patterns to support performance, scalability and reliability. 
 - Apply database development and management practices across relevant database technologies, such as relational databases, MySQL or equivalent platforms, depending on application needs. 
 - Support distributed system design by considering service boundaries, transaction handling, latency, resilience and dependency management. 

DevOps, Deployment & Release Readiness

- Support application deployment through CI/CD practices, automated build pipelines, version control and controlled release processes. 
 - Collaborate with release, infrastructure and operations teams to ensure applications are deployment-ready and aligned to environment, configuration and operational requirements. 
 - Use DevOps practices, containerisation or orchestration technologies - such as Docker, Kubernetes or equivalent platforms - where relevant to improve delivery consistency and application portability. 
 - Prepare applications for production by ensuring appropriate configuration, documentation, operational handover and release readiness activities are completed. 

Application Performance, Reliability & Supportability

- Monitor and analyse application performance, errors, logs and operational metrics to identify reliability, scalability or user experience issues. 
 - Troubleshoot and resolve technical issues across application code, APIs, databases, integrations, infrastructure dependencies or runtime environments. 
 - Design and improve applications with supportability in mind, including observability, logging, error handling, recovery behaviour and operational diagnostics. 
 - Strengthen application resilience by identifying failure points, reducing recurring incidents and improving system behaviour under real-world operating conditions. 

Technical Problem Solving & Continuous Improvement

- Investigate and resolve complex technical problems using structured analysis, debugging, experimentation and collaboration with relevant specialists. 
 - Evaluate new tools, frameworks and engineering approaches where they improve maintainability, security, scalability, developer productivity or delivery efficiency. 
 - Simplify and refactor systems, code and workflows to reduce complexity, improve performance and address technical debt. 
 - Apply lessons learned from defects, incidents, reviews and delivery challenges to improve future engineering outcomes. 

Stakeholder Collaboration & Delivery Alignment

- Collaborate with product owners, business stakeholders, designers, testers, release teams, infrastructure teams and other engineers to align solutions with user and business needs. 
 - Communicate technical options, risks, dependencies and trade-offs clearly to support effective decision-making. 
 - Contribute to agile delivery practices by participating in planning, refinement, estimation, reviews and continuous improvement activities. 
 - Document technical designs, implementation decisions, interfaces and support information to enable maintainability, knowledge sharing and operational continuity. 

Skills And Experience

Priority Skills

- Software Engineering
 - Programming Principles
 - Application Programming Interface
 - Database Development
 - Distributed Systems
 - DevOps
 - Software Testing
 - Secure Coding
 - Web Application Security
 - Mobile Security

Other Skills

- Platform Management
 - Operating Systems
 - Computer Network
 - Database Administration
 - Functional Writing

Motivations

- Motivated by solving complex problems through technology and engineering creativity. 
 - Energised by learning, experimenting and continuously improving technical solutions. 
 - Thrives in collaborative environments where innovation, quality and craftsmanship are valued. 

Qualifications

- Experience contributing to the development of software solutions that support business, customer or operational outcomes. 
 - Experience working in collaborative, cross-functional delivery teams where requirements are translated into technology solutions. 
 - Experience applying structured problem-solving approaches to resolve technical challenges and improve system performance. 
 - Experience working within engineering environments that emphasise quality, maintainability, security and continuous improvement. 
 - Experience adapting to evolving technologies, development practices or delivery approaches while maintaining effective outcomes.

Strong proficiency in at least one major programming language, such as Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, Java, C/C++, C#, Go, Rust, Ruby, PHP, Kotlin, or Swift.

Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to communicate technical risks and project status clearly to clients and internal stakeholders. 

Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple pods, priorities, and delivery phases simultaneously.

10+ years CORE DOMAIN

Avionics V&V ASSURANCE

DO-178B/C

Position Overview

We are seeking a Senior Advanced Embedded Engineer to provide technical leadership in the verification and validation of safety-critical avionics embedded software. The successful candidate will shape verification strategies, strengthen common test architectures and environments, advance automation, and support design assurance and certification activities aligned with DO-178B/C. This role combines deep hands-on engineering expertise with stakeholder leadership and a continuous-improvement mindset. 

Responsibilities

Key Responsibilities

- Lead end-to-end software verification and validation activities for avionics embedded software, from planning and test strategy through execution, evidence review, closure, and certification support. 
 - Define and drive reusable test architectures, environments, methods, tools, and processes that improve consistency, quality, scalability, and engineering efficiency across programs. 
 - Interpret and apply DO-178B/C objectives and applicable supplements across planning, verification, traceability, structural coverage, reviews, and certification deliverables. 
 - Provide technical direction for embedded software testing using C, C++, Python, embedded programming techniques, and model-based testing approaches. 
 - Guide the effective use of debuggers, simulators, target hardware, and structural coverage tools such as VectorCAST/VectorCAST Cover, LDRA, TCA, CodeTest, and TRACE32, as applicable to the program environment. 
 - Lead technical reviews, resolve complex verification issues, influence engineering decisions, and identify practical solutions that balance compliance, quality, schedule, and product needs. 
 - Partner with stakeholders within and outside the organization, communicating technical risk, evidence, recommendations, and improvement opportunities with clarity and credibility. 
 - Drive test methodology innovation and test-design automation, including responsible exploration of AI/ML-enabled opportunities where they provide measurable engineering value. 
 - Ideate and lead Velocity Product Development (VPD) initiatives to improve productivity and reuse. 
 - Contribute to change impact analysis, tool qualification, Test Readiness Reviews (TRR), Release for Software (RFS) activities, certification documentation, and SOI #3 audit readiness, as required. 
 - Mentor engineers, promote disciplined engineering practices, and foster a culture of technical excellence, accountability, learning, and continuous growth. 

Qualifications

Required Qualifications

Description

Invent the future with us. 

Ampere is a semiconductor design company for a new era, leading the future of computing with an innovative approach to CPU design focused on high-performance, energy efficient AI compute.

Join us at Ampere and work alongside a passionate and growing team - we'd love to have you apply!

About The Role

This position is for a Principal Silicon Validation Engineer within the Silicon Validation Engineering team, supporting Ampere's AI Compute family. The engineer will test, qualify, and improve bare-metal validation framework used for CPU/Mesh, SoC, and platform validation across emulation and post-silicon environments. 

The role owns regression strategy, test automation, CI/CD integration, results analysis, and first-level failure triage. The engineer will ensure validation processes, traceability, documentation, and test evidence meet strict ISO 26262 functional-safety and high-quality engineering requirements up to ASIL-D, where applicable

What You'll Achieve

- Develop test plans, automated regression suites, and validation strategies for the bare-metal framework. 
 - Create and execute functional, negative, stress, robustness, fault-injection, and regression tests across simulation, emulation, FPGA, and post-silicon environments. 
 - Validate framework execution, build/load/boot flows, CPU and memory features, interrupts, timers, coherency, power/reset, error handling, recovery, and multicore configurations. 
 - Own regression execution, monitoring, metrics, CI/CD pipelines, test artifacts, and reporting.

 - Develop automation for test execution, log collection, result analysis, failure classification, and reporting.

 - Support ISO 26262-aligned requirements-based testing, safety-mechanism validation, fault handling, diagnostic testing, and review/audit readiness up to ASIL-D.

About You

 - Strong Python, C, or C++ programming, scripting, and AI Coding skills. 
 - Experience building automated test infrastructure, regression suites, and CI/CD workflows. 
 - Experience with test planning, requirements-based testing, defect tracking, result analysis, and reporting.

 - Understanding of traceability, configuration/change management, anomaly management, verification evidence, and safety-quality processes. 
 - Experience with Linux, Git, build systems, and CI/CD tools such as Jenkins, GitLab CI or GitHub Actions.

 - Strong ownership, attention to detail, communication, and systematic debugging skills. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience with bare-metal test frameworks, CPU/Mesh/SoC validation, boot firmware, or post-silicon bring-up. 
 - Experience with safety mechanisms, fault injection, diagnostic coverage, safety evidence, assessments, or audits. 
 - Experience with requirements/test-management tools such as Jira, Polarion, Codebeamer, or TestRail. 
 - Experience owning hardware or firmware regression infrastructure and resolving flaky or intermittent failures.

data.title: Principal Silicon Validation Engineer
data.description:
Description

Invent the future with us. 

Ampere is a semiconductor design company for a new era, leading the future of computing with an innovative approach to CPU design focused on high-performance, energy efficient AI compute. 

As a pioneer in the new frontier of energy efficient high-performance computing, Ampere is part of the Softbank Group of companies driving sustainable computing for AI, Cloud, and edge applications. 

Join us at Ampere and work alongside a passionate and growing team - we'd love to have you apply!

About The Role

This position is for a Principal Silicon Validation Engineer within the Silicon Validation Engineering team, supporting Ampere's AI Compute family. The engineer will test, qualify, and improve bare-metal validation framework used for CPU/Mesh, SoC, and platform validation across emulation and post-silicon environments. 

The role owns regression strategy, test automation, CI/CD integration, results analysis, and first-level failure triage. The engineer will ensure validation processes, traceability, documentation, and test evidence meet strict ISO 26262 functional-safety and high-quality engineering requirements up to ASIL-D, where applicable

What You'll Achieve

- Develop test plans, automated regression suites, and validation strategies for the bare-metal framework. 
 - Create and execute functional, negative, stress, robustness, fault-injection, and regression tests across simulation, emulation, FPGA, and post-silicon environments. 
 - Validate framework execution, build/load/boot flows, CPU and memory features, interrupts, timers, coherency, power/reset, error handling, recovery, and multicore configurations. 
 - Own regression execution, monitoring, metrics, CI/CD pipelines, test artifacts, and reporting. 
 - Perform first-level triage; reproduce and classify failures across test, framework, firmware, hardware, configuration, and lab infrastructure. 
 - Develop automation for test execution, log collection, result analysis, failure classification, and reporting. 
 - Maintain reproducible test configurations, tool versions, artifacts, requirements traceability, and objective verification evidence. 
 - Support ISO 26262-aligned requirements-based testing, safety-mechanism validation, fault handling, diagnostic testing, and review/audit readiness up to ASIL-D. 
 - Improve logging, diagnostics, assertions, timeouts, health checks, and failure signatures; identify and resolve flaky tests. 
 - Collaborate with cross-functional teams on testability, debug, framework improvements, defect resolution, and platform bring-up

About You

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related field
 - 8+ years of experience in validation, test automation, firmware/system testing, or functional safety
 - Strong experience in validation, test automation, firmware/system testing, or hardware/software integration. 
 - Strong Python, C, or C++ programming, scripting, and AI Coding skills. 
 - Experience building automated test infrastructure, regression suites, and CI/CD workflows. 
 - Experience with test planning, requirements-based testing, defect tracking, result analysis, and reporting. 
 - Experience with ISO 26262 or similar safety-critical standards; ASIL-D validation experience is strongly preferred. 
 - Understanding of traceability, configuration/change management, anomaly management, verification evidence, and safety-quality processes. 
 - Experience with Linux, Git, build systems, and CI/CD tools such as Jenkins, GitLab CI or GitHub Actions. 
 - Familiarity with bare-metal software, firmware, boot flows, ARMv8/AArch64 or Cortex-M/R Series Controllers, and CPU/SoC concepts including caches, MMU, interrupts, timers, coherency, exceptions, reset, and power. 
 - Experience analyzing logs, firmware traces, register dumps, crashes, and test results. 
 - Familiarity with DSTREAM, Trace32, OpenOCD, GDB, JTAG, simulation, emulation, FPGA, post-silicon bring-up, or lab automation is a plus. 
 - Strong ownership, attention to detail, communication, and systematic debugging skills. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience with bare-metal test frameworks, CPU/Mesh/SoC validation, boot firmware, or post-silicon bring-up. 
 - Experience with safety mechanisms, fault injection, diagnostic coverage, safety evidence, assessments, or audits. 
 - Experience with requirements/test-management tools such as Jira, Polarion, Codebeamer, or TestRail. 
 - Experience owning hardware or firmware regression infrastructure and resolving flaky or intermittent failures. 

At Ampere we believe in taking care of our employees and providing a competitive total rewards package that includes base pay, cash long-term incentive, and comprehensive benefits. 

Benefits Highlights Include

- Premium medical, dental, vision insurance, parental benefits including creche reimbursement, as well as a retirement plan, so that you can feel secure in your health, financial future and child care during work. 
 - Generous paid time off policy so that you can embrace a healthy work-life balance 
 - Fully catered lunch in our office along with a variety of healthy snacks, energizing coffee or tea, and refreshing drinks to keep you fueled and focused throughout the day. 

And there is much more than compensation and benefits. At Ampere, we foster an inclusive culture that empowers our employees to do more and grow more. We are passionate about inventing industry leading cloud-native designs that contribute to a more sustainable future. We are excited to share more about our career opportunities with you through the interview process.

These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us. 

Ampere is an inclusive and equal opportunity employer and welcomes applicants from all backgrounds. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, national origin, citizenship, religion, age, veteran and/or military status, sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, physical or mental disability, or any other basis protected by federal, state or local law.

data.description:
Job Description

Our Mission: 

We aim to be the leading provider of content management software and expertise, helping clients create, manage, publish, and deliver high-value content. 

About Us

Contiem, Inc. is a global provider of software and services to assist clients in creating, managing, and delivering high-value content - technical documentation, eLearning, online help, visualizations, training materials, etc. We continuously challenge the status quo and empower organizations by delivering effective content solutions and services that help clients achieve their business objectives. 

Contiem headquarters is located in Annapolis, MD, with additional locations in the US and internationally in Sutton, UK, Chennai, India, and Sydney, Australia. Our elite team of subject matter experts works closely with clients to assess, optimize, and transform their content objectives and operations. Our global team allows us to support clients in 40 countries, including many of the world's largest companies and iconic brands, from various industries such as Government, Aerospace, Publishing, Consumer Products, Healthcare, Industrial, Technology, and Financial Services. 

Position Summary

Contiem is seeking a highly skilled and experienced Lead/Senior SQA Analyst to join our team and support testing for our Web, Desktop, and mobile applications. As a Senior SQA Analyst, you will play a critical role in ensuring the quality, reliability, and usability of our documentation tools. Your primary responsibility will be to design, execute, and maintain testing strategies and test cases to validate the functionality and performance of our software applications. 

Essential Duties & Responsibilities

Quality Ownership & Technical Leadership

- Own end-to-end quality of releases through comprehensive test planning, execution, and risk assessment. 
 - Define and drive test strategies, quality standards, risk-based testing approaches, and release readiness criteria across multiple product areas. 
 - Act as a technical escalation point; mentor colleagues on test case design, automation frameworks, and QA best practices. 
 - Collaborate with Product Management, Engineering, and Professional Services teams to influence product quality decisions. 
 - Conduct root cause analysis, track defect metrics, and drive continuous process improvements. 
 - Participate in release retrospectives, providing actionable testing insights to improve product quality. 
 - Champion quality advocacy across teams, ensuring adherence to standards and compliance requirements. 

Test Strategy & Coverage

- Analyze requirements and user stories to identify gaps, ambiguities, and risks; design targeted test plans accordingly. 
 - Execute manual and automated tests across web, Windows desktop, mobile (iOS/Android), APIs, databases, and XML content. 
 - Validate XML against schemas/DTDs (e. g. , S1000D, DITA, custom) to ensure product compliance. 
 - Perform accessibility testing (WCAG & EAA), performance testing (JMeter), functional, regression, and exploratory testing. 
 - Ensure test coverage across integration, system, and user acceptance testing phases. 

Automation & CI/CD Excellence

- Architect and optimize scalable automation frameworks like Playwright and Selenium. 
 - Implement Power Automate flows to streamline testing workflows. 
 - Integrate and maintain automation within Azure DevOps CI/CD pipelines for continuous quality validation. 
 - Maintain test data management strategies to support automation and regression testing. 
 - Assist in expanding automated coverage across UI, API, workflow, and data validation layers. 
 - Develop automation approaches for XML validation, publishing verification, and content quality checks. 
 - Analyze automation effectiveness and continuously improve test coverage. 

Functional & Workflow Testing

- Design and execute comprehensive test plans, test cases, and test strategies for enterprise content management solutions. 
 - Validate complex XML based structured authoring, review, approval, and publishing workflows. 
 - Test automated workflows, including content creation, reuse, versioning, branching, localization, metadata management, and publication processes. 
 - Validate workflow orchestration across multiple integrated systems and services. 
 - Ensure content integrity throughout the content lifecycle. 

XML and Publishing Validation

- Perform validation of XML-based content processing pipelines. 
 - Verify XML structures (e. g. , DITA maps, topics, etc. ), metadata, key references, conrefs, and content reuse mechanisms. 
 - Validate XML transformations and publishing workflows. 
 - Conduct output fidelity testing by validating that rendered outputs accurately reflect source XML structure, metadata, conditional processing rules, content reuse mechanisms, and publishing business rules. 
 - Verify content accuracy across PDF, HTML, WebHelp, and other publishing formats. 
 - Troubleshoot content rendering issues and identify root causes across transformation pipelines. 

Data Layer Testing

- Test both relational and NoSQL data architectures. 
 - Validate data persistence, retrieval, indexing, and content storage processes. 
 - Perform scale and performance testing against our content databases . 
 - Develop and execute XQuery-based validation scripts to verify content integrity and business rules. 
 - Validate database indexing, search relevance, faceted search behavior, metadata retrieval, taxonomy relationships, and content discoverability across large repositories. 
 - Ensure data consistency across systems and environments. 

API and Integration Testing

- Design and execute API testing for REST, GraphML, MCP and SOAP services. 
 - Validate API and Application integrations with authoring tools, publishing engines, translation management systems, identity providers, content delivery platforms, and downstream applications. 
 - Test webhook-based integrations and event-driven workflows. 
 - Verify message processing, asynchronous workflows, and system-to-system communication. 
 - Perform end-to-end validation across integrated platforms. 
 - Ensure reliability, scalability, and fault tolerance of integration points. 

Performance and Reliability Testing

- Validate system performance under realistic content processing workloads. 
 - Test scalability of publishing pipelines and content repositories. 
 - Identify bottlenecks across application, database, and integration layers. 
 - Collaborate with engineering teams to improve system reliability and performance. 

Collaboration & Execution

- Partner closely with global developers, technical writers, product managers, and QA teams. 
 - Document results and issues in Jira with detailed repro steps, severity levels, and acceptance criteria. 
 - Support multiple projects simultaneously while maintaining sprint velocity and meeting deadlines. 
 - Contribute to cross-functional initiatives such as DevOps, release management, and quality governance. 

Experience And Skills

Mandatory Requirements & Qualifications: 

- Excellent English language (written and spoken) skills. 
 - Strong experience with enterprise XML based Component Content Management Systems (CCMS), including structured content authoring, workflow management, content reuse, localization, and publishing processes. 
 - Solid understanding of XML content architectures and structured content management. 
 - Strong understanding of XML technologies and XML-based publishing pipelines. 
 - Experience validating publishing outputs against source XML content. 
 - Hands-on experience testing XML/NoSQL database platforms, with the ability to develop and execute XQuery-based validation scripts. 
 - Experience testing modern APIs. 
 - Experience testing asynchronous, event-driven, and webhook-based workflows. 
 - Strong SQL skills and experience validating relational database systems.

data.title: Cloud Automation Architectured
data.description:
Job description: 

Job Title: Cloud Automation Architect

Location: Hyderabad

________________________________________

The Role

We are looking for a senior automation architect who does not just write scripts - someone who builds production-grade automation frameworks from the ground up. You will own the full lifecycle: infrastructure provisioning, configuration, validation, self-healing, and monitoring. If you have spent years turning manual, fragmented ops into reliable, repeatable systems - this is built for you. 

________________________________________

What You Will Be Responsible For

Ansible Automation Design and maintain enterprise-grade playbooks, roles, and collections. Automate OS patching, configuration drift correction, security hardening, and compliance enforcement across AWS, Azure, VMware, and REST-integrated environments. Combine Ansible with Terraform for seamless post-provisioning configuration. 

AWS Cloud Automation Architect serverless and event-driven automation using Lambda, Step Functions, Event Bridge, SNS/SQS, S3 triggers, and Systems Manager. Build scalable, cross-account automation across AWS Organizations with proper IAM boundaries. Align all implementations with CIS, NIST, and AWS Well-Architected standards. 

Kubernetes & Helm Develop and own custom Helm charts for multi-environment Kubernetes deployments. Manage the full Helm lifecycle including upgrades, rollbacks, and canary releases. Drive GitOps adoption using ArgoCD or Flux. Automate namespace management, RBAC, secrets, and network policies. 

Infrastructure as Code & CI/CD Build reusable, versioned Terraform modules covering AWS networking, IAM, EKS, ECS, RDS, and security controls. Implement CI/CD pipelines for IaC using GitHub Actions or Azure DevOps - with automated testing, linting, drift detection, and policy enforcement baked in. 

Security & Compliance Automation Automate CIS benchmark enforcement, vulnerability remediation, and infrastructure hardening. Integrate with CyberArk, AWS Secrets Manager, and SSM Parameter Store. Implement policy-as-code using OPA, Gatekeeper, or Conftest. Automate certificate lifecycle management end to end. 

Observability & Auto-Remediation Connect automation workflows to New Relic and LogicMonitor for telemetry-driven triggers. Build self-healing routines that detect, diagnose, and resolve incidents automatically. Convert operational runbooks into fully automated diagnostic workflows to cut MTTR significantly. 

ITSM Integration Integrate automation into SymphonyAI-driven ticketing, approval flows, CMDB updates, and change management processes. Build operational runbooks that map directly to ITSM workflows. 

________________________________________

What We Are Looking For

• 8+ years of hands-on infrastructure automation experience in enterprise environments

• Expert-level Ansible engineering - advanced Jinja2 templating, dynamic inventory, custom module development

• Strong Kubernetes and Helm expertise - chart authoring, multi-environment lifecycle management

• Deep Terraform knowledge - reusable module design, remote state, CI/CD integration

• Proficiency in Python, Bash, or PowerShell for automation scripting

• Solid AWS architecture knowledge - serverless patterns, IAM design, multi-account networking

________________________________________

Bonus Points

GitOps with ArgoCD or Flux · OPA / Gatekeeper / Conftest · Multi-account AWS automation · Service mesh (Istio / Linkerd) · IaC testing with Molecule, Terratest, Checkov, or tfsec · AWS cost optimization automation

________________________________________

Why Join

• Own automation end to end - not just a piece of it

• Replace reactive, manual operations with intelligent, self-healing systems

• Work across cloud, security, infrastructure, and platform engineering

• Build patterns and frameworks the entire engineering org will adopt

• Directly reduce MTTR, improve security posture, and accelerate cloud maturity

Please share your resume and LinkedIn i'd as well

Looking forward to your response

data.title: Manager, Enterprise Systems Engineering
data.description:
OpenGov is the leader in AI and ERP solutions for local and state governments in the U. S. More than 2, 000 cities, counties, state agencies, school districts, and special districts rely on the OpenGov Public Service Platform to operate efficiently, adapt to change, and strengthen the public trust. Category-leading products include enterprise asset management, procurement and contract management, accounting and budgeting, billing and revenue management, permitting and licensing, and transparency and open data. These solutions come together in the OpenGov ERP, allowing public sector organizations to focus on priorities and deliver maximum ROI with every dollar and decision in sync. Learn about OpenGov's mission to power more effective and accountable government and the vision of high-performance government for every community at OpenGov. com. 

OpenGov is seeking a Manager, Enterprise Systems Engineering to lead our enterprise systems engineering function in Pune - a player-coach role that combines hands-on ownership of complex integrations with people leadership. You'll remain deeply technical, designing and owning integrations across our enterprise application stack (Okta, Google Workspace, Slack, NetSuite, Workday, and Salesforce via API) alongside your team, while managing, coaching, and growing the systems engineers who build them. You'll partner closely with Enterprise Technology leadership and cross-functional stakeholders in shaping technology decisions. 

Based in Pune, working closely with US and India-based teams across time zones. 

Position Responsibilities

- Remain hands-on in the design, build, and ownership of complex integrations across enterprise applications (Okta, Google Workspace, Slack, NetSuite, Workday) and Salesforce using REST, GraphQL, and SOAP APIs
 - Manage, coach, and develop a team of enterprise systems engineers, owning performance management, career growth, and hiring
 - Lead project planning and execution across enterprise systems integration initiatives, ensuring on-time delivery and clear stakeholder communication
 - Partner with stakeholders across R&D, GTM, Finance, HR, Security, and IT to prioritize the roadmap and align it to business needs
 - Serve as a key voice - alongside Enterprise technology leadership - in shaping technology decisions, integration patterns, and engineering best practices. 
 - Establish and improve team processes, documentation standards, and operational rigor to support long-term platform stability
 - Serve as a technical escalation point for complex integrations and systems issues
 - Facilitate agile ceremonies for the team, including sprint planning, backlog grooming, and retrospectives, to keep delivery predictable and visible

Required

Position Qualifications

- 8+ years in enterprise systems engineering, IT systems engineering, or business systems administration, with hands-on multi-platform integration experience
 - Experience managing or leading technical teams, including performance management and career development
 - Demonstrated experience building integrations using REST, GraphQL, and/or SOAP APIs across different systems, with strong understanding or functional knowledge of scripting languages such as Python
 - Hands-on experience with one or more of: Okta, Google Workspace, Slack, NetSuite, Workday, and Salesforce
 - Strong project management skills, with experience planning and delivering cross-functional technical initiatives
 - Strong understanding of IAM concepts and access governance across SaaS platforms
 - Comfortable using AI-native tools to accelerate workflows and improve efficiency
 - Strong written and verbal communication skills

Preferred

 - Experience managing a distributed team across US and India time zones
 - Experience facilitating Agile/Scrum ceremonies, including sprint planning, backlog grooming, and retrospectives
 - Working understanding of serverless technologies such as AWS Lambda or equivalent

Why OpenGov?

A Mission That Matters. 

At OpenGov, public service is personal. We are passionate about our mission to power more effective and accountable government. Government that operates efficiently, adapts to change, and strengthens public trust. Some people say this is boring. We think it's the core of our democracy. 

Opportunity to Innovate

The next great wave of innovation is unfolding with AI, and it will impact everything-from the way we work to the way governments interact with their residents. Join a trusted team with the passion, technology, and expertise to drive innovation and bring AI to local government. We've touched 2, 000 communities so far, and we're just getting started. 

A Team of Passionate, Driven People

This isn't your typical 9-to-5 job; we operate in a fast-paced, results-driven environment where impact matters more than simply clocking in and out. Our global team of 800+ employees is united in our commitment to challenge the status quo. OpenGov is headquartered in San Francisco and has offices in Atlanta, Boston, Chicago, Dubuque, Dallas, and Pune. 

A Place to Make Your Mark

We pride ourselves on our performance-based culture, where every employee is encouraged to jump in head-first and take action to help us improve. If you have a great idea, we want to hear it. Excellent performance is recognized and rewarded, and we love to promote from within.

Job Description: 

Required Experience: 14-20 Years

Team Management- Yes

Key Relationships: Product, Delivery, Architecture, Security, DevOps / SRE

A senior role accountable for target architecture, engineering practices and delivery governance across a polyglot engineering platform spanning React, TypeScript, Node. js, NestJS, MongoDB/Mongoose, GraphQL Federation, Kafka, Python/FastAPI and n8n-based automation. You set target architecture and engineering standards, and stay close enough to the code to assure designs you approve. You own identity, data, event-driven and AI-assisted engineering architecture, translating strategy into a funded roadmap for the engineering team and its sub-pods. 

Key Responsibilities: 

- Define the target technical architecture for the platform, including architecture principles, reference patterns, and the roadmap from current to target state. 
 - Govern architecture decisions through documented decision records, design review, and conformance checkpoints, escalating material trade-offs for approval. 
 - Architect the React/TypeScript frontend, covering component structure, state management, performance budgets, and accessibility standards. 
 - Direct backend service architecture in Node. js/TypeScript (NestJS), including service boundaries, API contracts, resilience patterns, and versioning strategy. 
 - Define the data architecture across MongoDB, covering schema and access-pattern design, indexing strategy, data lifecycle, and integrity controls. 
 - Own the GraphQL Federation architecture: supergraph composition, subgraph boundaries, schema contracts, entity resolution, and breaking-change policy. 
 - Establish event-driven architecture on Kafka, defining topic and event contract design, partitioning, delivery semantics, and schema evolution rules. 
 - Set the identity and access architecture, covering authentication and authorization flows, token handling, session policy, and least-privilege service access. 
 - Guide the Python/FastAPI service architecture, defining where it is the correct tool, its contract and packaging conventions, and its integration with the wider platform. 
 - Scope and constrain n8n usage to workflow automation and integration orchestration, defining the guardrails that distinguish automation workflows from engineered application services. 
 - Own the AI architecture, covering model integration and routing, prompt and tooling boundaries, evaluation criteria, and safety and cost controls. 
 - Assure evidence-based application readiness for Docker and Kubernetes, ensuring applications correctly consume platform-owned Helm charts and GitHub Actions pipelines rather than duplicating them. 
 - Set runtime performance and observability standards, including Azure Cache for Redis caching patterns and Application Insights instrumentation, tracing, and alerting. 
 - Partner with the engineering team and its sub-pods to raise engineering practices, embed the testing strategy across unit, integration, contract, and end-to-end layers, and sustain predictable delivery flow. 

Must Have Skills: 

- Proven technical leadership of an engineering team at Lead Technical Architect or Principal Architect scope. 
 - Deep expertise in TypeScript, React, Node. js, NestJS, MongoDB/Mongoose and Web Components/micro-frontends. 
 - GraphQL schema design and federated graph architecture (GraphQL Federation), including subgraph composition and contract versioning. 
 - Experience with event-driven architecture using Kafka, Schema Registry and Avro, including schema evolution and compatibility governance. 
 - Experience with identity and access architecture: OAuth2/OIDC, Okta, service-account token exchange and ABAC. 
 - Working knowledge of Python/FastAPI in a polyglot service environment. 
 - Experience integrating AI capabilities in production systems, including Azure OpenAI and Anthropic model routing, with attention to prompt governance, token-cost control and PII safeguards. 
 - Strategy and architecture governance in a cross-functional environment. 
 - Cloud-native, distributed systems design with deployment readiness ownership for Docker/Kubernetes applications consuming platform-owned Helm/GitHub Actions. 
 - Demonstrable accountability for delivery, reliability and security outcomes. 
 - Established testing and quality practice across Jest, React Testing Library, Playwright and pytest. 
 - Track record of establishing engineering practices and architecture governance that scale across a complex organization. 

Strongly Preferred / Nice to Have: 

- TOGAF certification or equivalent structured architecture practice. 
 - Kubernetes, Docker, Infrastructure as Code and DevSecOps experience beyond core application readiness. 
 - Legacy modernization and platform re-architecture at scale. 
 - Platform engineering or SRE practice - service level objectives, observability and operational resilience beyond core responsibilities. 
 - Prior integration delivery against Media ocean Prisma or comparable media buying and finance platforms.

The candidate will build, lead and develop a team of structural engineers and designers, combining hands-on technical authority in STAAD modelling and code compliance with people leadership, project coordination and client-facing accountability. 

Key Responsibilities: 

Design and Analysis of Mounting Structures: 

- Lead the design and analysis of solar mounting structures using STAAD, ensuring structural integrity, safety and compliance with applicable codes. 
 - Oversee load analysis, including wind, seismic and snow loads, for project locations across India and, where applicable, to Eurocode or U. S. standards. 
 - Drive design optimisation for structural stability, durability and cost efficiency based on site-specific requirements, and coordinate foundation inputs with geotechnical and civil teams. 

Code Compliance, Quality and Documentation: 

- Ensure designs comply with Indian standards (IS 800, IS 801, IS 456, IS 875) and relevant wind and seismic guidelines; apply Eurocodes and American standards (ASCE 7, AISC) for projects outside India. 
 - Review and approve structural analysis reports, engineering drawings and specifications, and run quality checks and peer reviews to ensure accuracy and safety. 
 - Keep design practices current with industry trends, material advancements and best practices for solar structures. 

Project Coordination and Stakeholder Management: 

- Act as the structural point of contact for project teams, clients and vendors, incorporating site-specific needs and client specifications. 
 - Support field teams and resolve on-site structural issues promptly; coordinate with electrical, procurement and manufacturing teams for seamless project integration. 

Team Leadership and Management: 

- Hire, onboard and develop a team of structural engineers and designers; build a clear structure, roles and succession within the team.

Engineering Manager (Python/Django)

MishiPay - Global POS / Checkout Technology

Competitive basic salary and bonus

Bangalore (office based plus 36 WFH days a year)

Unlimited Holidays

About Us

MishiPay is a global leader in next-generation checkout technology, enabling seamless in-store purchases via shoppers' own smartphones or our minimalist, low capex kiosks. 

We provide a complete checkout ecosystem - spanning self-checkout, Mobile POS, Click & Collect and traditional tills - allowing retailers to run their entire store checkout operation on MishiPay. 

Our technology reduces operating costs, increases basket size and visit frequency, lowers abandonment, and unlocks rich, real-time customer data - delivering both immediate commercial impact and deeper insight into the in-store customer journey. 

We now have major international retail customers in the UK, Europe, Middle East and the USA, and we're expanding!

About The Role

We are growing rapidly and are looking for a hands-on Engineering Manager to lead a critical engineering team from our tech hub in Bangalore. This team is at the heart of our business, responsible for both our core product engineering and the strategic customization and integration of our platform for major global clients. 

This is a technical leadership role where you will split your time between managing the team and contributing as a senior developer. We expect you to spend roughly 60-70% of your time on hands-on coding, technical design, and solving complex client integration challenges. 

We'd like to speak to you if you have strong Python and Django skills, you've been a Founding or early stage member of a startup and you are happy to code and lead. These requirements are essential. 

Roles and Responsibilities: 

Technical Leadership & Architecture: 

- Lead system design and technical architecture for both product features and client customizations, creating Entity Relationship Diagrams (ERD), system architecture diagrams, and API specifications. 
 - Develop comprehensive Technical Specification Documents and Solution Design Documents based on Statement of Work (SoW) requirements. 
 - Act as a hands-on technical authority; conduct code reviews, contribute to critical path development, and troubleshoot complex production issues. 
 - Architect, design, and guide the implementation of scalable, resilient, and secure services using Python, Django, and Django REST Framework. 
 - Lead our cloud infrastructure strategy on Microsoft Azure, with deep hands-on expertise in Kubernetes (AKS) for container orchestration, scaling, and management. Hands-On Execution & Delivery: 

- As a contributing developer, you will design, write, test, and deploy code for critical services, client-specific features, and integration endpoints. 
 - Explore and integrate modern technologies, including generative AI and machine learning services, to build smarter, more adaptive retail solutions. 
 - Estimate effort, define project timelines, and manage technical delivery from conception through completion. 
 - Lead the end-to-end delivery of complex projects, from core platform features to high-priority client customizations. 
 - Drive the adoption of best practices in software engineering, including CI/CD, automated testing, observability, and SRE principles. Client Solutions & Customization: 

- Architect and implement scalable solutions for client-specific requirements, creating detailed technical documentation for both internal and client stakeholders. 
 - Lead the technical delivery of client integrations, working directly with client technical teams when necessary. 
 - Design and build robust, configurable systems that can be tailored for different retail environments without requiring one-off code forks. Team Leadership & Process Excellence: 

- Lead, mentor, and grow a high-performing team of software engineers. 
 - Foster a culture of innovation by encouraging the experimentation with and adoption of AI-powered development tools to improve code quality, testing, and system reliability. 
 - Utilize a data-driven approach to improve team performance and system reliability through DORA metrics and Service Level Objectives (SLOs). 
 - Manage team capacity and allocation across the dual streams of product roadmap and client commitments. 
 - Manage project priorities, track risks and blockers, and ensure transparent communication with all stakeholders. 

About You

As well as your startup/co-Founding experience and your ability to inspire, lead, mentor and code, you'll also have:

Why MishiPay?

You'll work with an ambitious and inspirational multi-cultural team who are redefining the retail industry globally. 

We offer a tight-knit, collaborative and exciting work environment, coupled with the opportunity to see the apps you develop put to use in some of the world's largest retailers. 

We also offer:

data.title: Senior Manager, Software Engineering - Browse and Discovery Platform
data.description:
Teamwork makes the stream work.   

Roku is changing how the world watches TVRoku is the #1 TV streaming platform in the U. S. , Canada, and Mexico, and we've set our sights on powering every television in the world. Roku pioneered streaming to the TV. Our mission is to be the TV streaming platform that connects the entire TV ecosystem. We connect consumers to the content they love, enable content publishers to build and monetize large audiences, and provide advertisers unique capabilities to engage consumers. 

From your first day at Roku, you'll make a valuable - and valued - contribution. We're a fast-growing public company where no one is a bystander. We offer you the opportunity to delight millions of TV streamers around the world while gaining meaningful experience across a variety of disciplines. 

  

What does the team work on?Roku pioneered streaming to the TV and continues to innovate and lead the industry. As we strive to influence the future of television globally, including TV advertising, the ongoing success depends heavily on our investment in the Content Management System. With Roku providing millions of movies, episodes, news, and channels, the Content Management System plays a vital role in managing content ingestion, selection, enrichment, and curation. We are seeking engineers capable of developing, designing, and deploying highly scalable, dependable applications, tools, and automation frameworks essential for efficiently handling the vast volume of content in our pipeline. 

  

What is the role?As a Senior Manager of Software Engineering on the Browse and Discovery Platform team, you will own engineering for featured experiences and lead key components of the browse platform. You will lead and grow a team of backend engineers building the services and APIs that connect content, product capabilities, and user experiences across Roku devices. This role requires strong technical leadership in distributed systems, cloud services, and backend architecture, paired with the ability to translate evolving product requirements into reliable, scalable solutions. You will define technical direction, guide architectural decisions, and collaborate with cross-functional partners to deliver new experiences from concept through launch. The successful candidate will balance product delivery with long-term platform development while developing engineers and promoting a culture of technical excellence, collaboration, and accountability. 

  

How will I use AI at Roku?At Roku, we don't just use AI, we work with it. AI agents and smart tools help power drafts, analysis, and repetitive workflows, while our people bring direction, judgment, and accountability. We're looking for curious, adaptable builders who can show how they've used AI or automation to move faster, raise the bar, and scale their impact. 

We value your AI skills if you have built fluency across the agentic engineering toolchain - coding harnesses like Claude Code or Cursor, MCP servers, custom skills, or agent frameworks. And you can describe projects where you shipped real work with these tools. You know how to drive an agent, verify its output, and ramp on an unfamiliar codebase with an agent helping you. 

  

What are the responsibilities of the role?
 - Lead and manage a team of backend engineers, providing guidance, mentorship, and support to foster professional growth and development
 - Own the technical roadmap and delivery of featured experiences and key browse platform services, from design and implementation through launch and ongoing operation
 - Architect and evolve highly available, distributed services and APIs that support content discovery and engaging user experiences at scale
 - Build reusable capabilities for configuring, publishing, scheduling, and delivering featured experiences across Roku devices
 - Collaborate with product management, design, client engineering, and content teams to define requirements, manage dependencies, and deliver new capabilities
 - Drive improvements in service reliability, performance, observability, and operational efficiency while enabling experimentation and rapid product iteration
 - Define and enforce engineering best practices, coding standards, and development processes to ensure high-quality software delivery
 - Conduct performance evaluations, set clear objectives, and provide mentorship to foster professional growth and development across the team
 - Work closely with senior leadership to align engineering efforts with overall business objectives and timelines  What experience would help someone be successful in this role at Roku?
 - 10+ years of software development experience with deep technical expertise in building high-availability, large-scale distributed systems and services
 - 5+ years of experience in a leadership or management role, overseeing engineering teams and driving software development projects from conception to delivery
 - Proven track record of building and managing high-performing engineering teams
 - Strong proficiency in Java or a similar backend programming language, with experience designing and developing APIs and cloud-based services
 - Deep understanding of backend technologies, architecture patterns, and best practices, including microservices, RESTful APIs, message queues, caching, and databases
 - Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud Platform
 - Experience operating production services at scale, including performance optimization, observability, and incident response
 - Strong ability to make practical trade-offs and drive programs with autonomy
 - Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across cross-functional teams
 - Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or equivalent experience
 What's Roku's approach to hybrid working?Roku fosters an inclusive and collaborative environment where teams generally work in the office Monday through Thursday. Fridays are generally flexible for remote work, except for employees whose specific roles or assigned office location require five days' a week attendance. 

  

What are some of the benefits?Roku is committed to offering a diverse range of benefits as part of our compensation package to support our employees and their families. Our comprehensive benefits include global access to mental health and financial wellness support and resources. Local benefits include statutory and voluntary benefits which may include healthcare (medical, dental, and vision), life, accident, disability, commuter, and retirement options (401(k)/pension). Employees are supported in taking time off, in accordance with local leave policies and other personal needs to support their evolving work and life needs. It's important to note that not every benefit is available in all locations or for every role. For details specific to your location, please consult with your recruiter. 

  

AccommodationsRoku welcomes applicants of all backgrounds and provides reasonable accommodations and adjustments in accordance with applicable law. If you require reasonable accommodation at any point in the hiring process, please direct your inquiries to EmployeeRelations@Roku. com. 

  

What should I know about Roku's culture?Roku is a great place for people who want to work in a fast-paced environment where everyone is focused on the company's success rather than their own. We try to surround ourselves with people who are great at their jobs, who are easy to work with, and who keep their egos in check. We appreciate a sense of humor. We believe a fewer number of very talented folks can do more for less cost than a larger number of less talented teams. We're independent thinkers with big ideas who act boldly, move fast and accomplish extraordinary things through collaboration and trust. In short, at Roku you'll be part of a company that's changing how the world watches TV. 

We have a unique culture that we are proud of. We think of ourselves primarily as problem-solvers, which itself is a two-part idea. We come up with the solution, but the solution isn't real until it is built and delivered to the customer. That penchant for action gives us a pragmatic approach to innovation, one that has served us well since 2002. 

To learn more about Roku, our global footprint, and how we've grown, visit https: //www. weareroku. com/factsheet. 

By providing your information, you acknowledge that you want Roku to contact you about job roles, that you have read Roku's Applicant Privacy Notice, and understand that Roku will use your information as described in that notice. If you do not wish to receive any communications from Roku regarding this role or similar roles in the future, you may unsubscribe at any time by emailing WorkforcePrivacy@Roku. com.

Senior Staff Software Engineer - Full Stack & AI-Assisted Engineering

Company : KAVIA AI

Location : India - Remote

Type: Full-time

About KAVIA AIKAVIA AI is an enterprise software engineering platform for complex codebases. We help engineering teams understand existing software and move from requirements and specifications through implementation, review, and validation. 

The RoleThis is a senior individual contributor role with technical leadership responsibilities. You will work closely with engineering and product leadership and collaborate with our customer solutions team to turn real engineering problems into reliable product capabilities. 

We value engineers who can improve an existing system, explain their decisions, and demonstrate that their changes work. You should be comfortable moving between user experience, APIs, data, infrastructure, and production troubleshooting while knowing when to involve a specialist. 

What You'll Do

End-to-End Ownership & Architecture
 - Own delivery end to end: Translate product needs into technical designs, implementation plans, reviewable changes, tests, and production releases. 
 - Improve existing systems: Diagnose unfamiliar codebases, simplify architecture, reduce technical debt, and migrate components safely. 
 - Technical leadership & founder collaboration: Partner directly with founders to define architecture, strategy, and engineering quality standards across the company. Stack & System Engineering
 - Build across the stack: Develop intuitive web interfaces, backend services, APIs, integrations, and data models. 
 - Strengthen the enterprise platform: Build and improve tenant isolation, authorization, secure integrations, asynchronous workflows, and operational controls. 
 - Core AI platform engineering: Design and implement knowledge graphs, LLM-powered orchestration agents, lifecycle traceability, and CI/CD/testing automation. AI Coding Agent Integration
 - Use AI coding agents effectively: Plan and delegate bounded tasks, provide relevant context, inspect generated changes, and validate results. Remain accountable for architecture, security, correctness, and maintainability. 
 - Model evolution resilience: Design AI architectures that are resilient to underlying model evolution and vendor changes across open and closed-source LLMs. Enterprise Platform, Quality & Operations
 - Measure performance and reliability: Use profiling, query plans, load tests, logs, and production telemetry to identify bottlenecks and verify improvements. 
 - Contribute to cloud operations: Improve infrastructure as code, CI/CD, observability, release safety, rollback procedures, and cloud cost efficiency. 
 - Raise engineering quality: Mentor colleagues through code review, technical discussions, reusable tooling, and clear documentation. 
 - Production operations & incident management: Participate in incident response, root-cause analysis, and post-incident improvements for mission-critical enterprise systems. 
 - Security, compliance & procurement readiness: Ensure architecture meets enterprise trust, compliance (e. g. , SOC 2), procurement, and cloud marketplace expectations. 
 - Learn from customer use: Partner with customer solutions engineers to reproduce difficult issues, validate workflows on representative codebases, and translate recurring needs into product improvements. What We're Looking For

Required
 - Substantial experience building, releasing, and supporting production software, including ownership of complex features or services. 
 - Strong hands-on skills in TypeScript/JavaScript and React, plus backend development in Node. js, Python, Go, Java, or a comparable language. 
 - Practical relational database expertise, including schema design, indexing, migrations, and query optimization; PostgreSQL experience is valuable. 
 - Strong backend engineering capabilities with Python (FastAPI a plus) alongside frontend framework expertise (React, Next. js). 
 - Experience designing and operating graph-based or highly relational data models at scale. 
 - Experience designing APIs and handling authentication, authorization, failure modes, and integration boundaries. 
 - Experience with cloud infrastructure, preferably AWS, containers, CI/CD, and infrastructure as code. 
 - A disciplined approach to automated testing, debugging, production incidents, and performance measurement. 
 - Practical use of AI coding assistants or agents, with examples of how you reviewed, corrected, tested, and safely delivered their output. 
 - Sound architectural judgment: you can explain trade-offs and choose solutions proportionate to the problem. 
 - Clear written and spoken English and experience working independently with distributed teams. 
 - A degree in computer science, engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience. Strong Plus
 - B2B SaaS, multi-tenant systems, enterprise access controls, or audit logging. 
 - Developer tools, code analysis, repository integrations, or engineering workflow automation. 
 - LLM APIs, agent orchestration, retrieval, model evaluation, or secure model integration. 
 - Familiarity with SaaS compliance requirements (e. g. , SOC 2), cloud marketplace listings, or enterprise procurement expectations. 
 - Redis, background jobs, queues, distributed systems, or long-running asynchronous tasks. 
 - Terraform, Kubernetes, contract testing, browser automation, or load testing. 
 - Modernizing legacy applications or contributing to open-source projects. What Success Looks Like

Within your first three months, you will have developed a working understanding of a significant product area, delivered an agreed improvement through release, established tests or measurements that demonstrate its quality, and documented the key decisions and operational considerations. 

Over time, your impact will show up in dependable delivery, measurable product improvements, fewer recurring failures, and stronger engineering practices across the team. 

Why Join KAVIA

- Help shape a product used to solve difficult enterprise software engineering problems. 
 - Combine deep engineering work with practical application of AI coding agents. 
 - Own significant technical decisions and see your work through to real-world use. 
 - Work remotely from India with a global team, with mutually agreed overlap for collaboration. How to ApplyPlease apply with your resume and a short note addressing the following: 

- A brief example of a production system you personally helped build or substantially improve, explaining your contribution and the outcome. 
 - An example of using AI coding agents, including how you validated the result. 
 - Your location, notice period, and compensation expectations. 

GitHub, portfolio, open-source contributions, and technical writing are welcome but optional. We understand that much enterprise engineering work is confidential; anonymized descriptions are sufficient. Please fill this form https: //docs. google. com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLScmKZungWRDa0HxePWtMnlKZATmsQP6fGJ5vOfTKKKjxSsFlg/viewform?usp=header

This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Specialist in Machine Learning Engineering based in India. 

As a Specialist in Machine Learning Engineering, you will help build, operate, and scale the infrastructure powering advanced AI services and applications. You will work at the intersection of Site Reliability Engineering, distributed systems, and machine learning infrastructure, ensuring that production AI workloads remain reliable, secure, scalable, and cost-efficient. Your responsibilities will span large-scale LLM inference, model serving, vector databases, and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) platforms. You will also drive automation, improve system observability, and optimize GPU resources to enhance performance and availability. Working closely with AI researchers, software engineers, and platform teams, you will contribute to the development of resilient AI infrastructure in a dynamic, hybrid multi-cloud environment. 

Accountabilities

You will take ownership of the reliability, performance, and operational excellence of critical AI infrastructure, helping ensure that large-scale machine learning services operate efficiently in production. Your work will combine hands-on engineering, automation, incident management, and cross-functional collaboration. 

- Operate, scale, and optimize multi-tenant LLM inference, model-serving, VectorDB/RAG, and Model Context Protocol (MCP) platforms across global cloud and GPU clusters. 
 - Establish and monitor Service Level Objectives (SLOs), Service Level Indicators (SLIs), automated health checks, and observability dashboards using tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, Splunk, and OpenTelemetry. 
 - Develop automation for deployment rollouts, autoscaling, canary releases, self-healing systems, and disaster recovery to reduce operational overhead. 
 - Optimize GPU utilization and inference performance by improving throughput, latency, model scheduling, batching, caching, and resource allocation using Kubernetes, vLLM, and Ray. 
 - Lead complex production incident responses, conduct root-cause investigations using methodologies such as 5 Whys, and implement long-term solutions to prevent recurring issues. 
 - Collaborate with AI researchers, product developers, and platform engineering teams to conduct production readiness reviews and ensure reliable service delivery. 
 - Participate in a sustainable on-call rotation and continuously improve operational practices, system resilience, and service availability. 

Requirements

The ideal candidate combines strong software engineering expertise with practical experience operating distributed, cloud-native systems in production environments. You should have a solid understanding of SRE principles, observability, and infrastructure automation, alongside an interest in the challenges of deploying and scaling modern AI workloads. 

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, with at least 5 years of relevant experience, or a Master's degree with at least 3 years of experience. 
 - At least 3 years of software development experience using Python, Go, or Java, particularly in building automation tools, infrastructure solutions, or production backend services. 
 - Strong experience operating distributed and containerized production systems using Kubernetes, microservices architectures, and CI/CD pipelines. 
 - Proven background in Site Reliability Engineering, production operations, distributed systems troubleshooting, and observability. 
 - Practical experience with monitoring and observability tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, Splunk, or OpenTelemetry. 
 - Working knowledge of at least one major cloud platform: AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud Platform (GCP). 
 - Hands-on experience with LLM inference and serving frameworks such as vLLM, TensorRT-LLM, Ray Serve, or KServe is highly desirable. 
 - Familiarity with GPU orchestration, capacity planning, model parallelism, and performance profiling. 
 - Experience managing vector databases, search engines, or distributed caching solutions such as Milvus, Pinecone, or Redis. 
 - Understanding of generative AI architectures, including RAG pipelines, model routing, Model Context Protocol (MCP), and agent runtimes. 
 - Experience designing highly available multi-region systems, automated remediation solutions, and chaos engineering practices is an advantage. 
 - Strong problem-solving, analytical, communication, and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively across multidisciplinary engineering teams. 

Benefits

- Fully remote working arrangement. 
 - Full-time employment opportunity. 
 - Opportunity to work on large-scale AI infrastructure and advanced generative AI technologies. 
 - Exposure to distributed systems, GPU computing, and modern machine learning platforms. 
 - Collaboration with experienced professionals across AI research, software development, and platform engineering.

data.title: FBS Agile Dev Team Member II - Guidewire and React Developer
data.description:
Job Summary

This position works with business stakeholders, solution engineers, product owners, UX designers, and Agile team members to develop, test, and deploy Guidewire PolicyCenter solutions and React-based digital applications. React development is a mandatory capability for this role. The developer uses foundational to intermediate Guidewire configuration and integration skills together with hands-on React, JavaScript or TypeScript, responsive user interface, REST API integration, and automated testing experience. Experience with Guidewire Jutro Digital Platform is a plus. The role follows established coding, design, accessibility, security, and delivery standards and delivers reliable working functionality each sprint with support and guidance from senior developers, solution engineers, or architects. 

Essential Job Functions

- Develops and modifies Guidewire PolicyCenter components and React-based web applications to deliver approved business and digital experience requirements
 - Interprets customer, business, and user experience needs and provides technical input into feasible application solutions and system design
 - Builds reusable React components, screens, forms, and workflows using modern JavaScript or TypeScript, HTML, CSS or SCSS, and approved component libraries
 - Integrates React applications with Guidewire and enterprise services using REST APIs, JSON payloads, and established authentication and authorization patterns
 - Codes and configures Guidewire programs, objects, components, and packaged software using established standards and conventions
 - Documents implementation details and performs quality checks on Guidewire configuration, React code, API integrations, test evidence, and supporting documentation
 - Delivers working functionality incrementally each sprint and modifies existing code or configuration to meet approved requirements
 - Performs detailed impact assessments across business processes, data, Guidewire applications, APIs, digital channels, and integrations; identifies and raises functional or technical risks
 - Creates unit and component tests and applies Test-Driven Development or Behavior-Driven Development practices where appropriate
 - Supports application implementation, release, environment troubleshooting, root cause analysis, and corrective actions across Guidewire and React components with guidance
 - Takes ownership of assigned deliverables, communicates status and impediments, and completes issue resolution in a timely manner

Requirements

Guidewire Technical Requirements

- Minimum 3 years of experience in software development, solution engineering, or a related technology field
 - Hands-on experience developing web applications using React and modern JavaScript; TypeScript experience is preferred
 - Working knowledge of React functional components, hooks, props, component composition, state management, routing, reusable design patterns, and front-end error handling
 - Experience with HTML5, CSS3, responsive web design, SCSS or CSS modules, browser developer tools, and cross-browser compatibility
 - Experience consuming REST APIs, handling asynchronous operations, processing JSON payloads, and displaying service data in React applications
 - Experience writing front-end unit and component tests using tools such as Jest and React Testing Library
 - Working knowledge of Node. js, npm, package management, dependency management, build tooling, linting, code formatting, and front-end CI/CD practices
 - Ability to apply accessibility, basic internationalization, performance, security, and responsive design practices to customer- and producer-facing applications
 - Ability to translate approved UX designs or design-system specifications into reusable and accessible React components
 - Experience with Guidewire Jutro Digital Platform or Jutro-based React applications is a plus

Agile Delivery and Collaboration

- Writes and refines user stories with clear technical tasks and acceptance criteria covering Guidewire, APIs, React, and integration changes; estimates work using relative sizing
 - Partners with the Product Owner, UX designers, and team members to confirm that implementation and acceptance tests reflect the intended functionality and user experience
 - Participates in PI Planning, Sprint Planning, backlog refinement, daily stand-ups, system demos, retrospectives, and Inspect and Adapt activities
 - Commits to team PI objectives and sprint goals, communicates progress and impediments, and owns assigned work items
 - Practices continuous exploration, continuous integration, and continuous deployment to support the Continuous Delivery Pipeline and DevOps
 - Demonstrates integrated PolicyCenter and React functionality to Product and Business Owners and supports iteration and PI System Demos
 - Actively develops T-shaped Guidewire and React skills, participates in Communities of Practice, shares knowledge, and contributes ideas for continuous improvement
 - Works effectively across development, testing, product, UX, architecture, and business partners to improve flow and transparency

Additional Qualifications

- Strong verbal communication, listening, writing, and collaboration skills, with the ability to adjust technical detail for the audience
 - Demonstrated problem-solving skills, including breaking down moderately complex issues, identifying root cause, comparing alternatives, and recommending a viable solution
 - Ability to use data to identify meaningful information, patterns, or conclusions and organize the steps needed to address an issue
 - Strong ownership and accountability for individual deliverables, including timely identification and correction of gaps
 - Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced environment with changing priorities and multiple assignments
 - Foundational knowledge of object-oriented and component-based programming, defensive coding, error handling, version control, databases, SQL, and integrated development environments
 - Working-level understanding of applications within the assigned domain and the flow of data between Guidewire, digital applications, and internal or external systems
 - Broad understanding of insurance concepts, terminology, products, and business processes
 - Ability to share knowledge, provide constructive feedback, and support others in areas of developing expertise

Education and Certification Requirements

- High school diploma or equivalent required; bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, information systems, or a related field preferred
 - Guidewire Configuration or Integration certification is preferred or expected based on assignment needs
 - Relevant React, JavaScript, TypeScript, cloud, or web development training or certification is preferred

Benefits

Competitive compensation and benefits package: 

- Competitive salary and performance-based bonuses
 - Comprehensive benefits package
 - Career development and training opportunities
 - Flexible work arrangements (remote and/or office-based)
 - Dynamic and inclusive work culture within a globally renowned group
 - Private Health Insurance
 - Pension Plan
 - Paid Time Off
 - Training & Development

Note: Benefits differ based on employee level. 

About Capgemini

Capgemini is a global leader in partnering with companies to transform and manage their business by harnessing the power of technology. The Group is guided everyday by its purpose of unleashing human energy through technology for an inclusive and sustainable future. It is a responsible and diverse organization of over 340, 000 team members in more than 50 countries. With its strong 55-year heritage and deep industry expertise, Capgemini is trusted by its clients to address the entire breadth of their business needs, from strategy and design to operations, fueled by the fast evolving and innovative world of cloud, data, AI, connectivity, software, digital engineering and platforms. The Group €22. 5 billion in revenues in 2023. 

https: //www. capgemini. com/us-en/about-us/who-we-are/
