data.title: Lead Engineer-Hardware Validation Coexistence (AI Glasses)
data.description:
Job Requirements

At Quest Global, it's not just what we do but how and why we do it that makes us different. With over 25 years as an engineering services provider, we believe in the power of doing things differently to make the impossible possible. Our people are driven by the desire to make the world a better place-to make a positive difference that contributes to a brighter future. We bring together technologies and industries, alongside the contributions of diverse individuals who are empowered by an intentional workplace culture, to solve problems better and faster. 

Key Responsibilities

We're looking for a Lead Hardware Validation Engineer to lead the AI Glasses System Coexistence validation team. You'll set the technical direction, lead a team of validation engineers, and be the main technical contact for customers and cross-functional stakeholders. Your team will make sure that the main subsystems in our wearable devices (Camera, Audio, Wi-Fi/BT, Display, Sensors, Memory and Power) work together without one disrupting another. You'll also lead the team in using AI tools to speed up scripting, log analysis and failure triage. 

Key Responsibilities

Team Leadership

- Lead, mentor and grow a team of validation engineers: assign work, set priorities, review their output and support their careers. 
 - Plan the team's resources and staffing across several programs and build phases (EVT, DVT and PVT). 
 - Run regular team syncs, technical reviews and knowledge-sharing sessions. 
 - Build a team culture of ownership, technical rigor and continuous improvement. 
 - Help hire and onboard new team members. 

Customer & Stakeholder Communication

- Be the main technical contact with customers, program managers and engineering leadership for coexistence validation. 
 - Present validation plans, status, risks and results clearly in program reviews and customer meetings. 
 - Turn customer requirements and feedback into validation strategies and test plans. 
 - Manage expectations, escalations and trade-offs on schedule, coverage and quality. 
 - Write high-quality reports, executive summaries and closure documents for issues. 

Technical Ownership

- Set the overall coexistence validation strategy for AI Glasses programs. 
 - Define aggressor/victim test matrices and stress scenarios that reflect real use, such as camera capture during Wi-Fi streaming, or speaker playback during captouch use. 
 - Oversee concurrency testing and logging of victim-subsystem metrics (camera image quality, captouch false or missed touches, eMMC throughput and errors, RF sensitivity and desense, audio noise floor). 
 - Lead debugging and root-cause analysis of complex EMI, signal integrity, power integrity, thermal and vibration issues, working with the EE, RF, antenna, mechanical, firmware and software teams. 
 - Work with ODM and contract manufacturer partners on test setup, failure analysis and design changes. 
 - Review schematics and layouts to find coexistence risks early. 

AI-Driven Validation

- Lead the team's use of AI tools such as Claude / Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT, Cursor and Gemini for writing and debugging test automation scripts. 
 - Lead AI-assisted analysis of large device logs (logcat, dmesg/kernel, firmware and RF logs) to find failures, anomalies and coexistence patterns. 
 - Build AI-powered workflows that summarize test results, sort failures into categories, suggest likely root causes and draft bug reports. 
 - Set team standards for checking AI-generated output and for responsible data handling. 

We are known for our extraordinary people who make the impossible possible every day. 

Questians are driven by hunger, humility, and aspiration. We believe that our company culture is the key to our ability to make a true difference in every industry we reach. Our teams regularly invest time and dedicated effort into internal culture work, ensuring that all voices are heard. 

We wholeheartedly believe in the diversity of thought that comes with fostering a culture rooted in respect, where everyone belongs, is valued, and feels inspired to share their ideas. We know embracing our unique differences makes us better, and that solving the worlds hardest engineering problems requires diverse ideas, perspectives, and backgrounds. We shine the brightest when we tap into the many dimensions that thrive across over 21, 000 difference-makers in our workplace. 

Work Experience

Minimum Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics & Communication, Computer Engineering, or equivalent practical experience. 
 - 8+ years of experience in hardware, system or platform validation for consumer electronics, mobile or wearable devices. 
 - 3+ years of experience leading engineers in a technical lead or people lead role. 
 - Proven experience communicating directly with customers or external partners, including presenting technical results and handling escalations. 
 - Strong practical knowledge of EMI/EMC, RF desense, signal integrity and power integrity testing. 
 - Expert use of lab equipment such as oscilloscopes, spectrum analyzers, power analyzers, signal generators and protocol analyzers. 
 - Python scripting for test automation and data analysis. 
 - Hands-on experience with AI tools such as Claude, Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT, Cursor or Gemini for scripting and log analysis. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Master's degree in EE or a related field. 
 - Experience with wearables, AR/VR, smart glasses or other small, highly integrated devices. 
 - Familiarity with wireless technologies (Wi-Fi, Bluetooth/BLE, GNSS, NFC) and coexistence between them. 
 - Knowledge of camera, audio, display, touch and storage (eMMC/UFS) subsystems. 
 - Experience with Android or Linux-based embedded platforms, ADB and firmware debug tools. 
 - Experience building custom LLM workflows through APIs (for example, the Claude or OpenAI APIs) or with agent-style tools such as Claude Code or Cursor agent mode. 
 - Experience leading teams spread across sites or time zones, and managing ODM or vendor relationships through new product introduction. 
 - Experience setting up validation processes, metrics and dashboards for a whole team. 

Key Competencies

- Leads people and builds a strong team
 - Communicates clearly and confidently with customers and executives
 - Takes a systematic, data-driven approach to solving problems
 - Owns problems from first detection to fix
 - Looks for ways to use AI to make validation more productive
 - Stays effective while schedules and priorities change

Benefits

- Work on cutting-edge Next-generation consumer electronics hardware
 - Work on High-bandwidth data streaming solutions
 - Automated hardware validation and test infrastructure
 - Collaborate with world-class engineers and product teams. 
 - Opportunity to grow as a technical leader in a fast-paced, innovative environment.

 - Investigate Python errors, service failures and connectivity issues using logs and basic Linux/network tools; resolve assigned defects and escalate complex issues with useful diagnostics. 
 - Write unit and integration tests using pytest or unittest, mock external dependencies, and run checks through existing CI/CD pipelines.

 - Practical exposure to setting up, integrating, testing or supporting IoT devices, gateways or edge systems; willingness to work hands-on with lab hardware.

Desirable Skills

data.description:
Location - Sanand, GIDC

Website - www. eacengineer. com

Email- hr@eacengineer. com

Number- 9723552305

Job Summary

We are looking for a Quality Engineer with experience in pressure vessel and heat exchanger manufacturing. The candidate will be responsible for fabrication inspection, welding quality, material traceability, NDT coordination, and quality documentation in compliance with ASME Section VIII, Division 1 & 2, and applicable customer requirements. 

Key Responsibilities

- Carry out stage-wise quality inspections during the fabrication of pressure vessels, heat exchangers, and related equipment. 

- Review engineering drawings, material specifications, approved procedures, Inspection and Test Plans (ITPs), and Quality Assurance Plans (QAPs). 

- Perform incoming material inspection and verify Material Test Certificates (MTCs), material grades, identification, and traceability. 

- Conduct fit-up, dimensional, visual welding, and final inspections as per approved drawings and applicable code requirements. 

- Verify compliance with approved Welding Procedure Specifications (WPS), Procedure Qualification Records (PQR), and welder performance qualification records. 

- Ensure weld identification, material traceability, and inspection records are maintained throughout manufacturing. 

- Coordinate NDT activities, including RT, UT, MT, and PT, as required by the approved inspection plan and applicable code. 

- Monitor hydrostatic testing and other applicable pressure tests, ensuring approved procedures and safety requirements are followed. 

- Coordinate inspections with Authorized Inspection Agency (AIA) representatives, third-party inspectors, and customer inspectors, as applicable. 

- Prepare and maintain inspection reports, non-conformance reports (NCRs), corrective action records, and manufacturing quality documentation. 

- Support preparation and review of the final manufacturing data report and quality dossier, including applicable ASME documentation and the Manufacturer's Data Report (U-1 or applicable form). 

- Ensure inspection hold points and witness points are followed and properly released. 

- Identify quality issues, coordinate root cause analysis, and implement corrective and preventive actions to minimize rejection and rework. 

- Support ASME U Stamp-related quality activities in accordance with the company's Quality Control System (QCS) and applicable code requirements. 

- Coordinate with Production, Engineering, Procurement, and Project teams to resolve quality-related issues and ensure timely inspection clearance. 

Required Qualifications and Experience

- Diploma or Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering or a related discipline. 

- 5-8 years of relevant experience in pressure vessel, heat exchanger, or process equipment manufacturing. 

- Practical experience in fabrication quality control and inspection of welded pressure equipment. 

- Working knowledge of ASME Section VIII, Division 1, and applicable material and welding requirements. 

- Knowledge of welding inspection, WPS/PQR, welder qualifications, NDT, dimensional inspection, and material traceability. 

- Experience in quality documentation, ITP/QAP implementation, NCR handling, and final inspection. 

- Ability to read and interpret engineering drawings and technical specifications. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience working in an ASME U Stamp-certified manufacturing facility. 

- NDT Level II certification in applicable methods. 

- Welding inspection certification such as CSWIP or AWS-CWI. 

- Familiarity with ASME material traceability, pressure testing, and Manufacturer's Data Report documentation. 

- Knowledge of ISO 9001 Quality Management Systems.

data.title: Engineering Manager - Payments
data.description:
Overview 
As a part of expanding our Engineering team, we are looking for Engineering manager/s who will be responsible for keeping projects on track, solving technical issues that arise, communicating with other teams and acting as an overall leader for the team. He / She will be working on multiple projects at the same time, building and managing diverse teams of engineers from different disciplines (in-house & outsourced). 
To succeed, you need to possess a blend of strong leadership skills and technical depth in Payments. You will own the systems that move money between diners, restaurants and payment partners across multiple APAC markets, including payment acceptance, orchestration, settlement, reconciliation and merchant payouts. 
This role is for someone who understands why idempotency matters, what happens when a PSP times out mid-capture, and how a one-cent reconciliation break turns into a finance escalation. You will lead a team of in-house and outsourced engineers, partner closely with Product, Finance, Risk and Compliance, and stay close enough to the code to make sound technical calls. 

Key Responsibilities: • Payments Platform Ownership: Own the end-to-end payments stack including checkout, authorisation, capture, refunds, voids, chargebacks, settlement, and merchant payouts. Lead integrations, onboarding, and ecosystem management with PSPs, acquirers, and gateways such as Stripe, Adyen, and Airwallex, as well as local payment methods across APAC (e. g. , PayNow, GrabPay, QRIS, PromptPay, GCash). • Orchestration & Reconciliation: Drive payment orchestration and smart routing across payment rails (Stripe, Adyen, Airwallex) to improve authorisation rates, reduce costs, and enable failover during outages. Own transaction-level reconciliation, analytics, and reporting across our ledger, gateway/PSP dashboards, reports, and bank statements. • Reliability, Security & Compliance: Set high bars for uptime and correctness with idempotent APIs, clear state machines, and auditable ledgers. Ensure PCI DSS compliance, tokenisation, secure data handling, and partner with Risk/Compliance on 3DS, SCA, and fraud controls. data.title: Principal Software Engineer (Backend - C)
data.description:
Role

We are looking for a Principal Software Development Engineer to join our team. This is a Hybrid role, reporting to the Senior Manager, Software Development Engineering in the Data Protection department. 

In this position, you will serve as a premier technical leader, defining architectural direction, designing high-performance systems-level subsystems, and driving the engineering execution of our next-generation inspection capabilities. 

What you'll do (Role Expectations)

- Architect and implement high-performance DLP engines, dictionary compilers, and distributed incident processing pipelines, setting the benchmark for clean, highly optimized systems-level C code running in production proxy runtimes
 - Own the technical direction and architectural roadmap for line-rate pattern matching, regular expression evaluators, custom dictionary compilers, exact data match (EDM), and indexed document matching (IDM)
 - Help develop next-generation Data Loss Prevention (DLP) solutions utilizing Machine Learning (ML) models, collaborating with data science teams to successfully deploy and integrate models in high-throughput data paths while balancing inspection capabilities against strict network latency and resource constraints
 - Establish and enforce exacting architectural standards for multi-threaded C daemons on FreeBSD/Linux, designing robust shared memory structures, high-performance Inter-Process Communication (IPC), lockless concurrency, and memory-safe subsystems
 - Serve as the technical escalation authority for critical production issues-leading hands-on post-mortem core dump analysis, deep system profiling, and leak detection

What We're Looking for (Minimum Qualifications)

- Foundational understanding of AI/ML technologies and experience leveraging, securing, or positioning AI-driven solutions to optimize outcomes within your functional domain
 - 10+ years of experience with systems software engineering, including a proven track record of technical leadership (e. g. , as a Tech Lead or Principal Engineer) driving the design and delivery of high-performance backend platforms
 - Advanced hands-on proficiency in C programming on Linux or FreeBSD runtime environments, with deep architectural expertise in Inter-Process Communication (IPC) and shared memory architectures
 - Expert-level proficiency in production troubleshooting and root-cause analysis, including post-mortem core dump analysis, GDB/LLDB debugging, Valgrind, and system-level performance tracing
 - Proven track record of mentoring, guiding, and multiplying the impact of systems software engineers across the organization, championing engineering excellence, conducting rigorous design reviews, and fostering continuous technical growth

What Will Make You Stand Out (Preferred Qualifications)

- Proven ability to leverage AI technologies and workflows to drive measurable operational efficiency
 - Strong familiarity with Data Loss Prevention (DLP) technologies, including regex evaluation engines, custom dictionary compilers, and EDM (Exact Data Match) / IDM (Indexed Document Matching) profiles
 - Hands-on experience or familiarity with public cloud environments (specifically AWS and Azure), including deploying, optimizing, or maintaining performance-intensive cloud-native systems

data.title: Software Development Manager III, EU Off- Selection, EU International Technologies
data.description:
Description

Off-Amazon Selection (OAS) team aims to make worldwide selection discoverable and shoppable for its customers using large language models, and Agentic AI. In EU Off-Amazon Selection (EU OAS), we bring OAS to customers in Amazon's European stores building and owning OAS customer experiences and systems covering for multilingual, multi-currency and multi-country usecases within the constraints of EU regulatory setup. 

We are looking for a Software Development Manager to setup and lead the EU OAS engineering team in Hyderabad. As its founding manager, you will hire a full team comprising of software development, machine learning and support engineers, set the technical direction for EU OAS engineering, and lay its foundations. You will lead your team's work from the first launches to scale across Amazon's European stores, and take on more of OAS as the program grows in the coming years. 

You will build from scratch with a large platform team beside you. EU OAS is part of Localization group, whose platform processes tens of millions of products every day with machine translation, large language models and machine learning quality checks. You will reuse what already works at Amazon scale, partner with its engineers and scientists, and use that head start to make EU OAS bigger, faster. 

The problems are new and hard. Your team will build catalog, discovery and commerce systems that take in product information in many formats and levels of quality, decide what is accurate and eligible to show customers, match it to the Amazon catalog, and help customers discover, evaluate and buy it. 

If you want to build a team and a customer facing product from the start across 10 EU Stores, with the newest AI and a large platform behind you, we would love to talk to you. 

Key job responsibilities

- Hire, develop and lead the founding team, and set a high bar for every engineer you hire and grow. 
 - Own the technical vision, roadmap and architecture for your team's catalog, discovery and commerce systems, from the first launches to scale across Amazon's European stores. 
 - Build and run production systems that use large language models and AI at internet scale. 
 - Run the team AI-native from day one, with engineers using AI coding agents across design, coding, testing and operations. 
 - Own operational excellence, including on-call, health metrics that catch issues early, and regular operational reviews. 
 - Turn ambiguous problems that span teams and time zones into clear plans with owners and dates, and lead the designs, roadmaps and business reviews that set the team's direction. 

A day in the life

You might start the day reviewing the design for a service that checks product data for a new European store, then join a working session with scientists on how a large language model should match products to the Amazon catalog across languages. You will weigh in on architectural trade-offs, and sequence a multi-quarter roadmap against ambiguous requirements. You will invest in your people through 1: 1s, career conversations, hiring, and coaching. In the afternoon you hold one-on-ones and a hiring debrief, and review experiment results with product and science partners worldwide. 

About The Team

EU OAS sits in the larger Localization team that makes Amazon's selection available to customers in their own language across Amazon's stores. The new Hyderabad team will be the dedicated engineering team for EU OAS. Our program and operations teams already work in Hyderabad, and our engineering, science and product teams work from Luxembourg, Paris and other European cities. We build AI-native, with AI coding agents across design, coding and testing, and we build reusable building blocks so each launch makes the next one faster. 

Basic Qualifications

- 3+ years of engineering team management experience
 - 7+ years of engineering experience
 - 8+ years of leading the definition and development of multi tier web services experience
 - Knowledge of engineering practices and patterns for the full software/hardware/networks development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, certification, and livesite operations
 - Experience partnering with product or program management teams
 - Experience designing or architecting (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience in communicating with users, other technical teams, and senior leadership to collect requirements, describe software product features, technical designs, and product strategy
 - Experience in recruiting, hiring, mentoring/coaching and managing teams of Software Engineers to improve their skills, and make them more effective, product software engineers
 - Experience leading teams that build and run machine learning, large language model or agentic AI systems in production for large-scale catalog, search, discovery or e-commerce systems

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https: //amazon. jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you're applying in isn't listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

data.description:
Join our team and help shape the future of connectivity indoors and outdoors. Together, let's push the boundaries of technology and advance sustainable networks worldwide.

As an AI Automation Engineer, you will design, build, and run the LLM-powered and agentic systems that are changing how we work. You will ship production AI services that automate triage, classification, and decision support for our operations and support teams, and build the AI-driven SDLC tooling that makes our engineers faster-from custom coding-assistant skills and agents to automated evaluation and guardrails. 

This is a hands-on role where you are expected to pair strong backend engineering with practical GenAI skills. You will be based in Bangalore, Karnataka. 

You Will Make An Impact By

- Designing, building, and deploying LLM-powered and agentic workflows that automate triage, classification, and decision support for operational and support teams. 
 - Developing production-grade backend services in Python - REST APIs and async pipelines-with solid prompt engineering, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), and evaluation practices. 
 - Partnering with cross-functional stakeholders to turn ambiguous business problems into reliable, well-documented AI solutions. 
 - Building and maintaining AI-driven SDLC automation such as spec-to-code generation, AI-assisted code review, and automated test generation embedded in everyday engineering workflows. 
 - Developing and extending AI coding-assistant tooling for engineering teams, including Claude Code skills and plugins, custom agents, and reusable prompt templates. 
 - Designing evaluation frameworks and guardrails for AI-generated output, using golden datasets, automated and LLM-as-judge scoring, and regression suites so quality is measured, not assumed. 
 - Monitoring and improving model quality, reliability, latency, and cost through observability, guardrails, and feedback loops. 
 - Maximizing token yield without compromising quality by delivering more useful, accepted output per token spent, with every optimization backed by evals that prove quality holds. 
 - Optimizing multi-agent workflows for speed, cost, and token usage through context management, parallel execution, and prompt optimization. 
 - Cutting token waste with tight context curation, prompt caching, right-sized model routing, and concise structured outputs. 
 - Tracking token efficiency as a first-class metric including cost per successful task and tokens per accepted output while setting token budgets for agentic workflows. 
 - Owning the delivery lifecycle in a DevSecOps environment (CI/CD, containerization, and automated testing from first commit to production)
 - Applying secure-by-default practices to every service you ship, including secrets management, access control, and dependency scanning. 

Required Qualifications For Consideration

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Science, Electronics Engineering, or a related field. 
 - 3 to 5 years of professional software engineering experience, including at least 1 to 2 years building LLM-powered applications that run in production. 
 - Track record of taking AI features from prototype to production, with measurable impact on quality, speed, or cost. 
 - Hands-on experience with LLM APIs (Anthropic Claude, OpenAI) including prompt engineering, tool/function calling, and structured outputs. 
 - Practical experience building RAG systems: chunking, embeddings, vector databases (FAISS, Chroma, pgvector), hybrid search, and re-ranking. 
 - Experience with agent frameworks such as LangGraph, the Claude Agent SDK. 
 - Familiarity with LLM evaluation and guardrail techniques: golden datasets, LLM-as-judge, red-teaming, and mitigation of hallucination and prompt injection. 
 - Daily use of AI coding assistants such as Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, or Cursor. 
 - Strong Python skills, including asyncio, type hints, and testing with pytest. 
 - Experience designing REST APIs with frameworks such as FastAPI or Flask. 
 - Experience with async, event-driven pipelines and queues (e. g. , Celery, Kafka, Redis), plus working knowledge of SQL and NoSQL data stores. 
 - Experience with CI/CD (Jenkins, GitHub Actions, or GitLab CI), Docker, Kubernetes. 
 - Working knowledge of secrets management (e. g. , Vault, AWS Secrets Manager), role-based access control, and dependency and container scanning (e. g. , Snyk, Trivy). 
 - Experience with observability tooling (e. g. , OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, Grafana, Langfuse) for tracing, metrics, and cost tracking of LLM applications. 
 - Hands-on experience with a major cloud platform, preferably AWS. 

You Will Excite Us If You

- Have experience building AI for IT operations or customer support
 - Are experienced in reducing LLM cost and latency at scale through prompt caching, model routing, batching, and context compression
 - Have applied AI tooling to large C/C++ codebases.

Bangalore, IND

data.title: Principal Platform Software Engineer
data.description:
Job Description

Leads platform projects crossing multiple teams, evolving runtimes or middleware patterns for interoperability and multi-tenant scale. Diagnoses and resolves complex cross-service issues; enforces versioning, compatibility, and safe rollout practices. Drives observability standards, capacity planning, and resilience patterns across several workloads. Produces migration guides and adoption playbooks that raise ecosystem consistency and developer experience. 

Responsibilities

Short Description

We're looking for exceptional engineers to join our team, with a strong foundation in distributed systems, microservices architecture, and modern technologies. This role presents a unique opportunity to design and build innovative, cloud-centric applications from scratch, and make a significant impact on our technical and business strategies. You'll enjoy autonomy and ownership in your work, and be part of a team that values diversity, inclusivity, and creativity. Our dynamic and flexible work environment is designed to support and encourage you to excel, and thrive in a culture that fosters innovation and growth. 

Description

About Us: 

At Oracle, we are transforming healthcare by modernizing Electronic Health Record (EHR) systems to empower front-line healthcare professionals. Our mission is to enable them to focus more on patient care and less on administrative tasks, achieving peak efficiency with the support of generative AI and modernized applications. By leveraging the power of generative AI and state-of-the-art applications, we aim to enhance efficiency and effectiveness in healthcare delivery. Our approach to modernization includes investing in cutting-edge AI capabilities, advancing user experience, and offering open APIs that enable customers and third parties to develop innovative, integrated solutions. We are dedicated to creating a seamless and intuitive healthcare experience that benefits patients, providers, payers, and the entire healthcare ecosystem. 

Our Mission: At Oracle Health, we prioritize humans in the healthcare experience-for patients, providers, payers, and the population. We advance healthcare and population-level health by making cutting-edge solutions practical and effective at the practitioner level. Our goal is to enable patients to receive care from anyone, anywhere, on any device by providing practitioners with comprehensive medical information. 

As a Principal Application Software Engineer on our team, you'll be responsible for and will lead efforts in designing and building scalable, distributed, and resilient software components and services to support health care platform, applications, and our end users. We believe in ownership and expect you to think long term, mentor, and empower other engineers. 

Qualifications and Experience: 

Technical Skills: 

- BS degree in Computer Science or related field (MS preferred) 
 - 10+ years distributed service engineering experience in a software development environment 
 - Expert in Java and an exceptional problem solver 
 - Deep understanding of object-oriented design and SDK development, specifically within a cloud environment 
 - Strong skills in data structures, algorithms, operating systems, and distributed systems fundamentals. 
 - Experience working closely with architects, principals, product and program managers to deliver product features on time and with high quality. 
 - Working familiarity with networking protocols (TCP/IP, HTTP) and standard network architectures. 
 - Experience with containers and container orchestration technologies (Kubernetes, Docker) 
 - Good understanding of databases, NoSQL systems, storage and distributed persistence technologies. 
 - Good understanding of Linux 
 - Demonstrable technical leadership and mentorship skills 
 - Knowledge of OCI or AWS, Azure, GCP, Public Cloud SaaS, PaaS Services and/or related technology is a plus 
 - Good to have hands-on experience designing, developing, and operating public cloud service control planes

Functional Skills: 

- Design and implement intuitive and seamless customer experiences. 
 - Proficiency in Agile methodologies, especially Scrum. 
 - Experience using ticket tracking systems such as JIRA. 
 - Ability to quickly translate wireframes into prototypes and production-ready interfaces. 
 - Quick learner with the ability to pick up new languages and technologies. 
 - Self-driven and able to work independently on projects, even as designs evolve. 
 - Passionate about learning and staying updated with new technologies and services. 
 - Strong communication skills, including cross-team collaboration. 
 - Ability to deliver basic functionality and iterate rapidly. 
 - Experience working with geographically distributed teams. 
 - Significant plus: Knowledge of healthcare and experience delivering healthcare applications.

data.title: Senior Core Infrastructure Engineer
data.description:
Job Description

The Security Central team builds and operates services that help OCI teams understand their security posture, identify risks, and drive remediation across cloud infrastructure. The Senior Core Infrastructure Engineer designs, implements, and optimizes distributed system components, backend services, data pipelines, and integrations with an emphasis on scalability, resiliency, and operability. 

The role includes owning features and service components from design through production, delivering load and performance tests, and using data plane platforms and distributed state tools for high-volume retrieval, storage, and processing. Responsibilities include building fault-tolerant paths through redundancy, replication, synchronization, and automatic failover; applying recovery-oriented design principles; and implementing retries, circuit breakers, and timeouts. 

Operational ownership includes proactively detecting and mitigating issues through tests, alarms, dashboards, and telemetry; authoring runbooks; and participating in incident response and root cause analysis. The role also involves developing automation and Infrastructure as Code for deployment, troubleshooting, and maintenance, and implementing security controls for encryption, access management, and remediation while meeting change management, compliance, and documentation standards. 

Close collaboration with security and engineering teams is essential to translate requirements into practical solutions. Contributions include technical design reviews, peer implementation reviews for scalability and reliability, and ongoing improvements to engineering and operational practices. 

This role is ideal for an engineer with strong software development fundamentals, experience with distributed systems, and an interest in building secure, reliable cloud services. 

Responsibilities

Key Responsibilities

System Design & Architecture - System Scalability: 

-Implements and contributes to the development for components of distributed systems that support horizontal and vertical scaling including leveraging distributed state management tools. 

-Optimizes code and/or systems for large-scale data processing in large-scale systems. 

-Implements scalability requirements for assigned components and reviews implementation of team members. 

-Leverages components of data plane platforms to handle large-scale data retrieval, storage, and processing. 

-Implements performance and load testing. 

System Design & Architecture - System Reliability Design: 

-Collaborates with team to build fault-tolerant components capable of withstanding in-service updates by implementing redundancy, replication, and automatic failover mechanisms. 

-Applies recovery oriented computing principles to design components that effectively handle service disruptions. 

-Implements retry mechanisms, circuit breakers, and timeouts to help handle network unreliability. 

System Design & Architecture - System Reliability Performance: 

-Implements tests and alarm configurations to proactively detect and address issues/failures. 

-Supports efforts to recover from failures by drafting and executing runbooks and operational procedures. 

-Builds and customizes dashboards, telemetry systems, and alerting mechanisms to monitor component health. 

System Design & Architecture - Correctness / Availability: 

-Designs and implements functional requirements and testing for assigned features within an existing system. 

-Implements tests scenarios (e. g. , fault-injection, brown-out) to evaluate system correctness. 

-Implements standard data replication and synchronization techniques to maintain data integrity and availability. 

Operational Troubleshooting & Incident Management: 

-Diagnoses, debugs, and resolves issues in system components to support ongoing operation. 

-Implements basic strategies to prevent interruptions, ensuring no maintenance windows are required for customers and users when resolving issues. 

-Designs and implements automation scripts and tooling used to troubleshoot operational issues. 

-Participates in operational support rotations, assisting in incident responses and root cause investigations. 

Compliance & Security: 

-Applies advanced security measures to protect data and applications in multi-tenant environments, including encryption and access controls. 

-Implements remediation plans to continuously improve security. 

-Collaborates with the team to ensure cloud infrastructure complies with relevant industry standards and regulations and that documentation is up-to-date

Automation & Change Management: 

-Maintains automation scripts and tools (e. g. , Infrastructure as Code (IaC)) for managing cloud infrastructure. 

-Adheres to change management plans for patching, updating, and rolling back applications. 

Core Responsibilities

Planning & Execution: 

-Track timelines with minimal supervision, ensuring work is completed in a timely manner and is in alignment with project requirements. 

-Prioritize and adjust work as resources or timelines change, with some guidance

Collaboration & Partnership: 

-Collaborates across teams to align on expectations and achieve shared objectives. Builds and maintains a comprehensive understanding of business, stakeholder, and/or customer needs to build and support effective partnerships. Actively listens to diverse perspectives and asks questions to ensure understanding of others. 

Problem Solving: 

-Independently identifies and addresses standard and non-standard issues in accordance with standard practices, escalating more complex issues as appropriate. Analyzes data and/or information from multiple sources to troubleshoot standard and non-standard errors. Contributes to knowledge sharing and best practices

Continuous Learning: 

-Embraces continuous learning by actively seeking to build knowledge and new skills and/or tools, and staying current with industry trends and best practices. Seeks out and leverages feedback and training to improve skills. Contributes to a culture of continuous learning and knowledge sharing with team members. . 

Continuous Improvement: 

-Develops ideas and recommends updates to increase the efficiency and effectiveness of processes, protocols, and workflows within a team. Seeks input from team members on alternative approaches and methods for improving work.

data.description:
Welcome to Natus Sensory India

We are continuing to grow our business in India and are now looking to expand our team there. Be part of this exciting journey right from the start!

We manufacture and distribute a range of medical device products used in the diagnosis of human disorders of sensory system and neural pathways. 

Job Function: Engineering

Job Family: Software Engineering

Job Overview

Design, implement, automate, and maintain CI/CD pipelines, build and release processes, infrastructure, and development environments that support medical device software across the software development lifecycle, in alignment with project objectives and established technical guidance. 

Ensure build, deployment, configuration management, and release activities are controlled, secure, traceable, and reproducible, and follow applicable Quality System procedures, design controls, regulatory expectations, and established DevOps and engineering practices. 

Responsibilities

At this role level the preferred candidate is fully proficient in most functional tasks and demonstrates a comprehensive understanding of their area of specialization. Responsibilities include collaborating with team members to solve complex problems, proactively identifying and addressing quality issues, and preventing potential disruptions within their scope of work. The individual is expected to document and present research, recommendations, and complex information in a clear and accessible manner to both internal and external audiences. 

- Contribute actively as a Scrum team member by participating in sprint planning, backlog refinement, estimation, reviews, retrospectives, and delivery of assigned DevOps, build, and release work. 
 - Collaborate with software, cybersecurity, release, and management stakeholders to define, implement, and continuously improve build, integration, deployment, and release workflows. 
 - Analyze DevOps and infrastructure requirements and translate them into secure, reliable, scalable, and maintainable pipeline, environment, and automation designs. 
 - Design, implement, maintain, and troubleshoot CI/CD pipelines using Jenkins and Azure DevOps Pipelines, including automated builds, static code analysis, automated test execution, code signing, installer packaging, and artifact publishing for C#/. NET applications. 
 - Administer and maintain Git repositories and workflows on GitHub, Azure Repos, or similar tools, including branching strategies, pull request policies, code review gates, tagging, versioning, and traceability between commits, work items, builds, and releases. 
 - Provision, configure, and maintain Microsoft Azure cloud resources and environments, such as App Services, Virtual Machines, Storage, Key Vault, Azure SQL, and networking, using infrastructure as code where applicable. 
 - Develop and maintain PowerShell, Bash, or Python scripts to automate builds, deployments, environment setup, diagnostics, and support activities, and maintain Jenkins nodes, build agents, and virtual test environments. 
 - Support deployment and configuration of SQL Server/database components as part of the release process, including migration scripts, backup/restore, environment refreshes, and data integrity checks. 
 - Implement and maintain monitoring, logging, and alerting using Azure Monitor, Application Insights, or similar tools to support system availability, performance, and incident troubleshooting. 
 - Apply DevSecOps practices, including secrets management, role-based access control, dependency and vulnerability scanning, and secure pipeline configuration, to support cybersecurity, patient data protection, and applicable regulatory or Quality System expectations. 
 - Work effectively across Agile and waterfall software development lifecycle models, adapting build, release, and documentation activities based on project needs and guidance. 
 - Create and participate in reviews of pipeline configurations, scripts, infrastructure changes, release documentation, and tool validation evidence to support high-quality, audit-ready deliverables. 
 - Support technical problem-solving, share DevOps knowledge and best practices with team members, and communicate effectively in an international engineering environment. 

B. E. /B. Tech/MCA or equivalent degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Software Engineering, or a related discipline, with at least 6 years in DevOps, build and release engineering, CI/CD, cloud infrastructure or related software engineering.

Join Natus Sensory today. Confidence in every Sense.

data.description:
Job Description

Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) builds high-performance GPU platforms for demanding AI, machine learning, and high-performance computing workloads. We are seeking a Senior Software Development engineer to join the Raw Metal Cloud (RMC) team and help deliver reliable, scalable AI infrastructure. 

RMC builds the software platform that manages the AI infrastructure lifecycle, from hardware onboarding and inventory through networking, provisioning, validation, rack certification, and customer handoff. Our work connects physical infrastructure with distributed orchestration services, enabling GPU capacity to become ready for customer workloads efficiently and reliably. 

As an IC4 engineer on the RMC team, you will own the design, development, and operate telemetry services supporting data center telemetry, device management, and hardware lifecycle automation. You will build reliable software that provides visibility into power, thermal, cooling, and device health conditions, helping teams detect issues and improve infrastructure readiness. Your work will help reduce manual intervention, improve infrastructure readiness, and increase the speed and predictability of GPU capacity delivery. 

As an IC4 engineer, you will independently own defined service components from design through production, collaborate with senior engineers on technical decisions, and deliver secure, scalable solutions supporting data center deployments.

- Experience with OCI or another cloud platform, object storage, and infrastructure automation. 
 - Familiarity with telemetry pipelines, monitoring systems, time-series data, and alerting. 
 - Experience with hardware management interfaces or protocols such as ILOM, Redfish, gNMI, or MQTT.

Only Oracle brings together the data, infrastructure, applications, and expertise to power everything from industry innovations to life-saving care. data.description:
Description

When you attract people who have the DNA of pioneers and the DNA of explorers, you build a company of like-minded people who want to invent. And that's what they think about when they get up in the morning: how are we going to work backwards from customers and build a great service or a great product" - Jeff Bezos. Amazon. com's success is built on a foundation of customer obsession. 

Have you ever thought about what it takes to successfully deliver millions of packages to Amazon customers seamlessly every day like clock work? In order to make that happen, behind those millions of packages, billions of decisions get made by machines and humans. What is the accuracy of the customer provided address? Do we know exact location of the address on a Map? Is there a safe place to leave the package at? Can we make an unattended delivery? Would a signature be required? Is the address a commercial property? Do we know open business hours of the address? What if customer is not home? Is there an alternate delivery address? Does the customer have any special delivery preference? What are the other addresses that also have packages to be delivered on the same day? Are we optimizing the delivery associate's route? Does the delivery associate know the locality well enough? Is there an access code to get inside the building? And the list simply goes on. At the core of it all is the underlying data that can help make those decisions in time. The Last Mile Analytics and Quality (LMAQ) team capitalizes on Amazon's scale, speed, and ability to invent and simplify to accelerate the data flywheel and curate fresh and authoritative geospatial datasets to improve customer delivery experience. We work closely with tech and science teams on multiple initiatives to automate processes to operate at scale across all regions. 

Amazon is seeking an experienced leader to drive operations related to Maps and Navigation. As a Sr. Operations Manager with the Last Mile Analytics and Quality (LMAQ) Maps team, you will run manual operations for fixing and deep diving defects related to Maps and Routing managing large teams (700+ member teams). data.description:
DESCRIPTION

We are seeking a Quality Manager for our Amazon Logistics (AMZL) Last Mile Delivery Experience Team. 

The successful candidate has last mile logistics experience, an interest in and ability to work and think analytically, and manage all the aspects of multi-disciplinary projects and programs. 

Key job responsibilities

Become an subject matter expert for AMZL and customer service processes and systems

Conduct root cause analysis, define corrective actions and ensure they are completed. Dive deep on executive escalations. 

Develop a thorough understanding of customer needs and pain points related to our deliveries, both existing and potential. Produce white papers and present to senior management

Build strong relationships with stakeholders to understand and evaluate business priorities, define shared opportunities and requirements, and establish information sharing mechanisms. Work alongside stakeholders to define and execute innovative solutions for customers while influencing with and without authority. 

Deliver end-to-end continuous improvement programs, projects and initiatives. Develop and produce metrics and reports leading to performance improvement. Lead Kaizens or auditing activities in delivery stations to ensure process implementation. 

About The Team

Amazon Logistics, or AMZL, handles Last Mile delivery duties in partnership with multiple stakeholders - LM Ops, NOC, CPU, LMAQ etc. We utilize creative thinking and continuous improvement initiatives to get millions of physical products into the hands of our customers. Our goal is to make our customers' delivery experience as smooth as possible and roll out global delivery solutions. 

Key job responsibilities

Own daily and weekly operational performance governance for the cluster - review metrics, identify bottom-performing stations, conduct site Gembas, and drive defect reduction through structured action tracking with clear ownership and timelines. 

Partner cross-functionally with COM leadership, Station Leaders, CRMs, and central ACES Program Managers to diagnose quality gaps, align on root causes, and execute corrective actions through daily DBRs, weekly WBRs, and monthly cluster business reviews. 

Drive on-ground process standardisation and new program rollouts in coordination with L&D and Program teams - including training needs assessment, associate ride-alongs, and best practice sharing across COMs within the zone. 

Manage a structured escalation framework - resolving station-level issues within 24 hours, escalating systemic COM-level issues with proposed solutions within 48 hours, and raising technical/system defects via SIM tickets to Trans SME (NOC) for cross-functional resolution. 

Maintain regular stakeholder cadence with COM, Zonal QM, city managers, and business coaches to identify channel-level opportunities, track program updates, and ensure all recommendations are data-backed and concise for leadership decision-making. 

About The Team

The Last Mile ACES (Amazon Customer Excellence System) Quality team serves as the guardian of quality control and operational excellence within Amazon's last-mile delivery operations. This team is responsible for the adoption, oversight, and continuous improvement of Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) across Amazon Logistics (AMZL), where packages are delivered directly to customers' doorsteps. 

The team's primary focus encompasses quality assurance and control processes throughout the entire package journey within Last Mile Operations. Key responsibilities include monitoring and improving critical performance metrics such as scan hygiene, delivery success rates, bad scan incidents, invalid scans, and various operational parameters including DOT (Delivered on Time), DDS (Daily Delivery Success), EMD (Estimated Missed Delivery), and CPS (Customer Promise Success) metrics. The ACES Quality team operates at multiple organizational levels-Network, Zone, and Cluster-to identify operational process gaps and drive improvements using Lean and Six Sigma methodologies. 

The team's operational model includes deployment of Quality Associates to identified hotspot sites across the network, where they collaborate directly with operations teams to address quality parameters and implement corrective measures. Through systematic auditing, performance tracking via specialized dashboards, and continuous process refinement, the Last Mile ACES Quality team ensures that Amazon maintains its commitment to being Earth's most customer-centric company by delivering exceptional service quality and operational excellence in its final-mile delivery operations. 

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS

- 2+ years of employee and performance management experience
 - Bachelor's degree or equivalent, or 2+ years of Amazon (blue badge/FTE) experience

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

- 1+ years of performance metrics, process improvement or lean techniques experience

Job Summary

As a Senior Software Engineer, you will serve as a technical leader and org-level authority for on-prem system architecture, setting the multi-year technical vision and strategy across software, firmware, hardware, and manufacturing not just for a single team, but for how the broader engineering organization builds, validates, and scales low-level systems. You will be recognized as a driving force in applying AI/GenAI to engineering practice itself shaping how the org uses AI in design, validation, and automation while also owning the deepest technical bets on storage, networking, and OS architecture. This role carries organizational influence: your technical judgment sets direction that other senior engineers and teams align to. 

Job Requirements

- Defines and owns the multi-year technical roadmap for on-prem platform architecture, balancing performance, reliability, cost, and manufacturability
 - Makes and defends high-stakes architectural trade-offs with org-wide impact, and is accountable for their long-term consequences
 - Identifies emerging technologies (hardware, protocols, AI-driven tooling) worth betting on, and builds the case to adopt them org-wide
 - Acts as a recognized leader in applying AI/GenAI across engineering not only using GenAI tools, but setting the strategy, standards, and best practices for how the org adopts them
 - Drives architecture decisions for LLM/GenAI-powered systems: RAG pipelines, agentic automation, model evaluation frameworks, and prompt/response reliability at scale
 - Evangelizes and mentors other engineers and leads on applied AI running reviews, setting guardrails (accuracy, cost, data privacy), and identifying where AI should and shouldn't be used
 - Represents the org's AI engineering direction to senior leadership and, where relevant, external technical communities
 - Authoritative, protocol-level expertise across networking, capable of driving architecture decisions and resolving the org's hardest network-layer issues
 - TCP/IP network stack
 - Computer networks
 - NFS, SMB, iSCSI, FC

- Deep, authoritative command of OS internals sets direction on kernel/OS architecture decisions and is the escalation point for the hardest root-cause investigations
 - Linux, Unix OS internals (Kernel & Networking)
 - FreeBSD and its architecture
 - OS booting process (Linux/Unix)
 - BIOS/UEFI, GRUB bootloaders
 - Owns architectural decisions across storage and hardware interfaces, including performance tuning, failure analysis, and next-generation platform design
 - NAS, SAN
 - NVMe technologies, NVMeOF (NVMe over Fabrics) architecture and design trade-offs
 - PCIe, Ethernet interfaces
 - RAID, SSDs
 - IOM (I/O Module) design, shelf/enclosure architecture, and hardware interface integration
 - Sets the automation strategy and standards for the broader team determining what should be automated, how, and to what reliability bar
 - Maintains expert, hands-on fluency in Python, C, and C++, using it to prototype and validate architectural decisions directly, not only to review them
 - Mentors senior and staff-level engineers, shaping how they grow technically and how they approach ambiguous problems
 - Runs and sets the bar for architecture reviews across multiple teams, not just design/code review within one

Senior Software Engineer - Java Full stack with AI

MasterCard is a technology company in the global payments business. We connect consumers, financial institutions, merchants, governments, and businesses worldwide and enable them to use secure and convenient electronic forms of payment.

We work collaboratively with our product partners and other technical teams to continuously improve and enhance our existing products and drive new products to the global marketplace.  - Respond to operational and business concerns or issues relative to future business programs, projects, or enhancements to ensure consistent delivery of quality services. 
 - Ensure development supports all appropriate certifications and compliance requirements, including those for PCI, GLBA, Safe Harbor, and others. 
 - Responsible for performance engineering of the enterprise software architecture, and providing functional guidance, advice, and/or training to other application developers. 
 - Responsible for designing, developing, testing, delivering, and monitoring scalable and secure cloud architectures, using various AWS cloud and cloud native platforms, such as EC2, ECS, S3. 
 - Need to improve and expand the existing platform by ensuring that it is resilient, secure, and scalable. 

All About You

- Bachelor's degree in Information Systems, Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent work experience with 7+ years of industry experience. 
 - Strong experience in Full Stack Java development using J2EE, Java 8 or higher, JSP, Servlets, Spring 5, Hibernate, and backend service development. 
 - Proven expertise in building and consuming Web Services (SOAP/RESTful APIs) and developing scalable, high-performance applications.

 - Hands-on experience with application servers such as WebSphere, JBoss, and Tomcat, and development environments including Visual Studio, RAD, Eclipse, IntelliJ, and VS Code.

 - Strong knowledge of SDLC methodologies, with experience in both Agile and Waterfall models. 
 - Excellent communication, analytical, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to work across multiple organizational levels and global teams. 
 - High-energy, detail-oriented, proactive mindset with ability to work independently under pressure, demonstrating strong ownership and self-motivation. 
 - Strong interpersonal and relationship-building skills, with a proven track record of collaborating with internal and external stakeholders. 

Corporate Security Responsibility

All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must: 

- Abide by Mastercard's security policies and practices; 
 - Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed; 
 - Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
 - Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard's guidelines.

data.title: Principal Software Engineer - Applications Architect
data.description:
Our Purpose

Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we're helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.

Principal Software Engineer - Applications Architect

Principal Engineer - Applications Architect

Worker Type Level Location Number of Positions

Employee L5 Pune 1

Who is Mastercard?

Mastercard is a global technology company in the payments industry. Our mission is to connect and power an inclusive, digital economy that benefits everyone, everywhere by making transactions safe, simple, smart, and accessible. Using secure data and networks, partnerships and passion, our innovations and solutions help individuals, financial institutions, governments, and businesses realize their greatest potential. 

Our decency quotient, or DQ, drives our culture and everything we do inside and outside of our company. With connections across more than 210 countries and territories, we are building a sustainable world that unlocks priceless possibilities for all. 

Overview

Payments Network Technology is seeking a Principal Engineer to provide technical and delivery leadership across payment-network initiatives. This role will connect architecture, release coordination, dependency management, and engineering execution across multiple teams. 

Roles and Responsibilities

- Define and evolve architecture for secure, scalable, and highly available payment-network services, predominantly Java based. 
 - Coordinate technical delivery across teams, including releases, dependencies, defect triage, and resolution of cross-cutting issues. 
 - Partner with product and engineering leaders to translate business needs into architecture and implementation direction. 
 - Lead design reviews and drive decisions on APIs, service interactions, data, resiliency, security, and operational readiness. 
 - Identify reuse opportunities and promote common engineering patterns and standards. 
 - Mentor engineers and technical leads across teams. 
 - Communicate architecture trade-offs, delivery risks, and recommendations to senior stakeholders. 
 - Provide technical or product leadership, mentor team members, and drive decisions across multiple workstreams. 

Essential Skills

- Extensive software architecture and hands-on Java development experience in large-scale systems. 
 - Deep knowledge of Java, Spring Boot, microservices, REST APIs, messaging, event-driven architecture especially Kafka, SQL/NoSQL, and cloud-native platforms. 
 - Experience with secure engineering, DevOps, performance, resiliency, observability, and production-readiness practices. 
 - Ability to lead through influence across organizational boundaries. 
 - Bachelor's degree in computer science, information technology, engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience. 

All About You

- Experience working in Agile delivery environments and across the software development lifecycle. 
 - Clear communication, collaboration, problem-solving, and stakeholder-management skills. 
 - Ability to work with globally distributed product, engineering, architecture, operations, and business teams. 
 - Experience leading SOAR (Solution Architecture Review) and driving technical strategy, architecture alignment, engineering excellence, and risk management across multiple teams. 
 - Experience creating and reviewing TADs (Technical Architecture Documents) for large-scale distributed systems, ensuring alignment with enterprise standards, security requirements, resiliency objectives, and long-term maintainability. 
 - Demonstrated experience defining and governing cross-platform architecture, enabling interoperability, reuse, standardization, and consistent engineering practices across multiple products and services. 
 - Experience designing and implementing multi-region resiliency architectures, including active-active and active-passive deployment patterns, disaster recovery strategies, cross-region data replication, failover mechanisms, and business continuity solutions. 
 - Strong understanding of distributed data management, including data replication, consistency models, recovery objectives, and operational considerations across geographic regions. 
 - Champions operability and maintainability as first-class design principles, ensuring observability, monitoring, automation, self-healing capabilities, supportability, and simplified operational management are built into solutions from inception. 
 - Deep understanding of Mastercard Engineering Principles (or equivalent large-scale enterprise engineering standards) and a proven ability to apply them consistently across architecture, software design, deployment, resiliency, security, and operational practices. 
 - Demonstrated ability to balance architecture, business priorities, scalability, security, resiliency, and operational considerations while establishing technology direction for multiple engineering teams. 
 - Experience defining architecture guardrails, engineering standards, reference implementations, and reusable patterns that improve consistency, quality, and delivery effectiveness across the organization. 
 - Strong knowledge of reliability engineering practices, including service-level objectives (SLOs), error budgets, observability, fault isolation, disaster recovery testing, and continuous resilience validation. 
 - Payments or financial-services domain knowledge is preferred. 

Corporate Security Responsibility

All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must: 

- Abide by Mastercard's security policies and practices; 
 - Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed; 
 - Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
 - Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard's guidelines.

data.title: Senior Data Systems Software Engineer
data.description:
Job Description

Senior Data System Software engineer: Oracle Database 26ai and client drivers System Test Engineering

Database Product Development | Senior Lead or Principal Level

Role summary This role combines hands-on Oracle database development with component, integration, system, stress, and performance testing. The engineer will build automated test solutions for Oracle Database 26ai, Oracle client drivers, converged database features, and the major Oracle client drivers on Windows and Linux. 

Team and mission

The SHARP VLDB organisation improves the scalability, high availability, reliability, and performance of Oracle Database and cloud services. The team designs realistic, high-volume and highly concurrent workloads that expose product defects and architectural limitations before release. Engineers work closely with database kernel, feature, client drivers, cloud, and support teams to reproduce issues, verify fixes, and strengthen product quality across on-premises and cloud deployments. 

Role at a glance

Primary Focus

Database feature development and cross-platform system test engineering

Target database

Oracle Database 26ai with vector and AI capabilities

Platforms

Windows Server and Linux, including cross-platform compatibility and interoperability

Database areas

XDB, JSON, Oracle Text, SQL and PL/SQL, multitenant and high availability

ODAC scope

ODP. NET Core, Managed and Unmanaged providers and related ODAC components

Client drivers

python-oracledb, node-oracledb, OCI-C driver and JDBC

Test coverage

Functional, integration, compatibility, upgrade, patch, system, stress, performance and resiliency

Responsibilities

Design and develop production-scale database schemas, data generators, workload drivers, and application logic using SQL, PL/SQL, Python, Java, JavaScript or Node. js, C/C++, and C# as appropriate. 

- Create highly automated end-to-end test suites that simulate large enterprise applications, high concurrency, long-duration operation, mixed workloads, and very large databases. 
 - Review Oracle Database 26ai feature designs and translate functional and architectural requirements into test strategies, coverage matrices, test specifications, and reusable automation. 
 - Validate Oracle Database 26ai vector and AI capabilities, including vector data types, vector indexes, similarity search, hybrid vector and text scenarios, embedding workflows, concurrency, correctness, performance, and upgrade compatibility. 
 - Develop comprehensive coverage for XDB and XML processing, JSON data management and APIs, and Oracle Text indexing, search, synchronization, security, and mixed-workload interoperability. 
 - Test ODAC and ODP. NET components across Windows and Linux, including platform-appropriate ODP. NET Core, Managed, and Unmanaged provider scenarios, connection management, pooling, transactions, data type mappings, high availability, security, and framework integration. 
 - Build a consistent cross-driver test matrix for python-oracledb, node-oracledb, OCI C, and JDBC to validate feature parity, protocol behavior, data type support, error handling, failover, performance, and backward compatibility. 
 - Exercise client and server combinations across Windows and Linux, including installation, configuration, networking, TLS, authentication, character sets, file systems, process and memory behavior, and operating-system-specific regressions. 
 - Test Release Updates, one-off patches, client upgrades, rolling maintenance, database upgrades, and mixed-version scenarios while preserving data correctness and service availability. 
 - Execute tests on standalone databases, multitenant CDB and PDB environments, RAC and ASM clusters, Data Guard configurations, Exadata, and cloud or Autonomous Database environments as applicable. 
 - Develop monitoring and diagnostics for database, operating system, network, application, and client layers; analyze traces, dumps, logs, wait events, execution plans, memory usage, and performance profiles. 
 - File high-quality defects with reproducible evidence, isolate failures to the responsible layer, collaborate with development teams on root cause, and verify fixes across platforms and client stacks. 
 - Enhance test frameworks based on customer escalations and field defects, and participate in feature reviews, certification exercises, documentation reviews, and quality readiness assessments. Core technical scope

Area

Technologies

Expected coverage

Database features

XDB XML, JSON, Oracle Text, SQL, PL/SQL, Multitenant

Correctness, interoperability, security, concurrency, upgrade and performance

AI and vector

Vector types, indexes, similarity and hybrid search, AI workflows

Accuracy, scale, performance, resiliency and client accessibility

ODAC and . NET

ODP. NET Core, Managed and Unmanaged providers

Windows and Linux component behavior, pooling, transactions, HA and data types

Client drivers

python-oracledb, node-oracledb, OCI C and JDBC

Feature parity, compatibility, error handling, failover and throughput

Platforms

Windows Server, Linux, RAC, ASM, Data Guard and cloud

Installation, networking, security, resource behavior and lifecycle operations

Required Qualifications

- Bachelor's or master's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electronics, or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience. 
 - Strong Oracle Database development experience with SQL, PL/SQL, schema and physical design, transaction processing, concurrency, diagnostics, and performance tuning. 
 - Experience developing or testing database client applications using at least two of the following: Python, Node. js, C/C++, Java, or C# and . NET. 
 - Practical knowledge of client-server database architecture, Oracle Net connectivity, connection pooling, transactions, data type conversion, error handling, and high-availability behavior. 
 - Strong Windows and Linux engineering skills, including services and processes, networking, file systems, security, automation, resource monitoring, and troubleshooting. 
 - Experience designing automated functional, integration, system, stress, or performance tests and diagnosing failures across multiple software layers. 
 - Ability to read feature designs, identify risk areas, create measurable coverage, and produce maintainable test code and clear defect reports. 
 - Experience with source control and continuous integration practices, such as Git, build pipelines, automated regression execution, and artifact management. 
 - Clear written and verbal communication, strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and the ability to collaborate across geographically distributed engineering teams. 

Preferred Experience

- Expert Oracle Design/Development/Principal DBAs (OR) Lead/Principal Oracle DB Developers with sound

Oracle DB Application Development cum DBA Full-Life cycle experience ranging from 4-12 years. 

- Oracle Database 23ai or 26ai, AI Vector Search, machine learning or embedding-based applications, and performance evaluation of AI-assisted database workloads. 
 - ODAC, ODP. NET, . NET and . NET Core, Entity Framework Core, ADO. NET, ASP. NET, IIS, Visual Studio, and Windows application diagnostics. 
 - python-oracledb Thin and Thick modes, node-oracledb, OCI C interfaces, JDBC Thin or OCI modes, and cross-driver compatibility testing. 
 - Oracle XDB and XML, native JSON capabilities, Oracle Text, search indexing, document-oriented applications, and mixed JSON relational workloads. 
 - Oracle RAC, ASM, Data Guard, Multitenant, Exadata, Autonomous Database, Database Cloud Services, or Oracle Cloud Infrastructure. 
 - PowerShell, shell, Python automation, REST APIs, container platforms, orchestration, observability, and infrastructure-as-code tools. 
 - Experience analyzing customer escalations or post-release defects and converting them into durable automated regression coverage. 

Qualifications

Range and benefit information provided in this posting are specific to the stated locations only

data.description:
Job Description

Title: Control Software Designer-PLC-Husky (India), Chennai

Id: 21587

Type: FullTime

Location: Chennai, India

At Husky TechnologiesTM, our success is based on your success. Our ability to keep our customers in the lead is based on building the strongest team possible. 

Husky TechnologiesTM has a strong foundation built on innovation, close customer relationships and a unique culture and values. We are dedicated to offering our customers the highest quality products and services and are looking for people with the inspiration and talent to develop with us as we pursue our ambitious growth strategy. We are a leader in developing state-of-the-art technology and it is this technology base that uniquely positions us to serve customers who seek differentiation through solutions that provide speed, flexibility and maximum productivity. This capability is at the core of our mission and competitive strategy. 

Husky TechnologiesTM offers a wealth of opportunity for personal growth and development. Most importantly, Husky Technologies TM offers an opportunity to work with - and be challenged by - a team of great people. Our success is possible because of the creativity, intelligence and passion of our people around the world and their desire to lead change. At the same time, we are not afraid to expect a lot and strive for leadership in all of our key markets. We are a company taking on new challenges and for the right people this means exceptional career development opportunities, the chance to be part of a team that is the best in the world at what we do and the experience that comes from working in an environment that demands constant transformation and innovation. 

Husky TechnologiesTM is an exciting company with tremendous potential. We have a great team and great expectations. If you are attracted to bold goals, believe in uncompromising honesty, support mutual respect, care about environmental responsibility, have a passion for excellence and a desire to make a positive contribution - then we want you to join the Husky TechnologiesTM team!

Job Description

As part of the Development Engineering team, the Control Software Designer designs, supports, and troubleshoots control systems for Injection Molding Machines(IMM) and Mold controllers. This role operates in a fast-paced, innovative environment and focuses on developing creative, high-quality solutions to complex technical challenges. 

Key Responsibilities/Areas Of Accountability: 

- Design control systems for IMM and Mold controller applications including servo drive and servo-hydraulic controls, injection molding process control. 
 - Provide functional, design specifications and validation plans for new IMM and Mold controller functionality. 
 - Software development of machine sequences (PLC IEC 61131-3), process control, human-machine interface(HMI) in Windows environment. 
 - Troubleshoot and debug real-time and non-real-time software. 
 - Document software changes using resources such as TFS/VSTS and Azure DevOps. 
 - Document development, design changes and production design activities. 
 - Communicate design with other design groups and businesses. 

Requirements: 

- Bachelor's Degree or higher in Electrical & Electronics/ECE/Instrumentation/Software Engineering preferred, or equivalent. 
 - Minimum 5 years hands-on experience in automated control system design and troubleshooting preferred. 
 - Machine design/develop with Beckhoff, Siemens, GE, ABB and Allen Bradley products background are preferred. 
 - PLC structured text language design and programming using IEC 61131-3. 
 - Experience in programming using C, C++, C# or other high-level languages for HMI applications (Ruby). 
 - Strong knowledge of PC based control systems and embedded system. 
 - Strong Knowledge of control theory and model-based design principles. 
 - Knowledge of PLC's and motion controllers. 
 - Working knowledge of standard industrial communication networks and protocols such as RS232, RS485, Ethernet, CANOpen, Profibus, Profinet and EtherCAT. 
 - Ability to read control circuits using Eplan as a resource. 
 - Experience with Beckhoff TwinCAT3. 
 - Experience designing, debugging and deploying software in VSTS development environment. 
 - Machine design/develop with Beckhoff, Siemens, GE, ABB and Allen Bradley products background are preferred. 
 - Experience in Agile software design process and Test Driven Development methodologies. 
 - Familiarity and experience with AI and it's use in software development, ideation, and the creation of tools
 - Strong proficiency in English with effective verbal, written. 

Personal Qualifications: 

- Ability to communicate complex technical concepts clearly, verbally and in writing. 
 - A quick independent learner, able to digest and understand complex concepts. 
 - An intelligent thinker, able to formulate hypotheses, troubleshoot, analyze, and propose solutions. 
 - Highly creative with the ability to develop multiple concepts to resolve problems. 
 - Capable of Working in a multi-disciplined international team with excellent personal organization skills. 

Husky TechnologiesTM offers a competitive compensation and benefits package and excellent opportunities for growth and advancement. We are committed to equal employment opportunity and respect, value and welcome diversity in our workplace. Husky TechnologiesTM also values being a great place to work and strives to maintain a safe workplace. Accordingly, Husky TechnologiesTM conditions all offers of employment on satisfactory completion of background checks. No agency or telephone inquiries please.
