data.description:
About Business

JOB DESCRIPTION

Adani Group: Adani Group is a diversified organisation in India comprising 10 publicly traded companies. It has created a world class logistics and utility infrastructure portfolio that has a pan-India presence. Adani Group is headquartered in Ahmedabad, in the state of Gujarat, India. Over the years, Adani Group has positioned itself to be the market leader in its logistics and energy businesses focusing on large scale infrastructure development in India with O & M practices benchmarked to global standards. With four IG rated businesses, it is the only Infrastructure Investment Grade issuer in India. 

Adani Green Energy Limited (AGEL): AGEL is part of the Adani Group's promise to provide a better, cleaner, and greener future for India. Driven by the Group's philosophy of Growth with Goodness', the Company develops, builds, owns, operates, and maintains utility- scale grid-connected solar, wind farm and energy storage (Hydro PSP and Battery) projects. The electricity generated is supplied to central and state government entities and government- backed corporations. On the back of long-term Power Purchase Agreements (PPAs) with central and state government entities, AGEL has leveraged its capabilities and expanded its presence across 12 Indian states. With the integration of pump storage and battery storage projects with large solar & wind portfolio, AGEL shall be best placed amongst peers to supply round-the-clock green power to India's grid. The Company continuously adopts and deploys the latest technologies in its projects. With the target of 50 GW renewable energy capacity by 2030, AGEL is driving India on its renewable energy journey. 

Job Purpose: Engineer - Commissioning is responsible for the systematic commissioning of renewable energy systems, focusing on validating and verifying system performance, troubleshooting issues, and ensuring alignment with technical requirements and goals

Responsibilities

Commissioning Plan Formulation and Project Coordination: 

Develops and implements detailed commissioning plans for wind, solar, and hybrid projects, ensuring alignment with engineering specifications and regulatory standards. 

Coordinates with project stakeholders to address all necessary technical aspects and comply with project requirements. 

Gathers information related to connectivity, LTA/GNA, and project commissioning for efficient execution of upcoming renewable energy projects. 

System Testing And Performance Validation

Executes rigorous system testing and validation protocols to confirm that all systems meet performance specifications and function correctly under operational conditions. 

Conducts power performance analysis for wind turbines and ensures the commissioning of turbines as handed over by the project team. 

Ensures 100% turbine healthiness for continuous operation and addresses any discrepancies to maintain optimal performance. 

Technical Issue Identification And Rectification

Diagnoses and resolves technical issues encountered during the commissioning phase, applying advanced troubleshooting methods and collaborating with engineering teams to address root causes. 

Develops and implements effective solutions to technical problems, ensuring all issues are resolved promptly to prevent disruptions. 

Provides technical training to team members and supports in resolving error fault breakdowns for turbines. 

Regulatory Compliance And Safety Assurance

Ensures that all commissioning activities adhere to established industry regulations, safety standards, and project specifications, maintaining high levels of quality and compliance throughout the process. 

Develops a safety culture at sites by ensuring workplace safety and adherence to SOPs, targeting zero accidents and Lost Time Injuries (LTIs). 

Verifies compliance with safety protocols during construction and operation of EHV and 33KV lines. 

Documentation And Reporting

Prepares comprehensive documentation and reports on commissioning activities, including test results, performance data, and compliance verification. 

Maintains detailed records of all commissioning activities, providing essential documentation for ongoing monitoring and regulatory compliance. 

Prepares and submits site-wise budgets for operational and capital expenditure as per the project timeline. 

Collaboration And Business Performance Monitoring

Works closely with engineering teams to coordinate commissioning activities and address technical issues that arise, ensuring effective collaboration and problem resolution. 

Monitors business performance against goals and identifies cost optimization opportunities in running projects. 

Ensures timely closure of audit points and compliance with management systems, contributing to organizational transformation and change management.

IT Department

Equipment Suppliers

Grid Authority

Testing Laboratories

Industry Associations

Contractors

Qualifications

Educational Qualifications: 

Bachelor's degree in Electrical or Mechanical Engineering is required. 

Strong academic foundation in power systems, electrical machines, control systems, and instrumentation. Proficiency in commissioning procedures and testing methodologies. 

Work Experience

3-4 years of experience in commissioning of power plants or industrial equipment. 

Hands-on experience in equipment installation, testing, and commissioning. Knowledge of safety protocols, quality standards.

Job Description

As a Test Automation Engineer, you will design and implement automation solutions that validate system behavior across UI, APIs, and integrations. You will contribute to building a robust quality engineering ecosystem by integrating automated testing into CI/CD pipelines and supporting continuous delivery. 

In this role, you will translate requirements into effective test strategies, combining automation with manual, exploratory, and integration testing to ensure comprehensive quality coverage across all application layers. 

This role is ideal for an engineer who enjoys hands-on coding, solving complex validation challenges, and improving system quality at scale, while taking ownership of end-to-end quality outcomes and collaborating closely with cross-functional teams. 

Responsibilities

Automation Development & Framework Ownership

- Design, develop, and own scalable test automation frameworks and reusable components
 - Build automated test suites across: 
 - UI (Web/Mobile)
 - API and integration layers
 - Ensure automation solutions are maintainable, reliable, and extensible across teams

Test Strategy & Implementation

- Translate requirements into automation-ready test scenarios, test data, and validation strategies
 - Contribute to test strategy, coverage planning, and quality goals
 - Identify test gaps and proactively mitigate risks
 - Perform automation feasibility analysis to determine optimal test approach (manual vs automated)

Delivery & Execution Excellence

- Execute a balanced mix of automated and manual tests aligned with sprint goals, ensuring comprehensive validation across functional, integration, and edge-case scenarios. 
 - Contribute to task breakdown, estimation, and sprint commitments
 - Proactively raise risks, blockers, and testability concerns
 - Identify, log, prioritize, and track defects through resolution lifecycle
 - Perform root cause analysis and collaborate with development teams for fixes

Manual & Functional Testing

- Design, document, and execute detailed test cases and test scenarios
 - Perform functional, exploratory, and regression testing across features
 - Validate end-to-end workflows and business scenarios
 - Identify edge cases and usability issues through exploratory testing
 - Ensure test coverage for areas not suitable for automation

Quality, Standards & Engineering Practices

- Write clean, testable, and maintainable automation code
 - Participate in code reviews and continuous improvement of automation frameworks
 - Ensure adherence to Definition of Ready (DoR) and Definition of Done (DoD)
 - Take ownership of end-to-end quality outcomes across assigned areas
 - Follow established DevOps, security, and quality engineering practices

CI/CD & DevOps Integration

- Integrate automation into CI/CD pipelines (Azure DevOps preferred)
 - Enable continuous testing and shift-left quality practices
 - Monitor and improve pipeline stability, execution time, and reliability
 - Validate and troubleshoot system integrations, data flows, and error handling based on defined architectural designs and interfaces

Non-Functional Testing

- Contribute to performance, reliability, and resilience testing
 - Validate system behavior under load, stress, and failure scenarios

Observability & Debuggability

- Leverage logs, metrics, and traces to improve test reliability
 - Support root cause analysis of failures and improve system observability

Test Data & Environment Management

- Design and manage test data strategies and datasets
 - Ensure availability of stable, production-like test environments

Incident & Operational Support

- Assist in troubleshooting defects across environments
 - Support maintenance and continuous improvement of automation suites
 - Analyze and reduce flaky tests and unstable scenarios

Collaboration & Growth

- Collaborate with developers, QA, Product Owners, and Tech Leads
 - Actively learn and adopt new tools, frameworks, and best practices
 - Contribute to team knowledge sharing and a strong quality culture

Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in computer science, IT, or related field
 - 5+ years of experience in software testing with strong automation focus
 - Experience in designing and implementing test automation frameworks
 - Strong understanding of testing principles, SDLC, STLC, and Agile practices

Technical Skills

- Programming experience in one or more: C#, Java, Python, JavaScript, Swift
 - Experience with automation tools such as Selenium, Katalon, Playwright, Cypress
 - Experience with: 
 - API testing (REST, Postman, etc. )
 - Version control (Git)
 - CI/CD pipelines (Azure DevOps)
 - Familiarity with: 
 - Test data management
 - Test reporting and logging tools
 - Debugging and root cause analysis
 - Release Management
Assets

- Experience with: 
 - Performance testing tools (JMeter, k6)
 - Security testing (SAST, DAST, SCA)
 - Exposure to: 
 - Cloud platforms (Azure preferred)
 - DevSecOps practices
 - Experience using AI-assisted tools responsibly (e. g. , GitHub Copilot)
Key Expectations

- Drive an automation-first approach (target 60-80% regression automation), while ensuring critical flows and edge cases are validated through manual testing where automation is not feasible or cost-effective. 
 - Own and evolve automation frameworks and quality engineering practices
 - Ensure high reliability, scalability, and stability of automation pipelines
 - Take accountability for quality outcomes, not just test execution
 - Ensure alignment with organizational quality, security, and compliance standards

Why Husky?

- Regulated Working Hours: Enjoy a structured work schedule that promotes a healthy work-life balance, allowing you to excel professionally while maintaining personal well-being. 
 - Visible Impact: Experience the satisfaction of seeing the direct outcomes of your work, as you contribute to projects that visibly enhance our company's technological capabilities and efficiency.

 - Empowered Involvement: Take an active role in decision-making processes and architectural reviews, where your expertise helps shape the future of our cloud solutions and overall business strategy. 
 - Valued Contributions: Be more than just a number in a large organization; at our company, every individual's input is valued and can lead to significant, tangible improvements in our operations and services. 
 - Impactful Role: Play a crucial part in both developing new applications and maintaining existing systems, ensuring their optimal performance and reliability. 
 - Cutting-Edge Projects: Work on innovative cloud solutions that are transforming our and our customer's business, giving you the opportunity to be at the forefront of technological advancements. 
 - Supportive Community: Work in an environment that recognizes and celebrates individual achievements, fostering a sense of community and mutual respect among team members.

Husky TechnologiesTM offers a competitive compensation and benefits package and excellent opportunities for growth and advancement. We are committed to equal employment opportunity and respect, value and welcome diversity in our workplace. Husky TechnologiesTM also values being a great place to work and strives to maintain a safe workplace. data.title: Lead Blockchain Engineer_ Vice President _Software Engineering
data.description:
We're seeking someone to join our Middle Office Platforms Engineering team as Lead BlockChain Engineer in Wealth Management Technology division to lead our blockchain engineering team focused on building scalable, secure, and regulatory-compliant solutions for digital assets, tokenization, and decentralized finance (DeFi). This role combines deep technical expertise in blockchain systems with strong leadership to deliver enterprise-grade products for global markets. 

In the Technology division, we leverage innovation to build the connections and capabilities that power our Firm, enabling our clients and colleagues to redefine markets and shape the future of our communities. 

Middle Office is a dynamic and fast-paced area within the Firm's WM Technology Division. We are responsible for creating innovative technology solutions for Core Brokerage, one of the strategic growth areas of the Firm. Middle office is a core foundation for Morgan Stanley. It provides the platform with key capabilities to support customer digital journey from opening an account, funding the account, trade and order management, portfolio/balances, and risk management on all digital channels. It also provides the capabilities for Morgan Stanley B2B stock plan business to manage participants' lifecycle. If you are an exceptional individual who is interested in solving complex problems and building sophisticated solutions in a dynamic team environment, Middle office is the place for you. 

Since 1935, Morgan Stanley is known as a global leader in financial services, always evolving and innovating to better serve our clients and our communities in more than 40 countries around the world. 

What You'll Do In The Role

Digital Assets is an emerging priority initiative for Wealth Management and requires building out a new function with a niche blockchain skillset. 

- Define the engineering roadmap for blockchain infrastructure, tokenization platforms, and digital asset services. 
 - Oversee design, architecture, and implementation of blockchain-based solutions, ensuring security, scalability, and compliance with applicable regulations. 
 - Collaborate with product, compliance, and operations teams to define technical requirements. 
 - Evaluate and integrate blockchain protocols (Ethereum, Polygon, Hyperledger, Canton, etc. ) based on product needs. 
 - Manage the release lifecycle, CI/CD pipelines, and production reliability. 
 - Implement and enforce best practices for code quality, testing, and security
 - Stay ahead of industry trends, emerging standards, and evolving regulatory frameworks in digital assets. Required Qualifications

What You'll Bring To The Role

- 10+ years of software engineering experience, with at least 3+ years in blockchain and tokenization. 
 - 5+ years in an engineering leadership role managing distributed teams. 
 - Strong knowledge of blockchain architecture, consensus algorithms, smart contracts, and cryptographic primitives. 
 - Experience with Solidity, Rust, Go, or similar languages for blockchain development. 
 - Familiarity with custodial and non-custodial wallet infrastructure, key management, and secure signing. 
 - Understanding of token standards (ERC-20, ERC-721, ERC-1400, etc. ) and on/off-chain settlement workflows. 
 - Proven track record of delivering enterprise-grade software systems at scale. 
 - Experience in regulated financial services or fintech. 
 - 6+ years of relevant experience to perform this role. 

What You Can Expect From Morgan Stanley

At Morgan Stanley, we raise, manage and allocate capital for our clients - helping them reach their goals. We do it in a way that's differentiated - and we've done that for 90 years. Our values - putting clients first, doing the right thing, leading with exceptional ideas, committing to diversity and inclusion, and giving back - aren't just beliefs, they guide the decisions we make every day to do what's best for our clients, communities and more than 80, 000 employees in 1, 200 offices across 42 countries. We are proud to support our employees and their families at every point along their work-life journey, offering some of the most attractive and comprehensive employee benefits and perks in the industry. Our recruiting efforts reflect our strong commitment to a culture of inclusion, where individuals are hired, developed, and advanced based on their skills and talents. 

Our workforce reflects a broad cross-section of the global communities in which we operate, bringing a variety of backgrounds, talents, perspectives, and experiences.

data.title: Senior Manager, Engineering
data.description:
Our Mission

At Palo Alto Networks®, we're united by a shared mission-to protect our digital way of life. We thrive at the intersection of innovation and impact, solving real-world problems with cutting-edge technology and bold thinking. Here, everyone has a voice, and every idea counts. If you're ready to do the most meaningful work of your career alongside people who are just as passionate as you are, you're in the right place. 

Who We Are

In order to be the cybersecurity partner of choice, we must trailblaze the path and shape the future of our industry. This is something our employees work at each day and is defined by our values: Disruption, Collaboration, Execution, Integrity, and Inclusion. We weave AI into the fabric of everything we do and use it to augment the impact every individual can have. If you are passionate about solving real-world problems and ideating beside the best and the brightest, we invite you to join us!

We believe collaboration thrives in person. That's why most of our teams work from the office full time, with flexibility when it's needed. This model supports real-time problem-solving, stronger relationships, and the kind of precision that drives great outcomes. 

Job Summary

The Platform engineering organization builds the cloud-native foundation powering our Idira Security products using microservices and serverless architectures. As the Senior Manager of Software Engineering, you will lead the Idira Platform unit, overseeing three engineering teams comprising over 30 developers and tech leads. You will take end-to-end ownership of critical platform initiatives, guiding technical direction, execution, production health, and people development while partnering with global leadership and driving an AI-first engineering culture. 

Key Responsibilities

- Lead, mentor, and grow an organization of over 30 engineers across three teams, managing hiring, retention, performance, and the career development of engineering managers and tech leads. 
 - Take full ownership of high-priority platform initiatives, translating strategic goals into predictable multi-quarter plans and ensuring on-time, enterprise-grade delivery. 
 - Drive the design and deployment of resilient, highly scalable, and secure cloud-native services based on microservices architectures. 
 - Maintain complete accountability for the production health, service level agreements (SLAs), and operational rigor of all services owned by the unit. 
 - Accelerate the adoption of AI coding assistants, automated testing, and agentic workflows to improve developer throughput and code quality while maintaining strict security guardrails. 
 - Partner with architecture teams to enforce platform design standards, Zero Trust principles, and comprehensive data security requirements. 
 - Actively guide architectural trade-offs, lead deep technical discussions, and foster a collaborative culture of design reviews and continuous learning. 

Qualifications

Required Qualifications

- 15 or more years of software engineering experience, with at least 6 years in leadership roles, including experience as a manager of managers overseeing 25 to 30+ engineers. 
 - Proven track record of delivering high-scale, enterprise-grade SaaS products and cloud-native platform services. 
 - Strong hands-on technical background with at least one major cloud provider such as AWS, Azure, or GCP. 
 - Demonstrated success in owning production systems end to end, managing SLAs, observability, and incident resolution. 
 - Experience operating effectively within globally distributed organizations across multiple sites and time zones. 
 - Strong ability to drive complex programs through ambiguity and consistently deliver on technical and business commitments. 
 - Practical experience or a demonstrated commitment to integrating modern AI tooling into the software development lifecycle. 
 - Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a closely related technical field. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience building internal platforms, shared services, or developer platforms utilized by multiple product teams. 
 - Domain expertise in Cybersecurity, Identity and Access Management (IAM), Privileged Access Management (PAM), or Cloud Security. 
 - Background in infrastructure-as-code, multi-cloud deployments, and platform reliability engineering practices. 

Our Commitment

We're trailblazers that dream big, take risks, and challenge cybersecurity's status quo. It's simple: we can't accomplish our mission without diverse teams innovating, together. 

We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for all qualified individuals with a disability. If you require assistance or accommodation due to a disability or special need, please contact us at accommodations@paloaltonetworks. com. 

Palo Alto Networks is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity in our workplace, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran status, race, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or other legally protected characteristics. 

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines. 

Is role eligible for Immigration Sponsorship? No. Please note that we will not sponsor applicants for work visas for this position.

Position Summary

#S&SArchitect

The Customer Team empowers organizations to build deeper relationships with customers through innovative strategies, advanced analytics, GenAI, transformative technologies, and creative design. We enable Deloitte client service teams to enhance customer experiences and drive sustained growth and customer value creation and capture, through customer and commercial strategies, digital product and innovation, marketing, commerce, sales, and service. Position Summary

Level: Lead Business Transformation Architect or equivalent

As a Lead Business Transformation Architect at Deloitte Consulting, you will drive the design, implementation, and delivery of cutting-edge artificial intelligence solutions for our clients. This role combines deep technical expertise with strong leadership capabilities and exceptional client management skills. You will serve as a bridge between complex technical implementations and business objectives, leading development teams while effectively communicating with stakeholders at all levels. 

Work you'll do: 

- Technical leadership & Architecture 
 - Client Engagement & Solution Design 
 - Team Management & Development 
 - Service Delivery Excellence

The Team: 

Our Advertising, Marketing & Commerce team focuses on delivering marketing and growth objectives aligned with our clients' brand values for measurable business growth. We help clients turn business values into measurable growth through creatively driven, personalized content, communications, and experiences that engage and inspire people to act. We implement and operate the technology platforms that enable personalized content, commerce and marketing user-centric experiences. In doing so, we transform our clients' marketing and engagement operations into modern, data-driven, creatively focused organizations. Our team brings deep experience in creative and digital marketing capabilities by a combination of key focus areas i. e, Brand, Advertising, Experiences, Content, Marketing, Commerce, Products, Data and measurement/analysis. 

Qualifications

Must Have Skills/Project Experience/Certifications: 

- 9+ years of overall Salesforce Platform experience, with 5+ years focused on CPQ architecture. 
 - Proven track record delivering enterprise-scale Lead-to-Cash or Quote-to-Cash programs (multi-cloud preferred). 
 - Able to own end-to-end architecture for Salesforce CPQ implementations, including integration with Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Billing, ERP, and external systems. 
 - Partner with business and IT stakeholders to gather requirements, define solution roadmaps, and translate complex business processes into scalable CPQ configurations. 
 - Lead technical design sessions, produce architecture artifacts (data models, integration specs, ERDs, sequence diagrams), and ensure alignment with enterprise architecture standards. 
 - Configure, customize, and extend Salesforce CPQ (products, pricing, discounting, approval workflows, quoting, contract amendments, renewals, usage-based models). 
 - Provide technical leadership to delivery teams (developers, admins, business analysts), enforce best practices, and conduct code/configuration reviews. 
 - Drive performance tuning, data migration, release management, and environment strategy for large-scale CPQ programs. 
 - Oversee integration patterns (API, middleware, ETL, event-driven) between CPQ and downstream billing, provisioning, and ERP systems. 
 - Act as subject-matter expert during pre-sales, solution estimation, and proof-of-concept efforts. 
 - Mentor junior architects and consultants, fostering a culture of continuous learning and innovation. 
 - Contribute to CPQ and broader Lead-to-Cash thought leadership, accelerators, and reusable assets. 
 - Deep knowledge of CPQ data model, pricing waterfalls, product rules, approvals, quote templates, renewals, and amendment models. 
 - Hands-on expertise with Apex, Lightning Web Components, Salesforce APIs, and integration frameworks. 
 - Strong understanding of enterprise architecture concepts (data, application, security, integration, DevOps). 
 - Good to Have Skills/Project Experience/Certifications 
 - Salesforce Revenue Cloud, or Industries (Vlocity) exposure. 
 - Experience in high-tech SaaS, manufacturing, or subscription-based business models

Education : 

- BE/B. Tech/M. C. A. /M. Sc (CS) degree or equivalent from accredited university

Location: 

- Bengaluru/Hyderabad/Pune/Chennai

About CodeRabbit

CodeRabbit is the governance and control layer for agentic software development, helping engineering teams trust the code they ship. AI can generate code faster than people can review and understand it. Teams still need to know whether each change solves the right problem, fits their architecture, and is safe to ship. 

We provide independent validation grounded in codebase context and team standards, giving people the evidence they need to judge what should ship. Across Review, Triage, Explain, and Secure, our platform challenges changes before merge, prioritizes pull requests by value, impact, and risk, explains what changed and why it matters, and monitors the codebase for security vulnerabilities after merge. 

CodeRabbit serves nearly 20, 000 customers and supports approximately 300, 000 open-source repositories, performing over 2 million code reviews each week. Our $143M Series C, raised at a $1. 5B valuation, supports further product development and international expansion.

Systems Development Engineering (SDE) at Google is a role where you manage services and systems at scale. SDEs creatively put their engineering discipline to use automating the mundane and reducing toil. We don't just write code to fix bugs, but emphasize the development of tools and solutions that fix classes of problems. We know it's hard to control what you can't measure - so we focus on observability: instrumenting first, then turning data into knowledge, and finally knowledge into action. We know that the operational efficiency of Google systems, services, virtual compute environments and the operating systems that power them impact the environment, not just the bottom line. We know that working together we can do more, and that community matters. 

Google brings together people with a wide variety of backgrounds, experiences and perspectives. We encourage them to collaborate, think big and take risks in a blame-free environment. We promote self-direction to work on meaningful projects, while we also strive to create an environment that provides the support and mentorship needed to learn and grow. 

Together we engineer and build the infrastructure, tools, access and telemetry for systems that enable orchestration of Google-scale services. Come build things that matter. 

The EDACloud Operations team defines processes for managing incidents to develop automation to ensure upgrades are rolled out safely and slowly. The team builds out monitoring for internal use as well as for the users to understand the state of the service, and debug when there are issues. 

Behind everything our users see online is the architecture built by the Technical Infrastructure team to keep it running. From developing and maintaining our data centers to building the next generation of Google platforms, we make Google's product portfolio possible. We're proud to be our engineers' engineers and love voiding warranties by taking things apart so we can rebuild them. We keep our networks up and running, ensuring our users have the best and fastest experience possible.

Position Description

Founded in 1976, CGI is among the largest independent IT and business consulting services firms in the world. With 94, 000 consultants and professionals across the globe, CGI delivers an end-to-end portfolio of capabilities, from strategic IT and business consulting to systems integration, managed IT and business process services and intellectual property solutions. Job Title: Manager Consulting Delivery (QA)

Position: Technical Manager + People Manager for QA/QE

Experience: 14+ Years (minimum 5+ years leading QA/QE teams, with hands-on technical depth)

Category: Quality Engineering / Test Automation / Delivery Management

Shift: General Shift, with overlap with US onsite counterparts as required

Location: Chennai

Position ID: 

Employment Type: Full-time, Permanent

Education Qualification: B. E. /B. Tech/MCA or equivalent in Computer Science, IT, or a related discipline

Position Description: 

We are looking for a hands-on Technical Manager and People Manager to lead an enthusiastic QA/QE team with strong AI awareness. Our current model is automation-heavy but still involves a lot of manual intervention. The role requires a clear understanding of the team's current technical challenges and the ability to transform it into a modern, AI-first Quality Engineering team through smarter automation and better engineering practices. 

Every Advantage release must go out on time and certified, with zero escaped regression defects and no last-minute surprises. The leader we want thinks like the client and acts like the client, holding quality to the standard the customer experiences in production, and treats customer delight as the measure of success. 

You will own the transformation of the QA/QE function and treat quality as an engineering discipline, building it into the pipeline, the code and the environment rather than testing it in at the end. You will drive disciplined flaky test management, faster pipelines through test sharding, parallel execution and test impact analysis, ephemeral Cloud environments that are spun up on demand and destroyed once testing is done, and a shift-left and shift-right approach in which production monitoring feeds back into test strategy. You will also strengthen performance and regression engineering so that quality improves with every release. 

You will make release and investment decisions from data such as flake rate, pipeline duration, defect leakage and DORA-style delivery metrics. You will act as a trusted quality advisor to leadership and the client, translating technical quality signals into business risk and release confidence, and balance speed, quality and cost, including cloud environment spend and automation maintenance effort. You will also bring the team along, building the skills, habits and confidence it needs to work this way. 

Your future duties and responsibilities

Responsibilities

Delivery and Release Ownership

- Own on-time, high-quality delivery of Advantage releases with zero regression issues, and be accountable for the quality outcome the customer experiences. 
 - Think like the client and act like the client: view quality from the customer's business perspective, anticipate what matters to them and make release decisions accordingly. 
 - Lead release certification end to end from the QA side, owning readiness assessment, quality gates, exit criteria, go/no-go inputs and sign-off. Step into an RTE-style role when required to coordinate across teams and keep releases on track. 
 - Own QA planning, capacity and delivery commitments across Agile sprints, Program Increments and feature releases, ensuring smooth delivery to UAT and Production and timely resolution of client issues. 

Quality Strategy and Governance

- Own the regression and performance testing strategy and its outcomes, covering scope, coverage, risk-based prioritization and continuous optimization of suites to remove redundancy and improve effectiveness. 
 - Define quality standards, governance and a metrics-driven improvement framework (defect leakage, regression cycle time, automation reliability, pipeline duration, defect detection effectiveness, cost of quality), and use the data to drive decisions. 
 - Set the direction for performance engineering, ensuring workload models, benchmarks and bottleneck analysis give early confidence in scalability and stability before release. 
 - Maintain clear, current documentation in Confluence, including QA strategy, release certification records, runbooks, test environment guides and lessons learned, so knowledge is shared and not held by individuals. 

Technical Leadership and Transformation

- Take ownership of chronic reliability and speed issues such as flaky tests, recurring suite failures and long-running pipelines. Diagnose systemic root causes, set stabilization and optimization priorities, and hold the team accountable for sustained improvement in reliability and execution time. 
 - Periodically audit the automation tech stack, frameworks and tooling, assess fitness, maintainability and cost, and set the direction to upgrade or transform when it is justified. Make these decisions based on value, not change for its own sake. 
 - Lead the transformation of test environments from PDC to Cloud (Azure/AWS), enabling on-demand environments that are spun up for testing and destroyed once done, in partnership with DevOps and with cost optimization in mind. 
 - Champion AI-driven Quality Engineering across test design, automation, failure triage and maintenance, with measurable productivity and cycle-time gains. 
 - Drive continuous testing and quality gates in CI/CD, working with DevOps to make releases faster and more predictable. 
 - Foster a culture of innovation, continuously evaluating emerging tools and practices and bringing in those that improve outcomes. 

Stakeholder and People Leadership

- Partner with Product Engineering, Product Management, DevOps and onsite counterparts to surface quality risks early, and escalate risks to leadership with clear mitigation options. 
 - Communicate quality status, delivery risks and improvement plans to senior leadership and client stakeholders through clear presentations and dashboards. 
 - Build and lead a high-performing QA/QE team by setting goals, coaching, developing technical depth and succession, managing performance and fostering a quality-first culture of accountability and ownership. 

Required Qualifications To Be Successful In This Role

Must-Have Skills

- 14+ years of IT experience, with strong experience leading QA/QE teams and delivering large-scale programs (US state and local government experience preferred). 
 - Proven track record of release ownership and certification with consistently low regression leakage. 
 - Proven experience transforming a QA team into a modern, automation-first and AI-enabled Quality Engineering team. 
 - Strong people management skills, including team building, coaching, performance management, conflict resolution and capacity planning.

data.title: Warehouse Automation Manager, Engineering
data.description:
Description

Are you passionate about designing automation solutions that improve how millions of packages move through a fulfillment network? Amazon is looking for a Warehouse Automation Manager to drive innovation and product development for material handling equipment (MHE) across our operations. In this role, you will own the automation roadmap - from early-stage concept engineering and prototype design through vendor development and full-scale rollout. You will research emerging technologies, evaluate cost-effective alternatives, and collaborate with Safety, Maintenance, Process Engineering, and Finance teams to deliver solutions that increase productivity and capacity. If you thrive on turning ideas into real-world systems that operate at scale, we want to hear from you. 

Key job responsibilities

- Design and standardize automation prototypes for conveyors, lifts, and other MHE, managing the full lifecycle from concept engineering through implementation and performance qualification. 
 - Build and own the automation roadmap by researching new technologies, benchmarking industry best practices, and evaluating alternative solutions that balance quality, cost, and operational impact. 
 - Collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders - including Safety, Maintenance, Process Engineering, and Finance - to develop material flow layouts and engineering specifications for new and existing facilities. 
 - Lead vendor qualification, development, and management activities including preparation of Requests for Information (RFI), Requests for Quotation (RFQ), and scopes of work, while driving techno-commercial discussions with procurement and project teams. 
 - Leverage generative artificial intelligence (GenAI) tools and data-driven analysis to identify process improvements, optimize designs, and accelerate solution development cycles. 

A day in the life

You will start your week reviewing progress in business review forums, aligning priorities against the automation roadmap, and adjusting plans based on operational feedback. Much of your time is spent independently - prototyping concepts, analyzing power requirements, and refining engineering specifications - then shifting into collaborative sessions with partner teams to pressure-test designs and resolve technical trade-offs. You will stay connected to the professional community and market trends, bringing fresh ideas back to the team to keep solutions affordable and forward-looking. 

About The Team

Our team is on a mission to strengthen Amazon's automation charter by creating innovative MHE solutions that scale operations across fulfillment buildings. We work at the intersection of mechanical engineering, controls, and product development, turning ideas into systems that move real packages every day. Senior leaders provide strategic vision while team members take ownership of execution, building expertise through self-directed learning and engagement with the broader engineering community. This is a team where your work directly translates into measurable productivity and capacity gains. 

Basic Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree
 - Experience of automated equipment including packaging machinery, sortation and conveyor systems
 - Experience with Kaizen and Continuous Improvement Process

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience in a fast-paced, automated, industrial, logistics, production or manufacturing environment
 - Experience in preventative maintenance systems

data.title: Principal Firmware/Diagnostics Engineer
data.description:
At F5, we strive to bring a better digital world to life. Our teams empower organizations across the globe to create, secure, and run applications that enhance how we experience our evolving digital world. We are passionate about cybersecurity, from protecting consumers from fraud to enabling companies to focus on innovation. 

Everything we do centers around people. That means we obsess over how to make the lives of our customers, and their customers, better. And it means we prioritize a diverse F5 community where each individual can thrive. 

Job Description

F5 is seeking an accomplished Principal Firmware/Diagnostics Engineer to lead the development of reliable, secure, and serviceable firmware and diagnostics across the full product lifecycle, from hardware bring‐up and boot loaders through runtime services and field upgrades. As a key member of the Hardware Development Team, you will provide technical leadership and mentoring, drive roadmap execution and elevate engineering excellence, and partner cross‐functionally to deliver platform capabilities that delight customers and meet stringent security and compliance expectations (e. g. , secure boot, code signing, measured boot). This role requires deep expertise in firmware/software design and the ability to influence architecture decisions, ensure design excellence, and foster innovation. 

Key Responsibilities: 

- Uphold F5's Business Code of Ethics and promptly report violations of the Code or other company policies. 
 - Act as a technical authority, establishing standards for secure boot, code‐signing, anti‐rollback protections, measured boot, vulnerability remediation, and incident response. 
 - Lead firmware and diagnostics design for new products, including architecture definition, functional specifications, and requirements development. Work with cross-functional teams to align requirements and shepherd PRDs into executable plans. 
 - Assist in the planning of work across boot, board bring‐up, drivers, runtime services, manufacturing/test firmware, and in‐field update mechanisms. 
 - Define telemetry, detection, and recovery strategies for firmware integrity, and align to relevant standards (e. g. , FIPS 140‐3, FedRAMP implications as applicable). 
 - Define automated build, test, and validation, ensuring repeatable releases and traceable artifacts across SKUs. 
 - Drive design for manufacturability, testability, and reliability across all phases of development. Partner with MFG and Global Services to define factory programming, golden images, and resilient upgrade strategies (A/B, recovery partitions). 
 - Research and evaluate emerging technologies to enhance existing products and guide new product directions. 
 - Oversee and mentor engineers, providing technical guidance and reviewing work to ensure quality and efficiency. Serve and guide other team members through challenges, assuring their growth and project success
 - Conduct internal and external technical presentations and disseminate knowledge within the Hardware Development Team. 
 - Develop and maintain schedules for deliverables, ensuring timely and high-quality documentation and testing through holistic ownership over assigned product areas and projects. Provide status, risks, and decisions to leadership; translate technical details into business outcomes. 
 - Interface with suppliers and manufacturing partners for validation and issue resolution. 
 - Support sustaining engineering for legacy products and assist in manufacturing training for new designs. 
 - Participate in design reviews and contribute to continuous improvement of design processes and standards. 

Qualifications: 

Required: 

- Understand and comply with F5 internal processes and requirements. 
 - BS in Computer Science or equivalent required; MS in Computer Science is desirable. 
 - 10+ years of experience in embedded/firmware engineering. 
 - Advanced troubleshooting skills at board and system levels. 
 - Extensive experience in the following: 
 - Arm/x86 platforms, embedded Linux, secure elements, and measured boot pipelines. 
 - C/C++, low‐level debugging, and board bring‐up (oscilloscope/logic analyzer/JTAG). 
 - AMI Aptio V UEFI BIOS, OpenBMC, AMI MegaRAC/SPX, IPMI and Redfish. 
 - Boot architecture (UEFI/BIOS, bootloaders), BMC, PFR, TPM, SPI/QSPI flash, IO peripherals, and runtime firmware. 
 - Buses/protocols (I2C/I3C, SPI, UART, DDR, PCIe, GPIO, PMIC), and memory/storage (NOR/NAND, DRAM, SSD). 
 - Security protocols and knowledge of multiple Platform Root of Trust devices and secure boot mechanisms. 
 - Source code version control tools such as Git and GitLab. 
 - CI/CD and Agile software development. 
 - Prior work with factory programming, golden image workflows, and recovery strategies (A/B, rollback protections). 
 - Exposure to cloud‐connected devices and policy/version orchestration across fleets. 
 - Familiarity with relevant industry standards and compliance requirements. 
 - Excellent communication and cross-functional collaboration skills. 

Preferred: 

- Compliance and security standards (e. g. , FIPS 140‐3, NIST SP 800-193).

data.title: Silicon & Data Automation Systems Software Engineer, Staff
data.description:
Company

Qualcomm India Private Limited

Job Area

Engineering Group, Engineering Group > ASICS Engineering

General Summary

We are seeking a highly motivated and technically strong Staff Engineer, Silicon & Data Automation Systems to help build and expand a growing automation team supporting silicon and system yield engineering, spanning design, DFT, diagnostics, and yield engineering workflows. This role will focus on developing production-grade automation, data pipelines, database-backed applications, and engineering tools that improve the speed, quality, and scalability of complex semiconductor engineering workflows. 

This position is part of a broader effort to increase automation capacity within the silicon engineering organization, beginning with new engineering roles in the Bangalore Design Center (BDC). The engineer will work closely with U. S. -based yield automation leadership and stakeholders, including regular overlap with U. S. Central Time morning hours. 

This is a senior individual contributor role. The successful candidate will build new automation capabilities under architectural guidance, contribute to robust production systems, and use modern AI-assisted engineering practices to increase development velocity and quality. This role requires an AI-first engineering mindset, where LLM-based coding agents and AI-assisted automation tools are used as core productivity multipliers while maintaining strong human ownership of correctness, security, review, and production safety. 

The ideal candidate is a strong Linux, data, database, and automation engineer who can work effectively in complex semiconductor engineering environments. Prior experience with semiconductor engineering domains such as silicon design, DFT, validation, diagnostics, or yield is strongly preferred but not required for candidates with strong automation and data engineering depth. 

Minimum Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Electrical/Electronics Engineering, Engineering, or related field and 4+ years of Hardware Engineering or related work experience. 

OR

Master's degree in Computer Science, Electrical/Electronics Engineering, Engineering, or related field and 3+ years of Hardware Engineering or related work experience. 

OR

PhD in Computer Science, Electrical/Electronics Engineering, Engineering, or related field and 2+ years of Hardware Engineering or related work experience. 

Automation Development & Production Engineering

- Design, develop, test, and maintain automation tools that improve silicon and system yield engineering workflows, including data processing, diagnostics, reporting, and operation efficiency. 
 - Build reliable Linux-based automation services, scripts, data loaders, and backend systems used by engineering teams. 
 - Develop production-grade solutions with appropriate logging, monitoring, error handling, alerting, documentation, and operational supportability. 
 - Contribute to systems that are maintainable, fault-tolerant, secure, and suitable for long-running production use. 
 - Debug and resolve automation issues across Linux servers, databases, file systems, scheduled jobs, data feeds, and dependent engineering systems. 
 - Work under architectural guidance to implement new automation capabilities while developing deeper ownership of specific tools, workflows, or data domains over time. 

Data Systems & Database Automation

- Build and maintain data pipelines that collect, transform, validate, and load engineering and manufacturing data across design, DFT, validation, diagnostics, and yield-related systems.

data.title: Agentic AI Evaluation Engineer
data.description:
At EY, you'll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we're counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all. 

EY- Assurance - Senior - Digital

Role: GenAI / Agentic AI Evaluation Engineer (Quality, Safety & Reliability)

Position Details

As part of EY GDS Assurance Digital, you will help design, build, and scale a standardized evaluation capability, focused on evaluating GenAI, RAG-based, and Agentic AI solutions before deployment. 

This role sits at the intersection of AI evaluation engineering, Responsible AI, and GenAI security/red teaming. The primary objective is to ensure GenAI/agentic systems are safe, reliable, robust, and fit-for-purpose, by designing evaluation strategies, building repeatable test harnesses, and generating auditable evidence that supports go/no-go decisions. 

You will work with global stakeholders (product teams, solution architects, risk & compliance, and assurance leadership) to define evaluation requirements, request test datasets from product teams, execute rigorous evaluations (functional + non-functional), and recommend mitigations and controls to reduce risk. 

This is a core full-time role that requires a hands-on AI Development mindset, strong evaluation mindset, and the ability to translate risk concerns into practical testing strategies and measurable acceptance criteria. 

Responsibilities

- Define and operationalize evaluation strategies for GenAI systems across use cases like Q&A assistants, summarization, extraction, drafting, agentic systems, and multi-step workflows. 
 - Translate business use-cases into a structured evaluation plan: scope, assumptions, success criteria, datasets, metrics, red-team scenarios, thresholds, and reporting requirements. 
 - Drive standardization: reusable evaluation templates, test case libraries, scoring rubrics, and reporting formats across product teams. 
 - Design structured dataset requirements for product teams and ensure coverage across: 
 - Core user journeys and primary business intents
 - Edge cases (rare prompts, ambiguous queries, incomplete context)
 - Adversarial cases (malicious prompts, jailbreak attempts, prompt injections)
 - Bias & fairness cases (sensitive demographic proxies, protected attributes, stereotyping patterns)
 - Define guidance for dataset sufficiency and statistical coverage (e. g. , minimum samples, distribution balance, scenario matrices, stratification by intent/risk). 
 - Build reusable evaluation pipelines for: 
 - Answer quality (correctness, relevance, completeness, clarity)
 - Grounding & faithfulness (RAG-specific: faithfulness, context precision/recall, hallucination rate, citation quality)
 - Agentic behavior (tool-call accuracy, tool misuse, goal completion, step correctness, unnecessary actions, loop detection, safety of tool outputs)
 - Operational quality (latency, cost/token budget, throughput, stability, retries, failure recovery)
 - Combine LLM-as-judge and human evaluation in a calibrated way (rubric design, sampling plans, agreement checks). 
 - Implement automated evaluation harnesses in Python (preferred), enabling: 
 - batch runs on scenario suites
 - configurable metric definitions
 - reproducible runs with run IDs and artifacts
 - storage of traces and outputs for auditability
 - Execute structured red teaming aligned to OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications, covering (examples): 
 - Prompt injection (direct + indirect) and tool hijacking
 - Sensitive data disclosure / PII leakage
 - Insecure output handling (downstream injection)
 - Training data leakage / memorization probes
 - Model denial-of-service / denial-of-wallet patterns
 - Integrate evals into development lifecycle: pre-release regression gates, CI checks, benchmark comparisons across model versions/prompts/tools/retrievers. 
 - Perform adversarial testing for agentic workflows: 
 - tool misuse / over-permissioned tool access
 - unauthorized action execution
 - exfiltration via tools/connectors
 - prompt injection via retrieved documents (RAG poisoning)
 - Recommend mitigations: input validation, retrieval filtering, tool sandboxing, least-privilege permissions, guardrails, policy prompting, refusal logic, output encoding, monitoring alerts. 
 - Produce high-quality evaluation reports that are auditable and decision-ready, including: 
 - methodology, datasets, metrics, thresholds
 - quantitative results
 - qualitative results
 - risk assessment summary and recommended control actions
 - Present findings to stakeholders in a crisp, risk-informed manner; clearly explain residual risk, limitations, and rationale for go/no-go. 

Key Requirements/Skills & Qualification: 

- Excellent academic background, including at a minimum a bachelor's or a master's degree in data science, Statistics, Engineering, Operational Research, or other related field with strong focus on modern data architectures, processes, and environments. 
 - 4-7+ years of relevant experience in one or more areas: 
 - ML/AI/GenAI/Agentic engineering (NLP/LLMs), evaluation engineering, applied research
 - security testing / red teaming
 - building and designing evaluation harness that ensures safety, reliability and robustness. 
 - Strong hands-on Python for building evaluation harnesses (data processing, metric computation, orchestration, reporting pipelines). 
 - Practical understanding of GenAI system architectures: RAG, embeddings/vector search, prompt orchestration, tool calling, multi-agent systems, memory, routing. 
 - Experience designing metrics and evaluation methods (rubrics, automated scoring, sampling strategy, regression design). 
 - Familiarity with LLM risks and mitigations, especially for enterprise contexts (data leakage, hallucinations, prompt injection, unsafe content, bias). 
 - Security / Red Teaming Skills (Strong Preference)
 - Understanding of OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications and how to translate it into test cases and controls. 
 - Experience with adversarial testing approaches: jailbreak prompts, injection patterns, tool misuse scenarios, retrieval poisoning patterns. 
 - Familiarity with secure-by-design practices for LLM apps: least privilege, safe tool invocation, output encoding/validation, monitoring. 
 - Evaluation frameworks and tooling: RAGAS, DeepEval, LangSmith, Phoenix/Arize, custom eval harnesses. 
 - Experimentation practices: A/B testing mindset, baseline comparisons, statistical rigor for sample sizes. 
 - Observability/tracing: structured logging, OpenTelemetry, Langfuse-style traces, dashboards. 
 - Basic DevOps practices: Git, CI/CD, containerization (Docker), reproducible environments. 
 - Strong written communication to produce clear evaluation plans and reports for technical + non-technical stakeholders. 
 - Ability to challenge assumptions constructively ("effective challenge") and influence engineering teams toward remediation. 
 - Comfort operating in ambiguity with fast-evolving GenAI tooling and risk landscape. 

Preferred / Nice-to-Have

- Experience in Assurance/Finance/Regulatory environments (model validation, risk acceptance workflows, audit evidence mindset). 
 - Familiarity with responsible AI frameworks (NIST AI RMF, ISO/IEC 42001, EU AI Act concepts). 
 - Experience evaluating multilingual systems or domain-heavy enterprise assistants. 
 - Hands-on with Azure ecosystem (Azure OpenAI, AI Search, Function Apps, App Insights, Key Vault). 

Additional skills requirements: 

- Excellent written, oral, presentation and facilitation skills
 - Ability to coordinate multiple projects and initiatives simultaneously through effective prioritization, organization, flexibility, and self-discipline. 
 - Must have demonstrated project management experience. 
 - Knowledge of firm's reporting tools and processes. 
 - Proactive, organized, and self-sufficient with ability to priorities and multitask. 
 - Analyses complex or unusual problems and can deliver insightful and pragmatic solutions. 
 - Ability to quickly and easily create/ gather/ analyze data from a variety of sources. 
 - A robust and resilient disposition able to encourage discipline in team behaviors

What We Look For

- A Team of people with commercial acumen, technical experience, and enthusiasm to learn new things in this fast-moving environment
 - An opportunity to be a part of market-leading, multi-disciplinary team of 7200 + professionals, in the only integrated global assurance business worldwide. 
 - Opportunities to work with EY GDS Assurance practices globally with leading businesses across a range of industries

What Working At EY Offers

At EY, we're dedicated to helping our clients, from startups to Fortune 500 companies - and the work we do with them is as varied as they are. 

You get to work with inspiring and meaningful projects. Our focus is education and coaching alongside practical experience to ensure your personal development. We value our employees, and you will be able to control your own development with an individual progression plan. You will quickly grow into a responsible role with challenging and stimulating assignments. Moreover, you will be part of an interdisciplinary environment that emphasizes high quality and knowledge exchange. Plus, we offer: 

- Support, coaching and feedback from some of the most engaging colleagues around
 - Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career
 - The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that's right for you

EY | Building a better working world

EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets. 

Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate. 

Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

data.description:

Our Enterprise Platform team aspires to be a leader by applying technology to power business strategies. We connect concepts with solutions to create value and efficiencies for our employees and customers. Our success is driven by our skilled and diverse team who are passionate about excellence, innovation, and agility. 

As the Senior Salesforce Test Automation Engineer, you will lead the expansion of automated quality engineering across our Salesforce ecosystem, with primary ownership for establishing Cypress. io as a scalable, maintainable, and trusted enterprise test automation capability. You will combine hands-on automation engineering with technical leadership, partnering with developers, administrators, product owners, business analysts, release engineering, and quality engineers to improve release confidence, shorten feedback cycles, and reduce reliance on repetitive manual regression testing. 

Responsibilities: 

- Lead the design, implementation, and ongoing evolution of a Cypress. io automation framework for Salesforce applications, Experience Cloud, integrated web applications, and critical end-to-end business processes. 
 - Define automation architecture, coding standards, repository structure, reusable commands, fixtures, test-data patterns, environment configuration, tagging, and reporting conventions that support maintainability and scale. 
 - Develop and maintain reliable automated suites for smoke, regression, integration, end-to-end, API, and selected component-testing scenarios, balancing UI coverage with faster API-based setup and validation where appropriate. 
 - Create a pragmatic automation roadmap that prioritizes high-risk, high-volume, and business-critical Salesforce journeys and converts the existing regression inventory into a sustainable Cypress test portfolio. 
 - Design resilient approaches for Salesforce-specific automation challenges, including dynamic Lightning DOM behavior, asynchronous processing, authentication, role-based access, complex data dependencies, integrations, and multi-environment execution. 
 - Integrate Cypress execution into CI/CD pipelines and release workflows, including pull-request validation, scheduled regression runs, pre-release quality gates, test result publishing, screenshots, videos, and failure diagnostics. 
 - Establish test observability and quality metrics such as automation coverage, pass rate, execution time, flaky-test rate, defect escape trends, failure causes, and manual effort avoided; use insights to drive continuous improvement. 
 - Build secure, repeatable test-data and credential-management practices across Salesforce sandboxes and connected systems, partnering with platform, security, and DevOps teams to protect sensitive information. 
 - Perform hands-on exploratory, functional, integration, regression, and release-readiness testing when automation is not yet available or when human judgment provides better coverage. 
 - Partner with product owners, business analysts, solution architects, developers, and administrators to make requirements testable and to strengthen acceptance criteria, negative scenarios, risk analysis, and definition-of-done standards. 
 - Troubleshoot failed tests and application defects, distinguish product issues from automation issues, document reproducible evidence, and collaborate with engineering teams through resolution. 
 - Review automation code, mentor quality engineers and developers, provide technical guidance, and promote engineering practices that treat automated tests as production-quality software. 
 - Evaluate Cypress. io capabilities, plugins, Cypress Cloud features, and AI-assisted test authoring; recommend adoption based on security, maintainability, cost, measurable value, and enterprise standards. 
 - Contribute to QA governance, release management, Agile ceremonies, test planning, risk reviews, and continuous improvement across the software development lifecycle. 

Qualifications: 

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. 
 - 7+ years of software quality engineering and test automation experience, including 3+ years testing Salesforce solutions in complex enterprise environments. 
 - Advanced hands-on experience building and maintaining Cypress. io automation using JavaScript or TypeScript, with strong understanding of selectors, custom commands, fixtures, network interception, retries, asynchronous behavior, and test isolation. 
 - Demonstrated experience designing an automation framework or materially scaling an existing framework across teams, applications, or release trains. 
 - Strong Salesforce testing experience across Lightning Experience and one or more of Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Experience Cloud, CPQ/commerce, custom Apex and Lightning Web Components, integrations, or platform automation. 
 - Experience with API testing, including REST and GraphQL patterns, authentication, request/response validation, data setup, and combining API and UI tests. 
 - Experience integrating automated tests into CI/CD pipelines and source-control workflows using tools such as GitHub or Bitbucket and pipeline technologies such as GitHub Actions, Jenkins, Azure DevOps, or equivalent. 
 - Experience with test management, defect lifecycle, and work-management tools such as Jira, Xray, Confluence, or equivalent. 
 - Experience developing quality strategies, risk-based test plans, automation backlogs, traceability, release-readiness assessments, and meaningful quality reporting in Agile/Scrum environments. 
 - Experience diagnosing flaky tests, improving suite performance, handling parallel execution, and maintaining reliable automation across multiple environments and data states. 

Skills: 

- Expert-level analytical and troubleshooting skills, with the ability to isolate failures across the UI, Salesforce platform, APIs, integrations, test data, and automation framework. 
 - Strong software engineering fundamentals, including modular design, version control, code review, debugging, documentation, and maintainable test-code practices. 
 - Ability to translate business processes and technical architecture into clear, risk-based automated test coverage. 
 - Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain quality risks, trade-offs, and recommendations to technical and non-technical stakeholders. 
 - Demonstrated leadership through influence, mentorship, collaboration, and ownership of cross-team outcomes. 
 - Ability to work independently, navigate ambiguity, prioritize effectively, and balance immediate release needs with long-term automation health. 

Preferred Qualifications: 

- Salesforce Administrator, Platform App Builder, Platform Developer I, or relevant Salesforce Consultant certification. 
 - Cypress certification, recognized test automation certification, or equivalent evidence of deep Cypress expertise. 
 - Experience with Cypress Cloud capabilities such as recorded runs, test replay, analytics, flaky-test insights, parallelization, and enterprise reporting. 
 - Experience with Okta or SSO-enabled test authentication and secure automated credential management. 
 - Familiarity with accessibility testing, performance testing, AI-assisted test generation, and complementary tools such as Postman, SoapUI, Selenium, Playwright, or Jest. 
 - Experience modernizing or migrating an automation portfolio from a commercial or legacy testing platform to Cypress. io. 

What Success Looks Like: 

- Cypress. io is established as a governed, secure, and reusable automation capability for Salesforce delivery. 
 - Critical business journeys have reliable automated coverage and provide fast, actionable feedback before releases. 
 - CI/CD pipelines consistently execute the right tests at the right stage, with clear evidence for failures and release decisions. 
 - Flaky tests, duplicated effort, and manual regression time decline as framework quality, test data, and team adoption improve. 
 - Developers and quality engineers contribute to a shared automation codebase using consistent standards and effective code reviews. 
 - Quality metrics clearly communicate risk, progress, and business value to engineering and leadership stakeholders. 

Why Join Us?

- Shape the test automation strategy for a business-critical Salesforce platform and influence quality engineering practices across teams. 
 - Lead a high-visibility Cypress. io implementation with opportunities to modernize delivery, improve engineering velocity, and reduce release risk. 
 - Work with a collaborative, forward-thinking team investing in Salesforce, AI-enabled engineering, and enterprise platform transformation. 
 - Access ongoing professional development, technical learning, and Salesforce certification opportunities. 
 - Competitive compensation and benefits. 

Location: 

- India - (Flexible hybrid work model - work from Bangalore office for 20 days in a quarter)

Delivery & Engineering Excellence

Leadership

data.description:
Role description
Job Title: Senior / Lead Big Data Engineer
Experience: 9 - 15 Years
Location: Bangalore (Hybrid)
Mode of interview: 2 Virtual+1 in-person
# of roles: 2
Notice period: Immediate to 30 Days joiners only

About the Role
We are looking for a seasoned Senior/Lead Data Engineer with 9 to 15 years of experience to architect, build, and optimize large-scale data platforms. In this role, you will bridge the gap between complex big data infrastructure, functional business domains, and enterprise AI initiatives. Beyond taking end-to-end ownership of batch data pipelines that process massive customer and behavioral datasets, you will play a key leadership role in building, mentoring, and scaling a high-performing data engineering team. 

Key Responsibilities
Platform Optimization & Governance
Performance Tuning: Proactively troubleshoot and fine-tune complex Spark and Hive/HQL jobs to reduce latency, optimize memory usage, and manage cluster resource allocation (YARN). 
Data Quality & Reliability: Establish automated data validation frameworks, lineage tracking, and strict SLA monitoring to guarantee data accuracy and platform reliability. 
Platform Operations: Oversee on-prem big data platform stability, capacity planning, and workflow orchestration using Airflow. 
Team Building & Technical Leadership
Build & Scale the Team: Partner with leadership to hire, onboard, and build a strong data engineering team from the ground up. 

Mentorship & Guidance: Provide hands-on technical leadership, conduct architecture and code reviews, and mentor junior and mid-level engineers. 
Engineering Standards: Establish and enforce best practices around Git version control, code quality, documentation, and Agile delivery methodologies. 

Architecture & Pipeline Development
End-to-End ETL Ownership: Architect, develop, and maintain scalable, fault-tolerant batch ETL/ELT pipelines across on-premises Hadoop-based data platforms. 
Large-Scale Data Processing: Design high-throughput data ingestion and transformation workflows for massive customer and behavioral datasets. 
Data Modeling: Lead dimensional and relational data modeling efforts to support enterprise analytics, reporting, and downstream AI solutions. 
Functional Alignment & Cross-Team Collaboration
Business & Functional Translation: Translate complex functional business requirements into scalable technical data architectures, ensuring data assets directly solve business challenges. 
Cross-Functional Partnership: Collaborate closely with analytics, product, and AI teams to understand data needs and deliver reliable, analytics-ready datasets. 

Qualifications & Skills
Educational Qualification
B. E. or B. Tech in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related engineering discipline. 

Mandatory Qualifications
Experience: 9 to 15 years of progressive experience in Data Engineering, with deep hands-on expertise in Hadoop-based big data ecosystems (HDFS, YARN). 
Leadership: Proven experience leading engineering initiatives and building or mentoring technical teams. 
Big Data Stack: Expert-level proficiency in Apache Spark (Core, Spark SQL, PySpark) and Apache Hive / HQL. 
Programming & Querying: Strong command of Python and advanced SQL, paired with solid experience in enterprise data modeling. 
Pipeline Engineering: Proven track record of designing and maintaining production-grade batch ETL pipelines. 
AI & Functional Acumen: Practical experience working on data initiatives supporting AI applications, combined with strong functional business understanding. 
Version Control: Proficient in Git for collaborative software development. 

Preferred Qualifications
Domain Experience: Prior experience working with e-commerce platforms and processing high-volume customer/transactional datasets is an added advantage. 
Workflow Orchestration: Hands-on experience managing complex DAGs and schedules using Apache Airflow or Oozie. 
Infrastructure & Tuning: Deep understanding of on-premise big data platform operations and advanced performance tuning for Hive and Spark workloads. 
Methodology: Familiarity with Agile/Scrum development methodologies.

Who We Are

VOIS (Vodafone Intelligent Solutions) is a strategic arm of Vodafone Group Plc, creating value for customers by delivering intelligent solutions through Talent, Technology & Transformation. 

As the largest shared services organisation in the global telco industry with 30, 000 FTE, our portfolio of next-generation solutions and services are designed in partnership with customers across Vodafone Group, local markets, and partner markets to simplify and drive growth. We work with customers across 28 countries from 10 VOIS locations: Albania, Egypt, Hungary, India, Romania, Spain, Turkey, UK, Germany, Ireland, and with a network of teams in Czech Republic, Italy, Greece, and Portugal.

About This Role

We are seeking a Cloud DevOps Engineer with hands-on expertise in cloud infrastructure, container orchestration, automation, CI/CD and observability. You will independently manage and improve cloud infrastructure across development and operational environments, with particular focus on Microsoft Azure, Azure OpenAI Services, AWS, AKS/EKS, Kubernetes, networking, security and monitoring. 

The role combines cloud engineering and DevOps with operational responsibilities including incident, problem, change, release and deployment management. You will work closely with development teams to automate delivery, troubleshoot complex infrastructure and application issues, improve reliability and support secure, scalable cloud environments. 

What You'll Do

- Maintain and continuously improve cloud and DevOps infrastructure, including continuous integration infrastructure, build platforms, test systems and development environments

 - Monitor applications and infrastructure using tools such as Dynatrace, Instana, Grafana and Datadog

 - Apply ITIL practices across incident resolution, Incident Management, Problem Management, Change Management and deployment 
 - Perform root-cause analysis, identify known errors and coordinate corrective actions 
 - Support release and deployment activities within Unix/Linux-based environments 
 - Apply Git branching, tagging and versioning strategies across software repositories 
 - Support build and continuous integration activities using Maven and Gradle 
 - Contribute effectively within DevOps and Agile/Scrum delivery teams

Who You Are

- You have excellent knowledge of cloud platforms and services, particularly Microsoft Azure, AWS and/or Google Cloud Platform (GCP) 
 - You have hands-on experience managing cloud infrastructure and setting up monitoring and reporting 
 - You have strong expertise in DevOps, automation and CI/CD/CT practices 
 - You have hands-on experience with containers, Kubernetes and cluster creation and deployment using AKS and EKS 
 - You understand cloud networking, DNS, security and encryption 
 - You have experience with scripting languages such as Bash, Python or Ruby 
 - You have experience with Terraform, Ansible, AWS CloudFormation, GitHub Actions and/or Jenkins 
 - You understand Git branching, tagging and versioning strategies 
 - You have experience with build tools such as Maven and Gradle 
 - You have strong knowledge of observability and log analysis, with exposure to Dynatrace, Instana, Grafana, Datadog and Fluentd 
 - You understand NoSQL technologies such as Azure Cosmos DB, MongoDB and Cassandra 
 - You have practical knowledge of ITIL processes, particularly Incident Management, Problem Management, Change Management, release and deployment 
 - You have experience using ticketing and work management tools such as Remedy and Jira 
 - You have experience with configuration management and software deployment across multiple environments 
 - You understand Spring application development and the Spring Boot framework 
 - You have practical experience with Microsoft Azure OpenAI Services, networking, firewalls, Azure API Management (APIM) and related generative AI services 
 - You have a good understanding of the Apigee platform and API configuration 
 - You bring analytical troubleshooting and root-cause analysis skills, alongside a collaborative approach to problem solving 
 - You communicate clearly, work effectively within a team and navigate disagreements constructively 
 - Knowledge of Java is beneficial 
 - Microsoft Azure and/or AWS certifications are beneficial 
 - Experience working across international, multi-location teams is beneficial 
 - You are comfortable learning new technologies, working independently and focusing on measurable outcomes 
 - You understand software development and service management processes, including SDLC and ITIL, and can contribute to process improvement and innovation

Not a perfect fit?

Concerned you may not meet every requirement? Vodafone is committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive. If you are excited about this role but your experience does not align exactly with every aspect of the job description, you are encouraged to apply. You may be the right candidate for this or another opportunity, and the recruitment team will support you in exploring where your skills fit best. 

What's In It For You

- Exposure to cloud engineering across Microsoft Azure and AWS environments 
 - Opportunities to work with Azure OpenAI Services and related generative AI technologies 
 - Hands-on experience with Kubernetes environments using AKS and EKS 
 - Opportunities to contribute across cloud infrastructure, DevOps automation, observability, API management and secure deployments

What Skills You Will Learn
