data.title: Engineering Manager
data.description:
About the Role**

We are looking for a CJA Developer to build and maintain features across a React Native mobile app and a React web app, with a focus on Adobe Customer Journey Analytics integration. You will work in a TypeScript codebase, write tested and maintainable code, and handle health data responsibly in line with security, privacy, and HIPAA requirements. As a key link between business stakeholders, product managers, and development teams, you will ensure that digital customer interactions, user journeys, and lifecycle milestones are accurately captured and structured to deliver meaningful, actionable insights for decision-making. You should be able to own features independently with light guidance. 

**Job Title**

CJA Developer. 

**Responsibilities**

- Build and maintain features across a React Native mobile app for iOS and Android, and a React web app using TypeScript. 
 - Implement and maintain Adobe Customer Journey Analytics tracking across mobile and web, ensuring behavioral metrics, engagement milestones, and user pathing are consistently captured across all features and user flows. 
 - Instrument and monitor app lifecycle events such as application launches, session durations, and user retention events. 
 - Collaborate with business and product teams to translate business questions and strategic goals into clear data tracking requirements. 
 - Validate that captured data flows seamlessly into Customer Journey Analytics, central reporting systems, and business dashboards. 
 - Integrate REST APIs and manage application state using React Query. 
 - Write unit tests and conduct regular validation to ensure data accuracy across new application releases and feature updates. 
 - Diagnose and resolve data tracking discrepancies, missing events, and reporting anomalies. 
 - Participate in structured pre-release reviews to proactively identify data gaps before features launch to production. 
 - Partner with Product Owners, Business Analysts, and Design teams during planning phases to embed analytics requirements into upcoming projects. 
 - Follow standard Git and code review workflows, and contribute to peer code reviews. 
 - Create and maintain technical documentation, tracking guides, and release notes for internal stakeholders. 
 - Ensure all data collection and handling practices comply with governance policies, user consent requirements, HIPAA, and industry privacy standards. 

**Required Skills**

- JavaScript and TypeScript. 
 - REST API integration and state management using React Query. 
 - Adobe Analytics experience, ideally Adobe Experience Platform or Customer Journey Analytics, or strong general web and mobile analytics event tracking experience that is transferable. 
 - Writing unit tests using Jest or a similar framework. 
 - Git and standard code review workflows. 
 - Awareness of data privacy and handling sensitive data in a regulated environment. 

**Desirable Skills**

- React, including hooks and component patterns. 
 - React Native mobile app development for iOS and Android. 
 - Expo mobile framework experience. 
 - Adobe Experience Platform Mobile SDK, Adobe Assurance, XDM schemas, and consent or identity handling. 

**Education Qualification**

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Software Engineering, or a related field. 
 - Equivalent practical experience in frontend development, mobile development, or analytics implementation may also be considered.

The job responsibilities outlined in this document are not exhaustive and may evolve over time and be reviewed according to business needs. 

Role Description Summary

SES has an exciting opportunity for a Senior Engineer. You will be part of a team responsible for

- Portal software design, governing scalable architectural improvements along with team productivity, scalability, simplification and quality improvements
 - Driving architectural alignment and long-term technical strategy across multiple teams. 
 - Leading feature refinements and ensuring end-to-end delivery of high-quality, reliable solutions. 
 - Enabling predictable delivery through strong architectural judgment and technical mentorship. 
 - Ensuring long-term maintainability, operational excellence, and system health. 
 - Partnering closely with product, platform, and external stakeholders to deliver scalable solutions. 
 - Leading the team using Agile principles to ensure clarity, focus, and delivery alignment
 - Preparing and guiding the team through PI Planning and sprint commitments
 - Maintaining hands-on involvement in coding, design, and problem-solving
 - Guiding the team in following best coding standards, engineering practices and effective use of AI
 - Improving team productivity, code quality, and technical excellence

Primary Responsibilities / Key Result Areas

The ideal candidate will be a hands-on technical leader and key contributor within an engineering team, responsible for designing and delivering scalable, high-quality software solutions. The role requires strong expertise in system architecture, application design, performance optimization, CI/CD practices, and modern software development methodologies. The candidate will provide architectural direction, guide technical design and implementation, mentor engineering teams, and drive Agile execution to ensure predictable, high-quality delivery of business outcomes. Primary Responsibilities will include the following. 

Core Responsibilities

- Technical Leadership & Solution Architecture: Provide hands-on technical leadership while defining scalable, maintainable, and resilient solution architectures that align with business objectives, enterprise standards, and long-term technology strategy. 
 - Requirement Analysis & Feature Refinement: Partner with Product Owners, Architects, QA, and stakeholders to refine requirements, assess technical feasibility, define solution scope, identify dependencies, and drive end-to-end feature delivery. 
 - Hands-on Engineering & Design: Actively contribute to solution design, development, debugging, and technical problem-solving while guiding the team in delivering high-quality software solutions. 
 - Architecture Governance & Engineering Standards: Establish and enforce architecture principles, design patterns, coding standards, CI/CD practices, and AI-assisted engineering practices through design reviews, code reviews, and technical governance. 
 - Quality, Performance & Operational Excellence: Ensure solutions meet quality, security, scalability, reliability, observability, and performance expectations while driving production readiness and post-release stability. 
 - Cross-Team Collaboration & Integration: Collaborate with architecture, platform, DevOps, QA, product teams, vendors, and other engineering teams to align technical direction, manage integration contracts, and ensure seamless delivery. 
 - Risk, Dependency & Delivery Management: Identify and proactively mitigate technical risks, architectural challenges, cross-team dependencies, and delivery impediments to ensure predictable execution. 
 - Mentorship & Technical Capability Development: Coach and mentor engineers, foster technical excellence, strengthen engineering practices, and drive Communities of Practice (CoP) to promote continuous learning and knowledge sharing. 
 - Agile Delivery & Continuous Improvement: Lead technical execution within Agile teams by improving estimation accuracy, delivery predictability, engineering productivity, and continuous improvement initiatives. 
 - Innovation & Technology Enablement: Evaluate and adopt modern technologies, architectural patterns, automation, and AI-driven development practices to improve engineering efficiency and accelerate business value delivery. 

Key Focus Areas

- Portal System Software: Drive scalable, observable, high-quality software development and delivery. 
 - Team-Level Software Delivery: Drive high-quality, maintainable, and reliable software development within the team, ensuring timely and predictable delivery aligned with sprint and PI objectives. 
 - Implementation Excellence: Ensure solutions are designed and implemented with strong emphasis on code quality, testability, reusability, and adherence to engineering best practices. 
 - Non-Functional Requirements (NFRs): Ensuring the system is fully monitored, reliable, secure, performant, and maintainable. 
 - Operational Readiness: Support production readiness by incorporating monitoring, logging, resiliency, and supportability considerations into development. 
 - Continuous Improvement: Drive ongoing improvements in development practices, Agile execution, team productivity, and technical maturity. 

COMPETENCIES

- Communication: Clearly articulates complex technical concepts through concise documentation and presentations, effectively influencing stakeholders, customers, and vendors. 
 - Architectural Judgment & Problem Solving: Demonstrates strong analytical thinking to evaluate trade-offs, drive sound decisions, and resolve complex technical challenges. 
 - Technical Leadership & Collaboration: Leads with ownership while working autonomously and collaborating effectively across cross-functional, matrixed teams. 

Qualifications & Experience

- Master's or bachelor's degree in computer science, information technology or related technology - advanced degree preferred. 
 - Minimum 12+ years of experience in the software industry, including 2+ years as a Technical Lead and 2+ years as an Architect, along with 5+ years of hands-on experience designing and building scalable APIs and microservices. 
 - Good development experience with Java / Spring Boot / Go / Node. js / NGINX / Rabbit MQ
 - Nice to have development experience in React. js
 - Good experience in Architecting and Designing Large scale applications
 - Experience in CI/CD and AWS deployments (EC2, SQS, SNS, Lambda, S3, Aurora, DynamoDB)
 - Strong experience with system observability, monitoring and production support. 
 - Advanced knowledge of software development lifecycles; expert knowledge in Agile and Lean methods. 
 - Ability to support architectural suggestions and bring up a high available and scalable system. 
 - Ability to work under pressure, prioritize work, coordinate with onsite stakeholders and well organized. 
 - Flexibility in working with technologies and platforms. 
 - A commitment to excellence, best practices, and the continuous improvement of our products, code base, processes, and tools. 

SES and its Affiliated Companies are committed to providing fair and equal employment opportunities to all. We are an Equal Opportunity employer and will consider all qualified applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, pregnancy, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, genetic information, protected veteran status, disability, or any other basis protected by local, state, or federal law.

 - Leverage automation, AI-assisted engineering tools, and modern development practices to improve development productivity and quality.

YOUR TALENT:

 - Hands-on experience integrating frontend applications with REST APIs, microservices, and backend services. 
 - Good understanding of backend development using Java, Spring Boot, API design, and microservices architecture. 
 - Experience working with relational and NoSQL databases, caching technologies, and cloud-native applications on Azure, AWS, or GCP. 
 - Exposure to containerization and orchestration technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes. 
 - Experience building AI-powered and conversational user experiences using frameworks such as Google Conversational Commerce Kit (CCK), Vercel AI SDK, CopilotKit, LangChain/LangGraph, OpenAI SDK, or similar agentic application frameworks. 
 - Familiarity with agentic workflows, tool calling, streaming interactions, conversational experiences, and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) patterns within modern web applications. 
 - Familiarity with search technologies such as Elasticsearch, OpenSearch, Azure AI Search, or similar platforms. 
 - Strong understanding of application performance optimization, observability, security, and operational excellence. 
 - Experience owning medium-to-large features and contributing to technical design discussions and engineering best practices. 

PUMA provides equal opportunities for all job applicants, regardless of race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, or disability. Equality for all is one of the core principles at PUMA and we do not tolerate any form of harassment or discrimination. 

At PUMA, every application is reviewed by real people who are committed to fairness, transparency, and equal opportunity - no matter your background, identity, or experience. To ensure our process stays true to these values, no automated systems or AI tools are used to make hiring decisions. Every decision is made by real people -with real judgment and accountability. We may use functions supported by Artificial Intelligence (AI) to carry out isolated organizational steps, such as scheduling interviews. These functions have no influence on decisions in the application process. We believe in creating spaces where everyone is welcome, celebrated, and empowered to contribute authentically. Because at PUMA, whoever wants to play, can play. 

PUMA is a global sports brand creating footwear, apparel, and accessories that inspire athletes and everyday movers. The PUMA Group owns PUMA, Cobra Golf, and stichd, operates in 120+ countries, and has around 22, 000 employees worldwide.

Core AI is at the forefront of Microsoft's mission to redefine how software is built and experienced. We are responsible for building the foundational platforms, services, programming models, and developer experiences that power the next generation of applications using Generative AI. Our work enables developers and enterprises to harness the full potential of AI to create intelligent, adaptive, and transformative software. 

The Agentic Core Services Team is responsible for building the cloud-native, distributed platform that powers the development, execution, and management of agentic applications at scale. Our mission is to provide the foundational infrastructure and runtime systems that enable developers to build intelligent, autonomous, and enterprise-grade AI agents with confidence and agility. 

In this role, you will help define the future of software and application development. You will shape how developers interact with our platform-from programming models and user experiences to the design of a managed, distributed runtime that orchestrates agent-based AI applications at scale with enterprise-grade guarantees. You'll work at the cutting edge of AI research, collaborating with some of the brightest minds in generative AI, and integrating the latest breakthroughs in multi-modal capabilities (text, audio, video) into real-world agentic applications. 

Microsoft's mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond. 

Responsibilities

Responsibilities : 

- Collaborates with appropriate stakeholders to determine user requirements for a scenario. 
 - Drives identification of dependencies and the development of design documents for a product, application, service, or platform. 
 - Creates, implements, optimizes, debugs, refactors, and reuses code to establish and improve performance and maintainability, effectiveness, and return on investment (ROI). 
 - Leverages subject-matter expertise of product features and partners with appropriate stakeholders (e. g. , project managers) to drive a workgroup's project plans, release plans, and work items. 
 - Acts as a Designated Responsible Individual (DRI) and guides other engineers by developing and following the playbook, working on call to monitor system/product/service for degradation, downtime, or interruptions, alerting stakeholders about status and initiates actions to restore system/product/service for simple and complex problems when appropriate. 
 - Proactively seeks new knowledge and adapts to new trends, technical solutions, and patterns that will improve the availability, reliability, efficiency, observability, and performance of products while also driving consistency in monitoring and operations at scale. 

Qualifications

Required Qualifications: 

- Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science or related technical field AND 7+ years of experience designing, building, and operating production-grade software and services at scale, with a proven track record of delivering high-impact solutions. 

Preferred Qualifications: 

- Demonstrated expertise in solving complex technical challenges in one or more domains such as distributed systems, AI/ML infrastructure, developer platforms, or cloud services. 
 - Experience engaging with customers during integration or deployment phases, with a focus on delivering value and incorporating feedback into product evolution. 

Other Requirements: Ability to meet Microsoft, customer and/or government security screening requirements are required for this role. These requirements include but are not limited to the following specialized security screenings: 

- Microsoft Cloud Background Check: This position will be required to pass the Microsoft Cloud background check upon hire/transfer and every two years thereafter. 

#CoreAIIndiaHiring

This position will be open for a minimum of 5 days, with applications accepted on an ongoing basis until the position is filled. 

Microsoft is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, citizenship, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, immigration status, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran or military status, race, ethnicity, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable local laws, regulations and ordinances. Ready to take your career global?

Make your mark at one of the biggest names in payments. We're looking for a Quality Engineer to help shape the future of global commerce. We are seeking a Senior QA Engineer to drive quality engineering and test automation across our Salesforce ecosystem. This is a hands-on technical role focused on Playwright automation, API/integration testing, CI/CD, and shift-left quality practices. 

What You'll Own

- Design and execute test strategies for Salesforce applications, integrations, and end-to-end business workflows. 
 - Develop and maintain scalable Playwright automation using TypeScript/JavaScript. 
 - Build reusable automation components, fixtures, utilities, and test-data solutions. 
 - Automate UI, API, integration, smoke, and regression testing. 
 - Integrate automated test suites into CI/CD pipelines and support release quality gates. 
 - Participate in requirements, design, and refinement sessions to identify quality risks and testability gaps early. 
 - Troubleshoot automation failures and application defects, driving root-cause analysis and corrective actions. 
 - Conduct automation code reviews and establish engineering standards and best practices. 

Required Qualifications

- 7+ years of experience in QA, Quality Engineering, SDET, or Test Automation. 
 - Strong hands-on experience with Salesforce testing, preferably Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, and/or CPQ. 
 - Strong hands-on experience with Playwright and TypeScript/JavaScript. 
 - Experience designing or contributing to enterprise automation frameworks. 
 - Strong experience with REST API and integration testing. 
 - Experience integrating automation with GitHub Actions, Jenkins, Azure DevOps, or similar CI/CD platforms. 
 - Knowledge of Git, Agile/Scrum practices, test strategy, defect management, and root-cause analysis. 
 - Strong communication, analytical, and technical problem-solving skills. 

Preferred

- Experience with performance testing, test-data management, and AI-assisted testing. 

About The Team

Our inclusive and global teams win together every day. We're proud to have the best minds in the industry, who you can learn from as you grow your career. The people, the energy, the connections - it's unmatched. Come and be part of an ever-evolving company and get dynamic opportunities that go beyond borders. 

What makes a Globalpayer?

Globalpayers think like a client, act like an owner and win as one team. We're curious and innovative - always finding better ways to deliver impact. We empower each other to make decisions, and it's our passion that drives excellence in everything we set out to do. 

Does this sound like you? Then you sound like a Globalpayer. Apply now to take your career global.

data.title: Staff Software Engineer
data.description:
Company Description

It all started when engineer Fred Luddy wrote code that automated a tedious task for his coworker, Phyllis. She cried tears of joy. That moment inspired Fred to build a company that could do that for everyone-freeing people from busywork so they could focus on meaningful work. Today, ServiceNow is the AI control tower for business reinvention. Our ServiceNow AI platform brings together any AI, any data, and any workflow- helping 85% of the Fortune 500® work smarter, faster, and better. We're building an AI-native culture where technology and talent are unstoppable together. And we're just getting started. 

Join us to put AI to work for people. 

Job Description

- Lead the design and delivery of complex, cross-functional features across the platform, from architecture through production operations. 
 - Build AI-native capabilities, including LLM-integrated workflows, agentic patterns, prompt and context design, and evaluation pipelines, with reliability and governance built in. 
 - Define and drive how the team uses AI tools across the development lifecycle: code generation, test automation, review, triage, and documentation. Measure the impact and share what works. 
 - Design for ServiceNow platform internals: Flow Designer, Workflow Studio, Decision Management etc
 - Mentor senior and mid-level engineers and set standards for code quality, observability, and safe AI usage. 
 - Partner with product, UX, and other engineering leads to turn ambiguous problems into scoped, shippable plans. 
 - Own production quality for your area, including defect triage, release readiness, and gate reviews. 

Qualifications

- Experience in leveraging or critically thinking about how to integrate AI into work processes, decision-making, or problem-solving. This may include using AI-powered tools, automating workflows, analyzing AI-driven insights, or exploring AI's potential impact on the function or industry. 
 - 6+ years of software engineering experience, with a track record of technical leadership at the staff level or equivalent. 
 - Strong proficiency in Java, JavaScript, or another language relevant to the platform, plus solid system design skills. 
 - Hands-on experience building or integrating LLM-based features: prompt design, retrieval or context management, evaluation, and cost/latency tradeoffs. 
 - Working knowledge of agentic architectures, including tool use, orchestration, and human-in-the-loop controls. 
 - Experience using AI-assisted development tools in daily work, with an opinion on where they help and where they don't. 
 - Clear written and verbal communication, including the ability to brief senior leaders and align multiple teams. 
 - Familiarity with enterprise SaaS, multi-tenant systems, and secure, compliant software delivery. 
 - Must have strong Data Structure and Design Skills. 

Additional Information

Work Personas

We approach our distributed world of work with flexibility and trust. Work personas (flexible, remote, or required in office) are categories that are assigned to ServiceNow employees depending on the nature of their work and their assigned work location. Learn more here. To determine eligibility for a work persona, ServiceNow may confirm the distance between your primary residence and the closest ServiceNow office using a third-party service. 

Equal Opportunity Employer

ServiceNow is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, gender identity, veteran status, or any other category protected by law. In addition, all qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with legal requirements. 

Accommodations

We strive to create an accessible and inclusive experience for all candidates. If you require a reasonable accommodation to complete any part of the application process, or are unable to use this online application and need an alternative method to apply, please contact globaltalentss@servicenow. com for assistance. 

Export Control Regulations

Description

Love building and leading high-performing engineering teams? Want to own the systems that keep billing accurate and trustworthy for millions of advertisers spending billions of dollars worldwide? Excited to lead the shift from manual financial operations to AI-powered and agentic automation? Then, the Iron Mountain platform team wants you!

Amazon Advertising is one of the fastest-growing businesses within Amazon, empowering Sellers, Vendors, Authors, and Publishers to boost product reach and sales through performance and display advertising. The Iron Mountain platform is the singular system that manages all advertiser billing, invoicing, accounting automation, real-time budgeting, promotions, payments, and Billing Advertiser Experience (AX) - processing multi-billion transactions worth 100x in dollar value daily, worldwide, across all ad products displayed On or Off Amazon. 

Billing accuracy is a critical pillar of this platform. This team owns billing corrections (credits and rebills), offline and alternative payment workflows, and the revenue-integrity mechanisms that make advertising billing transparent and auditable end to end - serving thousands of correction requests each year from partners across Ads Sales, Finance, Accounting, and FinOps. The multi-year roadmap transforms this space into self-service and intelligent automation: AI-driven investigation of billing defects, agentic correction workflows, and advertiser-facing self-service experiences. 

The Iron Mountain team is looking for a Software Development Manager to lead this Bengaluru-based team. You will: 

Lead, hire, and develop a team of 8+ engineers, owning their growth, delivery, and engineering excellence

Own the product and technical roadmap for billing corrections and offline payments - from high-volume manual workflows today to automated, self-service, and agentic experiences through 2027

Drive operational excellence for tier-1 billing systems where accuracy and availability directly protect advertiser trust and Amazon revenue

Shape how GenAI and AI agents interact with financial systems safely - automation with auditability, guardrails, and zero tolerance for monetary error

Partner across Finance, Accounting, FinOps, and ad-product teams worldwide to reduce correction volume at the root cause, not just process it faster

Be a player-coach: technically strong enough to hold the bar in design reviews, while spending your energy on people, roadmap, and delivery

To succeed, you will bring a track record of building strong teams and delivering large-scale distributed systems, comfort operating business-critical financial services, and a forward-looking perspective on how AI transforms financial operations - combined with people-first leadership that grows engineers as fast as it ships software. 

Key job responsibilities

People & Team Leadership

- Hire, mentor, and grow a high-performing team of SDEs. 
 - Set technical direction and priorities, balancing short-term deliverables with long-term architectural investments
 - Foster a culture of operational excellence, innovation, and continuous improvement

A day in the life

As a Software Development Manager, you will play a crucial role in the development of services that keep advertising billing accurate and trustworthy at global scale. You will lead a dynamic group of passionate engineers and collaborate with peer teams across Ads, Finance, and Accounting to identify automation opportunities, design novel solutions that meet customer requirements, and build software that intelligently detects and remediates billing defects across our worldwide advertising platforms. The Cashmere team builds software which supports the automated detection, correction, and settlement of advertiser billing, empowering humans to automate key financial operations and take themselves out of the loop as Amazon Advertising scales. We own services that model billing behaviors across ad products and marketplaces, identify and remediate defects before they reach advertisers, capture the financial and compliance constraints of our systems, and execute credits, rebills, and offline payments that serve our customers while preserving accuracy, auditability, and advertiser trust.

data.title: Principal Engineer — Python is a must
data.description:
For more than 30 years, SonicWall  has delivered a partner-first unified cybersecurity portfolio that helps SMBs, MSPs, and IT teams consolidate network security, endpoint security, security service edge (SSE), and threat response across hybrid environments. By bringing connected technology, real-time threat intelligence, automation, and expert services together, SonicWall helps organizations simplify security operations, achieve better security outcomes, and lower total cost of ownership. Backed by a global ecosystem of more than 17, 000 partners, SonicWall delivers enterprise-grade protection built for SMB and mid-market realities.   

For more information, visit www. sonicwall. com or follow us on X, LinkedIn, Facebook, and Instagram.   

We are seeking an experienced  Principal Software Engineer to lead the architecture, development, and evolution of a large-scale malware analysis and cybersecurity platform. This role will own the end-to-end technical architecture across Python-based analysis pipelines, message-driven job orchestration systems, Windows VM sandbox environments, and web-based interfaces. 

The ideal candidate brings deep expertise in software engineering, malware analysis, and distributed systems, with a proven ability to take ownership of complex legacy platforms and drive modernization initiatives. You will lead the design and implementation of advanced detection capabilities, including behavioral analysis, malware sandboxing, machine learning-based classification, and support for new file types, while ensuring platform scalability, reliability, and performance. 

This position requires strong hands-on development skills in Python with Linux-based production environments, messaging architectures such as RabbitMQ, virtualization technologies, and cloud-native deployment practices. As the technical leader for the platform, you will establish engineering standards, guide architectural decisions, reduce technical debt, mentor senior engineers, and ensure the long-term maintainability and success of the system. 

Responsibilities
 - Own the end-to-end technical architecture of both platforms: the SonicSandbox analysis pipeline (static analysis, dynamic VM analysis, and machine learning) and the UrlProtection microservices (URL reputation, machine learning, and browser automation). 
 - Lead the design, development, and delivery of new detection capabilities across both products. 
 - Define and drive technical direction, including architecture, coding standards, testing practices, and technical debt prioritization. 
 - Own the complete software delivery lifecycle, from solution design and development through Docker/Debian packaging and production deployment. 
 - Ensure production stability and service reliability by monitoring platform health, leading incident response, and driving root cause analysis and resolution. 
 - Provide technical leadership, mentorship, and guidance to two Senior Software Engineers. 
 - Partner with cross-functional teams to align technical initiatives with product and business objectives. Requirements
 - Minimum of 10 years of software engineering experience with a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field; or 8 years with a Master's degree; or 6 years with a PhD; or equivalent professional experience. 
 - Expert-level Python development experience, including asynchronous programming (asyncio, aiohttp, FastAPI), multithreading, and distributed task processing architectures using RabbitMQ, Taskiq/Redis, Celery, or similar technologies. 
 - Strong proficiency in C and C++ with experience owning and maintaining compiled software components. 
 - Experience with KVM/libvirt or comparable virtualization and hypervisor technologies. 
 - Deep understanding of malware analysis, sandbox technologies, cybersecurity platforms, or related security software. 
 - Hands-on experience deploying and managing machine learning inference workloads in production using frameworks such as PyTorch, LightGBM, scikit-learn, or ONNX. 
 - Experience building or supporting production-scale headless browser automation pipelines is preferred. 
 - Strong knowledge of MySQL, Microsoft SQL Server, Redis, MongoDB, and Consul, along with experience managing containerized applications using Docker and Docker Compose. 
 - Demonstrated ability to lead large, complex codebases spanning multiple systems and services. 
 - Excellent written communication skills and experience collaborating effectively within distributed, asynchronous engineering teams.

With more than 40, 000 employees and a global team representing over 60 nationalities, Rönesans ranks among the world's largest contracting companies and continues to deliver innovative engineering projects on a global scale, driven by its vision of building a sustainable future.

What We Expect from You?

 - Extensive knowledge of NDT methods including RT, UT, MT, PT, PAUT, TOFD, VT,

data.title: Platform Distribution Architect
data.description:
About the Role

Purple Fabric is looking for a Platform Distribution Architect to own how Purple Fabric (PF) and MSOCK are packaged, deployed and delivered to enterprise customers. 

You will shape how our platforms reach customers across multiple public clouds, on-premises environments and different deployment models, including SaaS, PaaS, hybrid and customer-managed deployments. 

This role combines deep platform architecture expertise with hands-on technical leadership. You will define distribution standards, architect Kubernetes-based deployments and drive CI/CD and release automation, working closely with Product Engineering, DevOps/SRE and Customer Delivery teams to ensure every release is secure, reliable and deployment-ready. 

What You Will Own

1. Distribution Architecture

- Define reference architectures, packaging standards and deployment patterns for Purple Fabric and MSOCK. 
 - Establish repeatable distribution approaches across SaaS, PaaS, hybrid and customer-managed environments. 2. Multi-Cloud and On-Premises Readiness

- Drive platform compatibility, infrastructure prerequisites, service and quota assessments, and feature parity across AWS, Azure, GCP and customer data centers. 
 - Ensure deployment readiness for restricted and air-gapped network environments. 3. Kubernetes Platform Design

- Architect production-grade Kubernetes deployments across EKS, AKS, GKE, OpenShift and upstream Kubernetes. 
 - Define cluster topology, networking, security, scaling and upgrade strategies. 4. Infrastructure and Deployment Automation

- Design reusable Infrastructure as Code modules and automated provisioning workflows. 
 - Establish baseline configurations and secure, repeatable deployment processes. 5. CI/CD and Release Automation

- Own distribution pipelines across build, artifact packaging, versioning, promotion and release orchestration. 
 - Design blue-green and canary deployment strategies, automated rollback and release traceability. 6. Self-Service Distribution

- Build standard provisioning workflows, templates, tooling and deployment interfaces. 
 - Reduce manual effort for internal engineering teams and enterprise customers. 7. Upgrades and Migrations

- Architect repeatable upgrade, migration and environment-promotion processes. 
 - Build in validation, recovery and lifecycle automation. 8. Observability and Reliability

- Define telemetry, SLOs, alerting, resilience, capacity and incident-readiness requirements across distributed deployments. 9. Security and Compliance

- Embed DevSecOps practices throughout the delivery pipeline, including SBOMs, image signing and scanning, secrets management, infrastructure hardening and policy as code. 10. Distribution Assurance and Cost Efficiency

- Own certification criteria, deployment acceptance checks, technical documentation and L3 platform escalations. 
 - Guide infrastructure sizing and deployment architecture to improve utilisation and cloud cost efficiency. 11. Collaboration and Technical Leadership

- Partner with Product Engineering on release requirements, DevOps/SRE on operational readiness and Customer Delivery on deployment and handover. 
 - Mentor engineers and lead architecture and design reviews. 

What You Bring

- Multi-cloud architecture: Hands-on architecture and deployment experience across at least two major public cloud platforms - AWS, Azure or GCP - covering networking, compute, storage, identity and security. 
 - Kubernetes and containers: Strong production experience with Kubernetes, Docker, Helm and cloud-native deployment patterns. 
 - CI/CD and release automation: Proven experience designing build, packaging, versioning, promotion and rollback pipelines using tools such as Jenkins, GitLab CI, GitHub Actions or Azure DevOps. 
 - Infrastructure as Code: Proficiency with Terraform, Ansible or equivalent provisioning and configuration tools. 
 - Deployment architecture: Experience delivering repeatable deployments across SaaS, PaaS, hybrid and customer-managed environments, including configuration, upgrades and lifecycle automation. 
 - Observability and reliability: Hands-on knowledge of metrics, logs, tracing, alerting and SLOs, using tools such as Prometheus, Grafana or OpenTelemetry. 
 - Programming and scripting: Working knowledge of at least one programming or scripting language, such as Python, Go, Bash or PowerShell. 
 - Core technical fundamentals: Strong understanding of Linux, networking, DNS, load balancing, Git workflows and security fundamentals. 

Good to Have

- Experience deploying enterprise platforms in customer data centers, VMware or bare-metal environments, private clouds such as OpenStack, and air-gapped networks. 
 - Familiarity with GitOps tools such as Argo CD or Flux, and artifact management platforms such as Artifactory, Nexus, Harbor and OCI registries. 
 - Experience building internal tools, CLIs, Kubernetes operators or integrations using Go or Python. 
 - Understanding of FinOps practices, including cloud cost visibility, rightsizing, capacity planning and cost-aware architecture. 
 - Experience delivering platforms in regulated environments with standards such as ISO 27001, SOC 2 or PCI DSS. 

Interested?

If you have experience architecting and automating enterprise platform distributions across cloud and customer-managed environments, we'd like to hear from you. 

- Apply through this LinkedIn job listing or contact the recruiter listed in the accompanying recruitment post.

 - Candidates should possess familiarity with Software Development or technical software tools used for building management, monitoring systems, and reporting. 
 - Candidates should possess knowledge of building services (electrical, mechanical, HVAC, plumbing), safety regulations, and preventive maintenance practices. 
 - Candidates should possess a bachelor's degree in engineering (Mechanical, Electrical, Civil, or related field), or equivalent practical experience in facilities or mall engineering management. 
 - Candidates should possess strong communication, stakeholder management, and vendor coordination skills, with the ability to work in a fast-paced, customer-focused environment. 
 - Candidates should possess proven experience in large commercial complexes, malls, or integrated townships; exposure to energy management and sustainability initiatives is an advantage.

data.title: AI Evaluation Engineer
data.description:
# AI Evaluation Engineer

- Location: ** Pune, Maharashtra
 - Work Mode: ** Work From Office (WFO)(890)
 - Experience: ** 9-12 Years
 - Notice Period: ** Immediate to 45 Days
 - Preferred Candidates: ** Local candidates based in Pune

## Role Overview

We are seeking an experienced AI Solutions Engineer to develop, evaluate, test, monitor, and support AI agents and LLM-powered applications across their development and production lifecycle. 

The ideal candidate must have strong hands-on expertise in Python, LangChain, LangGraph, OpenAI, and Azure Databricks. The role involves agent orchestration, LLM evaluation, experiment lifecycle management, automated testing, observability, production monitoring, troubleshooting, and operational reliability. 

This is a client-facing position involving regular interaction with clients and technical teams. Excellent verbal and written communication skills are mandatory, with no compromise on communication quality. 

## Key Responsibilities

### 1. Agent Development & Orchestration

- Design, develop, integrate, and maintain AI agents using LangChain, LangGraph, and OpenAI-based technologies. 
 - Build Python-based services, REST APIs, and agent integration components using FastAPI and Pydantic. 
 - Work with agent orchestration frameworks such as OpenAI Agents SDK, Google ADK, and Pydantic-AI, where applicable. 
 - Support agent workflow development, integration, testing, and production operations. 

### 2. LLM Evaluation & Experiment Lifecycle

- Design and implement evaluation frameworks to assess agent quality, response accuracy, reliability, consistency, and performance. 
 - Develop automated evaluation suites using pytest and custom pytest-based evaluations. 
 - Work with MLflow Evaluation, DeepEval, Ragas, and promptfoo for LLM and agent evaluation. 
 - Manage experiment execution, evaluation results, test iterations, and quality improvement cycles. 
 - Identify performance gaps and support continuous improvement of AI agent outputs. 

### 3. Agent Observability & Tracing

- Implement tracing, monitoring, and observability for agent workflows and LLM applications. 
 - Use OpenTelemetry and OpenInference for telemetry and instrumentation. 
 - Work with Langfuse and LangSmith to trace agent execution, investigate failures, and analyze application behavior. 
 - Monitor agent performance and troubleshoot issues across application and integration layers. 

### 4. Azure AI Stack

- Work with Azure OpenAI and Microsoft Foundry for AI application and agent-related workloads. 
 - Use Azure Monitor and Application Insights for telemetry, application monitoring, diagnostics, and troubleshooting. 
 - Support operational monitoring and performance analysis of Azure-hosted AI solutions. 

### 5. Azure Databricks & Data Operations

- Work with Azure Databricks for data processing, SQL-based analysis, and operational workflows. 
 - Use Unity Catalog for data governance and access management. 
 - Work with Databricks Workflows/Jobs and SQL Warehouses. 
 - Support data-related workflows required for AI agent evaluation and operations. 

### 6. CI/CD, Testing & Version Control

- Maintain source code and version control using Git and GitLab. 
 - Integrate automated tests and evaluation suites into CI/CD pipelines. 
 - Support repeatable testing, deployment validation, and release quality checks. 
 - Troubleshoot build, test, and deployment issues. 

### 7. Production Monitoring & Reliability

- Monitor applications and services using Grafana, Prometheus, Azure Monitor, Kibana, and alerting platforms. 
 - Investigate production incidents, analyze logs and telemetry, and perform root-cause analysis. 
 - Support incident response, issue resolution, performance monitoring, and operational improvements. 
 - Help improve system reliability, observability, and troubleshooting efficiency. 

### 8. Cloud Infrastructure, Containers & Security

- Work with Docker, Kubernetes, and Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) for containerized workloads. 
 - Understand infrastructure-as-code practices using Terraform and Bicep. 
 - Apply security and identity management practices using Microsoft Entra ID, managed identities, OAuth2, Azure Key Vault, and role-based access control (RBAC). 
 - Support secure application access, credential management, and appropriate authorization controls. 

### 9. Client & Stakeholder Collaboration

- Collaborate regularly with clients, engineering teams, and other stakeholders. 
 - Communicate technical issues, evaluation outcomes, incident updates, and resolutions clearly. 
 - Participate in technical discussions and troubleshooting sessions. 
 - Maintain professional communication and timely coordination across teams. 

## Mandatory Skills / Must-Haves

The Following Skills Are Explicitly Mandatory For This Position

- Python
 - LangChain
 - LangGraph
 - OpenAI
 - Azure Databricks

Candidates must also demonstrate excellent communication, analytical thinking, problem-solving, and troubleshooting capabilities appropriate for a client-facing engineering role. 

## Nice-to-Have Skills

### Programming & APIs

- FastAPI
 - REST APIs
 - Pydantic
 - pytest

### Agent Orchestration

- OpenAI Agents SDK
 - Google ADK
 - Pydantic-AI

### Agent Observability

- OpenTelemetry
 - OpenInference
 - Langfuse
 - LangSmith

### LLM Evaluation & Experiment Lifecycle

- MLflow Evaluation
 - DeepEval
 - Ragas
 - promptfoo
 - Custom pytest evaluations

### Azure AI Stack

- Azure OpenAI
 - Microsoft Foundry
 - Azure Monitor
 - Application Insights

### Databricks

- Unity Catalog
 - Databricks Workflows/Jobs
 - SQL Warehouses

### CI/CD & Version Control

- Git
 - GitLab
 - Automated testing pipelines

### Production Monitoring

- Grafana
 - Prometheus
 - Azure Monitor
 - Kibana
 - Alerting platforms

### Cloud & Containers

- Docker
 - Kubernetes
 - Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS)
 - Terraform
 - Bicep

### Security & Identity

- Microsoft Entra ID
 - Managed identities
 - OAuth2
 - Key Vault
 - Role-Based Access Control (RBAC)

## Candidate Screening Criteria

- **Experience: ** 9-12 years(relevnat should be 8+yrs). 
 - **Employment stability: ** Minimum 2 years in an organization. 
 - **Notice period: ** Immediate to 45 days. 
 - **Communication: ** Excellent verbal and written communication is mandatory; no compromise. 
 - **Location: ** Local Pune candidates are preferred. 
 - **Work arrangement: ** Work From Office is mandatory. 
 - **Shift flexibility: ** willingness to work from office and in rotational shifts

Skills: langchain, azure, sql, langgraph, python, azure databricks, communication, ci/cd, openai, docker, kubernetes, rest apis, git

Job Title: Senior AWS Cloud Engineer

Job Summary

We are looking for an experienced and highly skilled Senior AWS Cloud Engineer with 7+ years of hands-on experience in designing, implementing, automating, and managing enterprise-scale AWS infrastructure. 

The ideal candidate will have strong expertise in AWS cloud architecture, Infrastructure as Code (IaC), networking, security, DevOps, and multi-account environments. 

This role requires a hands-on engineer who can design scalable, secure, and highly available cloud solutions, drive automation initiatives, troubleshoot complex infrastructure challenges, and collaborate with cross-functional teams in a managed services environment. 

Key Responsibilities

1. AWS Infrastructure & Architecture

- Design, deploy, and manage secure, scalable, highly available, and fault-tolerant AWS infrastructure. 
 - Implement and optimize AWS networking, compute, storage, databases, and cloud-native services. 
 - Design and manage enterprise multi-account AWS environments using AWS Organizations and Control Tower. 
 - Develop cloud architecture documentation, reference architectures, and technical design specifications. 
 - Ensure infrastructure follows AWS Well-Architected Framework principles and enterprise standards. 2. Infrastructure Automation & DevOps

- Develop, maintain, and optimize Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using Terraform. 
 - Build and manage CI/CD pipelines using AWS CodePipeline, CodeBuild, CodeDeploy, and GitHub Actions. 
 - Automate infrastructure provisioning, configuration management, monitoring, and routine operations.

- Implement enterprise-grade security controls, IAM policies, encryption, and AWS KMS key management. 
 - Design and troubleshoot complex AWS networking environments, including VPCs, Transit Gateway, VPNs, routing, DNS, and hybrid connectivity. 
 - Implement security monitoring, auditing, vulnerability management, and compliance controls. 
 - Work with security teams to ensure alignment with organizational security policies and industry best practices. 
 - Support security assessments, infrastructure audits, and remediation activities. 4. Containers & Cloud-Native Services

- Design, deploy, and manage containerized workloads using Docker, Kubernetes, and Amazon EKS.

 - Optimize containerized workloads for availability, performance, security, and cost efficiency. 5. Monitoring, Operations & Troubleshooting

- Monitor and optimize AWS infrastructure using Amazon CloudWatch, Datadog, and other observability tools. 
 - Troubleshoot complex infrastructure, networking, deployment, and performance issues across development and production environments. 
 - Perform root cause analysis (RCA) and implement long-term corrective and preventive measures. 
 - Implement backup, disaster recovery, and business continuity solutions. 
 - Identify opportunities for cloud cost optimization, operational efficiency, and infrastructure improvements. 6. Collaboration & Technical Consulting

- Collaborate with development, networking, security, and engineering teams to deliver cloud solutions.

 - Experience with AWS Organizations, Control Tower, and multi-account governance. 
 - Hands-on experience with Docker, Kubernetes, and Amazon EKS. 
 - Experience building CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions and AWS Developer Tools. 
 - Proficiency in Python scripting and infrastructure automation. 
 - Strong understanding of AWS security, encryption, KMS, IAM, auditing, and compliance. 
 - Experience implementing monitoring and observability using Datadog and CloudWatch. 
 - Knowledge of high availability, disaster recovery, and cloud cost optimization. Certifications

- AWS Certified Solutions Architect - Professional preferred. 
 - Additional AWS certifications in DevOps, Security, or Networking are an advantage. Preferred Qualifications

- Experience with serverless architectures using AWS Lambda and the Serverless Framework. 
 - Working knowledge of AWS services such as SQS, SNS, SES, and DynamoDB. 
 - Experience with AWS security and governance services, including CloudTrail, AWS Config, Security Hub, and GuardDuty. 
 - Familiarity with AWS migration strategies and hybrid cloud solutions. 
 - Experience with code scanning, infrastructure security scanning, and compliance automation. 
 - Experience conducting architecture reviews and evaluating emerging cloud technologies. 
 - Familiarity with AI-powered development and productivity tools such as GitHub Copilot, Claude, ChatGPT, Amazon Q Developer, or similar tools is a plus. 
 - Interest in leveraging AI and automation to improve cloud infrastructure management, DevOps workflows, troubleshooting, and operational efficiency. Soft Skills

- Strong analytical thinking, troubleshooting, and problem-solving capabilities. 
 - Excellent written and verbal communication skills. 
 - Ability to work independently and collaborate effectively across technical teams.

What We Offer

Description

Are you interested in building high-performance, globally scalable systems that support Amazon's current and future growth? Are you seeking an environment where you can drive innovation? Does the prospect of working with top engineering talent get you charged up?

Looking for a highly motivated System Development Engineer to help build Amazon's business critical delivery systems and build solutions to operate at scale. You will work on critical business functions for our customers around the world while meeting system availability goals and ensuring system performance with growing business needs. You will discover innovative ways to automate and scale our infrastructure as we expand globally. You will work together with multiple teams and departments, with plenty of opportunities to learn and grow. 

The ideal candidate has a passion for understanding computing systems and for applying that understanding with an obsession for delighting customers. In this role, you will apply your skills of system design, networking, coding/scripting languages, as well as technical communication and project organization to make your impact on improving our business processes. Your code, design, and implementation decisions should set a great example to other engineers. You will also have the opportunity to impact the technical decisions in the broader organization as well as mentor other engineers in the team. 

Key job responsibilities

Design, implement, maintain, and deploy components that solve problems in a complex ecosystem. We work in lots of different languages (not limited to, but most often Python and Java). It is more important to us that you understand coding in the context of working in distributed systems and/or widely scaled web applications. 

- Lead migration projects from planning through execution, including infrastructure setup, data replication, traffic management, and post-migration validation

- Experience in automating, deploying, and supporting large-scale infrastructure
 - Experience programming with at least one modern language such as Python, Ruby, Golang, Java, C++, C#, Rust
 - Experience with Linux/Unix

 - 4+ years of designing or architecting (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience with distributed systems at scale

data.title: Senior Manager — Global SAP ABAP & BTP Development Lead
data.description:
Xylem is a Fortune 500 global water solutions company dedicated to advancing sustainable impact and empowering the people who make water work every day. As a leading water technology company with 23, 000 employees operating in over 150 countries, Xylem is at the forefront of addressing the world's most critical water challenges. We invite passionate individuals to join our team, dedicated to exceeding customer expectations through innovative and sustainable solutions. 

This role provides leadership for custom application development, integrations, extensions, automation, and innovation capabilities within the SAP ecosystem. The position ensures all enhancements are developed using modern SAP architecture principles while minimizing technical debt and preserving clean-core strategies. As guardian of SAP extensibility and platform innovation, the role enables business differentiation without compromising system stability. The leader drives adoption of SAP Business Technology Platform (BTP) capabilities to accelerate digital innovation and future scalability. This capability is essential to ensure the transformed ERP environment remains adaptable to evolving business requirements. 

Development leadership

- Lead a global ABAP and BTP engineering team across onshore and offshore, spanning template build, 

deployment wave support, and sustaining engineering. 

- Own the technical backlog, capacity plan, and delivery commitments across product domains, working directly

with functional solution owners and process leads. 

- Set and enforce engineering standards: code quality, performance, security, ATC checks, peer review, unit

testing, and documentation. 

- Establish CI/CD pipelines, transport governance, and release management across the landscape, with quality

gates enforced in the pipeline rather than in review meetings. 

Clean core custodianship

- Own the extensibility decision framework and act as approval authority for any classical modification or in-core

enhancement, with escalation rather than absorption when the standard is challenged. 

- Drive extensions to key-user and developer extensibility, side-by-side on BTP, and released SAP APIs and BAdIs. 
 - Own custom code lifecycle management: inventory, usage analytics, remediation, retirement, and continuous

reduction of the custom footprint. Custom code is a liability with a carrying cost, and you own the trend line. 

- Ensure the landscape stays upgrade-ready so RISE release cycles and innovation adoption remain routine. 

BTP platform ownership

- Own the BTP architecture and its services - Integration Suite, Build, Application Development (CAP/RAP), 

Event Mesh, Workflow, Business Rules, and Datasphere where relevant. 

- Establish BTP governance: subaccount and space design, entitlement management, identity and

authorization, DevOps tooling, and cost transparency by consumer. 

- Build the API and event layer that exposes core business capability safely to satellite applications, partners, 

and AI services. 

- Provide the technical foundation for AI and agent enablement - Joule extensibility, AI Core and AI Foundation

services, and integration patterns that are production-grade rather than demo-grade. 

Reusable assets and enablement

- Build and maintain the golden path: reference architectures, code templates, integration patterns, security

patterns, and shared services that teams consume rather than rebuild. 

- Support deployment waves through interface build, conversion support objects, performance tuning, and

hypercare defect resolution. 

- Partner with security on authorization design, SoD-safe development, and evidence generation through GRC. 
 - Manage system integrator and AMS partner engineering quality, staffing continuity, and adherence to Xylem standards. 

Required

Qualifications

- 15+ years in SAP technical development, with at least 5 years leading global engineering teams. 
 - Deep, current, hands-on ABAP expertise: ABAP for Cloud, RAP, CDS views, OData, AMDP, OO ABAP, and

performance optimization on HANA. You must still be able to read and judge code, not only manage people who write it. 

- Proven SAP BTP delivery: CAP or RAP applications, Integration Suite, Event Mesh, and BTP security and

identity models in production. 

- Demonstrated clean core implementation on S/4HANA, with a track record of reducing custom footprint rather

than simply documenting it. 

- Experience with SAP Fiori and UI5 development and extensibility. 
 - Strong command of ATC, custom code migration tooling, and code quality automation. 
 - Transport and release management at scale across multi-wave global deployments. 
 - Ability to hold an architectural line under business and partner pressure, with the credibility to explain the cost

of an exception in business terms. 

Preferred

- RISE with SAP private or public cloud experience. 
 - SAP Cloud ALM, Signavio, and Datasphere familiarity. 
 - AI and ML integration on BTP, including AI Core, AI Foundation, and Joule extensibility. 
 - Manufacturing or industrial sector complexity: variant configuration, service and installed-base processes plant-level integration. 
 - SAP certification in ABAP Cloud, BTP Developer, or BTP Architecture. 

Success in the First 12 Months

A published and enforced extensibility standard with a measurable reduction in in-core modifications. A BTP

landscape with governed entitlements, identity, DevOps, and cost transparency. A reusable asset library that

teams actually adopt. Transport and release cycles that are predictable and audit-clean. And an upgrade-ready

core, proven by a routine release adoption with no remediation program attached. 

Operating Principles You Will Work Under

- Products, not projects. Persistent teams aligned to value streams, funded by capacity rather than project

cycles, each paired with a business process owner accountable for the outcome. 

- Clean core is non-negotiable. Extensions live on BTP, the core stays standard, and custom code is

governed at the point of creation. 

- Paved road, not toll booth. Golden paths, reference architectures, and reusable patterns, with guardrails

enforced in the pipeline rather than in a design authority meeting. 

- Compliance by default. Controls are designed into the platform and evidenced automatically, so control

integrity holds at deployment scale. 

- Accountable for value, not volume. Success is measured in business process KPIs, adoption, and realized

value, not tickets closed or hours delivered. 

- Intelligent enterprise by design. AI and agent enablement, and the data readiness that makes both credible, 

are owned capabilities. 

- Global template authority, local execution. Template integrity is held centrally through the current

deployment horizon, with a defined path to greater product-team autonomy. 

Join the global Xylem team to be a part of innovative technology solutions transforming water usage, conservation, and re-use. Our products impact public utilities, industrial sectors, residential areas, and commercial buildings, with a commitment to providing smart metering, network technologies, and advanced analytics for water, electric, and gas utilities. Partner with us in creating a world where water challenges are met with ingenuity and dedication; where we recognize the power of inclusion and belonging in driving innovation and allowing us to compete more effectively around the world.

Job Title: Director of Engineering

About The Role

Dash Technologies is a US-headquartered software services company building AI-first solutions for healthcare and enterprise clients. We are looking for a Director of Engineering who can lead both technical engineering excellence and delivery execution in a fast-paced services environment with deep fluency in the US healthcare ecosystem. 

This is the senior-most engineering and delivery role in the organization. It reports directly to the CEO, and the entire engineering and delivery organization approximately 30-40 team members (direct and indirect reports) reports into this role, including 5-10 US-based team members managed remotely from India. The role owns a portfolio of approximately 20 customers, of which five are blue-chip accounts requiring direct engagement with client CEOs and CIOs. The portfolio is approximately 70% US healthcare engagements and 30% other technology engagements. 

This role is a member of the company's leadership team and participates in all monthly and quarterly business reviews. This is not a 9-to-5 job it demands an always-on ownership mindset, with genuine care for customers and an unwavering commitment to delivery. 

This role is responsible for building AI-first engineering capabilities while ensuring high-quality, predictable delivery across multiple US client engagements. The ideal candidate is a hands-on engineering leader with strong delivery discipline, proven US healthcare domain experience, and exceptional people and client management skills the ability to build genuine, lasting relationships with team members, clients, and senior client executives is mandatory for success in this role. 

Key Responsibilities

Engineering Leadership

- 
 - Lead the entire engineering and delivery organization approximately 60 direct and indirect reports, including engineering managers, tech leads, and delivery teams
 - Directly manage 5-10 US-based team members from India, ensuring cohesion, accountability, and performance across geographies
 - Lead architecture, design, and development of scalable, secure, high-quality software systems
 - Establish and enforce engineering best practices across teams
 - Mentor engineering managers, tech leads, and senior developers
 - Ensure strong code quality, system performance, and reliability
Healthcare Domain Leadership

- 
 - Bring a working understanding of the US healthcare innovation value chain providers, payers, MedTech, digital health, and life sciences

AI & Innovation

Operational & Financial Excellence

-

 - Support business growth through better delivery capability and client outcomes
Qualifications

- 
 - Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field (Master's preferred)
 - 15-20 years of experience in software engineering and delivery management within a software services or product development environment
 - Demonstrated experience delivering software for US healthcare clients providers, payers, MedTech, or digital health companies
 - Strong understanding of the US healthcare innovation value chain, including EMR/EHR ecosystems, interoperability (HL7/FHIR), HIPAA/PHI compliance, and clinical and operational workflows
 - Proven track record of successfully managing multiple concurrent software projects for US-based clients

 - Must already be a heavy, daily user of AI tools in their own work - hands-on, everyday AI use is expected from day one (mandatory)
 - Strong understanding of software development methodologies (Agile, Scrum, Waterfall)
 - Experience working with cross-functional teams including developers, QA, product management, and operations
 - Experience managing US-based team members remotely from India (mandatory)
 - Excellent leadership, team management, and interpersonal skills - proven ability to build and retain high-performing teams (mandatory)
 - Exceptional relationship-building and client management skills, including comfort engaging directly with C-level client executives (CEOs, CIOs) (mandatory)

data.title: Staff Software Engineer, Persistent Disk Snapshot Team
data.description:
In most instances, this position requires in-person interviews as part of the hiring process. Minimum qualifications: 

- Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience. 
 - 8 years of experience programming in C++. 
 - 5 years of experience testing, and launching software products. 
 - 5 years of experience building and developing large-scale infrastructure, distributed systems or networks, or experience with compute technologies, storage, or hardware architecture. 
 - 3 years of experience with software design and architecture. 

Preferred qualifications: 

- Master's degree or PhD in Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical field. 
 - 8 years of experience with data structures and algorithms. 
 - 3 years of experience in a technical leadership role leading project teams and setting technical direction. 
 - Deep proficiency in C++ with advanced expertise in multi-threaded programming, concurrency control, and low-level system optimizations. 
 - Extensive background in modern cloud storage infrastructure, disaster recovery (DR), data replication protocols, or block storage snapshot methodologies. 

About the jobGoogle's software engineers develop the next-generation technologies that change how billions of users connect, explore, and interact with information and one another. Our products need to handle information at massive scale, and extend well beyond web search. We're looking for engineers who bring fresh ideas from all areas, including information retrieval, distributed computing, large-scale system design, networking and data storage, security, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, UI design and mobile; the list goes on and is growing every day. As a software engineer, you will work on a specific project critical to Google's needs with opportunities to switch teams and projects as you and our fast-paced business grow and evolve. We need our engineers to be versatile, display leadership qualities and be enthusiastic to take on new problems across the full-stack as we continue to push technology forward. 

Persistent Disk (PD) Snapshot team delivers foundational data protection and disaster recovery solutions for Google Cloud's Persistent Disk (PD). We are responsible for PD Snapshots and Instant Snapshots-critical backup primitives ensuring business continuity for global enterprises. While standard PD Snapshots offer highly durable, geo-redundant storage in Google Cloud Storage (GCS), Instant Snapshots provide ultra-fast, in-place checkpoints for rapid recovery. Our mission is to build the most reliable, scalable, and high-performance data protection infrastructure in the cloud, helping customers seamlessly guard against data loss with minimal downtime. 

In this role, you will manage distributed storage and metadata challenges at exabyte scale, directly impacting the reliability and trustworthiness of Google Cloud Platform for millions of users worldwide. Google Cloud accelerates every organization's ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise-grade solutions that leverage Google's cutting-edge technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems. 

Responsibilities

- Act as a critical technical leader setting the strategy, roadmap, and architectural direction for Google Cloud's backup and disaster recovery primitives. 
 - Be responsible for managing large, highly ambiguous problems where the path forward is unclear, reducing chaos, and building consensus across multiple cross-functional teams. 
 - Lead the evolution of PD Snapshots and Instant snapshots to support exponential growth, driving multi-quarter initiatives exabyte-scale data routing, metadata isolation, and zero-latency in-place backup mechanisms. 
 - Be a multiplier who advocates product excellence, drives system reliability, and mentors executive and junior engineers alike to achieve ambitious milestones at global scale. 
 - Align stakeholders, peer teams, and executive leaders across PD Engineering, Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), and Product Manager (PM) on critical design and integration decisions. 

Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form .

data.title: Software Dev Senior Engineer
data.description:
For more than 30 years, SonicWall  has delivered a partner-first unified cybersecurity portfolio that helps SMBs, MSPs, and IT teams consolidate network security, endpoint security, security service edge (SSE), and threat response across hybrid environments. By bringing connected technology, real-time threat intelligence, automation, and expert services together, SonicWall helps organizations simplify security operations, achieve better security outcomes, and lower total cost of ownership. Backed by a global ecosystem of more than 17, 000 partners, SonicWall delivers enterprise-grade protection built for SMB and mid-market realities.   

For more information, visit www. sonicwall. com or follow us on X, LinkedIn, Facebook, and Instagram.   

  

  

CSE SRE - DBA Focus

Job Description

As a Software Dev Senior Engineer, you will own the reliability, scalability, and operational excellence of our Cloud-based services. You will define and enforce reliability standards, drive the adoption of SRE practices across engineering teams, and build the systems and tooling that keep our production infrastructure healthy. We follow a DevOps model: Development and Operations teams are integrated, and the SRE function acts as the reliability layer - setting Service Level Objectives, managing error alerts, and continuously reducing toil through engineering. 

Key Responsibilities: 

- Lead on call response and triage - help design and lead the 24x7 response team for triage and rally engineering to address service degradation, facilitating process and communications along the way
 - Define, publish, and continuously refine Service Level Indicators (SLIs), Service Level Objectives (SLOs), and Service Level Agreements (SLAs) for all critical services, partnering with product and engineering leadership. 
 - Own the error management practices, including monitoring and alerting, and surfacing notable errors to the development team
 - Lead the design and implementation of comprehensive observability platforms - metrics, structured logging, and distributed tracing - to ensure full visibility into production systems. 
 - Drive toil reduction initiatives by identifying and automating repetitive, manual operational work, targeting measurable reduction in operational burden across teams. 
 - Design and execute chaos engineering programs to proactively uncover reliability weaknesses in our infrastructure and services before they impact customers. 
 - Lead blameless postmortem culture: facilitate incident retrospectives, extract systemic learnings, and track corrective action items to completion. 
 - Build and improve on-call incident response processes, runbooks, and escalation paths; manage and optimize on-call rotation health to prevent burnout. 
 - Collaborate with platform and application developers to bring new features and services into production using production-readiness reviews and launch checklists. 
 - Champion reliability engineering best practices across the organization, embedding SRE principles into the software development lifecycle. 
 - Mentor team members on SRE philosophy, technical decision-making, code reviews, and cloud engineering best practices. 
 - Participate in roadmap planning, identify areas of improvement, and perform technology evaluation and selection. Required: 

- 5+ years of experience in database scaling performance and reliability, connection pool optimization
 - 5+ years of experience in database HA design and failover strategies
 - 3+ years of hands-on Site Reliability Engineering experience, including ownership of SLOs and error budget management. 
 - 4+ years of experience with Cloud Platforms, GCP CloudSQL required. 
 - Experience with database capacity planning, load testing, and performance benchmarking at scale. 
 - Experience managing other database systems - PostgreSQL, Redis, Etc . 
 - CS Degree or equivalent experience. Preferred: 

- Familiarity with Google SRE principles and the concepts outlined in the Google SRE Book
 - Understanding of the HTTP protocol and experience diagnosing distributed system latency issues. 
 - Experience with instrumentation and management of automated deployments. 
 - Experience resolving customer-facing production issues under time pressure. 
 - Experience working with distributed, cross-functional teams
 - Experience in infrastructure as code (Terraform, AWS CDK)
 - Experience in scripting using Python, Shell, or a similar language. 
 - Experience with orchestration technologies, including Kubernetes. 
 - Understanding of networking, including routing, naming, security, network performance, and network failure modes. 
 - Experience designing and operating observability stacks (e. g. , Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog, OpenTelemetry, Jaeger, or equivalent). 
 - Experience with incident management platforms and on-call tooling (e. g. , PagerDuty, OpsGenie).

All qualified applicants receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, ethnicity, religion, sex, gender, gender identity and expression, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, age, marital status, veteran status, pregnancy, or any other basis prohibited by applicable law.
