data.title: Director, SoC Design Verification and Virtual Platform Quality
data.description:
Renesas is one of the top global semiconductor companies in the world. We strive to develop a safer, healthier, greener, and smarter world, and our goal is to make every endpoint intelligent by offering product solutions in the automotive, industrial, infrastructure and IoT markets. Our robust product portfolio includes world-leading MCUs, SoCs, analog and power products, plus Winning Combination solutions that curate these complementary products. We are a key supplier to the world's leading manufacturers of electronics you rely on every day; you may not see our products, but they are all around you. 

Renesas employs roughly 21, 000 people in more than 30 countries worldwide. As a global team, our employees actively embody the Renesas Culture, our guiding principles based on five key elements: Transparent, Agile, Global, Innovative, and Entrepreneurial. Renesas believes in, and has a commitment to, diversity and inclusion, with initiatives and a leadership team dedicated to its resources and values. At Renesas, we want to build a sustainable future where technology helps make our lives easier. Join us and build your future by being part of what's next in electronics and the world. 

Job Description

About the Opportunity

This role offers the opportunity to shape a differentiated verification strategy at the intersection of semiconductor Design Verification, SystemC modeling, Virtual Platforms, and pre-silicon software development. 

This leader will define and execute a reuse-first verification strategy spanning SystemC transaction-level models, RTL, IP, subsystem, SoC, and platform-level validation. The objective is to create a traceable verification asset chain that grows from loosely timed SystemC models through approximately timed models and RTL, rather than rebuilding independent verification environments at each stage. 

The position is part of Renesas' Software First, Simulation First engineering organization. The team develops reusable SystemC/TLM models and integrated Virtual Platforms that enable software development, verification, validation, and product evaluation before silicon availability. Design Verification is the quality and release gate that ensures these virtual products faithfully represent the intended silicon behavior. 

Key Responsibilities

- Define and drive the verification strategy for SystemC models, RTL designs, reusable IP, subsystems, SoCs, and Virtual Platforms. 
 - Lead and develop a global Design Verification organization, including verification leads, engineers, external partners, and project-specific teams. 
 - Establish a common verification architecture that supports reuse of test intent, stimulus, sequences, checkers, scoreboards, assertions, coverage models, and regression infrastructure across SystemC and RTL. 
 - Develop scalable SystemVerilog/UVM environments, including protocol adapters and TLM bridges that connect pin-level UVM interfaces to SystemC/TLM models. 
 - Establish functional-equivalence and timing-correlation methodologies between SystemC LT/AT models and RTL implementations. 
 - Define common verification plans, feature identifiers, test intent, functional and code coverage goals, closure criteria, maturity classifications, and sign-off requirements. 
 - Make verification sign-off an explicit release gate for customer- and software-facing Virtual Platform deliveries. 
 - Drive verification planning and execution from the IP level through subsystem, chip-top, SoC, and full-platform integration. 
 - Establish a risk-based verification approach that balances reusable UVM environments, Python/C++ tests, software-driven validation, formal techniques, and project schedules. 
 - Lead verification of configurable and parameterized IP models across supported configurations, interfaces, and operating modes. 
 - Build CI/CD-based regression systems for automated compilation, simulation, coverage collection, result analysis, release evidence, and quality reporting. 
 - Partner with architecture, RTL design, SystemC modeling, software, validation, methodology, and Product Group teams to define requirements and acceptance criteria. 
 - Lead complex debug and root-cause analysis across models, adapters, RTL, testbenches, firmware, and platform-level environments. 
 - Evaluate and adopt verification technologies that improve quality, reuse, coverage closure, simulation efficiency, and engineering productivity. 
 - Own staffing, organizational development, program planning, partner engagement, execution tracking, risks, dependencies, and executive reporting for the DV function. Leadership Profile

The successful candidate will: 

- Set a clear technical and organizational direction while maintaining delivery accountability. 
 - Balance verification rigor, reuse, schedule, risk, and business priorities. 
 - Build durable methodology without allowing methodology development to block critical product execution. 
 - Develop strong technical leaders and create clear accountability across IP, subsystem, SoC, and platform verification. 
 - Promote collaboration across RTL, SystemC, software, validation, architecture, and product organizations. 
 - Establish a culture of measurable quality, evidence-based sign-off, disciplined debug, automation, and continuous improvement. 

Qualifications

- Bachelor's or master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field. 
 - 15+ years of experience in semiconductor IP, subsystem, or SoC Design Verification. 
 - Demonstrated experience leading geographically distributed verification teams and multiple concurrent programs. 
 - Deep expertise in SystemVerilog and UVM, including verification architecture, reusable environments, constrained-random testing, assertions, scoreboards, functional coverage, and coverage closure. 
 - Strong knowledge of RTL design and simulation, computer architecture, embedded processors, interconnects, memory systems, interrupts, clocks, reset, and peripheral interfaces. 
 - Proven experience defining verification plans and delivering IP or SoC verification through sign-off. 
 - Experience leading complex debug across RTL, testbench, firmware, interfaces, and system-level environments. 
 - Experience with regression automation, verification metrics, CI/CD, revision control, and release-quality governance. 
 - Strong program-management capabilities, including effort estimation, staffing, schedules, priorities, risks, dependencies, and stakeholder communication. 
 - Strong communication and leadership skills, with the ability to influence architects, design teams, software organizations, Product Groups, executives, and external partners. Preferred Qualifications

- Experience verifying SystemC/TLM-2. 0 models or integrating SystemC models into RTL verification environments. 
 - Experience creating TLM-to-signal adapters, UVM/SystemC bridges, DPI interfaces, or mixed-language simulation environments. 
 - Knowledge of SystemC loosely timed and approximately timed modeling, functional equivalence, timing correlation, and performance verification. 
 - Experience with Python- or C++-based verification and running common tests against both SystemC and RTL implementations. 
 - Familiarity with common SoC protocols and peripheral interfaces such as AMBA AXI/AHB/APB, NoC, PCIe, CXL, Ethernet, USB, SPI, I2C/I3C, eSPI, UART, GPIO, and memory controllers. 
 - Experience with formal verification, emulation, FPGA prototyping, software-driven verification, or post-silicon validation. 
 - Experience verifying configurable or parameterized IP and automating configuration-space coverage. 
 - Familiarity with Virtual Platforms, virtual prototyping, embedded-software enablement, Digital Twin technologies, and pre-silicon application validation. 
 - Experience with commercial simulation, debug, coverage, VIP, regression-management, and formal-verification tools from providers such as Cadence, Synopsys, or Siemens EDA. 
 - Experience building verification teams, developing technical leaders, managing engineering partners, and establishing reusable methodology across multiple projects. 

Additional Information

Renesas is an embedded semiconductor solution provider driven by its Purpose 'To Make Our Lives Easier. ' As the industry's leading expert in embedded processing with unmatched quality and system-level know-how, we have evolved to provide scalable and comprehensive semiconductor solutions for automotive, industrial, infrastructure, and IoT industries based on the broadest product portfolio, including High Performance Computing, Embedded Processing, Analog & Connectivity, and Power.

At Renesas, you can:

The Supply Chain Technology Lead provides hands-on technical leadership for the applications, workflows and integrations that support the end-to-end Procure-to-Pay (P2P) ecosystem.  - Translate business requirements into pragmatic, secure and supportable technical designs within agreed enterprise architecture and engineering standards.

 - Design and improve API, event-driven, EDI and data integration patterns supporting internal systems and external partners.

 - Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with accountability for seeing issues through from diagnosis to sustainable resolution.

 - Ability to lead through influence, coach others and balance hands-on technical work with delivery coordination and stakeholder engagement. 
 - Tertiary qualification in computer science, software engineering, information systems or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.

data.title: Sr./Lead Embedded Firmware Engineer
data.description:
Job Description

In This Role, Your Responsibilities Will Be: 

- Design, develop, integrate, and debug embedded firmware for 32-bit ARM-based microcontrollers, including STM32 and NetX90. 
 - Develop embedded software using Embedded C/C++, with strong understanding of data structures, algorithms, memory management, and real-time operating systems. 
 - Develop device drivers and low-level interfaces using I2C, SPI, UART, and other peripheral interfaces. 
 - Develop and integrate industrial communication protocols including PROFINET, EtherNet/IP, EtherCAT, CANopen, and IO-Link. 
 - Develop embedded web pages and user interfaces using JavaScript and HTML, including configuration and diagnostic features. 
 - Develop, maintain, and validate device configuration and integration files such as GSD/GSDML, EDS, and IODD for PROFINET, EtherNet/IP, and IO-Link devices, supporting PLC configuration and fieldbus integration. 
 - Perform functional testing of fieldbus nodes using industrial PLCs such as Siemens, Rockwell, and similar platforms. 
 - Design and integrate REST APIs for device configuration, diagnostics, monitoring, and communication. 
 - Perform hands-on firmware debugging, optimization, integration, testing, and root-cause analysis. 
 - Collaborate with hardware and system teams for board bring-up, product integration, and validation. 
 - Conduct code reviews and contribute to firmware architecture, coding standards, reusable components, and best practices. 
 - Provide technical guidance and mentoring to firmware engineers and support resolution of complex technical issues. 
 - Contribute to project planning, technical estimation, documentation, project metrics, and EIC-Pune initiatives. 
 - Perform product/system-level testing in the Engineering Laboratory while following applicable safety practices and guidelines. 

Who You Are: 

As a Senior Embedded Firmware Engineer, you are a hands-on technical contributor with expertise in ARM/STM32, NetX90, Embedded C/C++, device drivers, and low-level interfaces (I2C, SPI, UART). You have strong knowledge of PROFINET, EtherNet/IP, EtherCAT, CANopen, and IO-Link, including fieldbus testing with Siemens/Rockwell PLCs. Experience in JavaScript, HTML, REST APIs, data structures, debugging, and firmware architecture, with the ability to provide technical guidance and mentoring. You are experienced in developing scalable, reliable, embedded software, collaborating across hardware and software teams to deliver robust and time-critical motion control solutions. 

For This Role, You Will Need: 

- Bachelor of Engineering degree or equivalent in Electronics, Electronics & Telecommunication, or related field. 
 - 8+ years of hands-on embedded firmware development experience, preferably in industrial automation, motion control, or connected products. 
 - Strong expertise in 32-bit ARM, STM32, NetX90, Embedded C/C++, data structures, algorithms, and firmware architecture. 
 - Hands-on experience in device driver development and low-level interfaces such as I2C, SPI, and UART. 
 - Strong knowledge of industrial communication protocols: PROFINET, EtherNet/IP, EtherCAT, CANopen, and IO-Link, device configuration files like GSD, EDS, IODD etc. 
 - Experience with fieldbus functional testing using PLCs, such as Siemens and Rockwell. 
 - Hands-on experience in JavaScript, HTML, embedded web pages, and REST APIs. 
 - Experience with RTOS/non-RTOS development, debugging, unit/integration testing, and Git-based development. 
 - Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills with experience in board bring-up, hardware-software integration, and product validation. 
 - Ability to provide technical guidance and mentoring while remaining primarily hands-on as an individual contributor. 
 - Strong communication, collaboration, documentation, and problem-solving skills; experience working in a global engineering environment preferred. 
 - Good verbal English communication skills with a neutral accent and a strong commitment to company values, ethics, and continuous learning. 
 - Respect for company values and ethics, with a strong willingness to learn. 

Preferred Qualifications That Set You Apart: 

- Familiarity with PLC-based system integration, fieldbus certification/testing, and industrial product development. 
 - Familiarity with Protocol pre-conformance test environment and process. 
 - Experience in industrial automation, factory automation, motion control, or process control systems.

Our Commitment to Diversity, Equity & Inclusion

Career Area

Engineering

Job Description

Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc. 

When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do - but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here - we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it. 

Role Summary

Caterpillar is seeking an engineering leader to manage the team responsible for advancing Remote Flash, Caterpillar's capability for remotely delivering software updates to connected equipment. 

Remote Flash enables software updates to be delivered directly to Caterpillar products without requiring a technician to physically access the machine, helping reduce service effort, improve equipment uptime, and accelerate deployment of software improvements. 

The Remote Flash Team Manager will lead an engineering team responsible for the architecture, development, integration, validation, and deployment of the next generation of remote software update capabilities. The role combines strong people leadership with software and systems engineering leadership across connected products, embedded systems, cloud/back-office services, and Caterpillar product programs. 

The team is entering an important technology transition. The Remote Flash roadmap includes NexGen platforms, 5G integration, enhanced flashing of control ECMs, orchestration of multi-component updates, and continued support for legacy equipment. 

What You Will Do

People and Engineering Leadership

- Lead, coach, and develop a multidisciplinary engineering team globally. 
 - Establish clear technical objectives, ownership, priorities, and engineering expectations. 
 - Build capability in embedded software, connected systems, cloud integration, systems engineering, DevSecOps, validation, and remote software update technologies. 
 - Develop technical leaders and create career growth opportunities within the team. 
 - Foster an engineering culture focused on accountability, collaboration, technical excellence, quality, and continuous improvement. 

Remote Flash Engineering

- Lead engineering delivery of Caterpillar's Remote Flash capabilities across connected products. 
 - Drive development of next-generation remote software update architecture, including NexGen & 5G Radio. 
 - These capabilities are reflected in the current Remote Flash roadmap and architecture work. 
 - Ensure solutions account for Caterpillar's diverse equipment population, embedded controllers, communication technologies, machine architectures, and legacy products. 
 - Guide engineering decisions involving update orchestration, rollback and recovery, software compatibility, cybersecurity, diagnostics, telemetry, and deployment reliability. 
 - Drive system-level design and integration across on-machine software and enterprise/back-office systems. 

Delivery and Operational Excellence

- Own execution of engineering roadmaps from requirements through development, integration, validation, release, and production support. 
 - Establish measurable engineering and operational KPIs for quality, reliability, deployment success, cycle time, and customer impact. 
 - Improve engineering practices through automation, CI/CD, automated validation, modern source control, and effective use of engineering data. 
 - Use field performance and failure data to identify systemic issues and continuously improve Remote Flash reliability. 

Cross-Functional Leadership

- Partner with product groups, embedded controls teams, connectivity teams, enterprise software teams, cybersecurity, digital product organizations, dealers, and external engineering partners. 
 - Translate product and customer needs into scalable technical capabilities. 
 - Lead technical trade-off and prioritization discussions involving architecture, cost, schedule, risk, and long-term maintainability. 
 - Communicate technical strategy, delivery status, risks, and recommendations to engineering and business leadership. 

What You Have

Required

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Software Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical discipline. 
 - Significant experience leading engineering or software development teams. 
 - Experience delivering complex distributed, embedded, connected-product, or cloud-integrated systems. 
 - Demonstrated ability to lead engineers through architecture, development, integration, validation, and production deployment. 
 - Strong technical problem-solving and systems-thinking skills. 
 - Experience working across organizations and influencing technical decisions without relying solely on direct authority. 
 - Strong written and verbal communication skills. 

Preferred

- Experience with embedded Linux, embedded controllers/ECMs, telematics, connected products, or IoT systems. 
 - Experience with OTA or remote software update systems. 
 - Experience with update orchestration, A/B software deployment, bootloaders, rollback/recovery, software signing, or secure software distribution. 
 - Experience with cloud-connected vehicle, machine, industrial, or edge-computing architectures. 
 - Experience with Agile software development, Git/GitHub, CI/CD, automated testing, and DevSecOps. 
 - Experience leading globally distributed engineering teams. 
 - Experience with construction, mining, industrial, automotive, or other complex connected equipment. 

Why This Role Matters

Software is becoming an increasingly important part of Caterpillar products. The ability to safely update software remotely at scale reduces equipment downtime and support cost while allowing Caterpillar to deliver improvements more rapidly. 

This manager will build and lead the engineering organization responsible for making remote software updates a reliable, scalable capability across current and future Caterpillar products.

November 12, 2026 - November 25, 2026

PropertyGuru is Southeast Asia's leading PropTech company, and the preferred destination for over 32 million property seekers monthly to connect with over 50, 000 agents monthly to find their dream home. PropertyGuru empowers property seekers with more than 2. 1 million real estate listings, in-depth insights, and solutions that enable them to make confident property decisions across Singapore, Malaysia, Thailand and Vietnam. 

PropertyGuru. com. sg was launched in Singapore in 2007 and since then, PropertyGuru Group has made the property journey a transparent one for property seekers in Southeast Asia. In the last 18 years, PropertyGuru has grown into a high-growth PropTech company with a robust portfolio including leading property marketplaces and award-winning mobile apps across its markets in Singapore, Malaysia, Vietnam, Thailand as well as the region's biggest and most respected industry recognition platform - PropertyGuru Asia Property Awards, events and publications across Asia. 

For more information, please visit: PropertyGuruGroup. com; PropertyGuru Group on LinkedIn. 

Recognised as a Top Employers Certified* organisation, we're proud to be among the best workplaces in the region-celebrating an inclusive culture of excellence, growth, and well-being. 

Engineering Manager - Consumer

You will run an engineering team in PropertyGuru's Consumer tribe. You ship on web and app. 

You work alongside strong engineers and bring the judgement to tell a sound design from one that needs more work. 

What Your Team Owns

Core consumer journeys on the website and the mobile app, across our Southeast Asian markets. 

How people find a property, and how they reach an agent. 

A conversion metric that is yours. You are measured on it. 

What You Will Do

Ship: Release to web and app every week. Own the result on both. 

Own the design: Review anything risky before code is written. Set the guardrails. Say no to a weak design and explain why. 

Own the funnel: Know where users drop off. Form a hypothesis. Run the experiment. Know why your number moved. 

Own production: Instrument the flow end to end. Set the alerts. Lead the incident when it breaks. 

Fix what is broken: Some things here are. Pick them up without being asked. 

Grow the team: Hire, coach and promote engineers. Give direct feedback. 

Work as one team with product, design and QA. No handoffs over the wall. 

Tech We Work With Every Day

Web: TypeScript, React and Next. js in a shared monorepo. 

App: React Native. 

Backend: A BFF layer over backend services, behind a Kong gateway. Elasticsearch for search. Redis for caching. 

Infra: Kubernetes, one deployment per market. 

Observability: Datadog and Kibana. 

What We Look For

You manage a team and still go deep. You can explain why your system is built the way it is, two layers down, with nobody else in the room. 

You have shipped consumer-facing product on web or app, and a conversion metric has been your own number. 

You ask scoping questions before you design. Given an unfamiliar problem, say authentication for a new API, you can reason your way to a sound design. 

You can build guardrails for contribution quality. Standards, reviews and checks that hold as more people contribute. 

You are honest with numbers. You know the baseline, how it was measured, and what else changed. 

You act. Your stories start with "I noticed", not "I was assigned". 

Our Commitment To You

- Hybrid flexible working that focuses on outcomes over hours. 
 - Holistic rewards package covering your financial, physical & mental health. 
 - Multi-directional career development across all levels. 
 - Inclusive benefits like equal paternity leave, supporting all employees in work-life balance. 

At PropertyGuru, you'll be part of a Top Employers Certified* company that puts people at the heart of everything we do. 

Desired Skills And Experience

Engineering Manager, Full Stack

data.description:
About Amgen

Amgen harnesses the best of biology and technology to fight the world's toughest diseases, and make people's lives easier, fuller and longer. We discover, develop, manufacture and deliver innovative medicines to help millions of patients. Amgen helped establish the biotechnology industry more than 40 years ago and remains on the cutting-edge of innovation, using technology and human genetic data to push beyond what's known today. 

At Amgen, data, analytics and digital capabilities are increasingly central to how we operate, make decisions and deliver medicines to patients. 

A successful candidate for the Director, Operational Analytics Delivery role will combine strong analytics and technology expertise with exceptional operational leadership to manage a large portfolio of analytics products, establish delivery guidelines, translate complex operational data into meaningful business outcomes, develop talent, and shape our analytics strategy. 

What you will do

Let's do this. Let's change the world. At Amgen, data, analytics and digital capabilities are increasingly central to how we operate, make decisions and deliver medicines to patients. 

A successful candidate for the Director, Operational Analytics Delivery role will combine strong analytics and technology expertise with exceptional operational leadership to manage a large portfolio of analytics products, establish delivery guidelines, translate complex operational data into meaningful business outcomes, develop talent, and shape our analytics strategy. 

This vital role will build and lead in India a high-performing clinical trial analytics capability that delivers trusted, scalable, and actionable analytics solutions for Amgen's Global Development Operations organization. 

The role will be responsible for establishing an effective delivery model in India, including developing analytics talent and capabilities, translating business priorities into an integrated analytics delivery portfolio, and ensuring high-quality execution across data, reporting, visualization, advanced analytics, and decision support solutions. The role will work closely with senior and functional leaders to shape Amgen's long-term analytics strategy and delivery. 

Key Responsibilities

Lead Operational Analytics Delivery

- Establish and lead the India-based Operational Analytics Delivery organization, including the operating model, governance and disciplines, and ways of working. 
 - Build capabilities across analytics engineering, business intelligence, product management, data science, and analytics delivery. 
 - Translate strategic business goals into clear product roadmaps and delivery and resource plans, with managing demand through prioritization mechanisms. 
 - Own the end-to-end delivery of the Operational Analytics Delivery products and solutions supporting global Operations, ensuring products and solutions are delivered with quality, speed, and scalability. 
 - Resolve organizational roadblocks and escalate risks appropriately to maintain delivery. 
 - Enable transparent portfolio reporting that covers Operational Analytics Delivery progress, risks, mitigations, and business impact / outcomes. 

Build a Product-Oriented Analytics Organization that Drives Business Value

- Shift and champion operational analytics delivery from one-time reports to reusable, scalable products for widespread use across Operations. 
 - Partner with business stakeholders to identify analytics opportunities, deliver clear business insights and actions, promote data-driven decision-making, and define analytics products' adoption, business value, and performance measures. 
 - Identify opportunities to apply advanced analytics, automation, machine learning, and artificial intelligence to operational challenges. 
 - Drive common standards and sustainable support for analytics product development, testing, deployment, and lifecycle management. 

Enable Delivery Excellence and Governance

- Establish and track delivery Key Performance Indicators (KPIs), service levels, quality measures, and business value metrics. 
 - Implement effective demand, capacity, and resource management practices. 
 - Ensure appropriate data governance, security, privacy, quality, and regulatory requirements are incorporated into analytics delivery. 
 - Oversee external partners and vendors where appropriate, including performance, quality, cost, and delivery against agreed outcomes. 
 - Drive continuous improvement in processes, tools, and organizational effectiveness. 

Develop Analytics Talent

- Recruit, develop, coach, and retain a high-performing analytics organization. 
 - Establish clear roles, career paths, development opportunities, and succession plans. 
 - Create a culture characterized by accountability, curiosity, continuous improvement, collaboration, and commitment to serving patients. 
 - Build strong global connections to ensure Operational Analytics Delivery operates as an integrated global capability. 

Be a Trusted Analytics Parter to Global Leadership

- Serve as a senior partner to Operations leaders and functional stakeholders globally. 
 - Build trusted relationships across Operations, Technology, Data & Artificial Intelligence, and other enterprise functions. 
 - Influence strategic business priorities and investment decisions through clear articulation of business value, trade-offs, and delivery considerations. 
 - Represent Operational Analytics Delivery in relevant leadership and governance forums. 
 - Communicate complex analytics and analytics products topics clearly and effectively to both technical and non-technical senior leaders. 

What we expect of you

We all use our unique contributions to serve patients. The professional we seek is an individual with these qualifications. 

Basic Qualifications

- Doctorate degree, Masters degree or Bachelors degree with 17+ years of clinical development, clinical data management, OR Master's degree and 8 years of analytics, technology, data, or related experience
 - AND 4 years of experience directly managing people and / or leadership experience leading teams, programs, or significant portfolios with directing resource allocation. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Significant experience leading analytics, data, digital, or technology delivery organizations in a complex global enterprise. 
 - Experience within biopharmaceuticals, life sciences, manufacturing, supply chain, or another highly regulated industry. 
 - Strong understanding of operational analytics across areas such as manufacturing, supply chain, quality, engineering, process development, and / or operational excellence. 
 - Experience building and scaling analytics teams in India supporting global stakeholders. 
 - Strong executive presence with demonstrated ability to influence senior leaders and navigate a global organization. 
 - Excellent communication, facilitation, negotiation, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to manage ambiguity, competing priorities, and complex organizational dependencies while maintaining a strong focus on delivery. 
 - Demonstrated success managing a portfolio of analytics products end-to-end, from demand through development, deployment, adoption, and lifecycle management. 
 - Strong knowledge of modern analytics architectures, product-oriented delivery models, data platforms, business intelligence, visualization technologies, and agile ways of working. 
 - Experience with advanced analytics, machine learning, artificial intelligence, and automation, and the ability to identify where these technologies can generate meaningful operational value. 
 - Demonstrated ability to define and use Key Performance Indicators (KPIs), Service Level Agreements (SLAs), and business-value measures to manage performance
 - Demonstrated strong financial and resource-management skills, including workforce planning, portfolio prioritization, and vendor management. 
 - Proven ability to recruit, develop and lead diverse, high-performing technical and analytical teams, with a demonstrated commitment to developing people, fostering inclusion, and building a collaborative global culture. 

Leadership Profile

The ideal candidate will be a builder, operator, and analytics leader, bringing the strategic perspective expected of a Director while maintaining a strong orientation toward delivery and measurable business outcomes. 

- Serve patients - Connect analytics and operational improvements to Amgen's broader mission of serving patients. 
 - Think strategically - Connect Operations priorities to analytics capability and roadmap. 
 - Delivery predictably - Create operating mechanisms to turn priorities into quality outcomes. 
 - Build capability - Establish a strong India-based organization with deep technical, analytical, and business expertise. 
 - Lead globally - Operate effectively across geographies, functions, and organizational boundaries. 
 - Focus on value - Measure success through business outcomes, adoption, and impact
 - Develop people - Create an environment where colleagues can contribute, grow, and build meaningful careers. 

EQUAL OPPORTUNITY STATEMENT

data.description:
About BlinkRx: 

BlinkRx is rebuilding how Americans access life-changing medicines. Today, only one in five prescriptions for new branded therapies are ever filled. The problem isn't the medicine. It's insurance barriers, affordability challenges, fragmented pharmacy experiences, and inadequate support that keep patients from starting and staying on treatment. Our mission is to change that. 

We built RxOS, the first AI-powered prescription operating system. RxOS connects the largest network of doctors, patients, pharmacies, payers, and pharmaceutical manufacturers, intelligently orchestrating every step to guarantee a seamless prescription journey for every script. 

Our teams solve complex, high-stakes problems at the intersection of artificial intelligence, healthcare operations, logistics, payments, and regulation. The impact is transformative: BlinkRx more than doubles the rate at which patients take their medications and lowers their out-of-pocket expenses by hundreds of dollars every month. 

BlinkRx created and leads a rapidly growing $80+ billion category, with exceptional momentum: 

- Built for scale: Over the past decade, we have invested nearly $1 billion in building the technology and operational platform required to serve patients at scale. 

- Proven growth and economics: We have grown 100% annually for the past five years, are profitable, and support more than 60 pharmaceutical brands. 

- Trusted with category-defining programs: Our technology powers a leading pharmaceutical manufacturer's direct-to-patient platform for its GLP-1 portfolio, providing the infrastructure to expand patient access as demand for these therapies grows. 

We are a dynamic team of technologists and industry experts seeking to build a generational company that delivers a genuine step change in American health.   

Responsibilities
 - Establish and evolve SRE best practices across the organization, including reliability principles, error budgets, incident response, postmortems, and operational readiness standards. 

- Define and drive observability strategy for system health, performance, and reliability, including SLIs/SLOs, alerting quality, dashboards, and service health indicators. 

- Design and implement software-driven solutions within the infrastructure domain, automating manual processes and eliminating operational complexity and toil. 

- Act as a technical leader and force multiplier, helping set priorities and influencing decision-making across core cloud infrastructure, reliability tooling, and platform architecture. 

- Take ownership of large, ambiguous initiatives, driving them from concept to delivery while aligning stakeholders across engineering, security, and product. 

- Combine deep knowledge of software development, infrastructure, and security to improve platform resilience, scalability, performance, and compliance. 

- Proactively identify systemic risks and reliability gaps, recommending and leading platform upgrades and architectural improvements before they become incidents. 

- Partner with engineering teams to improve developer workflows, tooling, and operational maturity, increasing productivity while reducing cognitive load. 

- Provide technical mentorship, architecture guidance, and high-quality design and code reviews for engineers across infrastructure and product teams. 

- Lead by example in documentation and knowledge sharing, ensuring systems and processes are well-understood and not dependent on individual ownership. 

- Participate in and help mature incident response, escalation practices, and post-incident learning across the organization. 

Desired Experience
 - Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science or equivalent practical experience. 

- 10+ years of experience in site reliability engineering, infrastructure engineering, or platform engineering roles, with demonstrated impact at scale. 

Reliability & Troubleshooting
 - Expert-level, methodical troubleshooting across the entire stack, from application to kernel to network. 

- Strong command-line proficiency and deep expertise in Linux systems and operating system fundamentals. 

- Advanced understanding of networking concepts including load balancing, proxies, DNS, TCP/IP, NAT, and service-to-service communication. 

Software & Automation
 - Experience working across multiple languages (e. g. , Python, Go, Bash, and familiarity troubleshooting application stacks such as React or similar). 

- Strong track record of automating repetitive and complex operational work to reduce toil and increase reliability. 

- Ability to design and build internal tools (Python or Go) that standardize and scale engineering practices. 

- Comfortable operating in an agile environment, with disciplined testing and quality practices. 

Cloud & Platform Engineering
 - Deep experience with cloud platforms (AWS preferred, GCP/Azure acceptable), particularly managed services and production-grade architectures. 

- Strong expertise in Kubernetes and container orchestration (EKS, Helm), including lifecycle management and operational best practices. 

- Proven experience designing and implementing observability systems, including metrics, logging, tracing, dashboards, and alerting. 

- Deep understanding of container technologies, security scanning, secrets management, dynamic configuration, and microservices architectures. 

- Familiarity with service meshes and advanced traffic management concepts. 

Infrastructure as Code
 - Experience designing and maintaining company-wide IaC codebases using tools such as Terraform, Pulumi, CloudFormation, or Ansible. 

- Ability to think holistically about infrastructure design, cost, reliability, security, and long-term maintainability. Why Join Us: 

It is rare to have a company that both deeply impacts its customers and is able to provide its services across a massive population.   At Blink, we have a huge impact on people when they are most vulnerable: at the intersection of their healthcare and finances. We are also the fastest growing healthcare company in the country and are driving that impact across millions of new patients every year.   Our business model not only helps people, but drives economics that allow us to build a generational company. We are a relentlessly learning, constantly curious, and aggressively collaborative cross-functional team dedicated to inventing new ways to improve the lives of our customers.

A Day in the Life

As the Engineering Manager for Software Verification and Validation (V&V), you will lead a high-performing engineering team dedicated to test automation, software quality engineering, and system-level validation for advanced medical software platforms. - Bachelor's degree with 18+ years of experience in Software Verification & Validation.

Physical Job Requirements

Location: Bangalore, India

Thales is a global technology leader trusted by governments, institutions, and enterprises to tackle their most demanding challenges. From quantum applications and artificial intelligence to cybersecurity and 6G innovation, our solutions empower critical decisions rooted in human intelligence. Operating at the forefront of aerospace and space, cybersecurity and digital identity, we're driven by a mission to build a future we can all trust. 

Present in India since 1953, Thales is headquartered in Noida and has other operational offices and sites spread across Delhi, Gurugram, Bengaluru and Mumbai, among others. Over 2200 employees are working with Thales and its joint ventures in India. Since the beginning, Thales has been playing an essential role in India's growth story by sharing its technologies and expertise in Defence, Aerospace and Cyber & Digital sectors. Thales has two engineering competence centres in India - one in Noida focused on Cyber & Digital business, while the one in Bengaluru focuses on hardware, software and systems engineering capabilities for both the civil and defence sectors, serving global needs. The Group has also established an MRO (Maintenance, Repair & Overhaul) facility in Gurugram to provide comprehensive avionics maintenance and repair services to Indian airlines and support the growth of the local aviation industry. 

Job Description: Technical Lead

Role Overview: 

We are seeking a DO-178C Software Engineer responsible for developing and verifying software lifecycle artifacts for avionics software systems. The engineer will work across multiple lifecycle stages defined in DO-178C, including requirements, design, coding, testing, and defect resolution. The role requires strong expertise in embedded software development, requirements-based verification, and lifecycle compliance. 

Job Responsibilities With 10yrs- 15yrs Experience

- Develop DO-178C DAL-A compliant avionics software in accordance with DO-178C objectives. 
 - Develop High-Level Requirements (HLR) and Low-level Requirements (LLR) ensuring clarity, completeness, and testability from upper-level artifacts. 
 - Develop and maintain embedded software code based on LLR and software design. 
 - Develop High-Level Test Cases (HLT) to verify compliance of software behavior with HLR. 
 - Develop Low-Level Test Cases (LLT) to verify detailed functional behavior defined in LLR. 
 - Review HLR, HLT, LLR, LLT, and source code to ensure correctness, completeness, and DO-178C compliance. 
 - Ensure bi-directional traceability between HLR, LLR, source code, and test cases. 
 - Collaborate with cross-functional teams to support software integration and certification activities. 

Mandatory Skills

- Solid understanding of the software development life cycle defined in DO-178C, particularly for DAL B/A avionics software. 
 - Proven experience in developing and reviewing software lifecycle artifacts, including HLR, LLR, HLT, LLT, and source code. 
 - Strong hands-on experience in embedded software development using C on STM32/AVR-8 processor families
 - Good knowledge of real-time embedded systems. 
 - Ability to analyze defects, perform debugging, and implement bug fixes. 
 - Good Knowledge of configuration management tools such as git
 - Good organizational abilities. Good interpersonal skills, writing & verbal skills

- Experience with IEC 61508 for functional safety concepts (including safety lifecycle activities and SIL-oriented verification/validation).

Familiarity with tool qualification concepts and standard such as DO-330.

Join us, and be part of a team reimagining technology to create solutions that truly make a difference - for a safer, greener, and more inclusive world.

Description

Role Overview

As a Senior Memory Systems design Engineer, you will play a key role in the early stages of SSD product development. You will collaborate closely with system architects, firmware engineers, and validation teams to define, implement, and execute system-level validation plans for SSDs. This role requires both strong technical depth and the ability to drive cross-functional efforts to ensure product performance, reliability, and quality. 

Roles and Responsibilities

- Work with system designers and firmware to define functional validation of memory features implemented by firmware. 
 - Use in-house data analytics tools to process, query, and analyze test and field data to identify patterns, root causes, and improvement opportunities. 
 - Validate NAND command sequences implemented by firmware. 
 - Develop and maintain comprehensive validation test plans for system-level and algorithmic features. 
 - Collaborate with firmware and system design teams to deploy white-box tests and debug feature-level issues. 
 - Interface with all key stakeholders to drive closure on validation issues and test failures. 
 - Develop Python scripts to automate testing, data analysis, and reporting for improved efficiency. 
 - Contribute to the continuous improvement of validation methodologies and influence future product designs for better testability and debugging. 
 - Support firmware debug activities by adding instrumentation or triggers for detailed feature analysis. 

Qualifications

- Education: 
 - BS in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or related field with 5+ years of experience, OR
 - MS with 3+ years of experience, OR
 - PhD with 1+ years of relevant experience. 
 - Understanding of firmware algorithms, NAND flash operation, and SSD architecture. 
 - Experience with system-level validation, storage test methodologies, and failure analysis. 
 - Hands-on debugging skills and ability to methodically root cause complex SSD or system failures. 
 - Proficiency in Python (including libraries such as NumPy, Pandas, Matplotlib, etc. )
 - Familiarity with embedded C programming and SQL for data querying and analysis. 
 - Experience with data analytics and exploratory analysis of test data. 
 - Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to work effectively in a collaborative team environment.

data.title: PMTS Software Development Eng.
data.description:
ADVANCE YOUR CAREER. ADVANCE THE WORLD. 

At AMD, we believe technology has the power to solve the world's most important challenges. From advancing healthcare and scientific discovery to powering AI and the technologies people rely on every day, innovation at AMD is shaping the future. 

Whether you're designing next-gen processors, enabling AI breakthroughs, or bringing leading edge products to market, every role at AMD contributes to something bigger - technology that moves the world forward. Join us and, together, we'll advance your career. 

The Role

AMD is looking for a Principal Member of Technical Staff (PMTS) to lead system and solution testing for our growing firmware team. As a key contributor, you will be part of a leading team that drives and enhances AMD's ability to deliver the highest-quality, industry-leading technologies to market. 

The Person

The ideal candidate has an innovative, problem-solving mindset and a keen eye for software engineering, and is diligent and passionate about technology. A successful candidate will bring strong knowledge of computer technologies, technical leadership skills and software engineering expertise, as well as a strong ability to compete effectively in a fast-paced environment while working with different teams of engineers and collaborators. As a technical leader, you will set the quality bar for the team, influence development teams and partners, and mentor the engineers around you. 

Key Responsibilities

- Define the system validation strategy, test architecture and release quality gates for firmware across AMD products. 
 - Validate new firmware and software features for AMD products at a system level before they are released to customers. 
 - Architect scalable automation frameworks and lab infrastructure for multi-node, cluster-scale testing. 
 - Leverage AI tools to accelerate the software validation cycle. 
 - Contribute actively to the day-to-day activities of the system test team in an Agile environment. 
 - Write test plans, review them with all stakeholders to cover the scenarios comprehensively, and execute them efficiently. 
 - Build maintainable, high-quality and effective automated test scripts. 
 - Review and triage test failures, and verify fixes. 
 - Help address customer-reported issues by reproducing them locally and working with peer teams for faster resolution. 
 - Stay informed of software and hardware trends and innovations, especially in firmware, CPUs, GPUs and accelerators. 
 - Debug complex technical issues and collaborate with peer teams. 
 - Develop technical relationships with peers and partners. 
 - Report quality status, risks and release readiness to program leadership. 
 - Mentor senior and junior engineers, and set the team's test engineering standards. 

Preferred Experience

- 15+ years of experience in system testing, validation or test automation, including 5+ years as a test architect or technical lead. 
 - Strong experience in firmware test and automation roles. 
 - Solid understanding of AI tools and how to leverage them in a large-scale distributed environment. 
 - Proficiency in writing automation scripts in Python, and experience with test and performance-testing tools. 
 - Solid understanding of automation frameworks, and fluency in Python. 
 - Prior experience with cloud, security and data center technologies is an added advantage. 
 - Strong troubleshooting skills. 
 - Knowledge of operating systems, kernel-mode programming, device drivers, and related technologies and architectures. 
 - Good interpersonal and communication skills. 
 - Ability to write high-quality automation code with keen attention to detail. 
 - Good understanding of the Linux operating system and hypervisors (VMware ESX, KVM). 
 - Experience with software development processes and tools such as debuggers, source code control systems (GitHub) and profilers is a plus. 
 - Track record of defining test strategy and release quality gates, and of building automation frameworks used across teams. 
 - Experience leading customer escalations and influencing development teams and leadership. 
 - Experience testing firmware on CPU, GPU or SoC platforms at scale, including AI workloads on multi-node clusters, is a strong plus. 

Academic Credentials

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering or equivalent. 

Benefits offered are described: AMD benefits at a glance. 

AMD does not accept unsolicited resumes from headhunters, recruitment agencies, or fee-based recruitment services. AMD and its subsidiaries are equal opportunity, inclusive employers and will consider all applicants without regard to age, ancestry, color, marital status, medical condition, mental or physical disability, national origin, race, religion, political and/or third-party affiliation, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity, military or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We encourage applications from all qualified candidates and will accommodate applicants' needs under the respective laws throughout all stages of the recruitment and selection process. 

AMD may use Artificial Intelligence to help screen, assess or select applicants for this position. AMD's "Responsible AI Policy" is available here. 

This posting is for an existing vacancy.

data.title: Senior iOS Engineer
data.description:
The Job in short

At Backbase, we build AI-powered, secure, enterprise-grade digital banking software used daily by millions worldwide. With seamless integration, unified data, agentic AI, and a complete banking suite built for every line of business, you'll be building the next generation of banking. 

As a Senior iOS Engineer, you will drive the AI-native engineering of our product across the software development lifecycle, following and improving our way of working, and refining our best practices. You will lead the team in ensuring our practices are not only best practice and efficient but continually evolving and improving to use AI principles

Meet the job

You will help design, build and maintain one or more capabilities for the Backbase Mobile Platform, working closely with the Principal Engineers. 

You will be part of a multidisciplinary squad that is responsible for delivering an end-to-end solution, from initial concept to fruition in one of our production-ready applications. You will be tasked with addressing complex business requirements and with translating them into technical designs and implementations. You will be expected to deliver high-quality, well-engineered software that is performant, clean and is easy to maintain. 

As a squad member, you will contribute to all aspects of product development, starting from gathering feedback & requirements and implementing actual functionality, to writing tests, documentation and providing product adoption support to colleagues, customers and partners. 

As a Senior Mobile Engineer, you will be working in the Identity team, which builds Identity and Authentication journeys and components for the Backbase mobile banking applications for Retail, Business and Wealth customers. 

You will

- Platform Development: Help design, build, and maintain one or more capabilities for the Backbase Mobile Platform, working closely with the Principal Engineers. 
 - Engineering & Quality: 

Build, improve, and grow SDKs and libraries to revolutionise Identity and Authentication for mobile banking. 

Write clean, maintainable Swift code to create scalable features that other developers can use seamlessly. 

Developing features with native frameworks and cutting-edge Apple technologies, collaborating with others in the squad and other mobile squads to bring in the latest ways to develop. 

Responsible for upholding our engineering standards across the product, proactively proposing and leading initiatives within your squad to improve engineering excellence. 

- Agile & CI/CD: 

Automate testing while working closely with QAs to achieve an 80% minimum unit test coverage using frameworks like XCTest and XCUITest. 

You have a strong engineering culture in all parts of the SDLC, working in Agile practices to deliver a complete product. 

CI/CD practices are part of your mantra, ideally with Bitrise and GitHub Actions. 

- AI-Native Mindset: 

Showing an AI-Native mindset, you will proactively explore, experiment with, and apply AI tools and agentic frameworks (e. g. , code generation, test automation, dev productivity). 

Encourage AI adoption across engineering workflows and product capabilities. 

- Collaboration: Contribute to all aspects of product development, starting from gathering feedback & requirements and implementing actual functionality, to writing tests, documentation and providing product adoption support to colleagues, customers and partners. 

How About You

- Experience: 6+ years of professional experience in native iOS development. 
 - Languages: Strong proficiency in Swift and practical experience with Objective-C. 
 - Domain: Experience developing applications in the FinTech, Banking, or Payments space. 
 - Architecture: Expertise in modern iOS architectural patterns (e. g. , MVVM, VIPER, Clean Architecture) and development frameworks (e. g. , SwiftUI, UIKit, Combine/RxSwift). 
 - Concurrency & Integration: Solid experience integrating with RESTful APIs, GraphQL, and asynchronous programming (e. g. , Grand Central Dispatch (GCD), async/await, Combine). 
 - Security & Tools: 

Strong understanding of mobile security best practices (e. g. , Keychain, Biometrics). 

Experience with version control systems like Git. 

- AI/ML Passion: 

You are passionate about embracing AI/ML tools such as GitHub Copilot, Cursor AI, and Xcode (AI) and you enjoy shaping the product or platform's functionality with AI. 

Bonus Points (Preferred Experience)

- In-depth knowledge of mobile application security and data encryption standards
 - Experience with dependency managers like Swift Package Manager (SPM) or CocoaPods. 
 - Familiarity with mobile analytics, A/B testing, and crash reporting tools (e. g. , Firebase, Crashlytics). 
 - Experience with building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines (e. g. , Jenkins, GitLab CI, GitHub Actions). 
 - Published one or more iOS applications on the Apple App Store.

data.description:
A career that's the whole package!

At Conga, we've built a community where our colleagues can thrive. Here you'll find opportunities to innovate and support growth through individual and team development, all within an environment where every voice is heard. 

Conga lines up commercial operations so companies run as connected, smarter businesses. By unifying the people and processes that drive commerce, Conga aligns pricing, quoting, contracting, rebates, and communications so teams stay in sync and buyers keep moving forward. The result is trusted decisions, consistent buyer experiences, and profitable growth. More than 10, 000 customers worldwide, including over 50% of the Fortune 100®, trust Conga when commercial complexity is high and global impact is on the line. 

Job Title: Software Engineer

Locations: Bangalore/Ahmedabad

Reports to: Director, Software Engineering

A quick snapshot. . . 

This role contributes to engineering quality by modernizing testing practices and implementing AI-assisted test automation solutions. Responsibilities include building AI-driven test suites, agentic workflows, and Model Context Protocol (MCP) integrations across web applications (React. js, Next. js). The position exists to execute core technical tasks, ensuring reliable and high-performing test suites alongside Engineering, Product, and DevOps teams. 

Why it's a big deal. . . 

This is a key role that focuses on hands-on delivery-writing clean test automation, using AI-assisted tooling, contributing to framework updates, and delivering reliable test coverage for the product ecosystem. 

Are you the person we're looking for?

Experience. 3 to 5 years of hands-on experience in Software Quality Engineering, with practical expertise writing, running, and maintaining UI (Playwright, Selenium) and API (REST Assured, Postman) automation tests using Java, TypeScript, or JavaScript. Hands-on experience working with test execution hooks like TestNG Listeners and Playwright Custom Reporters/Fixtures. 

AI & Intelligent Test Automation. You utilize AI-assisted tools for test generation, debugging, and failure analysis. You help build, integrate, and test custom AI agents, agentic workflows, and Model Context Protocol (MCP) integrations connected with Swagger/OpenAPI, qTest, Jira, and code repositories. 

AI Evaluation & Benchmarking. You support LLM and AI agent testing by running evaluations to measure accuracy, latency, and prompt output consistency using pipelines built with frameworks like Ragas, DeepEval, or Promptfoo. 

Engineering Productivity & Framework Excellence. You build and maintain automated test scripts, support workflow automation tools, write BDD scenarios (Cucumber/Gherkin), follow TDD practices, and participate in code reviews. 

CI/CD & DevOps Integration. You run and integrate automated test suites within CI/CD pipelines using Jenkins, GitHub Actions, Spinnaker, GitHub Copilot, Maven, and Git. 

Education. A bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent. 

Here's What Will Give You An Edge. . . 

Framework Modernization. Familiarity with modern Playwright/TypeScript test setups and Spec-Driven Development (OpenSpec / Spec Kit). 

AI Stack. Familiarity with Python, LLM prompt engineering, RAG, and multi-agent concepts. 

Tooling & Infrastructure. Basic exposure to dev tools and CI/CD pipelines (Jira, qTest, Jenkins, GitHub Actions, OpenAPI/Swagger) is good to have. 

Did we pique your interest?

If this sounds like the kind of job you would love in the kind of environment where you would thrive, please click apply. We'd love to hear from you!

Preferred Resume Format

We accept resumes in any format, we suggest using PDF or plain text. These formats help ensure that your resume's formatting remains intact, making it easier for our recruiters to review your application promptly. 

Don't meet every requirement for the role?

Studies have shown that women and members of ethnic minorities are less likely to apply to jobs unless they meet every single qualification. At Conga we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive, and authentic workplace, so if you're excited about this role but your experience doesn't align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You just might be the right candidate for this or other roles. 

Additional Information

Conga is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer and provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants regardless of race, color, religion, gender, gender identity, age, national origin, disability, parental or pregnancy status, marriage and civil partnership, sexual orientation, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We understand interviewing can be stressful for those with disabilities. If reasonable accommodation is needed to allow you to show us your best self, please let your recruiter know as soon as possible. All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines. Conga is not open to third party solicitation or resumes for our posted FTE positions. Resumes received from third party agencies that are unsolicited will be considered complimentary. 

Conga's Applicant Privacy Statement

The information you provide during the application process will be used in accordance with Conga's Applicant Privacy Statement (https: //conga. com/applicant-privacy-statement). By submitting your application, you acknowledge and agree to the terms outlined in this privacy statement.

data.title: Power Apps Technical Lead — Power Pages & Dataverse
data.description:
Avanade is the world's leading Microsoft expert, helping more than 7, 000 organizations modernize securely and scale AI using Microsoft technology, faster. Founded by Microsoft and Accenture, and operating as Microsoft's Client Zero, Avanade brings deep expertise and proven delivery to simplify complexity, accelerate innovation, and deliver measurable results. 

Together with Accenture, Avanade combines global scale with expertise in AI, cloud, data, cybersecurity, and ERP to design solutions that put people first. With 60, 000 Microsoft professionals worldwide, 165, 000 certifications, and the largest community of Microsoft MVPs, Avanade has spent more than 25 years helping organizations unlock the full potential of people and technology to create lasting impact for clients, employees, and communities. 

Role Summary

Avanade India's Business Applications practice is looking for a Power Apps Technical Lead to own the technical design and build of applications on the Microsoft Power Platform - with Power Pages and Dataverse at the centre of the role. This is a hands-on lead position: you will set the technical direction, make the design calls, write the harder parts of the code yourself, and lead a team of developers through delivery. 

The role is deliberately weighted towards Power Pages and front-end engineering. We are looking for someone who is as comfortable with HTML, CSS, JavaScript and Liquid as they are with a Dataverse security model - because externally facing portals are where those two worlds meet, and where most Power Platform projects run into trouble. 

Key Responsibilities

- Own the end-to-end technical design of Power Platform applications - solution architecture, Dataverse data model, security model, integration approach and front-end design - and document the decisions behind them. 
 - Lead the design and development of Power Pages sites: site structure and templates, web pages and web templates, Liquid, forms and lists, page and table permissions, authentication providers and external user access. 
 - Build rich, responsive front-end experiences on Power Pages using HTML, CSS, JavaScript and Bootstrap - custom components, client-side validation, dynamic behaviour and integration with the Dataverse Web API. 
 - Design and build applications in Power Apps - model-driven and canvas apps - including forms, views, business rules, client scripting and app-level performance considerations. 
 - Design and implement Dataverse solutions: tables, columns and relationships, keys, calculated and rollup fields, business rules, and a security model built on roles, teams, business units and row/column-level security. 
 - Develop server-side extensions where required - plug-ins and custom APIs in C#/. NET - and integrate with external systems through REST APIs and the Dataverse Web API. 
 - Build custom controls with the Power Apps Component Framework (PCF) using TypeScript and React where out-of-the-box components fall short. 
 - Lead the development team day to day - task breakdown, technical guidance, code reviews, unblocking developers and holding the quality bar on what ships. 
 - Own ALM and release practice: solution layering and management, environment strategy, source control, deployment pipelines and configuration/data migration between environments. 
 - Set and enforce engineering standards - coding conventions, naming, reusable components, performance patterns, accessibility and security practices for public-facing sites. 
 - Translate functional requirements into technical designs with the functional and business analyst teams, and challenge requirements where a simpler or more sustainable approach exists. 
 - Own non-functional quality: performance and page-load optimisation for portals, caching, scalability, accessibility (WCAG) compliance and security hardening of externally exposed sites. 
 - Support estimation, sprint planning and technical risk identification, and give realistic delivery input to project and client leadership. 
 - Engage client technical stakeholders directly - design walkthroughs, technical discussions and issue resolution - and represent the technical position credibly. 
 - Mentor developers on the team, and contribute reusable components, templates and accelerators back to the practice. 

Qualifications

Required Skills & Qualifications

- 6 - 9 years of overall application development experience, with substantial recent delivery on the Microsoft Power Platform. 
 - Strong hands-on experience building applications with Power Apps - model-driven and/or canvas - taken through to production. 
 - Deep, demonstrable Power Pages (or Power Apps Portals) experience: web templates, Liquid, forms and lists, table and page permissions, web roles, authentication and external-facing site delivery. 
 - Strong front-end web development skills - HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript (ES6+), responsive design and Bootstrap - with the ability to build custom UI rather than only configure out-of-the-box components. 
 - Deep Dataverse expertise: data modelling, relationships, business rules, and a genuine command of the security model - roles, teams, business units, and row- and column-level security. 
 - Experience with the Dataverse Web API and REST integration patterns, including authentication and error handling. 
 - Server-side development capability in C#/. NET - plug-ins, custom APIs and custom workflow activities. 
 - Experience with Power Apps Component Framework (PCF) and TypeScript for custom control development. 
 - Solid ALM discipline: solution management, environment strategy, source control (Git) and automated or repeatable deployments. 
 - Proven experience as a technical lead - owning design decisions, running code reviews, guiding developers and being accountable for technical quality on an engagement. 
 - Ability to work directly with clients and functional teams, explain technical trade-offs clearly, and push back constructively where needed. 
 - Strong debugging and troubleshooting skills across the full stack - browser, portal runtime, Dataverse and integrations. 

Preferred / Good To Have

- Microsoft certifications: PL-400 (Power Platform Developer), PL-600 (Solution Architect) or PL-200.

data.title: Design Manager
data.description:
Company Description Schematic Engineering Industries Private Limited manufactures specialized isolators, glove boxes, and containment equipment that conform to cGMP standards for the pharmaceutical, chemical, and food industries. The company offers an extensive product range for application isolators used in API/bulk drugs and formulations, including sterility testing, capsule packing, micronising, filling lines, and centrifuges. With head offices in Sheffield, UK, and Hyderabad, India, Schematic designs and manufactures isolators tailored to specific end-user requirements. The team also integrates its solutions with Original Equipment Manufacturers (OEMs), such as filling line and packaging machines, providing complete containment and process solutions. This environment offers engineering professionals exposure to complex, customized projects and international collaboration. 

Role Description The Design Manager is a full-time, on-site role based in Hyderabad, responsible for leading the design and development of isolators, glove boxes, and containment systems. The role involves managing a team of designers and engineers, planning design activities, allocating tasks, and ensuring that all projects meet technical, cGMP, and safety standards. The Design Manager will oversee concept development, detailed engineering, and design reviews, coordinating closely with production, quality, and project management teams to ensure seamless execution. They will collaborate with sales and customers to understand user requirements, translate them into practical designs, and adapt solutions for integration with OEM equipment such as filling and packaging lines. Day-to-day responsibilities also include maintaining design documentation, improving design processes and standards, mentoring team members, and supporting continuous innovation in product offerings. 

Qualifications

- Strong mechanical or process equipment design skills, including experience with containment systems or similar engineered products. 
 - Proficiency in CAD tools (e. g. , SolidWorks, Solid Edge, AutoCAD) and familiarity with design documentation, drawings, and BOM management. 
 - Knowledge of cGMP standards, pharmaceutical or chemical process requirements, and safety and compliance considerations. 
 - Demonstrated leadership and team management skills, including task planning, mentoring, and cross-functional coordination. 
 - Ability to manage customer requirements, translate specifications into design solutions, and collaborate with OEM partners. 
 - Strong problem-solving, analytical, and decision-making abilities, with attention to detail and quality. 
 - Effective communication skills for working with international teams and presenting designs to internal and external stakeholders. 
 - Bachelor's degree or higher in Mechanical Engineering, Industrial Design, or a related discipline; experience in pharmaceutical engineering or equipment design is an advantage. 
 - Experience in project management, design process improvement, and documentation control is beneficial. Detailed responsibilitiesTechnical ownership•          Review customer URS, order scope, exclusions, process needs and risk classification; establish the design basis and allocate engineering work. 

•          Approve GA, P&ID, calculations, 3D assemblies, fabrication drawings, bought-out specifications and BOMs before release. 

•          Ensure pressure/vacuum, structural, thermal, airflow, ergonomic, lifting and transport calculations are performed to the level required by project risk. 

•          Lead technical decisions for isolator architecture, airflow/pressure cascade, HEPA arrangement, VHP distribution, glove/RTP interfaces, decontamination boundaries and maintenance strategy, with specialist inputs where required. 

Design governance and standardisation•          Maintain standard modules, drawing templates, material specifications, approved components, design checklists and lessons-learned database. 

•          Control design revisions and prevent uncontrolled changes after approval; quantify cost and schedule impact before accepting customer changes. 

•          Drive value engineering without weakening containment, GMP, safety, reliability or lifecycle serviceability. 

•          Review recurring NCRs, FAT punch points and service failures and implement permanent design corrections. 

Team and project delivery•          Prepare engineering schedules linked to project milestones and balance workloads across multiple custom projects. 

•          Conduct concept, 30/60/90-percent and pre-release design reviews; record decisions, owners and closure dates. 

•          Coach engineers in Solid Edge, sheet metal, fabrication, tolerance, hygienic design and design documentation. 

•          Coordinate daily with Projects, Production, QA/QC, Purchase and Automation to remove execution constraints. 

Customer and compliance interface•          Represent engineering in customer design reviews and explain technical solutions, limitations and deviations with evidence. 

•          Ensure compliance with customer URS and applicable cGMP, machinery safety, electrical interface, pressure/vacuum and export-market requirements. 

•          Support FAT/SAT, technical investigations and critical field modifications. 

Cross-functional working and operating discipline•          Work in an engineered-to-order environment where customer URS, layout, process, containment, automation and documentation requirements vary from project to project. 

•          Use SAP and approved document-control systems for BOMs, material status, project records and release control, as applicable to the position. 

•          Follow Schematic's quality system, EHS requirements, confidentiality obligations and change-control process; do not release unapproved drawings, software, documents or commercial commitments. 

•          Coordinate constructively across Sales, Applications, Design, Automation, Purchase, Production, QA/QC, Projects, Service and Finance rather than working as an isolated function. 

Performance measures Measure

Expected evidence

Engineering on-time delivery

Design milestones achieved without delaying procurement or production

Design quality

Reduction in design-origin NCR, rework, cost leakage and FAT punch points

Standardisation

Increasing reuse of verified modules and reduction in engineering hours per comparable project

Change control

No uncontrolled scope/design release; cost and schedule impacts documented

Team capability

Skill matrix improvement, review discipline and successor development

Required experience and competencies•          Strong experience in engineered stainless-steel equipment, preferably pharmaceutical containment, isolators, cleanroom/process equipment or special-purpose machinery. 

•          Advanced 3D CAD and drawing-review capability; Solid Edge preferred. 

•          Working knowledge of stainless-steel fabrication, TIG welding, polishing, seals, filters, instrumentation and pneumatic systems. 

•          Ability to lead customer-facing technical reviews and make risk-based decisions. 

Expected outcomes in the first six months•          Establish a visible engineering plan and review cadence for all active projects. 

•          Identify the top recurring design failures and issue controlled standard corrections. 

•          Release at least one major project to production with documented design-basis and review closure. 

Candidate discussionShortlisted candidates should be prepared to discuss one or two relevant projects personally handled, the exact responsibility taken, calculations/drawings/data used, problems encountered, decisions made and measurable result achieved. Samples may be shown only if they do not violate a current or former employer's confidentiality. 

Note: This JD defines the present scope of the role. Project allocation and reporting interfaces may be adjusted according to business requirements, while maintaining appropriate authority and accountability.
