We are committed to equal employment opportunity and respect, value and welcome diversity in our workplace. Husky TechnologiesTM also values being a great place to work and strives to maintain a safe workplace. Accordingly, Husky TechnologiesTM conditions all offers of employment on satisfactory completion of background checks. No agency or telephone inquiries please.

data.title: Advisor–TSMS
data.description:
At Lilly, the work is demanding because patients are waiting. We unite caring with discovery to help make life better for people around the world, knowing that every decision, every detail, and every day matters. Headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana, our over 50, 000 employees around the globe take on complex challenges to discover and deliver life-changing medicines, strengthen how health is understood and managed, and support the communities we serve. This is hard, urgent, selfless work-but it's work worth doing. If you're driven by purpose and ready to bring your best to work that truly matters for patients, we invite you to join us. 

About Lilly

At Lilly, the work is demanding because patients are waiting. We unite caring with discovery to help make life better for people around the world, knowing that every decision, every detail, and every day matters. Headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana, our over 50, 000 employees around the globe take on complex challenges to discover and deliver life-changing medicines, strengthen how health is understood and managed, and support the communities we serve. This is hard, urgent, selfless work-but it's work worth doing. If you're driven by purpose and ready to bring your best to work that truly matters for patients, we invite you to join us. 

Manufacturing & Quality Technical Hub, Hyderabad

Lilly's Hyderabad hub is a first-of-its-kind technical center built to lead the manufacturing and quality science agenda for Lilly's global supply network, and the work done here reaches patients in more than 110 countries. 

This hub oversees contract manufacturing of starting materials and intermediates for API manufacturing in India, managing the full scientific agenda for manufacturing and quality. We're building a cutting-edge scientific organization and looking for top talent in process engineering, chemistry, analytical and data sciences to be part of it. 

The science you develop here doesn't stay here. It moves through Lilly's global supply network and reaches patients across more than 110 countries who are counting on it.

Lilly, a leading innovation-driven corporation is developing a growing portfolio of pharmaceutical products by applying the latest research from its own worldwide laboratories and from collaborations with eminent scientific organizations. Description

The Manager, Quality & Training Strategy owns how GO-AI defines, measures, and improves the quality of annotations delivered to Amazon Robotics and Worldwide Operations science teams. You will own the quality model for an AI and ML annotation workforce: how accuracy is measured, how measurement scales across use cases and demand, and how quality standards reflect the customer's perception of the output they receive. You operate as the independent measurement function for the annotation business, providing defect insights to Operations while representing the customer's view of quality. 

As GO-AI evolves, this role ensures that quality measurement keeps pace with how annotations are consumed by data scientists inside an ML product development lifecycle, and increasingly alongside model-generated output. You lead a team of program managers and quality managers across India and Costa Rica, and you apply an up-to-date understanding of AI capabilities to identify and drive use cases that improve operational metrics. 

Key job responsibilities

- Own the GO-AI quality model. Define how annotation accuracy is measured for each use case so that published metrics reflect the customer's perceived quality of the output. 
 - Own quality KPI definition and governance across 70+ use cases, including target baselining, process capability assessment, and the standards applied to new and ramping workforces. 
 - Define the quality measurement strategy, including how coverage and depth of measurement scale with demand, risk, and cost of quality. 
 - Lead deep dives on any degradation of customer-consumed quality metrics, drive to root cause through standardized mechanisms, and publish findings and corrective actions to senior leadership through weekly and monthly business reviews. 
 - Operate as the independent measurement function for the annotation business. Partner with Customer Tech Programs on customer quality and speed expectations, and with Operations business unit leaders on defect insights and remediation. 
 - Translate ML customer needs into quality standards. Understand how annotations feed model training and evaluation so that quality definitions match how data scientists consume the output. 
 - Maintain a current understanding of AI capabilities and how they function. Identify and drive use cases where AI tooling improves quality, speed, and experience. 
 - Lead and develop a geographically distributed team of 6 to 8 program managers and quality managers across India and Costa Rica. Own hiring, onboarding, performance management, career growth, and team structure. 

About The Team

GO-AI is a technology enablement organization that accelerates the development and enhances the performance of AI-based robotic and automation solutions for Amazon Robotics (AR) and key Worldwide Operations programs. data.title: Senior Director - Design Assurance & Product Management
data.description:
GSK remains committed to achieving bold commercial ambitions for the future. By 2031, we aim to deliver £40 billion in annual sales, leveraging our existing strong performance momentum to significantly increase our positive impact on the health of billions of patients globally. Our Ahead Together strategy is centered on early intervention to prevent and alter the course of disease, thereby protecting people and supporting healthcare systems. 

Our diverse portfolio consists of vaccines, specialty medicines, and general medicines. 

Through continuous innovation and a dedicated focus on scientific and technical excellence, we strive to develop and launch new, groundbreaking treatments that address critical health challenges. 

Domain focus: Function head for cyber security product management and Design Assurance across the Cyber Architecture and Solutions portfolio. 

Job Purpose: 

Serve as the quality, governance and product authority for Cyber Architecture & Solutions. You are accountable for ensuring every security solution Cyber Architecture and Solutions designs and builds meets the required quality, compliance and operational standard before it reaches the global managed service vendor - the independent quality gate between what Cyber Architecture and Solutions produces and what the vendor is asked to operate. You own the Cyber Architecture and Solutions governance framework, the security product portfolio, vendor governance for the managed service as a whole, and the programme capability that delivers all Cyber Architecture and Solutions change. Platform support engineering moves into this function, with a small internal team retaining accountability while the vendor operates more than 30 platforms and the data fabric under an OTO model. Seventeen roles, and the primary Cyber Architecture and Solutions interface to internal audit, regulators and the second and third lines of defence. 

About the team: 

Design Assurance and Product Management makes sure security is designed in before anything is built, and that GSK's security capabilities are run as products rather than projects. Design Assurance independently verifies that solutions meet the architecture standards set elsewhere in Cyber Architecture and Solutions; it writes none of those standards, and that separation is what makes the review worth anything. Product Management owns the security portfolio, vendor governance and investment analytics, and is how GSK manages its managed service vendor as a whole. Platform support engineering moves into this function, with a small internal team retaining oversight while the vendor operates more than 30 platforms and the data fabric under an OTO model. Seventeen roles. 

What makes this role different. The defining tension is that you assure against standards you do not own. Architecture writes them; you verify independently and make binding pass-or-fail calls on vendor handover readiness - and that separation has to survive pressure from programmes with deadlines and from architects who will not welcome the finding. You are also the executive accountable for a vendor operating more than 30 platforms, where the operational risk is real but the levers are contractual rather than direct. Expect audit and regulatory scrutiny of the governance framework you own, and be ready to evidence a governance function of yours that withstood it. 

Key responsibilities: 

This role will provide you the opportunity to lead key activities to progress your career. These responsibilities include some of the following: 

- Define, own and continuously improve the Cyber Architecture and Solutions governance and quality framework - the assurance process, the pass or fail criteria for vendor handover and the exception regime - applying the design standards owned by the Architecture function rather than authoring them. 
 - Own and operate the independent design assurance process, making binding pass or fail determinations on vendor handover readiness with no compromise on quality. 
 - Lead a 17-role function spanning Design Assurance, Security Product Management, and vendor and portfolio governance, sustaining a culture of rigour, independence and delivery. 
 - Own the Cyber Architecture and Solutions security product portfolio: product roadmaps for every capability under Cyber Architecture and Solutions's remit, full lifecycle management from introduction through evolution to decommission, prioritised against GSK's cyber risk appetite. 
 - Hold ultimate commercial accountability for vendor governance across the managed service - performance, SLA, escalation and commercial levers, and oversight of platform support as it transitions to the OTO model - with day-to-day governance delegated to the Associate Director for vendor governance. 
 - Own Cyber Architecture and Solutions security risk and exception management at the most senior level: assess complex architectural risk exceptions, maintain the Cyber Architecture and Solutions risk register, and escalate material unmitigated risk with unambiguous clarity. 
 - Own Cyber Architecture and Solutions-wide metrics and security posture reporting, and present authoritative performance evidence to the CISO, ExCo and Board-level risk committees. 
 - Lead Cyber Architecture and Solutions engagement with internal audit, external regulators and the second and third lines of defence, evidencing design quality and governance effectiveness. 
 - Own portfolio intelligence and investment analytics so prioritisation decisions are evidence-based rather than loudest-voice. 
 - Protect the independence of assurance when it is commercially or politically inconvenient. 
 - Own the function's budget and the security tooling spend envelope it governs, and defend the consolidation savings committed in the annual plan against the renewal calendar. 
 - Lead your team in using approved AI tools to improve productivity and ways of working, role-modelling responsible use and follow GSK's Responsible AI, privacy and security requirements. 
 - Set the technology and opportunity investment agenda for the portfolio - what to adopt, what to pilot and what to retire, including AI-enabled capability - and hold the evidence that justifies each decision. 

Basic Qualifications: 

- 20+ years in cyber security, including 7+ in senior leadership in a regulated environment leading leaders across geographies - domain focus: function head for cyber security product management and Design Assurance across the Cyber Architecture and Solutions portfolio
 - End-to-end product management of cyber security products - threat-led use-case definition, business case and investment, roadmap, vendor evaluation and selection, onboarding, adoption and value tracking, renewal and decommission - running capabilities as products with outcome KPIs (coverage, adoption, efficacy, cost per capability)
 - Building and leading a cyber security product management practice with domain product owners for each domain group, each mirrored to a Security Solution Engineering squad working in parallel, and technical deep dives proving product efficacy and integration
 - Leading an independent Design Assurance practice and governing a security managed service - binding pass or fail decisions on handover readiness made against standards owned by the Architecture function and never by you, supported by drift detection, QBRs and EBCs. 
 - Leading AI adoption across the portfolio and assurance - AI-enabled tool evaluation, assurance of agentic solutions and AI-driven lifecycle automation from intake to decommission

Preferred Qualifications: 

- Architecture literacy to make binding quality judgements on expert architecture output they do not own, expressed as non-conformance to a specific standard clause
 - Delivering enterprise security tool rationalisation with quantified savings, sequenced against renewal dates, with automated utilisation and renewal analytics
 - Evidencing design and product governance to internal audit, external audit and regulators, producing decisions, approvals and exceptions on demand
 - Credibility with Board-level risk committees, presenting assurance outcomes, portfolio performance and residual risk directly
 - Commercial acumen - multi-year vendor contracts, TCO and cost-to-serve modelling
 - Qualifications: Bachelor's degree in a relevant discipline, or equivalent professional experience. 
 - Typical tools and technologies: Product portfolio and roadmap platforms, vendor performance, SLA and commercial governance, design assurance methodology and assurance register, AI-assisted and agentic lifecycle automation, ServiceNow, Power BI for portfolio and assurance analytics, GxP-compliant documentation and audit evidence management. 

#AGTech

Skills

AI for Cybersecurity, Application Security, Cloud Security, Computer Programming, Cybersecurity, Data Security, Design Assurance, Global Team Management, Identity Access Management (IAM), Information Systems, Infrastructure Security, ML Security, Network Security Design, Operating Systems Security, Product Management, Product Portfolios, Scripting, Security Engineering, Security Strategy Transformation, Security Technologies, Security Testing, Vulnerability Management

Why GSK?

Uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. 

GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. We aim to positively impact the health of 2. 5 billion people by the end of the decade, as a successful, growing company where people can thrive. We get ahead of disease by preventing and treating it with innovation in specialty medicines and vaccines. We focus on four therapeutic areas: respiratory, immunology and inflammation; oncology; HIV; and infectious diseases - to impact health at scale. 

People and patients around the world count on the medicines and vaccines we make, so we're committed to creating an environment where our people can thrive and focus on what matters most. Our culture of being ambitious for patients, accountable for impact and doing the right thing is the foundation for how, together, we deliver for patients, shareholders and our people. 

Inclusion at GSK: 

As an employer committed to Inclusion, we encourage you to reach out if you need any adjustments during the recruitment process. 

Please contact our Recruitment Team at IN. recruitment-adjustments@gsk. com to discuss your needs. 

Important notice to Employment businesses/ Agencies

GSK does not accept referrals from employment businesses and/or employment agencies in respect of the vacancies posted on this site. All employment businesses/agencies are required to contact GSK's commercial and general procurement/human resources department to obtain prior written authorization before referring any candidates to GSK. The obtaining of prior written authorization is a condition precedent to any agreement (verbal or written) between the employment business/ agency and GSK. In the absence of such written authorization being obtained any actions undertaken by the employment business/agency shall be deemed to have been performed without the consent or contractual agreement of GSK. GSK shall therefore not be liable for any fees arising from such actions or any fees arising from any referrals by employment businesses/agencies in respect of the vacancies posted on this site. 

It has come to our attention that the names of GlaxoSmithKline or GSK or our group companies are being used in connection with bogus job advertisements or through unsolicited emails asking candidates to make some payments for recruitment opportunities and interview. Please be advised that such advertisements and emails are not connected with the GlaxoSmithKline group in any way. 

GlaxoSmithKline does not charge any fee whatsoever for recruitment process. Please do not make payments to any individuals / entities in connection with recruitment with any GlaxoSmithKline (or GSK) group company at any worldwide location. Even if they claim that the money is refundable. 

If you come across unsolicited email from email addresses not ending in gsk. com or job advertisements which state that you should contact an email address that does not end in "gsk. com", you should disregard the same and inform us by emailing askus@gsk. com, so that we can confirm to you if the job is genuine.

data.title: Software Architect - WiFi Protocol Stacks/Embedded Software
data.description:
Silicon Labs (NASDAQ: SLAB) is the leading innovator in low-power wireless connectivity, building embedded technology that connects devices and improves lives. Merging cutting-edge technology into the world's most highly integrated SoCs, Silicon Labs provides device makers the solutions, support, and ecosystems needed to create advanced edge connectivity applications. Headquartered in Austin, Texas, Silicon Labs has operations in over 16 countries and is the trusted partner for innovative solutions in the smart home, industrial IoT, and smart cities markets. Learn more at www. silabs. com. 

The Role

We are looking for a hands-on Software Architect to shape the architecture of embedded software, Wi-Fi protocol stacks, low-level firmware, and Linux drivers for our next-generation Wi-Fi ICs. 

This is a unique opportunity to contribute to the architectural foundations of advanced wireless connectivity - balancing execution today with a forward-looking vision of where our overall system, spanning both software and hardware, should be tomorrow. 

As part of a collaborative group of architects, you will work across execution, planning, and long-term strategy: defining architectures, guiding designs, and shaping the direction of our technology to align with evolving Wi-Fi standards and product needs. 

Responsibilities

Execution

- Own software architecture and design, and guide implementations to align with architectural direction. 
 - Debug complex system-level issues and provide solutions with architectural insights. 
 - Perform code reviews from an architectural and system perspective to ensure scalability, performance, and maintainability. 

Planning

- Collaborate with engineering managers on JIRA top-level split, estimation, and backlog structuring to ensure feasibility and alignment with architectural goals. 
 - Provide technical input on schedules, dependencies, and integration risks. 

Broad and Long-Term Vision

- Shape the long-term architectural vision for embedded software, Wi-Fi protocol stacks, and Linux drivers. 
 - Contribute to Wi-Fi specifications and standards and track industry trends to influence product direction. 
 - Drive strategic architectural initiatives that position Silicon Labs as a leader in wireless connectivity. 
 - Advocate for open-source/Linux engagement, including upstream contributions where valuable. 
 - Ensure rigor in software quality by driving unit testing, functional testing, continuous integration, and verification practices across the team. 

Skills you'll need: 

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or related field preferably IIT/NIT/BITS/IISc
 - 12+ years of professional software development experience, including significant experience in an Architect role, with a strong focus on embedded systems, communication stacks, or Linux kernel drivers. 
 - Proven ability to define and evolve software architectures for complex embedded systems, making thoughtful trade-offs across performance, power, scalability, reliability, and maintainability. 
 - Strong knowledge of software architecture and design patterns, with the ability to apply them pragmatically to achieve the best architecture without unnecessary reinvention. 
 - Demonstrated expertise in documenting and communicating architectures and designs in a clear and structured way for engineering teams and stakeholders. 
 - Ability to provide logical reasoning and lead technical conversations, building consensus around the best architectural and design choices, and influencing across architects, engineering teams, and leadership. 
 - Deep experience in system-level thinking and HW/SW partitioning, including designing software for complex SoCs and hardware accelerators. 
 - Deep expertise in Wi-Fi protocols or other communication stacks. 
 - Solid understanding of Linux kernel architecture and device drivers, including upstreaming practices. 
 - Hands-on proficiency in C development and low-level debugging at system and driver layers. 
 - Strong exposure to CI/CD pipelines, integration testing, and performance benchmarking frameworks. 

The following qualifications will be considered a plus: 

- Contributions to open-source projects (Linux kernel, networking stacks, etc. ). 
 - Familiarity with real-time operating systems (RTOS) alongside Linux. 
 - Knowledge of security in embedded software, including secure boot, cryptography, and trusted execution environments. 
 - Understanding of Agile/Scrum methodologies and experience collaborating in iterative development environments. 

Benefits & Perks

Not only will you be joining a highly skilled and tight-knit team where every engineer makes a significant impact on the product; we also strive for good work/life balance and to make our environment welcoming and fun. 

- Equity Rewards (RSUs) 
 - Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP) 
 - Insurance plans with Outpatient cover 
 - National Pension Scheme (NPS) 
 - Flexible work policy 
 - Childcare support. 

Silicon Labs is an equal opportunity employer and values the diversity of our employees. Employment decisions are made on the basis of qualifications and job-related criteria without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

Job Description

In this role, you will translate requirements into effective test strategies, combining automation with manual, exploratory, and integration testing to ensure comprehensive quality coverage across all application layers.

Automation Development & Framework Ownership

- Design, develop, and own scalable test automation frameworks and reusable components

data.description:
TESTOPS ENGINEER - AGENTIC AI

Location: XenonStack office, Sector 75, STPI, Mohali (Chandigarh Tricity), work from office

Experience: 2-8 years | Employment: Full time, XenonStack Private Limited | Team: AgentOps / Agentic AI Engineering

Role Level: X2 - Workflow

About Xenonstack

XenonStack is a Data and AI Foundry for Agentic Systems, enabling enterprises to design, deploy, operate, and scale intelligent agents across digital and physical environments. We build enterprise-grade platforms across the agentic stack: 

- Akira AI - Reasoning and agent orchestration. 
 - ElixirData - Agentic analytics intelligence. Explainable, decision-centric analytics for measurable business outcomes. 
 - NexaStack - Agentic infrastructure automation. Secure, compliant AI deployment across cloud, edge, and on-prem. 
 - MetaSecure - Trust, compliance and defense. Continuous assurance with AI-BOMs, risk scoring, and agentic security. 

Our mission is to accelerate the world's transition to AI + Human Intelligence by making agentic systems reliable, responsible, and enterprise-ready. 

About The Role

We are looking for a TestOps Engineer - Agentic AI with strong expertise in Python automation, LLM evaluation, agentic workflow testing, and CI/CD integration. 

You will design and maintain shared evaluation infrastructure, golden datasets, automated quality gates, and regression frameworks for AI agents across ElixirData, ElixirClaw, and NexaStack. 

This is an engineering-focused TestOps role, not a traditional manual QA position. You will build the testing systems and enable engineering teams to test their own components. 

ROLE MISSION

Make every AI agent release measurable, repeatable, reliable, and safe to ship through automated evaluations, statistical quality measurements, and continuous regression testing. 

Key Responsibilities

- Build and maintain reusable evaluation harnesses for LLM-powered agents and agentic workflows. 
 - Integrate offline evaluations for prompts, models, tools, and retrieval into CI/CD release gates. 
 - Measure agent quality, reliability, latency, and execution cost against defined thresholds. 
 - Create and version golden datasets, synthetic conversations, and edge-case scenario libraries for customer workflows. 
 - Validate agent trajectories, tool selection, execution sequences, and tool arguments. 
 - Develop contract tests for MCP servers, APIs, and external tools used by agents. 
 - Handle non-deterministic AI behavior using repeated evaluations, pass@k scoring, and statistical thresholds. 
 - Implement LLM-as-a-Judge evaluations and calibrate results against human-labelled datasets. 
 - Conduct adversarial testing for prompt injection, jailbreaks, data leakage, and policy violations. 
 - Execute regression evaluations during model, prompt, provider, and dependency upgrades. 
 - Establish release quality gates and validate releases against agreed quality and safety thresholds. 
 - Convert production incidents into automated regression tests and maintain shared quality dashboards. 
 - Provide reusable test templates and evaluation playbooks to engineering teams. 

How We Work With Ai

AI is part of the daily workflow at XenonStack, not an add-on. 

- At our Mohali/Chandigarh office, AI tools are open for use: coding assistance, test generation, evaluation design, debugging, documentation, and research. 
 - When working on a client's data or environment, follow the client's compliance and information security policy. Use only approved tools and never expose client data, code, credentials, or configurations to unapproved AI services. 
 - Every AI-generated test, evaluation result, and recommendation must be reviewed, validated, and understood before use. 
 - Come ready to discuss your AI testing stack, how you evaluate non-deterministic outputs, and how you prevent unsafe agent behavior. 

What Success Looks Like

- 100% of agent releases go through automated evaluation gates. 
 - Every active customer workflow has a versioned golden dataset with agreed scenario coverage. 
 - Every production incident is converted into a regression test within 5 days. 
 - Zero critical AI safety findings reach production. 
 - All engineering pods adopt the shared evaluation harness rather than maintaining separate testing scripts. 
 - Quality dashboards provide measurable visibility into agent reliability, latency, cost, and evaluation results. 

Must-have Skills

- Python and test automation: Strong Python programming, pytest, reusable test framework development, API testing, automated regression testing, and Git. 
 - LLM evaluation frameworks: Hands-on experience with DeepEval, Promptfoo, Ragas, LangSmith, or equivalent evaluation tools. 
 - Agentic AI: Understanding of RAG, LLMs, tool calling, agent execution trajectories, and agent frameworks. 
 - Agent integration testing: Experience validating APIs, MCP servers, tool contracts, and multi-step agent workflows. 
 - Evaluation techniques: Golden datasets, synthetic test generation, pass@k, statistical thresholds, repeated runs, and LLM-as-a-Judge evaluation. 
 - CI/CD and release engineering: Integrating automated evaluations into CI/CD pipelines and enforcing release quality gates. 
 - AI safety testing: Knowledge of prompt injection, jailbreaks, data leakage, adversarial scenarios, and policy validation. 
 - Engineering fundamentals: Debugging, root-cause analysis, test coverage, reproducibility, and maintainable automation code. 

Good-to-have Skills

- LangChain, LangGraph, or other agent orchestration frameworks. 
 - Claude, Azure OpenAI, Amazon Bedrock, or other LLM providers. 
 - Multi-agent system testing and agent-to-agent interaction validation. 
 - Docker, Kubernetes, and cloud-native deployment environments. 
 - AI observability, tracing, quality dashboards, and production monitoring. 
 - AI security, red-teaming, responsible AI, and governance frameworks. 
 - Experience with model and prompt versioning, benchmarking, and cost optimisation. 

CANDIDATE PROFILE

- 2-8 years of experience in QA Automation, SDET, MLOps, or related engineering roles, including hands-on LLM evaluation. 
 - Proven experience developing Python-based automation frameworks and integrating them into CI/CD workflows. 
 - Practical understanding of LLM applications, RAG systems, tool calling, and agentic AI architectures. 
 - Ability to evaluate non-deterministic systems using statistical metrics rather than relying only on binary pass/fail checks. 
 - Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline; demonstrated hands-on experience is equally important. 
 - Strong analytical thinking, debugging, communication, and cross-team collaboration skills. 

We value engineers who build scalable testing systems rather than simply execute test cases. Be ready to explain how you evaluated an AI agent, designed golden datasets, handled inconsistent outputs, and prevented regressions from reaching production. 

Traditional manual QA experience alone is not sufficient for this role. 

HIRING PROCESS

Pre-screening assessment (about 10 minutes, at application) → Technical interview → Face-to-face technical assessment at our Mohali office → HR and Leadership round → Background verification → Offer. 

TERMS

- Location: Work from our Mohali (Chandigarh Tricity) office. 
 - Full time; immediate joiners or short notice periods preferred. 
 - Background verification (BGV) is mandatory. 
 - Compensation as per company policy and budget band. 

How We Work

We value deep work, clarity, and execution over activity. You will be expected to clarify, plan, execute, and escalate with options, not wait to be told. Ownership sits with the individual, and outcomes are measured, not effort. 

OUR VALUES

Agency - Be self-directed and proactive | Taste - Sweat the details and build with precision | Ownership - Take responsibility for outcomes | Mastery - Commit to continuous learning and growth | Impatience - Move fast and challenge inertia | Customer Obsession - Always put the customer first

WHY JOIN US

- Build evaluation and testing infrastructure for enterprise-grade Agentic AI platforms. 
 - Work on LLM evaluation, agent reliability, AI safety, and production-grade quality engineering. 
 - Collaborate with AgentOps, engineering, security, and observability teams. 
 - AI-first environment: work alongside the agentic platforms we build. 
 - Great Place to Work-Certified, 14+ years, headquartered in Mohali.

data.description:
Job Summary

Non Functional Test Engineer role in a hybrid work model for an airport operations and airlines domain project focusing on performance reliability and resilience testing for critical aviation applications. The engineer will design and execute non functional test strategies using automation AI test generation tools and API testing to ensure high quality systems that support safe and efficient air travel operations across global stakeholders. 

Responsibilities

- Define comprehensive non functional test strategies and plans that validate performance reliability scalability and security of airport operations and airline applications in alignment with business goals and regulatory expectations. 
 - Design detailed test scenarios using advanced AI test generation tools to increase coverage reduce human error and accelerate identification of bottlenecks across complex aviation workflows. 
 - Develop robust automated test suites for performance and resilience including load stress endurance and capacity tests that provide clear metrics on system behavior under realistic airport passenger and flight volumes. 
 - Implement API testing frameworks that validate response time throughput data consistency and error handling for critical integrations among booking systems airport operational control systems and airline services. 
 - Coordinate end to end non functional test execution in a hybrid work model ensuring smooth collaboration between onsite and remote stakeholders and maintaining consistent communication and documentation. 
 - Analyze performance test results using structured methods to identify root causes of latency resource contention and stability issues and translate findings into practical tuning recommendations for engineering teams. 
 - Collaborate closely with application architects and developers to define non functional requirements capacity targets and service level objectives that reflect real world airline and airport operational demands. 
 - Create clear reusable test data strategies for non functional testing that simulate flight schedules passenger profiles baggage volumes and operational events without compromising privacy or compliance. 
 - Prepare concise dashboards and reports that present key non functional quality indicators trends and risks to project managers product owners and domain experts enabling informed decision making. 
 - Establish and refine automation standards for non functional tests to improve repeatability maintainability and integration into continuous integration and delivery pipelines across aviation platforms. 
 - Validate system behavior under failure scenarios by orchestrating component outages network disruptions and degraded services to ensure graceful recovery and minimal impact on airport and airline operations. 
 - Support defect triage for non functional issues by prioritizing based on customer impact operational risk and regulatory considerations and by driving timely resolution with technical teams. 
 - Mentor peers on non functional testing practices tools and domain specific scenarios sharing knowledge about aviation processes so the entire team can deliver higher reliability outcomes. 

Qualifications

- Demonstrate strong experience in using AI test generation tools to design complex non functional test scenarios enhancing coverage and reducing test design cycle time in fast paced delivery environments. 
 - Apply practical expertise in test automation frameworks to create maintain and execute performance and reliability test suites that integrate seamlessly with existing build and deployment pipelines. 
 - Use deep hands on skills in API testing to validate functional and non functional aspects of services including response time throughput error handling and security behavior for aviation integrations. 
 - Bring proven domain experience in airport operations encompassing passenger handling flight turnaround baggage operations and resource allocation to design realistic performance test scenarios. 
 - Exhibit solid understanding of airline business processes such as reservations ticketing check in boarding disruption management and loyalty programs to align non functional testing with actual use cases. 
 - Possess strong analytical abilities in interpreting performance metrics logs and traces enabling quick isolation of capacity constraints configuration issues and architectural limitations. 
 - Show capability to work effectively in a hybrid model managing time collaboration tools and documentation practices to maintain transparency and continuity across distributed teams. 
 - Maintain familiarity with industry standards and good practices related to non functional quality performance security and reliability in mission critical transportation and travel systems.

Description

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we're the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain - and we're looking for talented people who want to help. 

You'll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You'll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you'll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion. 

The Data Center Capacity Delivery Asia-Pacific Controls Deployment and Service (DCCD APAC CDS) team delivers and services the control systems that ensure the health of AWS data centers. Operating across Australia & New Zealand, India, North Asia, and Southeast Asia, APAC CDS manages 41 leased/owned sites and supports global follow-the-sun operations. APAC CDS covers three core disciplines: deployments (control systems in new data centers), projects (controls capital improvement works at live sites), and service (control systems at live sites), with additional specializations in colocated sites, systems engineering, controls fleet, program management, and coordination. 

As Amazonians, we work in a competitive environment. Our customers are always beautifully, wonderfully dissatisfied. Being successful in our roles is not just about doing our jobs well, but also evolving and innovating. Change is the only constant, and applies to our customers, our roles, our team organization, our tools, and our mechanisms. 

To be successful in this team, you will also have: 

- Ability to thrive at the pace and scale of Amazon
 - Ability to work independently and manage multiple competing priorities
 - Ability and willingness to collaborate with peers around the globe, which may involve some participation in meetings at odd hours
 - Ability and willingness to travel domestically or globally as and when needed

Controls Deployment & Service (CDS) Engineers deliver and support data center building automation systems, such as Building Management Systems (BMS) and Electrical Power Monitoring Systems (EPMS). CDS Engineers work to deploy and service building automation systems, to ensure the health of our data centers. As a CDS Engineer, you may oversee deployment of a new BMS or EPMS as part of a new data center build, deliver projects to upgrade an existing data center owned or leased by Amazon, or deliver projects to upgrade colocated data centers with Amazon hardware. As a CDS Engineer, you may also be required to provide local servicing expertise to our fleet or data centers in your region, and occasionally assist with global support. Successfully working as a CDS Engineer will also require you to partner effectively with the many teams at Amazon that make our data center deployments and operations a success, including Construction, Commissioning, Critical Projects, Data Center Operations, Procurement, Program Management, Design, and Engineering teams, as well as maintaining strong relationships with our vendors. 

Key job responsibilities

Deployment of data center controls, on time, with effective management of vendors to ensure minimal defects at the point of Power and Facilities Hand-Off (PFHO)

- Delivery of critical projects to upgrade data center automation
 - Service and support provided to partner teams, providing diagnosis and resolution of Loss of Visibility (LOV), Loss of Resilience (LOR), Large Scale Event (LSE), Critical Scale Event (CSE), and other operations impacting events
 - Resolution of tasks within predefined Service Level Agreements (SLAs)
 - Delivery of further initiatives to improve the efficiency of our data centers or our operations procedures

A day in the life

Join the cloud leader: AWS has the most proven operational and security expertise, and the business is innovating at a faster clip-especially in new areas such as Machine Learning and Artificial Intelligence, the Internet of Things, Serverless Computing, and custom-designed processors and chips. 

- Be at the nexus of action: Your involvement in data center delivery will be mission-critical to the successful deployment of our data centers. You won't just be observing from the sidelines; you'll be representing Amazon, building relationships across a wide variety of internal and external stakeholders. 
 - Build at scale: Build and operate infrastructure at an enormous scale, participating in Amazon's global presence. 
 - Your unique background will be an asset: At Amazon, our ability to innovate on behalf of our global customers and communities is dependent upon the skills, perspectives, and knowledge of people from all backgrounds. 
 - Continuous growth and learning: You may not be an expert in AWS when you join our company, but you will have support to become one. Benefit from direct access to industry-leading specialists, latest training materials, and courses to propel your career. 

About The Team

About AWS

Diverse Experiences

AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn't followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don't let it stop you from applying. 

Why AWS?

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world's most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating - that's why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses. 

Inclusive Team Culture

AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do. 

Mentorship & Career Growth

We're continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth's Best Employer. That's why you'll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional. 

Work/Life Balance

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there's nothing we can't achieve in the cloud. 

Basic Qualifications

 - Experience carrying new design concepts through exploration, development, and into deployment or mass production

Preferred Qualifications

 - Knowledge of building codes and regulations including Life Safety, BOCA, NFPA, NEC, or OSHA

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. This role operates in a fast-paced, innovative environment and focuses on developing creative, high-quality solutions to complex technical challenges.

data.title: Director, AI/ML
data.description:
Job Title: DIRECTOR, AI/ML

GCL: F

Location: Bangalore

Introduction To Role

Are you ready to set the technical bar for AI systems that shape how life-changing therapies reach patients? In this senior individual-contributor role based in Bangalore, you will be the technical authority guiding advanced AI across our commercial landscape-from traditional ML to Generative and agentic AI-turning breakthroughs into measurable outcomes for patients and the business. 

You will lead through influence, not headcount, defining architecture, standards and strategy while pairing that with hands-on expertise. Partnering with colleagues across Commercial, Medical and Technology, you will help transform diverse data-patient, physician, health systems, sales and scientific content-into rigorous, scalable AI that drives better decisions at pace. How would you design resilient AI systems that are trusted, governed and production-ready from day one?

Accountabilities

- Technical Vision and Architecture: Define and drive the technical vision, roadmap and architecture for traditional ML, Generative AI and agentic AI capabilities, aligned to enterprise strategy and commercial priorities. 
 - Multi-functional Leadership: Provide hands-on technical leadership to project teams; set design direction, review architectures and code, and remove blockers on sophisticated problems. 
 - Agentic AI Systems: Lead the design of multi-agent systems and LLM applications, including orchestration, tool use, memory, guardrails and human-in-the-loop patterns. 
 - Evaluation Excellence: Establish standards for evaluation, including automated and human-in-the-loop methods, benchmarking, and quality gates pre- and post-release. 
 - Model Optimization: Drive approaches to fine-tuning, distillation and reinforcement learning (including RL from feedback) to improve quality, cost and latency over off-the-shelf models. 
 - Production Observability: Set standards for telemetry, observability, monitoring, drift detection and cost management for AI systems in production. 
 - Emerging Tech to Production: Evaluate emerging models, frameworks and methods; run proofs of concept and translate them into robust, production-grade solutions. 
 - Enterprise Alignment: Partner with platform, data engineering, architecture, security and responsible-AI teams to ensure governance, compliance and reuse. 
 - Partner Communication: Translate complex technical concepts and trade-offs for senior non-technical partners and shape compelling use cases for AI investments. 
 - Talent Uplift and Representation: Mentor senior data scientists and ML engineers, raise the technical bar, and represent our work in internal forums and partner engagements. 

Essential Skills/Experience

Minimum Requirements: 

- BS (or equivalent experience) in computer science, mathematics, statistics, engineering, physics, computational sciences or a related quantitative field. 
 - Extensive experience (typically 12+ years) building and deploying data science and ML solutions, including considerable recent hands-on experience (typically 2+ years) with LLM-based and agentic applications in production. 
 - Demonstrated track record of setting technical direction and leading complex, multi-functional AI delivery through influence. 

Mandatory Technical Skills

- Generative AI and LLMs: prompt and context engineering, retrieval-augmented generation, fine-tuning (including parameter-efficient methods), distillation, and model selection and cost/latency optimisation. 
 - Agentic AI: design and delivery of multi-agent systems using frameworks such as Amazon Bedrock AgentCore (or equivalents such as LangGraph, Strands or AutoGen), including tool integration, orchestration and guardrails. 
 - Evaluation and observability: LLM and agent evaluation methods and platforms, telemetry, tracing and monitoring of AI systems. 
 - Machine learning foundations: strong classical ML (supervised and unsupervised methods, statistical modelling) and deep learning, including transformers, using PyTorch or TensorFlow. 
 - Programming and tools: expert Python; SQL; scikit-learn; Jupyter; Streamlit or similar for rapid prototyping. 
 - Cloud and MLOps: AWS (SageMaker, Bedrock), CI/CD for ML, MLflow or equivalent experiment and model tracking, containerisation (Docker). 

Desirable Skills/Experience

- Master's or PhD in machine learning, computer science or a related field. We prioritise demonstrated skills over credentials. 
 - Hands-on experience with reinforcement learning, including RLHF, RLAIF or other preference-optimisation methods. 
 - Experience with knowledge graphs, NLP, and structured and unstructured data (text and image). 
 - Experience with data and pipeline tooling such as Airflow, Spark and data-quality frameworks. 
 - Pharmaceutical, healthcare or commercial analytics domain experience (for example next-best-action, field-force, marketing or market-access analytics). 
 - Publications, patents or open-source contributions in AI/ML. 
 - Exceptional technical judgement, balancing innovation with pragmatism, risk and cost. 
 - Strong written and verbal communication, explaining complex methods to non-technical audiences. 
 - Collaborative approach to working with global, multi-functional teams. 
 - Curiosity and an aim to keep learning in a fast-moving field. 

When we put unexpected teams in the same room, we unleash bold thinking with the power to inspire life-changing medicines. In-person working gives us the platform we need to connect, work at pace and challenge perceptions. That's why we work, on average, a minimum of three days per week from the office. But that doesn't mean we're not flexible. We balance the expectation of being in the office while respecting individual flexibility. Join us in our unique and ambitious world. 

Why AstraZeneca

Here, your technical leadership meets meaningful scale: we build from the ground up as one team, connecting across the enterprise to convert complex data into practical insights that improve lives. You will collaborate with deep specialists and external partners, access cutting-edge tooling, and contribute to novel solutions that move from prototype to production with rigor and pace. We value ambition and kindness in equal measure, pair bold experimentation with strong ethics, and bring unexpected teams together to unlock ideas that drive real patient impact-while giving you the room to grow your craft and your profile. 

Call To Action

If you are ready to define the standards for AI that powers real-world decisions and deliver impact at scale, step forward and help us build what's next!

Date Posted

09-Nov-2026

Closing Date

AstraZeneca embraces diversity and equality of opportunity. We are committed to building an inclusive and diverse team representing all backgrounds, with as wide a range of perspectives as possible, and harnessing industry-leading skills. We believe that the more inclusive we are, the better our work will be. We welcome and consider applications to join our team from all qualified candidates, regardless of their characteristics. We comply with all applicable laws and regulations on non-discrimination in employment (and recruitment), as well as work authorization and employment eligibility verification requirements.

data.title: Senior Manager - Design Assurance & Product Management
data.description:
GSK remains committed to achieving bold commercial ambitions for the future. By 2031, we aim to deliver £40 billion in annual sales, leveraging our existing strong performance momentum to significantly increase our positive impact on the health of billions of patients globally. Our Ahead Together strategy is centred on early intervention to prevent and alter the course of disease, thereby protecting people and supporting healthcare systems. 

Our diverse portfolio consists of vaccines, specialty medicines, and general medicines. 

Through continuous innovation and a dedicated focus on scientific and technical excellence, we strive to develop and launch new, groundbreaking treatments that address critical health challenges. 

Domain focus: Design Assurance practice delivery across all Cyber Architecture and Solutions security domains. 

Job Purpose: 

The delivery management layer in the Design Assurance practice, between the Principals and the analysts. You own review scheduling and reviewer allocation against demand, track findings to closure across the practice, and manage the assurance throughput and turnaround metrics the function is judged on. You carry a review caseload alongside the management load. 

About the team: 

Design Assurance and Product Management makes sure security is designed in before anything is built, and that GSK's security capabilities are run as products rather than projects. Design Assurance independently verifies that solutions meet the architecture standards set elsewhere in Cyber Architecture and Solutions; it writes none of those standards, and that separation is what makes the review worth anything. Product Management owns the security portfolio, vendor governance and investment analytics, and is how GSK manages its managed service vendor as a whole. Platform support engineering moves into this function, with a small internal team retaining oversight while the vendor operates more than 30 platforms and the data fabric under an OTO model. Seventeen roles. 

What makes this role different. The delivery management layer between the Principals and the analysts in a practice judged on throughput and turnaround, not just rigour. You own review scheduling and reviewer allocation against incoming demand, drive findings to closure across every domain, and run the governance reporting and audit evidence packs. Workflow automation in ServiceNow is how the practice scales, and improving it is part of the role. You carry a review caseload alongside the management load, so this is not a pure coordination job. 

Key responsibilities: 

This role will provide you the opportunity to lead key activities to progress your career. These responsibilities include some of the following: 

- Manage the demand pipeline across two Principals and the domain analysts, and decide what gets expedited - including telling a programme director that their review will not be. 
 - Manage assurance throughput, turnaround and SLA metrics the function is judged on, and escalate capacity pressure before turnaround slips quietly. 
 - Drive findings and time-bound conditions to closure across all domains, chasing the ones that stall and escalating aged items by name. 
 - Develop the analyst team's domain depth and progression, in a practice where most reviewers arrive strong in one domain and need two. 
 - Own the quality of what the practice produces - review rigour, finding clarity and closure discipline - and correct it at the individual level when it drops. 
 - Carry a review caseload alongside the management load, so technical credibility with the Principals is maintained. 
 - Manage the analyst team's day-to-day workload, quality and development across their domain specialisms. 
 - Carry roughly a third of a reviewer caseload yourself on Tier 2 designs, so allocation decisions are informed by current technical judgement rather than administration. 
 - Verify against standards the practice does not write, and protect that separation in how work is allocated. 
 - Spot capacity pressure in the pipeline two sprints out and escalate it, rather than letting turnaround slip quietly and explaining it afterwards. 
 - Use approved AI tools in your day-to-day work to improve your own productivity and your team's ways of working, sharing what works and applying sound judgement, including validating outputs and following GSK's Responsible AI, privacy and security requirements. 

Basic Qualifications: 

- 10+ years in cyber security or technology assurance, including team management - domain focus: Design Assurance practice delivery across all Cyber Architecture and Solutions security domains
 - Managing delivery across Principals and analysts - review scheduling and reviewer allocation against demand, using workflow automation
 - Tracking findings to closure with throughput and turnaround metrics, and running practice governance reporting and audit evidence packs
 - Carrying a review caseload alongside people management, coordinating with architecture, engineering and vendor delivery teams
 - Managing AI and agentic tool reviews within the practice, and using AI to improve review throughput and evidence qualityManaging AI and agentic tool reviews within the practice, and setting the evidence standard those reviews must meet. 

Preferred Qualifications: 

- Managing and developing a team of senior reviewers and analysts
 - ServiceNow or equivalent GRC and workflow tooling, including automation and dashboards
 - Enough architecture depth to personally carry a Tier 2 review of a SIEM integration or a cloud landing-zone design, so reviewer allocation is informed rather than administrative. 
 - Regulated industry experience, including GxP and audit evidence standards
 - Protecting senior review capacity by absorbing day-to-day allocation and demand management into the delivery layer. 
 - Qualifications: Bachelor's degree in a relevant discipline, or equivalent professional experience. 
 - Typical tools and technologies: Review scheduling and reviewer allocation, workflow automation in ServiceNow, SLA, throughput and turnaround metrics, findings tracking to closure, governance reporting and audit evidence packs, Power BI. 

#AGTech

Skills

AI for Cybersecurity, Application Security, Cloud Security, Computer Programming, Cybersecurity, Cyber Security Architecture, Data Security, Design Assurance, Identity Access Management (IAM), Information Systems, Infrastructure Security, ML Security, Operating Systems Security, Scripting, Security Engineering, Security Technologies, Security Testing, Technology Assessment, Technology Compliance, Vulnerability Management

Why GSK?

Uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. 

GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. We aim to positively impact the health of 2. 5 billion people by the end of the decade, as a successful, growing company where people can thrive. We get ahead of disease by preventing and treating it with innovation in specialty medicines and vaccines. We focus on four therapeutic areas: respiratory, immunology and inflammation; oncology; HIV; and infectious diseases - to impact health at scale. 

People and patients around the world count on the medicines and vaccines we make, so we're committed to creating an environment where our people can thrive and focus on what matters most. Job Description - API Test Architect & Test Solution Lead

API Modernization | Microservices | Healthcare | Quality Engineering

Role Overview

We are seeking an experienced API Test Architect & Solution Lead to lead the quality engineering strategy, architecture, and implementation for large-scale API modernization and microservices transformation programs within the healthcare domain. 

The role will be responsible for defining the end-to-end API testing architecture and modernization validation strategy for enterprise services being transformed from legacy/monolithic platforms into modern RESTful APIs and microservices. 

This is a customer-facing technical leadership role requiring strong expertise in API testing, test automation architecture, microservices, legacy-to-modern API parity validation, CI/CD integration, healthcare data validation, and AI-assisted Quality Engineering. 

The Solution Lead will work closely with enterprise architects, API developers, product owners, business teams, DevOps teams, and QA engineering teams to ensure modernized services meet functional, integration, data integrity, performance, security, and release-readiness requirements. 

Key Responsibilities

API Test Architecture & Solutioning

- Define the enterprise API Quality Engineering architecture, strategy, standards, and implementation roadmap for API modernization programs. 
 - Design scalable and reusable API automation frameworks supporting hundreds of APIs and thousands of test scenarios. 
 - Establish standardized testing approaches using Cucumber, TestNG, REST Assured, Gradle, Git/Bitbucket, Jenkins/Udeploy, and automated reporting. 
 - Define framework architecture with clear separation of: 
 - Test data
 - Test logic
 - Configuration
 - Validation utilities
 - Reporting
 - Environment management
 - Build reusable automation components, utilities, libraries, and common validation capabilities that can be adopted across multiple projects. 
 - Establish traceability across requirements → feature files → test data → automated execution → defects → results. 

API Modernization & Microservices Validation

- Lead testing strategy for migration of legacy enterprise services to REST APIs and microservices architecture. 
 - Define legacy-versus-modernized service parity testing to ensure business functionality and data behavior remain consistent during modernization. 
 - Establish baseline request/response datasets from legacy services and compare them against modernized API responses. 
 - Design automated comparison capabilities for: 
 - Request/response validation
 - JSON/XML payload comparison
 - Schema validation
 - Field-level comparison
 - Business-rule validation
 - Data transformation validation
 - Database/backend validation
 - Error and exception handling
 - Validate service decomposition and interactions across distributed microservices. 
 - Develop testing approaches for synchronous and asynchronous service integrations. 
 - Define regression strategies that allow modernization teams to continuously verify functional parity during incremental migration. 

API Functional & Integration Testing

- Define comprehensive API testing coverage including: 
 - Functional testing
 - Integration testing
 - Contract testing
 - Schema validation
 - Positive and negative testing
 - Boundary testing
 - Authentication and authorization validation
 - Error handling
 - Data integrity validation
 - Regression testing
 - End-to-end service validation
 - Establish API test scenarios based on OpenAPI/Swagger specifications, GraphQL schemas, interface contracts, business requirements, and legacy system documentation. 
 - Define reusable test-data strategies using Excel, generated datasets, synthetic data, and approved production-like samples. 
 - Drive automation-first testing while identifying scenarios requiring specialized or exploratory validation. 

Healthcare Domain Validation

- Provide Quality Engineering leadership for healthcare enterprise services supporting areas such as: 
 - Member and eligibility
 - Provider
 - Claims
 - Benefits
 - Enrollment
 - Accumulators
 - Authorization
 - Payments
 - Clinical and administrative integrations

CI/CD & DevOps Integration

Reporting & Quality Metrics

AI-Assisted Quality Engineering

Technical Leadership & Customer Engagement

 - Lead technical discussions across development, architecture, DevOps, business, and QA teams. 
 - Mentor automation engineers and QA leads and provide technical direction across distributed teams.

API Automation: REST Assured, Cucumber BDD, TestNG, Java, Gradle

Framework Architecture: Reusable automation framework design, modular architecture, custom assertion utilities, schema validation, response comparison, test-data management

and independently define the corresponding:

data.title: Senior QA Engineer, OmniSub
data.description:
About Us

DriveWealth is on a mission to make investing easier. We believe that everyone should have the ability to control their financial future, and that access to financial markets should not be limited by geography, wealth, or legacy systems. We are a global B2B financial technology organization dedicated to democratizing access to financial independence around the world. Our mission is realized through an API-based platform, empowering our partners to offer seamless investing and trading experiences to clients worldwide, all from their mobile devices. Our technology provides partners with a modern, extensible toolkit, enabling traditional investment workflows and innovative techniques like fractional share ownership. DriveWealth has evolved into a global platform offering trading of US equities, mutual funds, ETFs, fixed income, and options. 

There's never been a better time to build a category-defining business and there has rarely been a team better positioned for this opportunity. Our culture blends the pace and agility of a fintech start-up with the impact, stability, and discipline of Wall Street. We encourage creativity and experimentation while ensuring institutional-grade execution and regulatory compliance in everything we do. Join us and help build the future of global investing!

About The Role

DriveWealth is seeking a hands-on Senior QA Engineer to join our Quality Assurance team supporting post-trade platforms: clearing, custody, settlement, and the back-office systems that follow trade execution. This role is embedded within a product engineering team and focuses on scalable automation, high-quality releases, and stronger testing practices across the SDLC. 

The ideal candidate has strong technical automation experience and prior exposure to post-trade processing, reconciliation, and margin products in a broker-dealer or clearing environment. 

What You'll Do

- Design, develop, and maintain automated test frameworks using Java, Cucumber (BDD), and RestAssured
 - Build and execute automated tests across API, event/messaging (Kafka, queue-based integrations), and data layers, with UI coverage where applicable
 - Validate end-to-end post-trade workflows, including trade settlement, positions and cash, corporate actions, options lifecycle (exercise, assignment, expiration), margin, asset transfers (ACATS), and cost basis/tax lots
 - Design and automate reconciliation tests between DriveWealth systems and clearing/custodian platforms, validating positions, balances, and transactions Validate downstream outputs such as trade confirmations, statements, and regulatory reports (e. g. , CAT/FINRA)
 - Create test plans, scenarios, and regression suites for financial systems, including migration and parallel-run validation
 - Build and maintain CI/CD test pipelines (Jenkins, GitHub Actions)
 - Performance Testing experience
 - Analyze test results, troubleshoot defects, and improve test coverage
 - Collaborate with Engineering, Product, Operations, and Compliance teams on testing strategy and quality improvements
 - Participate in test reviews, bug triage, and production issue analysis

You Bring

- 8+ years of QA experience in financial services, with direct exposure to post-trade, clearing, or back-office platforms
 - Strong hands-on programming in Java
 - Automation experience with Cucumber/BDD and RestAssured
 - Experience testing REST APIs and event-driven systems (Kafka; RabbitMQ or SQS a plus)
 - Strong SQL (Postgres) skills for data validation and reconciliation
 - Working knowledge of post-trade concepts: settlement cycles, corporate actions, margin, options lifecycle, and books-and-records requirements
 - Experience with AWS, Git, and Jenkins
 - Familiarity with JIRA and test management tools (Allure TestOps)

Special Knowledge (Nice To Have, But Not Required)

- Playwright and TypeScript for UI automation
 - Experience with a clearing system conversion or platform migration
 - Exposure to FIX protocol, crypto asset workflows, or data tools such as Databricks

Location

This role is open to candidates in the following locations: Hyderabad, IN

- This role is expected to come into the office on a cadence set by the Hiring Manager/Team. 
 - If you're not based in one of the locations listed above, this role is not a fit, and we cannot accommodate remote work outside these locations. 

Working at DriveWealth

We do our best work when we're in the same room. To maintain the speed our partners expect, our New York, Chicago, and Lithuania teams work in office on a hybrid schedule. We've found that being physically side-by-side is the only way to solve complex problems in real-time and stay truly accountable to the products we ship. When you're here, you're working directly with the people making the decisions. 

To support that work, we provide competitive compensation, equity, and a 401(k) match. We also offer Medical insurance, Dental insurance, Vision insurance, Disability insurance, and Paid Parental Leave, along with a wellness reimbursement, a company-provided phone, and a personal development allowance. Finally, we value the time you spend away from the office with generous Paid Time Off (PTO) and observed holidays. 

Work Authorization

Applicants must possess the legal right to work in the country where the position is located at the time of application. DriveWealth requires all employees to provide original documentation verifying their work authorization on or before their first day of employment. 

For US-based roles: Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States on a full-time basis without the need for current or future visa sponsorship. DriveWealth does not provide visa sponsorship or support for employment authorization, including transfers, at this time. Offers of employment are strictly contingent upon an individual's ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the Company. 

How We Think About AI

We leverage AI to work smarter and move faster. We seek AI-curious talent who are proactive about using emerging tools to increase signal quality, reduce friction, and improve outcomes to deliver products faster, provide better service to our partners, and to streamline processes. Your ability to leverage our internal tools and technology to drive results is as important to us as your core domain expertise. 

Compensation

Pay is generally based on the level, complexity, responsibility, location, and job duties/requirements of the specific position. We then source candidates with the requisite skills, expertise, education, training, and experience. If you are selected for an interview, please feel welcome to speak to a recruiter about our compensation philosophy and other available benefits. This role is eligible for base, bonus, equity, 401(k) match, and heavily subsidized benefits and perks. 

Equal Employment Opportunity

To build technology and products that are used and loved by people and solve real-world problems, we need to build a team with many different perspectives and experiences. We are an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. We encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply. 

Agency Disclaimer

DriveWealth does not accept agency resumes. Do not forward resumes to our jobs alias, employees, or any other organization location. DriveWealth is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes.

data.title: Data Security Engineering Lead
data.description:
About Astellas

Astellas is a global life sciences company committed to turning innovative science into VALUE for patients. We provide transformative therapies in disease areas that include oncology, ophthalmology, urology, immunology and women's health. Through our research and development programs, we are pioneering new healthcare solutions for diseases with high unmet medical need. Learn more at Astellas. com (https: //www. astellas. com/en)

Are you driven to make a real difference in the lives of patients?

We're seeking passionate individuals who thrive in dynamic environments, embrace new ideas, and aren't afraid to take intelligent risks. People who act with unwavering integrity and are deeply committed to making a tangible impact. 

Purpose And Scope

Engineer and run the Microsoft Purview platform that protects Astellas' most sensitive data. As Data Security Engineering Lead, you will turn approved protection requirements into working sensitivity labels, data loss prevention and classification controls, keep them accurate as the business and its use of AI evolve, and lead the Astellas team that takes over day-to-day operations from our implementation partner. 

Responsibilities And Accountabilities

- Scope: Microsoft Purview data security capabilities across Exchange Online, SharePoint Online, OneDrive, Teams, Windows endpoints, browsers, and Microsoft 365 Copilot and other AI tools, in a single global Microsoft 365 tenant. 
 - Information Protection: Design, configure and maintain sensitivity labels and label policies, container labels, client-side and service-side auto-labeling, and encryption (Rights Management and Message Encryption), keeping the label scheme simple enough for employees to apply correctly. 
 - Data Loss Prevention: Build and tune Purview DLP policies across email, collaboration, endpoint (via Defender for Endpoint) and browser channels, and extend protection to Copilot and AI tools using Data Security Posture Management (DSPM) for AI. Configure policy tips, user notifications and business-justification overrides. 
 - Classification & Detection: Turn crown-jewel and use-case inputs from the Data Protection Policy & Engagement Lead into accurate detection, using custom sensitive information types, exact data match, document fingerprinting and trainable classifiers. Validate coverage with Content Explorer and Activity Explorer, and reduce false positives using feedback from the business and the Insider Risk team. 
 - Policy Lifecycle & Operations: Run policy change control from simulation to enforcement and rollback; triage and escalate DLP alerts; configure approved exceptions with expiry dates; and monitor user overrides, reporting patterns back to policy owners. 
 - Integration & Automation: Send Purview alerts and audit data to Microsoft Sentinel and ServiceNow with the Security Operations and platform teams; automate configuration, reporting and testing with Purview PowerShell and Microsoft Graph; and work with the Insider Risk team to share data loss and insider risk signals, align detections and Adaptive Protection, and use joint findings to tune policies. 
 - Service Ownership: Own service levels, performance metrics and the operations and engineering runbook; lead knowledge transfer from our implementation partner; and become the Astellas operations owner for the platform by mid-2027. 
 - Platform Leadership: Own the Microsoft Purview data security platform roadmap and provide input to licensing decisions; oversee our implementation partner's engineering delivery and quality; and lead and mentor the Astellas engineers and analysts who take over day-to-day operations. 

Required Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, Information Technology or a related field. 
 - 10+ years in security engineering or operations, including 4+ years hands-on with Microsoft Purview data security (Information Protection, DLP and data classification) in a production Microsoft 365 environment. 
 - Experience leading cross-functional initiatives with global stakeholders and overseeing external partners or vendors, including leading or mentoring a team. 
 - Experience building custom sensitive information types and tuning DLP policies to reduce false positives at enterprise scale. 
 - Hands-on experience with Endpoint DLP and Microsoft Defender for Endpoint. 
 - PowerShell scripting, with working knowledge of KQL and Microsoft Graph. 
 - Ability to explain technical behavior clearly to non-technical stakeholders. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience with exact data match, document fingerprinting or trainable classifiers. 
 - Experience protecting Microsoft 365 Copilot and AI tools with DSPM for AI. 
 - Experience integrating Purview with Microsoft Sentinel, Defender XDR and ServiceNow. 
 - Experience with Zscaler CASB and Data Security products. 
 - Experience in pharmaceutical, life sciences or other regulated industries. 
 - Microsoft Certified: Information Security Administrator Associate (SC-401); SC-200 or SC-100 a plus. 

Working Environment

At Astellas we recognize the importance of work/life balance, and we are proud to offer a hybrid working solution allowing time to connect with colleagues at the office with the flexibility to also work from home. We believe this will optimize the most productive work environment for all employees to succeed and deliver. Hybrid work from certain locations may be permitted in accordance with Astellas' Responsible Flexibility

What awaits you at Astellas?

- Global collaboration: Become part of a connected global business of like-minded life science leaders, all dedicated to improving patients' lives worldwide. 
 - Real-world patient impact: Contribute to transformative therapies that reach patients around the world, knowing your work makes a difference every day. 
 - Relentless Innovation: Join a company at the forefront of scientific breakthroughs, where you'll have the opportunity to shape the future of healthcare. 
 - A Culture of Growth: Chart your own course within a supportive environment that values your contributions, champions your development, and empowers you to pursue your passions. 

Our Organizational Values and Behaviors

Values: Innovation, Integrity and Impact sit at the heart of what we do.

Admin

Techno Commercial

As a Cloud Architect, you will provide technical leadership for our cloud infrastructure, platform engineering and security architecture. This role partners closely with engineering, security and data teams to drive cloud-native adoption and operational excellence.

 - Drive Infrastructure as Code (Terraform/GitOps) and automation standards across cloud, containerised and serverless platforms. 
 - Establish monitoring, logging, tracing, and reliability practices to ensure platform health and operational excellence. 
 - Lead and mentor a team of Cloud and Security Engineers, fostering technical excellence and DevSecOps best practices. 

Key Performance Measures

- Well-Architected Infrastructure: Maintain high availability, cost efficiency and resilience across public cloud environments.

Required Skills & Experience

Extensive experience implementing Infrastructure as Code using Terraform and driving automated deployments through GitOps-based delivery models.

Education & Qualification : Bachelor's in Computer Science/Engineering, or a Master's in Computer Applications/Science preferred.

Hybrid Remote
