Adaptability, Adaptability, Agile Methodology, Amazon Web Services (AWS), Automation Cloud, Cloud Infrastructure, Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery Methodologies, Docker (Software), Empathy, Experimentation, GitHub, Infrastructure As Code (IaC), Kubernetes, Lambda, Linux, NoSQL, Prometheus, Python (Programming Language), Scala (Programming Language), Spark, Structured Query Language (SQL), Systems Programming, Taking Ownership, Teamwork, Technical Documents {+ 2 more}

data.title: Senior Software Engineer, Security Platform
data.description:
The salary range for this role is $5, 000 - $9, 500 per month (Gross in USD)

About Sezzle{{{{~}}}}

With a mission to financially empower the next generation, Sezzle is revolutionizing the shopping experience beyond payments, blending cutting-edge tech with seamless, interest-free installment plans that make shopping smarter and more accessible. We're not just transforming payments; we're redefining how people discover, interact with, and purchase the things they love while driving real impact on merchant sales through increased conversions and higher order values. As we continue to shape the future of fintech and retail, we're building an innovative, dynamic team passionate about creating more than just a transaction but a truly unique shopping journey. If you're excited about pushing boundaries in tech and delivering a game-changing experience for consumers and merchants alike, come join us at Sezzle and help create the future of shopping!

Compensation{{{{~}}}}

For this senior role, with 6+ years of experience, the compensation range is $5, 000 - $9, 500 USD based on experience level per month and in gross amount. This range acknowledges the strong expertise and significant contributions expected at this level. This is a fully remote role. We believe the best engineers can do world-class work from anywhere, and we hire accordingly. Work from where you do your best work. 

About the Role{{{{~}}}}

We are seeking a hands-on Senior Software Engineer, Security Platform, to build and own the platform the security team runs on{{{{~}}}} the services that discover, scan, triage and route security findings, the event-driven bus that connects them, and the CI security gates every team's pipeline runs through. 

This is a development role on the security team, not a security-analyst role. Most of your time goes into designing, building and operating services in Go and Python on Kubernetes{{{{~}}}} new services where the programme needs them, the existing fleet where it has grown faster than its upkeep, and the NATS-based event platform that moves findings, inventory changes and notifications between them. The security gates in our GitLab CI (SAST, SCA, secret detection, container and IaC scanning) and the agentic triage and review workflows are part of that platform, not the whole of it. Your job is to make these systems fast, low-noise, and reliable enough to be trusted by default without slowing delivery. 

You will report to the Director of Information Security and work alongside the engineers who own detection and response and network and zero trust - your platform is what their work composes with. 

At Sezzle, AI-assisted engineering is a standard part of how we build. In this role you will build reusable agentic workflows (Claude Code skills, CI review agents, automated triage and verification) that multiply what the team can cover, and hold that review discipline in the platform code you own. 

What You'll Do{{{{~}}}}

- Design, build, and operate security engineering services primarily in Golang and Python, on AWS and Kubernetes{{{{~}}}} new services where the programme needs them, and the upkeep, hardening and retirement of the existing ones. 
 - Own the event-driven platform between the security services{{{{~}}}} the NATS bus, its contracts and consumers, delivery guarantees and observability - so a finding, an inventory change or an alert reaches every service that acts on it. 
 - Integrate the platform end-to-end{{{{~}}}} scanners → finding system-of-record → tickets → metrics, so remediation state is visible and exam evidence is a by-product of engineering. 
 - Own delivery of the security gates - SAST, SCA, secret detection, container and IaC scanning{{{{~}}}} scanner selection and tuning, suppression workflow mechanics, false-positive burn-down, and the rollout tooling that takes a gate from advisory reporting to enforcing without blocking delivery. 
 - Build agentic security workflows{{{{~}}}} CI review agents, automated finding triage and verification, remediation helpers - tooling other engineers actually adopt. 
 - Build the triage-to-remediation automation{{{{~}}}} validate true positives by hand enough to prove the tooling right, then automate the loop - reproduction context, fix guidance, and routing to the owning teams and to vulnerability-management operations. 
 - Participate in threat modeling and secure design reviews for the services you build and the pipelines you own. 
 - Participate in the on-call rotation for the services you own. 

What We Look For{{{{~}}}}

- 6+ years of professional software engineering experience, including significant backend experience. 
 - Deployed significant changes to a production application in the past 30 days. 
 - Strong proficiency in Golang, plus working proficiency in Python. 
 - Hands-on experience building and operating event-driven or message-based systems (NATS, Kafka, or similar){{{{~}}}} contracts, idempotent consumers, replay, back-pressure. 
 - Hands-on experience building and operating CI/CD pipeline tooling - jobs, shared templates, runners - GitLab CI at fleet scale is a strong plus. 
 - Hands-on web application security knowledge{{{{~}}}} the OWASP Top 10 in real code - able to find these issues, fix them yourself, and encode the detection so they stop recurring. 
 - Hands-on experience with SAST, SCA, and secret-scanning tooling (e. g. , Semgrep, CodeQL, Snyk, Trivy, Grype, gitleaks), including tuning them to a signal-to-noise ratio developers will tolerate. 
 - Demonstrated AI-forward engineering{{{{~}}}} you actively use AI tooling (e. g. , Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, or custom LLM integrations) in your development work today, have opinions grounded in practice about where it helps and where it doesn't, and have built agentic workflows that other engineers adopted. 
 - Working knowledge of AWS and Kubernetes as deployment targets for the services you build. 

Preferred Knowledge and Skills{{{{~}}}}

- Experience in fintech, payments, BNPL, or consumer lending, especially with systems in cardholder-data or regulated scope. 
 - Working knowledge of PCI DSS and SOC 2 as they apply to software development and change management - the platform you build is what produces that evidence. 
 - Software supply-chain integrity{{{{~}}}} SBOM pipelines, dependency governance, artifact signing and provenance (Sigstore, SLSA). 
 - Familiarity with policy-as-code and admission control (OPA, Kyverno, conftest) - your gates compose with the cluster's runtime policy-enforcement layer. 
 - Exposure to bug bounty or external vulnerability report triage - enough to know what the automation you build has to get right. 
 - Experience with threat modeling at a system level. 

About You{{{{~}}}}

- You measure yourself by other teams' code - a fix you shipped is good; a vulnerability class that stopped appearing across the fleet is better. 
 - You'd rather ship a gate than publish a policy - you know that enforcement changes behavior and documents do not, and you build the enforcement so well that engineers want to keep it. 
 - You have relentlessly high standards - many people may think your standards are unreasonably high. You are continually raising the bar and driving those around you to deliver great results. You make sure that defects do not get sent down the line and that problems are fixed so they stay fixed. 
 - You're not bound by convention - your success-and much of the fun-lies in developing new ways to do things. 
 - You need action - speed matters in business. Many decisions and actions are reversible and do not need extensive study. We value calculated risk-taking. 
 - You earn trust - you listen attentively, speak candidly, and treat others respectfully. 
 - You have backbone; disagree, then commit - you can respectfully challenge decisions when you disagree, even when doing so is uncomfortable or exhausting. You do not compromise for the sake of social cohesion. Once a decision is determined, you commit wholly. 
 - You deliver results - you focus on the key inputs and deliver them with the right quality and in a timely fashion. Despite setbacks, you rise to the occasion and never settle. 

Sezzle's Technology Stack{{{{~}}}}

- Languages{{{{~}}}} Golang, Typescript, Python
 - Frontend{{{{~}}}} Typescript - React and React Native
 - Backend{{{{~}}}} Golang
 - Database{{{{~}}}} MySQL, Postgres, Elasticsearch
 - DevOps & Cloud{{{{~}}}} AWS, Kubernetes
 - Version Control{{{{~}}}} Git
 - CI/CD{{{{~}}}} Gitlab
 - Testing{{{{~}}}} Developer and AI-driven, focus on automated end-to-end, integration, and unit tests
 - Open Source{{{{~}}}} Sezzle is focused on using open source, and we build what we can before buying!

What Makes Working at Sezzle Awesome?

At Sezzle, we are more than just brilliant engineers, passionate data enthusiasts, out-of-the-box thinkers, and determined innovators; we are skilled musicians, yogis, cyclists, chefs, golfers, dog-lovers, and rock-climbers. We believe in surrounding ourselves with not only the best and the brightest individuals, but those that are unique and purpose-driven in all that they do. Our culture is not defined by a certain set of perks designed to give the illusion of the traditional startup culture, but rather, it is the visible example living in every employee that we hire.

MathWorks has a hybrid work model that enables staff members to split their time between office and home. The hybrid model provides the advantage of having both in-person time with colleagues and flexible at-home life optimizations. Learn More: https: //www. mathworks. com/company/jobs/resources/applying-and-interviewing. html#onboarding. 

MathWorks is seeking an engineer to help develop and deploy a production engineering solution for Model-Based Design. The role combines strong software development skills with practical engineering expertise to translate real-world development processes and needs into reusable tools, automation, and system capabilities. 

The role will focus on creating scalable solutions that integrate the MathWorks toolchain into end-to-end engineering pipelines, spanning requirements, system and software design, modeling, simulation, verification and validation, code generation, quality assurance, reporting, and continuous integration. The engineer will help establish standardized and automated processes while providing the flexibility needed to adapt them to different engineering organizations, development environments, and tool infrastructures. 

A key aspect of the role is connecting product development with practical production engineering, identifying repeatable engineering patterns and turning them into robust, maintainable capabilities that can be deployed broadly. These environment may support development processes governed by industry standards such as ISO 26262 and DO-178C, where traceability, consistency, verification evidence, configuration management, and engineering rigor are critical. 

The ideal candidate brings hands-on experience with Model-Based Design and the MathWorks toolchain, strong software development skills, and an understanding of production engineering processes and practices for developing complex or safety-critical systems. 

MathWorks nurtures growth, appreciates inclusivity, encourages initiative, values teamwork, shares success, and rewards excellence. 

Responsibilities

- Design and develop reusable software components, process automation, tools, and frameworks that enable engineering teams to implement consistent and scalable development processes. 
 - Develop extensible and maintainable software architectures that provide standardized operational capabilities while allowing configuration and extension for different engineering organizations, programs, and development environments. 
 - Apply software engineering best practices including modular architecture, source control, automated testing, continuous integration, documentation, release management, and maintainability to ensure production-quality solutions. 
 - Integrate the MathWorks toolchain with engineering infrastructure, including source control, CI/CD systems, requirements systems, test environments, build pipelines, and other development tools. 
 - Identify repeatable engineering patterns and practices and translate them into reusable workflow capabilities rather than one-off solutions. 
 - Collaborate across MathWorks development, consulting, and application engineering teams to incorporate relevant product capabilities, engineering practices, and field experience into the deployment solution. 
 - Contribute to the evolution of the offering, including architecture, requirements, feature development, examples, documentation, testing, deployment approaches, and technical roadmap. 

Minimum Qualifications

- A bachelor's degree and 6 years of professional work experience (or a master's degree and 3 years of professional work experience, or a PhD degree, or equivalent experience) is required. 

Additional Qualifications

- Strong Experience with Simulink and Model-Based Design. 
 - Strong MATLAB scripting and programming experience. 
 - Software development in C or C++ for real-time and embedded applications. 

In addition, experience in the following areas would be advantageous: 

- Development of software tools for engineering and/or scientific applications. 
 - Software certification processes and standards such as ISO 26262, AUTOSAR, DO 178C, etc.

data.title: Senior Site Reliability Engineer
data.description:
The salary range for this role is $5, 000 - $9, 500 per month (Gross in USD)

About Sezzle{{{{~}}}}

With a mission to financially empower the next generation, Sezzle is revolutionizing the shopping experience beyond payments, blending cutting-edge tech with seamless, interest-free installment plans that make shopping smarter and more accessible. We're not just transforming payments; we're redefining how people discover, interact with, and purchase the things they love while driving real impact on merchant sales through increased conversions and higher order values. As we continue to shape the future of fintech and retail, we're building an innovative, dynamic team passionate about creating more than just a transaction but a truly unique shopping journey. If you're excited about pushing boundaries in tech and delivering a game-changing experience for consumers and merchants alike, come join us at Sezzle and help create the future of shopping!

Compensation{{{{~}}}}

For this senior development role, with 6+ years of experience, the compensation range is $5, 000 - $9, 500 USD per month. This range acknowledges the extensive expertise, leadership capabilities, and significant contributions expected at this level, offering a competitive salary to reflect the value of advanced skills and experience. 

Working Hours{{{{~}}}}

This role operates on a fixed schedule of 6{{{{~}}}}00 AM to 2{{{{~}}}}00 PM EST. While the position is based in India, the team operates primarily in the United States, supporting Sezzle's operations across the U. S. and Canada. Candidates must be available to consistently work during these EST hours. 

About the Role{{{{~}}}}

We are seeking a talented and motivated best-in-class Senior Site Reliability Engineer. This role presents an exciting opportunity to thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced environment within a rapidly growing team, with abundant prospects for career advancement. 

As a Senior SRE with Sezzle, you will have a high degree of autonomy and authority to identify and resolve problems you see in our infrastructure, deployments, operational workload, and overall systems. 

You should consider yourself a DOer to be a good fit for this role. We expect you to bring a deep well of experience to play, and with AI tooling, you should be a force for scaling in the organization. 

What you'll do{{{{~}}}}

- Architect, upgrade, design, and build scalable infrastructure solutions leveraging Kubernetes, AWS, RDS (MySQL/Postgres), and modern distributed patterns. 
 - Help drive the infrastructure team's roadmap, leading us to higher levels of reliability, recoverability, and scalability. 
 - Drive capacity planning, benchmarking, and work with the team to stress test our systems, find bottlenecks, and prepare for further growth in the business. 
 - Define, maintain and enforce SLAs and alerts across our infrastructure. 
 - Lead the teams towards stronger signal anomaly detection, better, more flexible alerting. 
 - Help Lead Sezzle's AI enablement efforts, identifying opportunities to apply AI and automation to enhance infrastructure reliability, developer productivity, and internal tooling. 
 - Build in consistency and scalability across a distributed microservices architecture while maintaining performance and reliability. 
 - Establish and evolve engineering best practices for observability, security, and CI/CD across teams. 
 - Mentor engineers and champion a culture of learning, innovation, and operational excellence. 
 - Collaborate cross-functionally to translate business goals into technical roadmaps and deliver results that matter. 

What We Look For{{{{~}}}}

- 6+ years of professional software engineering or infrastructure engineering experience, including significant SRE and backend experience. 
 - Deployed significant changes to a production application or infrastructure configuration in the past 30 days. 
 - Strong proficiency in Golang, with experience building and maintaining RESTful APIs. 
 - Expertise with SQL-based RDBMS (MySQL, PostgreSQL) and experience optimizing schema and queries for performance at scale. 
 - Proficiency in observability tools (Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog, New Relic). 
 - Solid understanding of distributed systems design patterns (e. g. , transactional outbox, event-driven architecture and stream processing, queues). 
 - Demonstrated ability to bring new ideas forward, influence decisions, and lead complex technical initiatives. 
 - Demonstrated experience working with Claude or equivalent large language model tools is required; candidates must be comfortable leveraging AI to enhance productivity, research, and communication. 
 - Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field. 

Preferred Knowledge and Skills{{{{~}}}}

- Experience with AWS cloud infrastructure, mainly AWS Aurora RDS, both MySQL and Postgres. 
 - Experience with data engineering, data pipelines and data warehousing. 
 - Experience with CI/CD pipelines and deploying containerized microservices in Kubernetes. 
 - Familiarity with AI developer tooling like Claude Code, Gemini CLI, Codex, Cursor and using it to be a more productive engineer. 
 - Track record of shipping commercial APIs and data-driven applications in high-growth environments. 
 - Proven leadership in guiding technical direction, improving system reliability, and scaling high-traffic services. 

About You{{{{~}}}}

- You have relentlessly high standards - many people may think your standards are unreasonably high. You are continually raising the bar and driving those around you to deliver great results. You make sure that defects do not get sent down the line and that problems are fixed so they stay fixed. 
 - You're not bound by convention - your success-and much of the fun-lies in developing new ways to do things
 - You need action - speed matters in business. Many decisions and actions are reversible and do not need extensive study. We value calculated risk-taking. 
 - You earn trust - you listen attentively, speak candidly, and treat others respectfully. 
 - You have backbone; disagree, then commit - you can respectfully challenge decisions when you disagree, even when doing so is uncomfortable or exhausting. You have conviction and are tenacious. You do not compromise for the sake of social cohesion. Once a decision is determined, you commit wholly. 
 - You deliver results - you focus on the key inputs and deliver them with the right quality and in a timely fashion. Despite setbacks, you rise to the occasion and never settle. 

Sezzle's Technology Stack{{{{~}}}}

- Languages{{{{~}}}} Golang, Typescript, Python
 - Frontend{{{{~}}}} Typescript - React and React Native
 - Backend{{{{~}}}} Golang
 - Database{{{{~}}}} MySQL, Postgres, Elasticsearch
 - DevOps & Cloud{{{{~}}}} AWS, Kubernetes
 - Version Control{{{{~}}}} Git
 - CI/CD{{{{~}}}} Gitlab
 - Testing{{{{~}}}} Developer and AI-driven, focus on automated end-to-end, integration, and unit tests
 - Open Source{{{{~}}}} Sezzle is focused on using open source, and we build what we can before buying!

What Makes Working at Sezzle Awesome?

At Sezzle, we are more than just brilliant engineers, passionate data enthusiasts, out-of-the-box thinkers, and determined innovators; we are skilled musicians, yogis, cyclists, chefs, golfers, dog-lovers, and rock-climbers. We believe in surrounding ourselves with not only the best and the brightest individuals, but those that are unique and purpose-driven in all that they do. Our culture is not defined by a certain set of perks designed to give the illusion of the traditional startup culture, but rather, it is the visible example living in every employee that we hire.

data.title: Manager - Smelter
data.description:
Responsibilities

- Key Responsibilities of Role

Manager - Smelter - Copper

Production Planning And Execution

- Lead the entire section's (anode and casting, boiler operation, convertor, crane operations, flue gas desulphurisation, primary smelter/ secondary smelter/raw material handling, refractory maintenance, revert crushing, flash smelting furnace and tapping) production across three shifts, ensuring seamless operations and adherence to the production plan. 
 - Plan and ensure the availability of materials, preventing any production delays or issues across shifts. 
 - Execute the business plan for the section, aligning production goals with overall organizational objectives. 
 - Coordinate with shift in-charges and ensure smooth workflow across upstream and downstream processes. 

Process Optimization And Continuous Improvement

- Drive continuous improvement initiatives to enhance production efficiency and reduce waste. 
 - Analyze process performance metrics and recommend strategies for improving yield and reducing downtime. 
 - Develop process optimization projects focused on material handling and equipment usage. 
 - Collaborate with cross-functional teams to implement best practices for smelting operations. 

Quality Assurance And Control

- Ensure compliance with quality standards across all production processes, conducting routine checks and process parameter analysis. 
 - Monitor lab assays and operational parameters to ensure minimal deviations from quality standards. 
 - Review feedback from quality control tests to identify areas for improvement. 
 - Lead the troubleshooting of any quality-related issues to prevent recurring defects. 

Equipment Monitoring And Troubleshooting

- Monitor equipment performance across shifts, ensuring timely identification of issues and preventive maintenance. 
 - Direct the scheduling of maintenance demand to avoid unplanned downtime, ensuring equipment runs optimally. 
 - Troubleshoot equipment malfunctions in real-time, collaborating with the maintenance team to resolve issues. 
 - Ensure preventive maintenance schedules are followed to minimize breakdowns and extend equipment life. 

HSE And Regulatory Compliance

- Ensure compliance with all Health, Safety, and Environmental (HSE) regulations, including proper handling of materials and equipment. 
 - Lead safety audits and inspections to proactively identify hazards and enforce corrective actions. 
 - Direct the implementation of safety protocols and Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) to maintain a safe working environment. 
 - Promote a culture of safety among the workforce, ensuring adherence to regulatory and safety standards. 

Cost Management And Budgeting

- Plan and manage the budget for the section, ensuring efficient resource allocation and cost-effective production. 
 - Monitor and approve PR/PO processes to ensure timely procurement of materials and services. 
 - Drive cost-saving initiatives by optimizing resource use and minimizing waste across production cycles. 
 - Review and manage invoice processing to ensure proper cost tracking and financial control. 

Resource And Workforce Management

- Allocate manpower efficiently, including on-roll employees and contractual workers, to meet production demands. 
 - Plan for manpower needs, including manpower planning for shifts and scheduling based on operational requirements. 
 - Lead workforce training and development initiatives, ensuring employees are well-versed in operational and safety standards. 
 - Ensure effective coordination between teams across shifts to maintain production consistency. 

Reporting And Data Analytics

- Analyze key production data, including shift reports, material consumption, and equipment performance, to identify trends and areas for improvement. 
 - Review and submit accurate production reports, ensuring management has up-to-date insights on section performance. 
 - Use data analytics to track process performance metrics and drive data-based decision-making. 
 - Ensure all records are maintained in compliance with regulatory and organizational standards. 

Digitization And Tech Adoption

- Utilize SAP and other digital tools to monitor production, material movement, and equipment performance in real-time. 
 - Lead the adoption of digital technologies to improve operational efficiency and automate routine tasks. 
 - Ensure the section's operations are aligned with the latest technological advancements, driving continuous process improvement. 
 - Promote the use of digital tools for reporting, maintenance tracking, and data analysis. 

Key Stakeholders - Internal

- Smelter Sections
 - Maintenance
 - QA Team

Key Stakeholders - External

- Equipment Vendors
 - Regulatory Agencies
 - External Auditors
 - Regulatory Bodies

Qualifications

Education Qualification: 

B. E in Metallurgy

Work Experience (Range Of Years)

Minimum 10 years of experience in the metallurgy industry

data.title: Mechanical Maintenance Lead (O&M- PSP Hydro)
data.description:
Responsibilities

- Ensure reliable, safe and efficient operation of all generating units, auxiliaries, and balance of plant systems. 
 - Ensures full compliance with Statutory HSS, environmental and technical requirements from central and state governmental bodies (i. e. CEA, CERC, DSA, SCEI, AP/CPCB etc. compliances). 
 - Developing safe systems of work (SSOW) procedures, including HIRA, PTW, LOTO, JSA etc. for your area. 
 - To provide oversight of all mechanical maintenance activities, management of the maintenance teams, financial control, contract management, environmental compliance, regulatory compliance, technical compliance, risk evaluations and relationship management. 
 - Prepare maintenance strategy to achieve higher reliability (maximized MTTF) and greater efficiency (minimized MTTR) and implement the maintenance plans at plant level accordingly. 
 - Lead equipment failure investigations and analysis, establish RCA framework and implement performance monitoring, corrective actions and continuous improvement methodology, for your area. 
 - Ensure O&M for mechanical systems at Hydro and PSP Assets are aligned and carried out in line to prevailing O&M practices in the organization. 
 - Implement analytical tools, procedures, protocols etc. for ensuring efficient and effective monitoring, cost and performance optimization of mechanical systems/works at Hydro and PSP Assets. 
 - Plans and leads major upgradations at Hydro and PSP assets for mechanical systems. 
 - Preparation of service contract and contract management for mechanical maintenance works outsourced to external service providers. 
 - Establishment of Computerized Maintenance Management Systems (CMMS) at plant level, taking lead for mechanical systems. 
 - Guide and support Mechanical section head Preparation and implementation of complete plant maintenance reports and checklists, including daily, monthly, quarterly, and annual reports and checklists. 
 - Guides and supports Hydro and PSP Mechanical section heads in preparation of maintenance budget, work to optimize the costs and maximize production. This includes developing and tracking the monthly, quarterly, and annual maintenance budgets. 
 - Define and monitor maintenance plans to achieve yearly Generation targets and yearly agreed Plant/Machines Availability targets. 
 - Supports mechanical section heads in plant improvement projects and modernization initiatives. 
 - Maintains plant critical spares inventory for your area, to meet the exigencies. 
 - Train and develop mechanical maintenance team at Plant and prepare a detailed training calendar for mechanical maintenance team accordingly. 
 - Develop and execute risk management strategies to mitigate maintenance related risks and ensure compliance with internal audits. 
 - Guide and support Hydro and PSP Mechanical section heads in developing Mechanical maintenance records and present the same to management on need basis. 
 - Inspects and monitors production equipment to ensure operational healthiness, maintain a cost-effective production process, by utilizing optimum resources to achieve generation targets. 
 - Support Hydro and PSP Assets for IMS implementation, documentation preparation and updating, pertaining to your area (i. e. , Mechanical systems). 
 - Provide support to Hydro and PSP Mechanical section heads in ensuring the production equipment are in good working condition, are reliable for use, and are maintained at an optimal cost. 
 - Ensures Mechanical maintenance activities are performed in a safe, professional manner and in accordance with the industry standards, original equipment manufacturer's recommendations and in line to approved standard operating procedures. 
 - Proffer solutions to solve Mechanical system related issues faced at Assets and ensure optimization of equipment reliability. 
 - Coordinate and monitor implementation of reliability centred maintenance (RCM) in conjunction with relevant section heads at Hydro and PSP Assets. 
 - Ensures compliance with industry standards, regulations, safety protocols, and safe system to work (SSOW) procedures. 
 - Staying up to date with the latest trends, innovations, and best practices in Mechanical engineering, to drive continuous improvement. 

Qualifications

- B. E/B. Tech in Electrical Engineering. 
 - 15+ years of experiene in mechanical maintenenance within hydro power generation sector. 
 - Strong knowledge of Statutory and regulatory requirements pertaining to Hydro power/ PSP Plants. 
 - Experience with CMMS (Computerized Maintenance Management Systems) for Plant maintenance works. 
 - Knowledge of analytics tools for performance optimization and risk assessment. 
 - Advanced certifications in maintenance management are preferred.

data.title: Senior AI Engineer
data.description:
Our Company

At Teradata, we believe that people thrive when empowered with better information. Teradata Autonomous Knowledge Platform activates enterprise intelligence by unifying data, knowledge and business context to achieve tangible outcomes. With Teradata, organizations can provide agents with full context for impact when it matters. Our solution lets businesses connect and scale on premises, in the cloud, or through a hybrid approach. Teradata delivers real business value with AI. 

What You'll Do

As a Senior AI Engineer, you will be a key contributor to our internal engineering AI initiatives, designing and building agent-based AI solutions that significantly enhance developer productivity across the organization. You will work on AI agents and platforms across Software Development Lifecycle and design them to be scalable, reusable, and marketplace-ready for broader adoption. 

You will operate in a technically deep, fast-paced environment, collaborating closely with platform, product, and engineering teams to shape the future of our developer-facing AI capabilities. 

In this role, you will: 

- Design, develop, and maintain high quality systems, services, and applications with an emphasis on scalability, reliability, and performance. 
 - Collaborate with cross-functional engineers and product partners to shape design and consistently deliver end to end features. 
 - Build and integrate robust RESTful APIs, ensuring security, data consistency, and maintainability. 
 - Work with SQL and NoSQL databases to implement efficient data models and service access patterns. 
 - Apply and experiment with AI/ML technologies, including agentic AI and large language models (LLMs).

You will be part of a high-performing engineering team building core components of Teradata's AI platform. You will collaborate closely with other engineers, AI/ML specialists, product managers, cloud architects, and partner teams across the company. The role offers opportunities to contribute directly to Teradata's AI product roadmap and technological direction. 

What Makes You a Qualified Candidate

 - Strong proficiency in Java, Go, or Python for service development.

 - Strong communication and collaboration skills.

- Familiarity with messaging systems such as Kafka. 
 - Experience experimenting with or implementing AI/ML technologies, Agentic AI, or LLMs. 
 - A track record of influencing design decisions and driving engineering best practices. 
 - The ability to mentor engineers and guide them through design, planning, and execution. 
 - A proactive mindset and comfort working in fast paced, dynamic environments. 
 - Curiosity, adaptability, and a passion for building impactful AI-driven products. 

Why We Think You'll Love Teradata

We prioritize a people-first culture because we know our people are at the very heart of our success. We embrace a flexible work model because we trust our people to make decisions about how, when, and where they work. We focus on well-being because we care about our people and their ability to thrive both personally and professionally. We are an anti-racist company because our dedication to Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion is more than a statement. It is a deep commitment to doing the work to foster an equitable environment that celebrates people for all of who they are. 

Teradata invites all identities and backgrounds in the workplace. We work with deliberation and intent to ensure we are cultivating collaboration and inclusivity across our global organization. We are proud to be an equal opportunity and affirmative action employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, color, ancestry, religion, creed, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, breastfeeding, or related conditions), national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, medical condition, genetic information, gender identity or expression, military and veteran status, or any other legally protected status.

data.description:
Vacancy Location Manager

Location: Lucknow, India

Lead safe, efficient and consistent food production

Tempeh today is looking for an experienced Location Manager to plan, manage and optimize production activities at our food manufacturing facility in Lucknow. 

In this role, you ensure that production runs safely, efficiently and consistently, while meeting quality standards, food-safety regulations and customer requirements. You combine strong operational knowledge with leadership skills to manage production teams and drive continuous improvement. 

Your role

As Location Manager, you oversee daily production operations, coordinate people and resources, and monitor production performance. You work closely with different departments to achieve production targets, maintain quality standards and improve operational efficiency. 

You play a key role in ensuring smooth production processes, effective teamwork and compliance with food-safety and workplace-safety requirements. 

Your responsibilities

As Location Manager, you: 

- Manage production operations: Plan and supervise daily, weekly and monthly production activities, ensuring production targets, quality standards and delivery schedules are met. 
 - Lead and develop your team: Manage production staff, shift supervisors, operators and contract workers. Allocate manpower, machinery, materials and other resources effectively, while supporting employee training, performance monitoring and development. 
 - Monitor production performance: Track production output, productivity, yield, wastage, downtime and efficiency. Monitor raw-material and packaging-material consumption to minimize waste. 
 - Ensure food safety and compliance: Maintain compliance with GMP, HACCP, food-safety, hygiene and workplace-safety requirements, as well as applicable food-manufacturing laws and company policies. 
 - Maintain operational standards: Oversee cleaning, sanitation, line clearance and changeover procedures. Ensure machines and production areas are operated and maintained according to SOPs. 
 - Coordinate across departments: Work closely with Quality Assurance, Maintenance, Stores, Procurement and Dispatch teams to ensure smooth production operations. 
 - Resolve production challenges: Investigate production issues, deviations, breakdowns and process losses, and implement corrective actions. 
 - Drive continuous improvement: Support new product trials, process improvements and production scale-up, while identifying opportunities to reduce costs and increase productivity. 
 - Maintain documentation and reporting: Keep accurate production records, batch documentation, SOPs and required reports. Prepare regular production reports and communicate operational performance to senior management. 

Who we are looking for

You are an experienced production professional with strong leadership skills and a hands-on approach to managing food manufacturing operations. You understand the importance of quality, safety and efficiency, and know how to translate production plans into daily operations. 

You Bring

- A Bachelor's degree or Diploma in Food Technology, Food Science, Production, Mechanical Engineering or a related field. 
 - Typically 10 years of experience in food manufacturing, including relevant supervisory or management experience. 
 - Strong knowledge of food production processes and manufacturing operations. 
 - Working knowledge of GMP, HACCP, food safety, hygiene and quality systems. 
 - Experience in production planning, manpower management and KPI monitoring. 
 - Good problem-solving, leadership, communication and organizational skills. 

What We Offer

- The opportunity to build a new B2B food category in India
 - A key role in developing and optimizing our production operations in India
 - An entrepreneurial and international working environment
 - Close collaboration with production, R&D, quality and supply chain
 - A competitive salary package
 - Room for initiative, ownership and professional growth

What success looks like

Your focus is on maintaining reliable production operations while continuously improving performance. Key areas include: 

- Achieving production targets and delivery schedules. 
 - Maintaining consistent product quality and food-safety standards. 
 - Improving productivity, yield and operational efficiency. 
 - Reducing wastage, downtime and process losses. 
 - Developing production teams and maintaining effective operational coordination. 

About Tempeh Today

Tempeh today produces tempeh in India and works with food companies to develop nutritious, plant-based products for Indian and international markets. We combine expertise in tempeh with local partnerships to support scalable food solutions. 

Interested?

Do you want to lead food production operations and contribute to the growth of Tempeh today in India? Send your CV and motivation to hello@tempeh. today.

data.title: Principal Engineer - Design Verification
data.description:
Renesas is one of the top global semiconductor companies in the world. We strive to develop a safer, healthier, greener, and smarter world, and our goal is to make every endpoint intelligent by offering product solutions in the automotive, industrial, infrastructure and IoT markets. Our robust product portfolio includes world-leading MCUs, SoCs, analog and power products, plus Winning Combination solutions that curate these complementary products. We are a key supplier to the world's leading manufacturers of electronics you rely on every day; you may not see our products, but they are all around you. 

Renesas employs roughly 21, 000 people in more than 30 countries worldwide. As a global team, our employees actively embody the Renesas Culture, our guiding principles based on five key elements: Transparent, Agile, Global, Innovative, and Entrepreneurial. Renesas believes in, and has a commitment to, diversity and inclusion, with initiatives and a leadership team dedicated to its resources and values. At Renesas, we want to build a sustainable future where technology helps make our lives easier. Join us and build your future by being part of what's next in electronics and the world. 

Job Description

We are seeking a diligent SoC/MCU Verification engineer to join our team at Renesas. The Verification engineer will be responsible for performing various verification tasks including Test Plan creation, Testcase creation, Coverage closure, Requirements traceability and Gate Level Simulation. They will also review system requirements and track quality assurance metrics. Ultimately, the role of the Verification Engineer is to ensure that our products, applications, and systems work correctly, safely & securely. 

Job Responsibilities: 

- Drive Verification R&D team driving technical execution and best in class methodologies used in the design of advanced microcontrollers and microprocessors. 
 - Work closely with system architects to understand high level specifications to be able to verify them. 
 - Work with various EDA vendors to deploy next generation tools 
 - Build strong collaboration with other R&D teams such as RTL, DFT, digital IP, PD, Design Enablement, Emulation, and Validation to achieve project milestones 
 - Promote continuous improvement to design techniques to ensure 'Zero Defect' chips

data.title: Senior Software Engineer
data.description:
Job Description

Role purpose

Lead substantial engineering work within a X3 squad, delivering maintainable modern capabilities while protecting X3 behaviour, upgradeability and operational continuity. 

X3 context

Sage X3 is the SaaS-readiness programme for X3: a progressive transformation from tightly coupled legacy runtime patterns towards portable, cloud-operable and upgradeable capabilities. The programme protects customer behaviour, partner IP and rollback while it modernises journeys, APIs, components, data paths, business logic, delivery automation and migration economics. 

The role contributes to outcome-owned squads. India is a scalable engineering and product delivery centre, connected to Europe and North America through deliberate overlap, shared standards, recorded decisions and continuous support of production outcomes. 

Required Technical And Domain Skills

- Strong software engineering experience delivering cloud-native SaaS platforms and distributed systems using modern programming languages such as Rust, TypeScript/Node. js, Go, Python, Java, or C#, with a track record of building secure, scalable, maintainable, and production-ready services. 
 - Strong understanding of distributed systems architecture, including service decomposition, synchronous and asynchronous communication patterns, event-driven architectures, resiliency engineering, fault tolerance, scalability, observability, eventual consistency, and failure-recovery strategies. 
 - Deep experience designing, developing, and evolving API-first platforms, including REST, GraphQL, event-driven integrations, service contracts, versioning, backward compatibility, security controls, and integration governance. 
 - Experience designing and operating solutions using relational databases and document databases, including data modeling, performance optimization, scalability, reliability, migration strategies, and operational support. 
 - Strong cloud-native engineering experience across containers, orchestration platforms, CI/CD, infrastructure automation, observability, telemetry, secure software supply chains, reliability engineering, release management, upgrade strategies, disaster recovery, and rollback mechanisms. 
 - Hands-on experience with containerization and Kubernetes. 
 - Experience defining domain boundaries, service ownership models, integration contracts, extensibility frameworks, and modernization patterns that improve maintainability, scalability, and customer continuity. 
 - Strong understanding of modern web application architecture, including React, TypeScript, component-based design, state management, accessibility, responsive design, browser performance optimization, and browser-to-service integration patterns where relevant to the domain. 
 - Ability to leverage AI-assisted engineering responsibly with appropriate human review, traceability, automated testing, security validation, and regression evidence. 
 - Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to lead technical discussions, mentor engineers, participate in architecture reviews, and collaborate effectively across globally distributed engineering teams. 

Modern Platform Skills for this Role

- Own service and API contracts, event-driven integrations, and domain boundaries within the assigned area, ensuring scalability, resilience, security, maintainability, and backward compatibility. 
 - Design and operate distributed services using modern SaaS engineering principles, including observability, performance management, fault isolation, resiliency patterns, capacity planning, and reliability engineering. 
 - Drive secure software delivery through CI/CD, supply-chain security controls, identity and secrets management, policy enforcement, automated quality gates, and infrastructure automation. 
 - Establish and maintain OpenTelemetry-compatible observability practices, including logs, metrics, traces, SLOs, operational dashboards, alerting strategies, and production diagnostics. 
 - Contribute to platform engineering capabilities through containers, orchestration, Infrastructure as Code, GitOps, self-service delivery patterns, and automation that improves developer productivity and operational excellence. 
 - Own compatibility, upgrade, migration, recovery, and rollback strategies for services under management, ensuring customer continuity and operational resilience. 

Preferred Skills

- Experience modernizing legacy business applications, ERP platforms, batch-processing systems, data migration solutions, reporting platforms, or other enterprise software environments. Legacy X3 technologies and 4GL experience are beneficial but not required. 
 - Experience building modern web applications using React, Next. js, TypeScript, design systems, micro-frontends, accessibility frameworks, and advanced user experience patterns. 
 - Experience with event-driven systems, messaging platforms, distributed data architectures, performance engineering, platform engineering, and production operations at SaaS scale. 
 - Experience with AI-assisted software development practices, including code generation, automated testing, code review workflows, security validation, traceability, and regression management. 
 - Experience operating global-scale SaaS platforms with strong reliability, observability, security, compliance, and operational governance requirements. 

Senior Software Engineer Hiring Signal

- Senior Software Engineers are expected to design, build, and operate distributed SaaS platforms, own domain-level architecture decisions, drive modernization initiatives, mentor engineers, and deliver reliable cloud-native services using technologies such as Rust, TypeScript, Go, Python, Java, or C#, while leveraging X3 domain knowledge to accelerate transformation rather than as a prerequisite for hiring. 

Experience And Qualifications

Typically 6+ years of software engineering experience delivering commercial products. Degree or equivalent practical experience in computer science, engineering or a related field. 

Professional English is required for global collaboration. Equivalent practical experience is valued alongside formal qualifications. 

Expected outcomes / success measures

- Substantial slices reach production predictably with tests, telemetry, documentation and rollback plans. 
 - Technical debt and coupling are reduced in the owned area without breaking supported customer behaviour. 
 - Code reviews, estimates and incident learning improve squad flow and engineering quality. 
 - Less experienced engineers deliver safely with useful coaching and examples. 

Measures should be agreed with the squad and reviewed through the X3 monthly scorecard and quarterly evidence gates. For this role's owned scope, show how customer behaviour and partner investment are preserved, capabilities become portable, secure, cloud-operable and upgradeable, and quality, reliability, supportability and rollback are proven. Include safe migration and improved cost or delivery economics where relevant. 

Key stakeholders and collaboration model

Collaborates with Product, Principal/Staff Engineers, Software and Automation Engineers, Architects, Cloud Support/L3, Security, Customer Services and domain specialists in Europe/North America. Owns outcomes from India with deliberate overlap for design and production conversations. 

Sage behaviours / leadership expectations

Customer Focus, Action Orientation, Trust, Innovation and Collaboration. Takes ownership, raises risks early, gives kind and precise feedback, and keeps learning visible. 

Every colleague is expected to protect customer continuity, partner investment, security and the integrity of evidence. Leaders additionally create clarity, develop talent and make accountable decisions visible. 

Key Responsibilities

Core accountabilities and decision ownership

- Break outcomes into sound designs, vertical slices and estimates; deliver production-quality code across services, APIs, UI or data paths. 
 - Make day-to-day technical decisions on component boundaries, GraphQL contracts, PostgreSQL access, observability, test strategy and safe rollout. 
 - Analyse legacy dependencies and contribute to retain, wrap, translate, rebuild or retire decisions with evidence. 
 - Review code and designs, support incident resolution and improve the squad's automation, documentation and delivery flow. 
 - Pair with and mentor Software Engineers while learning from Principal Engineers and Architects. 

Decision ownership: 

Implementation design and sequencing inside the squad, technical risk escalation, test and observability approach, and readiness of owned work for review and release. 

Common capability baseline

All X3 roles are expected to build capability in the following areas. Depth and decision scope increase with level: 

- Understand X3 customer workflows, metadata, customisation and architecture well enough to protect supported behaviour, partner investment and SaaS readiness in the decisions owned by the role. 
 - Treat the internal platform as a product: use developer and operator research, feedback and adoption evidence to reduce cognitive load; provide self-service APIs and golden paths where they solve a demonstrated need. 
 - Use cloud-native service boundaries, versioned API contracts and event integration where appropriate, preserving compatibility and clear ownership across X3 capabilities. 
 - Apply CI/CD and secure software-supply-chain controls, with identity, secrets and policy enforcement built into relevant delivery and runtime paths. 
 - Make services diagnosable with OpenTelemetry-compatible logs, metrics and traces; define role-appropriate SLOs, reliability and resilience evidence. 
 - Manage performance and cost deliberately, and engineer lifecycle, upgrade, deprecation and rollback paths as part of supported capability ownership. 
 - Use migration, reconciliation and compatibility evidence to preserve customer data and behaviour while moving towards portable, secure, cloud-operable and upgradeable capabilities. 
 - Use AI-assisted engineering securely, with human review, privacy and IP protection, regression evidence and a recovery path; use deterministic methods when they are more appropriate. 
 - Depth follows role scope: engineers demonstrate hands-on lifecycle capability in their discipline; managers, product and programme leaders, and architects need decision-relevant fluency, not universal coding or every tool. Containerization and Kubernetes are required for all engineering roles. Infrastructure as code, GitOps and a custom internal developer platform apply where the role owns those paths.

data.description:
Job Description

Role purpose

Create and maintain dependable automated checks that protect X3 customer behaviour and give X3 squads fast feedback on every change, release and migration asset. 

X3 context

Sage X3 is the SaaS-readiness programme for X3: a progressive transformation from tightly coupled legacy runtime patterns towards portable, cloud-operable and upgradeable capabilities. The programme protects customer behaviour, partner IP and rollback while it modernises journeys, APIs, components, data paths, business logic, delivery automation and migration economics. 

The role contributes to outcome-owned squads. India is a scalable engineering and product delivery centre, connected to Europe and North America through deliberate overlap, shared standards, recorded decisions and continuous support of production outcomes. 

Required Technical And Domain Skills

- Professional experience in software testing or automation and a willingness to write production-quality code. 
 - Working knowledge of one automation language and tools for API, UI or service testing. 
 - Foundational understanding of enterprise business workflows (ERP or similar), Agile delivery, CI/CD and source control. 
 - Basic SQL/data validation and REST/SOAP integration testing, with interest in batch and migration workflows. 
 - Interest in GraphQL, PostgreSQL/data paths, Web/Syracuse, observability and cloud operations. 
 - Hands-on experience with containerisation and Kubernetes. 
 - Good English communication, attention to detail and a habit of recording evidence. 

Modern platform skills for this role

- Build automated API, event, integration and regression checks into CI/CD; validate compatibility and migration reconciliation, keep failures diagnosable, and learn the team's secure artifact, telemetry and rollback practices. 

Preferred Skills

- TypeScript/JavaScript, Playwright/Cypress, API contract testing or SQL Server/Oracle. 
 - Sage X3, ERP, manufacturing, distribution or finance testing experience, including L4G/4GL or Crystal Reports. 
 - Performance, accessibility, security or migration testing exposure. 

Experience And Qualifications

Typically 2+ years in software testing, quality engineering or development, with practical automation experience. Degree, diploma or equivalent experience in computing or engineering is desirable. 

Professional English is required for global collaboration. Equivalent practical experience is valued alongside formal qualifications. 

Expected outcomes / success measures

- Stories have relevant automated checks and clear, reproducible evidence. 
 - Regression suites remain reliable and useful as components, APIs and customisations change. 
 - Defects are found earlier, described precisely and linked to customer impact. 
 - The engineer steadily expands domain knowledge and contributes to safer release and migration practice. 

Measures should be agreed with the squad and reviewed through the X3 monthly scorecard and quarterly evidence gates. Key stakeholders and collaboration model

Works with Software Engineers, Senior Automation Engineers, Product, Cloud Support/L3, Security and Customer Services in a distributed squad, with India-based execution connected to Europe/North America overlap.

Customer Focus, Action Orientation, Trust, Innovation and Collaboration. Is curious, precise, open to feedback and willing to learn the domain behind the test.

AI Infrastructure Engineer (Mid / Senior)

Location: Bengaluru (Hybrid - 3 days a week in office)

We're investing heavily in AI - building the platform that lets AI agents and assistants do real engineering work, reliably and at scale. This team designs and runs the infrastructure behind our coding agents, review agents, and internal AI assistants: the orchestration, context and memory systems, evaluation frameworks, and feedback loops that make them better over time. 

The Impact You'll Make

- Build and operate agent platforms: orchestration, tool and skill registries, plugin frameworks, and sandboxed execution. 
 - Develop coding agents and review agents that work well on real, large codebases, and integrate them into the existing SDLC (IDE, CI/CD, code review, issue tracking).

 - Own observability for agent systems: tracing, cost and latency tracking, and quality monitoring.

 - Experience with model routing, cost optimization, or prompt caching.

EIT is a centralized group within Global Risk Management responsible for independent testing of operational processes within the eight lines of business and enterprise control functions at Bank of America to ensure the company is in compliance with domestic and international laws, rules and regulations, and that risk and controls procedures are operating effectively. 

Job Description*

The Sampling & Test Development associate is responsible for designing and supporting high-quality manual and automated testing solutions through effective sampling, data validation, and governance practices. This role collaborates with Test Owners, Front Line Units, data partners, and Test Execution teams to ensure accurate data sourcing, sound sampling methodologies, and test structures that support automation. 

The associate independently acquires and validates data from internal and external sources, documents testing procedures and sampling requirements, and resolves issues related to data procurement, sample design, and test development. The role is accountable for maintaining data integrity, implementing changes to sampling requirements, and ensuring accurate tracking of testing activities within the System of Record (SOR). 

Responsibilities*

- Partner with Test Owners, Front Line Units, data providers, and Test Execution teams to develop and enhance manual and automated testing approaches. 
 - Gather, validate, and document data requirements, ensuring accurate sample populations and alignment with test objectives. 
 - Incorporate appropriate sampling methodologies and governance requirements into test plans and execution strategies. 
 - Evaluate and coordinate pilot testing activities, providing recommendations to improve test effectiveness and quality. 
 - Design, maintain, and update sampling procedures, test scripts, and support documentation. 
 - Drive test structures and methodologies that enable automation and scalable testing solutions. 
 - Participate across the testing lifecycle, including intake, planning, execution, reporting, and issue remediation, providing subject matter expertise and guidance. 
 - Analyze, manipulate, and summarize large data sets to support testing activities and deliver high-quality results. 
 - Identify and resolve data sourcing, sampling, and test design issues while maintaining data integrity and compliance standards. 
 - Maintain accurate test status, milestones, and deliverables within the System of Record (SOR). 
 - Lead initiatives focused on process improvement, automation, and operational efficiency. 
 - Escalate and drive resolution of areas requiring process refinement, policy updates, or procedural enhancements. 
 - Build and maintain strong stakeholder relationships to support effective test execution and risk management objectives. 

Requirements: 

Education details: 

Graduates or Post-Graduates in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Statistics. Tech/B. E. /B. Sc. (Statistics)/B. C. A. /M. C. A/M. Sc. (Statistics)

Experience Range: 6-8 yrs

Certifications (if Any): 

- CRCM, CAMS, FRM, CRISC, CISA
 - SQL, SAS, Python
 - PCEP / PCAP Python Certification
 - Microsoft Power BI Certification
 - Alteryx Designer Certification
 - PMP, Agile, or Scrum Certifications
 - DB2, Teradata, Oracle, SQL Server
 - Microsoft Excel, Access, PowerPoint, Word
 - JIRA, Confluence, SharePoint
 - Enterprise Data Warehouse

Foundational skills*

- Extensive experience in Audit, Testing, Quality Assurance, Risk, and Compliance functions, with Compliance or Risk-related certifications considered an advantage. 
 - Strong expertise in sampling methodologies, test design, test execution, and quality assurance frameworks, with the ability to translate business objectives into comprehensive testing requirements. 
 - Advanced technical proficiency in SQL, SAS, Python, Alteryx, Tableau, Cognos, MicroStrategy, Power BI, and other business intelligence and analytics platforms. 
 - Hands-on experience sourcing, validating, and analyzing data from diverse environments including DB2, Teradata, Oracle, SQL Server, Hadoop, Hive, and enterprise data warehouses. 
 - Strong understanding of data warehousing, data mining, data acquisition, and automation concepts, with a proven ability to identify and implement efficiency improvements through automation. 
 - Advanced Microsoft Office skills, particularly Excel, including data analytics, Pivot Tables, Power Query, Lookups, dashboards, and reporting solutions. 
 - Demonstrated project management capabilities with the ability to manage multiple competing priorities, meet service level agreements (SLAs), and deliver high-quality outcomes in a fast-paced environment. 
 - Exceptional analytical, critical-thinking, research, and problem-solving skills with the ability to independently solve complex business and technical challenges. 
 - Strong business acumen and extensive functional knowledge, coupled with the ability to assess risk, evaluate control effectiveness, and drive operational excellence. 
 - Excellent verbal, written, and business communication skills, including the ability to influence stakeholders and effectively engage with senior leadership. 
 - Proven ability to build strong partnerships, collaborate across multiple lines of business, and influence stakeholders to achieve strategic objectives. 
 - Self-motivated, adaptable, and highly organized professional capable of working independently with minimal supervision while maintaining a strong team-oriented mindset. 
 - Strong attention to detail, issue management, time management, quality focus, and commitment to continuous improvement. 
 - Demonstrates courage, accountability, and sound judgment while navigating complex business, regulatory, and operational environments. 

Work Timings: 12: 30 to 21: 30

Job Location: GIFT City / Mumbai

data.title: Associate Director - Design Assurance & Product Management - Independent Design Assurance
data.description:
GSK remains committed to achieving bold commercial ambitions for the future. By 2031, we aim to deliver £40 billion in annual sales, leveraging our existing strong performance momentum to significantly increase our positive impact on the health of billions of patients globally. Our Ahead Together strategy is centred on early intervention to prevent and alter the course of disease, thereby protecting people and supporting healthcare systems. 

Our diverse portfolio consists of vaccines, specialty medicines, and general medicines. 

Through continuous innovation and a dedicated focus on scientific and technical excellence, we strive to develop and launch new, groundbreaking treatments that address critical health challenges. 

Domain focus: Independent Design Assurance across all Cyber Architecture and Solutions security domains, including Cryptography and AI Security. 

Job Purpose: 

Lead the Design Assurance practice, an eight-role team, as the most senior independent reviewer in Cyber Architecture and Solutions. You own the assurance methodology, review standards and assurance register, and manage reviewer capacity against demand. Accountable for pre-production architecture review, technical consultation and BAU design assurance. 

About the team: 

Design Assurance and Product Management makes sure security is designed in before anything is built, and that GSK's security capabilities are run as products rather than projects. Design Assurance independently verifies that solutions meet the architecture standards set elsewhere in Cyber Architecture and Solutions; it writes none of those standards, and that separation is what makes the review worth anything. Product Management owns the security portfolio, vendor governance and investment analytics, and is how GSK manages its managed service vendor as a whole. Platform support engineering moves into this function, with a small internal team retaining oversight while the vendor operates more than 30 platforms and the data fabric under an OTO model. Seventeen roles. 

What makes this role different. You lead an eight-person practice that issues binding go/no-go determinations on tools before they reach production - and you assure against architecture standards written elsewhere in Cyber Architecture and Solutions, which you do not own and must not rewrite. That separation is what makes the review worth anything, and it will be tested by programmes with committed go-live dates. Coverage spans every Cyber Architecture and Solutions domain including Cryptography and AI Security, so you need enough architecture literacy to arbitrate a finding in a domain you have never personally built in. The practice is subject to internal audit and regulatory inspection, and the assurance register and finding classification are yours to defend. 

Key responsibilities: 

This role will provide you the opportunity to lead key activities to progress your career. These responsibilities include some of the following: 

- Lead the Design Assurance practice of eight and own its capability plan across every Cyber Architecture and Solutions domain, including Cryptography and PQC and AI Security. 
 - Issue binding go/no-go determinations on tools before production, and own the consequences when a programme with a committed date does not get the answer it wanted. 
 - Approve the assurance methodology, review standards and the Critical, High, Medium and Low classification scheme, and defend both under audit. 
 - Verify against architecture standards set elsewhere in Cyber Architecture and Solutions and write none of them, because that separation is what makes the assurance opinion worth anything. 
 - Manage reviewer capacity and tiering so high-risk designs get full review and low-risk change moves through pattern-based self-attestation with sampling. 
 - Assure vendor-delivered designs to exactly the same standard as internally delivered ones, including configuration handed over under the managed service model. 
 - Own pre-production architecture review, technical consultation and BAU design assurance across the estate. 
 - Feed recurring findings back to the architecture domains as standards gaps rather than reviewing the same defect repeatedly. 
 - Own assurance throughput, turnaround, first-time-pass and defect escape metrics, and defend them under challenge. 
 - Lead the practice's response to internal audit and regulatory inspection, including the evidence that reviews operated rather than merely existed. 
 - Lead your team in using approved AI tools to improve productivity and ways of working, role-modelling responsible use and follow GSK's Responsible AI, privacy and security requirements. 

Basic Qualifications: 

- 15+ years in cyber security, including leading technical or specialist teams - domain focus: independent Design Assurance across all Cyber Architecture and Solutions security domains, including Cryptography and AI Security
 - Leading an independent design assurance practice - methodology, review standards and assurance register - issuing binding go/no-go decisions on tools pre-production and in BAU
 - Protecting independence from architecture under programme pressure - verifying against standards owned elsewhere, never writing them, and assuring vendor-delivered designs to the same standard as internal ones
 - Sponsoring automation of review intake, evidence capture, drift checks and reporting, managing reviewer capacity against demand and feeding recurring findings back as standards gaps
 - Assuring AI-enabled tools and agentic solutions against AI security standards, and using AI to accelerate review and evidence captureAssuring AI-enabled tools and agentic solutions against AI security standards, including the evidence standard an AI-assisted review must still meet

Preferred Qualifications: 

- Architecture literacy to challenge senior architects' designs without owning the standards
 - Evidencing assurance to internal audit and regulators, including GxP documentation standards - using automated evidence capture and reporting
 - Developing and leading a team of senior reviewers and analysts
 - Executive stakeholder influence - holding a contested finding with senior leaders
 - Experience defending an assurance opinion to an audit committee or a regulator when the first line disagreed with it. 
 - Qualifications: Bachelor's degree in a relevant discipline, or equivalent professional experience. 
 - Typical tools and technologies: Design assurance methodology, review standards and assurance register, finding classification and assessment scoring, architecture review tooling, SABSA or TOGAF reference models, ServiceNow workflow, Power BI for assurance metrics, GxP-compliant documentation and evidence management. 

#AGTech

Skills

AI Agent Security, AI for Cybersecurity, Application Security, Central Authentication Service (CAS), Cloud Security, Computer Programming, Cryptography, Data Security, Design Assurance, Identity Access Management (IAM), Independent Decision-Making, Information Systems, Infrastructure Security, ML Security, Operating Systems Security, Scripting, Security Engineering, Security Technologies, Security Testing, Vulnerability Management

Why GSK?

Uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. 

GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. We aim to positively impact the health of 2. 5 billion people by the end of the decade, as a successful, growing company where people can thrive. We get ahead of disease by preventing and treating it with innovation in specialty medicines and vaccines. We focus on four therapeutic areas: respiratory, immunology and inflammation; oncology; HIV; and infectious diseases - to impact health at scale. 

People and patients around the world count on the medicines and vaccines we make, so we're committed to creating an environment where our people can thrive and focus on what matters most. Our culture of being ambitious for patients, accountable for impact and doing the right thing is the foundation for how, together, we deliver for patients, shareholders and our people. 

Inclusion at GSK: 

As an employer committed to Inclusion, we encourage you to reach out if you need any adjustments during the recruitment process. 

Please contact our Recruitment Team at IN. recruitment-adjustments@gsk. com to discuss your needs. 

Important notice to Employment businesses/ Agencies

GSK does not accept referrals from employment businesses and/or employment agencies in respect of the vacancies posted on this site. All employment businesses/agencies are required to contact GSK's commercial and general procurement/human resources department to obtain prior written authorization before referring any candidates to GSK. The obtaining of prior written authorization is a condition precedent to any agreement (verbal or written) between the employment business/ agency and GSK. In the absence of such written authorization being obtained any actions undertaken by the employment business/agency shall be deemed to have been performed without the consent or contractual agreement of GSK. GSK shall therefore not be liable for any fees arising from such actions or any fees arising from any referrals by employment businesses/agencies in respect of the vacancies posted on this site. 

It has come to our attention that the names of GlaxoSmithKline or GSK or our group companies are being used in connection with bogus job advertisements or through unsolicited emails asking candidates to make some payments for recruitment opportunities and interview. Please be advised that such advertisements and emails are not connected with the GlaxoSmithKline group in any way. 

GlaxoSmithKline does not charge any fee whatsoever for recruitment process. Please do not make payments to any individuals / entities in connection with recruitment with any GlaxoSmithKline (or GSK) group company at any worldwide location. Even if they claim that the money is refundable. 

If you come across unsolicited email from email addresses not ending in gsk. com or job advertisements which state that you should contact an email address that does not end in "gsk. com", you should disregard the same and inform us by emailing askus@gsk. com, so that we can confirm to you if the job is genuine.

data.title: Sr Principal SoC DFT Engineer
data.description:

Introduction

GlobalFoundries is seeking a Senior Principal SoC Design-for-Test Engineer to serve as a senior technical authority for complex custom SoC designs. The successful candidate will define DFT strategy and architecture, solve critical problems of exceptional complexity, drive scalable innovation across programs, and influence cross-functional technical direction from concept through high-volume manufacturing. 

Key Responsibilities

- Define DFT strategy, architecture, methodology, and signoff criteria for complex SoCs and multiple interdependent technical areas. 
 - Lead high-impact DFT initiatives spanning planning, risk management, execution, manufacturing readiness, silicon quality, and test cost. 
 - Architect scalable solutions for scan and ATPG, compression, memory test and repair, logic BIST, test access, boundary scan, IJTAG, and mixed-signal test. 
 - Establish readiness and signoff frameworks, close critical risks, and provide evidence-based recommendations to engineering and program leadership. 
 - Solve critical DFT problems of exceptional complexity and establish reusable approaches across products and teams. 
 - Lead cross-functional resolution of issues involving architecture, RTL, DV, PD, firmware, product engineering, manufacturing test, and post-silicon teams. 
 - Drive DFT innovation, automation, and technical tradeoffs while mentoring senior engineers and influencing customers, partners, and senior stakeholders. 

Other Responsibilities

- Perform all activities in a safe and responsible manner and support all Environmental, Health, Safety & Security requirements and programs

Required Qualifications

- Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field with 10+ years of relevant experience; or bachelor's degree with 15+ years of relevant experience. 
 - Exceptional mastery of SoC DFT and demonstrated recognition as a senior technical authority across programs or technical areas. 
 - Expert-level experience with scan and ATPG, compression, memory test and repair, test clocking and access, boundary scan, and hierarchical DFT. 
 - Experience defining DFT implementation, verification, readiness, and signoff criteria across IP, subsystem, partition, and SoC levels. 
 - Experience across the silicon lifecycle, including architecture, RTL integration, physical implementation, pattern generation, tapeout, silicon bring-up, and high-volume manufacturing. 
 - Deep understanding of fault models, test coverage, diagnosis, outgoing quality, test time, manufacturing risk, and test cost. 
 - Experience with major DFT EDA toolchains (prefer SNPS) and automation using Python, Tcl, Perl, Shell, or equivalent languages. 
 - Demonstrated ability to solve exceptionally complex problems, lead across organizational boundaries, influence senior stakeholders, and communicate technical and business tradeoffs. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience with advanced DFT methodologies such as hierarchical ATPG, streaming scan, logic BIST, scan diagnosis, cell-aware test, or lifecycle test. 
 - Experience with memory repair, NVM test, eFuse, IEEE 1149. 1 boundary scan, IEEE 1687 IJTAG. 
 - Experience with low-power, tester-correlation, silicon-debug, and high-reliability DFT requirements. 
 - Track record of developing reusable DFT architectures, automation, reference flows, and signoff methodologies across multiple SoC programs.

Good to have skills : Java (Programming Language), TestNG
